assassin_danger_0001.chinese: 就算关于他们的谣言只有一半是真的，你也要在他们看到你之前就把他们全都干掉。
assassin_danger_0001.english: If even half the rumors about them are true, you're going to want to take them out long before they see you coming.

assassin_danger_0002.chinese: 显然，他们几乎是此区域内最危险的分子。不要犯了低估他们的错误。
assassin_danger_0002.english: Apparently, this is supposed to be one of the more dangerous hitters in the sector. Do not make the mistake of underestimating them.

assassin_danger_0003.chinese: 确保狩猎时武装到牙齿，我觉得你或许得这样才能干掉他们。
assassin_danger_0003.english: Make sure to bring your full arsenal when you go hunting. Something tells me you might need it to take them down.

assassin_danger_0004.chinese: 提醒你一下，像 ~mission(TargetName|Last) 这样的人是很难拿下的。你想要干掉他们？那得又快又狠。
assassin_danger_0004.english: Word of warning, no way someone like ~mission(TargetName|Last) is going down easy. You want to take them out? Do it hard and fast.

assassin_fps_boss_obj_long_01.chinese: 消灭敌对目标并吸引出 ~mission(TargetName) 。
assassin_fps_boss_obj_long_01.english: Draw out ~mission(TargetName) by eliminating enough hostile forces.

assassin_fps_boss_obj_short_01.english: Eliminate Hostiles To Draw Out Target

assassin_fps_targetonly_obj_long_01.chinese: 将火力集中在目标上，不要造成误伤其他人。
assassin_fps_targetonly_obj_long_01.english: Limit focus to the target and do not cause collateral damage.

assassin_location_0001.chinese: 他们最后被发现的坐标
assassin_location_0001.english: the coordinates where they were last spotted

assassin_location_0003.english: where they like to hang out

assassin_location_0004.chinese: 他们经常出没的地方之一
assassin_location_0004.english: one of the spots they're known to frequent

assassin_multiplayer_0001.chinese: 值得一提的是，你可能会遇到一些竞争，因为这不是一个专属合约。
assassin_multiplayer_0001.english: Probably worth it to mention you might run in to some competition out there since this isn't an exclusive contract.

assassin_multiplayer_0002.chinese: 本合约不具有排他性。谁先完成谁受益。
assassin_multiplayer_0002.english: This contract is non-exclusive. First-come, first-serve.

assassin_multiplayer_0003.chinese: 正如你所知道的，你很可能不是唯一的猎人，因为 ~mission(Client) 做成了开放合约。
assassin_multiplayer_0003.english: And just so you know, you most likely won't be the only one on the hunt since the ~mission(Client) made this an open contract.

assassin_multiplayer_0004.chinese: 你应该预料到在这方面会有一些激烈的竞争。外面有很多人渴望看到这个人渣一劳永逸地死去。
assassin_multiplayer_0004.english: You should expect there to be some stiff competition on this. A lot of people out there are eager to see this scum dead once and for all.

assassin_phrase_0006.chinese: 看来你今年的生日来得早了
assassin_phrase_0006.english: Looks like your birthday came early this year

assassin_timed_0001.chinese: 你在这件事上拖拖拉拉的话，他们消失了可别惊讶。
assassin_timed_0001.english: You drag your feet on this, don't be surprised if they vanish.

assassin_timed_0002.chinese: 对这这么狡猾的家伙来说，你在他们逃跑前干掉他们的机会稍纵即逝。
assassin_timed_0002.english: With a slippery bastard like this, you might only have a limited window of opportunity to hit them before they go to ground.

assassin_timed_0003.chinese: 这事昨天就该成了。别瞎忙活，赶紧完事。
assassin_timed_0003.english: Need this taken care of yesterday. Drop everything and get it done now.

assassin_timed_0004.chinese: 紧急是对这事的轻描淡写。客户已经和我联系了三次，问完事了没。
assassin_timed_0004.english: Urgent's an understatement on this one. Client's already comm'd me three times to ask if it's done yet.

covalexrand_reference_0001.english: A friend of a friend said you'd be up to doing something like this, so figured it couldn't hurt to ask.

covalexrand_reference_0002.chinese: 我听说你可能去过那个空间站一次，所以你能帮我做这件事再好不过了。
covalexrand_reference_0002.english: I heard that you may have been out to the station once already, so you'd be perfect to help me with this.

covalexrand_reference_0003.chinese: 伊莱恩·沃德说过你可能是干这事的行家。
covalexrand_reference_0003.english: Elaine Ward mentioned that you might be a good person to help with this.

covalexrand_reference_0004.chinese: 我听说了你在那空间站做的调查工作，我想既然你已经了解了那的地形你会是最合适的人选。
covalexrand_reference_0004.english: I heard about the investigation work you did at the station, and figured since you know the lay of the land already you'd be the perfect person to hit up.

covalexrand_reference_0005.chinese: 你以前去过贡多，对吧？再去一次对你来说不是什么大问题。
covalexrand_reference_0005.english: You've been to Gundo before, right? Makes sense that going back shouldn't be that big of an issue for you.

covalexrand_timed_0001.chinese: 这整件事花了这么长时间，如果能尽快搞定就太好了。
covalexrand_timed_0001.english: This whole thing has been taking so long, it'd be great to get this wrapped up as fast as possible.

covalexrand_timed_0002.chinese: 在这一点上我几乎失去了耐心，要是你能尽快把包裹运给我，那就太好了。
covalexrand_timed_0002.english: I've pretty much run out of patience at this point. Anything you can do to get the package to me as quickly as possible would be great.

covalexrand_timed_0003.chinese: 这包裹在延迟之前就很急，现在更是如此，昨天就该送到。
covalexrand_timed_0003.english: This delivery was urgent before the delay and now it's more so. Need it delivered yesterday.

covalexrand_timed_0004.chinese: 我不知道你是否可以做些什么来节省时间，但是你越快把包裹运给我越好。
covalexrand_timed_0004.english: Not sure if there is anything you can do to save some time, but the faster you get the package to me the better.

crus_histmarker_text_15.chinese: 十字军首席执行官凯利·卡普兰十分喜爱赛琳这里的地貌，她甚至要求用她的爱犬朱利普的名字来命名这个山谷。

destroyprobeillegal_danger_0001.chinese: 你可能会遇上一些麻烦. 这些东西下线之后安保一定不会多高兴的.

destroyprobeillegal_danger_0002.english: If I were you, I'd approach cautiously. You never know who else might be out there.

destroyprobeillegal_danger_0003.chinese: 只是提醒下，有时他们会派安保来守着这些东西. 所以记得做好准备，或者带些帮手.
destroyprobeillegal_danger_0003.english: Just a head's up, sometimes they post up some security to guard these things. So bring a gun... or five.

destroyprobeillegal_danger_0004.chinese: 你可能会遇上些麻烦，但那也算一种乐趣，对吧?
destroyprobeillegal_danger_0004.english: There's a chance you'll run into trouble, but that's part of the fun, right?

destroyprobeillegal_danger_0005.chinese: 多注意下背后. 安保通常会对这种行动有很激烈的反应.
destroyprobeillegal_danger_0005.english: Watch your back, though. Security gets all worked up when these things get messed with.

destroyprobeillegal_timed_0001.chinese: 在完成这个之前没人会派活给你，所以尽快完成.

destroyprobeillegal_timed_0002.english: The clock's ticking on this one.

destroyprobeillegal_timed_0003.chinese: 速战速决，但也别搞砸了.了解?
destroyprobeillegal_timed_0003.english: Finish this fast, but don't be dumb about it. Got it?

destroyprobeillegal_timed_0004.chinese: 真的需要有人去处理它.而且要尽快.

destroyprobelegal_danger_0001.chinese: 有挺大的机会可能遇到在这管事的，所以注意点.
destroyprobelegal_danger_0001.english: There's a good chance that whoever's responsible might be in the area, so be careful.

destroyprobelegal_danger_0002.english: Intel suggests that the outlaws will come after anyone who messes with their property, so be prepared.

destroyprobelegal_danger_0003.chinese: 这份合约有相当高的战斗风险，所以做好相应对策.
destroyprobelegal_danger_0003.english: This contract has a high risk of combat, so plan accordingly.

destroyprobelegal_danger_0004.chinese: 敌意接触的可能性十分高.
destroyprobelegal_danger_0004.english: Chance of hostile contact is very high.

destroyprobelegal_danger_0005.chinese: 你在那可能会遇到敌人的抵抗。
destroyprobelegal_danger_0005.english: You should expect hostile resistance when you're out there.

destroyprobelegal_informant_0004.chinese: 我们的一位“消息提供者”

destroyprobelegal_timed_0002.english: The higher-ups are desperate to get this problem resolved. You'll need to move quickly on this.

destroyprobelegal_timed_0004.chinese: 确保你没什么别的事.因为这东西需要马上处理.

destroyprobelegal_timed_0005.english: Time is of the essence, so move quickly.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1101.chinese: 这些飞行员可没有退缩。

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1102.chinese: 虽然撞击其他飞行员会阻止他们获胜，但这也通常会导致你完全输掉。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1102.english: While crashing into the other pilots may stop them from winning, it often has the adverse affect of causing you to lose as well.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1103.chinese: 他们太快了！希望他们能保持控制。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1103.english: They clipped! Hopefully they can maintain control.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1104.chinese: 我虽然数学不好，但我可以肯定的是，两个物体以这样的速度撞上大约等于一千吨的...嗷呜。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1104.english: I don't know the exact maths, but I am fairly certain that two objects hitting at these speeds is equal to about a metric ton of uh-oh.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1105.chinese: 他们就像在泰拉的普莱姆的一家俱乐部里一样互相碰撞。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1105.english: They're bumping each other like they're at a club on Terra Prime.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1106.chinese: 我不知道，像这样的撞击他们还能承受多少次。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1106.english: I don't know how many more hits like that they can take.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1107.chinese: 哎哟！这场比赛结束后可能有人需要治疗了。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1107.english: Ouch! Someone's going to need some medgel after this race.

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1108.chinese: 这就是为什么在比赛中我们有这样的说法：“飞船可不能赢得漂亮。”
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1108.english: And that's why in racing we have the saying, "ships don't win pretty."

dlg_sc_mc_collision_1109.chinese: 这就是我说的临时工作。
dlg_sc_mc_collision_1109.english: Now that's what I call a bang up job.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_dfm_newhorizonspeedwa.chinese: 新地平线赛道真的证明了是一个有需要用脑比赛的赛场。

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2101.chinese: 关于穆雷比赛有趣的一点是，关于速度和敏捷，火力和防守的争论至今仍未停止。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2101.english: One of the great things about Murray racing is how the debate over speed vs. agility vs. firepower vs defense still rages to this day.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2102.chinese: 令人震惊的是，似乎没有一种方法可以赢得这场比赛。拥有最快的船也无济于事。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2102.english: It really is austounding how there seems to be no one way to win this race. Having the fastest ship means nothing if you're going to get your ass blown off.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2103.chinese: 我想起了2938年的一次比赛，当时所有飞船的航行速度都非常快。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2103.english: I'm reminded of a similar race in 2938 where all the ships also went around a track very fast.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2104.chinese: 很难相信，曾经有一段时间穆雷杯真的只是一个名叫穆雷的家伙所拥有的一个杯子。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2104.english: Hard to believe that there was a time when the Murray Cup was just a cup owned by a guy named Murray.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2105.chinese: 新地平线是杯赛的最新赛道，它需要飞行员努力掌握赛道所有细微的特点，但它却又具有不稳定性。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2105.english: New Horizon, a recent edition to the Cup, has been divisive amongst pilots as they strive to master all its nuances.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2106.chinese: 很难想象那些最初的穆雷杯赛中的选手是使用行星来标记航向的。他们应该也很难想到当今赛道的创新。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2106.english: It's hard to imagine what those original Murray Cup racers, using planets to mark the course, would think of today's track innovations.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2108.chinese: 在穆雷杯预选赛中，应对新地平线赛道的艰巨挑战是一个共同的烦恼。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2108.english: Dealing with the sheer difficulty of this New Horizon course is a common theme in these Murray Cup qualifiers.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2109.chinese: 在这样的比赛中，应付压力和疲劳几乎和你驾驶的飞船一样重要。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2109.english: Dealing with stress and fatigue may almost be as important in a race like this as is the ship you fly.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2110.chinese: 这不是你来学打架的地方。最好的选择是闭上眼睛，然后好好驾驶。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2110.english: This course is not one you want to fight against. The best bet is to close your eyes and just go along for the ride.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2111.chinese: 鲜为人知的是，该赛道最开始的设计理念，就是让这些飞行员在飞行时吓哭。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_lore_2111.english: Little known fact, this raceway was designed from the ground up to make these pilots gently weep to themselves as they fly.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.chinese: 关于穆雷比赛有趣的一点是，关于速度和敏捷，火力和防守的争论至今仍未停止。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.english: One of the great things about Murray racing is how the debate over speed vs. agility vs. firepower vs defense still rages to this day.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.chinese: 令人震惊的是，似乎没有一种方法可以赢得这场比赛。拥有最快的船也无济于事。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.english: It really is austounding how there seems to be no one way to win this race. Having the fastest ship means nothing if you're going to get your ass blown off.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.chinese: 我想起了2938年的一次比赛，当时所有飞船的航行速度都非常快。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.english: I'm reminded of a similar race in 2938 where all the ships also went around a track very fast.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_murray_cup_loregen_ch.chinese: 很难相信，曾经有一段时间穆雷杯真的只是一个名叫穆雷的家伙所拥有的一个杯子。

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1902.chinese: 我问这场比赛的飞行员，你能飞得更快些吗？如果答案是可以，那么请再快一点。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1902.english: To the pilots in this race I ask, can you go faster? And if yes, then please, go faster.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1903.chinese: 新地平线赛道以其棘手的转弯以及它的新地平线而闻名于整个竞速圈。

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1904.chinese: 作为解说员，保持公正是很重要的，但是作为竞速迷，我希望有人能快速冲线。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1904.english: As an announcer it is important that I remain impartial, however as a race fan I got to say, I hope someone crashes soon.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1905.chinese: 由于赛道如此之大，有时飞行员可能很难完全掌握自己的节奏。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1905.english: With a race track this huge, it can sometimes be difficult for pilots to get a full handle on the pacing they need to set for themselves.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1906.chinese: 当您知道飞船确实运转良好时，才能做出一些极限操作并设法保持优势。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1906.english: That's when you know the ships are really handling well, when they can pull a ring like that and manage to hold the line.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1907.chinese: 今天的比赛变得真的具有突破性了。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1907.english: Today's race is turning out to be a real stick breaker.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1908.chinese: 您经常会听到人们为发动机的最大输出功率而苦恼，但是我每天都在调试更精确的推进器机动性能。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1908.english: You'll often hear people grunting over max engine output, but give me precise maneuvering thrusters any day.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1909.chinese: 许多飞行员在比赛中已经把饮用水换成保湿凝胶，只是为了从船上减少那珍贵的几克重量。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1909.english: Many of the pilots have switched from drinking water during the race to a hydrating gel, just to shave off those few precious grams from their ship's weight.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1910.chinese: 而这就是一个极大的冒险。我们必须看看他们是否太过极端。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1910.english: Big risk there. We'll have to see if they made their move a little too early.

dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1911.chinese: 这些仪表环只能挤在弹丸之地，对以如此高的速度航行的飞船构成了重大风险。
dlg_sc_mc_gen_chat_race_banter_1911.english: With barely meters to spare, these rings pose a significant risk to ships at these intense speeds.

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0602.chinese: 我们有一名飞行员在赛道上走错路，因此值得指出的是，您越过终点线的方向实际上很重要。
dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0602.english: We have one pilot going the wrong way round the track, so it may be worth specifying that the direction in which you cross the finish line does in fact matter.

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0603.chinese: 注意，飞行员航向错误，你走错路了。
dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0603.english: Attention to the pilot going the wrong way, you are going the wrong way.

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0604.chinese: 您必须问，看着这艘船以错误的方式飞行，他们是否对这些飞行员进行了预检查？
dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0604.english: Watching this ship fly the wrong way, you have to ask, are they pre-screening these pilots?

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0606.chinese: 当飞行员朝错误的方向前进时，我们再次提到对嗑药的管理尚待完善。

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0607.chinese: 竞速迷们，我们可能离坠机时刻不远了，因为一名飞行员不顾自己或他人的生命，朝错误的方向飞行。

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0608.chinese: 似乎我们的比赛中有人逆行。

dlg_sc_mc_going_wrong_way_0609.chinese: 这是如此的危险，但我绝不会掉头。

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0702.chinese: 你知道那些比赛指导员在那里是有原因的。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0702.english: Those racing guides are there for a reason, you know.

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0703.chinese: 比赛结束后，他们像憨憨一样到处乱飞。无法排成一条直线。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0703.english: They're flying like a Jumpers fan after a match. Incapable of going in a straight line.

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0704.chinese: 有人想让他们回到赛道吗？
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0704.english: Anyone want to nudge them back on course?

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0705.chinese: 由于这些飞行员在保持航向上遇到很多麻烦，您可能会怀疑他们实际上并不想参加比赛。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0705.english: With the trouble these pilots are having staying on the course, you might suspect that they don't actually want to be in the race.

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0706.chinese: 以如此高的速度控制这些飞船并非易事，另一名飞行员就冲出了赛道。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0706.english: Controlling these ships at speeds this high is no easy task, as another pilot slips outside the track.

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0708.chinese: 发生什么了？他们冲出了赛道！
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0708.english: What is going on here? They're off the track!

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0709.chinese: 那个选手手跑得很偏...真的很偏...偏到了赛道外。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0709.english: That racer went wide... real wide... off the track wide.

dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0710.chinese: 看起来我们有了个违规的，这名选手并没有按着赛道表示标识线走。
dlg_sc_mc_leaving_track_0710.english: Looks like we have a rebel, who's not going to be penned in by your racing lines.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1401.english: That pilot's got some work to do to make up for lost ground.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1402.chinese: 得与失，这位飞行员选择了失。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1402.english: Use it or lose it, and that pilot clearly chose lose it.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1403.chinese: 快看看，画面只丢失的一秒钟，另一名飞行员就轻松把他给超了。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1403.english: There you go, lose focus for even a second, and another pilot is there to pick up the slack.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1404.chinese: 你不得不问问，一个飞行员怎么才能放弃这么好的位置。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1404.english: You've got to ask how a pilot could just give up their position like that.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1405.chinese: 那将是一个代价惨痛的教训。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1405.english: That is going to be a costly mistake.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1406.chinese: 稍有落后，您不会想在比赛中落后。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1406.english: Falling behind. Not something you want to do in races or in taxes for that matter.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1407.chinese: 这不是坏运气就是好运气，当然这取决于你在为谁加油呐。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1407.english: That's either a rough bit of luck, or a great bit of luck, dependant, of course, on who you are cheering for.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1408.chinese: 当飞行员们相互竞争的时候，你就能看出来谁真有两把刷子，谁得回家好好写简历了。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1408.english: As pilots are eclipsed by their competitors, you can really tell who's got what it takes, and who's got to get their resume into shape.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1409.chinese: 成败在此一举了，而其中一些飞行员显然已经崩溃了。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1409.english: It's make or break time, and some of these pilots are just plain broken.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1410.chinese: 资格赛与这场比赛同等重要，显然在比赛中保持自己头脑清醒至关重要。
dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1410.english: A qualifier as important as this, it's so important to keep your head in the game.

dlg_sc_mc_lose_position_1411.chinese: 可能就是这样，这可能就是这场比赛的决定性转折点了。

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1201.english: A pilot overtakes the competition, and gamblers everywhere sweat a little bit more.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1202.chinese: 排位有了新的变化，这说明不到越过终点线的最后一刻，谁胜谁负，犹未可知。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1202.english: We've got a change in position and a reminder that nothing is certain till they cross that final line.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1203.english: We've got a pilot making their move.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1204.chinese: 在今天的新地平线赛道上充分展示了一场咄咄逼人的飞行表演。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1204.english: Aggressive flying on full display at New Horizon today.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1205.chinese: 一些专业的处理让这个赛车手取得了领先地位。

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1206.chinese: 当梯队中的赛车手冲到前面，我们也跟着激动起来。

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1207.chinese: 这是一个该为自己感到满意的赛车手。

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1208.chinese: 一旦赛车手们进入状态，他们就会有明显的提升。

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1209.chinese: 而那些赛车迷们就是为什么直到越过终点线前，八字还没一撇的原因。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_position_1209.english: And that racefans, is why nothing's settled till the finish line is crossed.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.chinese: 而那些赛车迷们就是为什么直到越过终点线前，八字还没一撇的原因。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.english: And that racefans, is why nothing's settled till the finish line is crossed.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.chinese: 插队，甚至粗鲁的碰撞，在赛道上都被完美的诠释了。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.english: Cutting in line, rude at the souk, perfectly acceptable on the raceway.

dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.chinese: 这是一个外科手术式的举动，来跨过他们之间的竞争。
dlg_sc_mc_moving_up_positionmoving_up_po.english: That was a surgical move right there to slip past their competition.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1301.english: It's a battle for the ages.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1302.chinese: 这令人难以置信。这两个竞争对手谁都不会放弃领先优势。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1302.english: This is unbelievable. These two competitors are absolutely refusing to give up that edge.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1303.chinese: 他们真的在努力争夺排位。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1303.english: They are really jockeying for position.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1304.chinese: 这些赛车手似乎决心不给对方任何喘息的机会。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1304.english: These racers seemed determined to not give each other any breathing room.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1305.english: This is looking like it's going to be too close to call.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1306.chinese: 这些飞行员似乎都没有准备好放弃领先地位。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1306.english: Neither of these pilots seems ready to let go of the lead.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1307.chinese: 因为这些飞行员拼命地尝试追寻更快的速度，因此他们势如水火。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1307.english: We are nosecone to nosecone as these pilots try desperately to find some more speed.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1309.chinese: 在如此激烈的比赛中，我打赌这些赛车手会后悔没把那些摇头娃娃从自己飞船上的仪表显示器上拿走。
dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1309.english: With a race this close, I bet these pilots are regretting not removing that bobblehead from the dash.

dlg_sc_mc_neck_and_neck_1310.english: Who's it gonna be? Who's it gonna be?!?

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0901.chinese: 我最近有没有说过我是多么感激他们为这项运动增加了枪械？
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0901.english: Have I said recently how grateful I am they added guns to this sport?

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0902.chinese: 警告的枪声划过了船头，或者更确切地说，直接射进了船头。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0902.english: A warning shot fired across the bow, or rather, straight into it.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0903.chinese: 在这里真正的诀窍在于维持目标锁定，而不是松开油门。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0903.english: The real trick here is maintaing target lock, while not letting up on the throttle.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0904.chinese: 控制住你的射击。每个人都讨厌胡乱的扫射。太不体面了。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0904.english: Pick your shots.  Everyone hates spray and pray. So undignified.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0905.chinese: 我们看的是真正的有进攻性的飞行。您的喜爱在这里不会被辜负。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0905.english: We're seeing some real offensive flying. No love lost here.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0906.chinese: 棒极了！太棒了！那真是一个精彩绝伦的射击。如果比赛像这样激烈的进行下去，真不知道我的嗓子还能坚持多久。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0906.english: YES! Yes! That was a marvelous shot. If the race continues like this, not sure how much longer my voice will last.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0907.chinese: 在穆雷杯竞赛中，飞船速度是很快，但是射击速度往往更快。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0907.english: In Murray Cup racing, the ships are fast, but the guns are often faster.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0908.chinese: 枪声四起，竞争更激烈了。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0908.english: Shots are fired and the competition is thinned.

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0909.chinese: 又一个竞争对手倒下了。

dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0910.chinese: 这是一场持久战，总会有人在枪口绽放的的火焰中倒下。
dlg_sc_mc_open_fire_ship_destroyed_0910.english: It was a battle for the ages, but someone had to go down in flames.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0501.chinese: 这...这简直是可怕的飞行。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0501.english: This... this is just dreadful flying.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0503.english: The pack is really starting to separate.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0504.chinese: 在后面梯队中的许多驾驶员，他们只是还没有机会展示自己的实力。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0504.english: There are so many drivers in the rear of this pack who have just not had the opportunity yet to show what they can do.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0505.chinese: 看起来有些飞行员选择尾随在后，避免和那些“努力取胜”的人搅在一起。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0505.english: Looks like some of the pilots have chosen to hang back and avoid the whole 'struggling to win' altogether.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0506.chinese: 我们今天看到许多飞船都在努力坚持这一路线。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0506.english: We are seeing lots of ships struggling to get a hold of this track today.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0507.chinese: 一些赛车手可能真的要停止竞赛了。他们今天可能要重新考虑购买彩票的计划了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0507.english: Some pilots, really having an off race. They may want to rethink any plans to buy a lottery ticket today.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0508.chinese: 随着比赛的激烈进行，飞行员的驾驶技术开始出现不稳定的发挥了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0508.english: As the race goes on, pilots are really beginning to fade.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0509.chinese: 在这个级别的竞赛中，能看到这样粗劣的飞行几乎是一种罕见的享受。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0509.english: At this level of competition, seeing flying this shoddy is almost a rare treat.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0510.chinese: 对于那些以后想成为飞行员的人来说，这场比赛应被视为这是如何输掉比赛的最好例子。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badly_0510.english: To those of you thinking of becoming pilots, this race should be considered a prime example of how not to win races.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.chinese: 这个...这可真是可怕的飞行。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.english: This... this is just dreadful flying.
The pack is really starting to seperate.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.chinese: 看起来有些飞行员选择尾随在后，避免和那些“努力取胜”的人在一起。

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.english: As the race goes on, pilots are really beginning to fade.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.chinese: 在这个级别的竞赛中，能看到这样粗劣的飞行几乎是一种罕见的享受。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.english: At this level of competition, seeing flying this shoddy is almost a rare treat.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_badlyplayer_doing.english: To those of you thinking of becoming pilots, this race should be considered a prime example of how not to win races.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0401.chinese: 现在竞争完全趋于白热化。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0401.english: The competition is being absolutely dominated right now.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0402.chinese: 我从未见过这样的比赛。就像医生手术一样，必须精准，满是技巧。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0402.english: I have never seen anything like this. This is a clinic of precision and skill.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0403.chinese: 领头人就是简简单单的超过了每一个人。就好像他们仿佛跟他完全不在同一个级别上一样。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0403.english: The leader is simply outmatching everyone. It's like they're on a whole other level.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0404.chinese: 这事我曾经说过，而且是说过很多次了。主导技术会让竞赛越来越完美。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0404.english: If I've said once, I've said it a hundred times. Perfecting the foundations of racing will always dominate tech.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0405.chinese: 穆雷杯从未保证过什么，但是比赛印证了这一说法。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0405.english: There are no guarantees in Murray Cup, but this race is starting to look like a sure thing.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0406.chinese: 令人震惊的是，这些飞行员竟然能够保持这样的速度。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0406.english: It is astounding that these pilots have been able to maintain this pace.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0407.chinese: 在这场竞赛中，领先的飞行员们一定会考虑，现在是该谨慎行事，还是该全力以赴呢？
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0407.english: The pilots leading this race have to be wondering, is this the time to play it cautious, or is it the time to really go for it?

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0408.chinese: 今天这里进行了一些模范性的飞行表演。真是种享受啊。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0408.english: There is some exemplary flying happening here today. A real treat.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0409.chinese: 由于这些飞行员总是想展示为什么他们是是帝国中最优秀的，所以一切看起来都是你们的干净利落。
dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0409.english: Everything is looking neat and tidy as these pilots show off why they are the best in the empire.

dlg_sc_mc_player_doing_well_0410.chinese: 看看那精确地机动动作。

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1801.chinese: 以穆雷杯已经500多年的历史来说，我可以肯定地告诉你，这场比赛绝对是不合常理的那一种。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1801.english: With over 500 years of Murray Cup racing history, I can firmly say that this race was most certainly, pretty inconsequential.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1802.chinese: 让我们向获胜者致以喝彩。向死者表示哀悼。对于剩下的那部分人...我不想说什么。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1802.english: Congratulations to the winners. Condolences to the losers. And to those in the middle... I got nothing.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1803.chinese: 你看看，又是一个平庸的比赛得出了一个乏味的结论，但我的内心还是有一些东西随着比赛消逝了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1803.english: There you have it, another mediocre race comes to a bland conclusion, and I die a little inside.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1804.chinese: “多么精彩的结局！“这才是我想说出的评论。相反，我不得不被迫接受，“这场比赛真真切切的发生过。“
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1804.english: "What an exciting finish!" is something I wish I could say. Instead I am forced to go with, "That race was certainly something that happened."

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1805.chinese: (Yawns)。嗯？嗯？结束了吗？有人应该在这场无聊的比赛结束之前叫醒我的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1805.english: (Yawns). Hmm? Oh, it's finished? Someone's supposed to wake me before the end of the boring ones.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1806.chinese: 这样的结果...我想年年总是会有的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1806.english: With results like these... there's always next year, I suppose.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1807.chinese: 我鼓励这些飞行员把今天的结果作为一个机会认真的反省反省自己。赛车真的是你的本意吗？
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1807.english: I encourage these pilots to use today's results as an opportunity for some serious soul searching. Is racing really what I am meant to do?

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1808.chinese: 好的，至少关于比赛的这件事是结束了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1808.english: Well, the one thing you can say about that race is at least it's finally over.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1809.chinese: 咒骂和愤怒是结束，剩下的就是这些沮丧的赛车手。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1809.english: The sound and the fury has come to an end, and all we are left with is a lot of depressed pilots.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1810.chinese: 我的老教练曾说过，“还有提示的空间”，可能这是对这场比赛最好地评价吧。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_position_1810.english: That race may be best described by my old Equivalency instructor when she said, "there's room for improvement."

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 以穆雷杯已经500多年的历史来说，我可以肯定地告诉你，这场比赛绝对是普普通通的那一种。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: With over 500 years of Murray Cup racing history, I can firmly say that this race was most certainly, pretty inconsequential.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 让我们向获胜者致以喝彩。向死者表示哀悼。对于剩下的那部分人...我不想说什么。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: Congratulations to the winners. Condolences to the losers. And to those in the middle... I got nothing.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 你看看，又是一个平庸的比赛得出了一个乏味的结论，但我的内心还是有一些东西随着比赛消逝了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: There you have it, another mediocre race comes to a bland conclusion, and I die a little inside.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: “多么精彩的结局！”这才是我想说出的评论。相反，我不得不被迫接受，“这场比赛真真切切的发生过。“
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: "What an exciting finish!" is something I wish I could say. Instead I am forced to go with, "That race was certainly something that happened."

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: (Yawns)。嗯？嗯？结束了吗？有人应该在这场无聊的比赛结束之前叫醒我的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: (Yawns). Hmm? Oh, it's finished? Someone's supposed to wake me before the end of the boring ones.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 这样的结果...我想年年总是会有的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: With results like these... there's always next year, I suppose.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 我鼓励这些飞行员把今天的结果作为一个机会认真的反省反省自己。赛车真的是你的本意吗？
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: I encourage these pilots to use today's results as an opportunity for some serious soul searching. Is racing really what I am meant to do?

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.chinese: 好的，至少关于比赛的这件事是结束了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: Well, the one thing you get say about that race is at least it's finally over.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_any_positionplayer_.english: That race may be best described by my old Equivalency instructor when she said, "there's room for improvement."

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1601.chinese: 女士们先生们，我想这场比赛将成为我和我老婆做爱时，脑海中浮现的新画面。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1601.english: That race, ladies and gentleman, will be the new thing I picture while making love to my wife.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1602.chinese: 多么优异的成绩！我想我们可能刚刚见证了传奇的诞生。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1602.english: What a finish! I think we may have just witnessed the making of a legend.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1603.chinese: 赛车迷们，记住你们今天所在的地方。你们的孙子孙女会问你的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1603.english: Remember where you were this day, race fans. Your grandkids are going to be asking about it.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1605.chinese: 完成！我说的是它！结束了！不仅仅是指这场比赛！还有所有的比赛！多么出色的成绩。他们不仅赢得了比赛，而且赢了比赛本身。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1605.english: Done! I'm calling it! It's over! Not just this race! But all racing ever! That's how good that finish was. They didn't just win a race, they won racing itself.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1606.chinese: 每个人都看到了吗？！？人们想知道为什么我要不断尖叫，“我热爱竞速！”
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1606.english: Did everyone just see that?!? And people wonder why I constantly scream, "I love racing!"

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1607.chinese: 如果让我选个时间死去的话，那就现在吧，因为再也不会有比这精彩的竞速比赛了，我的朋友。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1607.english: If ever there was a time for the death threats against me to come to fruition, let it be now, 'cause racing does not get much better than that my friends.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1608.chinese: 从开始到最后，真是一场出色的比赛啊。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1608.english: Start to finish, that was a well executed race.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1609.chinese: 到达终点！他一定是一名对自己感到极其满意的赛车手。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1609.english: And across the line! That has got to be one pilot who is pleased with themselves.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1610.chinese: 看了这样一场表演后，我可以肯定地说所有人都会期待我们的下一届穆雷杯冠军。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_first_place_1610.english: After watching that performance, it may be safe to say that we could be looking at our next Murray Cup champion.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1701.chinese: 我猜我们不可能每一个人都成为赛车手。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1701.english: We can't all be racers I guess.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1702.chinese: 自从我第一次与拉希达·柯林斯约会起到现在，我还从没见证过如此令人失望的结果。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1702.english: I haven't witnessed a finish that disappointing since my first date with Rashida Collins.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1703.chinese: 也许在保存之前还是来一个硬重置吧。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1703.english: Maybe do a hard reset before it saves.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1704.chinese: 一个恶心的比赛向着恶心的结局发展，彻底毁灭了我们所有人的生活。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1704.english: And an abysmal race comes to an abysmal end, absolutely ruining all of our lives.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1705.chinese: 这场比赛被称为资格预选赛，但是在看到如此令人失望的表现后，似乎所有这些赛车手没有一个合格的。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1705.english: They call it a qualifier, but after watching that disappointing performance it is looking like almost none of these pilots are in fact qualified.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1706.chinese: 当您看到一场糟糕了的比赛后仍然愿意再次观看其他比赛时时，你就知道自己是多么喜爱这项运动。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1706.english: You know you love a sport when you see a race that bad and you're still willing to watch it ever again.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1708.chinese: 已经结束了。如果您需要哭泣的话，请便吧。这本不该是一个合理的反应，但是恐怕这是一场观看过类似这样比赛之后的自然反应。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1708.english: And it's over. If you need to cry, please, go ahead. It's not a reasonable reaction, but I'm afraid it's a natural one after a race like that.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1709.chinese: 衷心祝贺获胜者，并对失败者轻蔑地摇了摇头。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1709.english: A heartfelt congratulations to the winner, and a scornful shake of the head for the loser.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1710.chinese: 那场比赛终于结束了，抚慰心灵的过程终于可以开始了。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1710.english: That race is finally over, and the healing process can finally begin.

dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1711.chinese: 除了那些拥护犯罪的场所，很少能看到这样严重的斗殴事件。
dlg_sc_mc_player_got_last_place_1711.english: It is rare to see a beating this bad outside of an Advocacy crime scene.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2201.chinese: 对我来说足够了，特雷弗·巴斯克。下次再见。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2201.english: That will do it for me, Trevor Basque. See you next time.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2203.chinese: 感谢您在新地平线赛道这里和我一起。我是特雷弗·巴斯克。继续翱翔吧。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2203.english: Thanks for joining me at New Horizon. I'm Trevor Basque. Keep flying.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2204.chinese: 致此，今天的预选赛进入尾声。我叫特雷弗 · 巴斯克。下次再见。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2204.english: And with that, today's qualifier comes to a close. I've been Trevor Basque. See you next time.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2205.chinese: 又一场比赛结束了，又得到了一笔薪水，我是您的播音员特雷弗 · 巴斯克。继续翱翔吧，晚安。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2205.english: Another race over, and another paycheck for me, your announcer Trevor Basque. Keep flying and good night.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2206.chinese: 赛车迷们一直以来的乐趣。再见，继续飞翔吧。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2206.english: A pleasure as always race fans. Goodbye and keep flying.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2207.chinese: 随着另一个比赛日落下帷幕，我希望大家都和我一样开心。回头见，赛车迷们。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2207.english: As another race day winds down, I hope you all had as much fun as I did. See you soon, racefans.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2208.chinese: 这就是今天节目的全部内容了。特雷弗 · 巴斯克，来自新地平线赛道跑道，完毕。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2208.english: And that's all we have for today. Trevor Basque from New Horizon raceway signing off.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2209.chinese: 开个玩笑，谢谢观看。这里是特雷弗 · 巴斯克。保重，选手们。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2209.english: All kidding aside, thanks for watching. This is Trevor Basque. Take care racers.

dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2210.chinese: 然后，女士们，先生们，但主要是女士们，这里是特雷弗 · 巴斯克。再见不负遇见。
dlg_sc_mc_sendoff_lines_conclusion_2210.english: With that, ladies, gentlemen, but mostly the ladies, this is Trevor Basque. Bidding you a fond adieu.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1002.chinese: 给那些被击中的飞行员一些建议，赶紧别再被击中了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1002.english: Advice to the pilots getting shot at, stop getting shot at.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1003.chinese: 他们真的被撕开裂成碎片了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1003.english: They are really getting torn up out there.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1004.chinese: 可能要开始避开来袭的攻击了？仅仅是一个想法。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1004.english: Maybe start avoiding the incoming fire? Just an idea.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1005.chinese: 很多人在被击中的时候会关注船体的完整性，但是他们不应该忘记每一次撞击就像点了一下小小的刹车。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1005.english: Many people focus on hull integrity while getting shot, but they shouldn't forget each impact is like applying a little tiny brake.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1006.chinese: 没有什么比被射击更能催动飞行员飞得更快的了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1006.english: Nothing motivates a pilot to go a little faster better than getting shot at.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1007.chinese: 当飞船被造成一些严重的伤害时，护盾亮起来了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1007.english: Shields are lighting up as some serious damage is dealt.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1008.chinese: 同时，飞行员完全摆脱了这场战斗。时，飞行员完全摆脱了这场战斗。他们可能没有应对它的实力。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1008.english: And a pilot getting completely edged out of this fight. They may not have the muscle for it.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1009.chinese: 这样的损伤任何飞行员都承受不起。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1009.english: Taking damage like this is not something any pilot can afford.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1010.chinese: 根据我的经验，当你像这样被击中时，你脑子里的主要想法是，“千万不要击中我的推进器。”
dlg_sc_mc_taking_fire_1010.english: I can say from experience, when you're getting shot like that, the main thing running through your head is, "Please don't hit my thrusters."

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_02.chinese: 给那些正在被击中的飞行员的建议，不要再被逮到了，要是在被逮到了，保证没有你好果汁吃。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_02.english: Advice to the pilots getting shot at, stop getting shot at.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_03.chinese: 他们真的被撕开裂成碎片了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_03.english: They are really getting torn up out there.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_04.chinese: 可能要开始避开来袭的攻击了？仅仅是一个想法。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_04.english: Maybe start avoiding the incoming fire? Just an idea.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_05.chinese: 很多人在被击中的时候会关注船体的完整性，但是他们不应该忘记每一次撞击就像点了一下小小的刹车。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_05.english: Many people focus on hull integrity while getting shot, but they shouldn't forget each impact is like applying a little tiny brake.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_06.chinese: 没有什么比被射击更能催动飞行员飞得更快的了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_06.english: Nothing motivates a pilot to go a little faster better than getting shot at.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_07.chinese: 当飞船被造成一些严重的伤害时，护盾亮起来了。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_07.english: Shields are lighting up as some serious damage is dealt.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_08.chinese: 同时，飞行员完全摆脱了这场战斗。他们可能没有应对它的实力。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_08.english: And a pilot getting completely edged out of this fight. They may not have the muscle for it.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_09.chinese: 这样的损伤任何飞行员都承受不起。
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_09.english: Taking damage like this is not something any pilot can afford.

dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_10.chinese: 根据我的经验，当你像这样被击中时，你脑子里的主要想法是，“千万不要击中我的推进器。”
dlg_sc_mc_taking_firetaking_fire_10.english: I can say from experience, when you're getting shot like that, the main thing running through your head is, "Please don't hit my thrusters."

dlg_sc_tutorial_2nd_half_introtraining_1.chinese: 好了，让我们去大干一场吧。
dlg_sc_tutorial_2nd_half_introtraining_1.english: Topped off. Let's get back out there.

dlg_sc_tutorial_2nd_half_launchtraining_.chinese: 准备好后随时可以起飞。

dlg_sc_tutorial_auto_or_manualtraining_0.chinese: 你可以选择使用自动EDL（进入、降低、降落）程序或者自己手动完成整个进程。
dlg_sc_tutorial_auto_or_manualtraining_0.english: You can use the automatic EDL landing procedure or do the whole thing manually.

dlg_sc_tutorial_average_landingtraining_.chinese: 不算差，之后你慢慢会熟练的。
dlg_sc_tutorial_average_landingtraining_.english: Not bad. You'll get the hang of it.

dlg_sc_tutorial_back_to_basetraining_146.chinese: 让我们回基地吧，第一轮酒我请客。
dlg_sc_tutorial_back_to_basetraining_146.english: Let's get you back to base. First round's on me.

dlg_sc_tutorial_bad_landingtraining_1010.english: <sigh> That needs a lot of work.

dlg_sc_tutorial_barrel_roll_explanationt.chinese: 桶滚可以有效地改变你的飞船姿态去通过一些狭窄的缝隙或者躲避来袭炮火，现在你试试。
dlg_sc_tutorial_barrel_roll_explanationt.english: Rolling is a great way to orient your ship to fit through tight gaps or evade incoming fire. Now you give it a go.

dlg_sc_tutorial_barrel_roll_introtrainin.chinese: 继续下一项，接下来是我个人最爱的部分：来做个滚筒。
dlg_sc_tutorial_barrel_roll_introtrainin.english: Moving on. Now this is my favorite part of training: the barrel roll.

dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_alt_usetraining_10.chinese: 你可以用它去过载你的机动喷口去让你的转向更紧凑。
dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_alt_usetraining_10.english: You can also use it to overpower you manoeuvring thrusters in order to take tighter corners.

dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_introtraining_1080.chinese: 如果你需要迅速达到你的最大速度，也可以试试加力。
dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_introtraining_1080.english: If you need to get up to top speed in a hurry, try boosting.

dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_rechargetraining_1.chinese: 加力是有限的而且会随着时间慢慢补充，所以别傻了一样用。
dlg_sc_tutorial_boost_rechargetraining_1.english: You do have a limited amount that takes time to replenish, so don't go nuts with it.

dlg_sc_tutorial_chaff_difficultytraining.chinese: 释放噪声场比释放诱饵弹更考验技巧。你需要把它释放在你和来袭导弹之间才能让它发挥效用。
dlg_sc_tutorial_chaff_difficultytraining.english: Deploying Noise takes more skill than Decoys. To be successful, you need to put it between you and the missile.

dlg_sc_tutorial_chaff_explanationtrainin.chinese: 干得好。在被释放之后，噪声场干扰弹会产生一片电磁干扰云，进而掩盖你的电磁信号从而干扰导弹追踪。
dlg_sc_tutorial_chaff_explanationtrainin.english: Good. Now, a Noise creates a cloud of electromagnetic interference to mask your signature from the missile.

dlg_sc_tutorial_chase_player_dawdles_1tr.english: What are you waiting for? Go finish it off.

dlg_sc_tutorial_chase_player_dawdles_2tr.chinese: 出发。作为一个菜鸟，你还挺准时。
dlg_sc_tutorial_chase_player_dawdles_2tr.english: Let's go. You're on the clock, rookie.

dlg_sc_tutorial_cycletraining_0780_comba.chinese: 看来他准备使用他挂载的电磁制导导弹，做好部署噪声场的准备。
dlg_sc_tutorial_cycletraining_0780_comba.english: He's switched to EM tracking missiles. Cycle to Noise.

dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_autotraining_0.chinese: 启动降落模式将限制你强行进入解耦模式，意味着只有机动喷口会工作，帮助你在紧凑环境中做出更精确的动作。
dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_autotraining_0.english: Activating landing mode restricts you to decoupled mode, meaning only your manoeuvring thrusters fire, which is handy for precise movement in tight areas.

dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_player_trytrai.chinese: 试一下，只是要记得在你完成的时候松开它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_player_trytrai.english: Give it a try, just remember to disengage it when you're done.

dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_reminder_autot.chinese: 记住，进入着陆模式会自动解耦你的飞船，所以当它降低你的速度时，不要在离着陆平台太远的地方启动它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_reminder_autot.english: Remember, entering Landing Mode will automatically Decouple your ship, so don't activate it too far away from the landing pad as it cuts down your speed.

dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_reminder_manua.chinese: 当你展开起落架时，飞行系统会自动降低你的速度，所以不要在离着陆平台太远的地方启动它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_reminder_manua.english: The flight system automatically cuts down on your speed when you deploy the landing gear, so don't activate it too far away from the landing pad.

dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_warningtrainin.chinese: 这是一个阻止追击者的好方法，但要确保你已经在前面检查过了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_decoupled_warningtrainin.english: It's a great way to dissuade a pursuer, but make sure you've checked your path ahead first.

dlg_sc_tutorial_deviate_from_landingtrai.chinese: 如果您将起落架收回或离着陆平台太远，则必须再次提出请求。
dlg_sc_tutorial_deviate_from_landingtrai.english: If you raise you landing gear or stray too far from the pad, you'll have to request it again.

dlg_sc_tutorial_disabled_controlstrainin.chinese: 您会注意到大多数系统已禁用。我将控制它们的联机和脱机时间，以模拟战斗情况下的潜在情况。
dlg_sc_tutorial_disabled_controlstrainin.english: You'll notice the majority of your systems are disabled. I'll be controlling when they are on and offline to simulate potential scenarios in combat situations.

dlg_sc_tutorial_doors_opentraining_0110_.chinese: 当你对齐后，塔台将会打开门。
dlg_sc_tutorial_doors_opentraining_0110_.english: Once you're aligned, the tower will open the doors.

dlg_sc_tutorial_drone_2_killedtraining_0.chinese: 杀得漂亮！在培训的最后一部分，我们将回到降落场地进行补给。
dlg_sc_tutorial_drone_2_killedtraining_0.english: Good kill. We're heading back to the landing pad to restock and refuel for the final part of your training.

dlg_sc_tutorial_drone_shields_downtraini.chinese: 他的护盾废了。用导弹搞定它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_drone_shields_downtraini.english: Its shields are down. Finish it off with a missile.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_1t.chinese: 我不能在不启动自毁程序的情况下让你弹出。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_1t.english: I can't let you eject without initiating self-destruct.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_2t.chinese: 小子，这是我唯一不能远程完成的事情，你必须带头快点。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_2t.english: It's the only thing I can't do it remotely, kid. You have to initiate. Hurry.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_3t.chinese: 你的发电机正在渗出辐射，你必须马上自毁。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ejects_before_warning_3t.english: Your plant's leaking radiation. You need to self-destruct now.

dlg_sc_tutorial_enter_landing_modetraini.chinese: 你需要展开你的起落架来进入降落模式。
dlg_sc_tutorial_enter_landing_modetraini.english: To enter landing mode you need to lower your landing gear.

dlg_sc_tutorial_fails_to_mark_targettrai.chinese: 你必须标记一个目标，孩子。
dlg_sc_tutorial_fails_to_mark_targettrai.english: You gotta mark a target, kid.

dlg_sc_tutorial_fire_player_dawdles_1tra.chinese: 这种犹豫会害死你的，开火。
dlg_sc_tutorial_fire_player_dawdles_1tra.english: This kind of hesitation can get you killed. Fire.

dlg_sc_tutorial_fire_player_doesnt_firet.chinese: 去吧，射击！无人机是不会介意的。
dlg_sc_tutorial_fire_player_doesnt_firet.english: Go ahead, shoot. The drone isn't going to mind.

dlg_sc_tutorial_flare_durationtraining_0.chinese: 热诱弹持续时间很短，发射时不要太快。
dlg_sc_tutorial_flare_durationtraining_0.english: Flares have a short lifetime, don't be too quick to fire them.

dlg_sc_tutorial_flare_explanationtrainin.chinese: 最后一颗导弹是热追踪的，所以装上你的热诱弹。给你个小贴士，不要释放热诱弹后开加力。推进器加力的热源要比热诱弹强得多。
dlg_sc_tutorial_flare_explanationtrainin.english: Last missile was heat-seeking so equip your flares. Helpful tip, don't boost after dropping a flare. Boosted thrusters are much hotter than a flare.

dlg_sc_tutorial_glaive_id_short_0001.chinese: 有更多的敌人来了，看起来有个王牌混在里面。
dlg_sc_tutorial_glaive_id_short_0001.english: We got more hostiles inbound. Looks like there's a a recognised Ace in the mix.

dlg_sc_tutorial_glaive_idtraining_1330_c.chinese: 长刀'是公认的王牌专用机，敌人代号是“坦克”，我们得合力消灭它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_glaive_idtraining_1330_c.english: That Glaive's a recognised Ace, enemy designation is Tank. We're gonna have to work together to take it down.

dlg_sc_tutorial_good_alignment_2training.chinese: 飞行航向选得不错，驾驶员。

dlg_sc_tutorial_good_distancetraining_09.chinese: 这应该足够接近了，放下起落架。
dlg_sc_tutorial_good_distancetraining_09.english: This should be close enough. Deploy your landing gear.

dlg_sc_tutorial_gsafe_explanation_3train.chinese: 如果你需要在转弯时获得额外的优势，可以禁用过载安全系统，但是会被系统警告。一名昏迷的驾驶员很快就会变成一具尸体。
dlg_sc_tutorial_gsafe_explanation_3train.english: If you need to get that extra edge in turning, you can disable G-Safe, but be warned. An unconscious pilot turns into a dead one pretty quick.

dlg_sc_tutorial_gsafe_explanationtrainin.chinese: 还在跟着我，小子？干得好。现在你需要明白一件事，每艘船都配备了系统来辅助你。
dlg_sc_tutorial_gsafe_explanationtrainin.english: Still with me, kid? Good job. Now one thing you need to understand, every ship's outfitted with systems to look out for you.

dlg_sc_tutorial_guns_backtraining_0810_c.chinese: 你取回了你的武器，但我需要更多时间把你的导弹准备好。
dlg_sc_tutorial_guns_backtraining_0810_c.english: You got your guns back, but I'll need more time to get your missiles up.

dlg_sc_tutorial_heavy_damagetraining_030.chinese: 别慌，第一次大家都会在船上留下痕迹。你的船还能飞，所以我们继续。
dlg_sc_tutorial_heavy_damagetraining_030.english: Ah, don't sweat it, everybody tags their ship the first time. Your ship is still spaceworthy so I we'll just press on.

dlg_sc_tutorial_hudtraining_0140_take_of.chinese: 注意，你正处于起飞或降落模式。
dlg_sc_tutorial_hudtraining_0140_take_of.english: Take note that you're in take-off and landing mode..

dlg_sc_tutorial_initiate_self_destructtr.chinese: 这里几乎火烧眉毛了，小子。

dlg_sc_tutorial_introductiontraining_004.chinese: 我们会把你安排在那架停在着陆平台的 F7C 上。快点过去，我们得出发了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_introductiontraining_004.english: We're gonna set you up in the F7C on the landing pad over there. Hustle over and let's get going.

dlg_sc_tutorial_keep_shootingtraining_06.english: There you go. Keep on the pressure.

dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_mode_infotrainin.chinese: 一旦着陆模式激活，你的 HUD 界面将会更换掉战斗系统来显示特定的着陆功能。
dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_mode_infotrainin.english: Once Landing Mode's active, your HUD's going to swap out your combat systems for landing specific functionality..

dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_pad_idtraining_0.chinese: 自由降落区域将显示在您的 HUD 上。
dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_pad_idtraining_0.english: Free landing pads will appear on your HUD.

dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_radar_helptraini.chinese: 确保你的船停留在平台范围内，并注意你的俯仰和滚转姿态。
dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_radar_helptraini.english: Make sure your ship stays within the bounds of the pad and keep your eye on your pitch and roll.

dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_radartraining_09.chinese: 现在您正在接近，雷达将由着陆系统取代。它会引导您到达着陆平台并帮助您安全着陆。
dlg_sc_tutorial_landing_radartraining_09.english: Now that you're on approach, your radar is replaced by the landing system. It'll guide you to your landing pad and help you perform a safe landing.

dlg_sc_tutorial_lead_targettraining_0600.chinese: 好了，尝试使用预瞄点锁定飞船。
dlg_sc_tutorial_lead_targettraining_0600.english: Okay, try targetting the ship with the PIPs.

dlg_sc_tutorial_leader_exitstraining_012.chinese: 就是这样。等我结束，就到你。
dlg_sc_tutorial_leader_exitstraining_012.english: That's it. Once I clear out, it'll be your turn.

dlg_sc_tutorial_leader_player_dawdles_1t.chinese: 你在干什么，在休息吗？让我们动起来，菜鸟。
dlg_sc_tutorial_leader_player_dawdles_1t.english: What are you, on break? Let's move it, rook.

dlg_sc_tutorial_leader_player_dawdles_3t.english: Move it, move it, move it.

dlg_sc_tutorial_marks_targettraining_128.chinese: 收到。我搞定了另一个，祝你好运。
dlg_sc_tutorial_marks_targettraining_128.english: Copy that. I got the other. Good luck.

dlg_sc_tutorial_match_speed_explaintrain.chinese: 当你追击目标的时候，要保持你的速度尽可能接近他们。试一试，确保把我锁定并且达到了合适的速度。
dlg_sc_tutorial_match_speed_explaintrain.english: When pursuing a target, you'll want to keep your speed  as close to their as possible. Give it a shot. Make sure I’m targeted and hit Match Speed.

dlg_sc_tutorial_missile_lock_explanation.chinese: 导弹锁定传感器位于机头上，因此要将目标保持在前部足够长的时间以锁定目标。
dlg_sc_tutorial_missile_lock_explanation.english: Missile locking sensors are on the nose so keep your target in front of you long enough to lock on.

dlg_sc_tutorial_missiles_backtraining_08.chinese: 不错。你的导弹回来了。把它拿出来。
dlg_sc_tutorial_missiles_backtraining_08.english: Great. You got your missiles back. Take it out.

dlg_sc_tutorial_move_it_rookietraining_0.chinese: 让我们动起来，菜鸟。您不会按小时获得报酬。
dlg_sc_tutorial_move_it_rookietraining_0.english: Let's move it, rookie. You aren't getting paid by the hour.

dlg_sc_tutorial_multiple_missilestrainin.chinese: 你可以一次性让多枚导弹进行锁定，只是不要胡乱射击。
dlg_sc_tutorial_multiple_missilestrainin.english: You can lock multiple missiles at once, just don't get too trigger happy.

dlg_sc_tutorial_new_drone_targettraining.chinese: 让我们继续 - 哦！看起来他有一个朋友。看一眼您的后视摄像头。
dlg_sc_tutorial_new_drone_targettraining.english: Let's move on - uh-oh! Looks like he had a friend. Take a look in your rear-view camera.

dlg_sc_tutorial_on_the_clocktraining_002.english: We're on a clock here, let's go.

dlg_sc_tutorial_outrotraining_0470_comba.chinese: 好的，你似乎可以掌握好飞船了，所以让我们看看你是否可以应付一些战斗。
dlg_sc_tutorial_outrotraining_0470_comba.english: Well, you seem to be able handle your ship, so let's see if you can handle a bit of combat.

dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_averagetrain.chinese: 你可以在模拟环境中多待几个小时，虽然你在模拟环境中的表现还不错。
dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_averagetrain.english: You could use some extra hours in the sim, but you weren't too bad back there.

dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_goodtraining.chinese: 你做得很好，小子。让我猜猜 - 你是竞技场指挥官的游戏粉丝吗？
dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_goodtraining.english: You did good back there, kid. Let me guess - you're an Arena Commander fan?

dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_poortraining.chinese: 我知道这是你的第一次，但如果你想要成为真正的飞行员，你得更加努力。
dlg_sc_tutorial_performance_poortraining.english: I know it's your first time out there, but you're going to have to try harder if you want your wings.

dlg_sc_tutorial_permission_for_launchtra.chinese: 这里是塔台，已授予起飞许可。

dlg_sc_tutorial_permissiontraining_0940_.chinese: 一旦你对准了一个着陆平台，你就可以试着请求停靠许可了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_permissiontraining_0940_.english: Once you've targeted a landing pad, request permission to land.

dlg_sc_tutorial_pip_explanationtraining_.chinese: 现在有个目标，你会发现多了一些准星出来。那是预测着弹点又称PIPs。它们的作用就是告诉你朝哪里开火才能击中移动目标。
dlg_sc_tutorial_pip_explanationtraining_.english: Now you have a target, you will have extra aim reticules. Those are Predicted-Impact-Points or PIPs. They'll show you where to shoot to hit a moving target.

dlg_sc_tutorial_pitch_rolltraining_0160_.chinese: 保持机头稳定，不要上下左右移动。否则要让准星回正会比较困难。
dlg_sc_tutorial_pitch_rolltraining_0160_.english: Make sure you don't pitch or roll. It'll be tough to get back into proper alignment.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_alignedtraining_0.chinese: 当你准备好起飞时，塔台会将门打开。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_alignedtraining_0.english: The tower will open the doors once you're lined up.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_boards_gilly_ship.chinese: 放轻松，菜鸟。这是我的座驾。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_boards_gilly_ship.english: Easy there, rookie. That's my ride.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_boards_gilly_ship.chinese: 你在干嘛？你该去那边才对。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_boards_gilly_ship.english: What are you doing? You're over there.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_causes_damage_2tr.chinese: 说了让你当心点！这些船可不便宜。

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_causes_damage_3tr.english: What the hell's wrong with you?

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_completes_2traini.chinese: 还活着吗？好吧，你确实秀到了我。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_completes_2traini.english: Still with me? All right, I'm a little impressed.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_damagetraining_02.chinese: 干得漂亮。我倒是没见过多少人第一次试就能成功的。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_damagetraining_02.english: Great job. I haven't seen many pull one off on the first try.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_dawdlestraining_1.chinese: 别在那瞎玩了，快瞄准那艘长刀。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_dawdlestraining_1.english: Stop screwing around and target the Glaive.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_fail_line_3traini.chinese: 你不会觉得我时间很多吧？
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_fail_line_3traini.english: I don't have time for this.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_failstraining_120.chinese: 行了，就这样吧。我觉得你还未准备好。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_failstraining_120.english: Okay, that's enough. I don't think you're ready yet.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_1tra.chinese: 来吧。你能做得比这更好。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_1tra.english: Come on. You can do better than that.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_2tra.chinese: 动起来，动起来。我都快在这睡着了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_2tra.english: Let's go, let's go. I'm falling asleep up here.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_warn.chinese: 坚持住，孩子，你要搞砸了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_warn.english: Keep up, kid, you're blowing it.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_warn.chinese: 你现在准备放弃吗？加油，你可以的。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_behind_warn.english: You gonna give up now? Come on, push yourself.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_falls_off_trailtr.english: Don't lose it. Stay on its tail.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_flies_away_last_w.english: Turn around. I won't say it again.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_1.chinese: 集中注意力。让我们一起搞定它。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_1.english: Stay focused. Let's get through this.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_2.chinese: 让我们回归正题。要学的还有很多。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_2.english: Let's get back on track. We got a lot to cover.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_3.chinese: 你我都清楚，孩子：你要是不听我的命令这个测试就甭想通过了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_3.english: Just so we're clear, kid: you will follow orders or you will fail this training exercise.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_5.chinese: 好好磨练，菜鸟。这些还不是全部呢。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_general_warning_5.english: Sharpen up, rookie. This isn't going to cut it.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_gets_hittraining_.chinese: 你正挨打呢。在抬头显示器上检查你的护盾和伤害状态。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_gets_hittraining_.english: You're taking hits. Check your HUD for shield and damage status.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_hits_dronetrainin.chinese: 打得不错，看到你的护盾正在削弱了吗？
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_hits_dronetrainin.english: Good shot. See its shields weakening on your HUD?

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_lags_2training_03.chinese: 你可真磨蹭，臭小子。快点。

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_lags_3training_03.chinese: 你听懂了吗？你到底有什么毛病?
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_lags_3training_03.english: You reading me? What the hell's wrong with you?

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_no_weaponstrainin.chinese: 刚才那一下把你武器给打没了。你得撑到它们重新上线为止。不过反制措施还能用。快用它们。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_no_weaponstrainin.english: That hit took out your weapons. You'll have to hold out until they come back online. Countermeasures are still online. Use them.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_off_centretrainin.chinese: 不要瞄准门的中间。傻了吧，好多船员都没意识到驾驶舱并不是飞船的中心。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_off_centretrainin.english: Don't align yourself with the middle of the doors. You'd be surprised how many 'cruits forget that the cockpit is not the centre of the ship.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_strafe_forwardtra.chinese: 可以。现在向前平移到滑行道，如有需要，塔台可以帮你打开路径灯。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_strafe_forwardtra.english: Okay. Now strafe forward onto the taxiway. If you need it, the tower should have lit up your path.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_take_offtraining_.chinese: 很好，停机坪已经清空了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_take_offtraining_.english: Nice, you're clear of the pad.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_testtraining_1120.chinese: 你觉得能把学到的运用上了吗？走着瞧。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_testtraining_1120.english: Think you can put all this together? Let's see.

dlg_sc_tutorial_player_turningtraining_0.chinese: 转向幅度不要太大。无法回正的滋味可不好受。
dlg_sc_tutorial_player_turningtraining_0.english: Don't turn too much. You don't want to fall out of alignment.

dlg_sc_tutorial_players_turntraining_013.chinese: 准备好了吗？我正在激活你的系统，等下就在这里观看你的流程。
dlg_sc_tutorial_players_turntraining_013.english: Ready? I'm enabling your systems and will monitor your progress from up here.

dlg_sc_tutorial_power_plant_warningtrain.chinese: 我发现你船上的功率峰值不太稳定，你的电源一定是被他们击中了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_power_plant_warningtrain.english: I'm getting erratic power spikes from your ship. They must have hit your power plant!

dlg_sc_tutorial_race_intro_2training_107.english: Think you can stay on my tail?

dlg_sc_tutorial_race_introtraining_1220_.chinese: 来竞速吧，看看谁先到尖塔。

dlg_sc_tutorial_radar_checktraining_0470.chinese: 检查你的雷达。你应该会发现有个联系对象。
dlg_sc_tutorial_radar_checktraining_0470.english: Check your radar. You should have a contact.

dlg_sc_tutorial_select_landing_padtraini.english: Go ahead and pick a landing pad.

dlg_sc_tutorial_selecting_landing_padtra.chinese: 你可以循环选择停机坪，和选择目标是一样的。
dlg_sc_tutorial_selecting_landing_padtra.english: You can cycle through available landing pads the same as cycling through targets.

dlg_sc_tutorial_self_destruct_introtrain.chinese: 你这船上可有不少军事机密，所以绝对不能让它落入敌手。弹出之前你得先启动自毁程序。
dlg_sc_tutorial_self_destruct_introtrain.english: Your ship's loaded with military intel, so we can't let it fall into enemy hands. You'll have to initiate self-destruct before you eject.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_checktraining_0070_.chinese: 准备好起飞。我会一步一步教你怎么做。系统，检查完毕。引擎，检查完毕。塔台，请求起飞。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_checktraining_0070_.english: Let's get ready for takeoff. I'll do this step by step to show you how it's done. Systems, check. Engines, check. Tower, permission for launch.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_groupstraining.chinese: 在那里面你能看见你的武器组、护盾配置以及电源分配。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_groupstraining.english: In there you'll see your weapon groups, shield configuration and power distribution.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_introtraining_.chinese: 等待期间可以随便看看飞船的设置。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_introtraining_.english: While we're waiting, feel free to take a look at your ship's setup.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_warningstraini.chinese: 不过在训练期间我可不会搞乱那些设置。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_menu_warningstraini.english: I wouldn't mess around with them during training.

dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_positiontraining_07.chinese: 再给你一个专家的提示：反制措施是向后发射的，所以千万不要朝着导弹飞行时发射，没用。
dlg_sc_tutorial_ship_positiontraining_07.english: Another pro tip: countermeasures are fired backward so never fly at a missile head-on, launch a countermeasure and expect it to work.

dlg_sc_tutorial_somedamagetraining_0280_.chinese: 有点不太稳，不过垂直起飞确实是要多加练习。
dlg_sc_tutorial_somedamagetraining_0280_.english: A little shaky, but vertical take-offs take some practice.

dlg_sc_tutorial_spire_fillertraining_147.chinese: 朋友，那就是尖塔。是不是很漂亮？
dlg_sc_tutorial_spire_fillertraining_147.english: That, my friend, is the Spire. Isn't she a beauty?

dlg_sc_tutorial_strafe_forwardtraining_0.chinese: 现在我确定可以向前平移至滑道。
dlg_sc_tutorial_strafe_forwardtraining_0.english: Now that I'm clear I can strafe forward onto the taxiway.

dlg_sc_tutorial_strafe_sidewaystraining_.chinese: 现在我正在将船体对准天花板库门，准备垂直起飞。
dlg_sc_tutorial_strafe_sidewaystraining_.english: Now I square my ship up with the ceiling doors ready for a vertical take-off.

dlg_sc_tutorial_successful_targettrainin.chinese: 不错。现在你的武器已上线。
dlg_sc_tutorial_successful_targettrainin.english: Good. Now your weapons are online.

dlg_sc_tutorial_takes_damagetraining_129.chinese: 你正在承受大量船体伤害。试试看打开护盾别让敌人打到你。
dlg_sc_tutorial_takes_damagetraining_129.english: You're taking a lot of hull damage. Try and keep a shield between you and the enemy.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_closesttraining_0.chinese: 使用你的标记系统标记最近的敌人。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_closesttraining_0.english: Use your targeting system to quickly target the closest enemy.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_hud_explanationtr.chinese: 好的，现在看看你抬头显示器的右上部。这里能看到你的目标这里可以显示它的实时受损状态、护盾状态以及其他的信息。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_hud_explanationtr.english: Okay, now look at the top right of your HUD. You should see you target displayed. This will show realtime damage, shield status and a few other things.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_hudtraining_0480_.chinese: 使用你的标记系统标记最近的敌人。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_hudtraining_0480_.english: Use your targeting system to target the closest enemy.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_leadertraining_03.chinese: 我刚刚激活了你的标记系统。用它标记我试试。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_leadertraining_03.english: I've just enabled your targeting system. Use it to target me.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_lines_uptraining_.chinese: 对准你的目标，准备好就开火。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_lines_uptraining_.english: Line up your target and fire when you're ready.

dlg_sc_tutorial_target_player_failtraini.chinese: 我们回去吧。感觉你得在这模拟里头多花些时间。
dlg_sc_tutorial_target_player_failtraini.english: Let's head back. Guess you need more time in the sims.

dlg_sc_tutorial_too_much_damagetraining_.chinese: 嗯，我感觉你的船已经到头了，打不了了。感觉我们得先把船维修一下再继续尝试。
dlg_sc_tutorial_too_much_damagetraining_.english: Yeah, I don't think your ship can take any more. I think we'll need to get it patched up and try again.

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_all_deadtraining.chinese: 搞定。吼吼，这培训课程够呛哈？
dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_all_deadtraining.english: We're clear. Hell of a training session, huh.

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_freefiretraining.chinese: 你可以和剩下的那些交战了祝你好运。
dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_freefiretraining.english: You're cleared to engage the rest. Good luck.

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_intro_1training_.english: Hold on, I've got contacts inbound…

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_intro_2training_.chinese: 遇敌！剜度战士，前方危险。

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_intro_3training_.chinese: 这不是演习。重复，这不是演习。你的所有系统已经激活，这是一场实弹遭遇战。
dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_intro_3training_.english: This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill. All your systems are active. This is a live-fire encounter.

dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_wave_2training_1.chinese: 保持警觉。看来有更多敌机。看来里面混有长刀。
dlg_sc_tutorial_vanduul_wave_2training_1.english: Stay sharp. We got more hostiles inbound. Looks like there's a Glaive in the mix.

dlg_sc_tutorial_vertical_lift_offtrainin.chinese: OK，我想在垂直起飞之前清理我的停机坪。
dlg_sc_tutorial_vertical_lift_offtrainin.english: All right, first I want to lift vertically until I'm just clear of the landing pad.

dlg_sc_tutorial_warningtraining_0030_int.chinese: 别以为你能翘掉这一课。你需要集中精神听取并执行我的命令，因为在黑暗中是不允许出错的。清楚了吗？
dlg_sc_tutorial_warningtraining_0030_int.english: Don't think you can slink your way through this. You need to focus and execute my commands because there is zero room for error in the black. We clear?

dlg_sc_tutorial_weapons_hottraining_1300.chinese: 别紧张。你的武器发热了。
dlg_sc_tutorial_weapons_hottraining_1300.english: Ease up. Your weapons are getting hot.

dlg_sc_tutorial_weapons_overheat_advicet.chinese: 有规律地射击好让你的武器冷却下来，不然容易过热停火。
dlg_sc_tutorial_weapons_overheat_advicet.english: Fire in controlled bursts and give your weapons time to cool or they'll overheat.

docking_alignedmessage.chinese: 校准完成：开始最终对接程序
docking_alignedmessage.english: Alignment Achieved: Commencing Final Docking Procedure

docking_dockeelanded.english: Docking Terminated Due To Target Landing

docking_excessiveangularmisalignment.chinese: 旋转姿态以对齐对接口
docking_excessiveangularmisalignment.english: Adjust Rotation to Align with Docking Port

docking_excessiveangularspeed.chinese: 减缓旋转速度以对齐对接口
docking_excessiveangularspeed.english: Slow Rotation to Align with Docking Port

docking_excessivelinearmisalignment.chinese: 调整位置以对齐对接口
docking_excessivelinearmisalignment.english: Adjust Position to Align with Docking Port

docking_excessivelinearspeed.chinese: 减缓速度以对齐对接口
docking_excessivelinearspeed.english: Slow Speed to Align with Docking Port

docking_noqtundock.english: Undocking Not Permitted During Quantum Travel

docking_outofrange.english: Out Of Range For Docking Process

downloadstalled_reliablesourcebadintegri.chinese: 提供损坏数据的可靠源

dusters_repui_leadership.chinese: 弗林·“扬尘"·马西斯，创始人

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 时间一分一秒地过去，只剩下 30 秒了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The clock winds down, with only 30 seconds left.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 时间还剩 30 秒。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: 30 seconds left on the clock.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 本轮比赛即将结束。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: This round is almost over.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 各队该采取最后行动了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Time for the teams to make their final moves.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 战斗人员最好在大门彻底关闭前离开这里。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With the gates closing, those combatants better get out there.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 一名战斗人员在准备室徘徊。大门即将关闭，不知道他们在等什么。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A combatant is lingering in the Ready Room. With the gates closing, gotta wonder what they're waiting for.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 大门已打开！
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Gates are open!

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 大门打开，参赛队伍涌入赛场。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The gates open and the teams pour onto the field.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 你不得不佩服这样的技巧。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: You got to admire skill like that.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 队员们一定感觉很好。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Team's got to be feeling good about that.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 正是这样的时刻让我爱上了这场比赛。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: It's moments like these that make me love the game.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 战斗员们今天正在进行一场真正的比赛。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Combatants are putting on a real show today.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 那是本回合的第一滴血。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: And that's the first takedown of the round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 第一名战士被击倒了，现在比赛才算是正式开始。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Things kick off as the first combatant is taken out.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 第一次击倒出现了，事情变得越来越复杂了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: And with that first takedown, things are heating up.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 场上正在换人，一名新选手加入了航天队。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A substitution is made, and a new player joins the Aeros.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 场上正在换人，一名新选手加入了亚塔ZGCC队。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A substitution is made, and a new player joins Jata ZGCC.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 在今天的比赛中，两队将一直激战到双方所有选手都被淘汰为止。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Today's match will see both teams battling till all the combatants on either side have have been eliminated.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 今天的对决：团队淘汰赛，要想获胜，参赛选手必须干掉对手团队的所有成员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Today's face off: Team Elimination, where, to win,the combatants will have take out the entirity of their openants team.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 那一定很疼。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: That had to hurt.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 又一名战斗员倒下了
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Another combatant down.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 一发入魂。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A clean shot.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 拿下！
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Takedown!

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队又失去一名战斗人员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Aeros loses another combatant.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔队失去另一名战斗人员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Jata loses another combatant.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 您好，欢迎来到天文竞技场。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Hello and welcome to Astro Arena.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 很高兴你能加入我们。天文竞技场又将迎来激动人心的一天，今天的对决将由安吉里航天队对阵亚塔ZGCC队。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Glad you could join us. It's shaping up to be another exciting day here at Astro Arena. Today's match-up pits the Angeli Aeros against Jata ZGCC.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 欢迎来到天文竞技场。我们为您准备了一场精彩的比赛，今天是亚塔ZGCC队迎战安吉利航天队
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Greetings from Astro Arena. And boy, do we have a fight shaping up for you. Jata ZGCC steps up against the Angeli Aeros.
