dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A decisive round victory for the Aeros as they show what skill and teamwork can accomplish in the battle arena.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航空队赢得了这一回合的胜利，他们对本场比赛的前景感觉一定更好。希望亚塔队能扳回一城。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: As the Aeros claims the win for that round, they've got to be feeling better about the outlook for this match. Here's hoping that Jata can pull back.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 这一轮，安吉利航天队绝对压制了雅塔队，将他们一网打尽，未尝一败。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The Angeli Aeros absolutely dominated the team from Jata that round. Managing to wipe them out without suffering a single loss.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队以一场近乎完美的胜利结束了本轮比赛，昭告了亚塔队谁才是天文竞技场的主宰。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The Aeros viciously showed Jata just who's in charge here at Astro Arena, as they close out that round with a near flawless win.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 安吉利航天队几乎毫发无损，彻底击溃了对手。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With barely a scratch on them, the Angeli Aeros completely shuts out the competition that round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 终结！主宰！航天队以零阵亡人数结束本回合。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Eliminate! More like dominate! The Aeros take the round with zero combatants down.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔ZGCC队没有杀掉一个对手就结束了这一回合的比赛，他们的粉丝一定很失望。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Jata ZGCC closes out that round without a single kill and their fans have got to be disappointed.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队刚刚在一场决定性的胜利中消灭了亚塔队，而且没有损失任何一名战斗员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The Aeros just eradicated the Zata in a decisive victory without a single combatant loss.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队这轮比赛输得很难看，让我们看看他们能否在下一轮有更好的表现。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A tough loss on that one, let's see if the Aeros can do better in the next round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 安吉利航天队以失败告终。希望他们能振作起来，重整旗鼓。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The round ends in defeat for the Angeli Aeros. Hopefully they can pull it together as they prepare to head back out.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队在本轮失去了最后一名战斗员，被轻松击败。我想他们肯定不会为自己的表现感到高兴。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With the loss of their last combatant, the Aeros are handily defeated that round. I'm sure they cannot be happy about their performance.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 在经历了上一轮的失利后，航天队将寻求扭转局势的方法。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: After suffering a defeat that last round, the Aeros will be looking for a way to turn things around.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔队赢得了这一回合的胜利，他们对本场比赛的前景感觉一定更好。希望航天队能扳回一城。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: As Jata claims that round, they've got to be feeling better about the outlook for this match. Here's hoping that the Aeros still got some fight in them.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 尽管航天队的一些行动令人印象深刻，但亚塔ZGCC队还是拿下了这一回合。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Despite some impressive moves from the Aeros, Jata ZGCC takes the round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔队的胜利，让我们看看他们能不能在下一轮的比赛中保持这种势头。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A solid win that round for Jata, let's see if they can maintain the momentum as they head into the next.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 随着亚塔队在本轮获胜，本场比赛离决出胜负又近了一分。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With Jata's win this round, this match is one point closer to being decided.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 这一轮，亚塔队战胜了航天队。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Jata managed to overcome the Aeros this round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔队取得了决定性的一轮胜利，他们展示了技巧和合作在战场上的威力。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: A decisive win for Jata that round as they show what skill and hardwork can accomplish in the battle arena.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔队完美地打赢了这一回合。他们在不损失一名队员的情况下，成功地干掉了所有的航天队队员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Jata executed that round flawlessly. They managed to take out every single Aero without losing a single player.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔ZGCC队完全主宰了这一回合，航天队完全无法突破他们的防御。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Jata ZGCC completely dominated that round. The Aeros couldn't make a single dent in their defenses.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 亚塔ZGCC队几乎毫发无损，完全主宰了本轮的比赛。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With barely a scratch on them, Jata ZGCC completely shuts out the competition that round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 终结！主宰！亚塔队以零阵亡人数结束本回合。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Eliminate! More like dominate! Jata takes the round with zero combatants down.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 航天队没有杀掉一个对手就结束了这一回合的比赛，他们的粉丝一定很失望。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The Aeros close out that round without a single kill and their fans have got to be disappointed.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 看来本轮比赛即将开始。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: It looks like the round is about to start.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 本轮比赛正在进行。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: The round is underway.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 又一轮比赛开始了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Another round kicking off.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 我们再来一轮。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Here we go with another round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 本轮比赛开始。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: That's the start of the round.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 倒计时开始。5，4，3，2，1，全体队员，出发。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Countdown's going. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. and the team's are away.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 倒计时开始，5，4，3，2，1。本轮比赛开始。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: Here's the countdown, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. and the round has begun.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.chinese: 为了给本轮比赛开一个好头，准备室进行了消毒。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_battlearena_announcer_.english: With round off to a strong start, the ready room is sterilized.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_30_seconds_left.chinese: 我们没时间了，速战速决吧
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_30_seconds_left.english: We're running out of time. Let's bring it home.
Clock's ticking down, it's now or never.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_encouragement_0.chinese: 继续努力，海军陆战队们。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_encouragement_0.english: Keep up the good work, Marine.
That's what I like to see.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_first_blood_01,.chinese: 速战速决，你们是军团的骄傲。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_first_blood_01,.english: Quick and clean. You do the corps proud.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_first_blood_02,.chinese: 没有比这更好的方式来表达我们的诚意了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_first_blood_02,.english: No better way to show we mean business.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_first_blood_03,.chinese: 先下手为强，后下手遭殃。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_gain_player_01,.chinese: 看来我们又有新成员了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_gain_player_01,.english: Looks like we got ourselves a new recruit.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_gain_player_02,.chinese: 有一名新的海军陆战队员加入我们的行列。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_gain_player_02,.english: Got a new Marine joining our ranks.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_game_objective_.chinese: 听着，里面有敌人。这是歼灭行动，不把他们放倒我们就不回家。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_game_objective_.english: Listen up, we got hostiles inside. This is elimination, we don't go home until they're put down.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_game_objective_.chinese: 我们需要清除这一地区的所有战斗人员。以极端的火力将这些亡命之徒一网打尽。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_game_objective_.english: We need this area cleared of all combatants. Terminate every last one of these outlaws with extreme prejudice.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_greetings_02,p.english: Let's get down to business, shall we?

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_greetings_03,p.chinese: 欢迎执行任务，陆战队员们。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_halftime_01,p.chinese: 我们被分配到了不同的渗透点。让我们好好利用它。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_halftime_01,p.english: We've been assigned a different infilitration point. Let's use it to our advantage.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_halftime_02,p.chinese: 是时候改变战术了，我们要转移到另一个渗透点。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_halftime_02,p.english: Time to change tactics. We're moving to a different infiltration point.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_kill_assist_01,.chinese: 没有什么比团队合作更致命了。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_kill_assist_02,.chinese: 这支队伍就像一台运转良好的机器。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_kill_assist_02,.english: This squad's running like a well-oiled machine.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_kill_assist_03,.chinese: 你很好地帮助了你的队友。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_kill_assist_03,.english: Good looking out for your squadmate.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.chinese: 你们就像一个不可阻挡的战斗营。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.english: You're like an unstoppable battalion of one.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.chinese: 击杀多个目标，干得好，陆战队员。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.english: Multiple targets down. Fine work, marine.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.chinese: 你他妈简直就是一台我从未见过的高效杀人机器。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_killing_spree_0.english: You are a damn efficient killing machine if I've ever seen one.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_last_player_ali.chinese: 只剩下你了，陆战队员现在所有人都指望你了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_last_player_ali.english: You're all that's left, Marine. Everyone's counting on you now.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_last_player_ali.chinese: 你是最后的陆战队员。不要让队友白白牺牲。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_last_player_ali.english: You're the last Marine standing. Make their sacrifice mean something.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_confirm.chinese: 带好装备了吗？快去准备区域。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_confirm.english: Got your gear? Head to the readyline.
Good choice. Get ready to roll out.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.chinese: 装备就是生命，好好想想你要带什么上战场吧。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.english: Your gear's your life. Think hard on what you're gonna bring into battle.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.chinese: 你是选择给敌人带来痛苦？还是选择协助你的队友？抑或是两者之间的平衡？选择何种装备完全取决于策略。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.english: You gonna bring the pain? Help your squad? Strike a balance? Pickin' a loadout's all about strategy.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.chinese: 谨慎选择装备，用不着的东西不要带。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_loadout_selecti.english: Choose your equipment carefully. If you bring it, plan to use it.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_lose_player_01,.english: One of your squadmates went off-grid.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_lose_player_02,.chinese: 命令来了，你的一个队友被调职了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_lose_player_02,.english: Orders came in. One of your squadmate's been reassigned.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.chinese: 这次任务是一场彻头彻尾的失败。你明明能做得比那更好的，我想你也知道这一点。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.english: I call that mission a complete failure. I think you're better than that, I think you know that too.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.chinese: 你们都尽力了，但这次还不够好。但这也是一个教训。一定要吸取教训。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.english: You all tried your best, and this time it wasn't good enough. But there's a lesson to be learned in that. Make sure that you learn it.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.chinese: 我们今天输了，这是不争的事实。重要的是接下来会发生什么，你是要继续失败，还是要超越对手？
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_loss_.english: We lost today. No getting around that. The important part is what comes next. Are you going to carry defeat with you, or are you going to rise above it?

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.chinese: 干得好啊，你们是带着任务去的，而且你们完成了任务。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.english: Let me be the first to say well done. You went in with a job to do, and you sure as heck did it.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.chinese: 我已经在这里待了一段时间了...嗯，真是精彩。祝贺你，今晚第一杯酒我请。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.english: I've been at this awhile and... well, that was a sight to see. Congrats. First drink's on me tonight.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.chinese: 任务完成，但这就是海军陆战队的工作，不是吗？收拾东西，回家吧。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.english: Mission accomplished. But that's just what Marines do, isn't it? Pack it up, and let's go home.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.chinese: 多亏了你们，那些不法分子再也不是问题了。你们都应该为自己感到骄傲。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_end_win_0.english: That was some fine work you did out there today, and thanks to you, those outlaws won't be a problem anymore. All of you should feel proud of yourselves.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_start_01,.english: Ready up, op is a go.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_match_start_cou.english: Op starts in 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. We are go!

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_melee_kill_01,p.chinese: 有人不怕弄脏自己的手。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_melee_kill_01,p.english: Somebody ain't afraid to get their hands dirty.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_melee_kill_04,p.chinese: 近距离接触没什么不好。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_melee_kill_04,p.english: Nothing wrong with getting up close and personal.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_multi_kill_01,p.chinese: 就是这样，我们有的是时间把他们一个个干掉。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_multi_kill_01,p.english: There we go. Who's got time to kill 'em one by one.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_multi_kill_03,p.chinese: 这样他们就不敢聚在一起了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_multi_kill_03,p.english: That'll teach them not to bunch together.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_01,p.chinese: 海军陆战队员受伤，需要治疗。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_01,p.english: Marine down and in need of medical.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_02,p.chinese: 我们有一名受伤的海军陆战队员需要帮助。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_02,p.english: We've got an injured Marine in need of help.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_03,p.chinese: 需要医疗包，生命是第一要务。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_need_medic_04,p.chinese: 队员中弹倒下，队员中弹倒下。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_one_enemy_left_.chinese: 只剩下一个敌人，了结它。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_one_enemy_left_.english: Only one hostile left. End it.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_one_enemy_left_.chinese: 只剩最后一个目标了，干掉他。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_one_enemy_left_.english: We're down to the last target. Take 'em out.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 我们不可能让事情就这样过去，我们回去吧。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: No way we let things stand at that. Let's get back out there.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 他们重创了我们，但我们必须狠狠地反击。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: They hit us hard, but we got to go back and hit them harder.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 我就不粉饰太平了，这简直是一团糟。吸取教训，这种事情不能再发生了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: I ain't gonna surgar coat it, that was a mess. Learn from it. Don't let it happen again.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 我们可能输掉了这场战役，但我们肯定还能赢得这场战争。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: We may've lost the battle, but we sure as hell can still win this war.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 我们失去了对局势的控制。这种情况不能再发生了。下一次，我们要集中精力，齐心协力。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: We lost control of the situation. That can't happen. Next time, we need to focus, and we need to work together.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 这简直是一场惨烈的屠杀，我很失望。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: That was a complete bloodbath of epic proportions. Consider me dissapointed.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 他们一天不重样地瓦解了我们，我们需要做到更好。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: They completely dismantled our operation six ways from Sunday. We need to be better than that.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.chinese: 我他妈刚才看到的是什么？真是错得不能再错了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_loss_.english: What the hell did I just witness? That went about as wrong as wrong can go.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.chinese: 这次我们赢了，但要集中精力。还没完呢。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.english: We got them that time, but stay focused. This ain't over yet.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.chinese: 这就是将威胁扼杀在摇篮里的方法，干得好。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.english: And that is how you stop a threat dead in it's tracks. Well done.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.chinese: 我们将他们置于死地，但这也阻止不了他们多久。只是日常工作罢了，让我们再来一次吧。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_0.english: We put them in their place for now, but that's not going to stop them for long. Just another day on the job. Let's do it again.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_s.chinese: 进进出出，没有一个陆战队员倒下。没有比这更好的行动了。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_s.chinese: 所有的训练都得到了回报，那些亡命之徒还没反应过来就被你们击倒了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_marine_round_end_win_s.english: All that training really paid off. You put down those outlaws before they even had a chance to know what hit them.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_encouragement_0.english: Take a breath. You got this.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_encouragement_0.english: It's us or them. Remember that.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_encouragement_0.chinese: 你真的要让海军的马润们这样践踏我们吗？
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_encouragement_0.english: You really gonna let some Marines stomp us like that?

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_first_blood_02,.english: Hit hard and fast, that's what I like to see.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_first_blood_03,.chinese: 我打赌他们肯定没想到会这样。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_gain_player_01,.english: Looks like someone finally woke up.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_gain_player_02,.english: Got some new blood on the team.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_game_objective_.english: All right, scumbags, listen up: we got rats in the clubhouse and I need them dead. Every single one.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_game_objective_.chinese: 这有一队马润正在入侵我们，不是你死就是我亡。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_halftime_02,p.chinese: 是时候大干一场了，让我们从另一侧攻击他们。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_kill_assist_03,.chinese: 看来你自己都做不好这项工作。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_killing_spree_0.english: Don't stop 'til your heart stops beating.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_last_player_ali.english: Take a sec. Breathe. It's you or nothin'.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_loadout_confirm.chinese: 准备好了吗？我们开始吧。
整理好了吗？很好，那就开始吧。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_loadout_selecti.chinese: 拿上你想要的，我们稍后再分类。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_loadout_selecti.english: Grab what you want, we'll sort it later.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_loadout_selecti.english: These are UEE Marines, so pick your load-out carefully.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_lose_player_01,.chinese: 等一下，那个傻逼东西溜走了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_lose_player_01,.english: Hold on. That son of a bitch skeeved out.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_loss_.chinese: 你很幸运，他们只是杀了你，而我想做的可不止这些。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_loss_.english: You're lucky they killed you because I wanna do so much worse.
(off-mic) I ain't goin' back! (exchange of gunfire)
Go, go, go let's get outta here.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_loss_.english: I set us up, make a perfect plan, and you just had to go and mess it up didn't you?

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_loss_.chinese: 我们被打败了，但话又说回来，他们是海军陆战队，而我们，呃，我们是我们，所以也没什么好惊讶的。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_loss_.english: Well we got beat, but then again, they're Marines and we're, well, we're us, so its not too big of surprise really.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.chinese: 这会让他们知道我们的厉害。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.english: That'll teach 'em to try and roust us.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.chinese: 去搜刮尸体吧，这是你自己挣来的资格，干完后一定要发泄一下。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.english: Scav the bodies. You earned it. Make sure you vent 'em when you're done.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.chinese: 干得好，小子们。那些地球联合帝国的蠢货根本不知道他们被什么攻击了。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.english: Fine job, my wonderful scumbags. Those UEE pukes didn't know what hit 'em.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.chinese: 这就是我们还在这里的原因。谁想喝酒？
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.english: And that is why we are still here. Who's drinking?

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.chinese: 打败那些马润的感觉比我想象的要好上十万倍，这值得庆祝。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_match_end_win_0.english: Trouncing those Marines felt a billion times better than I thought it would. I say this calls for celebration.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_multi_kill_03,p.chinese: 你简直就是在砍瓜切菜。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.english: Fine. They got lucky this time. Load up and hit 'em again.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.english: All right, okay... no, we still got this.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.chinese: 你想让那些法西斯流氓压在你身上？简直是疯了！

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.chinese: 为了让你做得更好，我可以给你们付更多钱，但是一手交钱一手交货。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.chinese: 他们可是陆战队员，你以为是什么小喽啰吗？你最好打起精神来，不然我就用烟斗敲你的脑袋。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.english: These are Marines. Did you think this was going to be easy? You better rack your game up or I'll rack your brain with a pipe.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_loss_.chinese: 要是再出现这样的情况，我就要走了。

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_win_0.chinese: 是啊，大伙，这就是我喜欢看到的。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_win_0.english: Hell yeah, people. That's what I like to see.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_win_0.chinese: 今晚你们名声大涨，保持继续。
dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_win_0.english: You're getting private stock tonight. Keep it up.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_end_win_s.english: There you go, the Empire's finest laid to waste.

dxsh_mccv_indi_sm_outlaw_round_start_02,.chinese: 一切都取决于你，不是你死就是他亡。

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_co.chinese: 这就是为什么在比赛中我们有这样的说法：“飞船可不能赢得漂亮。”
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_co.english: And that's why in racing we have the saying, "ships don't win pretty."

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_co.chinese: 经过那样的一次空难，这些飞行员一定会问自己，“我是不是忘了上个公民日给我的焊工们送礼了？”
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_co.english: After a crash like that, these pilots have got to be asking, "Did I remember to give my welder a gift last Citizen Day?"

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.chinese: “多么精彩的结局！”这才是我想说出的评论。相反，我不得不被迫接受，“这场比赛真真切切的发生过。“
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.english: "What an exciting finish!" is something I wish I could say. Instead I am forced to go with, "That race was certainly something that happened."

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.chinese: 我的老教练曾说过，“还有提示的空间”，可能这是对这场比赛最好地评价吧。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.english: That race may be best described by my old Equivalency instructor when she said, "there's room for improvement."

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.chinese: 每个人都看到了吗？！？人们想知道为什么我要不断尖叫，“我热爱竞速！”
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_pl.english: Did everyone just see that?!? And people wonder why I constantly scream, "I love racing!"

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_ta.chinese: 根据我的经验，当你像这样被击中时，你脑子里的主要想法是，“千万不要击中我的推进器。”
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_murraycup_announcer_ta.english: I can say from experience, when you're getting shot like that, the main thing running through your head is, "Please don't hit my thrusters."

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0040_.chinese: 我们会把你安置在飞船里 你右边的停机坪上快点过来，我们走吧。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0040_.english: We're gonna set you up in the ship on the landing pad to your right. Hustle over and let's get going.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0070_.chinese: 准备起飞我会一步一步教你怎么做。看着我，看我怎么做。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0070_.english: Let's get ready for takeoff. I'll do this step by step to show you how it's done. Look over at me and watch what I do.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0320_.chinese: 当你追击目标的时候，要保持你的速度尽可能接近他们。试一试，确保把我锁定并且达到了合适的速度。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0320_.english: When pursuing a target, you'll want to keep your speed  as close to their as possible. Give it a shot. Make sure I'm targeted and hit Match Speed.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0430_.chinese: 继续下一项，接下来是我个人最爱的部分：来做个滚筒。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0430_.english: Moving on. Now this is my favourite part of training: the Axial Roll.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0820_.chinese: 如果无人机跟在你后面，进入耦合模式，解除主引擎，让你的飞船在保持原有矢量的情况下旋转。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0820_.english: If the Drone gets behind you, enter Decoupled mode to disengage your main engines and allow you to spin your ship around while retaining your original vector.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0830_.chinese: 你的导弹回来了。把它拿出来。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0830_.english: You got your missiles back. Take it out.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0970_.chinese: 着陆系统取代了雷达。它将引导您到达停机坪，并帮助您安全着陆。
dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_0970_.english: Your radar is replaced by the landing system. It'll guide you to your landing pad and help you perform a safe landing.

dxsh_mccv_osys_ac_tutorial_trainer_1010_.english: <sigh> That needs a lot of work.

fw2022_datapadscreen_convo_3,p.chinese: 是的，理查森。你就是我说的理查森。
fw2022_datapadscreen_convo_3,p.english: Yes Richardson. You are the Richardson I was referring to.

fw2022_datapadscreen_convo_4,p.chinese: 不，那是电影里的一句话，老板，你又把他惹毛了。

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_01.chinese: 这是你的密码，斯塔克斯。

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_03.chinese: 谢了，门多！你感觉怎么样？

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_04.chinese: 我觉得我们胜算很大，这个计划本身就很靠谱，敌我识别转换技术也很厉害。唯一的问题是我们有没有找到对的人来完成它。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_04.english: I give us solid odds. The plan is as good as they come and the IFFI tech's impressive. Only question is if we got the right people to pull it off.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_05.chinese: 是在说我为了参加风暴鲸游览的而放你鸽子的事？
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_05.english: Is this about me bailing for that stormwal tour?

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_06.chinese: 得了吧，伙计。你知道我不是指你。我只是担心那个下载。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_06.english: Come on, man. You know I didn't mean you. Just worried about the download.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_07.chinese: 这不会出什么问题的。他们即使能发现发生了什么，也为时已晚，无能为力了。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_07.english: It's gonna go fine. Even if they find out what's going on, it'll be too late to do anything.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_08.chinese: 是啊，尤其从我用从你所有代码的第一个数字生成的密码锁定了这个系统之后。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_08.english: Yeah, especially since I got the system locked tight with a password generated from the first digit of all your codes.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_09.chinese: 好了，完成了。估计他们能阻止我们的唯一方式就只有拿个水晶球出来猜这该死的密码了。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_09.english: Well, there you go. Pretty much the only way they'd be able to stop us is if they pull a Globy and guess the damn thing.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_10.chinese: 只是出于好奇，游览怎么样？
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_10.english: Out of curiosity, how was the tour?

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_11.chinese: 太疯狂了，我最后看见了两只！
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_11.english: Shit was crazy. Saw two of them out there in the last second.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_13.english: Yeah, yeah. I know you don't give a shit.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_14.chinese: 干完这一票，或许我就会开始关心了呢。
fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_14.english: Let's get through this and maybe I'll start.

fw22_nt_datapad_admin_title.chinese: 派对用品 - 行政中心

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_02.chinese: 你的密码。现在我希望你能专心防守布拉什伍德平台和上面的防空炮塔。
fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_02.english: Here's your code. Now, I want you focused on keeping Brushwood safe and those AAs gunning.

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_04.chinese: 我们没什么问题吧？我可不想像上次德拉一样翻车。
fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_04.english: We're not going to have a problem are we? I don't need another Della happening today.

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_05.chinese: 我记得德拉那活儿九尾最后还是收到钱了吧。
fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_05.english: Last time I checked, Nine Tails still got paid for the Della.

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_06.chinese: 上次那活儿跟现在这个比根本不值得一提。这就是为什么我需要你集中精力，懂了吗？
fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_06.english: That was a rain drop in the ocean compared to this job. Which is why I need you focused. We clear?

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_07.chinese: 当然了门多，你说什么我都照做。

fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_title.chinese: 派对用品 - 布拉什伍德

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_01.english: Here's the code for the containers.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_05.chinese: 当然了，为啥觉得我没有？
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_05.english: Yeah, sure. Why wouldn't I be?

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_06.chinese: 只是确保一下我们有足够的掩护来搞定这活儿。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_06.english: Just want to make sure that we'll have enough cover to get the job done.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_07.chinese: 不知道你有什么好担心的，制空权我们已经拿下来了，在我看来剩下的很好办。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_07.english: Not sure what you're getting so worked up about. With us owning the skies, it all seems pretty straight forward to me.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_08.chinese: 没错，我们按计划行事，别出什么幺蛾子。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_08.english: Right. Let's just keep on task and not get creative.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_09.chinese: 又来？我告诉你啊，想吓人的话也得拿出点吓人的东西吧。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_09.english: This again? I keep telling you, mate. If you want to scare people, you gotta do some scary shit.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_10.chinese: 你的意思是把亨德一家排队开膛破肚才算吓人吗？
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_10.english: Is that what you call gutting Hender's whole family one by one?

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_11.chinese: 听着，我知道你什么意思。你不想弄脏自己的手是吧，行。那你能不能做好自己的事儿，别来对我指手画脚的。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_11.english: Look, I get it. You don't like getting your hands dirty. Fine. But how about you worry about doing your job and stay the hell out of my business.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_12.chinese: 我的工作就是确保你能完成任务。这就是为什么上头挑我管事儿，不是你，别忘了。
fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_12.english: My job is making sure you do yours. That's why I got picked to run things and not you. Don't forget it.

fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_title.chinese: 派对用品 - 哈特莫尔

fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_05.chinese: 一切准备就绪，待会儿按计划行事。
fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_05.english: Everything is set up. Expect things to kick off on schedule.

fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_07.chinese: 我们还需要好运？这些敌我识别转换器（IFFI）可太 TM 牛逼了。谢谢你给我们弄来这个。
fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_07.english: Who needs luck? Those IFFIs are impressive bits of tech. Thanks for the hookup.

fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_08.chinese: 很高兴你喜欢我们的新玩具。说回正事，我给你准备的特殊包裹应该能无缝接入到他们的系统里去。
fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_08.english: Glad you like the new toys. Onto business, that special package I prepped for you should match pretty seamlessly with their system.

fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_09.chinese: 不用谢，传输完毕后我会告诉你的。
fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_09.english: No doubt. I'll let you know once the transfer's complete.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_01.chinese: 这是你平台上集装箱的密码。
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_01.english: Here's the code for the containers on your platform.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_03.chinese: 乖乖！我们得手后十字军的那帮人一定会巨吃一惊的！
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_03.english: Hell yeah! Crusader's gonna be kipo surprised when we take over.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_06.chinese: 无所谓！做好你眼前的任务就好，其他事情应该会没事的。
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_06.english: Whatever. Just focus on doing your part and everything should be fine.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_07.chinese: 放心吧，老大！搞定任务前我会牵制住他们，不管要复活我多少次。
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_07.english: No worries, boss. I'll keep 'em busy enough to get the job done. Doesn't matter how many times they regen me.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_08.chinese: 我们之前谈过这个问题，你不重生肯定更好。
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_08.english: We talked about this. It's better if you don't need a regen.

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_10.chinese: 但假如我真的被干掉后去重生了，你还记得你发誓过要夺回我的护甲吧？
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_10.english: But if I do regen, you remember you swore to get my armor, right?

fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_12.chinese: 你不送死我就没必要去了。
fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_12.english: Don't die and I won't have to.

hdactivist_assassination_danger_001.chinese: 不要掉以轻心。赫斯顿靠他们做这么多肮脏的工作是有原因的。
hdactivist_assassination_danger_001.english: Don't take this target lightly. There's a reason Hurston's relied on them to do so much dirty work.

hdactivist_assassination_danger_002.chinese: 你要追击一个恶毒的混蛋，所以最好做好准备。
hdactivist_assassination_danger_002.english: You're going after one vicious bastard, so best come prepared.

hdactivist_assassination_danger_003.chinese: 建议你在他们呼叫增员之前把他们又快又准地干掉。
hdactivist_assassination_danger_003.english: I'd recommend hitting them hard and fast before they have a chance to comm for backup.

hdactivist_assassination_danger_004.chinese: 注意这一点。他们的字典里可没有“可怜”一词。
hdactivist_assassination_danger_004.english: Watch out for this one. 'Mercy' isn't part of their vocabulary.

hdactivist_assassination_timed_001.chinese: 消息在这里传得很快。不要滞留太久，不然就没惊喜了。
hdactivist_assassination_timed_001.english: Word spreads fast around here. Don't wait too long on this, or you might lose the element of surprise.

hdactivist_assassination_timed_002.chinese: 为了这次行动，请尽快完成这一任务。
hdactivist_assassination_timed_002.english: For the sake of the movement, it's vital this gets done soon.

hdactivist_assassination_timed_003.chinese: 有传言称 ~mission(TargetName|Last) 正在策划一个大阴谋。你必须在事态发展到无法控制前阻止他们。
hdactivist_assassination_timed_003.english: There's chatter that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is planning something big. You've got to stop them before it's too late.

hdactivist_assassination_timed_004.chinese: 我需要你尽快处理这事。天知道这些鬼东西在干什么。
hdactivist_assassination_timed_004.english: We need you to move fast on this. Who knows what the target is working on.

hdactivist_basesweep_danger_001.chinese: 他们不知道你会出现，但也别掉以轻心。那些混蛋特喜欢打架。
hdactivist_basesweep_danger_001.english: They aren't expecting you, but don't think for a second this is going to be easy. Those bastards love to fight.

hdactivist_basesweep_danger_002.chinese: 确保弹药充足，毕竟不知道你在那里会遇到多少敌人。
hdactivist_basesweep_danger_002.english: Make sure you have more than enough ammo. There's no way to know how many of 'em will be down there.

hdactivist_basesweep_danger_003.chinese: 做好充足的准备迎接战斗吧。
hdactivist_basesweep_danger_003.english: Make sure you're armed up and prepared for war.

hdactivist_basesweep_danger_004.chinese: 坦白说，到时候一定会打得头破血流，但这是捍卫我们未来的代价。
hdactivist_basesweep_danger_004.english: I'm not gonna lie, this will get bloody, but that's what we have to do to secure our future.

hdactivist_stealitem_danger_001.chinese: 这件事可能有点危险。为以防万一，请全副武装。
hdactivist_stealitem_danger_001.english: Things could get dangerous. Gear up just in case.

hdactivist_stealitem_danger_002.chinese: 在那一定要小心。可以肯定的是，赫斯顿将竭尽所能阻止我们得到这个东西。
hdactivist_stealitem_danger_002.english: Watch yourself out there. Pretty sure Hurston will do whatever it takes to keep us from getting this thing.

hdactivist_stealitem_danger_003.chinese: 讲道理，现场可能有安保人员。如果惹到他们了，请采取必要手段来得到这个箱子。
hdactivist_stealitem_danger_003.english: Fair warning, but security might be at the site. If they come after you, do what's necessary to get that crate.

hdactivist_stealitem_danger_004.chinese: 这次行动一如往常地很有可能遭遇危险。所以记住抱最大希望，做最坏打算这个道理你也懂吧？
hdactivist_stealitem_danger_004.english: As always, a gig like this can be dangerous. So plan for the worst, hope for the best, right?

hdactivist_stealitem_danger_005.chinese: 务必小心。那里可能到处都是安保人员。
hdactivist_stealitem_danger_005.english: Be careful. Security could be all over that location.

hdactivist_stealitem_destination_001.chinese: 在赫斯顿的一个藏身处

hdactivist_stealitem_destination_002.chinese: 在艾瑞尔上的一个安全点

hdactivist_stealitem_destination_003.chinese: 在阿伯丁的一个隐蔽点

hdactivist_stealitem_destination_004.chinese: 在玛格达的一个安全屋

hdactivist_stealitem_destination_005.chinese: 在依塔的一个秘密基地

hdactivist_stealitem_timed_001.chinese: 别墨迹，搞快点。鬼知道这箱子还会在那放多久。
hdactivist_stealitem_timed_001.english: Don't drag your heels. Who knows how long that crate will be there.

hdactivist_stealitem_timed_002.chinese: 我无法形容这批货对我来说有多重要。
hdactivist_stealitem_timed_002.english: I can't stress how important it is that you get this shipment to us.

hdactivist_stealitem_timed_003.chinese: 合约倒的时限就要到了，我们需要你尽快地完成这份工作。
hdactivist_stealitem_timed_003.english: The clock's ticking on this contract. We need this thing as soon as possible.

hdactivist_stealitem_timed_004.english: Need it sooner rather than later.

hdactivist_stealitem_timed_005.chinese: 希望这玩意儿还在那儿。你最好快点找出来。
hdactivist_stealitem_timed_005.english: Hopefully, this thing isn't already gone. Better hurry up and find out.

hint_refuelingprovider_landingservices.chinese: 通过 mobiGlas 上的降落服务选项提交加油请求。
