hint_refuelingprovider_undocking,p.chinese: 加油完成后，使用 ~action(spaceship_docking|v_toggle_docking_request) 脱离对接
hint_refuelingprovider_undocking,p.english: When refueling is complete, undock using ~action(spaceship_docking|v_toggle_docking_request).

hints_actorstatus_pitmenudrugs.chinese: mobiGlas的健康应用程序显示所有当前的损伤，以及有效的药物，持续时间，以及它们缓解的症状。
hints_actorstatus_pitmenudrugs.english: The mobiGlas health app displays all current injuries along with active medications, their duration, and what symptoms they're relieving.

hints_actorstatus_pitmenuinjury.chinese: 要查看你目前的受伤、症状和严重程度的完整列表，以及目前的药物，请使用mobiGlas健康应用程序。
hints_actorstatus_pitmenuinjury.english: To review a full list of your current injuries, symptoms and their severity, along with current medications, use the mobiGlas Health app.

hints_actorstatusbuffapplied.chinese: HUD 边上的一个“+”或“-”符号代表目前系统中激活的增益或减益状态。
hints_actorstatusbuffapplied.english: A "+" or "-" symbol next to a HUD icon represents an active buff or debuff is being applied to that system.

hints_actorstatusclothingchanged.chinese: 一些护甲和衣物可以抵御极端温度，在他们的描述中有详细说明。
hints_actorstatusclothingchanged.english: Some armor and clothing can protect against extreme temperatures as detailed in their descriptions.

hints_actorstatuscorpsemarkershown.chinese: 你之前的身体和上面的任何物品都可以在尸体标记处找到。要想解除标记，需要打开内思菜单，前往 动作-玩家 页面。
hints_actorstatuscorpsemarkershown.english: Your previous body and any items on it can be found at the Corpse marker. To dismiss, open the Personal Inner Thought menu, and go to Actions, Player.

hints_actorstatusdeadlyinjurystarted.chinese: 你当前受了十分严重的伤。使用药物来缓解症状，并使用一级医疗床来全面治疗所有问题。
hints_actorstatusdeadlyinjurystarted.english: You have received a severe injury. Use medications to relieve symptoms, and a Tier 1 Medical Bed to fully treat any issues.

hints_actorstatusdigestionabsorptionempt.chinese: 定期饮食，避免营养和水分下降带来的负面影响。
hints_actorstatusdigestionabsorptionempt.english: Eat and drink regularly to avoid negative effects as your Nutrition and Hydration levels decrease.

hints_actorstatusdownedenter.chinese: 当你失去行动能力时，在“死亡时间”计时器结束前，通过你的队友、聊天或通过呼叫救援服务信标让你苏醒。
hints_actorstatusdownedenter.english: While incapacitated, ask others in your party, in chat, or through rescue service beacons to revive you before the 'Time to Death' timer expires.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotcli.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时爬梯子。使用诸如咯沙芬的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotcli.english: You cannot climb ladders while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotman.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时穿着披风。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotman.english: You cannot mantle while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotste.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时驾驶飞船。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotste.english: You cannot pilot ships while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannottak.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时做出击倒动作。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannottak.english: You cannot perform a take down while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotuse.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时使用定点架设武器。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotuse.english: You cannot use a mounted gun while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotuse.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时使用手推车。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotuse.english: You cannot use a trolley while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockdropitem.chinese: 在手臂部分瘫痪时，你将无法拿取过重的物体。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockdropitem.english: You cannot carry heavy objects while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslocklowerweap.chinese: 你无法在手臂瘫痪时举枪瞄准。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslocklowerweap.english: You cannot raise weapons while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockstart.chinese: 你的手臂目前处于瘫痪状态。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复手臂功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockstart.english: You arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatuseffectbleedstart.chinese: 你正在失血，你的生命值会随着时间持续下降。使用血红扎之类的凝血剂来减缓生命值下降的速度。
hints_actorstatuseffectbleedstart.english: You are bleeding and will continue to lose health over time. Use a coagulant like Hemozal to reduce the effects.

hints_actorstatuseffectpronelockstart.chinese: 你的腿部目前处于瘫痪状态。使用咯沙芬之类的阿片类药物能暂时恢复腿部功能。
hints_actorstatuseffectpronelockstart.english: Your legs are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemheld.chinese: 虽然拿着的食物通常可以一口吃完，但饮料可以小口喝，或者连续喝，直到量表清空。
hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemheld.english: While equipped food can often be eaten in a single bite, beverages can be consumed in small sips or a long continuous drink until the meter is empty.

hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemininventor.chinese: 使用您的个人库存菜单查看消耗品，装备或丢弃它们。
hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemininventor.english: Use your personal inventory menu to view consumables and equip or discard them.

hints_actorstatushospitalenter.chinese: 要想使用医疗床，请使用大厅的登记处来预订一间医疗室。
hints_actorstatushospitalenter.english: To gain access to a medical bed, use a lobby check-in terminal to receive a medical room assignment.

hints_actorstatushospitalroomreserved.chinese: 为了帮助您导航到医务室，请查看附近的指示标志。可能在不同的楼层，需要使用电梯。
hints_actorstatushospitalroomreserved.english: For help navigating to your medical room, check nearby signs for directions. It may be on a different floor and require the use of an elevator.

hints_actorstatushungerthirstdamagestart.chinese: 当营养和水分水平过低时，你会受到伤害，最终失去意识。通过饮食来补充。
hints_actorstatushungerthirstdamagestart.english: When Nutrition and Hydration levels are too low, you will take damage and eventually become unconscious. Eat and drink to replenish your levels.

hints_actorstatushungerthirstdeath.chinese: 你的营养和水分水平下降使你失去知觉，记得饮食补充。
hints_actorstatushungerthirstdeath.english: Your depleted Nutrition and Hydration levels have rendered you unconscious. Remember to eat and drink to replenish them.

hints_actorstatushungerthirstfull.chinese: 当营养和水分水平满了，消耗物品不会再给予充分的效果。建议把它们保存到你饿了或渴了的时候。
hints_actorstatushungerthirstfull.english: When Nutrition and Hydration levels are full, consuming items no longer grants the full effect. Consider saving them until you are hungry or thirsty.

hints_actorstatushungerthirststatusstart.chinese: 你正在遭受营养或水分水平低的不良影响。尽快吃点食物或饮料来恢复你的水平。
hints_actorstatushungerthirststatusstart.english: You are suffering ill effects from low Nutrition and / or Hydration levels. Consume food and drinks as soon as possible to restore your levels.

hints_actorstatushyperthermiadamagestart.chinese: 你的体温过高，正在遭受中暑的伤害。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御高温的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatushyperthermiadamagestart.english: Your body temperature is too high and you're taking damage from hyperthermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.

hints_actorstatushyperthermiastarted.chinese: 你太热了，快中暑了。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御高温的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatushyperthermiastarted.english: You are too hot and hyperthermia is beginning to set in. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.

hints_actorstatushypothermiadamagestarte.chinese: 你的体温过低，正在遭受低温症的伤害。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御寒冷的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatushypothermiadamagestarte.english: Your body temperature is too low and you are taking damage from hypothermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.

hints_actorstatushypothermiastarted.chinese: 你太冷了，快低温症了。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御寒冷的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatushypothermiastarted.english: You are too cold and hypothermia is beginning to set in. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.

hints_actorstatusinjurystarted.chinese: 你受了轻伤。使用药物来缓解症状，并使用三级医疗床来获取全面的治疗。
hints_actorstatusinjurystarted.english: You have received a minor injury. Use medications to relieve symptoms, and a Tier 3 Medical Bed to fully treat any issues.

hints_actorstatusintoxicatedenter.chinese: 血药浓度过高会导致出现醉酒感，使得步行及驾驶变得更加困难且有可能伴随其他风险。
hints_actorstatusintoxicatedenter.english: An elevated Blood Drug Level can cause feelings of intoxication, making getting around or piloting a vehicle difficult and potentially dangerous.

hints_actorstatusmajorinjurystarted.chinese: 你受到了一些不那么严重的伤害。使用药物来缓解症状，并使用二级医疗床来获取全面的治疗。
hints_actorstatusmajorinjurystarted.english: You have received a moderate injury. Use medications to relieve symptoms, and a Tier 2 Medical Bed to fully treat any issues.

hints_actorstatusmedbedenter.chinese: 医疗床恢复了你的健康，重置了你的血药浓度。使用“治疗”标签来治疗伤害(取决于等级)，使用“药物”标签来注射药剂。
hints_actorstatusmedbedenter.english: The bed has restored your health and reset your BDL. Use the Treatment tab to heal injuries (depending on tier), and the Medication tab for dosage.

hints_actorstatusoverdoseenter.chinese: 极高的血药浓度 (BDL) 会导致药物过量，这会导致你昏迷并失去健康值，最终丧失行动能力。
hints_actorstatusoverdoseenter.english: A high Blood Drug Level (BDL) can make you stunned, losing health, and eventually incapacitated. BDL lowers naturally but a dose of Resurgia can help.

hints_actorstatusoxypenconsumenoundersui.chinese: 必须穿着基底服才能使用氧素笔。
hints_actorstatusoxypenconsumenoundersui.english: An undersuit must be worn to use OxyPen.

hints_actorstatusrespawncriminal.chinese: 鉴于你的犯罪等级，你被重生在了UEE辖区外最近的医疗设施。
hints_actorstatusrespawncriminal.english: Due to your current CrimeStat, you have been regenerated at the nearest facility outside of the UEE's jurisdiction.

hints_actorstatusrespawnlocationset.chinese: 要将您的重生地点重置为您的主要居住地，请使用任何等级的医疗床或保险终端。
hints_actorstatusrespawnlocationset.english: To reset your regen location to your primary residence, use a terminal at any medical bed or insurance office.

hints_actorstatusrespawnmedbed.chinese: 默认情况下，你将会在主要居住地重生，但可以通过医疗床或保险终端选择一个新的地点。
hints_actorstatusrespawnmedbed.english: By default, you'll regen at your primary residence, but a new location can be selected via medical beds or at insurance offices.

hints_actorstatusrespawnprison.chinese: 由于你的犯罪等级，地方当局在你重生后囚禁了你。
hints_actorstatusrespawnprison.english: Due to your current CrimeStat, local authorities have incarcerated you after regeneration.

hints_actorstatustemperatureabovemaxresi.chinese: 你正在经受高温，有中暑的危险。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御高温的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatustemperatureabovemaxresi.english: You're experiencing high temperatures and are at risk of hyperthermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.

hints_actorstatustemperaturebelowminresi.chinese: 你正在经受低温，有低温症的危险。寻找遮蔽处或穿上能抵御低温的衣服和护甲。
hints_actorstatustemperaturebelowminresi.english: You're experiencing low temperatures and are at risk of hypothermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.

hints_actorstatustemperaturedeath.chinese: 为了避免负面影响和失去知觉，记得穿上适合你所处温度的衣服或护甲。
hints_actorstatustemperaturedeath.english: To avoid negative effects and becoming unconscious, remember to equip clothing or armor rated for the temperature you are in.

hints_actorstatuswearinghelmetconsume.chinese: 你必须脱下头盔才能喝水或进食。
hints_actorstatuswearinghelmetconsume.english: You must remove your helmet to consume food or drink.

hints_actorstatusweatherlocomotionentere.chinese: 请注意，恶劣的天气和强风会降低温度，使行动变得困难。以防风暴来临准备好设备。
hints_actorstatusweatherlocomotionentere.english: Be aware that severe weather and strong winds can drop temperatures and make it difficult to move. Have equipment ready in case a storm breaks out.

hints_asop1.chinese: 舰队管理自助服务终端位于空间站、空港和机库，允许你检索任何你拥有或目前租用的载具。
hints_asop1.english: Fleet Manager kiosks located in stations, spaceports and hangars, allow you to retrieve any of the vehicles you own or are currently renting.

hints_asop2.chinese: 通过气闸室到达停机坪。
hints_asop2.english: Pass through an Airlock to reach the landing pads. Follow the AR waypoint on your visor to locate your ship.

hints_asop3.chinese: 当与舰队管理自助服务终端互动时，选择“取回”按钮把你想要的载具带到机库。
hints_asop3.english: While interacting with the Fleet Manager kiosk, select 'Retrieve' on the vehicle you wish to have brought to a hangar.

hints_atc1.chinese: 要获得机库分配或起飞许可，请通过 MFD 或 mobiGlas 上的通讯菜单联系着陆服务。
hints_atc1.english: To receive a hangar assignment or permission to take-off, contact landing services via the Comms menu on your MFD or in your mobiGlas.

hints_atc2.chinese: 点击着陆服务频道或空管旁边的通讯按钮即可发出请求。
hints_atc2.english: Select the Comms icon next to the landing service to make the request.

hints_atc3.chinese: 点击着陆服务频道或空管旁边的通讯按钮可提出起飞申请。
hints_atc3.english: Select the Comms icon next to the landing service to request take-off.

hints_bodydrag_dropbody.chinese: 要放手，使用交互模式并选择“丢下躯体”。冲刺、跳跃、蹲下或使用双手物品等动作会自动丢下躯体。
hints_bodydrag_dropbody.english: To let go, use Interaction Mode and select “Drop Body.” Actions like sprint, jump, crouch, or using two-handed items will automatically drop the body.

hints_bodydrag_whilstdragging.chinese: 在拖拽时你只能以步行的速度移动，拖拽状态下你只能用单手武器。
hints_bodydrag_whilstdragging.english: Move at a walking pace to drag the body along with you. You may use one-handed weapons without detaching from the body.

hints_camera1.chinese: 在驾驶载具时，您可以选择在多个摄像机视图中循环。
hints_camera1.english: While piloting a vehicle, you have the option to cycle through multiple camera views.

hints_cargo_align.chinese: 要转移货物，请保持你的飞船对准装卸区。如果您的货物甲板分配被撤销，请联系货运服务申请一个新的。
hints_cargo_align.english: To transfer cargo, maintain alignment of your ship in the loading area. If your deck assignment is revoked, contact Cargo Services for a new one.

hints_cargo_collect.chinese: 像货轮C这样的船舶需要通过货物转移系统进行装卸。联系货运服务，来分配一个开放的货物甲板。
hints_cargo_collect.english: Ships like the Hull C require loading and unloading through the Cargo Transfer system. Contact Cargo Services to be assigned an open cargo deck.

hints_cargo_deliver.chinese: 要在货轮C这样的船舶上转移货物，请联系货运服务来分配一个开放的货物甲板。货物转移完成后，相关款项将会发送到你的账户。
hints_cargo_deliver.english: To transfer cargo with ships like the Hull C, contact Cargo Services to be assigned a cargo deck. Payment will be sent when the transfer is complete.

hints_cargo_forfeit.chinese: 如果您在完成转移之前离开该区域，请联系货运服务以恢复。全部离开的话，剩下的货物将全部丢失。
hints_cargo_forfeit.english: If you exit the area before finishing the transfer, contact Cargo Services to resume. Depart entirely and your remaining cargo lost.

hints_cargo_hail.chinese: 要转移货物，请在 mobiGlas 上的通讯或船上多功能显示器 (MFD) 上的通讯菜单中联系货物服务。
hints_cargo_hail.english: To transfer cargo, contact Cargo Services from the Commlink in your mobiGlas or the Comm’s menu on your ship’s multi-function displays (MFDs).

hints_cargo_interrupt_transfer.chinese: 货物转移可以通过以下方式停止：移动或退出您的船，收回货物主轴或阻塞装载区域。
hints_cargo_interrupt_transfer.english: Cargo transfers can be halted by things like: moving or exiting your ship, retracting the cargo spindles, or an obstructed loading area.

hints_cargo_invalid_ship.chinese: 货运服务只支持外部装载的大型载具，例如“货”系列的飞船。
hints_cargo_invalid_ship.english: Cargo Services can only accommodate larger vehicles that support exterior loading, such as the Hull series of ships.

hints_cargo_invalid_ship_title.chinese: 货运服务 – 载具尺寸

hints_cargo_loading_revoked.chinese: 如果您未能及时向指定的货运甲板报道，您的装卸区将被撤销。联系货运服务以重新分配装卸区。
hints_cargo_loading_revoked.english: If you fail to report to your assigned cargo deck in a timely manner your loading area will be revoked. Contact Cargo Services for a new deck assignment.

hints_cargo_spindles.chinese: 要将货物装载到“货”系列飞船上，必须延长货物主轴。
hints_cargo_spindles.english: To load cargo onto the Hull series of ships, the cargo spindles must be extended.

hints_chat1.chinese: 你可以使用mobiGlas通信应用程序与他人聊天，或者打开面罩上的聊天窗口。
hints_chat1.english: You can chat with others using the mobiGlas Comms app, or by opening the chat window on your visor.

hints_criminality1.chinese: 因为在受监管的空域犯下违规行为，你获得了一个犯罪等级。你当前的犯罪等级将会显示在 HUD 上。
hints_criminality1.english: You've gained a CrimeStat level by committing an infraction in monitored space. Your current CrimeStat level is displayed on your HUD.

hints_criminality2.chinese: 你的犯罪等级越高，当地安全部门针对你的敌意越大。
hints_criminality2.english: The higher your CrimeStat level, the more hostility you'll encounter from local Security.

hints_criminality3.chinese: 您的犯罪等级会限制可用的合约。犯罪等级可以通过支付罚款或服刑来合法消除。
hints_criminality3.english: Your CrimeStat level can limit which contracts are available. Crimestat levels can be legally removed by paying fines or serving jail time.

hints_cryastro1.chinese: 只要支付一定的费用，你的飞船的损坏、燃料和弹药补给就可以在许多登陆区域通过mobiGlas着陆应用程序进行修复和补充。
hints_cryastro1.english: For a price, your ship's damage, fuel, and ammo supplies can be fixed and topped up at many landing areas via the mobiGlas Landing app.

hints_cryastro2.chinese: 找到一个可用的起降平台来开启你的交易。
hints_cryastro2.english: Find an available landing platform to land on to start your transaction.

hints_defaultitemactions_attempttocustom.chinese: 在拿着物品时，无法对其自定义操作。
hints_defaultitemactions_attempttocustom.english: This item's actions cannot be customized while being held.

hints_forcereaction_knockdown_firsttime.chinese: 强力撞击会令你倒下。按下或按住 ~action(player|zoom) 能令你更快的恢复并重新掌控武器。
hints_forcereaction_knockdown_firsttime.english: Large impacts can knock you prone.  Press or hold ~action(player|zoom) mid-fall to recover and gain weapon control sooner.

hints_fpsharvesting_onfpsharvestableitem.chinese: 你已经成功收获了一件物品！要把它转移到你的个人库存中，就与该物品互动并选择储存它。
hints_fpsharvesting_onfpsharvestableitem.english: You have successfully harvested an item. To add it to your personal inventory, interact with the item and choose to store it.

hints_fpsharvesting_onharvestableitemloo.chinese: 你库存中采集的物品可以在很多地方出售。为了最大化你的潜在利润，建议继续采集直到你的库存完全塞满。
hints_fpsharvesting_onharvestableitemloo.english: Items that you collect in your inventory can be sold at various locations. To maximize your profits, consider collecting until your inventory is full.

hints_fpsharvesting_onharvestablestowed.chinese: 你已经成功地收集并储存了一件物品。收集到的可开采物和可采摘物可以在交易终端出售以获取利润。
hints_fpsharvesting_onharvestablestowed.english: You have successfully collected and stored an item. Collected mineables and harvestables can be sold at trading consoles for profit.

hints_fpsharvesting_onplayerlooksatfpsha.chinese: 你发现了一个可采集的物品。要收获它，只需与它交互即可。
hints_fpsharvesting_onplayerlooksatfpsha.english: You have found a harvestable item. To collect it, simply interact with it.

hints_fpsharvesting_onplayerlooksatfpsha.chinese: 你发现了一个可以采集的物品，但是你没有装备可以装下它的护甲或衣服。所以无法存储此物品。
hints_fpsharvesting_onplayerlooksatfpsha.english: You have found a harvestable item but you don't have an armor with an inventory equipped. You cannot store this item without one.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerbackpackfull.chinese: 你的库存已经满了，在清空或出售库存中已有的矿物之前，不能存储更多矿物。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerbackpackfull.english: Your inventory is full. You cannot store any more shards until you empty it or sell its contents.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerfinishedscanning.chinese: 扫描后，用采矿工具产生的能量将其破碎，准备收集。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerfinishedscanning.english: Once scanned, prepare the deposit for collection by fracturing it with energy from your mining tool.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerlooksatfpsrock.chinese: 你发现了一个可开采的矿石。为了收集有价值的碎片，首先需要用采矿工具的能量将岩石破碎。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerlooksatfpsrock.english: You have found a harvestable deposit. To collect the valuable shards, the rock will first need to be fractured with energy from a mining tool.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerowningminingtool.chinese: 这种采矿工具可以从较小的岩石中收集有价值的材料，因为这些岩石过于脆弱，大型采矿车辆无法采集。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerowningminingtool.english: This mining tool allows for the collection of valuable materials from smaller ore deposits too delicate to be harvested by larger mining vehicles.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerselectingminingt.chinese: 要找到适合使用采矿工具的岩石，可以搜索洞穴，卫星，行星和小行星，寻找嵌有晶体的岩石。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerselectingminingt.english: To find deposits suitable for use with the mining tool, search caves, moons, planets, and asteroids for rocks embedded with crystals.

hints_fpsmining_onplayershootminingtoola.chinese: 试图将该工具用于除采矿以外的任何事情将收效甚微。找到合适的矿床，正确使用工具。
hints_fpsmining_onplayershootminingtoola.english: Trying to use the tool for anything other than mining will have little effect. Find a suitable ore deposit to use the tool properly.

hints_fpsmining_onplayerstartmining.chinese: 调节采矿工具的功率以保持岩石的最佳能量水平。不稳定性高则需要更多调整。阻抗高需要更多的能量。
hints_fpsmining_onplayerstartmining.english: Throttle the mining tool's power to keep the rock's energy level optimal. High instability needs more adjustment. High resistance needs more energy.

hints_fpsmining_onplayertargetsfpsrock.chinese: 扫描一个矿床，持有 ~action(player|zoom) 与采矿工具装备。所提供的成分细节对成功开采至关重要。
hints_fpsmining_onplayertargetsfpsrock.english: To scan an ore deposit, hold ~action(player|zoom) with the mining tool equipped. The compositional details provided are critical to successful mining.

hints_fpsmining_onrockenterdangerzone.chinese: 注意，对岩石的过度充能会导致危险甚至致命的爆炸。
hints_fpsmining_onrockenterdangerzone.english: Careful. Overcharging a rock can result in a dangerous and even lethal explosion.

hints_fpsmining_onrockenteroptimalzone.chinese: 只要在足够的时间内充入最合适的能量，它们很快就会碎裂。
hints_fpsmining_onrockenteroptimalzone.english: Once a deposit has been charged with the optimal amount of energy for enough time, they will soon fracture.

hints_fpsmining_onrocksuccessfulyfractur.chinese: 现在岩石已经被击碎，你可以与这些碎片进行互动，将有价值的矿物存储到你的个人库存中。
hints_fpsmining_onrocksuccessfulyfractur.english: Now that the rock has been fractured, interact with the shards to store them in your personal inventory.

hints_fpsmining_onshardlootedintobackpac.chinese: 你采集并存储到库存中的矿石碎片可以在很多地方出售。
hints_fpsmining_onshardlootedintobackpac.english: Collected shards in your inventory can be sold at various locations. To maximize your profits, consider collecting until your inventory is full.

hints_fuel1.chinese: 在飞行员座位上用你的手环应用在机库加油。如果你的飞船有燃料进入，限制你的速度以随时间补充燃料。
hints_fuel1.english: Refuel at a hangar with your Landing mobi-app from the pilot's seat. If your ship has intakes, limit your speed to refill over time.

hints_fuel2.chinese: 在停机坪或机库停好，然后在飞行员座位上使用你的着陆手环应用。
hints_fuel2.english: To refuel, park at a pad or hangar and use your Landing mobi-app from the pilot’s seat.

hints_fuel3.chinese: 如果你的飞船有燃料进入，限制你的速度以随时间补充燃料。
hints_fuel3.english: If your spaceship has fuel intakes, limit your maneuvering to refill over time.

hints_green_zone1.chinese: 你已经离开禁火区域并进入公共空域。禁火区域内的战斗限制现已失效。
hints_green_zone1.english: You have left the confines of the Armistice Zone and entered open space. The combat restrictions of the Armistice Zone are no longer in effect.

hints_heal1.chinese: 你的生命值目前偏低。如果你的个人库存中有医疗笔，可以装备它以进行治疗。你可以从商店中购买更多医疗笔。
hints_heal1.english: Your health is low. If you have a MedPen in your inventory, equip it to use it to heal. You can purchase more MedPens from shops.

hints_heal2.chinese: 如果你的个人库存中有医疗笔，可以装备它以进行治疗。你可以从商店中购买更多医疗笔。
hints_heal2.english: If you have a MedPen in your inventory, equip it to use it heal. You can purchase more MedPens from shops.

hints_hint_system1.chinese: 你可以在任何时候通过游戏设置禁用提示。
hints_hint_system1.english: You can disable the Hints at any time via the Game Settings.

hints_interaction_condition_carry.chinese: 这个物品太重了，无法捡起。
hints_interaction_condition_carry.english: This item is too heavy to pick up.

hints_interaction_condition_generic.chinese: 某些交互选项可能会因为环境变得不可用。使用内思菜单或提示来帮助解决限制状态。
hints_interaction_condition_generic.english: Some interaction options can become unavailable based on context. Use the inner thought text or hint to help resolve the blocking condition.

hints_interaction_condition_helmet.chinese: 您不能在戴着头盔时使用此交互。通过 mobiGlas 或个人内思菜单取下你的头盔，然后再试一次。
hints_interaction_condition_helmet.english: You cannot use this interaction while wearing a helmet. Remove your helmet through mobiGlas or Personal Inner Thought menu and try again.

hints_interaction_condition_helmet_consu.chinese: 吃东西或喝水时请摘下头盔。
hints_interaction_condition_helmet_consu.english: Remove your helmet to eat or drink.

hints_interaction_condition_standing.chinese: 你必须站立才能与之互动。
hints_interaction_condition_standing.english: You must be standing in order to use this interaction.

hints_interaction_condition_undersuit_ox.chinese: 装备一件基底服才能使用氧素笔。
hints_interaction_condition_undersuit_ox.english: Equip an undersuit to use an OxyPen.

hints_inventory_closedexternalinventoryo.chinese: 距离一个货柜或容器太远将关闭库存屏幕。要重新打开，请回到范围内。
hints_inventory_closedexternalinventoryo.english: Moving too far away from a source or container will close the inventory screen. To reopen, move back within range.

hints_inventory_containerfull.chinese: 存储容器有容量限制。当装满或几乎装满时，你将无法放入会超过容量限制的物品。
hints_inventory_containerfull.english: Storage Containers have capacity limits. When full or almost full, you cannot add items that would exceed the limit.

hints_inventory_containersizelimits.chinese: 存储容器有尺寸限制。过大的物品将无法放入。
hints_inventory_containersizelimits.english: Storage containers have size limits. Items that are too large cannot be placed inside.

hints_inventory_homeitemadded.chinese: 一个新的物品已经添加到您的主要居住地库存里，可以在那里通过库存访问
hints_inventory_homeitemadded.english: A new item(s) has been added to your primary residence's local storage and can accessed while there via the inventory.

hints_inventory_invalidclothingarmorequi.chinese: 服装与基底服（当然也包含基底服上的护甲）不可同时装备。
hints_inventory_invalidclothingarmorequi.english: Clothing and undersuits (and thus armor) cannot be equipped at the same time.

hints_inventory_itempurchased.chinese: 您的购买已被转移到您的本地存储，并可以在当前地点通过库存访问。
hints_inventory_itempurchased.english: Your purchase has been transferred to your local storage and can be accessed while at this location via the inventory.

hints_inventory_open.chinese: 拖放物品以在储存容器和个人储存间转移;包括任何穿戴或持有的物品。
hints_inventory_open.english: Drag and drop items to transfer them between storage containers and personal storage; including any items being worn or held.

hints_inventory_openinvehicle.chinese: 使用屏幕两侧的标签在你的个人库存和各种存储容器之间切换。
hints_inventory_openinvehicle.english: Navigate between your personal inventory and various storage containers using the tabs on the sides of the screen.

hints_inventory_openwithnocontainer.chinese: 装备衣服，护甲和背包来管理他们的存储。访问一个容器来管理它的库存。要丢掉项目，请将它们拖到拖放手图标上。
hints_inventory_openwithnocontainer.english: Equip clothing, armor, and backpacks to manage their storage. Visit a container to manage its inventory. To drop items, drag them to the drop hand icon.

hints_inventory_spawnpointexit.chinese: 要找到你的物品被存放在哪里，使用mobiGlas资产应用来跟踪你所有的物品和它们的当前位置。
hints_inventory_spawnpointexit.english: To find where your items are being stored, use the mobiGlas Asset app to track all your belongings and their current whereabouts.

hints_inventory_spawnpointexit_2.chinese: 通过拖放武器，衣服和护甲来使用你的库存来装备和拆卸物品
hints_inventory_spawnpointexit_2.english: Use your inventory to equip and unequip items, weapons, clothing, and armor by dragging and dropping.

hints_inventory_undersuitclothingincompa.chinese: 你必须穿着基底服才能装备护甲。由于基底服无法与服装同时装备，因此你也无法给服装配置护甲。
hints_inventory_undersuitclothingincompa.english: You must wear an undersuit to equip armor pieces. Since undersuits can't be worn with clothing, you are unable to pair clothing with armor.

hints_inventory_vehicledestroyed.chinese: 当载具被摧毁时，其库存中的一些物品有概率幸免于难。如果你想寻回这些物品，请在残骸中搜索存储容器。（牵引光束可能会帮上你。）
hints_inventory_vehicledestroyed.english: When a vehicle is destroyed, some items aboard have a chance of surviving. To recover, search the wreckage. (A tractor beam may be helpful.)

hints_inventory_vehiclestorageused.chinese: 要找到你的物品的位置，使用mobiGlas资产应用。
hints_inventory_vehiclestorageused.english: To find the locations of your belongings, use the mobiGlas Asset app.

hints_items1_priming.chinese: 装备的手榴弹可以待发开始一个爆炸倒计时。一定要在手榴弹爆炸前扔出或取消起爆。
hints_items1_priming.english: Equipped grenades can be primed to begin a detonation countdown. Be sure to throw or cancel the priming before the grenade explodes.

hints_items2.chinese: 当一颗手雷被抛向你的时候会触发手雷图案的指示标。
hints_items2.english: Watch out for the grenade icon that indicates when a grenade has been thrown near to you.

hints_journal1.chinese: 你可以通过日志应用查看信件和收集到的数据。
hints_journal1.english: The Journal app is for reviewing your correspondence and collected data.

hints_keybinding1.chinese: 如果提示中的动作按键是未绑定的，你可以在键绑定菜单中重新设置它们。在选项中找到按键设置菜单。
hints_keybinding1.english: If a Hint action is UNBOUND you should remap it in the Keybinding menu. Find the Keybinding menu in the Options.

hints_loggingout.chinese: 在你飞船的床上，与他互动以查看登出游戏选项。
hints_loggingout.english: While in your ship's bed, interact with it to see the option to log out.

hints_loginbedspawnfailgeneric.chinese: 你最近登出时躺着的床铺在该服务器当前不可用。所以，你已经在上一个位置重生。
hints_loginbedspawnfailgeneric.english: The bed you last logged out from is currently unavailable on this server. Instead, you have respawned at your previous location.

hints_logoutaiship.chinese: 只有玩家拥有的飞船可以作为初始登入地点。
hints_logoutaiship.english: Only ships owned by a player can be used as an initial spawn location.

hints_logoutenterednonowned.chinese: 你可以在另一个玩家的船上重生，如果该飞船在服务器上可用。否则，你的重生将会在你最后储存飞船的位置。
hints_logoutenterednonowned.english: You can spawn on another player's ship if it is available on the server. Otherwise, your initial spawn will be the last location you stored a ship at.

hints_logoutenterednoplayersaround.chinese: 当没有其他玩家在该区域时，你的飞船将在服务器上消失。
hints_logoutenterednoplayersaround.english: When no other people are in the area, your ship will despawn from the server.

hints_logoutenteredplayersaround.chinese: 当有玩家在附近时，你的飞船会在服务器上保留一段时间。在此期间，它有被破坏或盗走的风险。
hints_logoutenteredplayersaround.english: When people are nearby, your ship remains on the server for a short time. During this time there is a risk of it being destroyed or stolen.

hints_logoutenteredplayersinship.chinese: 如果有玩家在你的船上，服务器将会保留飞船直到空了为止。在此期间，它有被破坏或盗走的风险。
hints_logoutenteredplayersinship.english: If there are people aboard, your ship will not despawn until it is empty. During this time there is a risk of it being destroyed or stolen.

hints_logoutshipwithinship.chinese: 储存在另一艘载具内舰载机库中的飞船不能用于玩家的登入登出。
hints_logoutshipwithinship.english: Vehicles stored on another ship's landing area are not available for player spawning.

hints_map01.chinese: 用你的mobiGlas地图，你可以设置目的地，位置标记，并计划路线。
hints_map01.english: From your mobiGlas Map you can set destinations, place markers, and plan routes.

hints_map01_gamepad.chinese: 用你的mobiGlas地图，你可以设置目的地，位置标记，并计划路线。
hints_map01_gamepad.english: From your mobiGlas Map you can set destinations, place markers, and plan routes.

hints_medbeam_firemode.chinese: 通过在自己和其他受伤的人之间切换来选择治疗对象。
hints_medbeam_firemode.english: Choose who to heal by toggling between targeting yourself and other injured individuals.

hints_medbeam_medgun_advmode.chinese: 在进阶模式中，你可以调整输送给目标的药物类型和剂量。(player_choice|pc_select)来调整剂量滑块。
hints_medbeam_medgun_advmode.english: In Advanced Mode you can adjust the drug types and dosages delivered to your target.

hints_medbeam_medgun_advmodebuttons.chinese: 按下自动按钮可以自动设置对应的目标用药剂量。按下清除按钮以重设当前的目标剂量。
hints_medbeam_medgun_advmodebuttons.english: Press the Auto button to automatically set the target dosages. Press Clear to reset the target Dosage.

hints_medbeam_medgun_advmodecritbdlbypas.chinese: 进阶模式绕过了基本模式中的血药浓度临界值限制，应当被谨慎使用。更快的血药浓度下降速度可以通过控制瑞舒吉拉的用量来实现。
hints_medbeam_medgun_advmodecritbdlbypas.english: Advanced Mode bypasses BDL safety limits and should be used with caution. Administering Resurgera will reduce a target’s BDL faster over time.

hints_medbeam_medgun_bdlcrit.chinese: 在基础模式下，医疗设备无法治疗血药浓度（BDL）处于危急状态的目标。使用高级模式可以绕过 BDL 安全限制。
hints_medbeam_medgun_bdlcrit.english: Medical Devices cannot heal targets with a critical Blood Drug Level (BDL) when in Basic Mode. Use Advanced Mode to bypass the BDL safety limits.

hints_medbeam_medgun_targetrequired.chinese: 你可以使用医疗设备在短距离内对目标进行治疗和施药。
hints_medbeam_medgun_targetrequired.english: You can heal and apply drugs to a target over a short distance using a Medical Device.

hints_medbeam_medgun_toggleadvmode.chinese: 切换至进阶模式以访问更多样的施药选项。
hints_medbeam_medgun_toggleadvmode.english: Toggle to the Advanced Mode to access more drug application options.

hints_medbeam_mt_bdlcrit.chinese: 多功能工具的治疗附件无法治疗血药浓度处于危险值的目标。
hints_medbeam_mt_bdlcrit.english: The Multi-Tool Healing Attachment cannot heal targets with a Critical Blood Drug Level (BDL).

hints_medbeam_mt_targetrequired.chinese: 你可以使用多功能工具的治疗附件在短距离内治疗一个目标。
hints_medbeam_mt_targetrequired.english: You can heal a target over a short distance using the Multi-Tool Healing Attachment.

hints_medbeam_validtargetacquired.chinese: 有关目标当前健康状况详细信息可以在医疗设备的增强现实显示器中找到。
hints_medbeam_validtargetacquired.english: Additional information regarding a target's current health status can found in the Medical Device's AR display.

hints_medbeam_validtargetacquired_hurt.chinese: 使用药物来减轻受伤症状，改善受伤对象的健康状况。注意，这会增加目标的血药浓度(BDL)。
hints_medbeam_validtargetacquired_hurt.english: Apply drugs to alleviate injury symptoms and improve the health of an injured target. Note that this increases the target’s Blood Drug Level (BDL).

hints_medpenstabblockedingreenzone.chinese: 在禁火区内，医疗笔将无法用于医治他人。
hints_medpenstabblockedingreenzone.english: Medical pens cannot be used to inject others while in a armistice zone.

hints_melee_blocking.chinese: 要想成功阻挡敌人，就要转身面对即将到来的攻击。
hints_melee_blocking.english: To successfully block, turn to face the incoming attack.

hints_melee_comboattacks.chinese: 要进行组合攻击，请左右交替进行攻击。
hints_melee_comboattacks.english: To perform combinations, alternate left and right attacks.

hints_melee_heavyhaymaker.chinese: 要打出强力一击，在完成刺拳后，用另一只手进行一记重拳。
hints_melee_heavyhaymaker.english: To throw a Haymaker, preform a heavy punch with the opposite hand after performing a Jab.

hints_melee_stun.chinese: 当你被拳头击中时，你将遭受可能导致昏迷的伤害。这不会是致命的，但如果被击中太多，你会被击倒。
hints_melee_stun.english: When hit by fists you will suffer stun damage. This is not lethal, but get hit too much and you will be knocked down.

hints_melee_uppercut.chinese: 要投掷上勾拳，用另一只手的攻击跟随一个钩拳。
hints_melee_uppercut.english: To throw an Uppercut, follow up a hook with an attack from the alternate hand.

hints_mfd1.chinese: 通过驾驶舱的交互屏幕来管理你飞船的能量，热量，武器和护盾。
hints_mfd1.english: Manage your ship's power, heat, weapons and shields via the interactive screens in your cockpit.

hints_mfd2.chinese: 使用交互模式切换和操作屏幕上显示的信息。
hints_mfd2.english: Use Interaction Mode to switch between and manipulate the information displayed on screen.

hints_mfd3.chinese: 花点时间习惯这里提供的选项。能够快速浏览这些屏幕提供的信息对于驾驶至关重要。
hints_mfd3.english: Take the time to get accustomed to the options available here. Being able to quickly navigate these screens will be vital later.

hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableexpi.chinese: 一个激活的采矿模组已经失效，无法工作。主动激活式采矿模组可以被激活多次，直到它们完全耗尽。
hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableexpi.english: An Active Mining Module has expired and its effects have ended. However, they can be activated multiple times until they're depleted.

hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableexpi.chinese: 一个激活的采矿组件已经失效，完全耗尽。回到采矿设备供应商处购买更多采矿组件。
hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableexpi.english: An Active Mining Module has expired and is now fully depleted. Return to a mining equipment supplier to purchase more.

hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableused.chinese: 每种类型的采矿模组在激活时都有不同的效果和持续时间。尝试不同的模组，在不同的情况下找到最适合你的。
hints_miningconsumables_onconsumableused.english: Each type of Mining Module has different effects and durations. Experiment with Modules to find what works best for you in various situations.

hints_miningconsumables_onfirstminingcon.chinese: 购买的采矿模组可以装备在兼容的采矿激光上。通过载具管理器将模组分配到一个可用的槽位。
hints_miningconsumables_onfirstminingcon.english: Purchased Mining Modules can be equipped on compatible mining lasers. Assign the module to an available slot via the Vehicle Manager.

hints_miningconsumables_onfirstminingwit.chinese: 被动采矿模组是一直生效的。然而主动采矿模组必须在开采时手动激活。使用交互模式，或通过仪表板上的采矿模组面板激活它们。
hints_miningconsumables_onfirstminingwit.english: Passive Mining Modules are always functional. For Active Mining Modules, use Interaction Mode on the Mining Module Panel on your Dashboard.

hints_monitored1,p.chinese: 当地安全部队负责维护整个监管区域的法律秩序。在你的面罩上显示眼睛图标的任何区域都处于监控之下。
hints_monitored1,p.english: Local security forces uphold monitored zones throughout the system. Any area where the eye icon is displayed on your visor is monitored.

hints_monitored2.chinese: 正在工作中的通讯阵列是用来维持监管区域监控的。
hints_monitored2.english: Working Comm Arrays are required to maintain monitored space.

hints_monitored3.chinese: 你已经飞出了当地的安全监管区域。
hints_monitored3.english: You have passed outside of the local security's monitored zone.

hints_onprospectorcargofull.chinese: 你的货仓已经快满了。满容量后继续吸收的矿物将会丢失。前往有诸如十-L1或者赫-L2这样有精炼中心的休息站来售卖你的材料。
hints_onprospectorcargofull.english: Your cargo hold is full. Any additional minerals extracted will be lost. Travel to a rest stop with a Refinery to refine or sell your materials.

hints_onprospectorcargohalffull.chinese: 你的货舱已经装了一半了。
hints_onprospectorcargohalffull.english: Your cargo hold is half full.

hints_onprospectorenginestart.chinese: 想要开始采矿，就飞到一颗行星或卫星的表面，使用雷达扫描来发现有价值的岩石，然后开始采集矿物。
hints_onprospectorenginestart.english: To start mining, travel above the surface of a planet, moon, or asteroid and use your vehicle's radar ping to find and identify mineral deposits.

hints_onprospectorextractablerocktargett.chinese: 旦岩石块小到可以收获，它将拥有一个紫色提示轮廓。瞄准岩石，切换到提取模式提取岩石内部的矿物。
hints_onprospectorextractablerocktargett.english: Once the rock is small enough to harvest, it will have a purple outline. Target the rock and switch to Extraction Mode to extract the minerals inside the rock.

hints_onprospectorfracturablerocktargett.chinese: 瞄准一块岩石，让你的飞船自动扫描它。保持扫描进度以获得更多岩石的信息。切换到碎裂模式使用采矿激光，根据需要调整节流阀。
hints_onprospectorfracturablerocktargett.english: Target a rock to scan it, collecting more data over time. Switch to Fracture Mode to use the Mining Laser, adjusting the throttle as needed.

hints_onprospectorinloworbitovermoon.chinese: 为了找到有价值的材料，切换到你的扫描模式，使用雷达扫描来定位潜在的矿藏。
hints_onprospectorinloworbitovermoon.english: To find valuable materials, switch to your scanning mode and use the radar ping to locate potential mineral deposits.

hints_onprospectorminingnoprogress.chinese: 有些矿石对你现有的设备来说阻抗太大或尺寸太大。尝试升级你的激光器、寻找不同的矿藏、或者与其他人合作。
hints_onprospectorminingnoprogress.english: Some deposits are too resistant or big for your current equipment. Try upgrading your laser, finding different deposits, or teaming up with others.

hints_onprospectorradarblobfound.chinese: 发现可供采矿的沉积岩。飞近一点，缩小扫描区域，确定它含有何种矿物。
hints_onprospectorradarblobfound.english: Mineral deposit detected. Fly closer to narrow down its position and identify what it is.

hints_onprospectorrockextracted.chinese: 你已成功提取你的第一批有价值的矿物。你可以继续开采资源，直到满载而归。
hints_onprospectorrockextracted.english: You have extracted your first valuable materials. You can continue to mine resources until your cargo hold is full.

hints_onprospectorrockfractured.chinese: 现在，岩石已被击碎，继续尝试击碎这些碎裂下来的岩石块(黄色)，直到它们小到可以被提取(紫色)。
hints_onprospectorrockfractured.english: Now that the rock has fractured, keep shattering the fragments (yellow) until they become small enough to be extracted (purple).

hints_onprospectorrockinpassiveradar.chinese: 你发现了一块富含矿物的岩石，靠近并将你的船切换到采矿模式，开始碎裂和提取过程。
hints_onprospectorrockinpassiveradar.english: You have found a rock rich in ore. Get close and switch your ship to Mining Mode to begin the fracturing and extraction process.

hints_onprospectorrockpowerdangerlevel.chinese: 注意，如果岩石达到危险水平(红色)，它可能会爆炸，岩石周遭将会非常危险。
hints_onprospectorrockpowerdangerlevel.english: If a rock being mined reaches dangerous levels (red) it will potentially explode, damaging everything nearby.

hints_onprospectorrockpoweroptimallevel.chinese: 将能量保持在岩石的最佳窗口内(绿色)，进行可控安全的作业。
hints_onprospectorrockpoweroptimallevel.english: Keeping the energy level inside the rock's optimal window (green) will cause a controlled fracture to occur.

hints_oxygen1.chinese: 当你的氧气罐不够用的时候给它补充氧气，从你的库存中装备一个氧素笔，然后使用它。氧素笔可在商店购买。
hints_oxygen1.english: To refill your oxygen tank when its low, equip an OxyPen from your inventory and then use it. OxyPens are available for purchase at shops.

hints_oxygen2.chinese: 你的氧气快用完了。从你的库存中装备一个氧素笔，用它来补充你的储罐。氧笔可在商店购买。
hints_oxygen2.english: Your oxygen's running low. Equip an OxyPen from your inventory and use it to refill your tank. OxyPens are available for purchase at shops.

hints_oxygen3.chinese: 你的氧气存量很低。从你的库存中装备一个氧素笔，用它来补充你的储罐。氧笔可在商店购买。
hints_oxygen3.english: Your oxygen tank's very low. Equip an OxyPen from your inventory and use it to refill your tank. OxyPens are available for purchase at shops.

hints_oxygen4.chinese: 你的氧气快耗尽了。需要找到一个拥有生命维持系统的地方或找到一只氧素笔。
hints_oxygen4.english: Your Oxygen Tank is running low. Return to an environment with life support or use an OxyPen to replenish it.

hints_oxygen6.chinese: 你氧气罐中的氧气储量非常低。快回到一个拥有生命维持系统的地方或找到一只氧素笔。
hints_oxygen6.english: Your Oxygen Tank is very low. Quickly return to an environment with life support or use an OxyPen to replenish it.

hints_personal_inner_thought1.chinese: 使用交互模式 (~action(player_choice|pc_interaction_mode)) 然后按下 ~action(player_choice|pc_personal_thought) 打开你的个人内心思想菜单。
hints_personal_inner_thought1.english: Use Interaction Mode (~action(player_choice|pc_interaction_mode)) and press ~action(player_choice|pc_personal_thought) to open your Personal Inner Thought menu.

hints_personal_inventory01.chinese: 要打开完整库存，请按 (~action(player_choice|pc_pit_inventory))。要打开快速库存，请使用~action(player_choice|pc_pit_looting)。
hints_personal_inventory01.english: To open your Full Inventory press (~action(player_choice|pc_pit_inventory)). To open the Quick Inventory use ~action(player_choice|pc_pit_looting).

hints_pickups1.chinese: 当敌人被击败的时候，他们会掉落补给可以补充你的飞船。有四种不同的类型：燃料，弹药，导弹和维修材料。
hints_pickups1.english: When enemies are defeated, they drop pickups that replenish your spaceship. There are four different kinds: Fuel, Ammo, Missiles and Repair.

hints_pickups2.chinese: 补给是提供给造成最大伤害的玩家的一份奖励。
hints_pickups2.english: The pickups offer larger rewards to the players that dealt the most damage.

hints_pit_flightmodeselect_menu.chinese: 高亮显示一个部分并释放以打开或关闭模式。轻击将切换最后选择的飞行模式。
hints_pit_flightmodeselect_menu.english: Highlight a segment and release to toggle a mode on or off. Tapping will toggle the last selected Flight Mode.

hints_pit_flightmodeselect_open.chinese: 在飞行模式选择菜单中，按住键选择，松开键执行操作。
hints_pit_flightmodeselect_open.english: In the Flight Mode Select menu, hold to select and release to perform the action.

hints_pit_menu_favorites.chinese: 内思菜单是与环境关联的，只有在处于正确状态时才可用。例如，量子旅行开关只有在船上座位上才可用。
hints_pit_menu_favorites.english: Favorites are contextual and only available when in the correct state. For example, the Quantum Travel toggle is only available when in a ship seat.

hints_pit_menu_inactive.chinese: 与环境关联的动作在不可用时将停用切变为灰色。例如，在禁火区内的装备武器动作。
hints_pit_menu_inactive.english: Contextual actions will be greyed out and inactive when they are not applicable. For example, equipping a weapon within an Armistice Zone.

hints_pit_menu_inactive_title.chinese: 个人内思系统 (PIT) - 停用

hints_pit_menu_navigation_title.chinese: 个人内思系统(PIT) - 引导

hints_pit_menu_open.chinese: 管理你的角色行为和可携带的库存是通过个人内心思想菜单来完成的。
hints_pit_menu_open.english: Managing your avatar's behavior and carriable inventory is done through the Personal Inner Thoughts menu.

hints_pit_menu_summary.chinese: 从PIT菜单中，你可以触发与环境关联的动作，设置热键和加入收藏夹。
hints_pit_menu_summary.english: From the PIT menu, you can trigger contextual actions, set hot keys, and assign favorites.

hints_port_olisar3.chinese: 在试图通过任何气闸通往外部之前，检查你是否穿戴了基底服和头盔。
hints_port_olisar3.english: Before attempting to pass through any External Airlock, check you've an undersuit and helmet equipped.

hints_private_match1.chinese: 私人比赛是不影响排名的，这意味着你的分数不会被记录。
hints_private_match1.english: Private matches are unranked meaning your scores aren't recorded.

hints_quantum_drive_cooldown1.chinese: 量子航行结束后，你的驱动器需要冷却。冷却时间的长短取决于量子航行的距离。
hints_quantum_drive_cooldown1.english: After you QT, your drive will need to cooldown. How long of a cooldown depends on the distance Quantum Travelled.

hints_quantum_drive_spooling1.chinese: 为了进行量子航行，飞船必须将它们的量子驱动器完全预热。
hints_quantum_drive_spooling1.english: Ships must fully spool up their Quantum Drives in order to Quantum Travel.

hints_quantum_drive_spooling2.chinese: 如果未在星图中选择任何内容，充能模式将显露附近的导航标记。
hints_quantum_drive_spooling2.english: Spooling your Quantum Drive will expose nearby navigation markers if nothing is selected in the Map.

hints_quantum_drive_spooling3.chinese: 你的量子驱动器的预热情况会在飞行抬头显示器和校准UI上显示。
hints_quantum_drive_spooling3.english: Your Quantum Drive's spooling status shows on your Flight HUD and the Calibration UI.

hints_quantum_drive_spooling4.chinese: 预热时量子驱动器将会从你飞船的其它部件抽取能量。要特别注意你飞船的武器和护盾。
hints_quantum_drive_spooling4.english: Spooling your Quantum Drive will draw power from other elements in your ship; most notably, your ship's Weapons and Shields.

hints_quantum_linking1.chinese: 一旦连接，为团体发起量子航行。附近的团队成员将和你一起航行。
hints_quantum_linking1.english: Once linked, you will be able to initiate QT for the group. Nearby group members that are aligned and spooled will travel with you.

hints_quantum_travel1.chinese: 一旦你在星图上设定了目的地，一个航路点便会出现在你的面板上。将你的飞船对准航路点，以校准量子航行。
hints_quantum_travel1.english: Once you've set a destination in the Map, a waypoint will appear on your visor. Align your ship to the waypoint to calibrate for QT.

hints_quantum_travel2.chinese: 你的目的地被阻挡，不能开始量子航行。你可能需要先航行至其它地点，找到一条通往目的地的无阻碍路线。
hints_quantum_travel2.english: Your destination is obstructed and Quantum Travel cannot be initiated. You may need to travel somewhere else first to find a clear path.

hints_quantum_travel_calibration1.chinese: 对准一个导航标记以开始校准你的量子航行。
hints_quantum_travel_calibration1.english: Align to a Nav Marker to start Calibrating your QT Target.

hints_quantum_travel_calibration3.chinese: 充能你的量子驱动器，一旦校准完毕，你就能量子航行到任何标记好的目的地。
hints_quantum_travel_calibration3.english: Spooling your Quantum Drive will allow you to Quantum Travel to any marked destination once calibrated.

hints_quantum_travel_calibration4.chinese: 一旦你的量子驱动被对齐和校准，你将能够启动量子航行。
hints_quantum_travel_calibration4.english: Once your Quantum Drive is aligned and calibrated you will be able initiate Quantum Travel.

hints_quantum_travel_cancel1.chinese: 虽然量子航行可以中途取消，但是只能在量子航行的减速阶段开始前取消。
hints_quantum_travel_cancel1.english: While Quantum Travel can be cancelled mid-route, it must be done PRIOR to starting the deceleration phase.

hints_refueling_deployboom.chinese: 选择加油模式，使您的飞船准备好与客户对接。
hints_refueling_deployboom.english: Select Refueling Mode to ready your ship for docking with a client.

hints_refueling_dockingprocess.chinese: 确保你的燃料喷嘴与客户飞船的前端对齐。
hints_refueling_dockingprocess.english: Be sure to align your fuel nozzle with the front of the client's ship.

hints_refueling_fuelreminder.chinese: 前往客户飞船的位置之前，请确保外部燃料吊舱已加满。
hints_refueling_fuelreminder.english: Ensure external fuel pods are full before heading to client's ship location.

hints_refueling_refuel.chinese: 打开燃料吊舱以开始燃料传输。
hints_refueling_refuel.english: Open fuel pods to initiate fuel transfer.

hints_refueling_requestdocking,p.chinese: 要向目标客户飞船发送对接请求，请使用 ~action(spaceship_docking|v_toggle_docking_request)
hints_refueling_requestdocking,p.english: To send a docking request to the client's ship you're targeting use ~action(spaceship_docking|v_toggle_docking_request).

hints_refueling_targetship,p.chinese: 要锁定需要进行对接的客户飞船，请使用 ~action(spaceship_targeting_advanced|v_target_cycle_in_view_reset)。
hints_refueling_targetship,p.english: To target the client's ship for docking use ~action(spaceship_targeting_advanced|v_target_cycle_in_view_reset).

hints_refueling_undocking.chinese: 加油完成后将自动脱离对接。
hints_refueling_undocking.english: Undocking will occur automatically when refueling is done.

hints_repairbeam_ammoempty.chinese: 修复使用的再生复合材料(RMC)可以在商店购买或打捞获得。可以在商店或通过使用打捞光束获得。
hints_repairbeam_ammoempty.english: Repairing consumes Recycled Material Composite (RMC), which can be acquired in shops or by using the Salvage Beam.

hints_repairbeam_hulloverview.chinese: 修理光束可以在载具的护盾关闭的情况下部分修复外部损伤。
hints_repairbeam_hulloverview.english: The Repair Beam can partially repair damage done to a hull as long as the ship or vehicle's shields are deactivated.

hints_repairbeam_repairing.chinese: 转化宝Lite附件的修复能力是有限的。它不会凭空产生崭新的载具外壳，但他对生存仍然非常关键。
hints_repairbeam_repairing.english: The repair capabilities of the Cambio-Lite SRT Attachment are limited. It won't produce a pristine hull but field repairs can be vital for survival.

hints_repairbeam_vehicletargetaquired.chinese: 使用修复模式，以稳定的速度移动光束并瞄准受损区域来修补受损的船体。
hints_repairbeam_vehicletargetaquired.english: Use Repair mode to patch a damaged hull by moving the beam at a steady pace and targeting damaged areas.

hints_respawn_medbed_clearallrespawn.chinese: 如果从载具的医疗床上取下印记，或者该载具不可用，将在其主要居住地中再生。
hints_respawn_medbed_clearallrespawn.english: If an imprint is removed from a vehicle's medical bed, or that vehicle's not available, they will regen at their primary residence facility.

hints_respawn_medbed_clearrespawn.chinese: 制作一个新的印记，将医疗设施设置为您的再生位置。重置您的位置会将您的印记重新分配到您的主要居住地。
hints_respawn_medbed_clearrespawn.english: Make a new imprint to set medical facility as your regen location. Reset your location to reassign your imprint to your primary residence facility.

hints_respawn_medbed_firstunavailable.chinese: 如果你的重生偏好在重生时不可用，你将在离你主要居住地最近的设施中重生。
hints_respawn_medbed_firstunavailable.english: If your regen preference is unavailable at time of respawn, you will instead regen at the facility closest to your primary residence.

hints_respawn_medbed_outofrange.chinese: 重生位置有一个最大的作用范围。在这个范围之外死亡会导致你在其他地方重生。
hints_respawn_medbed_outofrange.english: Regen locations have a maximum range at which they can function. Dying outside of this range will result in your being respawned elsewhere.

hints_respawn_medbed_setrespawn.chinese: 在一个地方留下印记，会让你死后在那里重生，直到你的位置被重置或者留下新的印记。
hints_respawn_medbed_setrespawn.english: Create an imprint at a location to regen there after you die. You'll regen there until your location's reset or a new imprint's made.

hints_restrictedareatunnelactivatedlandi.chinese: 通过指定的AR标记隧道安全地穿过管制区域。
hints_restrictedareatunnelactivatedlandi.english: Safely traverse through Restricted Areas via the designated AR Marker Tunnels.

hints_restrictedareatunnelactivatedtakeo.chinese: 通过指定的AR标记隧道安全地穿过管制区域。
hints_restrictedareatunnelactivatedtakeo.english: Safely traverse through Restricted Areas via the designated AR Marker Tunnels.

hints_restrictedareatunneledge.chinese: 保持在AR标记航道内安全地穿过管制区域。
hints_restrictedareatunneledge.english: Stay within the AR Marker Tunnel to traverse through the Restricted Area safely.

hints_restrictedareatunnelnearby.chinese: 找到附近的AR标记航道并沿其路径飞行即可安全穿越禁区。
hints_restrictedareatunnelnearby.english: To safely traverse the Restricted Area, locate the nearby AR Marker Tunnel and fly along its path.

hints_salvagebeam_ammofull.chinese: 转化宝Lite附件将废料转化为再生复合材料(RMC)，可以出售或修复损坏的载具外壳。
hints_salvagebeam_ammofull.english: The Cambio-Lite SRT Attachment converts scrap into Recycled Material Composite (RMC), which can be sold or used to repair damaged hulls.

hints_salvagebeam_hulloverview.chinese: 使用打捞光束将载具与外壳剥离，并将外壳转化为再生复合材料(RMC)。收集的材料可以出售或修复损坏的船体。
hints_salvagebeam_hulloverview.english: The Salvage Beam strips vehicle hulls into Recycled Material Composite (RMC). Collected material can be sold or used to repair damaged hulls.

hints_salvagebeam_materialdepleeted.chinese: 以稳定的速度移动打捞光束，以确保收集到区域内所有可打捞的材料。
hints_salvagebeam_materialdepleeted.english: Move the Salvage Beam across the surface at a steady pace to ensure the collection of all the salvageable material in an area.

hints_salvagebeam_salvaging.chinese: 打捞将各种材料转化为再生复合材料(RMC)，并将其存储在配套的罐子中，直到装满为止。
hints_salvagebeam_salvaging.english: Salvaging turns various materials into Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and stores it in the accompanying canister until it's full.

hints_salvagebeam_vehicletargetaquired.chinese: 打捞船体会削弱飞船或车辆该部分的结构完整性。
hints_salvagebeam_vehicletargetaquired.english: Salvaging the hull weakens the structural integrity of that part of the ship or vehicle.

hints_salvagerepairbeam_shields.chinese: 如果目标载具护盾处于有效状态，则该目标不可被打捞或者修复。
hints_salvagerepairbeam_shields.english: The Salvage or Repair process is ineffective if the ship or vehicle's shields are active.

hints_scheduler1.chinese: 目标已通过合约管理应用追踪。
hints_scheduler1.english: Objectives are tracked via the Contract Manager app.

hints_scheduler2.chinese: 完成的合约也显示在这里。
hints_scheduler2.english: Completed contracts are also shown here.

hints_security1.chinese: 除非得到预先授权，否则进入此通讯阵列将被视为非法侵入。
hints_security1.english: Unless prior authorization has been given, entering a Comm Array is considered trespassing.

hints_ship_ammo1.chinese: 实弹武器的弹药快用完了。
hints_ship_ammo1.english: Ballistic weapons are running low on ammo.

hints_ship_ammo2.english: You are almost out of missiles.

hints_ship_combat2.chinese: 你的护盾已离线。在重新充能之前，你会更容易受到武器的伤害。
hints_ship_combat2.english: Your shields are down. You will be more vulnerable to weapons until they recharge.

hints_ship_combat4.chinese: 你飞船的能量武器使用太频繁会耗尽能量。需要时间来充能以继续使用。
hints_ship_combat4.english: Your spaceship's energy weapons will run out of power when used too frequently. Allow them time to recharge.

hints_ship_combat5.chinese: 你飞船上的武器因为持续使用导致过热了。等待一会儿以让武器冷却下来。
hints_ship_combat5.english: Your spaceship's weapons are overheating from too much use. Allow them time to cool down.

hints_ship_combat7.chinese: 一旦你有一个目标，进入导弹模式来发射任何预位好的导弹。
hints_ship_combat7.english: Once you have a target, enter Missile Mode to launch any armed missiles.

hints_ship_customization1.chinese: 这里的改变只会应用到你的飞船在竞技场指挥官中的设置。
hints_ship_customization1.english: The changes made here will only affect your spaceship's setup in Arena Commander.

hints_ship_defense1.chinese: 发射对抗措施可以让你避开导弹。针对情况切换使用诱饵或噪音。
hints_ship_defense1.english: Launching countermeasures allow you to avoid missiles. Cycle between Decoy or Noise types to select the correct countermeasure for the situation.

hints_ship_defense2.chinese: 将你的反制措施选择和导弹锁定图标相匹配。时间点很重要，并且针对每种反制的类型都是不一样的。
hints_ship_defense2.english: Match your countermeasure selection to the missile lock icon. Timing is important and varies for each type of countermeasure.

hints_ship_health1.chinese: 你的飞船外壳完整性非常低。
hints_ship_health1.english: Your spaceship's hull integrity is dangerously low.

hints_ship_movement3.chinese: 收起起落架以达到全速。
hints_ship_movement3.english: Remember to raise the landing gear to fly at full speed.

hints_ship_movement5.chinese: 解耦模式意味着你的飞船不再修正你的轨迹，将按照牛顿定律飞行。不建议新手飞行员。
hints_ship_movement5.english: Decoupled mode means your ship is no longer correcting your trajectory and will fly under Newtonian laws. Not recommended for beginner pilots.

hints_ship_movement6.chinese: 激活助推和超频你的推进器以获得更高的机动性。长时间处于这个行为下将会对你的飞船造成高温损害。
hints_ship_movement6.english: Activate your ship's boost to overclock your thrusters for higher maneuverability. Maintaining this for too long can burnout and damage your ship.

hints_ship_startup1.chinese: 寻找“启动系统”仪表盘按钮来启动你的系统，或者按下 ~action(spaceship_general|v_flightready)。
hints_ship_startup1.english: Look for the Engage Systems dashboard button to start your system, or press ~action(spaceship_general|v_flightready).

hints_ship_startup2.chinese: 在仪表板上找到一键启动按钮启动你的飞船系统，找到一键启动按钮。或者按快捷键： ~action(spaceship_general|v_flightready)
hints_ship_startup2.english: Look for the Engage Systems dashboard button to start your system, or press ~action(spaceship_general|v_flightready).

hints_shopping1.chinese: 大多数站点都有商店可供购物，在旅行前光临这些店铺来购买物品和设备。
hints_shopping1.english: Shops are available throughout most stations. Use them to buy items and equipment before a journey.

hints_shopping2.chinese: 通过互动模式选择“购买”选项或使用商店的售货终端进行购买。
hints_shopping2.english: Make a purchase by selecting the 'Buy' option via Interaction Mode or using the shop's kiosk.

hints_shopping3.chinese: 你也可以在购买前在商店里“试穿”或“检视”物品。
hints_shopping3.english: You can also 'Try On' or 'Inspect' items in a shop before purchasing.

hints_signaturesystem_emissionhud_01.chinese: 在你 HUD 上的辐射信号条显示的是飞船的辐射信号与周边环境的特征信号强度。当飞船的辐射信号强度接近或小于周边环境时，你会更难被探测到。
hints_signaturesystem_emissionhud_01.english: The HUD Emission Bars indicate the strength of your signature vs. the current ambient signature. Signatures lower than the ambient are hard to detect.

hints_signaturesystem_emissionshud_02.chinese: 降低车辆的耗电量以减少电磁信号，呈现较小的轮廓以减少CS，降低温度以减少IR。
hints_signaturesystem_emissionshud_02.english: Lower your vehicle's power usage to decrease EM signature, present a smaller profile to decrease your CS, and lower your temperature to decrease IR.

hints_signaturesystem_ping.chinese: 回波探测会高亮出新的目标或值得探索的区域，但同时也会短暂提高你的电磁特征信号，让你更容易被发现。
hints_signaturesystem_ping.english: Pinging will highlight new contacts or areas worth investigating, but will temporarily increase your EM signature making you more detectable.

hints_signaturesystem_pinganglechanged.chinese: 降低回波探测角度，会降低探测波所能覆盖的范围，但同时也能增幅探测出的信号强度。
hints_signaturesystem_pinganglechanged.english: Lowering the Ping’s angle reduces the area the wave will cover while increasing its amplification of encountered signatures.

hints_signaturesystem_pingtriggered_01.chinese: 启动回波探测时，你的雷达会发出一阵波并向外加速扩散，增幅途经的信号源。高亮显示任何值得调查的新接触或区域
hints_signaturesystem_pingtriggered_01.english: When pinging, a wave accelerates outwards from your radar, highlighting any new contacts or areas worth investigating.

hints_signaturesystem_pingtriggered_02.chinese: 回波形状可以拓展成一个球状，或是缩小至锥桶状。回波越窄，所能覆盖的区域也就越少，但对信号源的增幅程度也能越高。
hints_signaturesystem_pingtriggered_02.english: The Ping can be adjusted from an expanding sphere to a smaller projected cone. The narrower the Ping, the more it will amplify encountered signatures.

hints_signaturesystem_scanabandoned.chinese: 位于扫描准星右侧的进度条，能展示出你已掌握了多少有关目标物体的信息。进度条充满时，即代表你已获悉目前所能掌握的一切信息。
hints_signaturesystem_scanabandoned.english: The Scan Progress Bar shows how much information you've obtained. Once full, you have acquired all the available information.

hints_signaturesystem_scancompleted_01.chinese: 扫描进度条虽已充满，但若位于扫描准星左侧的信号强度条并未充满，则表示可能仍有信息可供获悉。
hints_signaturesystem_scancompleted_01.english: If the Signature Strength Bar is not full, there may be more information available. Try getting closer to the target and/or increase your Scan Focus.

hints_signaturesystem_scancompleted_02.chinese: 扫描噪声表示签名强度条的顶部为红色。通过增加扫描焦点或升级扫描仪来减轻扫描噪声。
hints_signaturesystem_scancompleted_02.english: Scan Noise is indicated by the top of the Signature Strength Bar being red. Mitigate Scan Noise by increasing Scan Focus or upgrading your Scanner.

hints_signaturesystem_scanmodeentered_01.chinese: 要分析目标，首先调整你的方向，使目标位于扫描刻度线内，然后持续扫描直到扫描进度条满。
hints_signaturesystem_scanmodeentered_01.english: To analyze a target, first adjust your direction so that the desired target is within the Scan Reticle, then scan until the Scan Progress Bar is full.

hints_signaturesystem_scanmodeentered_02.chinese: 你可以增加或减少扫描焦点来调整你要分析的对象。
hints_signaturesystem_scanmodeentered_02.english: You can increase or decrease your Scan Focus to adjust which objects you're trying to analyze.

hints_signaturesystem_scanstarted.chinese: 获取信息后，“扫描进度”栏会显示。保持扫描接收所有当前可用的信息。
hints_signaturesystem_scanstarted.english: The Scan Progress fills as information is obtained. Keep scanning to receive all currently available info.

hints_signaturesystem_scanzoomchanged.chinese: 如想调整扫描设备的灵敏度来提升信号强度，可试试增加扫描焦距。需留意，增加焦距后可能导致持续追踪扫描目标变得更难。
hints_signaturesystem_scanzoomchanged.english: To improve a target's Signature Strength, try increasing your Scan Focus. Note, increased Focus may make targets difficult to follow.

hints_sim_cab1.chinese: 选择竞技场指挥官，在安全的模拟舱中进行舰船空战或第一人称射击战斗练习。
hints_sim_cab1.english: Arena Commander allows you to practice your combat encounters from the safety of a Sim Cab.

hints_stamina1.chinese: 注意你的心率以避免疲劳。跑步和跳跃会增加你的心率。
hints_stamina1.english: Monitor your Heart Rate to avoid becoming fatigued. Running and jumping will increase your Heart Rate.

hints_stamina2.chinese: 你的心率非常高。休息一段时间让心率恢复正常。
hints_stamina2.english: Your Heart Rate is very high. Rest to allow it time to return to normal rates.

hints_stowcontractitem.chinese: 要存储你持有的物品，与物品互动并选择“存储”或使用库存屏幕。
hints_stowcontractitem.english: To store an item you're holding, interact with the item and select 'Store' or use the inventory screen.

hints_take-off_demo1.chinese: 悬浮载具通电后会自动浮起
hints_take-off_demo1.english: Grav-Lev vehicles automatically hover when powered on.

hints_take-off_demo1_axis.chinese: 悬浮载具通电后会自动浮起
hints_take-off_demo1_axis.english: Grav-Lev vehicles automatically hover when powered on.

hints_teamelimination1.chinese: 搜刮氧素笔以存活。中心位置有最多的氧气资源。
hints_teamelimination1.english: Scavenge for OxyPens to survive. Central locations have the most oxygen resources.

hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbreak_distance.chinese: 重量和距离都会影响牵引光束是否能拴住一个物体。物体越重，光束所能作用的距离也就更短。
hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbreak_distance.english: Both weight and distance factor into the tractor beam's ability to tether to a target. The heavier the object, the shorter the tether will need to be.

hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbreak_lineofsi.chinese: 如果光束在通往目标的路径上遇到阻碍或被截断，光束便会断裂。在光束作用时保持留意，以防目标意外脱离。
hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbreak_lineofsi.english: If the tractor beam path to the target is interrupted or blocked, the tether will break. Move carefully to prevent accidental release.

hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbroke_viewcone.chinese: 试图以太大的角度移动拴着的物体会切断牵引光束。仔细调整，防止意外释放。
hints_tractorbeam_ontetherbroke_viewcone.english: Attempting to move a tethered object at too sharp an angle will sever the tractor beam. Adjust carefully to prevent accidental release.

hints_tractorbeam_targetcantlift_mass.chinese: 牵引光束无法安全拴住距离太远，或是重量太重的物体。利用多功能工具的 HUD，来确认物体是否为合适的操纵目标。
hints_tractorbeam_targetcantlift_mass.english: The tractor beam is unable to safely target objects that are too distant or heavy (in gravity). Use the multi-tool's HUD to see viable targets.

hints_tractorbeam_targetcantlift_size.chinese: 有些物体的体型过于巨大，以至牵引光束无法安全操纵。利用多功能工具的 HUD，来确认物体是否为合适的操纵目标。
hints_tractorbeam_targetcantlift_size.english: Some objects are too large for the tractor beam to safely manipulate. The multi-tool's HUD will indicate if an object is an appropriate target.

hints_tractorbeam_title.chinese: 多功能工具 - 牵引光束

hints_tractorbeam_zerogtraversal.chinese: 当处于零重力环境时，试图栓住够大的物体时，（像是飞船或空间站）会将你拉向他们。
hints_tractorbeam_zerogtraversal.english: While in zero-g, tethering to a large enough object (like a ship or station) will pull you towards it.

hints_trade_kiosks1.chinese: 从在这里的在载具或当地的仓库购买商品交易或出售自己的商品。
hints_trade_kiosks1.english: Purchase commodities for trade or sell commodities you own from vehicles stored here or the local warehouse.

hints_trade_kiosks2.chinese: 本地市场价值标签会让你知道哪些商品会给你带来最大的利润。
hints_trade_kiosks2.english: The Local Market Value tab will let you know which commodities will net you the most profit.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocolle.chinese: 你的载具现在正在运送易爆货物。谨慎运输避免损坏，以保持货物稳定。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocolle.english: Your vehicle is now transporting volatile cargo. Use caution and avoid damage to keep the cargo stable.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocolle.chinese: 易爆货物已储存到你的载具，如果受到损伤可能会变得不稳定。如果它变得非常不稳定，就可能爆炸，进而损坏或摧毁致你的载具。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocolle.english: Volatile cargo stored aboard your vehicle can become unstable if it takes damage. If it becomes critically unstable, it may explode.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocriti.chinese: 你的易爆货物即将爆炸！这将严重损坏或摧毁你的载具！立即通过“货物警报”面板抛弃所有货物！
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargocriti.english: Your volatile cargo is about to explode! Jettison all cargo via the 'Cargo Warning' panel now!

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargoexplo.chinese: 你的易爆货物已经爆炸并已严重损坏你的载具。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargoexplo.english: Your volatile cargo has exploded and severely damaged your vehicle.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargojetti.chinese: 你已抛弃了所持有的货物且“货物警报”灯已解除。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargojetti.english: You have jettisoned the contents of your hold and your 'Cargo Warning' light is now deactivated.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargolight.chinese: 你的易爆货物非常不稳，可能会爆炸。建议通过“货物警告”面板抛弃货舱的全部货物。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargolight.english: Your volatile cargo is critically unstable and may explode. Consider jettisoning the entire contents of your cargo hold via the 'Cargo Warning' panel.

hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargolight.chinese: 你的易爆货物已经变得不稳定，可能会发生爆炸并损坏或摧毁你的载具。如果稳定性进一步下降，请考虑抛弃货物。
hints_volatilecargo_onvolatilecargolight.english: Your volatile cargo has become unstable and may explode. Consider jettisoning the volatile cargo if its stability drops further.

hints_weaponadsactivatenightvision_body,.chinese: 你可以按 ~action(player|interact_with_scope) 激活光学放大
hints_weaponadsactivatenightvision_body,.english: You can activate light amplification by pressing ~action(player|interact_with_scope)

hints_weaponadsactivatenightvision_title.chinese: 瞄具附件 - 光学放大

hints_weaponadsactivatezoom_body,p.chinese: 你可以通过按 ~action(player|interact_with_scope) 切换缩放级别
hints_weaponadsactivatezoom_body,p.english: You can switch zoom levels by pressing ~action(player|interact_with_scope)

hints_weaponadsactivatezoom_title,p.chinese: 瞄具附件 - 缩放级别

hmd_optionsactorcontrolmode.chinese: [实验性] VR - 角色控制模式

hmd_optionsactorcontrolmodeadsdirectoffs.chinese: [实验性] VR - 角色控制模式 ADS 直接偏移
hmd_optionsactorcontrolmodeadsdirectoffs.english: [Experimental] VR - Actor Control Mode ADS Direct Offset

hmd_optionscursorfollowshead.chinese: [实验性] VR - 3D 光标跟随头部

hmd_optionscursorsensitivity.chinese: [实验性] VR - 3D 光标灵敏度

hmd_optionscursoruseeyetracking.chinese: [实验性] VR - 3D 光标使用眼动追踪

hmd_optionsfpsadsdominanteye.chinese: [实验性] VR - 第一人称射击 ADS 主导眼

hmd_optionsinfinityprojectiondistance.chinese: [实验性] VR - 载具 HUD 投影距离

hmd_optionsipdscale.chinese: [实验性] VR - 瞳孔间距 (IPD) 缩放

hmd_optionsmonitormirrormode.chinese: [实验性] VR - 监视器镜像模式

hmd_optionsmonitormirrormodesmoothing.chinese: [实验性] VR - 显示器镜像模式平滑化

hmd_optionsresetonfpsads.chinese: [实验性] VR - 第一人称瞄准射击时回归中心点

hmd_optionsshowconsole.chinese: [实验性] VR - 显示控制台

lingfamily_family_001.chinese: 本来应该是我的哥哥瑞奇来处理这个工作的，但不幸的是他的冷却器炸了。虽然他已经在修它了，但于此同时我们希望你能介入一下。
lingfamily_family_001.english: My brother, Ricki, was supposed to handle this job but unfortunately his cooler blew. He's getting it fixed, but in the meanwhile we're hoping you can step in.

lingfamily_family_002.chinese: 本来应该是我的哥哥瑞奇来处理这个工作的，奈何他的发电机出问题了。虽然他已经在修它了，但是你要是能来接手的话就太棒了。
lingfamily_family_002.english: My brother, Ricki, was supposed to handle this job but his power plant's been having issues. He's getting it fixed, it'd be great if you can take this one.

lingfamily_family_005.chinese: 瑞奇在斯坦顿的对面做长途运输的时候被抓了，所以我们需要其他人来处理这个工作。
lingfamily_family_005.english: Ricki got caught up on the opposite side of Stanton doing a long haul, so we need someone else to handle this job.

lingfamily_family_006.chinese: 我原本安排瑞奇去做这件事，但奈何他油管漏油了赶不回来了。希望你有空。
lingfamily_family_006.english: I originally had Ricki slated for this, but a leaky fuel line means he's not going to get back in time. Hopefully, you're available.

lingfamily_reaction_bad_001.chinese: 上次合约很蛋疼吧? 反正已经发生了。别想太多，让它过去就好了 -
lingfamily_reaction_bad_001.english: Rough time on that last contract, huh? It happens. Important thing is not focus on it too much, and get back out there -

lingfamily_reaction_bad_002.chinese: 很难说你上次那个活到底是哪里出了问题，反正蛋疼的一批。这次咱好好加把劲，行不?
lingfamily_reaction_bad_002.english: Hard to say exactly where you went wrong on that last contract, but it wasn't pretty. Let's do better this time, Okay?

lingfamily_reaction_badtogood_002.chinese: 得想办法扭转局面。我开始担心你的能力，但上次的合约显示出你还是有潜力的。我们得看看你是否能保持下去...
lingfamily_reaction_badtogood_002.english: Way to turn it around. I was getting worried about you, but that last contract showed you got potential. We'll have to see if you can keep it up...

lingfamily_reaction_good_001.chinese: 上次的活你干的很好。好活。
lingfamily_reaction_good_001.english: You did good on that last contract. Nice stuff.

lingfamily_reaction_good_002.chinese: 真快，不得不提起你上次那活。看进展一切顺利。干得好。也就是说...
lingfamily_reaction_good_002.english: Real quick, wanted to mention the last contract you did. Saw that it went well. Good work. That said...

lingfamily_reaction_goodstreak_001.chinese: 不得不说，你在外面真的很拼命。连戴维都惊了，他可都干了几十年了。不管怎...
lingfamily_reaction_goodstreak_001.english: Got to say, you've really been killing it out there. Even Davi's been impressed and he's been doing this for decades. Anyway...

lingfamily_reaction_goodtobad_002.chinese: 上次的活辛苦你了。嘛...毕竟人无完人嘛。除非你是我妹妹琳达。但现在不是说她的时候...
lingfamily_reaction_goodtobad_002.english: Tough break on that last job. Can't be perfect all the time, I guess. Unless your my sister Linda. But let's not talk about her right now...

lingfamily_reaction_renew_002.chinese: 事情是这样的。我们开了个家庭会议，决定你应该再有一次机会。我希望你能好好利用这次机会。也就是说...
lingfamily_reaction_renew_002.english: Here's what's happening. We had a family meeting and decided that maybe you deserve another chance. I hope you make the most of it. That said...

lingfamily_timed_001.english: Unfortunately, we're on a bit of a tight schedule with this one. Need it taken care of ASAP.

lingfamily_timed_002.chinese: 一定要记住，这项工作是有明确时限的。没有什么回旋的余地。
lingfamily_timed_002.english: Be sure to keep in mind that this job has a firm deadline. Not much wiggle room.

lingfamily_timed_003.chinese: 干活的时候注意点时间。我可不想让你超时。
lingfamily_timed_003.english: Make sure to keep an eye on clock when you're out there. Don't want you missing the deadline.

lingfamily_timed_004.english: Make sure to be mindful of the time while you're working. Our business depends on us being punctual.

mg_clovus_acquirepart_incident_01.chinese: 一颗赫斯顿的卫星很不体面地坠落到了星球地表。幸运的是，看起来还有一件 ~mission(Item) 奇迹般地从事故中幸存了下来。

mg_clovus_acquirepart_marker_01a.chinese: 最后探测到的位置信号

mg_clovus_acquirepart_obj_long_01.chinese: 前往最后汇报的地点，并扫描 ~mission(Location) 的确切位置。
mg_clovus_acquirepart_obj_long_01.english: Travel to the last reported position and scan to locate ~mission(Location).

mg_clovus_acquirepart_subobj_long_02a.chinese: 找到并重启卫星内部的控制系统以追踪丢失的 ~mission(Item)。
mg_clovus_acquirepart_subobj_long_02a.english: Navigate inside the satellite and restart the internal control systems to track the missing ~mission(Item).

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_01.chinese: 赶在任何人之前到达卫星的最后雷达接触地点并找到 ~mission(Location)
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_01.english: Travel to the last radar contact of the satellite and locate the ~mission(Location) before anyone else.

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_02.chinese: 赶在任何人之前找到并回收 ~mission(Item)
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_02.english: Find and recover the ~mission(Item) before anyone else can claim it.

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_03.chinese: 赶在 ~mission(Item) 自毁前在存储设施里将其连接至一个赫斯顿服务器，解密并上传其中的信息
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_03.english: Decrypt and transfer the information on the ~mission(Item) before it self-destructs by connecting it to a Hurston server inside a storage facility.

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_03a.chinese: 进入卫星并重启内部控制系统来追踪遗失的 ~mission(Item)。
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_03a.english: Navigate inside the satellite and restart the internal control system to track the missing ~mission(Item).

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_04a.chinese: 前往 ~mission(Item) 的所在地并阻止数据被盗
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_04a.english: Travel to the ~mission(Item)'s current location and prevent the data from being stolen.

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_05a.chinese: 通过摧毁 ~mission(Item) 打断破解进程
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_05a.english: Stop the decryption by destroying the ~mission(Item).

mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_06.chinese: ~mission(Item) 落到了另一个相关团伙的手里.在其被摧毁之前把它偷回来.
mg_clovus_bladesteal_obj_long_06.english: The ~mission(Item) has been recovered by another interested party. Steal it back before it is destroyed.

mg_clovus_havejob_obj_long_01.chinese: 在“回收和处理”与克洛夫斯碰面

mg_clovus_invite_obj_long_01.english: Meet with Clovus at Reclamation & Disposal.

mg_clovus_satrecover_obj_long_05.chinese: 将数据芯片送回“回收和处理”克洛夫斯处。
mg_clovus_satrecover_obj_long_05.english: Return datachip to Clovus at Reclamation & Disposal.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_obj_long_01.chinese: 前往列夫斯基取得产品

mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0001.chinese: 我有一帮饥渴的伙计们正等着呢，所以一定搞快点，好不？
mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0001.english: I got a lotta thirsty folks waiting on this, so get your hustle on, yeah?

mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0002.chinese: 让我们赶快把东西送过去。他们越早拿到，越早用上。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0002.english: Let's move this stuff on the quick. Faster they get it, the quicker they use it.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0003.chinese: 请务用你最快的速度搞定，这单我想快点弄完。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0003.english: You'll be on a clock with this one. I need this delivered quick.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0004.chinese: 我想快点把这一切弄完，可以不? 坐着什么也不干等着被法律制裁是没有意义的。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_timed_0004.english: I need this done now. Okay? No sense in sitting on the stuff and letting the law catch wind of it.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_title_0002.chinese: 需要一个靠谱的快递小哥

mg_klim_deliver_drug_title_0004.chinese: 赚钱钱钱钱钱钱钱钱吗?

mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0001.chinese: 把眼睛放亮点儿，听说那附近可能有一些坏家伙在转悠。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0001.english: Keep an eye out too. Word is there might be some undesirables circling. Armed ones.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0002.chinese: 另外，一个小老弟告诉我这一趟可能会有点儿危险，所以最好做些准备。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0002.english: Also, a little bird told me this run might get a little dangerous, so better prep yourself.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0003.chinese: 如果我是你我会带几把枪，直觉告诉我这趟可能有点危险。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0003.english: I'd bring some guns too if I was you. I have a feeling this might get a little dangerous.

mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0004.chinese: 保持警惕，最近是比较危险的时期。
mg_klim_deliver_drug_trouble_0004.english: Keep your wits about you. These are dangerous times we're living in.

mg_klim_invite_obj_long.chinese: 在六角湾与华莱士见面。
mg_klim_invite_obj_long.english: Meet with Wallace Klim in Grim HEX.

mg_miles_assassin_danger_0001.chinese: ~mission(TargetName|Last)可能会发生一场战斗，所以请做好准备。
mg_miles_assassin_danger_0001.english: Odds are ~mission(TargetName|Last) will put up a fight, so be ready.

mg_miles_assassin_danger_0002.chinese: 拿出你的实力来，他们可不好对付。
mg_miles_assassin_danger_0002.english: You better come at them with your A-game, this ain't gonna be easy.

mg_miles_assassin_danger_0003.chinese: 用上你的全力。~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst)可不是随便能放倒的。
mg_miles_assassin_danger_0003.english: You'll want to arm up for this. ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst) won't go quietly.

mg_miles_assassin_danger_0004.chinese: 基于他们的威望，我估计这可能会演变成一场大战。
mg_miles_assassin_danger_0004.english: Based on their rep, I'd expect this op to be a brawl.

mg_miles_assassin_danger_0005.chinese: 我之前听过这名字。认真对付，在他们发现你前给上一击。
mg_miles_assassin_danger_0005.english: I've heard the name before. Might wanna arm up and hit them before they see you coming.

mg_miles_assassin_timed_0001.chinese: 这次行动时间有限，搞快点。
mg_miles_assassin_timed_0001.english: There's a clock on this op, so move quick.

mg_miles_assassin_timed_0002.chinese: 合约内容迟早会泄露，所以我建议在 ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst) 意识到前干掉他们。
mg_miles_assassin_timed_0002.english: Word of this contract's bound to slip out, so I'd recommend taking out ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst) before they get wise and vanish.

mg_miles_assassin_timed_0003.english: You might wanna hurry on this.

mg_miles_assassin_timed_0004.chinese: 客户想迅速解决这件事。
mg_miles_assassin_timed_0004.english: Clients want this taken care of quick.

mg_miles_assassin_timed_0005.chinese: 这件事需要马上完成。懂?
mg_miles_assassin_timed_0005.english: This needs to be done now. Get me?

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0001.chinese: 你最好搞快点，客户需要马上解决
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0001.english: You'll have to move quickly. The client needs this resolved now.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0002.chinese: 我需要你马上处理，所以先放下你手上的事，专心处理这个。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0002.english: I need this handled now, so drop whatever you're doing and get this done.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0003.chinese: 动作快点，明白？越早办完越早得到报酬。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0003.english: Take care of this quick, okay? Sooner it goes away, the sooner you get paid.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0004.chinese: 客户需要马上办，所以上点心。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_rush_0004.english: Client wants this to happen now, so take care of it.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0001.chinese: 你将会前往危险区域，小心别让麻烦找上你。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0001.english: You're gonna be heading into a hot zone, so keep an eye out for trouble.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0002.chinese: 据消息称这里可能有敌对势力，所以小心点。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0002.english: Got word there still might be hostiles in the area, so watch out.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0003.chinese: 在这片区域依旧可能有麻烦，保持警惕。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0003.english: Might still be some trouble in the area, so stay sharp.

mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0004.chinese: 很可能会发生战斗，武装起来。
mg_miles_blackboxillegal_trouble_0004.english: Odds are this is gonna lead into a fight, so make sure you're armed up.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_loc_0003.chinese: 失去联系信号前 ~mission(ship)'s的最后位置
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_loc_0003.english: the ~mission(ship)'s final position before its signal was lost

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0001.chinese: 这是一个十分有价值的客户，公司希望此事尽快解决
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0001.english: This is a valued client, so the company wants it resolved quickly.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0002.chinese: 这是个高优先级的任务
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0002.english: This is flagged as a priority mission.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0003.chinese: 客户需要你在极短的时间内完成这次任务
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_rush_0003.english: The client has requested a rush job on this op.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0001.chinese: 情报显示敌对机构可能在此区域活动。启用标准交战准则
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0001.english: Intel suggests that hostile elements may be in the area. Standard ROE applies.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0002.chinese: 此行动有极高的交火风险。请小心行事。
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0002.english: Combat is highly likely during this op. Use caution.

mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0003.chinese: 分析部门指出行动地区有极高的风险与敌对势力交火。请做好妥善的准备。
mg_miles_blackboxlegal_trouble_0003.english: Analytics department has indicated that there is a high possibility of hostile contact. Prepare accordingly.

mg_miles_bounty_elite_0001.chinese: 根据我们得到的心理状况资料，该目标是高风险目标。
mg_miles_bounty_elite_0001.english: Based on our psychological profile, this is classified as a high-risk bounty.

mg_miles_bounty_elite_0002.chinese: 任务目标被标记为极端危险目标。
mg_miles_bounty_elite_0002.english: Target has been flagged as extremely dangerous.

mg_miles_bounty_elite_0003.chinese: 接触时要留点心眼，目标必定是全副武装的，十分危险。
mg_miles_bounty_elite_0003.english: Use caution when engaging, the target will be armed and dangerous.

mg_miles_bounty_location_0001.chinese: 我们有个潜在的目标最后已知地点。
mg_miles_bounty_location_0001.english: We have a potential last known location for the target.

mg_miles_bounty_location_0002.chinese: 我们将提供能揭露 ~mission(TargetName|Last) 躲藏在何处的数据。
mg_miles_bounty_location_0002.english: We will provide data that might indicate where ~mission(TargetName|Last) is hiding.

mg_miles_bounty_location_0003.chinese: 我们的线人为我们提供了目标最后的下落。
mg_miles_bounty_location_0003.english: Our sources have provided the target's last known whereabouts.

mg_miles_bounty_obj_long_01.chinese: 搜索赏金目标的当前位置。通过扫描或重新激活通信阵列来追踪非监视区域内的目标。
mg_miles_bounty_obj_long_01.english: Search for bounty’s current location. Track targets in unmonitored areas by scanning or reactivating comm arrays.

mg_miles_bounty_rush_0002.chinese: 你的机会转瞬即逝，在他们再次消失之前干掉他们。
mg_miles_bounty_rush_0002.english: You will have a very specific window of opportunity. Take them down before they disappear again.

mg_miles_bounty_rush_0003.chinese: 任务目标手脚很快，你必须加快动作。
mg_miles_bounty_rush_0003.english: The target is a known flight risk, so you will need to act quickly.

mg_miles_collectcargo_legal_timed_0003.english: Client has requested expedited service on this contract.
