mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0001.english: You are cleared to engage any hostiles you encounter.

mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0002.chinese: 情报显示敌对机构有极高的可能在目标区域活动。做好相应准备。
mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0002.english: Intel suggests a high probability of hostile engagement. Plan accordingly.

mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0003.chinese: 此合约被标记为有可能需进行作战的任务。
mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0003.english: This contract has been flagged as a potential combat mission.

mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0004.chinese: 最新的情报显示，此合约所涉及地区所发生的暴力事件数量有明显上升。建议参与者做好准备以应对潜在交战威胁。
mg_miles_delivercargo_lawful_danger_0004.english: Latest intel indicates an increase in violent contact in this contract's area of operations. Operator should be prepared for potential combat.

mg_miles_planetcollect_drug_troub_0003.chinese: 关于这个小任务的消息已经传开了，所以如果你懂的话，可能会有其他“感兴趣的团体”想先发制人。

mg_miles_spacecollect_steal_troub_0002.chinese: 所以你知道的，这份任务可能会有点儿危险。

mg_pacheco_assassin_sync_danger_low.chinese: 别担心，这俩人菜得抠脚。你这种大佬解决他们应该没有任何问题。
mg_pacheco_assassin_sync_danger_low.english: And in case you're worried, these two upstarts are about as newborn as they come. Shouldn't be any trouble for someone with your skills.

mg_pacheco_assassin_sync_danger_medium.chinese: 我这边的情报显示这俩人的智商存在一些缺陷，所以他们经常需要一些朋友帮他们推着轮椅。我估计他们死前会用力挣扎那么一两下。

mg_ruto_assassin_danger_0002.english: Apparently, this scav's totalled up a hefty body count over the years. Don't underestimate them.

mg_ruto_assassin_danger_0004.chinese: 提个醒，我的第六感告诉我 ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst) 会跟你打场硬仗。别输给他。
mg_ruto_assassin_danger_0004.english: Bit of warning, my hunch says ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst)'s gonna give you a good fight. See that you put up a better one.

mg_ruto_assassin_location_0001.chinese: 他们最后出现的地点坐标
mg_ruto_assassin_location_0001.english: the coordinates where they were last spotted

mg_ruto_assassin_location_0003.chinese: 他们喜欢搞聚会的地方
mg_ruto_assassin_location_0003.english: where they like to hang out

mg_ruto_assassin_location_0004.chinese: 他们经常去的地方之一
mg_ruto_assassin_location_0004.english: one of the spots they're known to frequent

mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0001.english: The sooner this is over, the better.

mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0002.english: This bastard's run before, so take care of this before they can run again.

mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0003.chinese: ~mission(Client) 说这事对他们超级无敌重要。所以你最好赶紧把这事儿搞定了。
mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0003.english: ~mission(Client) have made it clear that this is really, really, really important to them. See that you get it squared away as fast as humanly possible.

mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0004.chinese: 我之前没说过这活儿是限时的嘛？没的话我再说一次，它是限时的。
mg_ruto_assassin_timed_0004.english: Did I mention there's a clock on this? No? Well, there is.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_danger_0001.chinese: 以 ~mission(ship)'s 的位置来看，是我的话就会准备好作战。
mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_danger_0001.english: Based on the ~mission(ship)'s location, I'd gear up for a fight.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_danger_0003.chinese: 准备作战。小道消息得知，这次可能会遭遇重火力。

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_danger_0004.english: There's a good chance this one might get ugly.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0001.chinese: 这是紧急任务，懂？这件事儿上可不能浪费时间。
mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0001.english: This is rush job, okay? Can't waste time on this one.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0002.chinese: 你得搞快点。他们为这单付过加急费了。
mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0002.english: Need you to knock this out quick. They're paying for fast results.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0003.chinese: 你要知道，这事儿可是有期限的。
mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0003.english: Understand that you'll be on a clock for this one.

mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0004.chinese: 这是优先任务，别胡闹了，搞快点。
mg_ruto_blackboxillegal_timed_0004.english: This is a priority gig, so no screwing around. Get it done fast.

mg_ruto_collect_reclaimer_obj_long_01.chinese: 前往十月启航号最后出现地点

mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0001.english: Get a move on, yeah? Need this done quick.

mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0002.chinese: 你懂我意思的话，这事得速度完成。
mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0002.english: Gonna need this handled on the quick side too, if you get me.

mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0003.chinese: 别瞎逛了。这事儿现在必须完成。
mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0003.english: Don't mess around. This has got to get done now.

mg_ruto_commhack_rush_0004.english: You need to move quick on this one.

mg_ruto_commhack_time_0001.chinese: 另外还有一件事，你得确保它离线一段时间。专业人士需要点儿时间来做事情，你懂我意思吧？
mg_ruto_commhack_time_0001.english: One more thing though, you're gonna need to make sure it stays off for a while. The pros need time to work, if you get me.

mg_ruto_commhack_time_0002.chinese: 完成后，我需要你看好阵列。得确保没有好心人来将它打开。
mg_ruto_commhack_time_0002.english: When it's done, I'm gonna need you to babysit the array. Make sure no do-gooders come and switch it back on.

mg_ruto_commhack_time_0003.chinese: 事情是这样的。一旦阵列离线，确保它保持静默。
mg_ruto_commhack_time_0003.english: Here's the deal. Once the array's down, make sure it stays down.

mg_ruto_commhack_time_0004.chinese: 一旦成功骇入之后你得呆在那。我需要断电持续一段时间。
mg_ruto_commhack_time_0004.english: You'll need to stick around once the hack's done. I need that blackout sustained for a bit.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0001.chinese: 你或许会在那里遇到点儿小麻烦。我是说，这很符合场景，对吧？你是去找尸体的。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0001.english: You might run into a little trouble out there. I mean, that's fitting right? You are going out to find a body.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0002.chinese: 记得武装好自己。你知道的，你去的是犯罪现场。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0002.english: And arm up. You're heading to a crime scene, you know.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0003.chinese: 注意点儿你的雷达。那里可能有一些不友好的人。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0003.english: Keep an eye on your scans. There might be some unfriendly sorts out there.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0004.chinese: 这种事儿都不用说，毕竟你是在寻找一具尸体，所以这项工作可能会有暴力冲突。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_danger_0004.english: This might go without saying, you are hunting down a corpse after all, but there might be a bit of violence out on this job.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0001.chinese: 搞快点可以不？尸体不可能永远在那个地方。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0001.english: Do hurry up, will you? Body probably won't be there forever.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0002.chinese: 嘿，动作快点，客户现在就想知道结果。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0002.english: Another thing, the clients would like to know now, so get to it.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0003.chinese: 我不知道尸体的保质期是多久，所以我推荐你最好动作快点。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0003.english: I don't really know how long bodies stick around for, so I'd recommend getting a move on.

mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0004.chinese: 你应该搞快点。只有上帝现在知道这具尸体上发生了什么。
mg_ruto_confirmkill_timed_0004.english: You might want to move fast. God knows what's happening to that body right now.

mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0001.chinese: 显而易见，你遇到的人看到你都不会很高兴。我相信你能解决他们。
mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0001.english: Odds are, anyone you come across won't be too pleased to see you. I trust you'll be able to handle them.

mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0002.chinese: 我不认为这活儿会很轻松，所以确保你的武器正常工作。
mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0002.english: I'm not anticipating this to be a smooth run though, so I'd make sure your guns are working.

mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0003.chinese: 我不开玩笑。这个任务也许有点棘手。
mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0003.english: I'm not gonna lie. This one might get a little rough.

mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0004.chinese: 实话跟你说，我之前送过去的那些人现在都已经去见阎王了，所以你要时刻保持警惕。
mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0004.english: Just gonna say, the last couple people I've sent on these runs have gotten tuned up, so stay sharpish.

mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0005.chinese: 要随时做好交战的准备。你永远不知道下一秒会发生什么。
mg_ruto_deploypiggyback_danger_0005.english: Might wanna get ready for a fight too. You never know.

mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_001.chinese: 我想让你让剜度对维佳的所作所为看起来像在格斯的周末一样。
mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_001.english: I want you to make what the 'duul did to Vega look like a weekend on Goss.

mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_002.chinese: 我想让人们认为你是第二个伊瓦尔·梅塞尔，或是...你知道，某个坏蛋。
mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_002.english: I want you to make people think you're the second coming of Ivar Messar or... you know, one of the bad ones.

mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_003.chinese: 在你完成以后，我想让你的名字成为一个警告。
mg_ruto_distraction_analogy_003.english: By the time you're done, I want your name to be a warning.

mg_ruto_distraction_obj_long_02.chinese: 前往这个地方 ~mission(Location) 然后等着安保出来
mg_ruto_distraction_obj_long_02.english: Go to this local ~mission(Location) and wait for security to show up.

mg_ruto_distraction_obj_long_03.chinese: 搞点事情让安保部队分心。
mg_ruto_distraction_obj_long_03.english: Cause a scene to keep security forces distracted.

mg_ruto_distraction_title_0001.chinese: 一点点分散注意力的事情

mg_ruto_intromission_obj_long_03.english: Get rid of the corpse off-world.

mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0001.chinese: 需要快速处理这件事。对不起，不想催你，但你懂的，客户付了钱的。
mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0001.english: Need to take care of this quick though. Sorry. Hate to rush, but you know, clients are paying.

mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0002.chinese: 我需要你尽快处理这件事。
mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0002.english: Oh, I'll need you to sort this out on the quicker side.

mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0003.chinese: 还有一件事，你需要快点完成。客户希望这件事能马上处理。
mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0003.english: One more thing, you'll need to hurry. Clients want this handled now.

mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0004.chinese: 是的，也许我该提一下，我需要你立即处理这件事，所以赶快滚。
mg_ruto_intromission_timed_0004.english: Yeah, probably should mention that I need this taken care of immediately, so off you go.

mg_ruto_invite_obj_long_01.english: Meet with Ruto in Grim HEX

mg_ruto_invite_oldman_001.chinese: 别太在意门口那个家伙。他就一看门狗。只是老一点...并且更安静。
mg_ruto_invite_oldman_001.english: Don't mind the guy at the front. He's kinda like a watch dog. Just older... and quieter.

mg_ruto_invite_oldman_002.chinese: 不管你在做什么，不要招惹门口那个家伙。他看起来可能不怎么样，但是他是前海军陆战队的成员。
mg_ruto_invite_oldman_002.english: Whatever you do. Don't piss off the guy at the front. He may not look like much, but he's an ex-Marine.

mg_ruto_invite_oldman_003.chinese: 事先警告，我柜台前面的那个门卫可不是好惹的。十分暴力。如果你看到他穿着绿色，赶紧跑。那是他的愤怒颜色。
mg_ruto_invite_oldman_003.english: Word of warning, the guy I have guarding the counter is violent. Real violent. If you see him wearing green, run. That's his trigger color.

mg_ruto_invite_oldman_004.english: Make sure the guy in the front doesn't talk your ear off.

mg_ruto_invite_oldman_005.chinese: 不用担心前台那个老古董。他是在这土生土长的人。
mg_ruto_invite_oldman_005.english: Don't worry about the antique at the front counter. He came with the place.

mg_ruto_invite_title_0002.chinese: 干得漂亮，现在有新活儿

mg_ruto_invite_title_0003.english: up for a face to face?

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0001.chinese: 它们坏的越久，我们损失的钱就越多。我需要它们尽快恢复运行。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0001.english: The longer they're dark, the more credits we lose. Need them up and running ASAP.

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0002.chinese: 很多人都在等它们重新运作起来，所以赶快帮帮忙吧。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0002.english: A lot of people are waiting on them to be up and running again, so basically, hurry the hell up with this.

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0003.chinese: 这地方交易量很大，所以急需维修。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0003.english: A lot of credits run through the place which makes this repair pretty damn urgent.

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0004.chinese: 我有很多其他活儿要等这个先解决，我可不喜欢等着。你越快完成越好。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0004.english: Some other jobs I got cooking are waiting on this being taken care of and I don't like being kept waiting. Faster you get this done the better.

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0005.chinese: 不是催你或者别的，但这件事很急。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_danger_0005.english: Not to rush you or anything, but this needs to get taken care of fast.

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0001.chinese: 我爸正在尝试修理空气循环机
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0001.english: my dad trying to fix the air recycler

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0002.chinese: 我的老室友正在尝试自制量子燃料
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0002.english: my old roommate trying to make his own quantum fuel

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0003.chinese: 有次和我一起的这老家伙把他的枪设置成自动开火，差点把他的船毁了
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0003.english: the time this banger I ran with rigged his gun to be autofire and nearly destroyed his ship

mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0004.chinese: 这个老矿工觉得她能给自己做一套更好的EVA(出舱活动)宇航服。
mg_ruto_outpost_repair_diy_0004.english: this old miner who figured she could build herself a better EVA suit.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_obj_long_02.chinese: 收集所有的尸体箱，然后带它们离开这个地方。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_obj_long_02.english: Collect all boxes containing remains and remove them from the site.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_obj_long_03.english: Get rid of the remains off-world.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0001.chinese: 放的越久，就更有可能有无关人员经过。不能冒那个险，更别说会发臭。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0001.english: The longer this sits, the more likely someone who shouldn't stumbles across it. Can't risk that. Not to mention the stench.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0003.chinese: 在被四处闲逛的人发现之前，我们最好尽快处理。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0003.english: We need to hurry up and take care of this before before someone starts poking around.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0004.chinese: 我愿称之为急差。尸体不会自己挪窝，但是如果早点处理完，~mission(Client)会感觉好点儿。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0004.english: Gonna call this a rush job. Remain are not going anywhere, but the ~mission(Client) will feel a lot better once everything's been taken care of.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0005.chinese: 不要拖得太久，我们最不想见到的事就是别人先你一步拿到尸体。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_body_timed_0005.english: Don't take too long on this. Last thing we need is for someone else to get to the remains before you do.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0001.chinese: 这项工作是有时效性的，希望你尽快完成。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0001.english: This job comes with a timetable, so I'm gonna need you to move quick on this.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0002.chinese: 快点干，我听说伙计们都等不及了。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0002.english: Hurry up too. I'm told the masses are eager for their party favors.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0003.chinese: 你时间紧迫，~mission(client)十分迫切地需要他的补给品。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0003.english: You'll be on a clock with this one. The~mission(client) need their supply quick.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0004.chinese: 行动快一点，我会给你掐着时间的。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_rush_0004.english: Move quick. I'm gonna be timing you on this one.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0001.chinese: 这是一趟禁药运输，所以请提高警惕万分小心，OK？
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0001.english: This is a drug run, so keep an eye out for baddies, yeah?

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0002.chinese: 有人告诉我，可能有几个大块头也要干这个工作。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0002.english: A little bird told me that there might be some heavies out gunning for this job too.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0003.chinese: 这次你可能需要打一架了，就是这样的你懂的。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0003.english: You might need to fight some people on this one. Just so you know.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0004.chinese: 准备好面对一些人渣，我不指望这会十分顺利。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_drug_trouble_0004.english: Be ready for a scrap. I'm not expecting this one to go smoothly.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0001.chinese: 记得带些武器，有很大的可能性会干上一架。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0001.english: Make sure you bring some guns. There's a high potentiality that this one might get a little rough.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0002.chinese: 在这个任务过程中你很可能需要做掉一些人，我相信这对你来说不成问题。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0002.english: There's a good chance you might need to kill some people on this one. I trust you don't have a problem with that.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0003.chinese: 时刻注意周围，有捕猎者盘旋于此，你应该明白我意思。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0003.english: And keep your eyes open. Word is there are predators circling, if you get my meaning.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0004.chinese: 你不介意干掉一些人吧？我没法保证什么，但你至少需要确保你带足了枪支。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0004.english: You don't mind killing people right? I'm not promising anything, but you might want to make sure you got some guns.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0005.chinese: 我认识的一个人说，这份工作可能在我得到它之前就被别人接过了，所以你可能会碰上竞争对手，不过处理掉他们就好。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_danger_0005.english: Guy I know said that this job might've been shopped around before it landed with me, so there might be some unfriendly competition out there. Handle them.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0001.chinese: 希望你能风驰电掣地搞定这事。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0001.english: I'm gonna need you to go light speed on this one.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0002.chinese: 请务必优先考虑这个任务，客户希望能快点拿到东西。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0002.english: Think you can prioritize this? Clients were very insistent that it happens quickly.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0003.english: Hurry up on this one. There are people waiting.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0004.chinese: 如果你接受这个任务，务必雷厉风行。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0004.english: If you do this job, make sure you take care of it quick.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0005.chinese: 行动快点，尽早搞定这事。
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_rush_0005.english: Move quick and get this done.

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_title_0003.english: pick up, drop off, you know...

mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_title_0004.chinese: 这事就是我和你说过的那啥...你懂吧
mg_ruto_planetcollect_steal_title_0004.english: that thing I was telling you about

mg_ruto_planetcollect_waste_obj_long_03.chinese: 让 ~mission(Item) 变成太空垃圾吧~

mg_ruto_sectorsweep_danger_004.chinese: 当然，尽管我们天天嘲笑这些安全系统黑客，不过不要太小瞧他们哟。别分神，如果你犯傻，谁手里有枪都有机会弄死你。
mg_ruto_sectorsweep_danger_004.english: Of course, as much as we make fun of these security hacks, don't underestimate them. Any idiot with a gun can kill you if you get sloppy.

mg_ruto_sectorsweep_obj_long_01.chinese: 去检查所有的巡逻信标，然后摧毁附近所有的安保。
mg_ruto_sectorsweep_obj_long_01.english: Visit all of the patrol beacons and clear out any security.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0001.chinese: 有消息说那地方会有点儿麻烦，请小心行事。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0001.english: Word is there's trouble in the area, so keep sharp.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0002.chinese: 如果有人来搞你，就甩掉他们，懂没？
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0002.english: Anyone messes with you, you drop them, yeah?

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0003.chinese: 还有一件事，你得去些麻烦的地方，我的建议是带好武器，带很多很多武器。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0003.english: Another thing, this'll take you in some rough parts of space. I'd recommend guns. Lots of guns.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0004.chinese: 你知道吗，从 ~mission(ship) 的坐标来看，我觉得你可能需要确保有足够的弹药。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0004.english: You know, looking at the ~mission(ship)'s position, I'm thinking you might wanna make sure your guns are all charged up.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0005.chinese: 我手下一个人告诉我，~mission(client)可能已经把这个任务消息泄漏出去了，所以你可能有麻烦了。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_danger_0005.english: One of my people told me the ~mission(client) might've shopped this job around, so you may run into some trouble.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0001.chinese: 他们需要一个急速的快递小哥。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0001.english: They're gonna need this delivered sharpish.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0002.chinese: 快马加鞭，好吗？我希望能马上完事。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0002.english: And get a move on, yeah? I need this done now.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0003.chinese: 快马加鞭！这需要尽快完成。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0003.english: Let's put on our speedy pants for this one, okay? This needs to get done sooner than later.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0004.chinese: 需要你雷厉风行，~mission(client) 想要它立马完成。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0004.english: Gonna need you to move fast on this. The ~mission(client) want it done now.

mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0005.chinese: 如果你要做这个任务，请一定务必要快快快！我们看时间给钱。
mg_ruto_spacecargo_illegal_timed_0005.english: If you do this, move fast, okay? The pay comes with a clock.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0001.chinese: 这份工作可能有点血腥，我想你需要做好充足准备。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0001.english: Odds are this job's gonna get a little bloody. Might wanna ready yourself for that.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0002.chinese: 从每一个碍你事儿的人尸体上踏过去。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0002.english: Handle anyone that gets in your way.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0003.chinese: 准备好迎接一些暴力场面，我不觉得能和平解决。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0003.english: Get ready for some violence, yeah? I don't think this'll go peacefully.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0004.chinese: 是我就会准备一些枪支，你懂的，要提防事态变得严重。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_danger_0004.english: I'd bring some guns too. You know, in case this gets ugly.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0001.english: Gonna need you to burn on this. Time's tight.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0002.chinese: 搞快点，可以吗？我希望能尽快完事。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0002.english: Move fast, okay? I want this handled quickly.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0003.chinese: 我需要你快点搞定这事，~mission(client)想要你尽快完成。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0003.english: I'm gonna need you to hop on this quick. ~mission(client) want it resolved.

mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0004.chinese: 这是很要的活，懂没？如果你要接，就要干好。没本事就别揽活。
mg_ruto_spacesteal_timed_0004.english: This is a priority gig. Hear me? If you're in, you get it done. No wasting around.

mg_ruto_ugf_eliminateall_lawnocivs_title.chinese: 活下去，让独立承包商来复仇
mg_ruto_ugf_eliminateall_lawnocivs_title.english: live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge

microtech_jumppoint_hurston,p.chinese: 微科星 - 赫斯顿跳跃点

microtech_repui_headquarters.chinese: 斯坦顿星系，微科星，新巴贝奇市

microtech_repui_leadership.chinese: 埃尔·菲利皮亚克，首席执行官

mileseckhart_lawfulkillcriminal_2,p.chinese: 如果您有兴趣，另一项悬赏也在规格范围内。看看吧。
mileseckhart_lawfulkillcriminal_2,p.english: Another bounty came over the spec if you're interested. Have a look.

mileseckhart_lawfulkillcriminal_4,p.chinese: 这个直接来自公会。这是一个高价值、高风险的目标。你自己小心点
mileseckhart_lawfulkillcriminal_4,p.english: This one came straight from the Guild. It's a high value, high risk target. Watch yourself with this one.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersaregiventheloc.chinese: 高风险检索刚刚收到。如果你有兴趣，请查看详情，否则我会转告你。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersaregiventheloc.english: High risk retrieval just came in. Check out out the details and see if you're interested, otherwise I'll pass it along.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersaregiventheloc.chinese: 估计是某个白痴飞行员去送死了，所以我们又签了一份寻找残骸的合约。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersaregiventheloc.english: Guess some idiot pilot went and got themself killed, so we've got another contract to find the wreck.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustdeliverone.chinese: 刚刚收到另一个快递的邮件。时间很紧，如果你赶不上最后期限，就别接这个活儿了。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustdeliverone.english: Just got pinged from another delivery. It's time sensitive so don't take the gig if you can't make the deadline.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustdeliverone.chinese: 如果你有时间，需要再送一次货。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustdeliverone.english: Need another delivery if you got the time.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.chinese: 有份伴游的工作，不知道你是否有空。赚钱应该很容易，但要睁大眼睛。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.english: An escort job just tumbled free and wondered if you might be available. Should be easy money, but keep your eyes open.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.chinese: 我需要一个保姆来照看一艘船。看看你是否感兴趣。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.english: Need a babysitter for a ship run. Take a look and see if you're interested.

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.chinese: 这是个基本的护送任务，客户要去几个地方。你跟着他们，不让他们惹麻烦不难吧？
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustescortashi.english: It's a basic escort mission, the client's got a handful of stops they need to make. You follow and keep them out of trouble. Not too tough, right?

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustgotoalocat.chinese: 又有一个准备好接受正义之手的卑鄙小人...值得一笔可观的赏金。想再来一次伏击吗？
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmustgotoalocat.english: Got another scumbag who's ready for the swift hand of justice... and worth a sizeable bounty. Up for another ambush?

mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmusttakeannpca.chinese: 又有一份当司机的工作出现了。看看您是否感兴趣。
mileseckhart_lawfulplayersmusttakeannpca.english: Another chaffeur job just came across the spec. Have a look and see if you're interested.

mileseckhart_lawfulsearchawreckforcorpse.chinese: 这是个回收任务需要收集一点特殊的东西 我们称之为 “打捞物”我让你负责去沉船现场寻找它。
mileseckhart_lawfulsearchawreckforcorpse.english: This job's a retrieval op. Need to collect a special bit of- let's say "salvage." I'm gonna give you the honor of going to the wreck, and finding it.

mileseckhart_missionfail_6,p.chinese: 整件事情都搞砸了，只剩下我拿着棍子。希望你为自己感到骄傲。
mileseckhart_missionfail_6,p.english: The whole thing's gone div and I'm left holding the stick. Hope you're proud of yourself.

mileseckhart_repui_location.chinese: 斯坦顿星系，赫斯顿，罗威尔

mileseckhart_revisityourecurrentlyonamis.chinese: 你知道细节，那就行动起来吧。
mileseckhart_revisityourecurrentlyonamis.english: You got the details, so get moving.

mileseckhart_sitsinthecornerofthedarkbar.chinese: 嘿 这边你好吗？请进来坐坐吧....
mileseckhart_sitsinthecornerofthedarkbar.english: Hey! Over here. How you been? Grab a seat. Come on. Get in here....

mileseckhart_unlawfulatprisonhard_2,p.chinese: 有一个危险的东西要给你。也许我越少说它越好。
mileseckhart_unlawfulatprisonhard_2,p.english: Got a dangerous one for you. Probably the less I talk about it the better.

mileseckhart_unlawfulkillinnocentorrival.chinese: 嘿，杀手，想赚点外快吗？我又找到了一个苟延残喘的目标
mileseckhart_unlawfulkillinnocentorrival.english: Hey killer, feel like earning some extra creds? Got another target that's living on borrowed breath.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersaregiventhel.chinese: 既然他们有偷东西的兴致 我想如果我们自己动手 没人会介意的如果他们介意，我相信你会处理好的。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersaregiventhel.english: Since they're in the stealing mood, I figure no one will mind if we help ourselves. If they do, I trust you'll handle them.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustdelivero.chinese: 需要一些需要移动的低调产品。如果你明白我的意思，我会避开任何重型安全扫描。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustdelivero.english: Need some low profile product that needs to be moved. I'd skirt any heavy security scans if you get my meaning.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustdropoffa.chinese: 好消息，光头，有些东西需要炸掉，而你将成为炸掉它的幸运儿。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustdropoffa.english: Exciting news, slick. Something needs blowing up, and you get to be the lucky one to do it.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustescortas.chinese: 你有时间再做一次保护行动吗？我有个客户需要一个重装杀手
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustescortas.english: You free for another protection op? Got a client who needs a heavy hitter on their wing.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustescortas.chinese: 你有时间参加护送行动吗？这是另一个交错行动，所以你会去多个地点。看看吧。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustescortas.english: You got time for an escort op? It's another staggered one so you'll hit multiple spots. Have a look.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustgotoaloc.chinese: 还有一个名字需要标注出来我已经想好了伏击的时间和地点，只需要一个引爆器就可以动手了。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmustgotoaloc.english: Got another name that needs to be marked off. I've worked out the time and place for the ambush, just need a trigger to do the deed.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmusthelpashi.chinese: 这又是一个猛男的工作，为客户提供支持，想杀谁就杀谁。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmusthelpashi.english: It's another muscle job, back up the client and shoot up whoever they want shot up.

mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmusttakeannp.chinese: 还有一位乘客正在寻找低调的交通工具。
mileseckhart_unlawfulplayersmusttakeannp.english: Got another passenger that's looking for low profile transport.

outlawsweep_combatpay_0001.chinese: 除了标准的合约报酬，您每消灭一个法外之徒都会获得奖金。
outlawsweep_combatpay_0001.english: In addition to the standard contract payment, there will be a bonus issued for each combatant you successfully neutralize.

outlawsweep_combatpay_0003.chinese: 我还要向您说明一下发放风险津贴的事宜，当您每解决掉一个法外之徒，您就会获得一份相应的风险津贴。

outlawsweep_combatpay_0004.chinese: 提前回答您的问题，没错，除了正常的固定费用外，您每解决一个敌人都会得到风险津贴。

outpost_repair_timed_0001.chinese: 我们非常想把这件事情尽快搞定，任何加快进度的事情都是值得表扬。
outpost_repair_timed_0001.english: We are in a big hurry to get this sorted. Anything you could do to speed things along is appreciated.

outpost_repair_timed_0002.chinese: 这是一个非常紧急的请求，我们没法问题解决之前好好工作。
outpost_repair_timed_0002.english: This is a pretty urgent request as we can't work at full capacity until the problem is fixed.

outpost_repair_timed_0003.chinese: 这个事儿拖得越久，问题就越严重。所以趁早把问题解决掉吧。
outpost_repair_timed_0003.english: The longer this problem goes unaddressed, the bigger of an issue it's becoming. Would be great to see this taken care of sooner than later.

outpost_repair_timed_0004.chinese: 截止日期马上就要到了，如果我们不能如期解决这个问题，那可就更头疼了。
outpost_repair_timed_0004.english: We have a few pressing deadlines coming up, so we are looking at a pretty big headache if this isn't taken care of as soon as possible.

outpost_repair_timed_0005.chinese: 我们本来是不想催您的，因为心急吃不了热豆腐。但是如果能尽快解决问题，那当然是极好的。
outpost_repair_timed_0005.english: Now, we don't want you to rush or do sloppy work or anything, but if there is any way of speeding things along, that would help us out immensely.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.chinese: 这种啃屎的感觉如何啊！
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.english: How do you like that shit!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_ammoprovide.chinese: 我会把这个记载你账上的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_ammoprovide.english: I'll put this on your tab.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_backupprovi.english: Yeah, I guess I could help

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_callbackup_.english: Hey, get some back up here!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_callbackup_.chinese: 有人能叫几个朋友来吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_callbackup_.english: Anybody got any friends they can call?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 最好别让我看到你们有谁想要退缩的！
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: I better not see a single one of you fall back!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 我们不能放弃这里，听明白了吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: We aren't giving up this ground. You hear?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 找掩体！我们没有退路了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: Dig in! We aren't going anywhere.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Why hello! Got some people inbound.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 快点，看起来有些婊子来找我们了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Look alive, there are some real mean lookin' sombitches heading our way.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: <警哨> 准备就绪！有麻烦来了。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: How the hell did you get in here?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 他们从上面接近我们了。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: They busted out the big guns!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 看起来有人准备好好打一场啊。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Looks like someone loaded up to fight.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 他们有一把...卧槽，好大的枪。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: They got a... damn that gun's big.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 看起来他们是开车过来的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Looks like they got a ride.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 看来有人把自己的座驾也带来了。
呃...我觉得他们有火箭筒。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Um... I think they got a rocket launcher.
Careful. They got some big guns.
Uh oh, they got a marksman!
Oh damn... they got a Titan.
I think we got a problem.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_gethits_fri.english: What the hell are you doing?!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 你以为我被吓到了？让我告诉你什么才叫真正的恐惧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: You think I'm scared? I'll show you scared.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 去他妈的，老子一个人更牛。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: Screw it, I work better alone.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 所以，呃...也许我们可以谈判下？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: So uh... maybe we can work something out?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 你知道我是开玩笑的，对吧？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: You know I was just kidding, right?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 要不我们就当无事发生...
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: How about we all just forget this thing happened...

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastofthem_.chinese: 噢，我们把他们都杀了？好戏才刚刚开始呢。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_lastofthem_.english: Oh, we killed 'em all? It was just getting fun.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_noticenotla.chinese: 呃...有人知道他们去哪了吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_noticenotla.english: Um... anyone know where they went?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: What took you all so long?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 好消息各位，增援在路上了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Good news everybody. Help is on the way.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 你猜怎么着？我们的朋友们要来了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Guess what? Got some friends coming in.
Hey, uh, anybody out there come help?
Yeah, we need some backup here.
Hey! Get your asses over here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.chinese: 我们赶紧离开这个鬼地方！
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.english: Let's get the hell out of here!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 我很喜欢以伤害你为业。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: I'm gonna hurt you for so long you're gonna think it's a career.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 杀了你之后，我会杀了你的家人，然后是你的狗，最后把你的房子烧成灰！
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: After I kill you, I'm gonna kill your family. Then your dog. Then burn your hab to the ground!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 你想打架是吧，那可得让你好好感受一下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: You wanted this fight. Now you're gonna feel every second of it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 讲真，出来吧，我会很快解决你的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.english: Seriously. Come on out. I'll make it quick.
We can work this out. Honest.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 你不可能永远躲下去的。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.english: You picked the wrong guy to screw with.
I'm gonna slice you thin enough to fry.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.english: What the hell? Are my sights off?
Hey, who messed with my gun!

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_deescalate.english: Well, that was a waste of time.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 好好看着，我觉得我们遇上了点什么东西。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Look alive. I think we got something.
Hey, wake up. Get on the clock.
Think I might have something here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 啊，没错，有什么大的要来了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Hey, yeah, something's definitely going on.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Don't sweat it. It wasn't anything worth worrying about.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 对，我们已经清空了这里。
那个？啊对，不是什么大问题。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: So that thing? Yeah, it wasn't a problem.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Hey, I think I might'a heard something.
I'm gonna go check on something.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 嘿，我去看看有什么东西，马上回来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Hey, looking into something real quick.
Maybe you should go check it out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 你在休息什么？去找他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: What are you on break? Find them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 要么他们死，要么我们亡。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: We're aren't stopping until they're dead or we are.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Are you kidding me? How'd we lose 'em?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 是的，我也不知道怎么回事，但是他们就这么消失了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Yeah, I don't know what happened, but they're gone.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 嘿，我们跟丢他们了。对，我也不知道怎么回事。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Hey, totally lost them. Yeah, I don't know.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 对，我们没找到他们。我他妈怎么知道？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Yeah, we don't have them anymore. How the hell should I know?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 你有看到什么吗？我也没有。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Yeah, hey, I didn't find anything.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 对，我看了一眼，什么都没有。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Yeah, took a look and nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 嘿，不管是什么东西，它都应该已经走了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Hey, whatever it was must be gone now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 妈的，我们得找到他们到底去哪了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Dammit, we need find where they went.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 不管他们在哪，都得给我查出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Where ever they are, I want them found.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们得找到他们，立刻。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: We need find them, now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 哪都找不到他们。但是别担心，我会找到的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Can't find 'em anymore. But don't worry. I'll get 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 对，他们把我甩掉了。但这不会持续多久的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Yeah, they gave me the slip. But not for long.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 妈的。<暂停> 嘿，是我。那谁已经溜了，我得看看能不能找到点他们的踪迹。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Goddammit. <pause> Hey, it's me. Whoever it was is gone now. Gonna see if I can pick up their trail.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 走走走。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's go, let's go.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 大家抓紧时间。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Get on the clock, people.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 快点，我们走。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Come on, let's do this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 对，我们这里有点情况。在找了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Yeah, we got something here. Heading in.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们正在狩猎，等抓到了就告诉你。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: On the hunt. I'll let you know what I catch.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 嘿，我这来了些捣乱的。得去找找他们了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Hey, think I got some troublemakers here. Gonna find out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们去看看。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's take a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 快点。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Look alive.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们走吧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's head out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我要去四处查查。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Gonna take a look around.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 看看我能找到什么。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Gonna see what I can find.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有情况，正在调查。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Got something. Looking into it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 散开，那个混蛋可能还在这。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Spread out. The bastard might still be here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 妈的，无论凶手是谁，我都要找到他。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Goddammit. I want whoever did this found.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 操。<大声说> 找到他们。<暂停> 快点，给我抓住这狗娘养的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Shit. <louder> Found 'em. <pause> Look alive. I want a net on this son of a bitch.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 发现一具尸体，我们要好好清查这地方。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Found a body. Gonna sweep the area.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 嘿，他们失败了。<暂停> 妈的，我一定要把凶手拿下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Hey, they didn't make it. <pause> Goddamn right I'm hunting down whoever did this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有个同伴死了，得好好防守这片区域。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: I got a friendly on ice. Gonna secure the area.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 你要去哪？我以为你想玩玩的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Where'd you go? I thought you wanted to play.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 回来，我们还有好多乐子没找呢。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Come back. We were having so much fun.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 你知道吗，我才刚刚喜欢上这样。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: You know, I was just getting into this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 喂？你可以出来了。我们是朋友。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Hello? You can come out. We're friends.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 对不起，我迷路了。你知道怎么去科途便利店吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Excuse me, I'm lost and looking for directions. Do you know how to get to Kel-To?

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 出来吧，我们不会伤害你的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Come on out. We're not gonna hurt you.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: I don't think I did that...

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticegunf.chinese: 听起来有人想闹点动静。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 我想我们可能来客人了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: I think we might have company.
Yeah, what the hell was that?
I got bad feeling about this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.chinese: 对...我听到有什么东西了。

ph_pu_genoutlaw1_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.english: Yeah, yeah, I saw it too.
Huh? No, I didn't see nothin.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.english: Did you see that? I killed one!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.chinese: 再给我的击杀记录添上一笔。
这帮混蛋干掉了一个我们的人。
我操，他们刚杀了几个人。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_backupdeny_.english: Sorry, can't make it to you.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_backupdeny_.chinese: 现在我们只能各自为战。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_backupdeny_.english: It's everyone for themselves, right now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 我们现在就要在这里阻止他们，明白？
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: We stop them here and now. All right?
We gotta hold this ground or die trying.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 无论什么东西，都不能让它越过我们的防线，明白？

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: We've got trouble coming right for us!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 让我们帮这些混蛋去见上帝。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Let's help these bastards meet their maker.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 我找到了可以拿来练枪的靶子。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Damn, they're on top of us.
Look out! They got heavy weapons.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 重火力朝我们这边来了！
飞船！这些混蛋们可不是闹着玩的。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: They're rolling in with a vehicle.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 那些混蛋不是闹着玩儿的！

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: They got a frickin' rocket launcher!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_fallback_hi.chinese: 我们必须撤退，重新集结。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_fallback_hi.english: We gotta drop back and regroup.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_followme_hi.english: Get behind me and let's go!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_gethits_fri.chinese: 你他妈看着点你的枪口！

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: Odds are still in my favor.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 立刻离开！不然我就把你们都干掉。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: Leave, now! Before I take you all down.
Come on, come on. I got this!
No, no, no. I'm not dying today...
Damn it! This can't be it...

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_overheating.english: Need a second to cool down!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 喂？趁现在还来得及，赶紧来支援。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Hello? Send backup before it's too late.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 他妈的支援再不来我们就撑不住了！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Won't last much longer without that damn backup!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.chinese: 我们需要离开这鬼地方！

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_spreadout_h.english: Put a little more space between us.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 识相的话你最好自我了断！等我找到你，你会后悔的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: Do the smart thing and kill yourself now! Cause if I find you, you'll regret it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 我还以为你想来打一场呢！

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.english: Come on out. Let's just talk this through.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 怪不得你一直没死，真是他妈的懦夫！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.english: No wonder you're still alive. You're a damn coward!

You screwed with the wrong people.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.chinese: 这儿有个有你名字的贴画。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.english: Got a whole clip here with your name on it.
Yeah, keep moving. Tire yourself out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.chinese: 你想躲就躲吧。反正到最后你还是死路一条！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.english: Dodge all you want. This ends with you dead!

Did you just learn how to shoot that thing?
Gotta get you a better gun.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 还有别人在这里，我发誓。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 嘿，我想我要找到什么东西了。小心点，做好准备。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Hey, I think I'm on to something. Get ready just in case.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Got all worked up over nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 好吧，我没料到会是这样。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Well, that wasn't what I expected.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 完全没问题，忘了那事吧。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 让我看看这里发生了什么。
在调查异常情况，可能没啥大不了的事。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Investigating something unusual. It's probably nothing,
Gonna check something out real quick.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 好像要出事，我检查一下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Something's going on. Taking a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 去查查那里有什么，然后汇报给我。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Find out what's there and report back.
What? I got that last one.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 他们就在这附近，继续找。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: They're around here somewhere. Keep at it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 找到那些傻逼前，谁都不许停下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: No one stops looking until we find the bastard.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 不能让他们任何一个跑掉，明白吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: We don't let anyone get away, understand?

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 蠢货，让他们就这么跑掉了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Disgraceful, letting 'em get away like that.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 怎么会让他们跑掉呢，操！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Letting 'em escape is unacceptable, damn it!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 真不知道说什么好，他们跑了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Don't know what to say, but they're gone.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 他们逃走了，如果这里有内鬼，那我一点也不惊讶。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: They got away, and I wouldn't be surprised if someone around here helped 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 我同意。他们的逃跑并不是什么好事，但我不知道还能做些什么。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: I agree. Them escaping is not ideal, but I don't know what the hell else to do about it.
Whatever it was its gone now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 操，我发誓他们刚刚在这。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Shit, I swear they were right here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 对，最奇怪的是，我什么都找不到。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Yeah, strangest thing, I can't find anything.
The investigation didn't turn up anything.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 别让那些傻逼跑了，找到他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Don't let the bastard escape. Find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 操，不管他们在哪，都跑不远了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Shit, wherever they are, they won't get away long.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 妈的，他们跑了。找到他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Damn, they're gone. Let's find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 那些傻逼躲过了我们的监视，但我会找到他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Bastards slipped our surveillance, but I'll find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 他们跑了，估计不远。我会继续找。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: The're gone, probably not far. I'll keep looking.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 对，他们要么跑了，要么藏得很好。我会再找一遍。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Yeah, they're either gone or hiding real good. I'll do another sweep.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 找到他们！杀了他们！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Find 'em! Kill 'em!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 动起来，找到他们！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Move out, find 'em!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 先下手为强！
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's get the jump on 'em!

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 前往调查中。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Moving out to investigate.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 好，我会查个水落石出。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Yeah, I'll get to the bottom of it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 如果这里有什么，我会找到的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: If something's here, I'm gonna find it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 最好查下那个。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Better check that out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们干活去。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's go to work.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 这值得一试。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: That's worth checking out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 注意点，四处看看，可能来人了。
