ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Maybe got something. Kicking off a patrol to look into it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有什么事情要发生了，我查清楚再告诉你。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Something's up. I'll get to the bottom of it and let you know.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有人得一命换一命了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Someone's gonna to pay for dropping this body.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 把枪上膛，凶手可能还在这里。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Get those guns locked and loaded. Whoever did this is probably still here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 开始搜查，绝不能让凶手逃跑。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Start searching. Can't let whoever did this get away.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有人被杀了，我们打算开始清查，让那个混蛋付出代价。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Got a ghost. Starting a sweep to find the bastard responsible.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 发现一具尸体，得调查一下这片区域。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Came across a body. Gonna investigate the area.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有人死了，得四处查查有没有什么蛛丝马迹。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Someone got dropped. Gonna look around and get to the bottom.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 你想藏就藏吧，这样更好玩了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Hide all you want. It's better this way. More fun.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 继续啊，藏好咯。我最喜欢打猎了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Go on, keep hiding. The hunt's my favorite part.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 如果有必要的话，我会花一整天的时间来追杀你的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: I'll spend all day hunting you down if I have to.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 找你找的我越来越暴躁了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: The harder I have to look for you the angrier I get.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 快出来吧，我可不想把事情闹得太难看。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Just come on out, and we can keep this from becoming a bigger deal than it is.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 来吧，快出来，不会有人受伤的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Come on. Come on out. No one needs to get hurt here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.chinese: 不知道这家伙哪里做错了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: Wonder what this one did wrong.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.chinese: 谁杀了他们？这是你的人吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: Who killed 'em? Was this one of you?

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 行吧，这可不是什么好事。
我他妈不喜欢这种感觉。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: Don't like this one damn bit.
Someone better not be messing with me.
The hell? Any idea what that was?

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 我他妈不喜欢这种感觉。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: I don't like this one damn bit.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 别胡思乱想了，集中注意力。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: Stop messing around and stay focused.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 你想太多了，那什么也没有。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: You're in your head. Nothing's there.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.chinese: 我肯定听到了什么东西。

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.english: Settle down. I didn't hear shit.
You better not be high again.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.chinese: 我好像看到那边有点东西。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.english: Think i spotted something over there.

ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.chinese: 你看见什么了？我看不太清。
ph_pu_genoutlaw2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.english: What'd you see? I couldn't make it out.
Don't get all worked up over nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_bs_general_celebratio.chinese: 我就是为这玩意儿而活的。

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_ammoprovide.chinese: 好吧，但这是最后一次了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_ammoprovide.english: Fine. But this is the last time.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_ammothanks_.chinese: 我杀的下个人记你头上！

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_coverfindbe.chinese: 这里呆不了多久了，该找点别的位置了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_coverfindbe.english: Won't last long here. Moving position.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 坚守阵地，不能让他们占领这里。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: Stand firm. Can't let 'em overrun us.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: It's over! They have the high ground!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 有一头野兽正在靠近我们。

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: They're trying to ride us down!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 究竟是什么样的混蛋才会带台泰坦过来？
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: What kind of assholes bring a Titan?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_fallback_hi.chinese: 我们撤退，然后重新集结。

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.chinese: 绕过去攻击他们的侧面。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.english: Circle around and hit their flank.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_gethits_fri.chinese: 再打我一次，你就有麻烦了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_gethits_fri.english: Shoot one more time, and we're gonna have a fuckin' problem.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_gethits_fri.chinese: 好好看看你他妈在瞄谁！

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.chinese: 看看他们有多喜欢这玩意。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.english: Let's see how they like this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_healdeny_ig.english: Then you should have brought some!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 来吧！你是怕了还是怎么的？让我们决一胜负吧！
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: Come on! You scared or something? Let's finish this!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 这还没结束！我才刚刚开始。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: This isn't over! I'm just getting started.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 就算我死了，我也要拉你们这些傻逼一起死！
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: If I'm going down then I'm bring you skags with me!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.chinese: 快走，我们在这待不了多久的！
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.english: Move out! We won't last long here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 噢...我会让你付出代价的！
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: Oh... I am going to make you pay for this!
Time to reap the whirlwind, fucker.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 有人吓得不敢出来干架啊。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.english: Somone's too scared to come out and fight.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.english: I'm going to mess you up!
Believe me, this is going to hurt.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.chinese: 你感觉到了吗？你越来越恐惧了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.english: You feel that? Your fear's getting the better of you.
You're in way over your head.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.chinese: 无论你怎么试，你都射不中。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.english: You couldn't shoot straight if you tried.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_areaclear_.chinese: 我查完了，这里什么都没有。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_areaclear_.english: I'm done looking around. Nothing here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_areaclear_.chinese: 我什么都没看到，也许这里什么都没有。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_areaclear_.english: Not seeing anything. It was probably nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_deescalate.chinese: 我想应该没有什么好担心的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_deescalate.english: Guess it's nothing to worry about.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: I'm going to take a closer look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 保持警惕，这里不太对劲。
嘿，看来我奶奶的追踪技术可算有了用武之地，我想我走对路了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Hey, looks like my grandma's tracking skills are paying off. Think I'm on the right path.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 对，也许发现了什么，继续搜索。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Yeah, Maybe got something. going to keep looking.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 所以，看来我的预感是对的。我还在找，但我会找到的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: So, looks like my hunch was right. Still searching, but I'll find them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 大家都放松一下吧，这是假警报。

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Well, that was a waste of time.
Turns out it was nothing to worry about.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 我得去看看发生了什么。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Guess I should look into it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 好像有事发生。我去那边看看。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Think something up. I'll check it out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 我去附近检查一下。马上回来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Gonna go take a look around. Be right back.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 嘿我得去看看那边到底发生了什么事。如果一会我没回信的话，那估计我已经挂了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Hey, I'm gonna check on something. If you don't hear back from me, I've been murdered.
Hustle up and take a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 分头行动，扩大搜索范围。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: Let's spread out and cover more ground.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 我们会找到他们的，他们应该还没跑远。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: We'll find 'em. They couldn't have gone far.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 操，一点他们的痕迹都找不到。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Shit, can't find any trace of 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 他们他妈地怎么跑掉的?
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: How the hell the get away from us?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 哪里都找不到他们的人影，我觉得他们溜走了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Can't find 'em anywhere. Think they slipped.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 整个地方都找遍了，肯定是跑了。
啥都没找到，搞不清这傻逼去哪了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Came up empty. No idea where the skag went.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 搜索结束，未发现任何东西，完毕。

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 那傻逼跑路了，我们不能放过他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Skag slipped me. Can't let 'em get away.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 他们跑了，要找的话只能上上下下都搜查一遍了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: They're gone. Better search high and low to find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 来点人给我找找这狡猾的混蛋跑哪去了，就现在。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Someone get eyes on this slippery bastard, now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 目标丢失，开始搜索。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Lost track of the target. Starting a sweep now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 他们溜了，得去把他们找出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: They snuck off. Going to track 'em down.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 听着，我要去把这个傻逼找出来，然后让他后悔选择了逃跑。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Listen. I'm going to find this skag and make 'em regret giving me the slip.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们去找他们，快。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's track 'em down, quick.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 来吧，谁想先来？
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Come on, who wants first crack?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 时间紧迫，立即行动。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Time's a wastin'. Let's go.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 开始地毯式搜索，不管他妈的是谁都得把他找出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Taking a sweep through. Find whoever the hell this is.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有动静， 我去看看到底是什么情况。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Bit of ruckus. On my way to find out the cause.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有麻烦上门了，我去瞧瞧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Got some trouble brewing. Looking into it now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 最好去看看发生了什么。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Better look into this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有些不对劲，我去看看怎么了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: That's not right. I'm going to check it out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 刚才那个得去调查一下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: That's worth investigating.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 有情况，现在就去检查，完毕。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Something's up. Checking it out, over.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 不知道到底是什么情况，但我会调查的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Not sure exactly what's going on, but I'm gonna investigate.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 这里发生了一些奇怪的事，我要调查一下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Some strange ass stuff is going on. Gonna look into it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 搜查这片区域，把那条蛇给我揪出来，他需要为此负责。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Search the area. Find the snake responsible.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 这里有人死了，大家小心。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Got a dead one here. Everyone watch out.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 所有人睁大你们的眼镜，把凶手找出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Eyes wide everyone. Find who did this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 找到一具尸体，正在调查现场。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Found a body, searching the area.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 警告，我发现了一具尸体，正在附近搜查。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Put out a word of warning. I found a body. Looking around now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 这里有具尸体，我们要找到凶手。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: There's a body here. Gonna find who did the deed.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 只有懦夫才会东躲西藏。你是懦夫吗？你怕了吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Cowards hide. You a coward? You scared?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 你想这样度过你生命最后的一刻吗？害怕地躲起来？
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Is this how you want to spend your final moments? Hiding scared?
Wonder how long you can keep quiet?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 来吧，让我看看你，你不会真的那么丑吧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Show yourself already. You can't be that ugly.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 别浪费我的时间了，出来吧。这对我们俩都好。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Quit wasting my time and come out. It'll be better for both of us.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 出来吧，我受够了这种猫捉老鼠的狗屎事情了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Come on out. I'm over this cat and mouse shit.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.chinese: 哦操，这可怜的傻逼死了！
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: Oh damn, this poor bastard's dead!

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.chinese: 这里他妈的发生什么事了？

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: Damn. What the hell was that?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.english: You hear like a sound or something?

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.chinese: 我好像听到那边有动静。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.english: Think I heard something coming from over there.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.chinese: 什么也没听到，但我会留意的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoun.english: Didn't hear a thing but I'll keep my ears open.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.chinese: 我发誓我看到了什么东西。
是的，我也看到什么东西了。
周围肯定有什么东西在动。
ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.english: Something definitely moved in my periphery.

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.chinese: 你确定你看到什么了吗？

ph_pu_genoutlaw3_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisu.english: Your eyes are playing tricks on you.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.chinese: 我打死一个？我打死一个！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_acknowledge.english: I got one? I got one!
Did you see that? What a shot.
One of ours just got cut down.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammodeny_ig.english: I'm sorry, I don't have one.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammodeny_ig.chinese: 看起来我也没有能分的了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammodeny_ig.english: Looks like I don't have one to spare.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammorequest.english: So uh... I need some ammo.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammorequest.chinese: 有人能分个弹匣给我吗？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_ammorequest.english: I don't suppose anyone has a mag they can spare.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_backupdeny_.english: I'm a little busy at the moment.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_coverpinned.english: Come on, give me a chance!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_coverprovid.chinese: 我会给他们制造点麻烦的。

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_coverreques.english: Keep 'em off me for a sec.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_defendthear.chinese: 这是我们的地盘。我们的！

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_defendthear.english: Don't you give them an inch!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Got a fight bearing down on us.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 让他们尝尝地狱的滋味！
我看到他们了，他们在上面。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: I see them. They're up there.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 他们在我们六点钟方向。
我看到他们了，他们在那边。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: I see them. They're over there.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 盯住那把巨他妈大的枪。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Eyes on a big ass gun.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 我不知道那是什么枪，但是它真的很大。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: I don't know what kind of gun that is but it's big.
Look out, they got a ride.
I think they got a rocket launcher.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.chinese: 我的老天爷，他们有泰坦！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_engageenemy.english: Sweet mercy, they got a titan!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_fallback_hi.chinese: 我们退后一点。你知道的，重新评估一下现在的态势。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_fallback_hi.english: Let's step back a bit. You know, reassess.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.chinese: 我们应该从侧面攻击他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.english: We should hit them on the sides.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.chinese: 我们偷偷溜过去，从侧面偷袭他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_flankthem_h.english: Let's sneak around and attack the flank.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_gethits_imh.chinese: 他们打中我了，他们真的打中我了！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_gethits_imh.english: They got me. They really got me!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.chinese: 看看他们有多喜欢这万一！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.english: Let's see how they like this!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.chinese: 你们可能得趴着躲这个了！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_grenadethro.english: Might want to stay down for this!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_healdeny_ig.english: I can't. Put pressure on it.
I don't think I have any.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_healrequest.chinese: 有人吗！随都行！我需要治疗。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_healrequest.english: Someone! Anyone! I need a heal.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_healthanks_.chinese: 治好自己我就可以重返战场了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_healthanks_.english: Healing up and I'm back in this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_keepfightin.english: Come on. Don't give up now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_keepfightin.chinese: 继续，继续！他们没有机会的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_keepfightin.english: Let's go, let's go! They don't stand a chance.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 你以为我会怕吗？你只是让我如释重负了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: You think I'm scared? You just killed the dead weight.
That's it? I'm just getting started.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.chinese: 好吧，现在我有点担心了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastmanstan.english: Okay. Getting a little worried now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastofthem_.english: That wasn't so bad was it?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastofthem_.chinese: 我觉得他们就只有这些人了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_lastofthem_.english: I think that was all of them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_overheating.chinese: 等下，我一下子射太多了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_overheating.english: Hold on. I think I shot too much.
Dammit, what is wrong with this thing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Call's in. Help's on the way.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 好吧，看看他们会不会出现。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: All right . Let's see if they show up.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.chinese: 送点支援过来，越快越好。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_reinforceme.english: Send backup. Sooner would be better.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.chinese: 我们赶紧离开这个鬼地方！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_retreat_hig.english: Let's get the hell out of here!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_spreadout_h.english: We should cover some more ground.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_stayclose_h.chinese: 我觉得你不应该到处乱跑。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_stayclose_h.english: I don't think you should wander.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 你这个小吊毛！我要搞死你！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: You little insignificant pissant! I'm gonna ruin you!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.chinese: 我会给你带来巨大的伤害！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_anger.english: I'm gonna bring an epic amout of hurt down on you!
You're really starting to piss me off.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.chinese: 真的吗？躲起来？你现在是在刁难我。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_hidin.english: Seriously? Hiding? You're just being difficult now.
How bout I hide and you come find me?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.chinese: 你信不信今天就是你的死期？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.english: Can you beileve today's the day you die?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.chinese: 别把那些值钱玩意打坏了！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.english: Try not to get shot in anything valuable!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.chinese: 这场战斗让我有种似曾相识的感觉！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_.english: This fight is giving me some serious deja vu right now!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.chinese: 拜托！这一枪应该可以打中的！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_misse.english: Come on! That one should've hit!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.chinese: 我已经等不及要告诉我的朋友们我遇到了全宇宙最差劲的枪手了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.english: Can't wait till I tell my friends I met the worst shot in the 'verse!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.chinese: 你要不要喊个暂停，去练习一下？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.english: Do you want to call a time out so you can go practice?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.chinese: 我敢打赌，你现在一定有了新的想法。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_combat_taunt_shots.english: Bet you're having second thoughts now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_deescalate.english: Feel a bit silly coming over here for nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Here we go. Got something. Keep looking.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 绝对有人在这，得找到他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Someone's definitely here. Just need to find them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 发现了点东西，正在搜索中。
可能会有发现，到时候会告诉你的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Might be on to something. Let you know.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.chinese: 有其他人在这里，但还不知道是谁。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_escalatese.english: Someone's here. Don't know who... yet.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Forget it. Not gonna be a fight.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 算了吧，没什么可兴奋的事。
虚惊一场，去做你的事吧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: False alarm. Go about your business.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.chinese: 嘿，你可以告诉大家冷静下来了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm.english: Hey, you can tell everyone to calm down.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 我想我得去看看...什么事都得我来做。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Guess I'll go take look... I do everything around here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 注意盯着点，我去看看这是在搞什么幺蛾子。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Keep an eye out, I'm gonna see what the fuss is.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 行吧。来看看我们找到了点什么。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: All right. Let's see what we got.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 喂，我这儿好像有点动静，但是也可能没啥。我看看再跟你说。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Hey, might have something over here. Might not. I'll let you know.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 感觉有点不太对劲。我得去看看。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Something's a bit off. Gonna take a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 你为什么不去看看到底是什么？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: Why don't you go see what the hell it is?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 挪挪你的屁股，去检查一下。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: How about you get off your ass and take a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.chinese: 如果你这么关心，就去看看是什么吧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_investigat.english: If you're so concerned, go see what it is.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 接着找。他们肯定在附近。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: Keep searching. They've got to be close.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.chinese: 集中注意力。他们就在附近的某个地方。
集中注意力。他们就在附近的某个地方。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_keepsearch.english: Check everywhere. I want to find this asshole.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Where the hell could they have gone?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 他们掉跳点里去了吗？到底他妈的去哪了啊？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Did they fall into a jump point? Where the fuck did they go?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 什么鬼？人是不可能凭空消失的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: What the hell? People don't just dissapear.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 我讨厌宣布坏消息，但是那个混蛋已经溜走了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Hate to be the bearer of bad news, but the bastard got away.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 没有他们的踪迹。他们消失了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: No sign of them. They're in the wind.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 鬼知道他们跑哪去了。反正肯定TM不在这。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Hell if I know where they went. But they sure as hell ain't here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 这可真是怪了，有烟无火起。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Well ain't that strange. All that smoke and no fire.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 算了，不找了，这里啥也没有。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Okay, I give up. There's nothing here.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 我尽力了，什么也没找到。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Try as I might, didn't find anything.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.chinese: 搜寻了半天什么也没找到。不管刚刚那是什么东西，我反正是没看到。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_searchfail.english: Search turned up empty. Whatever was out here, I'm not seeing it.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 好吧，真是只狡猾的猎物。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Well, isn't this an elusive prey.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 那个混蛋吓了我一跳，但是别担心，我会找到他们的
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: The bleeder shook me, but don't worry, I'll find them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 不知道他们去哪了，但是应该跑不远。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Not sure where they went, but they couldn't have gone far.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 这帮家伙还挺能跑，我现在就去把他们找出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: They pulled a runner on me. Gonna find them now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我正在追踪，看看这个小滑头溜哪去了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Tracking down where this slippery bugger went now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 不管这个傻逼逃哪去了，我都会把他揪出来。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Where ever the hell this gunter went, I'm gonna find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 你该办事了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Duty calls.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 看起来我们有麻烦了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Think we got company.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 来吧，该干活了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Come on. Let's get to work.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们来客人了，去找到他们。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: We got visitors. Finding them now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 客人们到了，该去欢迎一下他们了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Guests have arrived. Gonna go greet them.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 看起来好戏就要开始了，快点，别迟到了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Seems like the party's starting. Come on. Don't want to be late.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我们去看看那是个什么鬼东西。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's see what the hell that was.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 好吧，绝对有东西。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Well, that definitely wasn't nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 该去走走了。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Good time to take a walk.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 嘿，我去活动活动，顺便看看有没有什么动静。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Hey, I'm gonna stretch my legs and see if anything's going on.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 我感觉有些东西过来了，得去看一眼。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Get the feelin' like something's about to go down. Gonna take a look.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 嘿，正在检查一些东西，希望没什么事儿。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Hey, checking something out. Hopefully it's nothing.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 看看我们能不能跟那个干这事的变态打声招呼。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Let's see if we can't say hello to the sicko who did this.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 必须在他们再次作案之前找到凶手。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Gotta track down this killer before they can do it again.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 那混蛋可能跑不远。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Bastard probably couldn't have gotten far.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 发现一具尸体，不是我杀的，现正在寻找凶手。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Got a corpse I didn't kill. Looking for the responsible party now.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 保持警惕，有人在这里抛尸了。我们得尽快找到凶手。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Head's up. Someone's dropping bodies over here. We need to find the creeper fast.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.chinese: 嘿，我们正在追捕一些杀人的变态。如果我们找到他们，会告诉你的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_startsearc.english: Hey, hunting down some murderous skag. Will let you know if we find 'em.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 我可不喜欢你在这浪费我的时间！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: I don't appreciate you wasting my time!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 为了让我把子弹射进你的脑壳，我可做了不少准备。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: This is a lot of build up for me putting a bullet into your skull.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.chinese: 要么滚出来！要么给我一枪！你想做啥都成！
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost.english: Get out here! Or shoot me! Just do something already!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 嘿，躲在那里的朋友，出来聊聊吧。我发誓。我不会生气的。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Hey, who's ever hiding out there, come out now and we can work something out. Promise. Won't even be mad.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.chinese: 好了，好了，游戏结束。我认输。出来吧。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_hunting_taunt_sear.english: Olly, olly, oxen free. Come out. Come out.
Where you hiding, you little bugger?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: That's a bit of a mess.

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.chinese: 很好，一具血淋淋的尸体。
是他妈谁把这个混蛋弄死的？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorp.english: Who the hell ghosted this bastard?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticegunf.english: Looks like we got a party!

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 我该不该去看一下那是啥？
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: Do I wanna know what that was?

ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.chinese: 最好没有什么东西躲在那儿。
ph_pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesome.english: Damn well better not be someone hiding.

prisonerbreak_obj_long_004.chinese: 歼灭安保力量并登上运囚船。

prisonerbreak_obj_long_005.chinese: 定位并下载完整的囚犯转运名单，用它来找到正确的冷冻休眠舱。

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克的里格特。很高兴再次见到你，相信你对此已经很熟悉了。我已经发送了任务信息，所以你应该已经知道你所需要的信息。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.english: Hey, this is Riegert with BlacJac. Glad to see you're back. Anyway, you know the deal. I sent the mission info, so you should have everything you need.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。很高兴看到你回来。我已经把任务需要的信息发给你了。有任何更新我会通知你。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.english: It's Riegert with BlacJac. Glad to see you're back. I've sent you all the details to knock out this contract. I'll keep you posted on any updates.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.chinese: 这里是黑杰克安保公司，我是里格特中尉。我将负责此次任务。正在发送任务信息，这样你就可以出发了。祝你好运。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.english: BlacJac Security calling. This is Lt. Riegert. I'll be running this mission. Sending you the mission details now so you should be good to go. Good luck.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特中尉。我将是你这次任务的联络人。所有你需要的信息都在你的mobi上了。祝你好运。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.english: This is Lt. Riegert with BlacJac. I'll be your contact for this op. You should have everything you need on your mobi. Good luck out there.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.chinese: 这是黑杰克安保，我将是你这边的负责人。我将把所有的任务信息发到你的mobi上，去完成它吧。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa.english: This is BlacJac Security. I'll be your handler on this side. I've sent all the mission details to your mobi, so get to it.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_expired_mission_dru.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特。收到消息说该设施已经完成生产， 拿上你能拿的并带到安保终端。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_expired_mission_dru.english: What's up, this is Riegert. Got a tip that the facility's finished its production run, so grab what you can and get it to the security kiosk for disposal.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。我们将中断合约，你没能符合我们所需要完成的要求。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.english: This is Riegert with BlacJac. We?re cutting you loose. You're just not up to snuff for what we need to get done.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特。只是跟你说声我们将取消跟你的合约。抱歉。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.english: Hey. Riegert here. Just wanted to call and say that we're cancelling our contract with you. Sorry.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克安保。你未能达到我们对干员所期望的质量，所以我们将取消此次合约。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally.english: Hey, this is BlacJac Security. You haven't been delivering the kind of quality that we expect from our operators, so I'm gonna have to cancel this contract.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.chinese: 这里是黑杰克安保。我们将中断合约，也许下次再合作吧。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.english: This is BlacJac Security. We're gonna have to cut you loose. Maybe next time.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克的里格特。由于不佳的表现，我将终止你跟公司的合约。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.english: Hey. It's Riegert at BlacJac. Due to poor field performance, I gotta terminate your contract with the company.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。我将把你从任务中踢出。你的效率太低了。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.english: Riegert here with BlacJac. I'm pulling the job from you. You just aren't cutting it, performance-wise.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。抱歉，但是我将终止合约。你没能达到我们期望的水平。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe.english: This is Riegert over at BlacJac. Sorry, but I'm gonna have to cut you loose. You're just not delivering at the level we expect.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_break.chinese: 这里是黑杰克安保。我们将把你从当前的合约中踢出。我们的合约者不能有犯罪等级，所以我也无能为力。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_break.english: This is BlacJac Security. We're gonna need to pull your current contract from you. Our contractors can't have active CrimeStats, so my hands are tied.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.chinese: 这里是里格特。只是跟你说一下，你这个合约的进度非常好。如果你能够快点完成，那我就再开心不过了，继续努力吧。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.english: Riegert here. Just checking in, you're tracking really well on the contract. If we close this out quick enough, I can make happy hour, so keep it up.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特。我在这特别无聊，所以我决定看看你怎么样了。你看起来做的还不错，对吧？好像没什么其他可说的了，继续保持吧。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.english: What's up, it's Riegert. I'm bored as hell over here, so I figured I'd check in. You seem to be doing good, so yeah? not much to discuss I guess. Keep it up.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。你合约的进展很不错。只是想给你打打气，继续保持。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat.english: This is Riegert with BlacJac. You're making good progress on the contract. Just wanted to give a shout and tell you to keep it up.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克的里格特，听说你被人揍了。不管怎样，任务还得进行，所以回去继续吧。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.english: What's up. It's Riegert with BlacJac. Heard you got tuned up a bit. Anyway, mission's still a go, so get back out there.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。我很高兴看到你能重新振作起来。让我们回到那里然后把任务完成，怎么样？
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.english: This is Riegert calling from BlacJac. Glad to hear you're back on your feet. Let's get back out there and finish this contract off. Sound good?

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.chinese: 这里是黑杰克，欢迎回到生者的土地。等你完成包扎，就让我们回到那里。我们还有工作没完成。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.english: It's BlacJac calling. Welcome back to the land of the living. Once you finish getting patched up, let's get back out there. We still got a job to do.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克的里格特。等你觉得好些的时候就回去吧，我们还有工作要完成。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.english: Hey. It's Riegert over at BlacJac. Whenever you feel good enough to get back out there, we still got a job to do.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克的里格特。这可真是有惊无险，对吧？不管怎样，等你准备好的时候，我需要你回去完成这个合约。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp.english: Hey, it's Riegert calling from BlacJac. That was a close one, huh? Anyway, once you're up for it, I need you to get back out there and finish the contract.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.chinese: 这里是黑杰克，刚刚收到消息你在安保终端成功交货。干得漂亮，应该值不少钱。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.english: This is BlacJac. Just heard you made a drop at the security kiosk. Great job. Should be worth a nice chunk of creds.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特。刚刚听到你交货了，可惜它只能喂给焚化炉了。不多说了，你的报酬已经制服了。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.english: Hey, this is Riegert. Just got word of your drop. Shame it's slated for the incinerator. Anyway, sent your payment.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.chinese: 这里是里格特，刚刚看到你在安保终端交货了。现在就发送你的报酬。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal.english: Riegert here. Saw you made a drop at the kiosk. Approving the payment now.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.chinese: 这里是里格特。任务完成的不错，我正在结算你的合约并支付你的报酬。下次再找你。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.english: Riegert here. Did a good job on that mission. I'm completing your contract and sending your payment. Talk to you next time.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克安保。恭喜你完成了这个合约，这里的上级很高兴，所以我正在发送你的报酬。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.english: Hey, it's BlacJac Security. Congrats on completing that contract. Higher-ups over here are pretty pleased, so I'm sending along the credits.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。一切看起来都井井有条，正在发送你的报酬。这个合约干的不错。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.english: It's Riegert over at BlacJac. Everything seems to be in order, so I'm sending over your payment. Great job on this contract.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.chinese: 怎么样了，这里是里格特。看到你刚刚结束了合约，干得不错。我将会支付你的报酬，再次感谢你。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal.english: What's going on. It's Riegert. Saw that you just closed out your contract. Great work. I'll see you get your creds. Thanks again.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特。看起来所有的违禁品都被销毁了。干得漂亮。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.english: This is Riegert with BlacJac. Looks like all the contraband's been destroyed. Great job.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克安保。已确认所有的违法违禁品都被销毁了，感谢你的帮助。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.english: Hey. BlacJac Security calling. It's been confirmed that all the illegal packages have been destroyed. Thanks for your help.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特，所有的违禁品都被销毁了。看起来问题已经暂时解决了，谢谢。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru.english: Hey, it's Riegert. All the contraband's been destroyed. Looks like the situation's been resolved for now. Thanks.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 嘿，这里是黑杰克，你特么干嘛呢？完成你的任务。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: Hey, BlacJac calling. What the hell are you doing? Get back on mission.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 嘿，这里是里格特。看起来你偏离了任务目标，我需要你回到正轨。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: Hey, it's Riegert. Looks like you're diverting from the mission parameters. I'm gonna need you to get back on track.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 这里是黑杰克安保，我需要你现在回到任务里。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: This is BlacJac Security. I'm gonna need you to get back on mission.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特，你干嘛呢？你知道你只有完成了任务才能拿到报酬，对吧？去做我们雇你要完成的任务。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: This is Riegert with BlacJac, what are you doing? You know you're supposed to complete the contract in order to get paid, right? Do the job we hired you for.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 这里是黑杰克的里格特，我不想再催你回到任务。给我立刻完成。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: This is Riegert with BlacJac. I'm not going to tell you again to get back on mission. Do it. Now.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 嘿，这里还是里格特。我需要你回到任务，最后一次机会。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: Hey, this is Riegert again. I need you to get back on mission. Last chance.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 好吧，给我听着。我需要你现在完成我们要求你完成的任务。我不会再说第二次。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: All right, listen up. You need to finish the job we hired you to do. I'm not going to say it again.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 这是你的最后一次警告。回去并完成之前说过的任务，我已经没那么多耐心了。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: This is your final warning. Get back on task and finish the mission as described. I'm running out of patience.

pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.chinese: 嘿，别瞎搞了。完成你的任务，这是你最后的机会。
pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab.english: Hey. Stop screwing around and finish the job. This is your last chance.

pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_001_imalittle,p.english: I'm a little busy at the moment.

pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_002_itsnota,p.chinese: 现在不是聊天的好时机。
pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_002_itsnota,p.english: It's not a great time to talk.

pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_003_sorryikinda,p.english: Sorry, I kinda have to focus here.

pu_admin1_sk_calmdown_ig_001_takeabreath.english: Take a breath and calm down.

pu_admin1_sk_calmdown_ig_002_thinkfora,p.chinese: 想清楚，你不会真想这么干的。
pu_admin1_sk_calmdown_ig_002_thinkfora,p.english: Think for a second. You don't want to do this.

pu_admin1_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_youdhaveto,.english: You'd have to ask someone else.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_you.chinese: 你该去货运终端那儿看看。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_you.english: You should go check the cargo terminal.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_car.chinese: 货运终端能解决你的问题。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_car.english: Cargo terminal should sort you out.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_ify.chinese: 要是需要货运方面的帮助，我建议你去试试终端。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_ify.english: If you need help with cargo, I'd suggest trying the terminal.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_a.chinese: 所有和载具有关的事都归终端管。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_a.english: All vehicle-related issues are handled by the terminal.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.chinese: 如果需要载具，你应该去 ASOP 终端看看。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.english: If you need a vehicle, you should check out the ASOP terminal.

pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_s.chinese: 抱歉，我帮不上忙。去载具终端看看吧。
pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_s.english: Sorry, I can't help you. Have a look at the vehicle terminal.

pu_admin1_sk_offerhelp_ig_002_somethingi.english: Something I can help you with?

pu_admin1_sk_offerhelp_ig_003_whatcani,p.english: What can I do for you?

pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_a.chinese: 又是天堂般的一天，对吧？

pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_t.chinese: 有趣的是这工作看着比实际无聊多了。
pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_t.english: The funny thing is it looks a lot more boring than it is.

pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_m.chinese: 可能看起来不怎么样，但我们这儿有些相当有意思的突破。说不定很快你就能听说了...
pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_m.english: Might not look like much, but we've had some pretty interesting breakthroughs here. You might be hearing about them someday real soon...

pu_admin1_sk_requesttoleave_ig_001_imsor.english: I'm sorry, but you have to leave.

pu_admin1_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_hones.chinese: 老实说，你现在不能待在这儿。
pu_admin1_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_hones.english: Honestly, you can't be here right now.

pu_admin2_sk_busy_ig_001_sorrycantreally.english: Sorry, can't really talk right now.

pu_admin2_sk_busy_ig_003_dontreallyhave,.english: I don't really have time to talk.

pu_admin2_sk_calmdown_ig_001_imgonnaneed.english: I'm gonna need you to calm down.

pu_admin2_sk_calmdown_ig_002_youseemlike.chinese: 你看起来有点激动，先深呼吸冷静会儿吧。
pu_admin2_sk_calmdown_ig_002_youseemlike.english: You seem like you're getting agitated. Maybe, take a second and breathe.

pu_admin2_sk_calmdown_ig_003_youneedto,p.chinese: 你需要冷静下来，好好想想自己在做什么。
pu_admin2_sk_calmdown_ig_003_youneedto,p.english: You need to relax and think about what you're doing.

pu_admin2_sk_denyhelp_ig_001_imnotreally.english: I'm not really the one you should be asking.

pu_admin2_sk_denyhelp_ig_002_youregoingt.english: You're going have to find someone else to help you.

pu_admin2_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_thatisntmy,.chinese: 这不归我管。不过祝你好运。
pu_admin2_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_thatisntmy,.english: That isn't my department. Good luck though.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_the.chinese: 那边有个货运终端应该能解决你的问题。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_the.english: There's a cargo terminal over there that should sort you out.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_for.chinese: 任何和货运相关的事，终端都是最佳选择。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_for.english: For anything cargo related, the terminal's your best bet.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_ify.chinese: 要是来办货运的，那边那个终端就是你要找的。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_ify.english: If you're here for cargo, that terminal over there is what you want.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_i.chinese: 找载具终端的话，就在那边。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_i.english: If you're looking for the vehicle terminal, it's right over there.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.chinese: 需要载具终端的话，那边就有一个可以用。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.english: If you need the vehicle terminal, there's one that way you can use.

pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_o.chinese: 哦，载具的事？可以用那边的终端。
pu_admin2_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_o.english: Oh, vehicle stuff? You can use the terminal there.

pu_admin2_sk_offerhelp_ig_003_anythingic.chinese: 有什么我能帮上忙的吗？
pu_admin2_sk_offerhelp_ig_003_anythingic.english: Anything that you need help with?

pu_admin2_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_n.chinese: 不是抱怨，但有时候我真想干点别的什么工作。
pu_admin2_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_n.english: Not to complain, but sometimes I think I'd rather be doing anything else than this job.

pu_admin2_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_y.chinese: 你真该看看上周这儿有多忙，连喘口气的功夫都没有。
pu_admin2_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_y.english: You should have seen how busy it was here last week. Couldn't even take a break.

pu_admin2_sk_requesttoleave_ig_001_thats.english: That's it, you got to leave.

pu_admin2_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_enoug.english: Enough. You need to leave right now.

pu_admin2_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_noica.chinese: 不行，我受够了。你现在立刻给我走。
pu_admin2_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_noica.english: No, I can't take anymore of this crap. You've gotta go right now.

pu_admin3_sk_busy_ig_001_iminthe,p.english: I'm in the middle of something.

pu_admin3_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_you.chinese: 你要找货运终端，就在那边。
pu_admin3_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_you.english: You're looking for the Cargo Terminal. It's over there.

pu_admin3_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_che.chinese: 去看看货运终端，应该能解决你的问题。
pu_admin3_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_che.english: Check the Cargo Terminal. That should sort you out.

pu_admin3_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_y.english: You're looking for the Vehicle Terminal.

pu_admin3_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_t.chinese: 载具终端应该能处理这个。
pu_admin3_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_t.english: The Vehicle Terminal should handle that.

pu_admin3_sk_offerhelp_ig_001_somethingi.english: Something I can help you with?

pu_admin3_sk_offerhelp_ig_002_whatcani,p.english: What can I do for you?

pu_admin3_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_i.english: I don't know. Same as any other day, I guess.

pu_admin3_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_i.chinese: 还行吧。反正这活儿也没什么刺激的。又没人拿我当主角拍剧。
pu_admin3_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_i.english: It's fine. It's not like this is a really exciting job or anything. They aren't making spectrum shows about what I do.

pu_admin3_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_getth.english: Get the hell out of here.

pu_admin4_sk_busy_ig_001_sorryimnot,p.english: Sorry, I'm not supposed to a break yet.

pu_admin4_sk_busy_ig_003_donthavetime,p.english: Don't have time to talk right now.

pu_admin4_sk_calmdown_ig_002_lookjustcal.english: Look. Just calm down. Everything's fine.

pu_admin4_sk_calmdown_ig_003_heyitsokay,.chinese: 嘿，没事的，深呼吸，慢慢来。
pu_admin4_sk_calmdown_ig_003_heyitsokay,.english: Hey, it's okay. Deep breath. Nice and easy.

pu_admin4_sk_denyhelp_ig_001_wishicould,.chinese: 我也想帮你，但真不行，抱歉抱歉。
pu_admin4_sk_denyhelp_ig_001_wishicould,.english: Wish I could help you, but I can't. Sorry.

pu_admin4_sk_denyhelp_ig_002_imnotreally.english: I'm not really supposed to deal with this kind of stuff.

pu_admin4_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_ifyouneed,p.english: If you need help, I'm not the one to ask.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_the.chinese: 你要找的应该是那边的货运终端。
pu_admin4_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_the.english: The cargo terminal over there is probably what you're looking for.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_for.chinese: 货运相关的事，试试那个终端。
pu_admin4_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_for.english: For cargo stuff, try that terminal.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_car.english: Cargo? It's that terminal over there.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_t.chinese: 载具终端就在那边，随便用。
pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_t.english: The vehicle terminal is right that way. You're welcome to use it.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.chinese: 要用载具终端的话，那边那个就能用。
pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.english: If you need the vehicle terminal, you can use the one over there.

pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_f.chinese: 载具相关操作，用右手边那个终端就行。
pu_admin4_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_f.english: For vehicle stuff, try accessing the terminal right over there.

pu_admin4_sk_offerhelp_ig_003_anythingth.english: Anything that you need help with?

pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_w.chinese: 刚干这行时我以为...算了，跟我想的完全不一样。
pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_w.english: When I first took this job I thought it would be... well let's just say this isn't what I expected.

pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_t.chinese: 这工作就一个好处，一般没人来烦我。
pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_t.english: There is one great part about this job. Usually people don't try to bother me.

pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_i.chinese: 这班什么时候才能下啊...
pu_admin4_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_i.english: I cannot wait for this shift to be over.

pu_admin4_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_ineed.english: I need you to leave the premises.

pu_admin4_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_okayi.chinese: 听着，你现在必须马上离开。
pu_admin4_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_okayi.english: Okay, you need to get of here, right now.

pu_admin5_sk_busy_ig_001_couldyougive,p.english: Could you give me a second?

pu_admin5_sk_busy_ig_002_sorryima,p.chinese: 抱歉，我现在有点忙不过来。
pu_admin5_sk_busy_ig_002_sorryima,p.english: Sorry, I'm a little swamped right now.

pu_admin5_sk_busy_ig_003_ijustneed,p.chinese: 再给我几分钟就能处理完。
pu_admin5_sk_busy_ig_003_ijustneed,p.english: I just need a couple minutes to clear this up.

pu_admin5_sk_calmdown_ig_002_imgoingto,p.english: I'm going to need you to calm down.

pu_admin5_sk_calmdown_ig_003_imsorrybut,.chinese: 抱歉，但你能不能先放松一下？
pu_admin5_sk_calmdown_ig_003_imsorrybut,.english: I'm sorry, but can you just relax?

pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_001_yeahsorryi,.chinese: 呃抱歉，这个我真帮不上忙。
pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_001_yeahsorryi,.english: Yeah, sorry, I can't really help you.

pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_002_thatsnotrea.chinese: 这不是我负责的范围，懂吧？
pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_002_thatsnotrea.english: That's not really my thing, you know?

pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_idloveto,p.chinese: 我很想帮忙，真的，但是...没办法。
pu_admin5_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_idloveto,p.english: I'd love to help, I would, but I... can't.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_ohy.chinese: 哦对，你要找的是货运终端。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_ohy.english: Oh, yes. You're looking for the Cargo Terminal.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_act.chinese: 其实这事不归我管，货运终端那边能处理这类事情。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_act.english: Actually, I don't handle that sort of thing. The Cargo Terminal usually tackles that stuff.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_sor.chinese: 不好意思，我觉得你需要的是货运终端，那个能能帮到你到你。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_sor.english: Sorry, yeah, I think you want the Cargo Terminal. That should help you.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_a.chinese: 啊，如果是找载具的话，那边有个载具终端。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_a.english: Ah. If you're looking for vehicles, you should go to the Vehicle Terminal there.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.chinese: 抱歉我没权限安排载具运输，那边有专门的终端处理这个。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i.english: I'm afraid I'm not cleared to coordinate vehicle deliveries. There's a terminal for that.

pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_w.chinese: 你要的东西就在那边，载具终端能解决你的问题。
pu_admin5_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_w.english: What you want is right over there. The vehicle terminal. That can help you out.

pu_admin5_sk_offerhelp_ig_002_somethingi.english: Something I can do for you?

pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_s.chinese: 有人说这工作无聊，我倒觉得挺有挑战性的。
pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_001_s.english: Some people think this job's boring. Not me. I like the challenge.

pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_y.chinese: 其实我现在手头有一大堆重要任务，当管理员这段时间可刺激了。
pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_y.english: Yeah, well, I'm actually juggling a lot of really important tasks right now. Let's just say it's a pretty exciting time to be an administrator.

pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_w.chinese: 今早有点小感冒，不过我吞了好几包维生素。现在整个人整个人都是维生素味，你懂的。
pu_admin5_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_w.english: We've had a little bit of a cold spell this morning, but I had several packets of vitamin supplements. I'm all vitamin-ed out, if you get me.

pu_admin5_sk_requesttoleave_ig_001_excus.english: Excuse me? Excuse me. You have to leave.

pu_admin5_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_pardo.chinese: 抱歉，你必须走了。我不会再说第二遍。
pu_admin5_sk_requesttoleave_ig_002_pardo.english: Pardon me. You have to go. I will not repeat myself.

pu_admin5_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_imsor.chinese: 很抱歉，但我懒得客气了。请你立刻离开。
pu_admin5_sk_requesttoleave_ig_003_imsor.english: I'm sorry, but I'm tired of asking nicely. You need to leave.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_crimi.chinese: 谢谢你的帮助，但由于你活跃的犯罪记录，海军可能会认为你和异种威胁是一伙的。要么先搞定你的通缉等级，要么风险自担。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_crimi.english: Thanks for stepping up, but with your active crime stat, the Navy might think you're allied with XenoThreat. Either take care of that or take your chances.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 大家好，我是特别探员杜丽。很高兴你们能回来帮助我们，我会把详细信息发给你们。杜丽通话完毕。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Hey there, Special Agent Dulli here. Glad you're able to come back and help out. I'll send you the details. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 这里是杜丽。看到你刚刚接受了任务，对于新兵来说有民防部队的老面孔总是个好事情。我们到时候见。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Dulli here. Saw you just accepted the mission. Having CDF regulars out there is always good for the new recruits. I'll see you out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 这里是杜丽。很高兴看到民防部队的老面孔能伸出援手，我会把任务详情发给你把你带过去。再次感谢。杜丽通话完毕。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: This is Dulli. Always good to see a CDF regular lending a hand. I'll send the mission details over so we can get you out there. Thanks again. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 这里是特别探员杜丽。感谢你的再次参与，我会把行动详情发给你。杜丽通话完毕。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Special Agent Dulli here. Thanks for signing up again. I'm sending over the details for the op now. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 你好，我是杜丽。很高兴看到你回来，我会把任务详情发给你，但是你要习惯这种事情是如何运作的。通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Hey, Dulli here. Glad to have you back. I'll get you the details for the mission, but you should be used to how this is gonna operate. Out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 你好，这里是特别探员杜丽。很高兴看到你再次加入民防部队。我把详情发给你了，可以开始行动了。祝你好运。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Hey, it's Special Agent Dulli. Glad to see you're joining the CDF again. I've sent over the op details to get you started. Good luck out there. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 你好，这里是杜丽。我们需要最厉害的人去做这件事，很高兴你能来帮忙。我会把详情发给你。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Hey there,it's Dulli. We need our best out there so I'm glad you're able to help out. I'll send you the details. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 感谢帮助，这就把详细信息发过去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Appreciate the help. I'm sending the details now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 很高兴你能来，民防部队需要我们能找到的所有志愿者，正在发送详细信息。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Excellent to have you onboard. CDF needs all the volunteers we can get. Sending the details over.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.chinese: 民事防御部队很高兴得到你的帮助，飞行员，正在给你发送任务信息。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_resup.english: Civilian Defense Force is glad to have your help, pilot. Sending info on the op now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 感谢你的志愿参与，尽快赶往前线，他们肯定需要你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: Thanks for volunteering. Head to the front line ASAP. They'll definitely need your help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 感谢您的协助，迎战去吧， 他们需要你的帮助
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: Thanks for the assist. Head out to the fight. They need your help

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 详细信息已发送，登上你的飞船并准备战斗。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: Sent you the details. Grab your ship and get ready for a fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 感谢你的帮助，登船然后出发赶往前线吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: Thanks for your help. Grab your ship and get on site.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 我是民防部队的杜丽。你应该知道，异种威胁在击败海军之后只会变得更加强大，所以你要小心行事。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: This is Dulli with the CDF. You should know, XenoThreat's only gotten stronger since they overran the Navy, so be careful. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 这里是杜丽；感谢你自愿参加。我们把异种威胁击退了，往前线去吧。我等会儿再联系你。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: This is Dulli. Thanks for volunteering. We got them on the run now so head out to the front. I'll talk to you later. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 这里是杜丽，感谢你的报名。我们就快把异种威胁击垮了。任务详情已发送，请尽快赶到。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: Dulli here. Thanks for signing up. We got XenoThreat on the ropes now. Sent you the mission details so head on out as soon as you can. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.chinese: 这里是民防部队特别代理人杜丽； 由于我们激烈的进攻，异种威胁全数的枪弹火炮也正在向我方倾泻，所以注意安全，祝你好运。杜丽通话结束。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_showd.english: This is SA Dulli with the CDF. With this heavy push on XenoThreat, they're unleashing their full arsenal at us, so watch your back. Good luck. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.chinese: 标枪已就位，准备出航。可能得先消除一些异种威胁的敌人。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.english: Javelin's all stocked up and heading out. Might take out a few XenoThreat as it does.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.chinese: 标枪已驶离杰里科港，路上会顺手帮一下那些掉队的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.english: Javelin's disengaged from Jericho and might lend a hand with the stragglers.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.chinese: 标枪已出港，准备与异种威胁交战。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_departure_fla.english: Javelin's clear from the station and ready to engage XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 护卫队刚刚投放了他们的物资，感谢你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Convoy just dropped off their supplies. Thanks for your help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 如果没有民防部队的帮助，那艘补给船是不可能成功的，做得很好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Don't think that supply ship would have made it without CDF help. Nicely done.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 护卫队对你的帮助表示感谢。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Convoy wanted to send along their thanks for your help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 我想转达一下补给船船员的感谢之情，他们说，如果没有民防部队，任务永远不会成功。这是值得骄傲的事情。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Wanted to pass along the thanks of the supply ship crew. They said they never would have made it if it weren't for the CDF. Something to be proud of.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 海军刚发了一份通讯报告说补给船已成功抵达杰里科。谢谢你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Navy just sent a comm to say that the supply ship just made the drop at Jericho. Thanks for the help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 收到补给船安全通过的确认，民防部队需要更多像你这样的飞行员。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Received confirmation that the supply ship made it through safely. CDF could use more pilots like you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.chinese: 感谢对补给船的护航。如果没有你他们应该惨遭异种威胁的毒手了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_suppl.english: Thanks for seeing to it that the supply ship made it through. XenoThreat would have gotten them for sure if it wasn't for you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_comba.chinese: 注意： 民防部队需要所有能帮忙的战斗飞行员来对抗异种威胁。请联系我了解详情。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_comba.english: Attention. The CDF needs all available combat pilots to fight XenoThreat. Contact me for details.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_comba.chinese: 民防部队急需战斗飞行员前往抵抗异种威胁。我们在此支援海军，请尽快提供帮助！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_comba.english: CDF needs combat pilots for immediate deployment against XenoThreat. We're backing up the Navy here, so reach out as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 海军刚通知我一直支援船队在来杰里科路途中遭到伏击。我需要任何可用的民防部队成员提供支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Navy just notified me that a supply convoy just got ambushed en route to Jericho. I need any CDF to support.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 异种威胁刚刚突袭了海军的补给舰队。急需战斗支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: XenoThreat just jumped a Navy supply convoy. Need combat support scrambled immediately.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 一支补给舰队刚才被异种威胁攻击了。我需要任何战斗飞行员的支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: A supply convoy just got attacked by XenoThreat forces. I need any available combat support to help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 民防部队的战斗飞行员请注意，海军的一支补给舰队需要护航支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Any available CDF combat pilots, the Navy needs assistance protecting one of their supply convoys.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 异种威胁刚攻击了一支海军舰队。我需要战斗飞行员前去帮他们脱困。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: XenoThreat just hit a Navy convoy. I need any available combat pilots to go help them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 一支海军补给舰队在前往杰里科的途中遇袭。需要战斗飞行员前去支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: One of the Navy's supply convoys got ambushed on a run to Jericho. Any combat pilots are requested to help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 一支海军舰队在前往杰里科的途中遭到袭击。我需要战斗飞行员尽快赶去支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: A Naval convoy just got attacked while heading to Jericho. I need combat fighters scrambled there ASAP.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 又有更多补给船被拦截了。我们需要战斗支援前去帮他们脱困。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Some more supply ships got jumped. We need combat support to get out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 海军刚刚告诉我又有其他补给船遭到伏击。快前往那里帮他们脱困。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Navy just let me know there's another supply shipment just got ambushed. Get out there and help them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 又有一艘补给船要前往杰里科，我想它需要一些护航支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Got another supply ship headed towards Jericho that could use some protection.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 海军刚刚路过另一艘被伏击的补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Navy passed over another supply ship that's been ambushed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 另一艘补给船遭受攻击。我需要战斗支援前去帮助他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Another Navy supply shipment is under attack. I need combat support to help them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 异种威胁刚才偷袭了一些海军补给船。紧急派出战斗支援！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: XenoThreat just ambushed some Navy supply ships. Scrambling combat support to help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.chinese: 需要战斗人员紧急前往支援在杰里科入港的补给船。他们刚刚遭受到异种威胁的伏击。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_prote.english: Need fighters scrambled to support some supply ships inbound to Jericho. They just got ambushed by XenoThreat and need help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.chinese: 海军正在奋力抵抗异种威胁并请求民防部队的支援。我们需要所有战斗飞行员的加入。请联系我获取详情。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.english: The Navy's making a push against XenoThreat and has requested CDF support. We need any and all combat pilots to volunteer. Contact me for details.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.chinese: 我需要所有可战斗的民防部队成员前来报到。海军正在奋力抵抗异种威胁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.english: I need any available CDF recruits to report for duty. The Navy's making a push against XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.chinese: 我需要所有民防部队的成员立刻前来报到。海军需要更多支援来铲除异种威胁。公民们，此诚危急存亡之秋也。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.english: I need all CDF combat pilots to report for duty. Navy needs some backup taking out XenoThreat. Moment of truth, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.chinese: 面对愈发严重异种威胁，海军需要一切来自民防部队的支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.english: Due to increased XenoThreat activity, the Navy is requesting support from any available CDF recruits.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.chinese: 全斯坦顿星系请注意。民防部队急需战斗和货物运输志愿者来协助海军的战斗。请联系我获取详情。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_mission_showd.english: Attention, Stanton. CDF needs combat and cargo retrieval volunteers to assist the Navy. Reach out for details.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.chinese: 好了各位，已经找到九尾的转换器了。关掉它，重置限制空域。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.english: All right, people. The Nine Tails inverter has been located. Let's get it shut down and reset the restricted airspace.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.chinese: 我们发现九尾藏匿转换器的地点了，请尽快关掉它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.english: We got the location of where the Nine Tails hid their inverter. I want it shut down ASAP.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.chinese: 九尾指挥官已经被消灭。他身上应该有我们需要的访问密码。搜一下尸体找找有没有。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.english: The Nine Tails commander has been neutralized. He should have the access codes we need on him. Search the body and see if you can find them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.chinese: 门多·雷恩已经被消灭。我们认为他身上有我们需要的访问密码。搜一下尸体看看有什么发现。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_missionobj_ba.english: Mendo Ren has been eliminated. We believe that he was carrying the access codes we need on his person. Search the body and see what you can find.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.chinese: 标枪受损严重！海军正在把它从战场撤离出来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.english: The Javelin's taken too much damage. Navy's getting it the hell out of here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.chinese: 海军正在撤离那艘严重受损的标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.english: Navy's pulling the Javelin out. It's taken too much damage

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.chinese: 刚刚收到消息，标枪正在撤离。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.english: Just got word. The Javelin's getting pulled.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.chinese: 标枪正在撤离，他们遭受的火力太猛烈了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.english: Javelin's on the move. They're taking too much fire.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.chinese: 刚刚收到消息，标枪快撑不住了，已下达撤退命令。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_retreat_resup.english: Got word. The Javelin can't hold out any longer. A retreat's been ordered.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.chinese: 那艘伊德里斯现随时会袭击杰里科。我们得集结支援力量前去战斗，帮他们一把。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.english: That Idris should hit Jericho any second now. Let's get that support inbound and lend a hand.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.chinese: 异种威胁已经逼近杰里科，做好战斗准备。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.english: XenoThreat's moments away from Jericho. Get ready for a fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.chinese: 异种威胁兵临城下，我需要战斗支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.english: XenoThreat is almost on site. I need that combat support.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.chinese: 我们扫描到异种威胁正快速逼近，随时准备战斗。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.english: Scans are showing that XenoThreat are closing in fast. Could be any moment now. Be ready.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.chinese: 敌方伊德里斯正迅速接近。准备战斗，公民们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_alm.english: Enemy Idris incoming fast. Ready up, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.chinese: 呼叫！呼叫！发现异种威胁伊德里斯！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.english: Contact. Contact. XenoThreat Idris is on site.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.chinese: 目视确认敌方伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.english: Got eyes on the hostile Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.chinese: 异种的伊德里斯已入场，准备攻击。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.english: XenoThreat's on site and ready to throw down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.chinese: 敌方伊德里斯已抵达。开火。
异种威胁已在杰里科驶出量子航行。自由开火！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_atd.english: XenoThreat came out of QT at Jericho. Weapons free y'all.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.chinese: 敌方主力舰仍将前往INS 杰里科军港，我需要所有战斗力量尽快赶到这里。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.english: Hostile capship is still inbound to INS Jericho. I need all combat support to get there ASAP.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.chinese: 已确认一艘敌方主力舰正驶向杰里科港。全体支援部队请注意，请尽快赶往那里！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.english: Confirmed. We still got a XenoThreat capship burning towards Jericho station. All combat support, get there as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.chinese: 异种威胁的主力舰正在逼近，所有人迅速行动！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.english: That XenoThreat capship's getting closer. Get a move on, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.chinese: 赶紧！那艘异种威胁的伊德里斯可能几分钟后就会抵达杰里科港。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.english: Let's get a move on. That XenoThreat Idris is probably a couple minutes out from Jericho station.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.chinese: 异种威胁仍在接近杰里科港。请立即赶去那里！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_announce_xenoidris_get.english: XenoThreat is still en route to Jericho station. Get there as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.chinese: 提醒你一下，那个平台的防空设施已经解决了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.english: Just wanted to give you a head's up, that platform's anti-air's been taken down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.chinese: 嘿，以防你有疑问。告知你一下，那个平台的防空设施已经关闭了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.english: Hey, in case you were wondering, that platform's anti-air defenses are deactivated.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.chinese: 你应该可以安全靠近那个平台了，那儿上面的防空设备已经没了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_aainactive_si.english: You should be good to approach that platform, there aren't any active anti-air.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.chinese: 这个平台已经安全了，可以整顿一下然后前往下一个被占领的平台。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.english: This platform's secure, so do whatever you gotta do here and move onto the ones that aren't secure.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.chinese: 这个平台已经搞定了，如果没有别的急事，就快前往下一个被占的平台吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.english: We're all set with this platform, so unless you have pressing business here, I'd get to one of the unsecured platforms.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.chinese: 这个平台已经安全了，抓紧前往下一个平台解救它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemycleared_.english: This platform has been secured, so make your way to the next island and help clear that.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemypresent_.chinese: 我们已经解决了副官并关闭防空设备，现在只需要扫清平台上九尾的残余势力。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemypresent_.english: We've taken out the lieutenant and shut down the anti-air, now we just need to mop up any Nine Tails still on the platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemypresent_.chinese: 我们已经快要完全夺回这个平台了，只剩把那些残余九尾人员清理干净了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_enemypresent_.english: We've managed to nearly secure this platform, all that's left is to sweep through and engage any remaining Nine Tails.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.chinese: 这个平台上的中尉和防空导弹都已解决，你应该可以前往下一个平台了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.english: The lieutenant and anti-air on this platform have both been taken care of. You should be good to move onto the next one.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.chinese: 这个平台的中尉已被消灭，防空系统也已恢复正常，你们可以继续前进。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.english: This platform's lieutenant has been neutralized and the anti-air secured, so you can move on.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.chinese: 防空武器和中尉被解决了，这个平台已经没什么可做的了。继续前进，进入下一个行动区域。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionarea_s.english: With the anti-air secure and the Lieutenant dealt with, there's not much left to do on the platform. Go ahead and move onto one of the active areas.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.chinese: 我们盯着指挥官呢，给我把门多·雷恩解决了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.english: We got eyes on the Commander. I want Mendo Ren taken out!

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.chinese: 那里！门多·雷恩！我就知道我们能把他引出来。现在就剩搞定他然后拿到密码了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.english: There! Mendo Ren! I knew we'd draw him out. Now let's put him down and get those codes.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.chinese: 看来我们的计划成功了。他们的指挥官出现在驳船上了，干掉门多·雷恩我们就能关闭转换器。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ba.english: Looks like our strategey worked. The commander is out on the barge. We take out Mendo Ren and we can shut down the inverter.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ha.chinese: 那个九尾副官是诺兰·阿克，档案里显示他是具有丰富战斗经验的前安保人员，一定要小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_ha.english: That Nine Tails lieutenant is Nolan Acker. File says he's a former security officer with extensive combat experience, so watch yourself out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_me.chinese: 查到身份了，那是德温·马库斯，因为炸死他的采矿船员在奥丁星系被通缉了。一直在逃中，那之后还追加了不少通缉令。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_me.english: Got an ID. That's Devin Marcus. Guy's wanted in Odin system for blowing up his mining crew. Been on the run and got multiple warrants after that.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_si.chinese: 那人一定是他们在这个平台指挥的副官。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_si.english: That must be their lieutenant for this platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_si.chinese: 已确认那就是我们在找的九尾副官。可以行动了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_si.english: Got confirmation that's the Nine Tail lieutenant we're looking for. You're clear to engage.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.chinese: 看来你快到杰里科了。要想更快地卸载物资，请使用终端，军需官会帮你卸载货物的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.english: Looks like you're almost at Jericho. To get any supplies you have unloaded faster, use one of the kiosks and the Quartermaster will offload the cargo for you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.chinese: 杰里科站的军需官要求你们使用终端，这样他们就能更快地卸下这些物资。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.english: The Quartermaster of Jericho station requested you use the kiosks so they can get those supplies unloaded faster.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.chinese: 我看到你正在接近杰里科，所以我想通知你们，军需官要求你们使用终端卸货。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_missionobj_wi.english: I see you're approaching Jericho, so I wanted to inform you that the Quartermaster requested you use the kiosks to unload your cargo.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_nfzactive_sie.chinese: 这个平台已经基本清理干净了，剩下我们只需要逆转限制空域阻止他们的增援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_nfzactive_sie.english: This platform has mostly been cleared out, we just need to reverse the Restricted Air to stop them from reinforcing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_nfzactive_sie.chinese: 已经解决副官了，只要限制空域恢复为十字军拥有你在这个平台的任务就结束了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_nfzactive_sie.english: The lieutenant's been handled, so you don't have anything to do on this platform until the Restricted Air is returned to Crusader.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.chinese: 队员们还未找出九尾副官。他们一旦出现就需要你消灭他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.english: Operatives haven't been able to draw out the Nine Tails lieutenant yet. Once they show up, you'll need to neutralize them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.chinese: 有一个九尾副官在这个平台，如果我们想引出指挥官关掉转换器，就得先解决他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.english: There's a Nine Tails lieutenant on this platform. If we want to draw out the commander and shut down the inverter, we need to deal with them first.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.chinese: 那个平台的副官还活奔乱跳的呢，干掉他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.english: That platform's lieutenant is still at large. Take them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.chinese: 九尾副官还活跃在这个平台，消灭他们我们才能引出指挥官。
