pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.english: The Nine Tails lieutenant on this platform is still active. Neutralize them so we can draw out the commander.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.chinese: 我们还在努力解决这个平台的副官。如果想关掉转换器，得先处理他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_approach_siege_minibos.english: We're still trying to take down this platform's lieutenant. We need to get them taken care of if we want to shut down the inverter.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_cancelled_mission_play.chinese: 我是杜利，我知道你要去行动区域，但这次行动马上就要结束了。谢谢你的志愿，你可以离开了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_cancelled_mission_play.english: This is Dulli. I know you're heading to the AO but the operation is going to be wrapping up soon. Thanks for volunteering anyway. You are dismissed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_cancelled_mission_sieg.chinese: 请注意，十字军正在收回这次行动的管辖权，他们要求所有民事防御部队志愿者立即撤离该区域。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_cancelled_mission_sieg.english: Attention. Crusader is reclaiming jurisidiction over this operation. They need all CDF volunteers to vacate the area immediately.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_m2s.chinese: 星际运输船是令人印象深刻的军用装备。有一架在空中是一件非常好的事情，只需要留意剩余的防空设施就好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_m2s.english: The Starlifter is an impressive piece of military hardware. Will be good to have one in the air. Just be careful engaging with any remaining AA defenses.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 好，是个好选择。你可以用那玩意对防空火力或九尾的船只造成严重伤害。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: Yeah, that's a good choice. You can do some serious damage to AA or Nine Tails ships with that thing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 战神是在战场上令人闻风丧胆的存在。这几年督导局一直想把它融入他们的突袭行动中。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: Those Ares are nasty as hell in a fight. Advocacy's been integrating them into their raids the past couple years.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 让我们把这东西飞起来来保护空域。你要小心那些防空火力。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: Let's get this thing up and helping defend the air. You'll need to be careful of any AA defenses.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 对，星际快运船会是把人转移到其他平台的好选择。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: Yeah, Star Runner could be a good choice to move some people to other platforms.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 你以前飞过吗？ 操纵推进器对我来说有点难了，但我会尽我所能的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: You ever flown one of these before? Manuevering thrusters stick a bit too much for my liking, but we'll take whatever we can get.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.chinese: 好。把那艘星际快运船开走。我们需要空中支援来转移其他特工并对付九尾和他们的防空火力。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_comment_playership_sta.english: Great. Get that Star Runner up and out. We need air support to move other operatives and take on the Nine Tails and their AA.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 标枪被打掉了一个护盾！所有人，掩护它！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: Everyone defend the Javelin. One of its shields are down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 标枪的护盾全部下线！防卫标枪！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: The Javelin's shields are down. Defend it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 标枪的一个护盾下线了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: One of the Javelin's shields just went down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 标枪护盾下线。所有船只进入防御阵型！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: Javelin shield down. All ships. Defensive positions.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 伊德里斯的护盾掉了一个，集中火力打那个缺口！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: Idris has got a shield down. Focus fire while you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 我们打掉伊德里斯一个护盾，给我使劲打！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: We got a shield down on the Idris. Hit it while you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 那伊德里斯少了个护盾。
伊德里斯的护盾下线了不少，集中火力！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: Idris lost some shields. Focus fire on it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.chinese: 他们伊德里斯被打掉一个护盾了，民防部队的队员们，把它干掉！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_lostshield.english: All CDF, the Idris lost a shield. Take it out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 请注意，这里是督导局特别探员杜丽；海军正在INS 杰里科军港交火，我们需要助力支援，立刻、马上。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Attention, this is Special Agent Dulli of the Advocacy. The Navy's taking fire at INS Jericho. We need support scrambled there immediately.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪到极限了，再这么下去我们就得换艘船了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: The Javelin's getting torn up out there. We're gonna have to displace it if it keeps taking hits.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 快去掩护标枪，再这样下去他们就得撤离了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: You need to start protecting that Javelin or they're gonna have to get out of here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 海军通报说那艘标枪要撑不住了。快去帮他们脱困！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Navy says that Javelin's barely hanging on. Get in there and help them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 那艘标枪准备撤离星系了，掩护它！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: That Javelin's about to get pulled out of the system. Defend it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 我们收到标枪的损坏报告，他们撑不了多久了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: We're getting damage reports from the Javelin. They're not going to last much longer.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 好了公民们，标枪的受损比我想象的还要严重，我们去掩护它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Okay, people, that Javelin's taking a lot more damage than I'd like. Let's protect it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 异种威胁已经在瞄准标枪了，别让他们靠近。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: XenoThreat's tagging that Javelin. Keep them off it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 海军要求防卫标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Navy's requesting some help defending the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪遭受攻击，把那些亡命之徒赶走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Javelin's taking some fire. Get those outlaws off 'em.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 这么被打下去标枪遭不住，公民们，赶快行动。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: We can't let the Javelin keep taking fire like this. Step it up people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪正在遭受攻击。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Javelin's taking fire.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪受损。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Javelin's getting chewed up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 掩护标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Help out the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 异种威胁包围标枪了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: XenoThreat's all over the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪遭到直接打击。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Direct hit on the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 快，让我们把那些异种威胁从标枪边上轰走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Come on, let's get some of those XenoThreat punks off that Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪受到攻击，搜寻敌军，收到请回复。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Javelin's taking a beating. Look out for them. Copy?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 别让异种威胁靠近标枪，标枪都着了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Try to keep XenoThreat off that Javelin. It's getting lit up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 标枪遭受几次致命打击，开始掩护！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: Javelin's been taking some heavy hits. Start protecting it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.chinese: 异种威胁开始占上风了，集中精力保护标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_fl.english: XenoThreat's starting to get the upper hand. Focus on protecting the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_na.chinese: 管好你的武器，那是一艘海军舰船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_na.english: Check your fire. That's a Navy ship.
Back off, that's a Navy ship.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_na.chinese: 停止射击！那是艘海军飞船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_na.english: Cease fire! That's a Navy ship.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.chinese: 看看你在打谁，那是个友军。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.english: Watch where you're shooting. That's a friendly.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.chinese: 那是友方目标，小心你的炮口。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.english: That's a friendly target. Watch your fire.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.chinese: 看着点，他们和你一伙的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_vehicle_pl.english: Watch it, they're on your side.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.chinese: 我觉得那东西你连个花都刮不出来，还是集中精力对付那些护航的飞船吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.english: I don't think you're gonna put a dent in that thing. Focus on the support ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.chinese: 先解决那些护航的飞船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.english: Let's take care of the support ships first.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.chinese: 攻击伊德里斯只不过是在浪费你的弹药，你自己一个人根本打不动它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.english: You're wasting ammo on the Idris. Can't take it down yourself.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.chinese: 最好在攻击伊德里斯之前先干掉护卫舰。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.english: Best to take out the support ships first before hitting the Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.chinese: 把火力都集中在支护卫舰上。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_damagedealt_xenoidris_.english: Refocus fire on the support ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.chinese: 我还在追踪敌人的援军。坚守阵地，做好准备迎接他们的到来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.english: I'm still tracking those enemy reinforcements. Just stand firm and be ready when they arrive.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.chinese: 妈的，我跟丢了那些援军。这似乎是个陷阱，我希望所有人都准备好应对突袭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.english: Damn. I lost contact with those reinforcements. This smells like a trick. I want everyone ready for a surprise attack.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.chinese: 那些异种威胁的援军来得太慢了，我希望大家坚守岗位，等待他们的到来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_delayed_vehicle_idris_.english: Those XenoThreat reinforcements are taking their sweet time getting here. I want everyone to hold their positions until they arrive.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 我们只剩下一艘船了。让它好好发挥作用吧！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: There's only one ship left. Let's make it count!

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 大家放松。我们只剩下最后一艘船了。让我们集中精力把这事搞定。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Easy everyone. We're down to our last ship. Let's focus and get this done.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 好吧，不要惊慌。我们只剩下一艘船了，但是我们可以做到的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Okay, don't panic or anything, but we only got one ship left. We can still do this.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 操，我们刚被击落了一艘飞船。好好保护好剩下的飞船，我们需要他们才能飞到中央平台。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Shit, we're down a ship. Let's see if we can take better care of the rest. We need them to be able to fly to the central platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 不妙，我们只剩下最后几艘飞船了。要是这些飞船也没了，那九尾就赢了。我希望所有飞行员打起百分之110的精神，明白吗？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Not good. Down to our last few ships. We lose these and the Nine Tails win. I want all pilots to operating at 110 percent, clear?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 拜托，伙计们。我们只剩下几艘飞船了。如果它们出现任何意外，那任务就完蛋了。懂了吗？ 加把劲。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Come on, people! We only have a handful of ships left. If anything happen to them then this mission will be over. Got that? Lets do better.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 又一艘十字军的飞船被摧毁了，不妙。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: That's another of Crusader's ships destroyed. Not good.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 我们又损失了一条征用的船。我们尽量不要再损失船了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: We've lost another of the commandeered ships. Let's try and not lose anymore.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.chinese: 我们又一艘飞船被击落了。我们需要加倍小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_missionship_.english: Another of our ships went down. We need to be more careful out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 那边还有很多敌军战斗机。去干掉他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: Still got a lot of hostile fighters out there. Let's take them out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 坚持，他们的实力已经被我们大大削弱了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: Keep at it. We're cutting down their numbers.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 还有一堆敌军等着你去击杀。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: Still plenty of hostiles to kill.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 我们正大大削弱他们的部队，他们的总体实力下降到了大概70%到75%。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: We're making progress on depleting their forces. They're down to about 70- 75% of their strength.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 差不多干掉了他们四分之一，但还是有很多异种威胁，继续攻击！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: About a quarter of their forces have been eliminated. That's still a lot of XenoThreat left. Keep going.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 差不多干掉了他们一半的部队，继续攻击！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: It's looking like XenoThreat forces are down to half strength. Keep on 'em.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 已经歼灭了一半异种威胁。继续！好样的！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: You've cut XenoThreat fighters in half. Keep it up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 我已经搞定剩下敌人的一半了。继续攻击你的目标。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: I've got half the number of hostiles remaining. Keep doing what you're doing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 差不多他们一半的人都没了，继续！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: That's about half their forces gone. Don?t let up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 敌军部队严重缺损。几乎损伤了一半了，干得漂亮！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: Enemy forces are looking severly depleted. Barely half of them left. Nice work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 剩下的异种威胁屈指可数。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: Just a handful of Xeno fighters remaining.
Getting close. Not many hostiles left.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 他们被重创了，我们来把残余势力都清理干净。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: They're hurting now. Let's clear out the rest.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 反击奏效了，我们把他们逼上绝路了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: The counteroffensive's working. We got them on the ropes.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.chinese: 他们就剩四分之一的部队了，撑不了多久。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_aall.english: There's only about a quarter of their forces left. They can't hold out much longer.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_figh.chinese: 靠！友方海军飞船被击毁了。
友方海军飞船被毁，重复，友方海军飞船被毁。
我们的一个友方被干掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_figh.english: One of ours got taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪被击毁！重复！标枪被击毁！海军正努力寻找增援部队，但需要你在这拖住异种威胁！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin's down. Repeat. The Javelin's down. Navy's scrambling to find some reinforcements, but you gotta hold XenoThreat here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪已被击毁！重复！标枪已被击毁！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin's been taken out. Repeat, the Javelin's been taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 我们的标枪被击毁了，什么玩意？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: I think we just lost the Javelin. Shit?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 请注意，异种威胁刚刚击毁了标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Be aware. XenoThreat just took out the Navy Javelin.
Goddammit. The Javelin just got blasted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 异种威胁到底是他妈地怎么干过一艘全副武装的标枪的？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: How the hell did XenoThreat take out a battle ready Javelin?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 要是异种威胁击退了全副武装的标枪，那我们就有大麻烦了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: We got a problem if XenoThreat can take on a fully stocked Javelin and win.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪刚被他们拿下了；大家小心，任何能干掉一艘全副武装的标枪的家伙都不该被轻视。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin just got taken out. Everyone watch yourself out there. Anyone that can take out a fully operational Javelin shouldn't be taken lightly.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 一艘全副武装的标枪被击毁了；别被吓尿了，我们的活还没完呢。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: That was a fully stocked Javelin that just went down. Don't lose your shit, people. We still got a job to do.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 如果他们能干掉一艘全副武装的标枪，也就代表异种威胁比我们想象的要危险得多，我们必须马上在此地阻止他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: If they can take out a fully repaired Javelin, XenoThreat's a lot more dangerous than we thought. We gotta stop them here and now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪已被击毁，我重复，标枪已被击毁；它来的时候状态都不是很好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin's down. Repeat. Javelin's down. It was barely holding together when it got here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 异种威胁拿下了标枪；它来的时候都没啥准备，大概是打了场恶仗。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: XenoThreat took out the Javelin. Considering how beat up it was when it got here, that thing put up a helluva fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪退场了；我很意外它居然能在如此激烈的火力下坚持这么久。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin's out of this. With all the damage it had taken, I'm surprised it lasted as long as it did.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 标枪被击沉了；虽然它本来就状态不佳了，但是这依然很不妙。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Javelin got taken out. It was already pretty torn up, but still, this is not good.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.chinese: 妈的。我们失去了标枪。他们根本就不该强行把那种状态的标枪送上战场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flag.english: Goddammit. We lost the Javelin. They never should've sent it to fight in the condition it was in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_guns.chinese: 敌军的炮艇被击落了，干得好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_guns.english: Enemy Gunship has been taken out. Great job.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_guns.chinese: 异种威胁的炮艇被干掉了。
异种威胁的炮艇完蛋了，打得好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_guns.english: That XenoThreat gunship's done for. Good kill.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_guns.chinese: 搞定一艘异种威胁的炮艇。
那艘炮艇已经见鬼去了。
异种威胁炮艇被消灭了。

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.chinese: 我们的锤头鲨被击毁了。
海军锤头鲨刚刚被打掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.english: Navy Hammerhead just got punched out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.chinese: 海军失去了一艘锤头鲨。
锤头鲨被毁！重复！锤头鲨被毁！
异种威胁刚刚拿下了咱们一艘锤头鲨。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.english: XenoThreat just took out an Hammerhead.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.chinese: 友方锤头鲨刚刚被击落。
我们的一艘锤头鲨刚刚离我们而去了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_hamm.english: One of our Hammerheads got ghosted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 异种威胁的伊德里斯被摧毁了，大家干得漂...等等！等等！发现更多目标！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: XenoThreat Idris destroyed. Great job everyb- hold up, hold up! Got more contacts coming in hot.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 异种威胁的伊德里斯被摧毁了，大家辛...等下！发现敌军！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Idris down! Helluva job, people! Now all we [gotta do]?.... Contact. Contact. Got hostiles inbound.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 异种威胁的主力舰已被摧毁，这下它们完...？等下！好家伙，确认了，来了更多敌人！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Capship destroyed, XenoThreat's gonna have to?. Wait. Yeah, confirmed. Got more hostiles incoming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 这伊德里斯打得不错！等等，发现更多目标。而且看起来来者不善啊。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Great job taking out that Idris? hold up. Got contacts inbound. Don't look friendly.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 这伊德里斯打得不错，但我们还有个麻烦。看样子他们又来不少人，保持警惕！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: That's a good kill on that Idris. We got a problem though. Looks like they have some buddies inbound. Look sharp.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 打的漂亮！那是最后一艘伊德里斯！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Great job. That was the last Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 看来他们的主力舰就这些了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Looks like that's all their capships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 最后一艘伊德里斯被解决了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Last Idris has been taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 就这了，这是他们所有的主力舰。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: That's it. That's all of their capships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 所有伊德里斯已击毁！重复！所有伊德里斯已击毁！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: All Idris' destroyed. Repeat. All Idris' destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 第一艘异种伊德里斯已被击毁！重复！第一艘异种伊德里斯已被击毁！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: First XenoThreat Idris has been destroyed. Repeat. First Idris destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 我们干掉了第一艘伊德里斯。继续努力！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Got our first Idris down. Keep it up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 搞定一艘伊德里斯。加大力度！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: There's an Idris down. Let's keep up the pressure.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 斩获第一艘伊德里斯！不过前路漫漫仍需努力。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Bagged our first Idris. Still got some work to do though.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 打掉第一艘伊德里斯，继续打！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: First Idris ghosted. Let's keep hitting them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 又干掉一艘伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: That's another Idris down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 另一艘伊德里斯被干掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Another Idris just got ghosted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 异种威胁的伊德里斯被干掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: XenoThreat Idris has been destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 敌方伊德里斯已被消灭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Hostile Idris has been taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 看来有人把那异种的伊德里斯给解决了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Looks like someone poached a XenoThreat Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 已消灭异种威胁伊德里斯。重复。已消灭异种威胁伊德里斯。做得很好！各位！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: XenoThreat Idris is down. Repeat. XenoThreat Idris is down. Helluva job everyone.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 成功了！异种威胁的伊德里斯被干掉了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: We did it. XenoThreat Idris is down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 棒极了！伊德里斯已毁！重复。伊德里斯已毁！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: That's it! Idris is destroyed! Repeat. XenoThreat Idris has been dusted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 敌方主力舰被击毁。干得漂亮朋友们！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Enemy capship down. Helluva job, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 好极了，异种威胁伊德里斯已被消灭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: That was it. XenoThreat idris destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 海军报告损失一艘伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Navy report that they lost an Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 我操...异种威胁刚摧毁了一艘伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Oh shit... XenoThreat blew up an Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 海军伊德里斯被击毁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: Navy Idris is down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 我们损失了一艘伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: We lost an idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.chinese: 他们干掉了我们的伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_idri.english: They just took out of our Idrises.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_play.chinese: 提醒一下，该地区似乎有第三方在攻击民事防御部队的飞船，请留意。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_play.english: Word of warning, we seem to have a third party in the area attacking CDF ships. Keep an eye out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_play.chinese: 注意，我们收到报告说有无从属组织的飞船正在攻击民防部队的志愿者，小心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_play.english: Heads up. We're getting reports that unaffiliated ships are attacking CDF volunteers. Be careful.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_destroyed_vehicle_prot.english: That's what I like to see.
One less XenoThreat to worry about.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.chinese: 标枪想知道他们的护航在哪，快走吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.english: The Javelin is wondering where their protection detail is. Get going.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.chinese: 标枪现在是重点目标，在它跳走之前尽力保护它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.english: The Javelin is the priority right now. Go and protect them until they've jumped.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.chinese: 我需要你们和标枪待在一起，做它的后盾，直到他们量子走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_p.english: I need you to stay with the Javelin. Watch their back until they QT.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.chinese: 你需要在那个传输完成之前停掉它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.english: You need to stop that transfer before it finishes.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.chinese: 快！看看你是否能找到一种方法停止传输。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.english: Quick. See if you can figure out a way to halt the transfer.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.chinese: 继续，看看能不能在九尾覆盖权限之前完成它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_encourage_missionobj_s.english: Go ahead and try to stop the Nine Tails override before it completes.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_resu.chinese: 这片是你的作战区域。你可以去一趟休息站，万一出师不利他们能帮你在这里复活。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_resu.english: This is your general AO. You can check in with the rest stop medstation so they can revive you there if things go south.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_resu.chinese: 欢迎来到战区。民防部队推荐各位在出发前去休息站拜访医护人员，这样的话就算你发生不幸我们也能照料你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_resu.english: Welcome to the AO. CDF recommends checking in with the medical staff at the rest stop before heading out. That way we have you covered if anything goes wrong.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.chinese: 你已抵达战区，准许自由开火。检查武器，让他们下地狱吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.english: You're on site and weapons free. Check your fire and give 'em hell.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.chinese: 开始吧，你可以和敌人交战了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.english: Here we go. You're cleared to engage.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.chinese: 你已抵达作战区域。允许自由开火，不过小心别误伤平民。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.english: You're at the AO. Weapons free and keep an eye out for civvies.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.chinese: 不论你准备好没，我们要开始了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionarea_show.english: Ready or not, here we go.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.chinese: 这他妈的发生了什么？这看上去不像是九尾破坏行动的一部分。他们好像做完了什么事情？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.english: What the hell's going on here? This doesn't look like part of a Nine Tails smash and grab. Whatever they were doing seems to be done?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.chinese: 这个系统似乎被九尾破坏了。可惜我们没能及时赶到阻止他们的行动。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.english: This system seems to have been breached by the Nine Tails. It's a shame we didn't get here in time to stop whatever it is they were up to.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.chinese: 操！这是一个十字军安全终端。无论九尾企图做什么，那对我们来说肯定都不是什么好事。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hackc.english: Damn. This was a secure Crusader terminal. Whatever the Nine Tails managed' to take, it won't be good for us.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.chinese: 这他妈的是什么？ 他们连上十字军的网络了吗？你试试能不能关掉它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.english: What the hell is this? Are they hooked into Crusader's network? See if you can shut it down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.chinese: 这发生了什么？ 看起来九尾已经直接接入了十字军的网络。尝试去关掉它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.english: What is going on here? Looks like the Nine Tails are plugged right into Crusader's network. Try and shut it down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.chinese: 不确定为什么九尾要访问这些系统，但肯定不是什么好事。如果可以请尝试断开连接。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_missionpoi_hacki.english: Not sure why the Nine Tails are accessing these systems, but it can't be for anything good. Try and sever the connection if you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_shuttle_nomissio.chinese: 嘿，我告诉过你，我们不能让路过的旁观者在一个危险的战斗地区徘徊。如果你不打算做志愿者，就不要下穿梭机。明白吗？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_shuttle_nomissio.english: Hey, I told you we can't have random bystanders wandering around an active crisis area. If you aren't going to volunteer, don't get off that shuttle. Get me?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_hospnots.chinese: 在你出发前，有一个提示。确保你已经将你的印记设置为奥里森将军，这样你就可以在事情出错时迅速回到战斗中去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_hospnots.english: Here's a tip before you head out. Make sure you've set your imprint to Orison General, so you can get back to the fight quickly if things go wrong.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_nomissio.chinese: 对不起，这架穿梭机只针对民防部队的志愿者。我们仍然需要帮助，所以请随时通过你的合约经理报名参加。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_nomissio.english: Sorry, this shuttle is for CDF volunteers only. We still need help so feel free to sign up through your contract manager.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.chinese: 由于我们无法阻止九尾，我们已经停止了民防部队的行动。不要上那架穿梭机。十字军现在在现场收拾残局。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.english: We've shut down the CDF operation since we were unable to stop the Nine Tails. Don't get on that shuttle. Crusader's on site now picking up the pieces.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.chinese: 嘿，你不需要登上那架穿梭机。民防部队的人能够赶走九尾。十字军安保已经将平台作为犯罪现场进行封锁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.english: Hey, you don't need to board that shuttle. CDF forces were able to drive out the Nine Tails. Crusader Security's locking down the platforms as a crime scene.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.chinese: 你的这份热情很好，但任务已经结束了。我们设法让九尾离开了平台。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_station_postmiss.english: I appreciate the enthusiasm, but the mission's over. We managed to get Nine Tails off the platforms.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.chinese: 好了，希望你下船前有先扫描过残骸；有其他民防部队的人员看到过异种威胁在残骸附近游荡，祝你好运了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.english: Okay, I hope you scanned before exiting your ship. Another CDF member saw XenoThreat around that debris. Good luck in there

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.chinese: 你有先扫描过残骸了吗？异种威胁刚洗劫过这片残骸区域，他们大概率还在里边，当心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.english: Did you scan that wreck? XenoThreat's been raiding these debris fields so there's a good chance they're still on board. Be careful.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.chinese: 我收到了报告称异种威胁躲藏在某些残骸中；我劝你先扫描下，心里有个底再进去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_wreck_aally_tpla.english: I've been getting reports that XenoThreat are hiding out on some of the wrecks. I hope you scanned so you know what you're walking into.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 异种威胁大部队带着一艘军用伊德里斯来了。快过去参战并且让他们远离标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: XenoThreat just popped up with a milspec Idris. Get in there and keep them off the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 有艘伊德里斯正在接近。准备抄家伙赶跑他们吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: We've got an Idris inbound. Let's get to work and run it off.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 异种肯定熬不住想干一架了。他们呼叫了艘伊德里斯来支援。跟他们痛快大干一场吧，另外别忘了保护标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Xenos must be itching for a fight. They just called in an Idris. Let's give 'em what they want and protect that Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 需要更多人手来支援标枪，异种威胁他妈的叫了一艘伊德里斯来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Need help defending the Javelin. XenoThreat's here and they brought a damn Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 保护标枪避免受到异种部队的攻击，采取一切必要措施干掉那艘伊德里斯。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Gotta protect that Javelin from the Xenos. Do whatever's necessary to get that Idris out of here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 看到那个伊德里斯了，接下来干啥不用我说吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Got a visual on that Idris. You know what to do.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 我们正在与那艘伊德里斯酣战，做什么都行只要能保证那艘标枪的安全。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Dealing with an Idris here. Need any help we can get to keep that Javelin safe.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 开打时间到，异种那帮家伙带着伊德里斯参赛了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Time to tussle. Xenos came to play with an Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 异种威胁带了艘伊德里斯直奔标枪去了。我们不能让他们得逞。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: XenoThreat brought in an Idris to go after that Javelin. We can't let them take it out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.chinese: 异种觉得拿一艘伊德里斯就可以把我们唬住，给他们看看我们可不是被吓大的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_enter_xenoidrisarea_pr.english: Xenos think they can scare us off with an Idris. Let's show 'em we're not intimidated.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 该死的，我告诉过你会发生这种情况。我会尝试让他们远程禁用它，但我认为时间不够。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: Dammit, I told you that would happen. I'll try to get them to disable it remotely, but I don't think there's enough time.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 妈的，你的自毁装置已经启动了。我正试图让十字军通过远程通讯尝试关闭它，但我认为我们已经没时间了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: Shit, your self-destruct's kicked in. I'm trying to get Crusader on comms to try and shut it down, but I think we're gonna run out of time.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 你的飞船刚刚启动了自毁程序。我去看看十字军安保是否能远程禁用它，但你应该赶紧离开。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: Your ship just initiated a self-destruct. I'm gonna see if Crusader Security can remotely disable it, but you should get out of there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 我告诉过你会发生这种情况。趁现在还不晚，赶紧回到限制区域。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: I told you this would happen. Get back into the restricted area before it's too late.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 现在掉头。如果你回到限制区域，应该能关闭自毁装置。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: Turn around now. If you get back into the restricted area, that should shut off the self-destruct.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.chinese: 该死的。在计时器结束之前，把那艘船开回限制区域。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_restrictedarea_nf.english: Shit. Get that ship back in the restricted area before that timer counts down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.chinese: 好吧，我已经警告过你了。现在你正式闯入战斗区域了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.english: All right, I warned you. Now you're officially trespassing in a combat zone.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.chinese: 好吧，随你吧。你正式侵入了一个活跃的危险区域，并将被标记为战斗人员。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.english: Fine, have it your way. You're officially trespassing in an active crisis area and will be flagged as a combatant.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.chinese: 该死的，你到底为什么要离开穿梭机？你现在正式侵入了危险区域，并将被标记为战斗人员。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_exit_shuttle_nomission.english: Goddammit, why the hell did you get off that shuttle? you're now officially trespassing in a crisis area and will be flagged as a combatant.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 我们损失了一艘补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: We've lost one of our supply ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 异种威胁击毁了一艘海军补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: XenoThreat took out one of the Navy supply ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 收到消息一艘补给船被干掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: Just got word a supply ship was taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 异种威胁伏击了一艘海军补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: XenoThreat ambushed one of the Navy's supply ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 一艘开往杰里科的补给船被击毁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: A supply ship headed to Jericho was destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.chinese: 异种威胁击毁了一艘前往杰里科的补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_nottake.english: XenoThreat took out a supply ship en route to Jericho.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.chinese: 海军的补给船刚才被击毁了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.english: Navy supply ship just went down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.chinese: 异种威胁刚刚击毁了一艘补给船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.english: XenoThreat took out a supply ship.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.chinese: 我们失去了一艘护航船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.english: Just lost one of the convoy.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.chinese: 有艘海军护航船被异种威胁击毁了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.english: Navy convoy ship just got destroyed by XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.chinese: 友方护航船刚被干掉了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_protect.english: Friendly convoy ship just got taken out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.chinese: 我就和你直说了，刚那简直一塌糊涂，下次我要大家都给我拿出真本事来，否则星系内的其它人可就有得受的了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.english: I'm gonna be straight with you. That was a mess. I need everyone to bring their A-game next time or a lot of people in this system are going to suffer.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.chinese: 这真的是稀烂。下次得做得更好不然异种威胁会继续这样碾压我们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.english: This was a bust. We need to be better next time or XenoThreat's going to keep walking all over us.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.chinese: 我不是在逼逼你，我们得做得更好。如果海军需要我们的帮助，我们得伸出援手。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.english: I'm not going to bullshit you. We gotta do better. If the Navy needs our help, we gotta give it to them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.chinese: 我们今天输了。大家得做得更好那样海军才能打回去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.english: We lost today. People need to be better so the Navy can get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.chinese: 真的很令人失望，如果下次我们在海军需要我们的时候再搞砸，人们很难再去信任民防部队。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_mission_resuppl.english: That was dissapointing. Going to be hard for people to trust the CDF if we don't do better than that next time the Navy needs us.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 该死的。我们来得太晚了。九尾得到了他们想偷的东西。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.english: Goddammit. We were too late. Nine Tails got whatever it was they were trying to steal.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 我们无法阻止黑客的入侵。不管九尾想偷的是什么，他们得手了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.english: We couldn't stop the hack. Whatever it was the Nine Tails were trying to steal, they got it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 妈的。那个九尾的黑客成功了。天知道他们刚刚拿走了什么。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_failed_missionobj_sieg.english: Shit. That Nine Tails hack completed. God knows what they just got away with.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_farewell_aally_tplayer.chinese: 之后再与你联系，杜丽通话完毕。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_farewell_aally_tplayer.english: Talk to you later. Dulli out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_destr.chinese: 嘿，我告诉过你我们需要那些载具来帮助夺回驳船，所以我不能让你把它们炸了。下次要学会服从命令。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_destr.english: Hey, I told you we need those vehicles to help take back the barge, so I can't have you blowing them up. Next time, learn to follow orders.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_destr.chinese: 你到底在干什么？那些船是我们成功的关键部分。我手下的任何人都必须服从命令，所以你可以走了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_destr.english: What the hell are you doing? Those ships are a crucial part of our success. Anyone under my command needs to follow orders so consider yourself dismissed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.chinese: 你杀的是一个平民。我不会派疯子去打疯子。你完蛋了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.english: That was a civilian you killed. I won't send psychos to fight psychos. You're done.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.chinese: 民防部队是来保护民众的，不是来杀他们的。你会为你的所作所为付出代价。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.english: The CDF is here to protect the public, not kill them. You're gonna go down for what you did.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.chinese: 我不敢相信你和我们要阻止的那些罪犯一样坏。我已经通知了当局，你不是我的人了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_kille.english: I can't believe you're as bad as the criminals we're supposed to stop. I've notified the authorities, but you're off my team.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_siege.chinese: 你到底在做什么？我不能让我手下的人犯罪。我得让你离开，直到你把事情处理好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_siege.english: What the hell are you doing? I can't have people under my command committing crimes. I'm cutting you loose until you get that sorted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_siege.chinese: 为民防部队工作并不是犯罪的借口。我要把你踢出这个任务，直到你解决这个问题。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_gained_crimestat_siege.english: Working for the CDF isn't an excuse to go commiting crimes. I'm kicking you from this mission until you get that sorted out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.chinese: 听着，这里是民防部队的紧情特别代理人杜丽。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.english: Listen up. This is SAIC Dulli with the CDF.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.chinese: 这里是民防部队的特别探员杜丽。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.english: Special Agent Dulli with the CDF here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.chinese: 这里是和民防部队对接的杜丽。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.english: This is Dulli with the CDF.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.chinese: 这里是紧情特别代理人杜丽。
民防部队，你们是否收到？这里是杜丽。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.english: CDF, do you copy? It's Dulli.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_greet_aally_tplayer_fr.chinese: 能收到消息吗？这里是杜丽。

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_exit_cargobaydoor.chinese: 如果飞船残骸已经失去了电力，就表示异种威胁或许用了别的手段打开了货舱门。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_exit_cargobaydoor.english: If the wreck has lost power, XenoThreat might have rigged up something to open the cargo door.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.chinese: 看来你对那个伊德里斯造不成什么伤害，试着把注意力集中在战斗机身上。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.english: Doesn't look like you're making a dent on that Idris. Try focusing on the fighters.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.chinese: 如果我们想干掉异种威胁的伊德里斯，就得干掉更多他们的支援船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.english: We need to knock out more of XenoThreat's support ships if we want any chance of taking out their Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.chinese: 敌人的船太多了，我们应付不过来，侧重于减少他们的数量。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.english: There's still too many hostile ships for us to be effective. Focus on thinning their numbers.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.chinese: 如果我们不尽快击溃他们的支援飞船，我们就顶不住了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.english: They're going to overwhelm us if we don't take out more of their support ships soon.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.chinese: 专注在异种的支援舰上。少了它们掩护，伊德里斯也撑不了多久。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_mission_focusonfi.english: Target the Xeno support ships. Without their cover, the Idris won't stand a chance.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.chinese: 我们已经确认敌指挥官有这些上锁集装箱的密码。你得先干掉他才能拿到。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.english: We've confirmed the Commander has the access code to these locked containers. You'll have to take him out first to get it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.chinese: 有消息称门多·雷恩有这些集装箱的密码。你需要把他拿下才能拿到。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.english: Sources indicate that Menlo Ren has the access code to these containers. You'll need to take him down to obtain them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.chinese: 据说门多·雷恩带着这些集装箱的密码。你得把他引出来干掉才能拿到。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_barge_.english: Word is that Mendo Ren's carrying the access codes to these containers. You're gonna need to draw him out and take him down to get them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 看来穿梭机的控制失灵了。你必须找到另一种方法。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: Looks like the shuttle controls are busted. You're going to have to find another way around.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 那些穿梭机的控制被解除了。你必须找到另一种方法。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: Those shuttle controls are jacked. You'll have to find another way.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 你不可能让那些控制器工作。你需要另一种方法。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: No way you're getting those controls working. You'll need another way.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 这个平台上的副官被消灭了，也许有必要搜查一下他们的身体，看看能不能找到有用的信息。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: With the lieutenant on this platform dealt with, it might be worthwhile to search their body and see if you can find any usable intel.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 现在这个平台上的副官已被制服了，我建议从他身上搜查任何可能的情报。他身上可能有些有用的东西。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: Now that the lieutenant on this platform has been neutralized, I'd suggest searching him for any possible intel. He might have something useful on him.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.chinese: 试试搜查这个平台副官的尸体。永远不知道他身上可能有什么有用的情报。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_hint_missionobj_siege_.english: Try searching the body of this platform's lieutenant. Never know what useful intel he might have had on him.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 好消息。海军刚说标枪已准备好出航战斗。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Good news. Navy just said the Javelin's heading to the fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 听着。刚收到消息。海军的增援舰队正在赶来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Listen up. Just got word. Navy reinforcements are inbound.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 准备好。海军的标枪要过来帮忙了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Ready up. Navy's got a Javelin inbound to lend a hand.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 海军刚告诉我，正在准备让标枪过来战斗。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Navy just let me know, they're scrambling a Javelin to the fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 标枪正在路上。待会可有好戏看了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Javelin's heading in. This is about to get interesting.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 好消息，海军刚刚说标枪已经修整补给完毕；准备重返战场了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Good news. Navy just said the Javelin's been repaired and restocked. They're heading back to the fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 海军那边刚通知我，标枪已经修补完毕正出发重返战场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Navy just sent word. The Javelin's been patched up and is heading back to the AO.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 海军说标枪已经修护完毕，正在返回前线。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Navy said the Javelin's been repaired and is heading back to the front.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 海军刚完成标枪的修复工作，他们正在将标枪派回前线。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Navy just finished repairing the Javelin. They're dispatching it back to the front now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.chinese: 准备下；海军已经重新整补了标枪，准备把它送回战场了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_reinforcementsc.english: Ready up. Navy finished restocking the Javelin and they're sending it back to fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 你刚被标记上了犯罪等级。在有人把你误认为异种威胁前，得先去解决这个。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: You've been flagged with a crime stat. I'd go take care of that right now before someone mistakes you for XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 听好，我们需要任何人的帮助，但是你可小心，带着那个犯罪等级，可能会有人把你误认成异种威胁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: Look, we'll take any help we can get but watch yourself. With that crime stat, someone might think you're XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 你貌似带着个犯罪等级呢。不清理掉的话就自己看着办吧。没法保证你不会被别人误当成那群坏蛋的同伙就是了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: Says here you've got a crime stat. Either clear it or fight at your own risk. Can't promise someone won't mistake you for one of the bad guys.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 你TM怎么挂了个犯罪等级？听着，你得把这弄掉，不然别人会把你误当成目标的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: How the hell did you pick up a crime stat? Look, you need to get rid of that or people might mistake you for a target.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 嘿，你可不能顶着个罪名同时在这伸张正义，把这搞定。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: Hey, you can't be pulling crimes while you're working for the law. Fix it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.chinese: 只是加入了民防部队，可不代表你就能凌驾于法律之上。解决那个犯罪等级的问题，不然会有人把你误认成异种威胁的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_inform_switchtohostile.english: Just because you're CDF doesn't make you above the law. Resolve that crime stat or someone might mistake you for XenoThreat.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.chinese: 毫不意外，他们锁定了系统，也许你能找到密码。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.english: Not too much of a surprise that they locked their system. Maybe see if you can find a code somewhere.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.chinese: 操了，看来你需要密码才能进入终端，你得去找找。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.english: Shit, looks like you need a code to access the terminal. You're gonna have to find it somewhere.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.chinese: 被锁了...你也许能在某处找到访问密码。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_intro_missionobj_siege.english: Locked... You might be able to find the access code somewhere.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.chinese: 还得要你过来搭把手，尽快赶回来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.english: We still need your help. Get back here as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.chinese: 你要去哪？咱这的活还没干完呢。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.english: Where you going? Our work's not done here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.chinese: 没事吧？你这是在往反方向走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_resu.english: Everything ok? You're headed in the wrong direction.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.chinese: 这场仗还尚未结束，快回来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.english: The fight's still going on. Get back here as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.chinese: 这仗还没打完，你丫的是想往哪跑呢？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.english: Fight ain't done. Where the hell are you going?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.chinese: 你这在搞啥呢，飞行员？赶快回来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.english: What the hell are you doing, pilot? Get back in there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.chinese: 还没完呢，老弟。迅速回归战场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.english: This isn't over, sport. Get back in the fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.chinese: 你方向错了，往战场的方向走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_leave_missionarea_show.english: You're headed the wrong way. Go towards the battle.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.chinese: 这看起来像是敌我识别转换器（IFFI）的缩小版，但似乎是专用于控制这个平台的防空系统。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.english: This looks like a smaller version of the IFFI, but seems like it's dedicated to controlling this platform's anti-air defenses.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.chinese: 太好了，你找到了控制这个平台防空系统的敌我识别转换器（IFFI）。关掉它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.english: Perfect, you found the inverter that's controlling this platform's AA defenses. Shut it down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.chinese: 太好了，敌我识别转换器（IFFI）控制着这个平台的防空系统。关闭它以确保空域安全。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_aacont.english: Great, that inverter's controlling the anti-air on this platform. Shut it down to make the skies safe.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.chinese: 所有民防部队志愿者注意。一些九尾集装箱被卡住了，所以打开时要小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.english: Attention, all CDF volunteers. Some of the Nine Tails containers have been trapped, so be careful when opening them.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.chinese: 请注意。我收到报告说九尾已经在他们的一些集装箱设置了陷阱，小心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.english: Be advised. I'm getting reports that the Nine Tails have trapped some of their containers. Watch yourselves.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.chinese: 这里是杜丽。听好了，看起来有些九尾集装箱安装了陷阱，所以小心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_boobyt.english: This is Dulli. Listen up, looks like some of the Nine Tails containers have traps installed, so watch your step.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.chinese: 九尾可能会介意你用了他们的药。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.english: The Nine Tails will probably mind if you help yourself to some of their meds.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.chinese: 天哪，他们带了一堆药来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.english: Jesus, they brought a bunch of meds to this thing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.chinese: 这里有什么？看起来像一堆药。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcmeds.english: What have we got here? Looks like a bunch of meds.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.chinese: 那辆载具应该会派上用场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.english: That vehicle should come in handy.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.chinese: 似乎九尾为这次突袭带来了一点东西。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.english: Seems the Nine Tails brought a little of everything for this raid.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.chinese: 看来我们用九尾的载具来干掉他们才合适。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcvehi.english: Seems only fitting we use the Nine Tails' own vehicles to bring them down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.chinese: 九尾一定在用这个集装箱运载弹药。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.english: Nine Tails must be using this container to load up on ammo.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.chinese: 看来你找到了一个九尾弹药库。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.english: Looks like you found a Nine Tails ammo cache.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.chinese: 他们带了足够的弹药去打仗？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_hcweap.english: They brought enough ammo to go to war?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_open_missionpoi_massac.english: All these people? it's a massacre?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.chinese: 标枪正准备启动量子驱动，起跳前保护好它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.english: Javelin's prepping to spin up the Q drive out of here. Protect it until they make the jump.
Cover the Javelin until it gets out of here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.chinese: 标枪正在准备启航，我要所有人前去掩护，直到他们离开这为止。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.english: Javelin's spinning up. I want everyone protecting them until they launch.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.chinese: 让异种威胁远离标枪，直到它能从这量子出去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.english: Keep Xenothreat off that Javelin until it can quantum out of here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.chinese: 标枪的量子驱动器正在充能完成之前需要我们的掩护。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_order_defendtarget_qts.english: Quantum drives are spinning up on the Javelin. I want cover fire until they're ready to QT.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.chinese: 我不确定你之前处没处理过亚克力络合物，要当心；它们极其不稳定，磕碰破损了就会爆炸。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.english: Not sure how much you've handled Acryliplex, but be careful. They're really unstable and will go up if damaged.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.chinese: 提醒下你，亚克力络合物受损后会爆炸，处理那些箱子时要万分小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.english: Just a head's up, Acryliplex will explode if damaged, so be extra careful with that crate.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.chinese: 处理那些箱子时要小心，亚克力络合物十分不稳定，如果箱子受损，那事情就麻烦了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_destructiblesup.english: You'll need to be careful with that crate. Acryliplex is really unstable, so things will get really messy if that crate's damaged.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.chinese: 警告你一下，稀热树脂在量子航行的时候会极其不稳定，所以你得使用常规引擎来把它运回杰里科。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.english: Word of warning, Diluthermex becomes violently unstable when in quantum travel, so you'll need to use conventional engines to get it back to Jericho.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.chinese: 简单提醒下，稀热树脂在量子航行的时候会极其不稳定，所以别开量子；只能用常规推进器。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.english: Just a reminder that Diluthermex becomes violently unstable in Quantum travel, so don't do it. Use conventional thrusters only.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.chinese: 留意稀热树脂，这东西在量子航行的环境中会爆炸，所以你得用常规推进器来送回杰里科。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_quantumsupplies.english: Be careful with that Diluthermex. It will explode during Quantum travel, so you'll need to use regular thrusters to get it back to Jericho.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.chinese: 既然你已经拿到了一些物资，我要你尽快把它们送回杰里科。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.english: Now that you got your hands on some supplies, I need you to bring those back to Jericho as soon as you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.chinese: 一旦你把物资都拿上了，就把所有东西带回杰里科。他们在等你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.english: Once you're done hunting for supplies, go ahead and bring everything back to Jericho. They're waiting for you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.chinese: 一旦你搜索完物资，我要你把找到的东西都运回杰里科卸货。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_supplies_aally_.english: As soon as you're done searching for supplies, I want you to rush whatever you found back to Jericho and get it unloaded.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_timedsupplies_a.chinese: 不确定你之前是否运输过Z-普罗兰化合物，你一定得迅速地把它运抵杰里科，要不然计时器走完了，材料就没用了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_pickup_timedsupplies_a.english: Not sure if you've transported Zeta-Prolonide before, but make sure you deliver it to Jericho quick. If that timer on the box runs out, the mineral's useless.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.chinese: 不知道为什么你就这样跑了，但我们仍然需要帮助。如果你真心想要过来搭把手的话记得联系我。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.english: I don't know why you bailed on us, but we still need your help. Hit me up if you really want to lend a hand.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.chinese: 你放弃任务了？眼下还有什么能比对抗异种威胁更重要的？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.english: You abandoning the mission? What could be more important than dealing with the XenoThreat right now?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.chinese: 听好，我知道这不是谁都做得来的，但我们非常需要你的帮忙。如果你改变心意了就跟我说一声。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_resupply_.english: Look, I know not everyone's cut out for this but we could really use your help. Let me know if you change your mind.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.chinese: 听着，如果没法坚持到最后你以后就别瞎掺和当什么志愿军了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.english: Look, in the future, don't volunteer unless you're gonna see this through to the end.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.chinese: 我希望所有自愿者都能尽力而为，如果你做不到，那我也没辙。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.english: I need all volunteers to give their all. If you're not up to that, fine.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.chinese: 我知道异种威胁很可怕，但要想保卫我们星系的安全，就必须站出来对抗他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_quit_mission_showdown_.english: I know XenoThreat's scary, but we all have to stand up to them if we want to keep our system safe.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.chinese: 十字军安保公司以非法侵入罪拘留了你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.english: Crusader Security is taking you into custody for trespassing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.chinese: 退下。十字军安保公司要拘留你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.english: Stand down. Crusader Security's taking you into custody.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.chinese: 你因擅闯犯罪现场而被拘留。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_arrest_trespassi.english: You are being detained for trespassing on an active crime scene.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.chinese: 你找到并放倒他。让它受伤。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.english: You find him and put him down. Make it hurt.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.chinese: 该死的。人们声称剜度是野蛮的，但人类也可能一样坏？甚至更糟？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.english: Goddammit? people claim Vanduul are the brutal ones, but Humans can be just as bad? if not worse?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.chinese: 我这辈子见过很多悲剧，但是这个？你要确保阿克被拿下。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_react_missionobj_massa.english: I've seen a lot of tragedy in my life, but this? You make sure Acker goes down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_reactdamage_missionshi.chinese: 小心这些载具。在限制空域被重新设定之前，他们是我们唯一能得到的，我们需要他们找到九尾的敌我识别转换器（IFFI）。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_reactdamage_missionshi.english: Easy on the vehicles. Until the Restricted Airspace is reset, they're all we're going to get and we need them to reach the Nine Tails inverter.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_reactdamage_missionshi.chinese: 你需要小心那些载具。在主敌我识别转换器（IFFI）关闭之前，我们只有固定数量的载具。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_reactdamage_missionshi.english: You'll need to be careful with that vehicle. We only have a fixed number to work with until that main inverter is shut off.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.chinese: 刚收到消息，亚克力络合物已经达到所需储量，继续运送其它物资。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.english: Just got word that we hit our quota for AcryliPlex. Keep those other supplies coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.chinese: 收到海军的消息说，亚克力络合物已达所需储量。现在优先完成其它物资的运输。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.english: Received confirmation that the Navy has received a full stock of AcryliPlex. Efforts should be focused on completing the other supply runs.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.chinese: 看来我们的努力得到了回报，海军现在有了充足的亚克力络合物，让我们专注于收集他们所需要的其他物资。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_destructibles.english: Its seems our efforts are paying off. The Navy now has a full supply of AcryliPlex. Let's focus on finishing up the rest of what they need.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 收到了我们的第一单补给物资，继续运送。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Got our first supply drop. Let's keep them coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军说他们刚收到了第一批补给物资。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy just said they got their first supply drop.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 第一趟运送已完成。各位，要开始动起来了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: First drop's been made. We're off and running, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 有则给你的快讯，我们刚完成了第一趟的补给运输。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Quick update to let you know that we've had our first supply drop.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 已确认。收到第一批补给物资，干得好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Confirmation. First supply drop has been received. Good work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 我们带着补给正在路上，但还有一段路要走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: We're on our way with the resupply but still got a way to go.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 补给正陆续到达。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Supplies are starting to come in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 让那些补给接着送过来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Let's keep those supplies coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 我们还需要多得多的补给去应对异种威胁，继续运输。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: We're going to need a lot more supplies to deal with XenoThreat. Let's keep it going.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军很高兴看到补给送达，但是还差一大截呢。先别急着停下。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy's happy with the supplies being delivered, but there's still plenty of work to do. Don't stop now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 标枪已成功完成补给。重复，标枪已完成补给。感谢各位的努力。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Javelin's been successfully resupplied. Repeat. The Javelin's been resupplied. Thanks for the hustle.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军已补给完毕，感谢所有人的艰辛工作。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy's fully supplied. Thanks for all the hard work, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 刚刚接到海军的通讯，他们需要的东西现在都准备好了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Just got a comm from the Navy. They've got all the supplies they need for now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军发来消息说他们已经补给完毕了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy reached out to say that they're full up on supplies.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 做得不错，各位。海军已经补给完毕，向您表示感谢。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Nice job, all. The Navy has been fully resupplied and send their thanks.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 我们已经渡过难关了，伙计们。接下来可以放缓速度了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: We're over the hump, people. Let's keep those supply drops coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 看来我们已经完成四分之三的补给份额了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Looks like we're three-quarters of the way there on our supply drops.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 杰里科的军需官说他们所需要的物资已经拿到了75%。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Quartermaster on the Jericho said they just hit seventy-five percent of the supplies they need.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 给你更新个信息，我们运送补给的工作做得不错，但还需要运送大量补给。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Just wanted to send along an update. We're doing good with supplies, but still need a lot to be fully restocked.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 距离完成补给还需要一段时间。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Still got a while to go until we're resupplied.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军刚发来最新消息。他们大约有25%的存货，所以我们要继续进货。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy just sent an update. They're about twenty-five percent restocked, so let's keep it coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 我们已经满足了海军25%的补给要求。干得好，但我们现在不能松劲。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: We've fulfilled 25% of the Navy's supply request. That's good, but we can't let up now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 我刚跟海军军需官谈过，25%的物资已经到位。但这只是个开始，还有很多事情需要做。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Just spoke with the Navy quartermaster. 25% of the supplies accounted for. It's a start, but there's still a lot more needed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 补给工作刚刚完成了一半。坚持下去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Resupply efforts just crossed the halfway mark. Keep it up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军刚才发来通讯，他们的库存已经达到一半了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy just dropped a comm. They're about halfway full.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 状态更新，海军已经拿到所需物资量的一半了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Status update. Navy's got half of what they need.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 看来我们的供给量已经达到一半了，我们必须继续前进。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Seems that we hit the halfway point on fulfilling the supply requisition. We've got to keep going.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 好消息，补给量已经达到一半了。抓紧把剩下的送完。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Good news. Supply stock is halfway to being full. Let's focus and deliver the rest.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 最新消息，我们就快完成补给了。赶快把最后的那几批货送来吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Quick update. We've almost completed the resupply. Let's get those last deliveries in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 补给的供应流十分稳定，很快就能满足海军的需求了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: We got a good flow of supplies coming in. Navy's almost got everything they need.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.chinese: 海军通讯说他们的补给需求马上就要完成了，再加把劲。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_overallsuppli.english: Navy comm'd that they almost have all the supplies they need. One final push and we'll be done.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.chinese: 状态更新，空间站的稀热树脂已经满了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.english: Here's a status update. The station said they're full up on Diluthermex.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.chinese: 想告诉你下，海军的稀热树脂已经存储完备。现在需要我们着重在其它补给物资上。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.english: Wanted to inform you that the Navy is good on stores of Diluthermex. They want us to focus on the other supplies for now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.chinese: 刚收到海军通知，稀热树脂的存储量已经足够。就还剩下其它物资需要补给了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_quantumsuppli.english: Navy just comm'd. Diluthermex stores are now replenished. Just need to finish the rest of the resupply.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 第一趟送的很不错，再回去继续把货带来吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Nice first delivery. Now get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 很高兴能有你在这帮忙。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Glad to have you helping out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 这些补给物资看上去都很不错，回去那边继续运吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Those supplies look good. Get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 继续运送物资回来，这样才能让舰船完成装载。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Keep bringing in crates so we can get this ship stocked.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 谢了，没有你和其它民防部队的人这事可成不了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Thanks. Couldn't do this without you and the rest of the CDF.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 军需官一直在说他们堆箱子的速度都能比你们运来的快，那咱就测看看是真是假吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Quartermaster keeps saying they can stack crates faster than we bring them in. Let's put that to the test.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 还需要你再运点过来。标枪越早完成补给就越好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Need you to bring another haul in. The sooner we get this Javelin fully supplied the better.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 还需要再带些补给物资过来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Gonna need some more supplies brought in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.chinese: 还有很多补给品需要运送，赶回去那边继续回收吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_aall.english: Still got a bunch more supplies to haul in. Let's get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.chinese: 海军说那种补给物资已经够多了，所以你不用一直往这边送。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.english: Navy said they don't need any more of that supply crate, so you don't need to keep dropping it off.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.chinese: 那种物资已经储备完成了，你能带其它补给物资来吗？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.english: We're all stocked up on that. Any other supplies you can bring in?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.chinese: 很好，但那种补给物资已经满载了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.english: Good work, but we hit our quota for that type of supply crate.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.chinese: 还有什么你能运来的？海军说那种物资已经全部装载完成了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.english: What else can you haul in? Navy said that type of supply crate is all stocked up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.chinese: 标枪已满载该补给物资，不再需要了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_full.english: Javelin's at capacity for that supply. No need for it anymore.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.chinese: 海军那边已经过半了，继续运送物资过来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.english: Navy's over halfway there. Let's keep those drops coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.chinese: 我们的进度已经过半了，继续保持。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.english: We're past the halfway point. Keep up the good work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.chinese: 我听说标枪载量已经过半了，咱们离目标越来越近了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.english: I'm hearing the Javelin's over half full. We're getting close here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.chinese: 继续把那些物资运来，海军说舰船的装载量已经过半了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.english: Keep the crates coming. Navy's saying the ship's over half capacity.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.chinese: 我们离补给所需已过半了。继续把那些箱子运来，让我们尽快完事。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_good.english: We've got over half the supplies we need. Keep bringing in those crates and let's get this done.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.chinese: 刚听说你送完了一趟。继续保持，还有很长的路要走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.english: Got word on your latest drop. Keep them coming. Got a long way to go.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.chinese: 继续运送补给物资，离标枪重新补给完成还有段路要走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.english: Keep those supplies coming in. We've got a way to go before the Javelin's fully re-stocked.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.chinese: 很好，但海军还需要你回去尽力把能找到的物资都送来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.english: Nice work, but the Navy needs you back out there to haul in any supplies you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.chinese: 这才刚刚开始，离标枪完成补给还有很长的路要走。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.english: We're just getting started here. Long way to go before the Javelin has all the supplies it needs.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.chinese: 海军还需要你继续运送货物。船还不到完全满载。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_lows.english: Navy needs you to keep hauling in crates. Ship's not close to being fully stocked.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.chinese: 海军刚告诉我他们的补给量就快有一半了，做得好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.english: Navy just told me that they're nearly halfway supplied. Good work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.chinese: 标枪已开始装载，但还需要不少物资。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.english: Javelin's filling up but there's still a way to go.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.chinese: 船上空间还多的是，所以尽量再带点物资过来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.english: Still plenty of room on the ship, so keep bringing those crates in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.chinese: 刚收到则快讯，标枪连一半物资都没装满，继续运送补给过来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.english: Just got a quick update, Javelin's not even at half capacity. Let's keep those supplies flowing in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.chinese: 继续，标枪就快装满一半了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_meds.english: Keep it up. Javelin's getting close to half full.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.chinese: 标枪马上补给完毕，海军说他们只需要再补充一小点就行了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.english: Javelin's almost fully resupplied. Navy said they only need a couple more drops.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.chinese: 我们马上搞定了，再来一点就能完成补给了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.english: We're getting close here. Just a few more drops and we'll be resupplied.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.chinese: 继续你们的出色工作，标枪的补给工作就要完成了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.english: Keep up the good work. Javelin's almost resupplied.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.chinese: 海军说他们只需要再来几箱物资，标枪就储备充裕了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.english: Navy said they only need a few more crates and the Javelin will be all stocked up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.chinese: 海军回报说补给已经快完成了，咱也赶快把这整完吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_near.english: Navy's reporting that the resupply is almost complete. Let's get this done quick.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.chinese: 杰里科港的军需官刚和我说了你送达的那批物资，你真的很有精神嘛！不过话说回来，干得很好！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.english: The quartermaster on Jericho just told me about your last drop. You trying to set a record or something? Seriously though. Good job.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.chinese: 很高兴你来了，这批收获可不少啊。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.english: Sure glad you showed up. That's a hellva haul you brought in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.chinese: 大伙刚在聊你上趟送来的物资，真令人佩服。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.english: Folks are talking about that last shipment you delivered. Impressive work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.chinese: 你刚那趟送来的可真不少，如果大家都能像你这般效率，补给能完成得更快了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.english: That was quite the drop you just made. We'd be done a lot faster if everyone was that efficient.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.chinese: 杰里科港的军需官对你上次跑的那趟十分佩服，继续保持。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_supplies_sign.english: The Jericho quartermaster was impressed with your last delivery. Keep up the good work.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.chinese: 我们已取得最低需求量的Z-普罗兰化合物。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.english: We've got the minimum amount of Zeta-Prolanide requested.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.chinese: 刚刚确认站里有他们所需的所有Z-普罗兰化合物，我们赶紧把剩下的送过去吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.english: Just confirmed that the station has all the Zeta-Prolanide they need. Let's hurry up and deliver the rest.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.chinese: 据海军消息，Z-普罗兰化合物已经完全恢复储备。目前为止我们都做得很好，现在改着手处理其他的物资了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_received_timedsupplies.english: According to the Navy, Zeta-Prolanide has been completely restocked. We're good on that for now and should work on the other supplies.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.chinese: 海军需要更多的亚克力络合物。留意一下，多找找这东西。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.english: The Navy needs more AcryliPlex. Keep an eye out and drop off what you can.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.chinese: 在供应需求中优先考虑亚克力络合物，比起其它物资海军更需要它。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.english: Prioritize AcryliPlex in those supply runs. Navy needs that more than the others.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.chinese: 军需官给了我一个消息，他们需要更多的亚克力络合物。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.english: Quartermaster just gave me a head's up. They need more AcryliPlex.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.chinese: 如果可以的话，当你外出搜刮物资的时候，优先考虑亚克力络合物，海军需要更多这样的东西。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.english: If you can, prioritize AcrylicPlex when you're out scavenging. Navy needs a lot more of that.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.chinese: 需要更多的亚克力络合物。海军表示，他们还没有收到这批货物。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_destructiblesup.english: Need more AcryliPlex. Navy says they haven't been getting shipments of that.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.chinese: 我需要火力支援去帮助那些补给舰船。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.english: I need combat support to help out those supply ships.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.chinese: 有战斗飞行员吗？海军补给船只正在遭受攻击，需要支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.english: Any available combat pilots. Naval supply ships are currently under attack and need help.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.chinese: 前往支援海军护卫队，这是高优先级事项。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.english: This is a priority call. Go help that Naval convoy.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.chinese: 我还需要飞行员去帮助下那些海军补给舰队，放下手边的事并迅速前去支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.english: I still need pilots to help out that Naval supply convoy. Drop what you're doing and get out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.chinese: 我需要更多战斗船去支援海军的补给舰队。各位，尽速动身。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_protect.english: I need more combat ships to help out the Navy supply convoy. Let's move, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.chinese: 那些货物的情况如何？送达量目前还是不够。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.english: What's the status on those deliveries? We've been slacking on the dropoffs.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.chinese: 海军说他们的物资收取进入了空窗期，大家抓紧时间。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.english: Navy says they haven't received any supplies in a while. Let's get out there, people.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.chinese: 海军还在等着补给送达，抓紧了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.english: The Navy's been waiting on supply drops. Let's hustle up.
