pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.chinese: 刚听海军的军需官说，他们这段时间都没收到补给，赶快把东西送过去吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.english: Just heard from the Navy Quartermaster, they haven't had a supply drop recently. Let's keep them coming.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.chinese: 我们需要更多补给送往杰里科港，进度已经落后了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_resuppl.english: Need more supplies dropped off at Jericho. We've been slipping.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.chinese: 赶快动身吧，战斗可不会等你来了才开打。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.english: Let's get a move on. Battle's not going to wait on you to start.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.chinese: 速度！速度！大家都还在外头打仗呢！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.english: Let's go. Let's go. We got people fighting.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.chinese: 你到底TM在哪啊？我们这需要支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.english: Where the hell are you? We need help here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.chinese: 海军正在交火，我们需要火力支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.english: The Navy's currently engaged and we need combat support now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.chinese: 嘿，这场仗需要你。整快点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_showdow.english: Hey, we need you in this fight. Hustle up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.chinese: 你那边怎样？我这里需要你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.english: What's your twenty? We need your help out here.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.chinese: 我不知道你在玩什么，我需要你快点到场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.english: Not sure what you're playing at, but I need you on site ASAP.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.chinese: 时间不等人，我们需要所有飞行员即刻就位。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_res.english: Clock's ticking. We need all pilots on site now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_sie.chinese: 我们需要尽快解决这个问题，所以快去穿梭机。你应该知道位置。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_sie.english: We need this situation resolved ASAP so get to the shuttle. You should have the location.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_sie.chinese: 完成你正在做的事情，尽快去穿梭机。我们需要所有志愿者尽快赶到现场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionarea_sie.english: Finish whatever you're doing and get to the shuttle as soon as you can. We need all volunteers on site as quick as possible.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 嘿，十字军还在等着我们清除剩下的九尾和防空系统。检查您的mobi，让我们来处理剩下的平台。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.english: Hey, Crusader is still waiting on us to clear out the remaining Nine Tails and AA. Check your mobi and lets get the remaining platforms taken care of.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 我们仍然有敌对势力的平台和防空系统需要解决。检查你的mobi，让我们结束这次行动。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.english: We still got platforms with hostile forces and anti-air defenses that need to be sorted. Check your mobi and let's wrap this operation up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 该死的，更多九尾援军。他们会一直来，直到我们把那个转换器关掉。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.english: Damn. More Nine Tails reinforcements. They're just going to keep coming until we can take that inverter offline.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.chinese: 有更多的九尾来袭。你需要集中精力关闭主敌我防空识别装置，这样我们就可以阻止他们增援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_missionobj_sieg.english: We got more Nine Tails inbound. You need to focus on shutting down the main IFFI so we can stop them from reinforcing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.chinese: 注意那外边有没有稀热树脂，海军还需要很多。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.english: Look out for any Diluthermex out there. The Navy definitely needs more.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.chinese: 海军需要更多稀热树脂，跑下趟的时候优先处理这个。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.english: Navy needs more Diluthermex. Prioritize that on your next supply run.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.chinese: 收到海军消息，他们还需要更多稀热树脂。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.english: Just heard from the Navy, they need more Diluthermex.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.chinese: 跑补给运输的听一下，海军目前最需要的是稀热树脂。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.english: To all of you on supply runs, Navy needs Diluthermex more than the others right now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.chinese: 如果可以的话去搞点稀热树脂来。海军说比起其它的，目前他们更需要这个。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_quantumsupplies.english: Grab some Diluthermex if you can. Navy says they need that more than the others.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.chinese: 如果可以的话，搜刮补给的时候优先拿上Z-普罗兰化合物。比起其它的，海军更需要这个。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.english: If you can, prioritize Zeta-Prolanide when you're scavenging for supplies. Navy needs that more than the others.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.chinese: 如果你在外边搜刮补给，比起其它物资海，军更需要Z-普罗兰化合物。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.english: If you're out there scavenging supplies, the Navy's looking for Zeta-Prolanide over the others.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.chinese: 海军更需要Z-普罗兰化合物。如果你在跑补给运输的话记得多留个心眼。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.english: The Navy needs more Zeta-Prolanide. Keep an eye out if you're out on a supply run.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.chinese: 海军军需官给我了个消息，他们需要更多的Z-普罗兰化合物。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.english: Navy Quartermaster just gave me a head's up. They need more Zeta-Prolanide.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.chinese: 注意下外边有没有Z-普罗兰化合物，海军还需要很多。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_remind_timedsupplies_r.english: Look out for any Zeta-Prolanide out there. The Navy definitely needs more.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_request_missionobj_pro.chinese: 标枪正准备量子，我希望你能在他们离开之前保护他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_request_missionobj_pro.english: The Javelin is preparing to QT, I want you to guard them and provide protection until they're away.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_request_missionobj_pro.chinese: 标枪的舰长说他们正在做量子跳跃的最后准备，我想让你在他们离开之前保护他们的安全。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_request_missionobj_pro.english: Got word from the captain that the Javelin is in final preperations to quantum travel. I want you with them as a protection detail until they've QT'd away.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.chinese: 你还好吗？听说你被打倒了。慢慢地重新站起来，但是如果你愿意的话，我们仍然需要你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.english: You all right? Heard you got punched out. Take your time get back on your feet, but we can still use your help out there if you're up to it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.chinese: 嘿，我是杜丽。欢迎回来。希望重生不是太糟糕。不想催你，但如果你想回去的话，行动还在进行。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.english: Hey, it's Dulli. Welcome back. Hope the regen wasn't too bad. Don't want to rush you, but the operation's still active if you want to get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.chinese: 我是杜丽。我刚听说你被袭击了。希望你正在康复。如果你想报复，我们仍然需要你的帮助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_respawn_mission_siege_.english: Dulli here. I just heard you got hit. Hope you're recovering. If you'd like a little revenge, we could still use your help out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 那艘伊德里斯的主炮正在充能。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: That Idris is charging up its main gun.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 我看到那艘伊德里斯在充能。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: I'm getting an energy buildup on that Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 那艘伊德里斯的主炮已经准备发射了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: That Idris is getting ready to shoot.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 警惕点，伊德里斯的主炮正在充能。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: Look alive. Idris' main gun is charging up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 准备好，伊德里斯在充能它的主炮。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: Get ready. XenoThreat's charging their main gun.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.chinese: 伊德里斯的主炮正在启动中。
伊德里斯正在准备使用他们的主炮，坏起来了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_chargi.english: Idris is readying their main gun. Not good.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.chinese: 他妈的，异种威胁的伊德里斯朝着标枪打了一发。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.english: Dammit, XenoThreat just blasted the Javelin with their Idris.
Javelin just took a massive shot from that Idris.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.chinese: 异种威胁的伊德里斯刚刚锁定了标枪。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.english: That XenoThreat idris just tagged the Javelin.
Main gun hit on the Javelin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.chinese: 我日，刚刚那一发太畜生了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.english: Dammit, that was a monster hit.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.chinese: 标枪刚刚被主炮打中一发。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_railgun_engagi.english: Javelin just took one from the main gun.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.chinese: 我敢说这一幕一定让不少人大开眼界。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.english: Bet that's a sight for sore eyes.
Javelin's on site and engaging targets.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.chinese: 标枪来了，是时候给他们点教训了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.english: Javelin's here. Time to dish out some punishment.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.chinese: 标枪已准备完毕，这帮异种这下有好果子吃了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.english: Javelin's on deck. XenoThreat's in for it now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.chinese: 标枪已入场，看样子它迫不及待要大干一场了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_reinforcements.english: Javelin's jumping in and ready to rock.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemyf.chinese: 异种威胁的伊德利斯溜了。
视野内净空，伊德利斯已撤退。
敌方伊德利斯进入量子航行了，他们撤退了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemyf.english: Hostile Idris has completed quantum. They're gone.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemys.chinese: 看起来异种威胁正在撤退。
看！他们跑了！我们把他们打跑了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemys.english: Look! They're pulling back! We've got them on the run.
XenoThreat are making a break for it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemys.chinese: 敌方的伊德里斯...正在离开战场。我们击溃他们了！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_retreat_enemys.english: The enemy Idris... it's disengaging. We got them!

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 有未知信号正朝着空间站去。规模不小...可能是一艘主力舰？我需要所有民防部队立刻赶到杰里科。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Got an unknown contact headed for the station. It's big? might be a cap ship? I need all combat CDF forces to get to Jericho, now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 未知的入站信号，从截面积信号来看像是一艘主力舰。所有附近的民防部队战斗人员立即前往杰里科站。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Unknown contact inbound. CS looks like it might be a capship. All available CDF combat personnel scramble to Jericho station.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 追踪到一艘未知的主力舰正驶向杰里科站，可能来者不善，我要一些民防部队马上过去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: I'm tracking an unknown capship on a trajectory to Jericho station. I think it might be hostile. I want CDF combat forces to head there now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 有一艘未知的主力舰正驶向杰里科，感觉不太妙。我需要民防部队来拦截它，以防不测。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: There's an unknown capship heading for Jericho. I don't like the look of it. I want CDF combat support to intercept just in case.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 刚刚收到异种威胁的伊德里斯正在朝杰里科去的消息，需要战斗支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Just picked up a XenoThreat Idris headed towards Jericho. Combat support needed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 又有一艘异种威胁的主力舰正朝杰里科站驶去。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Got another XenoThreat cap ship heading towards Jericho station.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 看来又有一艘伊德里斯朝杰里科去了，他们到底有多少艘？
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Looks like another Idris is heading towards Jericho. How many of these things have they got?

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 侦测到另外一艘未知主力舰，和其他异种威胁的伊德里斯一样用的假注册标签，快去杰里科站。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: Picked up another unknown capship, got the same fake reg-tags as the other XenoThreat Idris, so get over to Jericho.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.chinese: 异种威胁派了另一艘伊德里斯攻去杰里科站了，到那里去准备好战斗吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_spotted_xenoidris_prot.english: XenoThreat's got another Idris burning to Jericho. Get over there and get ready for a fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 补给船保护得不错，舰长说打得很英勇。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Great job protecting that supply ship. Captain said it was a helluva fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 异种威胁飞船都被解决了，感谢协助。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: XenoThreat forces are clear. Thanks for the assist.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 我敢打赌异种威胁肯定以为补给船是软柿子。这下教他们做人了吧，和民防部队动手前最好好好想想。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Bet the XenoThreat thought that supply ship was going to be easy pickings. This'll teach 'em to think twice before tangling with the CDF.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 看来补给船没事了，多亏了你的支援。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Looks like the supply ship's in the clear. Thanks for backing them up.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 补给船保卫得不错，这说明了民防部队的作用有多大。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Good work defending the supply ship. Just shows how much the CDF can make a difference.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 最后一个敌人被消灭，你的护航真的很棒！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Last hostile eliminated. Good job looking out for that supply ship.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.chinese: 空域肃清，看来剩下的护卫舰能搞定了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_protec.english: Scope's clear. Looks like the convoy ship can finish its run.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.chinese: 标枪正在返回作战区域，海军放话了，一定为大家射爆那帮异种。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.english: Javelin's heading back to the AO. Navy said they'll be sure to hit XenoThreat extra hard for you.
Javelin's spinning up to head back to the front.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.chinese: 标枪正在重新启动量子驱动器准备重返战场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.english: Javelin's getting their Quantum online to get back out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.chinese: 收到海军通知，标枪正在路上，准备返回战场。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_resupp.english: Navy just updated me, the Javelin's on the move, heading back out to fight.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.chinese: 区域肃清。看来所有敌人都已清除，大家干得很好！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.english: Scope's clear. It looks like all hostiles have been taken care of. Helluva job everyone.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.chinese: 成功了！海军已确认完毕，你的飞行技巧有点东西！
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.english: You did it. Navy's given the all clear. Fine flying out there.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.chinese: 表单已完成。范围内也没看到其它东西了，大家干得好。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_showdo.english: Table's cleared. I got nothing else on my scope. Great job everybody.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 驳船的防空已被摧毁。空中进场应畅通无阻。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: The barge's anti-air defense have been destroyed. Aerial approach should be clear.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 民防部队志愿者们，你们可以靠近驳船了。防空工事已被摧毁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: CDF Volunteers, you are clear to approach the barge. Anti-Air defenses have been destroyed.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 那是驳船上最后的防空工事。民防部队船向前推进。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: That's the last of the anti-air defenses on the barge. CDF ships, lets move in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 驳船上的所有敌对势力都已被消灭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: All hostile forces on the barge have been eliminated.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 扫描显示船上没有任何九尾残余。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: The scans are showing that the barge is clear of all Nine Tails.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 看起来驳船上最后一批亡命之徒已经被消灭了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: Looks like the last of the outlaws aboard the barge have been neutralized.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 棒极了。我就知道你能搞定飞行限制的问题。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: Excellent. I knew I could count on you to get the flight restrictions sorted.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.chinese: 这是指挥官的密码。使用它们进入驳船上存放九尾转换器的集装箱。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_bar.english: Here are the Commander's access codes. Use them to get into the storage conainer on the barge housing the Nine Tails' inverter.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.chinese: 干得好。谁知道九尾想偷什么。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.english: Good work. Who knows what the Nine Tails were trying to steal.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.chinese: 好样的。当我告诉十字军发生了什么时，他们真的吓坏了。希望这能让他们放心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.english: Nice one. Crusader got really freaked out when I told them what was happening. Hopefully this'll put them at ease.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.chinese: 我很欣慰你能及时解决这个系统漏洞。十字军一定会很乐意听到这个好消息的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_sie.english: I'm relieved you were able to stop this system breach in time. Crusader's going to be thrilled when I tell them the good news.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 注意，行政中心平台的防空系统已关闭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: Attention, the anti-air defenses on the Admin Center platform have been disabled.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 注意了。行政中心的防空系统已经被解决了。干得漂亮。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: Listen up. Admin Center's anti-air defense network has been taken down. Good job.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 请注意，行政中心的防空系统已关闭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: Be advised, anti-air defenses on the Admin Center have been disabled.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 请注意，占据行政中心的九尾中尉已被消灭。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: Be advised, the Nine Tails lieutenant in charge of the Admin Center's been taken down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 已确认击杀位于行政中心的阿特·凯尔文
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: Just confirmed that Art Kelvin was just taken out on the Admin Center.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 已确认击杀。对于凯尔文这种法外狂徒来说真的是罪有应得。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: That's a confirmed kill. Quite an end for a longtime criminal like Kelvin.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 行政中心现已百分百安全并处于民防军的控制之下。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: The Admin Center is now 100% secure and under CDF control.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 我现在可以确定，行政中心的威胁已被完全消除。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: I can now confirm that the Admin Center has been completely secured.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.chinese: 我们取得了巨大进展，行政中心现在已经安全了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_succeed_missionobj_ver.english: We're making great progress and have now secured the Admin Center.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.chinese: 嘿，我只是想感谢你挺身而出，帮助我们解决这一时间。因为有了像你这样的志愿者，民防部队才得以有效运作。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.english: Hey, just wanted to thank you for stepping up and helping resolve this situation. The CDF is only effective because of volunteers like you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.chinese: 我是杜利，只是想说声谢谢，谢谢你刚才的帮助。没有你，我们不可能夺回那些平台。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.english: This is Dulli, just wanted to drop a line and thank you for your help back there. We wouldn't have been able to retake those platforms without you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.chinese: 我只是想让你知道，你今天发挥了巨大的作用。谢谢你，现在去放松一下吧，这是你应得的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_thanks_mission_partici.english: I just wanted you to know that you made a real difference today. Thanks. Now go try and relax, you've earned it.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.chinese: 根据收到的最新信息，我们缩小了该平台敌我识别转换器（IFFI）的一些潜在位置的可能性，正在发送数据。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.english: Looking at the latest info coming in, we've narrowed down some potential locations of this platform's IFFI device. Sending them now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.chinese: 我们找到了一些有关于这个平台上敌我识别转换器（IFFI）的线索，正在标记。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.english: We might have a couple leads on this platform's IFFI. Marking them now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.chinese: 我刚刚得到一些情报，也许能帮你找到这个平台上的敌我识别转换器（IFFI）。现在就把数据发给你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_update_missionobj_loca.english: Just got some intel that might help you find the IFFI on this platform. Sending you the data now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.chinese: 注意了，这个平台上的防空系统还开着呢。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.english: Be careful, the anti-air defenses are still active on that platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.chinese: 我看到九尾控制的防空系统还在平台上。接近时请加倍小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.english: I'm still seeing Nine Tail controlled anti-air defenses on that platform. Use caution approaching.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.chinese: 当心点，那个平台的防空系统还在启用状态。靠近那边时小心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_flyingship_aaacti.english: Watch it. That platform's anti-air is still active. Be careful as you get closer.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.chinese: 好了大伙们。我们该撤离这个平台回去奥里森了。十字军安保马上要来打扫战场了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.english: All right, people. Let's start vacating the platforms and get back to Orison. Crusader Security's trying to get in and start cleaning up the space.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.chinese: 我需要所有民防部队人员马上撤离平台。不走的人会因擅闯禁区罪被逮捕。这是最后的警告。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.english: I need any CDF personnel to leave the platforms immediately. Anyone sticking around can be arrested for trespassing. This is your final warning.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.chinese: 注意，我需要所有民防部队人员撤离平台。十字军马上就要来封锁区域了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_postm.english: Attention, I need all CDF personnel to vacate the platforms. Crusader's chomping at the bit to secure the scene.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.chinese: 喂，这几个平台附近的空域正处于九尾控制下。想过去的话只能搭穿梭机。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.english: Hey, the airspace around those platforms is under Nine Tails control right now. You need to use the shuttle if you want to access the platforms.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.chinese: 小心了，限制区域牧还在九尾的手中，过去的唯一途径就是搭穿梭机。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.english: Be careful. That Restricted Area is still under Nine Tails control. The only way you can get in is using the shuttle.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.chinese: 现在没法飞去限制空域，那里还在九尾的控制之中。先降落搭穿梭机过去吧。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_nfzactive_siege_i.english: You can't fly into that Restricted Airspace right now. Nine Tails are still controlling it. Set down and take the shuttle instead.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_parkedship_aaacti.chinese: 提醒你一下，在九尾控制防空系统还在运作的情况下起飞是非常危险的。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_parkedship_aaacti.english: Word of caution. It's going to be dangerous for you to take off while the Nine Tails controlled AA systems on this platform are still online.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 一个敌对人员刚刚干掉了我们的一个志愿者，他们似乎不是九尾的人，我会试着给他们标上记号的，但还是要小心。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: A hostile operative just took out one of our volunteers. They don't seem to be Nine Tails. I'll try to mark them, but be careful.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 妈的，一个同情九尾的人刚刚杀了一个民事防御部队成员。我给他们做了标记，你可以留意一下。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Shit, a Nine Tails sympathizer just killed a CDF member. I've tagged them for you so you can keep an eye out.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 这里有新的敌人。我觉得他们不是九尾，现在把他们的位置发给你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Got a new hostile in the area. I don't think they're Nine Tails. Sending you their location now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 该死 又一个同情九尾的人出现了，给你标好记号了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Goddammit, another Nine Tails sympathizer's in the area. Marked 'em for you.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 看这，我在为你标记另一个独立的敌人，避开或者干掉他们。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Here. I'm flagging another independent hostile for you. Steer clear or take them down.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 不知道这些混蛋是从哪里冒出来的，但又有一个独立分子在攻击我们的人了。正在标记。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Don't know where all these bastards keep coming from, but we got another independant attacking our people. Marking them now.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 请注意，该平台上有多个九尾同情者。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Be advised, you have multiple Nine Tails sympathizers operating on that platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 注意，民事防御部队志愿者们。在你们的平台上发现了几个九尾的同情者，小心点。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Attention, CDF. Several Nine Tail sympathizers have been identified on your platform. Be careful.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.chinese: 我们似乎有一个新的威胁要应对，多个无从属组织的敌人正在这个平台上攻击民事防御部队志愿者。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemymarked_s.english: Seems we have a new threat to deal with; multiple unaffiliated hostiles are attacking CDF volunteers on this platform.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemypresent_.chinese: 提醒一下，我收到报告说，有非九尾的敌人在攻击民事防御部队志愿者。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemypresent_.english: Just a head's up, I've been getting reports that there are non-Nine Tails hostiles attacking CDF volunteers.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemypresent_.chinese: 警告。我们收到独立人员袭击民防部队志愿者的报告，请留意那些不速之客。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_pvp_enemypresent_.english: Word of warning. We got reports of independent operators attacking CDF volunteers. Keep an eye out for unexpected hostiles.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_po.chinese: 喂，如果你可以的话，我建议你现在就撤离平台。十字军真的需要清空那边。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_po.english: Hey, if you could, I'd appreciate you leaving the platforms now. Crusader really wants the area clear.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_po.chinese: 我不会再警告你第二遍，你已经没有权限待在那片区域了。马上离开，否则十字军就会以擅闯禁区的罪名起诉你。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_po.english: Not going warn you again. You no longer have persmission to be in the area. Leave or Crusader will have you charged with trespassing.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.chinese: 小心了，如果你把这些飞船开出限制空域，十字军设定好了会自动触发自毁程序。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.english: Hey, watch it. If you take those ships outside the Restricted Air, Crusader's got them rigged to auto trigger the self-destruct.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.chinese: 收到了吗？你得在自毁激活前调头回来。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.english: Do you copy? You need to turn around before the self-destruct activates.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.chinese: 你听到我说的了吗？你再往前开飞船的自毁程序就要启动了。快调头。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.english: Did you hear me? That ship's self-destruct will kick in if you go much further. Turn around.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.chinese: 我不是在开玩笑，一旦你离开限制空域飞船马上就会启动自毁。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_restrictedarea_si.english: I wasn't kidding. If you get outside that Restricted Air, the ship's self-destruct will activate.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.chinese: 飞的时候小心点，那艘驳船上还有激活的炮塔。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.english: Careful with your approach. The barge still has active turrets in place.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.chinese: 小心了，通往驳船的路上还有激活的炮塔。我不希望你盲目冲进去然后被击落。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.english: Heads up there are still active turrets covering the approach to the barge. I don't want you to get shot down just blindly rushing in.

pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.chinese: 九尾在驳船上放满了防空炮塔，小心了。
pu_advrep01_f_deh_warn_turretsactive_bar.english: The Nine Tails got the barge rigged with AA turrets. Be careful.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 看来这单赏金得重新放回轮换了。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: Guess this bounty's going back in the rotation.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 你晓得不，有时候吧，要是你对这活儿没感觉，干脆点走人也挺好。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: You know, sometimes if you're not feeling a job, it's best to just walk away.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 我宁愿你直接放弃，也别凑合着干砸了。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: Rather have you drop a bounty than do a half-assed job.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 站在法律这边的好处嘛，大概就是搞不定任务直接走人，也不用担心被人掰断手指了。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: Nice thing about being on this side of the law, I guess. You can walk away from a job without getting your fingers broken.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 公会不喜欢猎人随便扔掉任务，但嘿，管他们呢，对吧？他们又不是咱主人。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: Guild don't like it when hunters drop a bounty, but hey, screw 'em, right? Not like they own us.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 赏金都是你得了。赶紧准备妥当，把那家伙给办了。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Bounty's all yours. Get locked and loaded and take 'em out.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 嘿，我是肯特。看你又接了个，这趟多加小心。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Hey, it's Kent. Saw that you're picking up another bounty. Good luck with this one.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 该给的情报都给你了，你知道该咋办。别莽，机灵点，平平安安回来，知道不？
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: You got all the details and you know what to do. Play it smart and come home safe, you hear?

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 干掉几个混球的好日子，对吧？等你搞定人，钱随时给你到账。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Good day to take down some shitheads, huh. Got your pay on tap and ready to go once you punch them out.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 我是肯特。我会盯着你这次悬赏的进展，在外头多留点神。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Kent here. I'll be tracking your progress on the bounty. Watch yourself out there.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.chinese: 那家伙可是个狠角色，想拿下他你得拿出真本事来。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.english: Mean son of a bitch, that one. Gonna need to bring your A-game if you're gonna take them down.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.chinese: 总算有人接这活了，这混蛋逍遥自在太久了。祝你好运。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.english: Glad someone picked this up. This scag's been breathing free air for too long. Good luck.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.chinese: 希望你准备好了，这家伙可比平时那些垃圾难搞多了。祝你好运，别阴沟里翻船。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepth.english: Hope you're ready, this one'll be tougher than your usual scumbag. Good luck.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.chinese: 嘿，说真的，我都不知道条子是脑子进水还是屁股不干净，这种垃圾居然还能满世界乱窜。你多保重。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.english: Hey there. Can't tell if the cops are dirty or just stupid, but it makes no sense this scumbag should still be running around. Good luck out there.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.chinese: 之前不少好手都栽在这孙子手里了，希望你运气能比他们强点。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.english: Lotta good people have tried to take this asshole down. Hope you have better luck than they did.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.chinese: 接了个顶级悬赏？行啊，看来今天是想大干一票啊。我喜欢你这劲头。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionaccepts.english: Taking on a top-shelf bounty, huh? Somebody's feeling their hustle today. I love it.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 刚收到确认，悬赏已经完成了。我这就给你发钱。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Just got confirmation that bounty's been cleared. I'll get you paid.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 干掉他们干得不错。我马上给你转账。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Nice job taking them out. I'll push your payment through.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 很好。让我把他们从名单上划掉，然后给你打钱。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Great. Lemme cross them off the list and get you paid.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 搞定收工。干得好。正在给你转账。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Done and dusted. Nice one. Sending your pay.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 我们又少了一个在逃的混球。跟你合作很愉快。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: We'll mark one less shithead on the run. Pleasure doing business with ya.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 我真没想到真有人能搞定这家伙，干得漂亮。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: I didn't think anyone was gonna take them down. Nice work.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 这混蛋在我悬赏榜上挂太久了，总算解决了，干得漂亮。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: That asshole's been haunting my bounty list for too long. Helluva job.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 这王八蛋总算是得到报应了。我要把这单赏金放到收藏里去。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Well that son of a bitch finally got what was coming to them. I'll push this bounty through collections.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 我靠。我从没想过真有人能搞定这事儿。好好享受，你配得上这单赏钱。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: God damn. I never thought someone would finally do it. Hope you enjoy your payout on this one. You earned it.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 牛逼。你做到了一大堆人都做不到的事。我这就结掉这个赏金，给你发钱。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Nice one. You did what a helluva lotta people couldn't. I'll close this bounty down and get you paid.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 这次干得真他妈漂亮。那混蛋让我想起以前跟我对着干的一个贱货。看到这种人被收拾总是特别爽。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: That was a damn fine takedown. That asshole reminded me of this skag I used to clash with back in the day. Always nice to see people like that get taken down.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 你已经很拼了。希望你恢复过来后能重新干活。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: That was a helluva effort. Hope you get back out there once you're on your feet.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 该死...他们把你收拾得够呛。嘿，振作点，最厉害的人也会遇到这种事。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: Damn… they really tuned you up. Hey, buck up, it happens to the best of us.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 看来他们是个难缠的混蛋，对吧。我把赏金重新发出去了，希望有别人能搞定他们。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: Well they're a nasty son of a bitch, huh. I put the bounty back on the wire, hopefully somebody'll bag 'em.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 有时候就是会栽跟头，对吧。花点时间恢复一下，然后重新开始干。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: Sometimes the bar eats you, huh. Take some time to get your feet back under you, but get back out there.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 本来可以干得更好的。不过嘿，谁都有状态不好的时候。下次再试试吧。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: That could've gone better. But hey, we all have off days. Maybe next time, huh.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.chinese: 嘿，我是肯特。看起来有人抢了你的赏金。干这行你动作得快。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.english: Hey, it's Kent. Looks like someone snaked the bounty from you. Gotta move fast in this game.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.chinese: 怎么样？有个坏消息。竞争对手抢先搞定了你的目标。有时候就是这样。下次好运吧。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.english: What's up there? Got some bad news. Rival bounty hunter got to your target first. How it goes sometimes. Better luck next time.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.chinese: 你要是还在去那个赏金的路上，那你可以踩刹车了。别人抢先一步帮你解决了。这回算你倒霉。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_genericmissionfailtar.english: You can hit the brakes if you're burning to that bounty. Somebody else got in there and took care of it for you. Bad luck, I guess.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_001.chinese: 嘿，我是肯特。看到他们了吗？扫描一下。那混蛋就在附近。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_001.english: Hey, it's Kent. You see 'em yet? Send out a scan. Bastard's here somewhere.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_002.chinese: 我是肯特。现在开始行动了。扫描一下锁定他们的位置，然后开始狩猎。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_002.english: Kent here. We're in it now. Send out a scan to get eyes on 'em and get hunting.

pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_003.chinese: 我是肯特。刚看到你快到了。如果看不到他们就扫描一下，找到了祝你有好收获。
pu_akent_civ_m_pmh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_003.english: It's Kent. Just saw you're getting close. Scan if you can't see 'em and good hunting when you can.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdlabshuttingdown_.chinese: 从这里的情况来看，我真不敢相信ASD在这件事后还留着约里特。永远不要怀疑一家公司为了赚钱能做出什么事。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdlabshuttingdown_.english: From the state of things here, I can't believe ASD kept Jorrit onboard after this. Never doubt the lengths a company will go to make money.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.chinese: 你要不干了，是吗？你不是第一个干不下去的想当调查员的人，也不会是最后一个。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.english: You're quitting, huh? Wouldn't be the first wannabe investigator who couldn't hack it, and you won't be the last.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.chinese: 听着，如果你做不来，那就是做不了，你要是不能坚持到底，就别接这工作。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.english: Look if you can't do it, you can't do it, but in the future, don't take on a job if you can't see it through.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.chinese: 所以，最终还是不做这个合约了？谢谢浪费我的时间。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdmissionabandoned.english: So, not gonna do the contract after all? Thanks for wasting my time.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.chinese: 很好。现在你拿到数据了，把它带来给我。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.english: Good. Now that you got the data, bring it to me.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.chinese: 好的。接下来你只需要把数据送到一个安全的地方就行。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.english: All right. Now you just need to drop that data off somewhere safe.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.chinese: 这就是我们要找的东西。离开那里，把它送到指定地点。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.english: That's what we're looking for. Get out of there and take it to the drop-off.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.chinese: 很好，确认提取了。现在你只需要把它带回来给我就行。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.english: Great, extraction confirmed. Now all you got to do is bring it to me.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.chinese: 看起来你已经拿到了我们需要的数据。最后一步就是尽快把它送过来。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2itemcollec.english: Looks like you got the data we need. Last step is to deliver it as soon as you can.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2missionacc.chinese: 好的，希望你准备好应对这个任务了。只要保持低调，应该就能搞定。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2missionacc.english: Okay, hope you're ready to tackle this one. Just keep your head down and you should be able to get it sorted.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2missionsuc.chinese: 好了，干得漂亮！我自己来做也不一定能做得更好。我很快会再联系你。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase2missionsuc.english: All right. That's some solid work. Couldn't have done it any better myself. I'll contact you again soon.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3arriveatsc.chinese: 好了，咱们进去看看约里特到底在搞什么。小心点。我对这家伙了解得越多，就越不喜欢他。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3arriveatsc.english: All right, let's get in there and see what Jorrit's been up to. Watch yourself. The more I learn about this guy, the less I like him.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3labexperim.chinese: 既然你拿到了那个代码，那现在可以去工程翼楼找下一个了。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3labexperim.english: Now that you got that code, you can head over to engineering for the next one.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionacc.chinese: 嘿，我是阿尔肯。客户想让你再去玛瑙设施那儿跑一遍实验。回去施展你的魔法吧。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionacc.english: Hey, it's Arken. Client wants you to run the experiment at Onyx again. Head back in and work your magic.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionacc.chinese: 嘿，我是阿尔肯。谢谢你愿意再回玛瑙设施一趟。我知道那地方不是什么好去处，但报酬绝对值得。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionacc.english: Hey, Arken here. Thanks for heading back to Onyx. I know it's not the most pleasant of places to spend a day, but the credits should more than make up for it.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.chinese: 好的，我现在正在提取研究数据。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.english: Okay, I'm pulling the research data now.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.chinese: 在那儿干得不错。客户看到我们真的搞定了这事儿，肯定激动坏了。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.english: Good work down there. Client's gonna flip their lid when they see we actually managed to pull it off.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.chinese: 拿到数据了。客户肯定会很高兴的。干得不错。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.english: Got the data. Client's gonna be thrilled. Good work.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.chinese: 数据传输很清晰。这就是我想看到的。谢谢你搞定了这事儿。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.english: The data's coming through clean. Just what I like to see. Thanks for making it happen.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.chinese: 正在接收数据。一切看起来都很好。我会转交给客户的。辛苦了。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3missionsuc.english: Getting the data now. Everything looks good. I'll pass it on. Appreciate the hard work.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3radiatione.chinese: 很好。搞定一个代码了。去研究翼楼那边找下一个。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_asdphase3radiatione.english: Good. One code down. Head over to the research wing and track down the next one.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_gravityexperiment_g.chinese: 这简直就是教科书式狂妄自大啊。真想不到有人会这么狠心抛弃自己的员工。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_gravityexperiment_g.english: Talk about a textbook case of hubris. Can't imagine anyone willing to drop their staff like that.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_regenexperiment_gp_.chinese: 那可怜的混蛋...真不敢相信有人会愿意把自己当约里特那些疯狂的点子的试验品。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_regenexperiment_gp_.english: That poor bastard… Can't believe anyone would subject themselves to one of Jorrit's crackpot ideas.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_vanduulbiomass_gp_0.chinese: 我真不敢想象约里特到底想喂这玩意儿吃什么东西。本来我就够睡不着觉了。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_vanduulbiomass_gp_0.english: I hate to imagine what sort of things Jorrit thought to feed into this thing. As if I didn't have enough trouble sleeping already.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_vanduulexperiment_g.english: What the hell… this guy's a lunatic.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_vanduulexperiment_g.chinese: 搞什么鬼...这家伙是个疯子。你那干得不错。客户看到我们真的搞定了这事儿，肯定会疯掉的。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_vanduulexperiment_g.english: What the hell… this guy's a lunatic. Good work down there. Client's gonna flip their lid when they see we actually managed to pull it off.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_wormlab_gp_001,p.chinese: 估计我们现在知道约里特从哪儿得到拉撒路的灵感了。这整个地方就是个滋生坏主意的温床。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_wormlab_gp_001,p.english: Guess we know where Jorrit got the inspiration for Lazarus from. This whole place is a breeding ground for bad ideas.

pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_yormandisample_gp_0.chinese: 我在想约里特有没有成功追查到这个样本的来源。如果他真的找到了，估计会折磨他的“宝贝”吧。
pu_amallor_civ_m_pmh_yormandisample_gp_0.english: I wonder if Jorrit ever did manage to track down where this sample came from. Probably would have tortured its babies if he did.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.chinese: 他们打得太狠了，比我预想的还猛。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.english: They're hitting us a little more than I'd like.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.chinese: 需要一些保护，宁静号已经挨了不少重击了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.english: Need some protection. Tranquility's taken some serious hits.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.chinese: 有谁肯搭把手吗，我们需要点保护。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgdamageidris75_gp_.english: If anyone can lend a hand, need some protection.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase1completedid.chinese: 应该就剩这些了。如果你需要，我们会打开舱门，让你重新补给和加油。这是我们应该做的。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase1completedid.english: Think that was the last of them. If you need it, we'll open our bay doors so you can rearm and refuel. It's the least we can do.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2introassaul.chinese: 还有一件事，那些能源中继器似乎配备了重型护盾，你可能得用能量武器以外的手段来对付它们。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2introassaul.english: One more thing, looks like those power relays are using some heavy shielding, so you might need to hit it with something other than energy weapons.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2subobjectiv.chinese: 那是最后一个冷却器。能源核心已暴露。把它毁了，我们或许能重新与我们的飞行员加布取得联系。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2subobjectiv.english: That was the last cooler. Power core's exposed. Take it out and we can hopefully re-establish comms with Gabe, our pilot.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2subobjectiv.chinese: 最后一个冷却器已被摧毁。现在你应该有机会攻击能源核心了。祝你好运。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase2subobjectiv.english: Last cooler's been taken out. You should have a shot at the power core now. Good luck

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5savepilotca.chinese: 这话听着不对劲。你得赶紧行动。另外，如果需要补给，现在就做吧。一旦剜度舰队出现，我们必须立刻撤离。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5savepilotca.english: I don't like the sound of that. You'll need to hurry. Also, if you need to restock, I'd do it now. We'll need to shell up if Vanduul arrive.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5success_gp_.chinese: 没门，加布。我要你立刻离开这里。剜度舰队正在逼近，你现在根本无力与他们周旋。马上量子撤离！
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5success_gp_.english: No chance, Gabe. You're in no condition to tangle with anyone. I want you to quantum out of here now.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5vanduulwarn.chinese: 远程传感器已锁定即将到来的目标。你最好赶紧行动。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5vanduulwarn.english: Long range sensors flagged incoming contacts. You might want to hurry up.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5vanduulwarn.chinese: 检测到剜度舰队正朝我们位置移动。还有点时间，但已经不多了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase5vanduulwarn.english: Vanduul contacts heading to our position. Got a little time but not much.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6attackmaule.chinese: 如果你愿意的话，我们打算尝试击落那艘重拳。让它在这星系里横冲直撞太危险了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6attackmaule.english: If you're up for it, we're going to try and take down that Mauler. It's too dangerous to let run loose in the system.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6escapemaule.chinese: 趁现在赶紧离开这里。我们会拖住剜度舰队。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6escapemaule.english: You should get out of here while you can. We'll hold off the Vanduul.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6escapemaule.chinese: 好吧，我们不能在这里久留了，毕竟那艘主力舰就在这儿。趁现在还能行动，赶紧进行量子离开吧。祝你好运。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6escapemaule.english: Alright, we can't afford to stick around any longer, not with that cap ship here. You should quantum away while you still can. Good luck.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6gabeescapes.chinese: 谢谢你把加布带离这里。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6gabeescapes.english: Thanks for getting Gabe out of here.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.chinese: 所有人注意！剜度主力舰刚刚出现。继续你们的工作，我们会尽可能拖住它们。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.english: Eyes up all. Vanduul cap ship just showed. Keep doing what you're doing. We'll hold them off as long as we can.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.chinese: 现场发现一艘剜度主力舰。加布，赶紧滚蛋离开这里！我们会拖住它们。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.english: Got a vanduul cap ship on site. Gabe, get the hell out of here. We'll hold them off.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.chinese: 新接触目标。一艘剜度主力舰已量子抵达这里。带加布立刻离开这里，我们来吸引它们的注意力。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.english: New contact. Vanduul cap ship just quantumed in. Get Gabe out of here. We'll get their attention.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.chinese: 剜度主力舰被击落！我真不敢相信你做到了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgphase6vanduulmaul.english: Vanduul cap ship down! I can't believe you did that.

pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgtargetencourageme.chinese: 不想催你，但我们必须把它解决掉。
pu_amartel_civ_m_mc_tsgtargetencourageme.english: Hate to rush you but we need that taken out.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.chinese: 要是你不把他们赶走，我们撑不了多久了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.english: We're not going to last much longer if you don't keep 'em off us.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.chinese: 宁静号正遭到猛烈攻击，重复，遭到猛烈攻击。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.english: Tranquility is taking heavy fire. Repeat. Heavy fire.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.chinese: 需要立即支援，我们受到了致命损伤。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris25_gp.english: Need some immediate assistance. We've sustained critical damage.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.chinese: 我的船严重受损，你得赶紧加把劲了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.english: My ship's taking some serious damage. You're gonna have to step it up.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.chinese: 得帮我们把那些碎刃帮甩掉才行。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.english: Need help getting these Shattered Blade off us.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.chinese: 这儿得靠你帮忙了，宁静号正受到猛烈攻击。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgdamageidris50_gp.english: Could use your help here. Tranquility's taking some serious hits.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsghostileskilleden.english: Shame it had to come to this.
Find peace in the next life.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsghostileskilleden.chinese: 真希望他们当初能做出不同的选择。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsghostileskilleden.english: I wish they'd made different choices.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.chinese: 听着，我们需要你的帮助。你不应该就这么跑了？
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.english: Look, we needed your help. You shouldn't just bail like that.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.chinese: 曾经承诺是有分量的。典型的 UEE 狗屁话。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.english: A promise used to mean something. Typical UEE bullshit.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.chinese: 我就知道不能指望公司代表能说到做到。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_g.english: I knew we couldn't trust a corporate rep to follow through.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_0.chinese: 所有能量重新分配到 <死亡惨叫>
宁静号要炸了，弃船 <死亡惨叫>

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1completed_.chinese: 看来我们已摆脱敌人。你来得正是时候。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1completed_.english: Looks like we're clear of hostiles. You got here in the nick of time.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1completed_.chinese: 扫描显示周边暂时没有直接威胁。
暂时应该安全了。干得漂亮。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1completed_.english: Think we're good for now. Nice work.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1introdefea.chinese: 你来自互安防务？我是人民联盟的马特尔舰长。稍后我会向你说明情况，现在必须先清除挡在宁静号面前的这些战斗机。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1introdefea.english: You from Intersec? I'm Captain Martel of the People's Alliance. I'll fill you in later, we need to clear these fighters off the Tranquility first.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1introdefea.chinese: 很高兴你能来。我叫马特尔，这艘船是宁静号。等你帮我们清除了这些战斗机，我再向你说明具体情况。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase1introdefea.english: Glad you could make it. My name's Martel and this ship's the Tranquility. Once you get these fighters off us, I'll fill you in on the situation.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefina.chinese: 这就对了。通往能源核心的舱门应该已经打开了。快去把它毁了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefina.english: That did it. Bays to the power core should be open. Go and take it out.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefina.chinese: 最后一个目标已击落。现在你应该能接近中央能源核心了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefina.english: Last one's down. You should have access to the central power core now.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefirs.chinese: 那侧所有生成器都已停摆。还有两台要处理。该侧臂的所有炮塔现在应该都失去防护了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefirs.english: All the generators in that arm are down. Got two more to go. All the turrets on that arm should be vulnerable now.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefirs.chinese: 第一个侧臂的生成器已停摆。这将使炮塔的护盾失效，但距离能触及动力核心还有两个需要解决。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damagefirs.english: First arm's generators are down. That'll disable the shields on the turrets, but two more to go until we can get to the power core.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damageseco.chinese: 那个侧臂搞定了。继续加油，把最后一个也干掉。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damageseco.english: That arm's down. Let's keep it up and take out the last one.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damageseco.chinese: 第二个侧臂已清除。只剩最后一个了。我们赢定了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2damageseco.english: Second arm's down. Just one more to go. We got this.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2targetdest.chinese: 中继器已摧毁。干得漂亮。

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase2targetdest.english: Keep it up. We're almost there.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase3introinter.chinese: 该死，检测到多架碎刃帮的轰炸机。看来他们对我们在这里的行动很不满。我们需要支援。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase3introinter.english: Dammit, picking up multiple Shattered Blade bombers. Guess they don't like what we're doing here. We're gonna need some help.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase3introinter.chinese: 碎刃帮刚派来了一大群轰炸机。你能不能搭把手？我们急需帮助。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase3introinter.english: Shattered Blade just sent a bunch of bombers. Any chance you could lend a hand? We'll need it.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase4destroypow.chinese: 干得漂亮。摧毁能源核心应该会触发全空间站超控，重置所有碎刃帮的协议。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase4destroypow.english: Great job. Taking out the power core should trigger a station-wide override which should reset all the Shattered Blade protocols.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase4reminderde.chinese: 如果我们想救回飞行员，就必须摧毁能源核心。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase4reminderde.english: We still got to take out the power core if we want to get our pilot back.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.chinese: 你最好快点行动。外面情况有点混乱。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.english: Might want to hurry up in there. Getting a little hectic out here.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.chinese: 不想打扰你，但你得赶紧行动了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.english: Hate to bother you, but you should get a move on.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.chinese: 外面的局势正急转直下。你要是好了我得走了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5remind_gp_.english: Situation's going from bad to worse out here. I'd move if you can.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5savepilotc.chinese: 我们找到你了，加布。听到你没事真好。我们这儿有帮手会把你带出来。接下来就靠你们俩一起重返自由了。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase5savepilotc.english: We got you, Gabe. Glad to hear you're alright. We got some help here who're gonna get you out of there. I'll leave it to you two to get you back in the air.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase6successcap.chinese: 我只想说，你今天真的挺身而出。我和我的伙伴们都感激你的坚韧与努力。希望有机会能在列夫斯基见到你。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase6successcap.english: Just want to say, you really stepped up today. My people and I all appreciate your tenacity and hard work. Hope to see you around Levski some time.

pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase6successcap.chinese: 我从未想过来自 UEE 的人能像这样与我们并肩作战。谢谢你。愿你找到心中的安宁。保重。
pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase6successcap.english: I never would've thought anyone from the UEE would've stood with us like this. Thank you. I hope you find peace where you seek it. Take care.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.chinese: 嘿，我是艾拉，就是弧光集团的那个。我看到你取消了合约。搞什么啊？下次只接你打算完成的合约，好吗？
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.english: Hey, this is El. You know, from ArcCorp. Saw that you canceled the contract. What the hell? Next time only take a contract you plan on doing, okay?

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.chinese: 嘿，你刚是不是退出任务了？你知道你给我添了多少麻烦吗？算了，我已经浪费够多时间在你身上了。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.english: Hey, did you just quit the job? Do you have any idea how much extra work you just made for me? Whatever, I've wasted enough time dealing with you.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.chinese: 啊，淦。这可不好。我还指望这个合约能顺利完成呢。看来今晚又得加班了...跟往常一样。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.english: Ah, dang it. That's not good. I was really counting on this contract getting done. Guess, I'm working late tonight after all… again.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.chinese: 唉，真希望结果能不一样啊。那才是我需要的。（重重叹气）我还是赶紧开始填那些该死的文件吧。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio.english: Oh wow. Wish that had gone differently. Just what I needed. [ Heavy Sigh ] I better get started on filling in the paperwork.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissionaccept.chinese: 好嘞！又来接新任务了，不错嘛。弧光集团很感谢你的付出，这些话就不多说了。尽量快点搞定，好吧？太好了，谢谢啊。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissionaccept.english: Okay! Back for another job. That's great. ArcCorp appreciates you and all that stuff. Just try to get it done ASAP, okay? Great. Thanks.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissionaccept.chinese: 嘿，我是艾拉。感谢你又接了个活儿，我相信你肯定能干得漂亮。弧光集团现在需要所有能找到的能人...什么？嗯，我这就挂了——
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissionaccept.english: Hey, it's El. Thanks for handling another job. I'm sure you'll do great.  ArcCorp needs all the competant people we can get right n- What? Yeah, I'm hanging up-

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 嘿，我是艾拉，来跟你说个进展。多亏了你，那些货物安全送到了弧光集团。辛苦了，非常感谢！
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Hey, El here with an update. Thanks to you that cargo made it to ArcCorp safely. Thanks for the hard work.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 嘿，看起来所有货物都安全送到我们这儿了。没有你的话肯定搞不定，所以真的谢谢你。希望我们很快能再合作一次。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Hey, looks like all that cargo was safely delivered to us. Wouldn't have made it without you, so thanks. Hopefully we can work together again soon.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 太完美了！看到货物顺利送达真是让人开心。你干得这么棒，应该马上再接个新合约吧，对不对？回头再聊！
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Perfect! Love to see a succesful delivery. You did such a good job you should probably take another contract as soon as possible, right? Talk soon!

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 嘿，我是艾拉。看到你顺利完成这次送货了，谢啦！如果你还能再接一单，那就更棒了。好了，我先撤了。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Hey, El here. Seeing that you were able to complete the delivery. Thanks! And if you could do another, that'd be even better. All right, gotta go.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 太好了！弧光集团感谢你完成了这次送货，而且——哎呀糟了。不好意思！我得去接另一个通讯。
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: All right! ArcCorp appreciates you completing your delivery and- Oh crap. Sorry! I have to take this other comm.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 太棒了！你把东西送来了。真高兴看到有人终于好好干活了。好了，我得回去忙了。祝你今天愉快！
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Great! You brought the stuff. Nice to see someone actually doing their job for a change. Okay, I better get back to it. Have a good one.

pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.chinese: 太好了！这次送货来得正是时候。我们真的非常需要这批货。弧光集团感谢你。下次再见！
pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple.english: Yes! Perfect timing on the delivery. Really, really needed this. ArcCorp thanks you. See you next time.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_001_h.chinese: 你好，是我，泰莎，初级制图师。有时间就来坐坐。我有东西要给你。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_001_h.english: Hello. It's me. Tessa. Junior Cartographer. Stop by when you can. I have something for you.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_002_h.chinese: 嗨，我是泰莎，我希望你有时间过来看看，有一些你可能感兴趣的事情。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_002_h.english: Hi, it's Tessa. I was hoping you might have a second to swing by. Have something you might be interested in.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_003_h.chinese: 你好，我是泰莎，希望我没有打搅你得不是时候。我突然想到了一些事情，就想到了你。如果你能来就好了。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_003_h.english: Hey there. Tessa here. Hope I'm not catching you at a bad time. Something popped up and I thought of you. Be great if you could come by.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_004_h.chinese: 嘿，我是泰莎，有件事我可以利用你，好吧，利用是个不好的词。总之，如果你有空的话，就过来吧。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_004_h.english: Hey, it's Tessa. Have something I could use you for. Well, use is a bad word. Anyway, if you're free, stop by.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_005_h.chinese: 嘿，猜猜是谁。我遇到了一些你会感兴趣的东西。有时间就来看看吧。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_005_h.english: Hey there. Guess who. Came across something that I think you'll be interested in. Come by when you can.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_fa.chinese: 听着，我不想让事情发展到这一步，但你偷了那份财产是有证据的。对不起。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_fa.english: Listen, I didn't want it to come to this, but there's a warrant on you for that property you stole. Sorry.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_fa.chinese: 你还没归还财产，现在我们只能报失了。我认为严格来说你是个小偷，所以你最好注意这一点。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_fa.english: Well, you didn't return the property, and now we had to report it stolen. I think that technically makes you a thief, so you might want to take care of that.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_ig.chinese: 嘿，呃，你还有我的一些财产。我需要你把它还给我。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_ig.english: Hey, eh, you still have some property of mine. I'm gonna need you to return it.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_ig.chinese: 看来你还拥有我的一些财产。如果你能把它带回来，那就太好了。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_ig.english: Looks like you have still have some property of mine. Be great if you can bring it back.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_la.chinese: 嘿，如果你不归还帝国制图中心的财产，我就得举报你。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_la.english: Hey, if you don't return the ICC's property, I'm gonna have to report you.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_la.chinese: 只是一句警告。如果你不归还他们的财产，帝国制图中心会举报你的。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_la.english: Just a word of warning. The ICC is going to report you if you don't return their property.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.chinese: 嘿。长话短说，我现在被攻击了，我真的需要帮助。请快点，带上武器，很多武器。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.english: Hey. Eh, Long story short, I'm being attacked right now, and I really need some help. Please, hurry. And bring some weapons. A lot of weapons.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.chinese: 求救！我是泰莎·班尼斯特，我被攻击了，需要援助。求救！S.O.S。紧急情况。另外，真碰到这种意外情况要求救感觉真的很奇怪。
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.english: Mayday. This is Tessa Banister. I am under attack. Assistance is needed. Mayday. S.O.S. Emergency. Also, it's realy weird finally making one of these.

pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.chinese: 嘿，希望你不忙，因为现在有一堆飞船在向我开火，如果你能阻止他们就好了。谢谢你！快点！
pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00.english: Hey. Eh, Hope you're not busy, because there's a bunch of ships shooting at me right now and it would great if you could stop them. Thanks! Hurry!

pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_001_.chinese: 看起来很适合你，不是吗？
pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_001_.english: Seems like a good fit for you. What do you think?

pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_002_.english: You think it's something you want to do?

pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_003_.chinese: 你如果不想去做，那你完全没必要去做。
pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_003_.english: If you don't want the job, you totally don't have to do it.

pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_005_.english: So, you think you'll do it?

pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_001_ih.chinese: 我不想这么说，不过我不觉得这会有效果。
pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_001_ih.english: I hate to say it, but I don't think this is going to work.

pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_002_so.chinese: 所以，虽然这很难说出来，但我想如果我们放弃，可能是最好的选择。
pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_002_so.english: So as hard as this is, I think it might be for the best if we just called it quits.

pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_003_lo.chinese: 听着，我试过了，我真的试过了 ，有时你不得不接受有些事情就是搞砸了。
pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_003_lo.english: Look, I tried to make this work, I really did, but sometimes you just have to accept that some things are a lost cause.

pu_banister_mg_farewell_good_ig_001_alri.english: All right. Talk to you soon.

pu_banister_mg_farewell_good_ig_004_hope.english: Hopefully I'll see you again soon.

pu_banister_mg_friendlyfire_callsecurity.chinese: 哦，你个杂种。我会让警察局会知道这个的。
pu_banister_mg_friendlyfire_callsecurity.english: Oh, you bastard. The authorities are going to hear about this.

pu_banister_mg_friendlyfire_ig_002_youre.english: You're not supposed to shoot that!

pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_004_let.chinese: 让我来告诉你一些事情。我在犹豫要去卡塞尔还是格林度假...你知道吗，算了，我还是决定吧，我决定了，就去坦格罗亚吧。
pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_004_let.english: Let me bounce something off you. I'm debating going to either Cassel or to Green for my vacation and you know what, nevermind. I just decided. Tangaroa it is.

pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_005_her.chinese: 给你讲个小知识，永远不要在关闭人工重力的情况下吃吐司，我这辈子就没有见过这么多的碎屑，真是巨大的错误。
pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_005_her.english: Here's a quick tidbit for you. Never eat toast with the gravity turned off. I have never seen so many crumbs in my life. Huge mistake.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_1stx_ig_001_tess.chinese: 泰莎呼叫陌生船只。收到请回答。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_1stx_ig_001_tess.english: Tessa to random ship. Come in random ship.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_bad_ig_002_heylo.english: Hey, look who it is... you...

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.chinese: 好吧，既然你在这里，我想必须你来做了。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.english: Well, since you're here, I guess you'll have to do.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.chinese: 哦，是你啊，我想只能这样了，在这种时候挑三拣四是没有好处的。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.english: Oh, it's you. I guess that's fine. It doesn't pay to be to choosy at times like this.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.chinese: 嘿，我碰到点麻烦，所以想请你帮个忙。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.english: Hey, I'm in a bit of a bind here, so I'm hoping you can help.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.chinese: 嘿听我说，这有点事想请你帮忙。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.english: Hey listen. There's something I need you do.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.chinese: 嘿，我几乎没别的办法了，所以我想你请你帮个忙。我真是病急乱投医啊，不是吗？
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00.english: Hey, I'm running low on options, so maybe you can help. Any port in a storm, right?

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0.english: Yes! I am so happy to see you.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0.chinese: 完美，正是我希望看到的飞行员。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0.english: Perfect. Just the pilot I was hoping to see.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0.chinese: 终于来了！我还希望你能到呢。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0.english: Finally! I was hoping you'd show.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_goaway_ig_001_li.chinese: 听着，我想我已经说得很清楚了，但如果你不再来这里我会很感激的，它只是不工作了。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_goaway_ig_001_li.english: Listen, I thought I made myself clear, but I'd appreciate it if you didn't come around here anymore. It's just not working out.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_004_woah.chinese: 哇，一次重复拜访，我也许不应该有那么深刻的印象，不是吗？
pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_004_woah.english: Woah. A repeat visit. I should probably be less impressed by that shouldn't I?

pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_005_nice.chinese: 很高兴看到一个熟悉的面孔在身边。
pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_005_nice.english: Nice to see a familiar face around.

pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_009_hope.english: Hope everything's been going all right out there.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.chinese: 虽然你没能救出之前的那艘船，但你能试一试已经很不错了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.english: Even though you weren't able to save that ship from before, it was pretty nice of you to try.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.chinese: 我听说了最后一个求救电话的情况，搞砸了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.english: I heard what happened with that last distress call. Messed up stuff.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.chinese: 你刚才试图帮的那艘船的情况实在太糟糕了，我想有时候我们做到最好也无济于事。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.english: It was too bad about that ship you tried to help. I guess sometimes our best just isn't good enough.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.chinese: 我很遗憾听到最后一艘船的事，真的很糟糕，还好你没事。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.english: I was sorry to hear about that last ship. Really sucks. At least you're okay.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.chinese: 想让你知道，我很感激你冒着生命危险去帮助那些人，即使结局不尽人意。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i.english: Wanted to let you know that I appreciate you risking your life to help those people, even if it ended the way it did.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failst.chinese: 我们现在失去了多少人？在最后一个求救信号之后，我开始怀疑我们为什么要尝试。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failst.english: How many is it that we've lost now? After that last distress beacon, I'm starting to wonder why we even try.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.chinese: 真的很可惜，关于最后一个求救信标的事，但你知道的，你不可能救下所有人，不过还是很遗憾。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.english: Really a shame that about that last distress beacon, but you know, you can't win them all. Still sad though.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.chinese: 听着，我知道我们失去了上一个飞行员，但你不能把注意力放在那上面。你已经帮助了很多人在那里。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.english: Listen, I know we lost that last pilot, but you can't focus on that. You've helped a lot of people out there.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.chinese: 在最后一个求救信标上，不要为过去的事情责怪自己，你曾经努力帮助他们了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu.english: On that last distress beacon, don't blame yourself for what happened. You were just trying to help.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_ignore.chinese: 我有点惊讶你竟然不去帮助最后一个飞行员，我真傻，以为你是那种关心有困难的人的人。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_ignore.english: I was a little surprised you decided not to help that last pilot. Guess I was silly for thinking you were the kind of person who cared about people in trouble.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 你能帮助那艘船，真是太好了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: It was nice of you to help that ship out.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 听说你在外面遇到了一些麻烦。很高兴你逃过一劫。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: Heard you got hit by some trouble out there. Glad you scraped through.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 那艘船有麻烦了...我的意思是，太空是危险的，但知道外面也有像你这样的人也很好。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: With that ship in trouble... I mean, space is dangerous, but it's good to know there's people like you out there too.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 感谢你舍己为人去救那艘船。我不知道是否有很多人会这样做。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: Appreciate that you put yourself on the line to help that ship out. I don't know if there's a lot of people who would have done that.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 我看到你救了那艘船，你可以这样就改变一个人的一生，这有点不可思议。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: I saw that you saved that ship. Kind of amazing that you can change someone's whole life like that.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 你现在救了多少艘船？一定是有记录的。你就像一个人的督导局小队一样。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: How many ships have you rescued at this point? Got to be some kind of record. You're like a one person Advocacy force.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 你帮了那么多人的忙，真让我大吃一惊。这就好像你是某种保险精灵，在保费上涨之前拯救船体。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: I'm kinda blown away by the number of people you've helped out there. It's like you're some kind of insurance fairy, saving hulls before premiums can go up.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 冒着让别人觉得你多管闲事的风险，你帮助营救了这么多艘飞船，真是令人印象深刻。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: At the risk of giving you a big ego, it's pretty impressive how many ships you've helped rescue. Good job.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 你还真能救人！我刚开始以为如果你不回应求救信标，他们可能会更好。我很高兴看到我错了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: Way to actually rescue someone! I was starting to think they may be better off if you didn't answer the distress beacons. I'm glad to see I was wrong.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.chinese: 恭喜你上一次的成功营救！在你经历了一连串的坏运气之后，这种感觉一定很不错。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes.english: Congrats on that last successful rescue! That must feel pretty good after that string of bad luck you had.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.chinese: 我猜你没能完成最后的工作，仔细想想，有点尴尬，你说过要做什么事，然后又改变主意了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.english: Guess you weren't able to finish that last job. Bit embarrassing, when you think about it. Saying you're going to do something, then changing your mind.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.chinese: 我很惊讶你取消了上一份工作， 一定是我奶奶一直抱怨的现代职业道德。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.english: I'm surprised you canceled on that last job. Must be that modern work ethic my nan was always complaining about.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.chinese: 我看到你取消了上次的工作 太可惜了 我猜你有你的理由，但还是... 哦，好吧。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0.english: Saw that you canceled the last job. That's too bad. I'm guessing you have your reasons but still... oh well.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_fail_.chinese: 看来你在上一份工作中运气不佳，下次你会成功的。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_fail_.english: Looks like you didn't have a lot of luck on that last job. You'll get 'em next time.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.chinese: 听说上次的工作很顺利。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.english: I heard that the last job went well.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.chinese: 我很高兴听到上次的工作解决的很好。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.english: I was very glad to hear that the last gig worked out all right.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.chinese: 恭喜你完成了最后一项工作。我相信那感觉一定很满足。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe.english: Congrats on pulling off that last job. I'm sure that felt satisfying.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.chinese: 次探测器没成功，是吧？呃...我想我们现在只好将就着过了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.english: No luck on that last probe, huh? Eh...I guess we'll just have to make do without for now.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.chinese: 可惜你没能部署最后一个探测器，它本来可以派上用场的
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.english: It's too bad you're weren't able to deploy that last probe. It would have come in handy.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.chinese: 我不认为部署探测器会有那么难，但我想有可能这只是取决于谁在做。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.english: I didn't think deploying a probe would be that hard, but I guess it's just one of those things that depends on who's doing it.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.chinese: 看来你在放置探测器的时候遇到了麻烦。我承认，我有一点失望，我真的很希望看到它能提供的数据。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.english: Looks like you ran into some trouble placing that probe. I will admit, I'm a bit disappointed. I was really hoping to see the data it would've provided.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.chinese: 很遗憾我们没能部署最后一个探测器，帝国制图中心真的很需要他们的扫描结果。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig.english: Shame that we couldn't get that last probe deployed. The ICC really counts on those scans.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_failstr.chinese: 又丢了一个探测器？我猜他们说的是真的。调查越多，问题就越多
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_failstr.english: Lost another probe, huh? I guess what they say is true. More probes, more problems.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_failstr.chinese: 你和这些探测器一起的时候真没什么好运气啊，一点没有，真让人印象深刻。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_failstr.english: You're really not having any luck with these probes. Like none. It's almost impressive.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 给你的快报， 你部署的探测器到现在为止运转良好。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: Quick update for you, that probe you deployed has been working out great so far.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 或许你对这事感兴趣，我们已经从你上次设置的探测器中提取了大量有用的数据，所以再次感谢你的帮助。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: In case you're interested, we've been pulling a ton of really useful data from the last probe you set up, so thanks again for your help on that.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 我想让你们知道我们从上次的探测器上得到了一些非常有趣的数据，再次感谢你们的部署。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: Wanted to let you know that we've gotten some really interesting data from the last probe, so thanks again for deploying it.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 我当班的时候花了很多时间整理上次那个探测器所得到扫描结果，里面真有一些很有趣的东西。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: I've been spending a lot of my shift pouring over scans from that last probe. There's some really intriguing stuff coming through.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 你为我们部署的探测器越多，我们对星系就了解的越清楚，这是一个巨大的帮助。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: The more of those probes you deploy for us, the clearer picture we're getting of the system. It's been a huge help.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.chinese: 你都快成为探测器专家了，不是吗？
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success.english: You're turning into quite the probe expert, aren't you.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_f.chinese: 决定回来看看我是否还活着？ 好吧，还有某人在，我很幸运。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_f.english: Decided to come back and see if I was still alive? Well, despite a certain someone, I luckily am.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_f.chinese: 我只是想告诉你，尽管遭受袭击后发生了这些，我原谅你，你尽力了，这才是最重要的。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_f.english: Just thought I'd tell you that I forgive you for what happened during the attack. You tried, and that's what matters.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_s.chinese: 我只是想再说一遍，我非常感谢你对抗那些歹徒的帮助，我不知道如果你当时没出现我该怎么办。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_s.english: I just wanted to say again how much I appreciate your help with those outlaws. I don't what I would have done if you hadn't shown up when you did.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_fail_i.chinese: 我猜你太忙了，没时间帮我调查那个未知信号，也没关系，这可能是一个我们不会再揭晓的重大发现，但我能理解。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_fail_i.english: Guess you were too busy to check out that unknown reading for me. That's fine. Could have been a huge discovery and we'll never know, but I understand.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_fail_i.chinese: 最后那个扫描没做吧？太可惜了，如果能知道外面有些啥一定很有趣。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_fail_i.english: Didn't end up doing that scan, huh? That's too bad. Would have been interesting to see what was actually out there.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.chinese: 谢谢你帮我调查这件事。真的有帮助。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.english: Thanks for looking into that for me. Really helpful.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.chinese: 再次感谢你帮我检测未知信号。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.english: Thanks again for checking into that unknown reading.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.chinese: 我得说，作为初次尝试，你已经证明了你很有本事了。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.english: I gotta say, for just being someone who flew by one day, you've proven pretty useful so far.

pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.chinese: 你还能这样帮我的话，我可能会让你成为荣誉初级制图师。
pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes.english: Keep helping me out like that, and I just might make you an honorary Junior Cartographer.

pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_complete.chinese: 哦，太棒了！你放置了探测器！让我试着和它的信号同步，就这样，完整的连接。哦，看看这些数据。
pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_complete.english: Oh great! You placed the probe! Let me just try to sync with its signal and... there. Full connection. Oh, just look at all that data.

pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_complete.chinese: 看来探测器已经就位了。剩下的就是同步我的系统，我们就可以开始工作了，太好了。
pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_complete.english: Looks like the probe is in place. All that's left is to sync my systems and we are up and running. Excellent.

pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_encourag.chinese: 不是我不喜欢你的来访，但我觉得你应该给我放个探针。一旦你准备好了，就来告诉我。
pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_encourag.english: Not that I don't appreciate the visit, but I think you're supposed to be dropping a probe for me. Once you get it in place, come and let me know.

pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_encourag.chinese: 探测器有进展了吗？一旦设置好就可以开始扫描，这将是一件令人兴奋的事。
pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_encourag.english: Any luck with that probe, yet? It'll be exciting to start scanning as soon as you have it set up.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.chinese: 向你发送求救信号的位置，情况不妙，你得帮助他们。这是太空道德之类的，对吧？
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.english: Shooting you the location of a distress beacon. It is going off hard. You gotta help them. Code of space and all, right?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.chinese: 刚刚收到求救信号，这是坐标，给你，保存。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.english: A distress beacon just went off. Here are the coordinates. Go. Save.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.chinese: 放下你手头的事，我就说四个字：求救肉包..信标..求救信标。抱歉，我没吃早饭，别管这个了。你快点去帮忙，好吗？
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.english: Drop whatever your doing. Two words. Distress bacon. Beacon. Distress beacon. Sorry. I didn't have breakfast. Forget it. Just go help, okay?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.chinese: 在这些坐标处收到求救信号。如果你去看，一定要小心。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene.english: Picking up a distress beacon signal at these coordinates. If you check it out, be careful.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.chinese: 他们被攻击了，这是坐标。你得快点！
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.english: They're under attack. Here are the coordinates. You've gotta hurry!

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.chinese: 也许你可以去帮忙？现在发送位置。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.english: Maybe you can go help? Sending location now.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.chinese: 呼，这周可真够难的。给，这是坐标，如果能去把他们救出来，那你可太优秀了。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.english: Yeah, nightmares for a week. Please, these are the cords, if you think you can help them out, it would be pretty nice of you.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.chinese: 它来自这些坐标。如果可以，你应该帮忙。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post.english: It's coming from these coordinates. You should help if you can.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.english: (frantic) I just got a comm. Here -
