pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.chinese: 问个问题，这听起来很严重，对吧？
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.english: Quick question for you. This sounds serious, right?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.chinese: 准备好迎接这令人不安的一天了吗？是的，一个星期的噩梦。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.english: Ready for your unsettling comm of the day? And, yeah. Nightmares for a week.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.chinese: 当你开始忘记太空是很可怕的时候...你会听到这样的声音——
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem.english: Just when you start to forget that space can be pretty terrible you hear something like this-

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 我在公告上看到了这个任务，我觉得可能是你的菜。发过来了。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: I picked up this job posting off the public spec and thought it might be your kinda thing. Sending it over.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 我想把这个给你看，看你是否有兴趣做些额外的工作。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: Figured I'd pass this along in case your interested in some extra work.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 我不知道你是很忙还是就在闲晃，看看这个。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: I don't know if you're busy or just out coasting, but check this out.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 找到了一份你可能会感兴趣的工作。有一个当地的工作机会很适合你，看看。我把它送过去。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: Saw a job that you might be interested in. I'll send it over.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 如果你正在找点钱，我的意思是，有谁不需要钱，有一个当地的工作机会很适合你，看看。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: If you're on the hunt for some credits, and I mean, who doesn't need credits, there's a local posting that could be perfect for you. Here.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_noavailable.chinese: 你猜怎么着？现在什么事都没有。说实话，如果你没有及时出现，我现在可能正在桌子上打盹呢。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_noavailable.english: Guess what? There's absolutely nothing going on at the moment. To be honest, if you hadn't shown up when you did, I'd probably be taking a desk nap right now.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.chinese: 我有个新位置需要放置一个探测器。你能帮忙吗？
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.english: I have a new location that we need a probe deployed to. Think you can help?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.chinese: 刚拿到一个新的探测器部署点的坐标。感兴趣吗?
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.english: Just got the coordinates for a new probe deployment site. Any interest?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.chinese: 如果你碰巧有心情部署一些探测器，那么今天是你的幸运日啦。看一看。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_gener.english: If you happen to be in the mood to deploy some scan probes, today is your lucky day. Take a look.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_lostr.chinese: 有一个探测器坏了，我希望你能帮我把它拿到空间站去。怎么说？
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_lostr.english: There's a scan probe on the fritz. I was hoping you could grab it and take it to the depot for me. What do you think?

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_repos.chinese: 我从其中一个探测器得到的所有数据都说不通。我觉得它可能需要重新布置。来，看看。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_probe_repos.english: All the data I'm getting back from one of the scan probes isn't making much sense. I think it might need to be repositioned. Here, have a look.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_unknown_ig_.chinese: 有个探测器...天哪，这数据真奇怪...我发现了一个奇怪的读数，或许值得检查一下。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_unknown_ig_.english: One of my probes... God, that's a weird lead-off... I just picked up an odd reading. Might be worth checking out.

pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_unknown_ig_.chinese: 如果你有空的话。你能检查一下这些坐标吗？扫描显示有东西，但无法识别。
pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_unknown_ig_.english: If you have a second. Could you check out these coordiates? Scans are saying something's there, but can't ID it.

pu_banister_mg_playeracceptsmission_ig_0.chinese: 很好，很高兴有你来处理。
pu_banister_mg_playeracceptsmission_ig_0.english: Great, glad you're the one handling it.

pu_banister_mg_playeractingstrange_ig_00.english: Are you feeling all right? You're acting a bit... odd.

pu_banister_mg_playeractingstrange_ig_00.chinese: 好吧，我很确信你这样不正常。
pu_banister_mg_playeractingstrange_ig_00.english: Okay. I'm pretty sure that's not normal.

pu_banister_mg_playeractingstrange_ig_00.chinese: 这是个玩笑吗？你在逗我吗？
pu_banister_mg_playeractingstrange_ig_00.english: Is this a joke? Are you messing with me?

pu_banister_mg_playercollides_ig_003_and.english: And I thought I was bad at flying.

pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ig_.chinese: 这很好，我希望能找别人来处理这件事。
pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ig_.english: That's fine. I can hopefully find someone else to handle it.

pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ig_.chinese: 如果你认为这样最好的话。
明白了。你不想接这活儿。知道了。
pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ig_.english: Got it. Not for you. Understood.

pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.chinese: 如果你改变主意的话，请告诉我。
pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.english: If you change your mind, let me know.

pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.chinese: 如果你改变注意的话，请告诉我。
pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.english: Let me know if you have second thoughts.

pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.chinese: 如果你最后还是想接这活的话，给我说一声。
pu_banister_mg_playerdeclinesmission_ope.english: Gimme a heads up if you end up deciding you want it after all.

pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_001_heremyway.chinese: 给，这就是我表达谢意的方式。
pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_001_heremyway.english: Here. My way of saying thanks.

pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_002_iwantyou.chinese: 我希望你收下这个，实在微不足道。
pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_002_iwantyou.english: I want you to have this. It's the least I could do.

pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_003_herealittle.chinese: 拿着这个，一点小意思，不成敬意。
pu_banister_mg_reward_ig_003_herealittle.english: Here. A little something to show my gratitude.

pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_001_illtra.chinese: 现在就把信用点转给你。
pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_001_illtra.english: I'll transfer the credits to you now.

pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_002_allrig.chinese: 好了，这就把你的报酬打过去，别一下子全花光了。除非是存到银行里去，这样理财比较精明。
pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_002_allrig.english: All right, sending your payment. Don't spend it all in one place. Unless you're in a bank. Then it's just good financial prudence.

pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_004_illjus.chinese: 我这就给你把报酬打过去。
pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_004_illjus.english: I'll just go ahead and send over your payment.

pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_005_okayev.chinese: 好的，我这里都没问题，马上给你打钱。
pu_banister_mg_sendpayment_ig_005_okayev.english: Okay. Everything seems good on my end, let's get you paid.

pu_banister_mg_transition_ig_004_ohihad.chinese: 额，我刚想聊点别的...是什么来着...哦！对了...
pu_banister_mg_transition_ig_004_ohihad.english: Oh, I had something else to discuss... what was it... oh! Right ...

pu_banister_mg_underattack_allclear_ig_0.chinese: 等下，打完了吗？ 他们走了吗？雷达上空了。我们成功了吗？不敢相信我们成功了。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_allclear_ig_0.english: Wait. Is that it? Are they gone? Cause the scans are clear. Did we actually make it. I can't believe we made it.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_allclear_ig_0.chinese: 好了！那是最后一个。我们成功了！
pu_banister_mg_underattack_allclear_ig_0.english: That was it! That was the last of them. We made it!
Looks like it's over for now.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_encouragedefe.english: You're doing great. Just keep shooting them.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_encouragedefe.chinese: 不是催你的意思，我们越快把他们干掉，他们炸飞的东西就越少。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_encouragedefe.english: Not to rush you, but the faster we take them out, the less likely they are to blow stuff up.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_encouragedefe.chinese: 这就对了。干掉这帮混蛋！
接着打他们！你能做到的。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_encouragedefe.english: Stay on them! You can do it.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.chinese: 糟糕，看起来他们叫了点朋友来。这对我们来说可不是什么好事。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.english: Oh no. Looks like they called in some friends. That can't be good for us.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.chinese: 扫描发现有更多麻烦正在朝我们这里赶来，哦，他们已经到了。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.english: I just picked up some more trouble coming our way, and - oh, they're here already.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.chinese: 他们的增援来了！有必要吗？
pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostilesarriv.english: Reinforcements! Like things weren't bad enough already.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostileskille.chinese: 我敢相信他们一定不太享受。
给他们好好上一课，别来招惹 ICC！
pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostileskille.english: That'll teach them not to mess with the ICC!

pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostileskille.chinese: 必须说，你战斗起来真不赖。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_hostileskille.english: I gotta say, you're not half bad at this combat stuff.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.chinese: 你真的来了，我知道你回来但你的出现还是让我高兴。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.english: You actually came. I thought you would, but still.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.chinese: 是的，真高兴能现在见到你。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.english: Yes. So happy to see you right now.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.chinese: 感谢老天，你及时赶到了。
pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerarrives.english: Thank god. You got here just in time.

pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerleaves_.chinese: 你要现在逃跑吗？认真的吗？
pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerleaves_.english: Are you actually running away, right now? Like seriously?
Where are you going? All the shooting's over here!

pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerleaves_.chinese: 嘿，你不能就这样丢下我！
pu_banister_mg_underattack_playerleaves_.english: Hey, you can't just leave me like this!

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_hostiledestroyeden.chinese: 打得不错，但别得意忘形。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_hostiledestroyeden.english: You're doing good, but don't get cocky.
You're making good progress. Stay frosty.
That's what we like to see. Solid work.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_hostiledestroyeden.chinese: 离终点又近一步，继续前进。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_hostiledestroyeden.english: One step closer to the finish line. Keep going.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.chinese: 目标击毁，你天生就是这块料。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.english: Target down. You're a natural at this.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.chinese: 不错嘛，挺有两下子，继续保持。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.english: Well, someone's Sierra Hotel. Keep it up.
Good kill. Keep on the pressure.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.chinese: 击杀确认，这才是我爱看的。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_traininghostiledes.english: Kill confirmed. That's what I like to see.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdfriendly.chinese: 发现目标。看来你扫描到了基础卫星。巡逻任务大多就是这样——检查各种东西，然后发现一切正常。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdfriendly.english: Contact. Looks like you picked up a basic satellite. That's what a lot of patrolling is about. Checking stuff out and finding everything's perfectly normal.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdfriendly.chinese: 你的扫描发现了一颗标准卫星，看起来一切正常。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdfriendly.english: Your scan's found a standard satellite. Seems like everything is in order.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.chinese: 好了，我们向下一处扫描点移动。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.english: Okay. We're Oscar Mike to the next scan point.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.chinese: 行，这个点安全了。转向前往下一个位置。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.english: All right. This point's secure. Redirect and head to the next one.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.chinese: 这个点搞定了，准备前往下一个任务区域。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_trainingsdmovetone.english: That should do it for this point. Get ready and fly to the next AO.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.chinese: 这波清完了，我已经通知下一波过来。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.english: Cleared that wave. I've signalled the next.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.chinese: 所有目标清除完毕。喘口气，下一波马上就到。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.english: All targets neutralized. Catch your breath, the next one is on its way.
Wave clear. Here comes the next.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.chinese: 清理完毕，但我又给你安排了一批。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.english: Clear up, but I got more coming your way.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.chinese: 全部清除。准备迎接下一波，这次会更难缠。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deh_waveclearedgetread.english: All clear. Standby for the next wave. It's going to be even tougher.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_hostilesarrived_gp.english: Looks like you got inbound. Weapons free.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_hostilesarrived_gp.chinese: 敌机正向你方移动，准备交战。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_hostilesarrived_gp.english: Got hostiles heading to your position. Prepare to engage.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_hostilesarrived_gp.chinese: 发现敌机，让他们尝尝你的厉害。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_hostilesarrived_gp.english: Hostiles spotted. Give 'em what you got.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.chinese: 菜鸟，欢迎。我们马上开始。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.english: Welcome, rook. We'll get started in a moment.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.chinese: 好，位置正确。待命，我正在部署你的目标。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.english: Okay, you're in the right place. Standby while I deploy your targets.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.chinese: 很好，你到位了。我通知其他飞行员，马上开始。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.english: Good. You're here. I'll notify the other pilots and we can begin.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.chinese: 欢迎来到训练场。准备就绪后我就通知大家开始。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.english: Welcome to the training site. Get settled and I'll let everyone know to start.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.chinese: 既然你已就位，我们马上开始课程。稍等。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_objectivestart_gp_.english: Now that you're in position, we can start the lesson. Standby.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_trainingdefendship.chinese: 集中精神菜鸟，我知道场面混乱，但你必须守住那艘船。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_deo_trainingdefendship.english: Try to focus, rookie. I know there's a lot going on but you got to protect that ship.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.chinese: 课程结束，今天表现不错。想继续训练随时来找我。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.english: That's it. Lesson complete. Good work today. Hopefully, I'll see you soon when you're ready to keep training.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.chinese: 漂亮！真希望更多学员有你这样的飞行技术。休息好了就来上下节课。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.english: Nicely done, rookie. I wish more of my students flew like that. Take a well-deserved rest and let me know when you're ready for the next lesson.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.chinese: 深呼吸菜鸟，你做到了。去庆祝吧，想继续训练时找我。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.english: Take a deep breath, rook. You pulled it off. Another lesson learned. Hit the showers, celebrate, and I'll see you when you're ready for the next one.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.chinese: 恭喜完成阶段课程，今天你让其他飞行员印象深刻。随时欢迎来继续训练。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missioncompletedom.english: Congrats on completing another part of the course. You impressed the other pilots out there today. I'll see you when you're ready to continue your training.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_001.chinese: 看来火候还差些。养好精神，等恢复状态再来挑战。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_001.english: Guess your skills aren't quite where they need to be yet. Rest up, and when you're back in fighting shape, you should give it another go.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_002.chinese: 这批学员可能超出你目前的飞行水平了。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_002.english: Seems like my pilots might be a bit beyond your current flying level.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_003.chinese: 虽然没通过，但别气馁——训练本就是用来提升的。重要的是重整旗鼓再试一次。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_003.english: You didn't pass that lesson, but don't feel too bad. That's what training's for, right? Important thing is you pick yourself up and try again.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_004.chinese: 没人要求你完美无缺。训练中犯错很正常，想再试时我随时恭候。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_004.english: Well, nobody said you had to be perfect. You're still training, so mistakes are bound to happen. I'll be ready when you want to give it another go.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_005.chinese: 说实话有点失望，本以为你能轻松拿下。不过下次还有机会，期待你回来继续课程。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_missionfail_gp_005.english: Not gonna lie, I'm a little disappointed. Really thought you had that one in the bag. Oh, well. Maybe next time. Hope I'll see you back for another lesson soon.

pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_trainingmissionfai.chinese: 差了口气啊菜鸟。所以这才是训练的意义，下次再战。
pu_baramsco_uee_m_pmh_trainingmissionfai.english: Too bad, rook. Really thought you were gonna come out on top that time. That's why it's called training. See you next time.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_busy_ig_001_illbe.english: Be with you in a minute.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_busy_ig_002_easeu.english: Ease up. I'm in the middle of something.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_convocont_ig_010_.chinese: 换做是我，那我肯定不会这样做。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_convocont_ig_010_.english: Its not what I would've done.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_convocont_ig_012_.english: Well I don't know about that.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_farewell_ig_006_a.chinese: 好吧，聊得很开心，以后保重。<叹气>
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_farewell_ig_006_a.english: All right. Well, good to talk to you. Mind how you go. {Sighs}

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_ig_002.chinese: 你想要喝点或来点什么东西吗？
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_ig_002.english: You want a drink or something?

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.chinese: 您想要什么? 威士忌？啤酒？或者... 威士忌就行？
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.english: What do you want? Whiskey? Beer? Or... whiskey?

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.chinese: 要威士忌吗？我有一些本地特有的产品，喝起来还不错。或者，如果你想要更内行的东西，我可以给你一杯拉德卡斯特。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.english: Whiskey? I've got some local stuff that's not half bad. Or if you want something fancier I can do you a shot of Radegast.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.chinese: 来杯啤酒怎么样？ 我有斯莫尔茨和...就这样吧。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_offerdrink_specif.english: How about a beer? I got Smoltz and... That's about it.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_playerturnsdowndr.chinese: 你知道这是酒吧吧？喝点什么吗？
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_playerturnsdowndr.english: You do know this is a bar right? For drinking?

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_playerturnsdowndr.chinese: 你要不点酒，我可没钱赚了。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_playerturnsdowndr.english: If you aren't drinking I'm not making a living.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.chinese: 你一直在关注比赛吗？ 今年有一些不错的阵容。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.english: You've been following the races? Some good line-ups this year.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.chinese: 这些剜度人让我感到恶心。我们越早消灭他们越好。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.english: These Vanduul make me sick. The sooner we wipe them out the better.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.chinese: 我一直想弄艘蜻蜓。听过不少它的好话， 惠特利都吹上天了。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.english: I've been thinking about picking up a Dragonfly. Been hearing good things. Whitley's gave it a helluva review.

pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.chinese: 你知道吗，我受够了听这些选举新闻。如果你问我这有没有好政治家，我的回答是：只有烂的和更烂的。
pu_bartender1_sk_gruff_randomchatter_ig_.english: You know, I'm sick of hearing all this election news. You ask me there ain't no such thing as a good politician. Only bad and worse.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_busy_ig_001_il.english: I'll be with you in a minute.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_busy_ig_003_so.english: Sorry I'll help you in a second.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_ig_.chinese: 有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_ig_.english: You look like you could use a drink.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 来杯像柠檬露诗之类的水果味的东西？ 或者如果你想要更具异国情调的酒，我可以为您调一杯腥红闪击。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: Something fruity like a Lemon Lush? Or if you want something more exotic, I can do a Crimson Blitz.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 如果你想放松一下的话，我可以给你来一杯泰拉茶。劲很大，但是能让你倒头就睡。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: I can make a mean Terran Tea if you're looking to unwind. Strong, but goes down easy.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 你尝过巴努贱卖吗？ 这酒在这备受好评。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: You ever try a Banu Firesale? It's a pretty popular shot around here.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 另外，如果您感兴趣，我们有全天特价的饮料：半价的卡塞利托斯。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: Also, if you're interested, we've got an all-day drink special: half off Cassellitos.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_playerordersdr.english: Perfect. Let me get that for you.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.chinese: 好的，你要是改主意了就告诉我一声。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.english: Okay. Let me know if you change your mind.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.chinese: 你要是有什么需要的话，我一直在这儿。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.english: I'll be here if you need anything.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 今天早些时候我只能跟别人合乘一辆载具去上班...没有自己的载具真是不方便。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: Had to take a HOV into work today... can be rough not having your own transport.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 你觉得亚塔队的阵容怎么样？昨晚的比赛可真是太精彩了。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: How about that Jata lineup? Last night was one hell of a match.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 我听说穆雷杯的这个赛季已经成型了，有很多新的飞行员加进队伍。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: I hear this Murray Cup season's shaping up. Got a lot of new pilots in the ranks.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 你刚刚听了毕晓普上将的演讲吗？是不是很鼓舞人？我都想着要冲去报名了。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: You catch that speech that Admiral Bishop gave a little while back? Pretty intense right? I almost thought of signing up.

pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 我寻思我们有机会得办一个小游戏之夜，肯定好玩。
pu_bartender2_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: I think we might be starting one of those trivia nights here soon. Could be fun.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_busy_ig_001_il.english: I'll be with you in a minute.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_busy_ig_003_so.chinese: 抱歉，我马上来为您服务。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_busy_ig_003_so.english: Sorry I'll help you in a second.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_ig_.chinese: 有什么我能为您做的吗？
你看上去很想来一杯啊。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_ig_.english: You look like you could use a drink.
Well, what can I get you?

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 你是想要水果味的饮品，像是柠檬露诗？还是说你更愿意喝点独具异域特色的，那我能帮你调一杯猩红闪击。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: You want something fruity like a Lemon Lush? Or if you want something more exotic, I can do a Crimson Blitz.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 渴望放松的话我能做一杯特伦茶给你。浓烈，但很容易下肚。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: I make a mean Terran Tea if you're looking to unwind. Strong, but goes down easy.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 你可曾尝试过巴努贱卖？它可是我们这里很受欢迎的特调。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: You ever try an Banu Firesale? It's a pretty popular shot around here.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.chinese: 还有，你要是感兴趣，我们这里还有一款今日特价饮品：半价卡塞利托斯。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_offerdrink_spe.english: Also, if you're interested, we've got an all-day drink special: half off Cassellitos.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerordersdr.chinese: 好极了，让我帮你调这一杯。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerordersdr.english: Perfect. Let me get that for you.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.chinese: 好的，你要是改主意了就告诉我一声。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.english: Okay. You let me know if you change your mind.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.chinese: 你要是有什么需要的话，我一直在这儿。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_playerturnsdow.english: I'll be here if you need anything.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 今天早些时候必须得和别人挤一辆载具上班...没自己的车有时候真是麻烦。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: Had to take a HOV into work today... can be rough not having your own transport.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 你觉得亚塔队的阵容怎么样？昨晚的比赛可真是太精彩了。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: How about that Jata lineup? Last night was one hell of a match.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 我听说穆雷杯的这个赛季已经成型了，有很多新的飞行员加进队伍。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: I hear this Murray Cup season's shaping up. Got a lot of new pilots in the ranks.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 你刚刚听了毕晓普上将的演讲吗？是不是很鼓舞人？我都想着要冲去报名了。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: You catch that speech that Admiral Bishop gave a while back? Pretty intense right? I almost thought of signing up.

pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.chinese: 哦我真是爱死这首歌了。
我寻思我们有机会得办一个小游戏之夜，肯定好玩。
pu_bartender3_sk_friendly_randomchatter_.english: I think we might be starting one of those trivia nights here soon. Could be fun.

pu_battaglia_mg_busy_ig_001_iminthe,p.chinese: 我正忙着呢，下次再聊吧。
pu_battaglia_mg_busy_ig_001_iminthe,p.english: I'm in the thick of it. Maybe some other time.

pu_battaglia_mg_busy_ig_002_domea,p.english: Do me a favor and come around some other time, all right?

pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.chinese: 没有金刚钻，别揽瓷器活。
pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.english: Better to say no then to take on a job you can't handle.

pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.chinese: 如果你改变主意的话，请告诉我。
pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.english: If you change your mind, let me know.

pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.chinese: 这份工作还会在这里保留一段时间的，你可以重新考虑考虑。
pu_battaglia_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemiss.english: The job will most likely be here for a little while if you reconsider.

pu_battaglia_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig.english: Let's go ahead and call that last job done.

pu_battaglia_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig.chinese: 所有东西都已经检查过了，合约已经完成了。
pu_battaglia_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig.english: Wanted to let you know that everything checked out. Consider the contract complete.

pu_battaglia_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_.chinese: 我有一份想要你来做的新工作。
pu_battaglia_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_.english: Got word of a new job that I like you for.

pu_battaglia_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_.chinese: 我们现在这里事情很忙，需要你这样的人。
pu_battaglia_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_.english: Things are pretty busy right now and I could use someone like you.

pu_battaglia_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002.english: Uploading your pay to you now.

pu_battaglia_mg_convorejoin_ig_001_decid.english: Decided to give it another go, huh?

pu_battaglia_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_youre.chinese: 现在你又打算听我话了？

pu_battaglia_mg_decide_encouragelookandd.chinese: 你看看有没有什么不对的地方。
pu_battaglia_mg_decide_encouragelookandd.english: Have a look, see if it's right for you.
Read through and let me know.

pu_battaglia_mg_decide_warningmissiontim.english: I'm going to need a decision.

pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_001_icanalways,.chinese: 我只要通过他们进来时的神态动作就能判定他们能不能成功。
pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_001_icanalways,.english: I can always tell when someone's got a good strike or not. Just by how they fly in.

pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_002_iheardan,p.chinese: 我听一个老前辈说过，你喜欢看跳舞，我记忆好着呢。
pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_002_iheardan,p.english: I heard an old timer say once that you loved to watch the dance. Stuck with me.

pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_003_ishouldbe,p.chinese: 虽然我现在已经习惯了，但当有一队人迟到时，我还是会忍不住有点焦虑。虽然99%的情况下都没什么就是了。
pu_battaglia_mg_idles_ig_003_ishouldbe,p.english: I should be used to it by now, but I can't help getting a bit anxious when a team's running a bit late. 99% of the time it's nothing.

pu_battaglia_mg_interrupt_ig_002_comeonn.english: Come on now. That's how it's gonna be?

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d1_00.chinese: 是吧？其实没什么可看的，但是酒吧里卖的东西都很烈， 小心别喝大了，否则你的行李可能醒来都没了。
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d1_00.english: Yeah? Not much to see, but the bar serves up a solid bit of firejuice. Just be sure not to lose all your wits, or your belongings might go with them.

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_a_.chinese: 非常好，我现在就扫描一下。
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_a_.english: Great. I'll take a scan through now.

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_b_.chinese: 好吧，如果你改主意了，你知道在哪能找到我。
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_b_.english: Well if you change your mind, you know where to find me.

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_su.chinese: 如果你愿意的话我现在就能给你找几个事情做。不是什么特别大的活，但是我们可以看看一起合作能不能合得来。你觉得怎么样?
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_d3_su.english: If you'd like I can see to setting you up with something now. Nothing too big, but it'll let us see how we feel about working together. Sound all right to you?

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_resol.chinese: 好的， 如果你还需要什么别的，跟我说就行。
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_resol.english: All right. If you need anything else, let me know.

pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_start.chinese: 我在这附近没见过你。我们这虽然平时人来人往，但我记人的本事很不错的。你来这有什么事?
pu_battaglia_mg_intro_1sttime_v_wp_start.english: Don't think I've seen your face around these parts before. We get our fair bit of traffic but I make a point of knowing who's who. What brings you around?

pu_battaglia_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 感谢你的辛苦付出，上一份工作完成得不错。
pu_battaglia_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: I appreciate a hard worker, nice work on that last job.

pu_battaglia_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 我想跟你说上一份合约完成得很好。
pu_battaglia_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: I wanted to say that you did a good job on that last contract.

pu_battaglia_mg_mission_farewell_mission.english: Keep your wits about you, you hear?

pu_battaglia_mg_mission_farewell_mission.chinese: 希望你能找到适合自己的东西。
pu_battaglia_mg_mission_farewell_mission.english: Hope you find something that suits you.

pu_battaglia_mg_mission_greetings_good_i.chinese: 嘿，我正盼着你会回来呢。
pu_battaglia_mg_mission_greetings_good_i.english: Hey, I was hoping you'd swing around again.

pu_battaglia_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.chinese: 你在这儿干嘛？我以为这时候你应该在收尾你的合约呢。
pu_battaglia_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.english: What are you doin' here? Figured you'd be out finishing up the contract by now.
Taking your sweet time on that contract, aren't you?

pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.chinese: 一些亡命之徒把当地当成了自己的狩猎场，我需要你帮我照料一下外面的那些人。
pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.english: Some outlaws have been using a local stretch as their own hunting ground. Need you to look after some people of mine out there.

pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.chinese: 很多人在附近遇到了麻烦，我想你可以出去看看。
pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.english: A lot of people have been running into trouble nearby. Figured you could go out and take a look at it.

pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.chinese: 不幸的是，最近没什么进展。不过，如果有任何情况，我都会告知你的。
pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.english: Unfortunately, things are a bit slow right now. I'll keep you in mind if anything turns up though.

pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.chinese: 我找不到给你的工作，不过情况应该很快就会好转。
pu_battaglia_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.english: I'm not seeing anything I can give you. Things should pick up soon enough though.

pu_battaglia_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_.chinese: 今天事很多，如果有你能找到喜欢的任务，欢迎。
pu_battaglia_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_.english: There's a bunch of stuff cooking right now. If one works for you, you're welcome to it.

pu_battaglia_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_.chinese: 我们有很多合约需要处理，你可以随便挑。
pu_battaglia_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_.english: Got a lot of contracts that need doing. You can take your pick of the litter.

pu_battaglia_mg_requestnewmission_search.english: There may be a contract I could toss your way.

pu_battaglia_mg_requestnewmission_search.chinese: 我看看能不能找到点什么。
pu_battaglia_mg_requestnewmission_search.english: Let's see what I can dig up.

pu_battaglia_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig.english: Here are the details for you.

pu_battaglia_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig.chinese: 现在就把合约上传给你。
pu_battaglia_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig.english: Uploading the contract to you now.

pu_battaglia_mg_transition_commenttogivi.english: All right, let's get down to business...

pu_battaglia_mg_transition_commenttogivi.chinese: 但你不是来听我唠嗑的吧...
pu_battaglia_mg_transition_commenttogivi.english: But you're not here to listen to me chatter are you...

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1findroc.chinese: 嘿我是雷科。看起来你在那片区域了。看来你正好在附近。你得扫描一下才能知道矿物具体在哪儿。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1findroc.english: Hey. Recco here. Looks like you're in the area. You'll have to scan to see where the minerals are.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1miningc.chinese: 这下差不多了。你天生就是干这行的料。回家吧。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1miningc.english: That should do it. You're a natural at this. Come on home.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockcra.chinese: 太好了。现在你已经把岩石击碎了，需要切换模式才能将其提取出来。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockcra.english: Great. Now that you've cracked the rock, you'll need to switch modes in order to extract it.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockfou.chinese: 在那儿。那就是你要找的东西。现在你只需要收获它。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockfou.english: There. That's what you're looking for. Now you just gotta harvest it.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body2fo.chinese: [停顿] 是啊，那是梅根...就在上周她还说想少跑几趟这种任务。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body2fo.english: [pause] Yeah, that's Meg… Just last week she was talking about doing fewer of these runs.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body3fo.chinese: 确认了。那是 TJ...抱歉，这种事一直都让人难以接受，你懂吗？
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body3fo.english: Confirmed. That's TJ… sorry, this never gets easier, you know?

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2gettheb.chinese: 嘿...里面没看到开普勒...对不起，艾萨克·开普勒。你能把飞船的黑匣子取回来吗？我们看看他是不是跟他们一起出发的。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2gettheb.english: Hey… I'm not seeing Kepler in there... Sorry, Isaac Kepler. Can you grab the ship's black box and we can see if he set out with them?

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2mission.chinese: 你好啊，我是雷科。这边有点情况，如果你能帮忙的话就太好了。如果可以的话就请通过你的手环接受任务吧
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2mission.english: Hi there. It's Recco. Got a bit of situation here if you're able to help. Accept it through your mobi if you can.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.chinese: 太好了。把数据带回来给我，我看看里面有没有提到艾萨克遭遇了什么。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.english: Great. Bring that data back to me and I can see if there's any mention of what happened to Isaac.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.chinese: 这就对了。你现在应该能进去了，不过要小心点。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.english: That did it. You should be able to get inside now. Just be careful.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.chinese: 你应该试试去找他们的服务器房间。也许我们能在那儿查出艾萨克遭遇了什么。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.english: You should try to find their server room. Maybe we can find out what happened to Isaac there.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.chinese: 就在那儿。如果你访问那个终端，就可以下载残留的冰碛帮数据。可能需要花一点时间。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine.english: Right there. If you access that terminal. You can download any lingering Moraine data. Might take a little bit.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 嘿，是我。我觉得这事儿能成。现在过去把艾萨克带回列夫斯基吧。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: Hey, it's me. I think this is going to work. Head over there now and bring Isaac back to Levski.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 你当然可以。我们大家都犯过错。成为家人的一部分，就是能够包容它们。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: Of course you can. We've all made mistakes. Part of being family is looking past them.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 听着，我这边有人正朝你的位置赶去。他们会把你带回来，我们好好谈谈。好吗？
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: Look, I've got someone heading to your position. They'll bring you back in and we'll just talk. Okay?
Sit tight, they'll be there soon.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 好了，我们开始了。接通通讯。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: Okay, here we go. Starting the comm.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 我们自己人要互相照应，艾萨克，你知道的。到底出什么事了？
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: We look after our own, Isaac. You know that. What's going on?

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.chinese: 我想知道炫目希望号上到底发生了什么。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans.english: I want to know what happened on the Blinding Hope.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3mission.chinese: 嘿，我是雷科。不知道你方不方便，关于艾萨克的情况我有个想法。看看你的手环。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3mission.english: Hey, it's Recco. I don't know if you're free, but I've had an idea about the situation with Isaac. Check your mobi.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3moraine.chinese: 好的，返回服务器房间，我们可以开始了。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3moraine.english: Okay, head back to the server room and we can get going.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_chatter_gp_001.chinese: 还凑合吧，毕竟现在有很多新承包商过来，管理起来有点费劲，不过还能应付。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_chatter_gp_001.english: Been doing okay, considering. We've been having a lot of new contractors come through, so it's a little tough to manage but we're getting by.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_chatter_gp_002.chinese: 打算休个假，但就是不知道去哪干点啥。
pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_chatter_gp_002.english: Looking into taking a bit of time off. Just can't seem to decide what to do or where to go.

pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_chatter_gp_003.chinese: 最近这个星系越来越有意思了。好像我一转头，就有人来打探。

pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_huntpolarispolarisflee.chinese: 你们自己应付这些民防部队吧，回合点再见。
pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_huntpolarispolarisflee.english: You all deal with these CDF. Meet at the rendezvous.

pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_missioncompletepolaris.chinese: 别以为这就完了。少了一艘北极星，也动摇不了我们必须做的事，边境战士一定会做到底，这点你放心。
pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_missioncompletepolaris.english: Don't think that's the end of us. One Polaris doesn't change what needs doing, and the Frontier Fighters will see it through. You can count on that.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 你杀的可不是什么罪犯，那是真心希望帝国变得更好的人，而且还是我的朋友。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: That wasn't some criminal you killed. That was someone who wanted the Empire to be a better place. They were also a friend.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 真希望那些指使你干脏活的人拍拍你脑袋时，能让你觉得这一切都值了。你害死了一个好人，别忘了这点。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: I hope the pat on the head your handlers give you for doing their dirty work is worth what you've taken away. You killed a good person. Remember that.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 边境战士会一直战斗下去，不管你在这儿干了啥。我们不会忘记倒下的同伴，可谁又会记得你呢？
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: Frontier Fighters are going to keep on fighting. Regardless of what you've done here. We remember our fallen. Who will remember you?

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 我希望你能记住他们的名字，真的。希望这名字一直缠着你，直到哪个混蛋一枪崩了你的脑子。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: I hope you remember their name. I really do. I hope it haunts you until some scumbag puts a bullet in your brain.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 都到了这地步，你还是看不到我们想做的好事。我没法让你明白，但总有一天，等我们赢了，你也许就懂了。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: Even after all this, you can't see the good we're trying to do. I can't make you see, but one day, when we've won, maybe you'll understand.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: （停顿数秒）你刚刚杀了一个朋友，一个相信帝国能变得更好的人。是你亲手毁了他们，这账算在你头上。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: (long 2-3 pause) You just killed a friend. Someone who believed in a better Empire. You took them away. You did that.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 他们下场就是所有想拦我们的人的下场。你给我记住了。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: They got exactly what will come to anyone who tries to stop what we're doing. Remember that.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 别以为你今天干成了什么事，你们根本挡不住我们。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: I don't care what you think you accomplished today. You aren't going to stop us.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 你们别想找到我们，就算真找到了，我们的声音也绝不会被掐掉。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: You're not going to find us. Even if you do, our message will not be silenced.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 别做梦能从那个叛徒嘴里撬出什么了，我们可没那么好打发。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: Don't think for a second you'll get anything from that traitor. We aren't going away that easy.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.chinese: 那家伙在找你之前就想拿情报勒索我们，说到底不过是为了钱罢了。他根本没什么信念，也不信任何东西。你们休想通过他找到我们。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc.english: They tried blackmailing us with that intel before coming to you. They just wanted money. They had no cause. Nothing to believe in. You won't find us.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你们到底有完没完？说白了不就是被公司和钱拽着走的狗吗？
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: Why the hell won't you leave us alone? You're just a slave to the credits and corporations who hold your leash.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你本该跟我们并肩作战，结果倒好，偏要跟那些杀人犯和腐败政客同流合污。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: You should be fighting with us instead of against us, but you'd rather throw in with murderers and corrupt politicians.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你真以为这事能这么结束？我们要是死了，派罗那帮不法分子和渣滓只会变本加厉地杀戮。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: How the hell do you think this is going to end? If we die, the outlaws of Pyro and the scum just like them will just keep on killing.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你现在那些道德说教都哪去了？刚才被你伏击干掉的可都是我的朋友，他们不过想让这宇宙更安全点罢了。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: Where's all your moralizing now? You just ambushed and killed friends of mine who were just trying to make the universe safer.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 别再骗自己了，你还觉得自己干的是好事？现在的你不过是个专挑好人下手的杀人犯。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: I hope you're not still deluding yourself to think that you're doing the right thing here. Now you're just an assassin, killing good people.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你搞清楚自己在干啥吗？你这是在断了那些还能重生的人的活路。赶紧住手吧。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: You realize what you're doing? You're making it harder for the people who can still regen. Just stop.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 你们毁了医疗床还有脸谈正义？真是恶心到我了。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: How dare you say that you are just when you destroy medical beds. You make me sick.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.chinese: 我从没想过 UEE 能堕落到这种地步。连同胞的重生机会都要剥夺，让我觉得这个帝国根本不值得救。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc.english: I never thought the UEE could sink as low as this. Stopping your fellow humans from being able to regen makes me think that the Empire isn't worth saving.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.chinese: 哟，找到我们了？行啊，来吧，让我看看派罗的走狗有多能耐。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.english: So, you found us, huh? Well come on then, let's see what Pyro's lapdogs can do.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.chinese: 这不就是你想要的吗？那就别废话，上呗。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.english: This is what you wanted, right? Let's go then.

pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.chinese: 躲躲藏藏的日子我早就过够了。今天就看看，你是不是真敢为这星系里的渣滓送死。
pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase3part1tauntpla.english: I'm sick of laying low. Let's see if you're ready to die for the scum of the system.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 我是布罗根。你想干啥都行，但我得实话实说，如果你老这样撂挑子，我可要花更长时间才能进行政休息室了。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Brogan here. Do what you gotta do, but I'll be honest, it's gonna take me a lot longer to get to the exec lounge if you keep dropping jobs like this.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 我是杰克。所有顶尖公司能保持地位，是因为他们说到做到。这从高层开始，一直贯彻到底。你听明白了吗？
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Jake here. All the top companies stay that way because they deliver what they promise. That starts at the top and goes all the way down. You hear me?

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 叮铃铃，舒宾来电。刚看到你又接了个合约。记得仔细看任务细节，合理安排时间，应该能顺顺利利搞定。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Ring, ring, Shubin calling. Just saw you picked up another contract. Be sure to read the details and manage your time well and it should go off without a hitch.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 我是舒宾的杰克·布罗根。很高兴看到你又接了新合约。咱们用 PAT 原则：准备、行动、彻底。祝你好运！
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Jake Brogan from Shubin here. Glad to see you pick up another contract.  Let's use the PAT approach: Preparation, Action, and Thoroughness. Good luck.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 嘿我是布罗根。你...你...太棒了！我就这么一句。你简直无敌了。工资已发，好好享受吧。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Brogan here. You… you… hell yeah. That's all I got. You're crushing it. Sent your pay. Enjoy it.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 嘿，这里舒宾。为你干得漂亮，我请你喝杯冰镇的。工资应该已经到账了，要是没收到，随时喊我。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Hey, it's Shubin. Crack a cold one on me for a job well done. Payment should be sent. Give a holler if it isn't.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 舒宾的杰克来电。坏消息，我得把这活儿从你这儿撤了。我知道挺难的，但就当是次学习经验吧。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: Jake calling from Shubin. Bad news. I gotta pull the job from you. It's tough I know, but use it as a learning experience.

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 这里是舒宾。我看你这次合约怕是完不成了，所以我先撤了。下次咱们拿出真本事，行不？
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: Shubin here. I don't think you're gonna be able to complete this contract so I'm gonna pull it. Let's bring our A-game next time, huh?

pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 嘿，我是布罗根。看来这合约要泡汤了，我得取消它。下回咱加把劲，把这次的损失补回来。
pu_brogan_shu_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: Hey, it's Brogan. Looks like that contract's gonna be a bust, so I'm gonna cancel it. Let's bring our game up for the next one to make up for it.

pu_brunt_mg_busy_ig_001_notnowim.chinese: 不是现在，我还要准备下场比赛呢。
pu_brunt_mg_busy_ig_001_notnowim.english: Not now, I'm getting ready for the next race.

pu_brunt_mg_busy_ig_002_whateveritis.chinese: 不论你有啥事，先等下。我手头上已经有够多要处理了。
pu_brunt_mg_busy_ig_002_whateveritis.english: Whatever it is you want, save it. I've got enough to deal with.

pu_brunt_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission_i.english: That's what I like to hear.

pu_brunt_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_.chinese: 如果你改变心意了，尽快让我知道，差事可不等人。
pu_brunt_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_.english: If you change your mind, let me know quick, but the offer isn't gonna stick around long.

pu_brunt_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_.chinese: 如果有其他想法，就告诉我，还是有机会能解决这事的。
pu_brunt_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_.english: Let me know if you have second thoughts. We still might be able to work things out.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_001_.chinese: 好吧，或许我的“到此了结”说的有点草率，是时候让你重返赛道了。
pu_brunt_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_001_.english: All right, maybe I was a little hasty with the whole 'we're done' thing. Maybe it's time to make your racing comeback.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_002_.chinese: 我把事情重新理了个遍，或许你还是值得再给一次机会的。
pu_brunt_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_002_.english: I've been thinking things over and maybe you deserve one more chance.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001_s.chinese: 有空的话就顺道来看看我。
pu_brunt_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001_s.english: Stop by the track when you can.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_002_m.english: Make sure you come see me, okay?

pu_brunt_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_003_s.chinese: 顺道路过就来和我聊会吧。

pu_brunt_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_004.chinese: 这就是我想看到的，这圈不错。
pu_brunt_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_004.english: That's what I like to see. Good race.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_gota.chinese: 我这待会有场你能参加的比赛。
pu_brunt_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_gota.english: Got another race coming up that I could use you for.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_this.english: This next race could use your special touch.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_newmission_ig_004_imig.english: I might have something for you.

pu_brunt_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_003_her.english: Here's your credits. You earned them.

pu_brunt_mg_convorejoin_ig_001_trytopay.english: Try to pay attention this time.

pu_brunt_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_nowyouwan.english: Now you want to listen? Fine...

pu_brunt_mg_decide_encouragelookanddecid.chinese: 如果有兴趣的话，告诉我一声。
pu_brunt_mg_decide_encouragelookanddecid.english: Let me know if you're interested.

pu_brunt_mg_decide_warningmissiontimeout.chinese: 快点，这趟马上就要开始了。
pu_brunt_mg_decide_warningmissiontimeout.english: Hurry up, the race is gonna start soon.

pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d1_001_y.chinese: 是啊，没什么能比得上这。我试过自己来，但我没有“那个东西”。懂不？总之，祝你好运，行吧？
pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d1_001_y.english: Yeah. Nothing quite like it. I tried to make a go of it myself, but I didn't have that 'thing.' You know? Anyway, good luck out there, Okay?

pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_a_001.chinese: 让这动荡不安的世间更稳些，在你拿定心意前，我也就说这么多了。
pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_a_001.english: Make an uncertain world a little more certain. That's all I can say tilI I know if you're in or not.

pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_b_001.chinese: 行。这就是自由的帝国，对吧？祝你下圈比赛顺利。
pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_b_001.english: Sure. Free empire, right? Good luck in your next race

pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_c_001.chinese: 很好。你准备下待会比赛，等你坐进驾驶位了我再和你说细节。
pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_c_001.english: Good. Get ready for your next race and I'll explain the details once you're in the cockpit.

pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_subst.chinese: 有什么你感兴趣的不？更多信用点？
pu_brunt_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_d2_subst.english: Is that something you'd be interested in? More credits?

pu_brunt_mg_intro_winrace_1sttime_v_wp_0.english: What a finish! Wanted to say congrats.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good.chinese: 听着，你一直都挺可靠的，但我们不能让上次比赛发生的事再次重演。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good.english: Listen, you've been pretty dependable, but we can't let what happened last race happen again.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good.chinese: 我知道你之前为我做了不少好事儿，所以我想上场比赛只不过是偶然罢了，别让这成习惯，好不？
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good.english: I know you've done some good work for me, so I'm willing to chalk that last race up as a fluke. Let's not make it a habit okay?

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neut.chinese: 你上圈比赛咋了？给你个这么小的事都处理不好。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neut.english: What happened that last race? I gave you one small task and you couldn't even handle that.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neut.chinese: 我搞不懂为啥你上圈比赛能整出这么多差错。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neut.english: I'm still trying to wrap my head around on how that last race went so sideways.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstrea.chinese: 你知道你的连败让我赔了多少不？
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstrea.english: Do you have any idea how much this losing streak of yours is costing me?

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstrea.chinese: 你最近把事都搞得一团糟，我都开始觉得，跟你对赌都能赚的比较多。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstrea.english: With how much you've been screwing things up recently, I'm starting to think that I'd make more credits betting against you.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_killed_ig.chinese: 你上场比赛伤的挺重的，很高兴你没缺个胳膊少条腿。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_killed_ig.english: Tough break in that last race. Glad to see you're back on your feet.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchanc.chinese: 虽有违我的判断，但我愿意给你最后一次机会。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchanc.english: Against my better judgement, I'm gonna give you one more try.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_.chinese: 如果我指望不上你，那也没啥好说的了，就这样，到此了结。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_.english: If I can't count on you, then we got nothing to talk about, so we're done.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_.chinese: 你已经让我失望太多次，这对我来说已经没有好处了。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_.english: You let me down too many times. You're no good to me anymore.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_e.chinese: 上场比赛你飞得可厉害了，我就知道能指望你。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_e.english: That was some sick flying last race. I knew I could count on you.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_e.chinese: 你真该听听上圈结束后其他人都怎么说的，那些飞行员都不知道自己被啥打中了。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_e.english: You should've heard all the talk after the last race you did for me. Those other pilots didn't know what hit 'em.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_g.chinese: 知道不，你上次比赛表现的还不错。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_g.english: You know, I cleaned up quite nicely on that last race you did.
Bang up job on that last race.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_successst.chinese: 最近你可是无往不利，百战百胜啊是不。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_successst.english: You've been on a bit of a hot streak for me with these last few races.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_successst.chinese: 上圈比赛结束后，我就开始觉得没什么能难得了你了。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_successst.english: After that last race, starting to think there isn't nothing you can't do.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder.chinese: 不知道你发生了啥，但不论如何，搞定它。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder.english: I don't know what's gotten into you, but, whatever it is, fix it.

pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder.chinese: 你就这点能耐吗？我是说，如果是，那就别在这浪费你我的时间了。
pu_brunt_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder.english: Is this really the best you can do? Because, if it is, then save us both some time and just walk away.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_damni.chinese: 去你的，这趟没戏唱了，干的漂亮哈，冠军。
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_damni.english: Damn it, the race is over. Way to go, champ.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_doyou.chinese: 你知道你刚让我赔了多少不？
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_doyou.english: Do you have any idea how many creds you just cost me?

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_002_.english: There's been a change of plans.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_001.chinese: 认真？这节骨眼跑来整这茬？
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_001.english: Seriously? You're gonna screw me like that.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_002.chinese: 你觉得这算几个意思？你可不能就这样拍屁股走人。
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_002.english: What the hell do you think you're doing? You can't drop out like that.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_00.chinese: 你时间不多了，速战速决。
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_00.english: You're running out of time. You need to do this now.

pu_brunt_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_00.chinese: 赛道快跑完了，加把劲，快。
pu_brunt_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_00.english: Not much track left. Time to make your move.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missionacce.chinese: 快点到你的船上去。比赛前我会保持联系的。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missionacce.english: Hurry and get to your ship. I'll be in touch before the race.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missionacce.chinese: 一旦你下了赛道，我会把详细情况发给你。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missionacce.english: I'll send you the details once you're down on the race course.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missiondecl.chinese: 不管怎样，我想我们两清了。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_farewell_missiondecl.english: Anyway, I think we're done here.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_002.chinese: 我很忙，所以我们需要速战速决。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_002.english: I'm busy, so let's make this quick.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_003.chinese: 快点，让我们快点处理掉这事。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_003.english: Come on, let's hurry and wrap this up.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_00.chinese: 哇，这不是我的幸运符吗？
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_00.english: Well, if isn't my lucky charm.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_00.chinese: 你还好吗？ 一切都好吗？
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_00.english: You doing all right? Everything good?

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_i.chinese: 见鬼，你不是要过来吗？我们之间的活，吹了。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_i.english: What the hell aren't you getting here? I'm done working with you.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_i.chinese: 如果你是来比赛或赌博的，没问题。但别指望能从我这得到什么了。
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_i.english: If you're here to race or gamble fine, but don't expect anything else from me.

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissi.chinese: 你不是应该去开着你的船去比赛吗？ 见鬼，你还在等什么？
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissi.english: Shouldn't you be getting your ship for the race? What the hell you waiting for?

pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissi.chinese: 你忘了吗？你应该去竞速，就在现在！
pu_brunt_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissi.english: You forget? You're supposed to be racing. Right now.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_nohelp_ig_003_so.english: Sorry, there's nothing I can do.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_requestleave_ig_.english: I've had enough you. You're done. Get out of here.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_requestleave_ig_.chinese: 你以为自己是谁啊？别人还在排队呢。
pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_requestleave_ig_.english: You know you're not the most important person in the 'verse. There are other people waiting.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_suggestterm_ig_0.chinese: 呃，你觉得那些终端机是干嘛用的？
pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_suggestterm_ig_0.english: Uh, what do you think those terminals are for?

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_suggestterm_ig_0.chinese: 终端机就在那边，自己搞定。
pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_suggestterm_ig_0.english: Terminals are over there. Figure it out.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_takealook_ig_001.english: Okay, yeah. Give me a second.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_takealook_ig_002.english: All right. Let me take a look.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_takealook_ig_003.english: Fine. I'll see what I can do.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_takealook_ig_004.english: Yeah, yeah. I get it. Hold on.

pu_bureaucrat4_sk_bored_waityourturn_ig_.english: Wait in line like everyone else.
You have to wait in line.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_boarding_announcethr.chinese: 操！有个王八蛋上我船了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_boarding_announcethr.english: Damn it! The bastards are on my ship!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 有时我会想，我为什么选择了这种生活。可能是因为当一个文员一点都不刺激。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: Sometimes I wonder why I chose this life. Guess being an accountant wasn't stressful enough.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 只要我回地面就直奔最近的酒吧，就这样吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: As soon as I touch down, I am heading straight for the nearest bar, tell you that much.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 我受够了这些想抢走我辛辛苦苦赚的钱的“自由工作者”们。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: I am so sick of these freeloaders trying to make a quick cred off my hard work.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 想起这些天打的仗，也许我该加入海军。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: With the amount of fighting I'm doing these days I might as well have joined the Navy.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 感觉这些不法分子每年都会控制更多的帝国区域。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: Feels like these outlaws take over more of the Empire every year.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 他妈的，需要海军的时候从来看到不到他们。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: Where's a damn Navy fleet when you need one.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 你最好叫一帮赏金猎人来帮忙，这样我就不用那么累了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: With all these attacks it's almost getting to the point where it would cost me less just to hire a squad of mercs.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 听着，如果你很穷，有很多比这个更好的方法来赚钱。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: Listen, if you're down on credits there's got to be a better way earn them than this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 我不清楚你私底下在搞什么蠢事，但是你错大发了，我知道你自己心里清楚。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: I don't know what kind of personal shit you got going on, but what you're doing isn't right. And I think deep down you know that.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 还不算晚，你还是能够远离这些事。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: It's not too late you know. You could still fly away from this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 你还要做出多少错误的决定才会放弃？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: How many bad decisions did you have to make to wind up here?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.chinese: 也许揍你一顿才能让你脑袋清醒。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_commsilence_.english: Maybe serving a stretch will help you get your head back on straight.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 她看起来很糟糕，不过还能撑会儿。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: She's a little chewed up, but functional.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 情况比之前更糟糕了，但我们现在至少还在飞嘛，对吧？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Definitely been better, but at least we're still flying, right?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 该死，我们在坠落，重复，我们在坠落
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Dammit, we're down. I said, we're down.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 我失去控制了，重复，我失去控制了
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: I've got not control. Repeat. No control.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 我只有最后一发导弹了
这就是我最后一发导弹了
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Gonna need to make this missile count.
My engines are really torn up.
Our engines are barely hanging on.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 我的护盾生成装置起宕机了
我的护盾生成装置下线了

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Looks like our ammo count's real low.
Don't have a lot of shots left.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 我们的剩余燃料不足了

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Yeah, I'm running on fumes here.
I only got a couple missiles left.
Kinda light on missiles at the moment.
Jeez, our ammo counters really go.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 情况比我想的要糟糕多了
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Kicked around a lot more than I'd like.
Shit, we're dead in the water.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 失去控制，重复，失去控制
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Lost control. Repeat. Got no control.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 靠，护盾生成装置起宕机了
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: Dammit. We lost our shield generator.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 想要干掉她这可远远不够。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: It'll take a lot more than that to take her down.
Taken some hits, but still kicking.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.chinese: 那就是我们最后一发导弹了。

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_statusupdate.english: My thrusters are really torn up.
Our thrusters are barely hanging on.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 这可会是一场硬仗，保护好你自己，可千万别莽撞。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: With the amount of force they have, this is gonna be a tough fight. Be careful and for the love of god, use your head.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 他们看起来可不好惹，但我们也不是吃素的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: They may be stronger than us, but... well, I'm not sure what the but is. We just have to do the best we can.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 接下来可能会有点疯狂。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: I think we might be a bit outgunned here.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 看起来会是一场胜负难分的比赛，不过我肯定会拿下头筹。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: Hard to say who's gonna come out on top here. It's gonna be a close one.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 这可不是闹着玩的，冷静下来。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: This looks like it's shaping up to be a long drawn out brawl. Pace yourselves.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 我们还挺默契的，这会帮助我们走的更远。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: We seem pretty evenly matched. This is gonna come down to experience and keeping a level head.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 看起来他们不是我们的对手，但可别大意了，千里之堤溃于蚁穴。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: It may look like we got them outclassed, but stay sharp. Mistakes destroy more ships than missiles do.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 我知道我们比他们强多了，但是盲目自信只会把人引向地狱。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: I know it seems like we got them dead to rights, but overconfidence is a hell of a way to wind up dead.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.chinese: 哈哈，撞上我们，他们肯定很绝望。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_chatter_tacticalsitu.english: Geez. They must be pretty desperate to be jumping all of us.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.chinese: 该死，那看起来可不轻松，你还好吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.english: Damn, that looks like it hurt. You good?
Watch yourself. You gotta be careful.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.chinese: 你感觉怎么样？那看起来很糟糕。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.english: What's your status? That looked nasty.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.chinese: 我的天啊，希望你人没事。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.english: Hell of a bump. Hope you're okay.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.chinese: 天呐，也许我该坐回去看着你自取灭亡。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.english: Hell, I might just sit back and let you kill yourself.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.chinese: 我靠，那看起来会很痛苦。

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_aplayer_tan.english: You should think about doing that again, but harder.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_aen.english: Next one won't be so gentle.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Hey, watch it.
Watch where you're flying.
Look where you're going!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 如果你再来一次，你知道后果。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Do that one more time and we're gonna have a problem.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 我发誓如果你敢再攻击我一次的话...
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: I swear if you hit me one more time...
Why the hell do you keep doing that?
Careful!
Look out. Look out!
Watch it!
Damn it! Whose side are you on?
Getting real tired of you hitting me.
You seriously hit me again? Enough already!
Great flying, jackass.
You forget how your trigger works?
You sure you wanna do this?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 看来有些人很喜欢用下下作手段。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Someone likes to fight dirty.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 和我光明正大的打，蠢货。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Fight me like a real pilot, coward.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 喜欢这样？去他妈开个剜度船来。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Get yourself a damn Vanduul ship if you like to fight like this.
Check your flight path!
Ease up!
Where'd you learn to fly?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 我发誓你肯定又撞了我一次！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: You ram me one more time, and I swear that's it!
You do that again and you'll regret it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 我再说最后一遍，离我的船远点。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: I won't tell you again, keep clear of my ship.
Out of my way!
Clear out!
I ain't got time to deal with your nonsense!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 如果有必要，我会连你一起解决。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: I'll fight you too if I have to.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 再来一次，你会得到你想要的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: Hit me again and you're asking for it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.chinese: 你再攻击我一次，我们之间的麻烦就大了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_collided_vehicle_apl.english: You hit me again, and we're gonna have a problem.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_damagedea.chinese: 我对你有信心，赶紧解决这事。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_damagedea.english: I've got faith in you. Just get it done.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_damagedea.chinese: 我们遇到过比这更糟糕的情况。

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_damagedea.english: Just dig in and lash out.
Not the time to lose faith.
Don't worry, we're in this together.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_destroyed.english: That was closer than I would've liked.
Geez. I was worried I wasn't gonna make it out in one piece.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_destroyed.chinese: 你没必要跟我们打，对吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_destroyed.english: Any fight you can walk away from, right?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_destroyed.chinese: 兄弟，肾上腺素使我手抖个不停。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_destroyed.english: Man, my hands are shaking from all the adrenaline.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.chinese: 看看咱能不能给这些清道夫上一课。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.english: Let's see if we can't teach these scavs a lesson.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.chinese: 你在这，挺不错。现在开始干活吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.english: Good. You here. Now get busy.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.chinese: 集中注意力解决眼下的问题。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engagearr.english: Let's focus on the problem at hand.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engageope.english: Keep it together and don't get sloppy.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engageope.chinese: 好了，让我们动起来，让这些混球知道该怎么做。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_commentary_engageope.english: All right, Let's work together and show these scavs how it's done.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_confirms_help_aally_.chinese: 让我看看我能做些什么。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_confirms_help_aally_.english: I'll see what I can do.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 我们快撑不住了，现在来帮忙还不算迟。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: We're on our last legs. Need support now before it's too late.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 没有支援我们撑不了多久！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Won't last much longer without some back-up!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 在我们成渣之前帮帮我们!
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Help before we're blown to bits!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 小心，他们有地面防空火力。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Watch out. They've got ground support.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 小心，正在遭受来自行星表面的攻击。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Careful, taking damage from planetside!
Got hit by ground fire!
Dammit, that one hurt.
We're getting ripped to shreds here.
Get this bastard off of us!
Taking damage!
Coming under fire.
We got hit.
You should leave while you still can.
Time for you to find a new line of work.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 你真是个蠢货，敢跟我打。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: You're a damn fool for picking a fight with me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 我不是个好下手的目标，对吧?
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Not such an easy target, am I?
Remember, this all your fault.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 看来你可能会需要一艘新船了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Looks like you're gonna need a new ship.
I'm gonna pick you apart.
There you are.
You deserve every bit of this.
How's that feel?
Right there!
I told you to leave me alone.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 我觉得你最好现在重新考虑一下。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Rethinking things now, I bet.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 你是不是以为我是软柿子。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Bet you thought I was easy pickings.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Hey! They're with us!
Cease fire. That's a friendly.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 看清楚你的目标。那是友军。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Check your target. That's a friend.
Hey, what the hell are you shooting at?
What the hell?
Hey! Lay off the trigger!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 听着，我不会再重复一遍了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Look, I'm not telling you again.
Do that again and I'm returning fire.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 如果有必要我会干掉你。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: I'll defend myself if I have to.
Check your fire!
I'm a friendly.
I'm on your side!
Have you lost your mind?! Stop shooting.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 你他妈是不是有什么毛病，我们是一伙的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: What the hell's your problem? We're on the same side.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 停火！重复，停火！否则我将反击。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Stop shooting. Repeat. Stop shooting. Or I'll return fire.
Go on. Finish them off!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 小心点，那船可还没沉呢。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Careful, that ship's busted but still deadly.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 在他们反应过来前赶紧杀绝。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Clean it up quick before they can strike back.
Nice shooting.
That was a thing of beauty.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 漂亮，他们很快就不会是麻烦了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Good work. They won't last much longer.
You sure you want to do this?
Stop... please.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 我发誓，如果我死了，你很快就会来陪我。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: I swear, if I go, you're coming with me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 呵，你还真是坏的彻底，喜欢趁人之危。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Yeah, you're real bad, hitting a ship that can't hit back.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 你不会这样做吧，求你了，还有人在家等着我回去。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: You ain't gotta do this. Please. I got people waiting on me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 够了！我们现在对你没有威胁！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Enough! We're no threat to you now!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 哪种王八蛋会喜欢趁人之危？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: What kind of sick bastard shoots a disabled ship?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 我保证你会被追杀到宇宙的尽头。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: I'll make sure you're hunted to the end of the 'verse for this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 停手！我们已经失去动力和反击能力了，你没有理由那样做。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Stop! We can't fly. We can't shoot. There's no cause for this.
Good, but not good enough.
Gotta admit, that one hurt.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 看看你对我的船做了些什么！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Look what you did my ship!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 没有什么是刷个漆不能解决的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Nothing a new paint job won't fix.
That'll buff right out.
Enjoy it while you can.
Come on, come on!
Shit!
You aren't giving up, are ya?
Time to return the favor.
You're not half bad.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 让我们看你怎么解决其他人！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Let's see how you handle dealing with them too!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 真幸运，我可不是一个人。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Lucky for me, I'm not alone.
Guess who's got back up?
Hey, watch your targeting.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 小心点，注意你在朝谁射击。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Careful, where you're shooting.
The hell you shooting them for?
What the hell? Was that on purpose?
What you messing with me for?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 你他妈看清楚后再动手。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Check your damn targeting.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 你再来一次，我不会手软的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Hit me again and we won't be so friendly.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 别射击我了，我不会重复了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: Stop shooting me. I won't say it again.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.chinese: 我不是你的敌人，至少在你再发病前。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer_.english: I'm not your enemy, but hit me again and I will be.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 我的护盾快玩完了，来点火力掩护！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: My shields are down. Need some cover fire!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 护盾需要重新充能，掩护我！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: Shields need to recharge. Cover me!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 帮我一把！我需要为护盾重新充能。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: Give me a hand! I'm recharging my shields.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 让我看看没有护盾后的你有多懦弱。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: Let's see how you fair without any shields.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 没有护盾你活不了多久了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: Not gonna last long without your shields.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 你的龟壳没了，接下来就是你了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: There go your shields. The rest of your ship's next.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 哈，不过是一层护盾。那又怎样？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: Yeah, you got my shields, so what?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.chinese: 你觉得我需要护盾这玩意？就你？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshie.english: You think I need shields against you?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_tally_fr.english: Won't last long at this rate!
Ship's toasted. Not much left in her!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_damagedealt_tally_fr.chinese: 我们马上就要被撕碎了！

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_denies_combataction_.english: Kinda in the middle of something.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: You see that? Took one of them out!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 你们现在落单了，你确定你们还要这样做？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: You're all alone now. You sure you want to do this?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 你也看到你朋友的下场了，你没必要也步他后尘。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: You saw what happened to your friends. No reason it has to be your fate too.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 他们只剩最后一艘船了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: They're down to their last ship.
I think that's all of them.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 区域清空，他们曾存在过。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: Area looks clear. That might've been it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 扫描结果确定，我想我们搞定他们了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: Scans look good. I think we made it through.
Guess it's down to just us then.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 如果你认为我不敢独自作战，你错了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: If you think I'm scared to fight on my own, you thought wrong.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.chinese: 你还得把我干掉，我不会放弃的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_aa.english: You're gonna have to go ahead and take me out too. I ain't giving up.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.chinese: 糟糕，我们损失了一艘船。
我们不能让他们再击毁我们的人了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.english: We can't let them take out any more of us!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.chinese: 操啊！不！我们损失了一名队友。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.english: Damn it! No! That was one of ours.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.chinese: 在我们干掉你们之前你还可以选择离开。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.english: You can still stop this before I have to hurt any more of ya.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.chinese: 你选择了开始，而我会很快结束这一切。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ae.english: You started this, but I'm damn well gonna settle it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 你个王八蛋！你做了什么？！

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: What in the 'verse possessed you to do that?!
I owe you one for that.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 这下他们领教我们的厉害了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: That'll teach 'em for messing with us.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 真不想这样，但迫不得已啊。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: Hate to see it, but it needed to be done.
You won't get away with that.
I'll see you burn for that!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 你就是清道夫啊！真是便宜他们了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: You scav! They didn't deserve to go like that.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 谢谢你！能遇到好心人真是太棒了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: Thank you! Nice to know there's still good folks out here.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 我们刚刚是不是杀人了？
我靠...我错过了什么吗？你为什么这么做？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: What the- Did I miss something? Why'd you do that?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 你不能随便乱杀人。要承担后果的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: You can't go around just killing anybody you want. There's gonna be consequences.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.chinese: 靠，你他妈为什么要这样做？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_ap.english: Whoa, why the hell did you do that?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_arrivingreinf.chinese: 看看我能不能帮你扳回一局。
