pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_arrivingreinf.english: Let's see if I can't help even the odds.
Looks like you're causing some trouble.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_arrivingreinf.chinese: 看来你挺喜欢别人找你麻烦啊。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_arrivingreinf.english: Let's see how you like it when someone picks on you.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.english: They got the drop on us!
Look out! They're right on us!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.chinese: 见鬼！这些他妈混蛋哪来的啊？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.english: Damn it! Where the hell did these neekos come from?
That's what you get for not paying attention!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.chinese: 看来你得换个更好的雷达了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.english: Looks like you need a better radar on that thing!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.chinese: 你的观察力不太行，是吧？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_attackfromste.english: You're not the most observant, are you?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.chinese: 我的扫描仪没发现目标。你发现什么了吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.english: My scanner's clear. You got something?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.chinese: 你到底想不想打他们啊？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.english: Are you even trying to hit them?
Come on, open your eyes and hit something!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.chinese: 你这命中率我都开始觉得你和他们一伙的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.english: With the amount you're missing I'm starting to think you're on their side.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.chinese: 描边射击是吓不到他们的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apla.english: You aren't gonna scare 'em off with missing them.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_openhostiliti.chinese: 来吧。让他们看看我们的厉害。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_openhostiliti.english: All right. Show them who they're dealing with.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_openhostiliti.chinese: 准备好了吗？我们动手吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_openhostiliti.english: Ready or not. Let's do this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.english: Oh that is fucking it. I've had enough.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.chinese: 去他妈的，我忍你很久了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.english: Screw it. I'm tired of your shit.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.chinese: 到此为止，我已经受够你了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.english: That's it. I have had enough of you.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.chinese: 我忍了好久了，该结束了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_engage_switchtohosti.english: I've stayed my hand long enough. This ends.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aenem.chinese: 这不是我第一次表演了，废物。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aenem.english: This ain't my first rodeo, punk.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aplay.english: All right. I see how it's gonna be.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_interdicted_aally_fr.english: Damn it! They got a net up!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_interdicted_aally_fr.chinese: 注意！他们设置了拦截力场。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_interdicted_aally_fr.english: Look sharp. They got an interdiction field up.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_aal.chinese: 让我们看看他们多喜欢这个。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_aal.english: Let's see how they like that.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_aen.english: You should'a just left us alone.
You picked the wrong ship to mess with!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_apl.english: Why the hell you firing at them?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_apl.chinese: 嘿！他们和我们是一伙的。
你在干什么？他们是盟友。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_apl.english: What are you doing? That's a friendly.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_apl.chinese: 老天啊。去打他们，别打我。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_launched_missile_apl.english: Oh come on. Shoot them, not me!
Shoot missiles at the bad people.
Oh, I see. Making this serious.
Goddammit, I see how it is.
That's uncalled for if you ask me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 你为什么不往后退一点呢！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: Why don't you back off a bit!
Hey, I'm trying to fly here!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 能不能他妈的给我腾个地！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: How about you give me some god damn room!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 不介意的话你看看你都到哪了？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: You mind watching where you're going?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 保持自己的飞行路线，好吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: Keep to your own flight lane, okay?
Hey, how about a little space?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 我不会说第二遍的，退后。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: I'm not gonna tell you again, back off.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.chinese: 我说最后一次，离我远点。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_ap.english: Last time I'm gonna say it, get away from me.
What don't you understand, fly the hell back.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 我的飞船不能再装了，对不起，我得抓紧离开这里。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: My ship can't take much more. Sorry, I need get out of here while I still can.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 这艘船就靠螺栓和祷告撑着了。我得走了，不然就太迟了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: This ship is hanging on by a bolt and a prayer. I got to go before it's too late.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 很抱歉，但我处理不了这个。祝你好运。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: I'm sorry, but I can't deal with this. Good luck.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 这已经失控了，我不干了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: This is getting out of hand. I'm done here.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 面对现实吧！我们输了。都结束了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: Face it! We're losing. This is over!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 我们根本没有机会，我不干了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: We ain't got a chance in hell of pulling this off. I'm done.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 就凭你刚刚扯的那堆废话，我他妈绝对不会再和你一起工作了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: No way in hell I'm working with you after that crap you just pulled.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 离我他妈远点你这傻逼。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: Get the hell away from me you murdering piece of shit.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 我受够你了，我们结束了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: I've had just about enough of you. We're through.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 我想我已经竭尽所能了。我们的合作结束了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: I think I've taken all I can of your shit. Consider this relationship over.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 我不能和罪犯同行，我们合作结束了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: I can't be flying with no criminal. We're done.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.chinese: 如果你想到处违法犯罪，那是你自己的事，但我不参与。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aally_.english: If you want to go around breaking the law, that's on you, but I ain't going to be a part of it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.chinese: 你认真的？你就这么把我自己晾在这？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.english: Seriously? You're just gonna leave me hanging?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.chinese: 你和我开玩笑呢吧。你就这么自己跑了把我自己扔在这？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.english: You got to be kidding me. You're just gonna leave me high and dry like that?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.chinese: 嘿！我以为我们是一起的呢！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.english: Hey! I thought we were in this together!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.chinese: 我勒个去？我们有协议的！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_quit_contract_aplaye.english: What the hell? We had a deal!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_rearm_aally.chinese: 我应该暂停修整一下，以防万一。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_rearm_aally.english: I should probably stop and restock, just in case.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_rearm_aally.chinese: 不清楚你的情况，但我需要修整一下。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_rearm_aally.english: Don't know about you, but I need to stock up.
I need to restock my weapons.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_refuel_aall.chinese: 我需要补充燃料才能继续。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_refuel_aall.english: I need to refuel before we do anything else.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_refuel_aall.chinese: 我马上就得停下来加油了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_refuel_aall.english: I'm gonna have to stop and refuel soon.
Gonna need to top off my fuel soon.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_repair_aall.english: I need to hit up a repair shop.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_repair_aall.chinese: 我们挺过去之后可能要修修飞船。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_requests_repair_aall.english: Ship could use a repair if we pass one.
I'm gonna have to repair my ship.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_continue_a.chinese: 别再躲了，让我们来个了解吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_continue_a.english: Stop hiding and let's get this over with.
What are you playing at? Come on out!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_continue_a.chinese: 你躲哪儿了？我可没有时间和你墨迹。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_continue_a.english: Where'd you go? I don't got time for this nonsense.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_lostcontac.chinese: 你看到他们去哪儿了吗？
我跟丢了，有人看到了吗？
我的雷达上看不到他们。
我有更好玩的事要做，没时间和你墨迹。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_searching_lostcontac.english: Good. I have better things to do than fight your sorry ass.
Yeah, you better get out of here...

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_dangerousenv.english: Coming up on a tricky patch.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_dangerousenv.chinese: 挺危险的，往那边飞要小心。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_dangerousenv.english: Be careful flying through here. It's a bit hairy.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemyfinishe.english: Don't let the airlock pinch you on the way out!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemyfinishe.chinese: 希望这是我最后一次看到他们的臭脸。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemyfinishe.english: Hope that's the last I see of their sorry face.
So long you criminal piece of shit!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.english: Guess they decided they had enough.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.chinese: 他们正在为量子驱动器充能！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.english: They're spooling up their quantum drive!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.chinese: 看样子他们正在充能准备量子航行了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.english: Looks like they're spooling to QT!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.chinese: 我识别到他们启动量子驱动器了！
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_enemystartin.english: I'm picking up some signatures from their QT drive!

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_missileclost.chinese: 见鬼，这导弹快把我搞死了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_missileclost.english: Dammit. Missile's got me dead to rights.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Got some help coming our way.
Damn glad to see some reinforcements.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 该死，看来他们需要支援。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Crap. Looks like they called for reinforcements.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 见鬼！他们来了更多的支援。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Damn it. We got more ships coming in.
Shit, they called for back up.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 叫支援了哈？自己整撑不住了哈？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Called for back up, huh? Not good enough to finish the job yourself?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 你到底在哪找了这么多愿意帮你的白痴？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Where the hell did you find more idiots willing to help you?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_signal_aally.chinese: 呃...我的扫描器发现了点东西。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_signal_aally.english: Huh... think I got something on my scanner.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 如果你们想和我较量一下，那我会让你们后悔的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: If you all are thinking about attacking me, let me just say that'd be a mistake.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 我还以为这趟能平安无事呢。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: And here I was thinking this might be a relatively quiet trip.
Well... let's get this over with.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 这样出其不意不太好啊。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: Ain't nice to sneak up on someone like that.
Woah, where the hell you come from.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 这明智吗？你一个人出来的？
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: Is that smart? You being out here by yourself?

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 我本来希望自己再也不会遇到混球了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: And here I was hoping I wouldn't run into any more scum.

pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.chinese: 听着，我们可以就这样离开，不找麻烦。
pu_cacaptain01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aene.english: Look, we can just pass on by, don't need no trouble.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.chinese: 我到这里来就是个该死的错误，我早该知道的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.english: This is my own damn fault for flying through here. Should have known better.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.chinese: 前两次我路过这个地区什么都碰到，但我想运气迟早会用光的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.english: Last two times I came through this area, nothing, but I guess my luck had to run out sooner or later.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.chinese: 不是我马后炮，我是真不该飞这条线的，简直就是羊入虎口了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_dangeroussec.english: In hindsight, I should never have come through this way. It was a goddamn rookie move flying through an area this dangerous.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.chinese: 如果你不管怎样都会被突袭的话，那飞过安全区域又有什么意义?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.english: What the hell's the point of flying through secured sectors if you're just gonna get jumped anyway?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.chinese: 我在这纳税，而那些政府混蛋甚至都懒得保证航道安全。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.english: Here I am paying taxes, and those government bastards can't even bother to keep the shipping lanes safe.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.chinese: 整个区域都要完蛋了。就算在航线上飞行都免不了碰到掠食者。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_safesector_a.english: This whole sector's going to hell. Can't even fly the shipping lanes without running into scav bastards.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.chinese: 这太他妈挤了，连思考的空间都没有，更别说行动了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.english: It's too damn tight in here. Barely have room to think, let alone move.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.chinese: 他们能选个更糟糕的地方打仗吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.english: Could they have picked a worse place to fight?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.chinese: 该死的，我需要更大的飞行空间。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_smallcombata.english: Damn it. I need more space to maneuver.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_valuablecarg.chinese: 现在的得分可是平时的十倍，我得把握住。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_valuablecarg.english: I'm carrying about ten times the creds I normally haul. I can't afford to lose it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_valuablecarg.chinese: 我工作太久太辛苦了，不能失去这么高价值的东西，我绝对不会把它交给这些混蛋的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_valuablecarg.english: I worked too damn long and hard to lose a haul this valuable. There's no way I'm just gonna hand it over to these creeps.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_volatilecarg.chinese: 你不用再担心了，但我这里的材料不是很稳定，如果我受到太大的冲击就废了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_volatilecarg.english: Not that you need anymore to worry about, but the material in my hold isn't the most stable. I take too big of a hit and the whole thing could go.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_volatilecarg.chinese: 说实话，我船上带了一大堆炸药。如果我受到太大的冲击...那对谁都没好处。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_chatter_volatilecarg.english: I'll be frank with you. I'm carrying a shit-ton of explosives onboard. If I take too big a hit... well, it won't be good for anybody.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_confirms_followupmis.chinese: 谢谢你！我就知道你靠得住。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_confirms_followupmis.english: Thank you! I knew I could count on you.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_confirms_followupmis.chinese: 太好了，听到这个很高兴。
完美，我就知道你靠得住。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_confirms_followupmis.english: Perfect. I knew I could count on you.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 我的情况很糟，需要你搭把手。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: I'm in a bad way. Need you to step up and handle this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 情况看起来很糟，如果你有什么锦囊妙计，那是时候出手了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: Things are looking pretty dire. If you got something up your sleeve, now's the time.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.chinese: 我需要你立刻反击，现在！
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_damagedealt_aenemy_t.english: You need to make a stand right here, right now. This is it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_denies_followupmissi.chinese: 我还希望你会说点别的呢，但没关系的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_denies_followupmissi.english: I was hoping you'd say otherwise, but no hard feelings.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.chinese: 好吧，我们的起航了，有很多日程要做的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.english: All right. I need to head out. Schedule to keep and all that.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.chinese: 好吧，我们应该继续前进了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.english: Okay, time we should be moving on. Be good.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.chinese: 我要继续上路了，你注意安全。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tplay.english: Guess I should be on my way. Stay safe.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.chinese: 修理出了点小问题，还需要点时间！
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.english: Hit a bit of a hiccup on the repairs, gonna need some more time!

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.chinese: 该死的溢流给堵住了！修理的时间要长一点！
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.english: Damn overflow backed up on us! Repairs are gonna be a bit longer!

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.chinese: 重启系统时备份失败了，还需要更多时间来修复。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairs_aally.english: Backup blew when we tried to restart the system. Gonna take a little more time to fix.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsalmost.chinese: 修理工作差不多完成了，应该不会太久。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsalmost.english: Repairs are almost done. Shouldn't be much longer.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsalmost.chinese: 差不多修好了，再给我们一点时间！
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsalmost.english: It's almost fixed. Just give us a little more time!

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsdone_a.chinese: 谢天谢地，我们可以启动运行了!
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsdone_a.english: Ah, thank heavens. We're up and running!

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsdone_a.chinese: 全部修复！至少目前没问题。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_inform_repairsdone_a.english: All fixed! For now at least.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_launched_missile_apl.english: God damn that's a lot of ordnance.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_launched_missile_apl.chinese: 我不是那种喜欢指手画脚的人，但你一大堆导弹都射空了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_launched_missile_apl.english: I'm not one to tell people how to live, but you shot a shit-ton of missiles there.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_launched_missile_apl.chinese: 你刚才发射了一堆什么贵玩意？
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_launched_missile_apl.english: Hell of a doomsday spread you just launched.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 如果我没撑下来，你得帮我完成任务。这很重要，听到了吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: If I don't make it out of here, you have to finish my job. It's vital, you hear me?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 如果那些混蛋杀了我，我要你继续完成我的工作。你能做到吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: If those bastards finish me off, I want you to carry on and finish my job. Can you do that?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 无论我发生什么事，这个活都必须完成。你能坚持到底吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Whatever happens to me, this job's got to be finished. Can I trust you to see it through to the end?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 我们解决了那些拾荒者，但我希望你能继续和我一起飞以防有更多的麻烦潜伏。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: We took care of those scavs, but I was hoping you'd keep flying with me just in case anymore trouble is lurking.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 有兴趣接着陪我一起吗？看来我们合作不错，很舒心。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Hey, any interest in seeing me the rest of the way? Seems like we work pretty well together and it'd give me some piece of mind.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 我就一说哈，如果你不忙的话，是否可以继续雇你充当眼线？报酬很合适。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Just an idea, if you aren't too busy, how about hiring you as an extra set of eyes the rest of the way? I can get you some proper pay.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 听着，如果我撑不过去。我需要你帮我做件事。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Listen, if I don't make it. There's something I need you to do for me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 我不确定能不能撑过去。如果出事了，我需要你帮我做件事。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Hey, I'm not sure I'm getting out of here. And if I don't, there's something I need you to do.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 听着，如果我出事了，我能托付你帮我处理些事吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Listen, if something happens, can I trust you take care of something for me?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 换个话题，我一个朋友一直在找像你这样有能力的人来做兼职。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: Just to change subjects, a friend of mine's been looking for someone with your skills for a gig.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 你知道，我不确定你的日程安排是什么样的，但如果你感兴趣的话，我可以会给你一份工作。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: You know, I'm not sure what your schedule's like, but I might have a job for you if you're interested.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.chinese: 我知道现在日子不好过，所以我得问问你。我接了一份自己没法干的活，你要是感兴趣可以给你。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_offer_followupmissio.english: I know times are pretty lean these days, so I gotta ask. There's a job I got sent that I can't do. You can snag it if you want.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attackobjectiv.chinese: 目标是你的了，干掉他们。

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attackobjectiv.english: You gotta take out the objective now.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attackobjectiv.chinese: 需要你攻击目标，快动手吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attackobjectiv.english: Need you to hit the objective. Get to it.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.chinese: 我需要你帮我对付目标。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.english: Need your help on my target.
Come on. I need your help here.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.chinese: 我一个人做不到，帮我把它们干掉。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.english: I can't do it alone. Help me take 'em out.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.chinese: 抓紧时间！来一起把他们干掉。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_attacktarget_a.english: Get on the clock! Let's take 'em out.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.english: Gonna need you to protect the target.
What are you doing? Help them.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.chinese: 你没听见吗？快保卫目标。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.english: Didn't you hear me? Defend the target.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.chinese: 保护目标，不过要躲开敌人的视线。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.english: Protect the target. Make sure you stay out of sight though.
Keep an eye on the target. But keep quiet.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.chinese: 跟住目标，潜行模式，明白吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_defendtarget_a.english: You watch the target. Low sig. Get me?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_holdposition_a.english: Hey, I said to stay where you are.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_retreat_aally_.english: We should get out of here.
I'm thinking we should fall back.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_retreat_aally_.chinese: 我讨厌这样，我们该走了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_retreat_aally_.english: I'm not liking the look of this. We should bounce.
What the hell are you doing? Get out of there!

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_retreat_aally_.chinese: 你疯了吗？快离开那鬼地方。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_order_retreat_aally_.english: Have you lost your mind? Get the hell out of there.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.chinese: 不管了，他们想干啥干啥吧。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.english: Hell with it. I'm just gonna give 'em what they want.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.chinese: 我不想这么做，但我别无选择，我会按他们要求做的。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.english: I hate to do this, but I don't think I have a choice. I'm gonna give in to their demands.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.chinese: 受够了，如果他们这么执着...那他们随便吧，我更想活着。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_quit_givein_aally_tp.english: Enough. If that want this so bad... they can just take it. I'd rather be alive.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.chinese: 注意！如果有人收到消息，我们正在遭受攻击，急需帮助。不知道我们还能坚持多久。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.english: Attention! If you hear this, we are under attack and are in desperate need of help. Not sure how long we can hold out.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.chinese: 求救，求救。我们受到攻击，需要援助。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.english: Mayday, mayday. We're under attack and need assistance.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.chinese: 有人吗？有混蛋攻击我们的飞船，需要支援。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.english: Anyone out there. We got some angry SOB's punching holes in our hull. Could use some assistance.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.chinese: 我们急需作战协助，这有一群心怀不轨的家伙。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.english: We are in dire need of combat assistance. I got bogies with bad intentions swarming around me.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.chinese: 紧急通讯，我受到攻击，需要紧急援助！任何战斗支援都将不胜感激。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_requests_help_distre.english: Emergency comm. I am under attack and need immediate assistance. Any combat support would be appreciated.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.chinese: 我撑不下去了，掩护我，我会想办法逃走。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.english: I can't hold out any longer. Cover me and I'll try to make a run out of here.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.chinese: 我要逃离这里，掩护我好吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.english: I'm gonna make a break for it. Cover me, would you?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.chinese: 好吧，我们看看能不能离开这里，你能掩护我们吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_retreating_announce_.english: All right, we're going to see if we can get out of here. Can you cover our exit?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 见到你真好，我的飞船坏了，正在努力恢复。保护我们一会，飞船应该能重启运行。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: You're a sight for sore eyes. My ships offline, but we're working on it. Keep us clear and we should be able to get up and running again.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 我滴天啊，我还以为你不来了呢。帮我们分散一下敌人的注意力，我们好修飞船。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: I'll be damned. I was getting a little worried you weren't gonna show. Keep them distracted while we fix our ship up.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 你来了！事情是这样的，我们已经受到一些攻击了，所以我们正试图让一些功能重新上线。你能在我们干活的时候对付一下敌人吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: You made it. Here's the deal, we've already taken some monster hits so we're trying to get functions back online. Think you can tangle with them while we work?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 差点来不及啊，他们把我们的飞船搞得一团糟。既然你来了，能帮着对付一下他们吗？我们试着让飞船恢复。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Not a moment too soon. They've done a number on our ship. Now that you're here, we can try and get her back online while you keep 'em busy.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 见到你真高兴，好好收拾一下这些混蛋。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Damn happy to see you. These bastards need a good seeing to.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 谢谢你能来，准备好让这些混蛋见识一下你的厉害了吗?
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Thanks for showing up. You ready to show these bastards what's what?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 谢谢你的支援，希望你喜欢精彩的战斗，现在恰好就有这么一场。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Appreciate the assist. Hope you like a good fight, cause we got one.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 很高兴你能来，我们可能得跳过寒暄环节了，要干架了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Glad to have ya. Might have to skip the introductions, we got a fight going on.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 谢谢你的支援，有你在应该很快就能搞定。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Thanks for the help. With you here, this shouldn't take long.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 该你上了，你准备好帮忙了吗？
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: About time you showed up. Now you ready to help or not?

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 我还担心你不来呢，希望你已经准备好了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: I was worried you weren't coming. Hope you're ready to jump into this.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.chinese: 慢慢来吧，迟到总比不到好。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_spotted_reinforcemen.english: Took your time, didn't ya. Better late than never I guess.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_aally_tplayer.chinese: 谢谢你为我们所作的一切。现在已经没多少人会这么做了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_aally_tplayer.english: Appreciate all you did for us. Not a lot of folks these days would.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_aally_tplayer.chinese: 谢谢你的帮助。你真的是我们的救命恩人。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_aally_tplayer.english: Thanks for the help. You're a literal lifesaver.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.chinese: 你帮我大忙了，我也会回报你的，给你添麻烦了。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.english: You did good by me. I like to do the same. Here. Something for your trouble.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.chinese: 谢谢你的帮助，这是对你冒着生命危险的送上小小敬意。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.english: Thanks for all your help. Sending over a little something for putting your neck on the line.

pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.chinese: 感谢你的帮助。虽然现在这些并不能报答你所作的一切，但我还是要送给你一些东西作为感谢。
pu_cacaptain01_m_ca_thanks_withpayment_a.english: Appreciate the help. Now this don't begin to cover what you done, but I'm sending a little something as a thank you.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 好的，货物正在进行转移。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: All right, cargo is being transferred.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 请稍等。我们开始转移您的货物了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: Hold tight. We're starting to transfer your cargo.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 好的，现在开始货物转移。
好的，您已经装载完毕。祝您一切顺利。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: All right, you're loaded up. Have a good one.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 所有货物已经转移完成。一路平安。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: All cargo's been transferred. Safe flying.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 转移完成。您可以出发了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: Transfer complete. You're good to go.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 哇，出了点问题。请再次检查您的位置以及装卸区是否清空。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: Whoa, got an issue. Double check your position and that the loading area is clear.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 我收到了有关您的货物的错误信息。请检查您的位置，并确保该区域清空，然后我们就可以继续了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: I'm getting an error on your cargo. Check your position and make sure the area's clear and we can continue.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 出现了错误，所以我暂停了转移。请确保您处于正确的位置，并且该区域没有障碍，以便我们可以继续。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: Got an error so I'm stopping the transfer. Make sure you're in the right position and the area's clear so we can keep going.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.chinese: 好的，我看到您在装卸区了。请就位，我们将开始装载您的货物。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.english: All right, I've got you in the loading area. Get into place and we'll start loading your cargo.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.chinese: 我正在追踪你。前往指定区域来转移你的货物。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.english: I'm tracking you. Go ahead and get into position to get your cargo transferred.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.chinese: 欢迎进入装卸区，如果你进入指定区域，我们就可以开始工作了
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_announce_deck_arriva.english: Welcome to the loading area, if you get into position, we can get started.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_call_security_ig_001.chinese: 我已将联系了区域内的安保。

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_call_security_ig_002.chinese: 别做什么疯狂的事情。安保人员已经在路上了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_call_security_ig_002.english: Don't do anything crazy. Security's on the way.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_call_security_ig_003.chinese: 你已经搞砸了。我已经向安保人员报警了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_call_security_ig_003.english: You messed up now. I've flagged you with security.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.chinese: 呃...你已经有一个位置了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.english: Uh... you already have a spot.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.chinese: 我已经给你一个位置了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.english: I gave you a spot already.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.chinese: 已经给你分配了一个位置。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_already.english: There's already a slot assigned to you.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.chinese: 对不起，我不能在你有犯罪等级的情况下给你安排位置。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.english: Sorry, I can't give you a spot with an active CrimeStat.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.chinese: 嘿，你需要在这里着陆之前解决那个犯罪等级。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.english: Hey, you need to take care of that CrimeStat before you can land here.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.chinese: 我不能为被通缉的罪犯分配位置。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_crimest.english: I'm not allowed to assign a slot to wanted criminals.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.chinese: 抱歉，您被拒绝进入此设施。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.english: Sorry but you've been denied access to this facility.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.chinese: 虽然我不愿意这样，但是我不能允许你在这对接。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.english: Hate to do this, but I can't let you dock here.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.chinese: 听着，我觉得我帮不了你。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.english: Look, I don't think I'm gonna be able to help you.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.chinese: 嘿，我很抱歉，但是这里无法容纳那辆载具。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.english: Hey, I'm sorry but we can't accommodate that vehicle here.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.chinese: 我认为我们没有适当的装备来处理那辆载具。抱歉。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.english: I don't think we're kitted out to handle that vehicle here. Sorry.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.chinese: 我们无法在这里处理那辆载具。非常抱歉。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_decline_deck_novalid.english: We can't handle that vehicle here. Sorry about that.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_001_.chinese: 这是你自找的。着陆系统正在接管你的系统。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_001_.english: You asked for it. Landing systems are taking control of your systems.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_002_.chinese: 行，好吧。正在锁定你的载具。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_002_.english: All right , fine. Locking down your vehicle now.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_003_.chinese: 好的，好吧，我们将采取强硬手段。接管您的载具控制权。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_despawn_ship_ig_003_.english: Okay, fine, we'll do this hard way. Taking over control of your vehicle.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_give_deck_cargo_ig_0.chinese: 好了，这就是你被分配到的甲板。

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_give_deck_cargo_ig_0.english: Got a deck assignment for you.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.chinese: 看起来我们这里已经满员了，请稍等。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.english: Looks like we're full up at the moment. Stand by.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.chinese: 我们这里没有空位了，请等一会。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.english: I don't actually have any free spots. Hold tight for a sec.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.chinese: 我们这现在有点繁忙，等我一下，我会给你分配个空位的。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.english: A little slammed right now, give me a minute and I'll get you a spot.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.chinese: 货运服务，让我看看都有些什么...
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.english: Cargo services, let me see what we've got...

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.chinese: 感谢你联系货运服务，正在检查空位中。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.english: Thanks for contacting cargo services, checking for an open slot.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.chinese: 嘿，这里是货运服务。让我看看这都有些什么。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.english: Hey, this is cargo services. Let me see what we got.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.chinese: 我们的时间安排很紧，除非你已经到地方了，不然我无法转移货物。请离开该区域并再次发送请求。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.english: We're on a tight schedule, I can't transfer cargo unless you're in place. Please vacate the area and request again.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.chinese: 我们不能一直等你到位，你得离开了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.english: We can't keep waiting for you to get into place. You're gonna have to leave.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.chinese: 好吧，看，我没时间再等你到位了，你得腾出那块地方。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.english: Okay, look, I can't wait anymore for you to get in place, you'll have to clear the area.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.chinese: 抱歉，我不能再让你占着那片甲板。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.english: Sorry, I can't hold your deck spot any longer.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.chinese: 我正在给你分配甲板，下次请快点。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.english: I'm pulling your deck assignment. Next time get there quicker.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.chinese: 听着，我们这很忙，所以如果你不打算用那地的话，我是没法一直给你留着它的。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.english: Look, we're pretty busy here, so I can't hold onto your spot if you aren't gonna use it.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_ig_001_i.chinese: 我正在给你取消甲板的分配。

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_ig_002_a.chinese: 好的，我正在取消你的甲板分配。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_ig_002_a.english: All right, I'm voiding your deck assignment.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_ig_003_s.chinese: 很抱歉，但我已经取消了给你的分配。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_revoke_deck_ig_003_s.english: Sorry but I canceled your assignment.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.english: Just waiting on you to get in place.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.chinese: 你没在位置上我没法转移货物。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.english: We can't start transferring your cargo until you're in position.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.chinese: 你能把你的飞船开到指定地点，这样我们就可以开始转移了吗？谢谢。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.english: Could you get your ship in place so we can start transferring? Thanks.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.english: Gonna need you to get to your deck assignment.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.chinese: 如果你还需要的话，你得去申请甲板。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.english: Can you head to your deck assignment if you still need it.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.chinese: 我们今天很忙，去你申请的那片甲板。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.english: We're busy today, get to your assigned deck.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.chinese: 和你有关的工作都做好了，我需要把那片甲板分配给另一个飞行员。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.english: You're all done here, so I'm gonna need the deck for another pilot.
Hey, I'm gonna need you to clear out.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.chinese: 你能离开这里吗？我这儿有个人想用甲板。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.english: Could you head on out of here? I got someone looking to use the deck.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 听着，你不能在这里。出去不然我们就把你的载具给扣了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: Look, you can't be here. Get out or we'll lock down your vehicle.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 你未授权来这里。离开这里否则你的载具将被扣押。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: You aren't authorized to be here. Get the hell out or you vehicle will be seized.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 嘿，你正在违规。你不离开这里降落服务将会扣押你的船。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: Hey, you're trespassing. Landing services will seize your ship if you don't get out of here.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 我不会再说一遍。滚出去不然我们就把你的载具给扣了。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: I'm not gonna tell you again. Get the hell out of here or we'll lock down your vehicle.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 如你不离开，你将会违反降落规程。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: If you don't leave, you're gonna be in violation of landing protocols.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 最后警告。立刻离开，否则我们会扣押你的载具。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: Last chance. You better leave or landing's gonna take control of your vehicle.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.chinese: 嘿，我需要你切换载具的配置以接收货物。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.english: Hey, I'm gonna need you to shift your vehicle configuration to accept cargo.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.chinese: 在我们可以装货之前，你需要把你的载具配置切换到另一种。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.english: You need to shift your vehicle into the other configuration before we can load cargo.

pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.chinese: 在你调整飞船配置前我无法开始装载作业。
pu_cargoatc01_f_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.english: I can't start loading until you adjust your ship configuration.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_announce_cargotransf.chinese: 错误。货物转移已暂停。要继续进行货物转移，请对齐载具，并清空装载区域。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_announce_cargotransf.english: Error. Cargo transfer halted. Vehicle must be aligned and loading area clear to continue.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_announce_deck_arriva.chinese: 载具必须正确对齐后方可进行货物转移。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_announce_deck_arriva.english: Vehicle must be aligned properly to begin cargo transfer.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_call_security_ig_001.chinese: 请注意。已通知安保人员。

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_already.chinese: 当前有正在执行的货物转移请求。请完成当前请求后再进行更多请求。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_already.english: Active cargo service request in progress. Complete before making additional requests.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.chinese: 你未被授权使用此货物设施。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_nopermi.english: You are not authorized to use this cargo facility.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_novalid.chinese: 货物服务请求已拒绝。该载具尺寸超限。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_decline_deck_novalid.english: Cargo service request denied. Unable to accommodate vehicle.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_despawn_ship_ig_001_.chinese: 你的载具已被锁定。请等待。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_despawn_ship_ig_001_.english: Your vehicle is now locked down. Standby.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.chinese: 货物服务请求已挂起。当前无可用空间。请等待。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_queue_deck_cargo_ig_.english: Cargo service request pending. No current space available. Standby.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_request_deck_cargo_i.chinese: 货物服务请求已确认。请等待。

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.chinese: 载具未对齐。指定的货运甲板已被取消。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_alignfai.english: Vehicle not aligned. Assigned cargo deck has been revoked.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.chinese: 指定货运甲板已被取消。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_arrivalf.english: Assigned cargo deck has been revoked.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_ig_001_a.chinese: 指定货运甲板已被取消。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_revoke_deck_ig_001_a.english: Assigned cargo deck has been revoked.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.chinese: 请对齐载具，否则指定的货运甲板将被取消。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_aligntimel.english: Align vehicle or assigned cargo deck will be revoked.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.chinese: 警告。如不使用，分配的货运甲板将被取消。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_arrivaltim.english: Warning. Assigned cargo deck will be revoked if not utilized.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.chinese: 不进行货物运送作业的载具必须离开货运甲板。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig_0.english: Vehicles not transferring cargo must vacate the cargo deck.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 警告。你的载具未被授权使用货运甲板。请离开，否则你的载具将被锁定。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: Warning. Your vehicle is not authorized for cargo deck use. Vacate or your vehicle will be locked down.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.chinese: 警告。请清空货舱，否则载具将被锁定。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_ship_obstructin.english: Warning. Vacate the cargo deck or your vehicle will be locked down.

pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.chinese: 请调整载具结构以进行货物转运。
pu_cargoatc02_m_atc_warn_shipstate_inval.english: Adjusting vehicle configuration for cargo transfer.

pu_civmed1_sk_busy_ig_001_imverysorry.chinese: 十分抱歉，我现在正在照顾一个病人。
pu_civmed1_sk_busy_ig_001_imverysorry.english: I'm very sorry. I'm with a patient at the moment.

pu_civmed1_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.chinese: 欢迎来到医疗单元，有什么可以帮您的吗？
pu_civmed1_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.english: Welcome to MediUnit. How may I help you?

pu_civmed1_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.chinese: 欢迎来到十字军健康诊所。
pu_civmed1_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.english: Welcome to the Crusader Health Clinic.

pu_civmed1_sk_healthcomment_ig_002_areyo.chinese: 你没事吧？ 我们能帮忙吗？
pu_civmed1_sk_healthcomment_ig_002_areyo.english: Are you all right? Can we help?

pu_civmed1_sk_playerwakes_duringop_ig_00.chinese: 好的，夹住它。正在添加抗凝血剂，要时刻注意他们的生命体征。
pu_civmed1_sk_playerwakes_duringop_ig_00.english: All right, clamp it. I'm adding an anticoagulant, so keep an eye on their vitals.

pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_001_ahyesth.chinese: 啊，是的。终端机应该能够满足您的需求。
pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_001_ahyesth.english: Ah, yes. The terminals should be able to handle your needs.

pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_002_yesofco.chinese: 当然可以，请在终端机上确认一下。
pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_002_yesofco.english: Yes of course. Please check with the terminal.

pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_003_youshou.chinese: 你应该在终端机上咨询一下。
pu_civmed1_sk_suggestterm_ig_003_youshou.english: You should consult the terminal for that.

pu_civmed2_sk_busy_ig_001_imverysorry.chinese: 十分抱歉，我现在正在照顾一个病人。
pu_civmed2_sk_busy_ig_001_imverysorry.english: I'm very sorry. I'm with a patient at the moment.

pu_civmed2_sk_busy_ig_001b_imverysorry.chinese: 十分抱歉，我现在正在照顾一个病人。
pu_civmed2_sk_busy_ig_001b_imverysorry.english: I'm very sorry. I'm with a patient at the moment.

pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.chinese: 欢迎来到医疗单元，有什么可以帮您的吗？
pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.english: Welcome to MediUnit. How may I help you?

pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.chinese: 欢迎来到十字军健康诊所。
pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.english: Welcome to the Crusader Health Clinic.

pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.chinese: 欢迎来到玛利亚纯洁之心医院。
pu_civmed2_sk_greetings_medstation_ig_00.english: Welcome to Maria, Pure of Heart.

pu_civmed2_sk_playerwakes_duringop_ig_00.chinese: 好的，夹住它。加了抗凝血剂，要时刻注意他们的生命体征。
pu_civmed2_sk_playerwakes_duringop_ig_00.english: All right, clamp it. Adding an anticoagulant, so keep an eye on their vitals.

pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_001_ahyesth.chinese: 啊，是的。终端机应该能够满足您的需求。
pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_001_ahyesth.english: Ah, yes. The terminals should be able to handle your needs.

pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_002_ofcours.chinese: 当然可以，请在终端机上确认一下。
pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_002_ofcours.english: Of course. Please check with the terminal.

pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_003_youshou.chinese: 你应该在终端机上咨询一下。
pu_civmed2_sk_suggestterm_ig_003_youshou.english: You should consult the terminal for that.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_alreadygrante.chinese: 现在有点困惑。你已经有权限了...奇怪的人类。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_alreadygrante.english: Confused now. You have permission... strange human.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_alreadygrante.chinese: 但你可以降落...哦，这是游戏吗？我明白了。好的
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_alreadygrante.english: But you can land… oh, is this game? I see. Yes.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_alreadygrante.chinese: 发生了什么？你可以降落。

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingassign.chinese: 是的。是的。来吧。停机坪准备好了。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingassign.english: Yes. Yes. Come on by. Pad is ready.
Here you go. Bring ship in.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.chinese: 哦，你好。今天没料到会有人来...你能看到吗？我看不到。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.english: Oh, hello. Wasn't expecting anyone today… can you see? I can't see.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.chinese: 你好，是的。你能看到我吗？非常失望...但你需要停机坪。稍等。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.english: Hello, yes. Can you see me? Very disappointing… but you want pad. Hold.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.chinese: 抱歉。通讯有点问题。但你想降落。稍等一下。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingcontac.english: Apologies. Having communication issue. But you want to land. Wait beat.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingdenied.chinese: 现在看不到你。晚点再试。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingdenied.english: Can't see you now. Try later. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingdenied.chinese: 现在没停机坪了。换个时间再来吧。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingdenied.english: No pad now. Try different time. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.chinese: 门开着呢。你怎么不降落？肯定是改变主意了。好吧。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.english: Door open. Why don't you land? Must have changed mind. Okay.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.chinese: 你睡着了吗？等你醒了再开机库。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.english: Did you sleep? Will close hangar until you wake.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.chinese: 得关机库了。想降落的时候再联系。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_landingoutoft.english: Need to seal hangar. Call when you want to land.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_requesttakeof.chinese: 想走了是吧。让我找找按钮。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_requesttakeof.english: Wish to leave, yes. Let me find button.
Time to leave then. Okay, okay…

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffgrante.chinese: 正在打开舱门让你离开。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffgrante.english: Opening hatch to leave. Bye now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffoutoft.chinese: 不想走吗？好吧。休息一下再告诉我。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffoutoft.english: Don't want to leave? Okay. Take some beats and let me know.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffoutoft.chinese: 要关机库了。如果想再开的话再叫我一次。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_takeoffoutoft.english: Going to close hangar. Call again if you want open.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.chinese: 嗯...这边有点问题。给我点时间。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.english: Hmm… have problem here. Give me second.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.chinese: 系统出错了。抱歉，正在修复中。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.english: Have system error. Apologize. Fixing now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.chinese: 需要再等一会儿。请稍等。
机库没有响应，必须修复。请稍等。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.english: Hangar not responding. Must fix. Hold please.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.chinese: 嗯...按钮没反应。给我一点时间。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_atc_waitinginqueu.english: Hmm… button do nothing. Give me beat.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 啊，太好了。很高兴给你做。请带东西来。我会让你更安全。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Ah, excellent. Happy to make for you. Please bring things. I make you safer.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 我是维科洛。宇宙又很多危险。有更多防护更好。请带东西过来。我会给你服装。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Wikelo here. Universe have much danger. Good to have more protection. Please, bring things. I give you suit.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 想要衣服是吗？经常中枪嘛？没问题。维科洛会做。你可以中枪一整天。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Need suit, yes? Get shot much? No problem. Wikelo can make. You get shot all day.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 维科洛搬来人类星系时见过好多这玩意儿。能带很多箱维科洛的东西。学会了怎么做得更有趣。会给你做的。走了。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Wikelo see many of these when move to Human system. Carry many box of Wikelo things. Learned how to make more fun Will make for you. Go. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你想要大机器人服装。理解。非常有趣。是的。可以做得更好。带东西来。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You want big robot suit. Understand. Very fun and yes, can make better. Bring things to me.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你想要令人印象深刻的船。有很多。人类，希安，巴努，也许还有剜度。去带东西给我。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You want impressive ship. Many do. This impress Human, Xi'an, Banu, maybe Vanduul too. Go, get things for me.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 给你造一艘大船。是的。维科洛准备好了。把我要的东西带过来，我会做的。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Make big ship for you. Yes. Wikelo ready. Just bring things I need and I do. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 嗯，好，我想可以做。我有个项目在做，但能帮你做。去拿来，我给你造飞船。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Hmm, yes, suppose can do. Have project I work on, but can do for you. Go. Bring. I figure make ship for you.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 对，你想要飞船。行，可以。你把东西拿来，我就给你造。祝你好运。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Yes, you want ship. Okay, yes. Will make for you when you bring things. Good luck. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 维科洛准备好给你造飞船了。你有清单吧？准备好就过来。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Wikelo ready to make ship. You have list of things, yes? Good. Be here when ready.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你有野心。我很喜欢。这飞船不好造。要很多零件，但很值。祝你好运。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You have ambition. I like very much. This ship not easy to make. Many part needed but very rewarding. Good luck.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 大项目，造很大的船。维科洛很兴奋要做这些。一直都很有趣。要花很多力气。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Big project for very big ship. Wikelo excited to make these. Always fun. Big commitment.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你要载具？哦是的，肯定能帮你造。很简单。去吧，带东西来。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You need vehicle? Oh yes, can for sure make for you. Very easy. Go. Bring things.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 好的。没问题。我准备给你造飞船。东西拿来，我就开工。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Yes. Okay. Will get ready to make vehicle for you. Bring things and I will do. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 哦哦，很强。你一定打很多仗。造起来也有趣。去拿东西来，我们一起开心。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Oooh, very powerful. You must fight lots. Fun to make too. Go, bring things and we have fun.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 现在武器很火。人人都想要枪。维科洛乐意给。带东西来。加入他们。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Weapons very popular now. Everybody want guns. Wikelo happy to give. Bring things and join them.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 要武器？行。维科洛能造。还能造得更好。带东西来，我来做。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Need weapon. Yes. Wikelo can make. Make it better. Bring things and I do. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 好啊好啊，人很好。维科洛很饿。请快拿来。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Wonderful wonderful human. Wikelo very hungry. Please bring.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 对。要能吃的好东西。很激动。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Yes. Could use useful, useful food. Very exciting. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你说给维科洛食物。你真好心。我会付钱。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You say you get Wikelo food. Very kind. Will pay.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 开心日子。想要食物。非常感谢。去吧。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Happy day. Would love food. Many thanks. Go.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 很有趣。高兴你拿食物来。去吧。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Very fun. Happy you will bring food. Go. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 好极了。你还想要人情？行。你做完我要的事，我就给你。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Excellent. You want more favors? Okay. Do what I need and I give.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 你需要更多人情？行。你拿东西来，我就能给。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: You need more favors. Okay. Can give when you bring things to me.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 喂。维科洛在这。你干活，我就给你人情。好的，再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Hello. Wikelo here. Will give you favors if you do job. Good. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.chinese: 对。拿东西换人情。我很乐意。祝好运。再见
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_deo_missionaccept.english: Yes. Trade for favors. Happy to. Good luck. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 好极了。现在我来造护甲。你觉得你会喜欢。对。很好。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Excellent. Let me make armor now. Think you will like. Yes. Very good.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 零件看着不错。我现在给你造护甲。稍等一会儿。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Parts look good. I make armor for you now. Hold for beats.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 现在开始做护甲。看起来不错。觉得你会喜欢。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Will be making armor now. Look good. Think you like.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 准备好要机甲服了吗？希望你准备好了。很有趣。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Ready for robo-suit now? Hope you get ready. Very fun.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 谢谢零件。现在给你造机器服装。等一下。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Thank you for parts. Build robot suit for you now. Wait.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 该造飞船了，对吧？零件很好。马上开工，让你快点回太空。等一下。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Time for ship, yes? Parts look good. Will get to work and get you back in space. Hold.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 觉得你一定会很喜欢这船。对你旅行很有用。很多人会对你印象深刻。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Think you will really like ship. It can very useful in travel. Many people impress with you.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 现在检查零件，看我有没有少啥。应该够给你造飞船了。等一下，就好。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Look over parts now, think I have everything need to make ship for you. Hold and will give.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 维科洛在这。刚看了你带来的零件。现在开始给你造船。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Wikelo here. Just see parts you bring. Will make ship for you now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 哦，你来拿飞船了。看到你带齐我要的东西了。挺好。这就造。等一下。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Oh, you have come for ship. See you have things I need. Look good. Will make. Be ready.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 现在开始造你的飞船。你做完你的事，我做我的。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Going to start build on your ship now. You do your part. I do mine now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 维科洛印象深刻。造这飞船要很多东西。觉得你会很喜欢。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Wikelo very impressed. Lots of thing needed to make this ship. Think you will enjoy much.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 你花了很多时间找飞船零件。很厉害。你在保护国赚大钱。我现在给你造。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: You spend many beats to get parts for ship. Very impressive. You make much money in Protectorate. I build for you now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 好。现在给你造一辆很棒的载具。对。跑得很快。你会喜欢。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Okay. Will make excellent vehicle for you. Yes. Move very well. You like.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 维科洛在这。我有造载具要用的零件了。等一下。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Wikelo here. Have parts I need to make vehicle for you. Wait.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 你回来了。让我看看零件...行。现在造枪，马上给你。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: You are back. Let me look at parts… yes. Will make gun now and give.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 维科洛在这。现在看零件。应该都齐了，可以造武器。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Wikelo here. I look at parts now. Think I have all need to make weapon.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 现在可以给你造武器了，对。等一下，很快就好。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Can build weapon for you now, yes. Hold and will have soon.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.chinese: 又见面了。维科洛在这。谢谢你按要求把活干完。我们现在是最好的朋友了。希望以后还能见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_missioncomple.english: Hello again. Wikelo here. Thank you for completing contract as asked. We are best of friends now. Look to seeing you in future.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.chinese: 很好。给你。人情留着以后用。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.english: Excellent. Here you go. Save up favors for later time.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.chinese: 拿好你的人情。希望你再来换你想要的东西。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.english: Have your favors. Hope you come back for thing you want. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.chinese: 维科洛很开心。谢谢你。这些人情给你。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.english: Wikelo very happy. Thank you. Here favors for you.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.chinese: 你做了维科洛要的事。现在用这个人情付你。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pmh_tradingcomple.english: You do what Wikelo ask. Pay you with favors now.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_itemready_002.chinese: 我觉得你可能会喜欢。拿去吧。

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_itemready_003.chinese: 嗯...我觉得完成了。非常自豪。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_itemready_003.english: Yes… I think that complete. Very proud.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_itemready_004.chinese: 你准备好了吗？我搞定了。

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_itemready_006.chinese: 请站远一点。正在送电梯过来。

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: 非常漂亮。一直在寻找其中之一。大野兽，非常讨厌。给我几个野兽，会为你找到一些好东西。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: Very pretty. Been looking for one of these. Big beast, very nasty. Give me several beats, will find something nice for you.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: 哦...哦确实。非常好的采集者，你是。希望有你作为奴隶跟我回公会。极好的发现值得极好的奖励。等一等。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: Oh… oh indeed. Very good gatherer, you are. Would wish to have you as slave back with me in souli. Incredible finds deserve incredible rewards. Hold on.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: 今天，非常棒的一天。你让我很开心。有非常特别的东西让你也开心。不要走开。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: Today, excellent day. You make me very happy. Have something very special to make you happy too. Stand there.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: 哦，谢谢你，谢谢你。非常好的品质这个。应该有好东西给你，在某处...
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: Ooh, thank you, thank you. Very fine quality this is. Should have something good for you somewhere...

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: [巴努语] ¡ówa! njakte, ¡ndi njakteyæ! 我的朋友，你带给我非常好东西。等等，让我给你一些东西作为回报。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: ¡ówa! njakte, ¡ndi njakteyæ! My friend, you’ve brought me something very nice. Hold on, let me get you something in return.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.chinese: 正是我在找的。让我给你一些好东西。请稍等。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_tradingcomple.english: Exactly what I look for. Let me get you something nice. Please hold.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.english: Just need to make a few… adjustments…

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.chinese: [巴努语] .mbe mbenge, ¡mbengeyæ! 抱歉，快好了。快好了。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.english: .mbe mbenge, ¡mbengeyæ! Sorry, almost there. Almost there.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.chinese: 是的，非常好。确实非常好。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.english: Yes, very nice. Very nice indeed.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.chinese: 是的，是的，进展不错，是的。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.english: Yes, yes, coming along nicely, yes.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.chinese: 是的，是的，进展顺利，是的。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_pve_workingsounds.english: Yes, yes, coming along nicely, yes.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 如果你想要，我可以给你做。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: Can make for you if you want.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 如果你想要，材料都贴出来了。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: Ingredients posted if you want one.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 如果你喜欢，我可以给你做。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: If you like, I can make for you.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 如果你想要，我有合约可以接。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: Have contract out if you want me to make.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 真的很漂亮，是吧？结构坚固，但制作起来也很有趣。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: Really pretty, yes? Solid build, but also fun to make.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 很多人喜欢这个。收到过很多请求。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: Many people like this. Get many request.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.chinese: 这个是我以前的老商会长得风格。差不多的线条，对吧？
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_browsinggener.english: This inspired by old essosouli of mine. Similar line, yes?
Can build. Could be very helpful in your travel.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 你好。我是维科洛。感谢你接受工作。很开心为你制作东西。带东西给我。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: Hello. I am Wikelo. Thank you for taking job. Happily make thing for you. Bring me stuff. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 可以为你制作，是的。你知道我需要的东西。有东西了就来我家。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: Can make for you, yes. You know the stuff I need. Come to home when you have.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 你会喜欢的。维科洛可以制作。是的，是的，带东西来，维科洛就可以制作。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: You would like. Wikelo can make. Yes, yes, bring things and Wikelo can make.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 刚刚看到你的请求物品。是的，可以为你制作。带东西来。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: Just saw you request item. Yes, can make for you. Bring things. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: Mobi 通知我说你希望维科洛帮忙。非常乐意帮助人类。带东西来。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: Mobi ping and say you want Wikelo to help. Very happy to help human. Bring things.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 维科洛听到你想要我建造。非常乐意帮助人类。带东西来，就会开始。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: Wikelo hear you would like me to build. Very happy to help human. Bring things and will start.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.chinese: 你想要维科洛制作吗？是的，可以制作。你有我需要的东西。去拿来。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_craftmissiona.english: You want Wikelo to make? Yes, can make. You have things I need. Go get. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.chinese: 但是...你没有完成请求。非常不寻常。你们人类真奇怪。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.english: But… you did not complete request. Very unusual. You humans are strange.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.chinese: 你好。维科洛在这里。你改变主意。没问题。犹豫不决，但还可以。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.english: Hello. Wikelo here. You change mind. No problem. Indecisive, but okay.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.chinese: 不知道你为什么取消订单。你不想要？奇怪。好的。再见。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_missionquit_0.english: Don't know why you cancel order. You not want? Strange. Okay. Bye.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 非常好。现在需要为我获取东西。有非常令人兴奋的东西来交换它。非常令人兴奋。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Excellent. Need to get things for me now. Have very exciting stuff to trade for it. Very exciting.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 好消息。对那些东西有极大的需求。请在你可以的时候获取。会很好地进行交易。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Wonderful news. Have great need for those things. Please get when you can. Will trade well for it.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 维科洛呼叫。刚刚听说你会为我获取东西。非常高兴。谢谢你，人类。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Wikelo calling. Just been told you will get stuff for me. Very happy. Thank you human.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 是的，真的吗？哦，非常令人兴奋。当你带来时，有许多好东西可以交易。你会很开心。是的。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Yes, really? Oh very exciting. Have many nice things to trade when you bring. You will be happy. Yes.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 我是维科洛。如果你真的拿到了，我将非常感激。开心的一天。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: I am Wikelo. If you really obtain, I will very grateful. Happy day.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 维科洛听到你将为我找东西，非常高兴。如果你拿到了，有最好的礼物来交易。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Wikelo very happy to hear that you will find for me. Have best present to trade if you get.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 好，好。非常渴望得到那个。去获取并带给我。会给你丰厚报酬。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Good, good. Very eager to get hands on that. Go, get and bring to me. Will pay you well.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 谢谢你，人类。非常高兴你将为我取回。非常让我满意。会为它交易好东西。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: Thank you human. Very happy you will retrieve for me. Very please me. Will trade well for it.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.chinese: 这是维科洛呼叫。谢谢你为我获取东西。会好好利用并给很棒的奖励。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_trademissiona.english: This Wikelo calling. Thank you for get things for me. Will put to good use and give you good prize.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.chinese: 啊，你好。这里是维科洛。欢迎来我家。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.english: Ah, hello. It Wikelo. Welcome to my home.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.chinese: 抱歉，现在很忙，不过你可以随便看看。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.english: Sorry, very busy at the moment, but have a look around.

pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.chinese: 欢迎。告诉我你需要什么。
pu_collector_ban_m_civ_soc_welcomerepeat.english: Welcome. Let me know what you need.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 很遗憾你没能完成这份合约，但我理解，大家都有忙的时候。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: I'm really sorry you weren't able to complete this contract, but I understand, we all get busy.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 我刚看到你无法完成合约。希望一切都还好，咱们再联系。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: I just saw that you are unable to complete the contract. I hope everything's okay. Talk soon.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 刚刚收到通知，说你退出了合约。嗯，说实话我也不太清楚具体情况...不过没关系，咱们总能找到办法的。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: Just received a ping that you were pulling out of the contract. I don't really know… hey, it's okay. We'll figure out something.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 很抱歉啊，我得告诉你，我们不得不取消这份合约了。希望这不会让你太沮丧。有时候退一步，反而能让我们走得更远。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: I hate to tell you this, but we have to pull the contract. I hope it doesn't get you down too much. Sometimes a step back can lead to a stronger step forward.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 很遗憾这次合约没跟你合作成。你知道的，有时候一份工作确实不太合适。不管怎么说，希望很快还能有机会一起合作！
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: Sorry this contract didn't work out for you. Sometimes a job is just not the right fit, you know? Anyway, hope to work with you again soon.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.chinese: 很遗憾，我不得不取消那份合约。说实话，我个人真的不太想这么做，希望你能理解。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggenericmiss.english: Unfortunately I'm going to have to pull that contract. On a personal level, I hate to do this and hope you understand.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggivereward_.chinese: 很高兴地通知你，我们已经为你送上了对你所有辛勤工作的感谢。感谢你在这些艰难时期对十字军工业的支持。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggivereward_.english: I'm excited to announce that we've sent you something for all your hard work. Thank you for supporting Crusader in these trying times.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggivereward_.chinese: 这里是十字军工业的丹佛。为了感谢你的努力工作，十字军工业让我转交一点小东西给你。希望你会喜欢！
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsggivereward_.english: This is Denver from Crusader. As a thank-you for all your hard work, Crusader wanted me to pass along a little something. Hope you like it.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 感谢你接受这份合约。我们这次真的是压力山大，特别需要你的帮助。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Thank you for accepting this contract. We're really behind the eight ball on this one and could really use your help.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 这里是十字军工业的丹佛。非常感谢你承担起这份责任，我们真的很感激你的努力。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: This is Denver at Crusader. Thank you so much for taking on this responsibility. We appreciate your hard work.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 十字军工业和帝国都感谢你接受这次任务机会。我由衷地感谢你。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Crusader and the Empire thank you for undertaking this opportunity. I appreciate you.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 看到你作为这次任务的承包人出现，我真的特别高兴。我觉得你一定能干得很棒。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: I'm so happy I saw your name pop up as the contractor for this. I think you're going to do a great job.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 看到你又接了我们的合约真是令人兴奋。十字军工业非常感谢你在这方面的辛勤工作。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Exciting to see you're doing another contract for us. Crusader appreciates your hard work on this.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 我刚才还在想你会不会帮我们再完成一个合约呢。真的太让我激动了。祝你好运！
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: I was just wondering if you were going to help us out with another contract. I'm really thrilled. Good luck out there.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 感谢你接受这份合约。每一位承包人对十字军工业来说都是非常重要的贡献者。祝你好运！
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Thank you for taking on this contract. Every single one of our contractors is a valuable contributor to Crusader. Good luck.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 欢迎加入。期待再次与你合作。你已经掌握了所有细节，祝你好运。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Welcome aboard. Looking forward to working with you again. You have all the details. Good luck.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.chinese: 嗨，我是丹佛·萨缪尔斯。我是十字军工业的承包人联络员。非常感谢你帮助我们和帝国度过这些艰难时刻。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissionacce.english: Hi, this is Denver Samuels. I'm a contractor liaison with Crusader. Thank you so much for helping us  and the Empire get through these trying times.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 我刚收到消息，货物已经安全送达了。要不是你，我们可能就丢了这批货。太感谢了！
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: I just received word that the cargo just arrived. We would've lost that delivery if it hadn't been for you. Thanks.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 好消息！你救下的那批货物刚刚到了。我非常感谢你，还有你的辛勤付出。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: Great news. That cargo you saved just arrived. I appreciate you and all your hard work.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 太棒了！非常感谢你完成了那份合约。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: That's amazing. Thank you so much for completing that contract.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 刚刚看到你完成了那份合约。非常感谢你，希望我们很快能再次合作。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: Just saw that you completed that contract. Thank you so much and hope to work together again soon.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 我会把那份合约标记为完成。非常感谢你的辛勤工作。和你合作真的让我感到非常兴奋。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: I will mark that contract complete. Thank you so much for all your hard work. It's been a genuine thrill to work with you.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 一切看起来都没问题，我这就给你安排付款。但最有价值的回报是，你知道你今天帮助了别人。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: Everything looks in order, so let me get you paid, but the most valuable reward is knowing you helped people today.

pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.chinese: 这里是十字军工业。只想感谢你完成了那份工作。你的贡献不仅仅是运送货物那么简单。感谢有你。
pu_crep_samuels_cru_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomp.english: Crusader here. Just wanted to thank you for completing that job. Your contribution goes beyond just cargo. Thank you for being.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.chinese: 哦！动起来，快动起来。不，不，请不要...啊！< 尖叫声 >
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.english: Ah... come on, come on no, no no please... no... < Scream >

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.chinese: 不！ < 尖叫声>... < 尖叫声 >
哦！动起来，快动起来。不，不，请放。。啊！< 尖叫声 >
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.english: No, no no... Come on, come on... No < Scream >

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.chinese: 不，动起来，求你了，求你了，不，我受不了了 < 尖叫声 >
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.english: No, come on... Please, please... No, I can't take it < Scream >

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.chinese: 动起来，快动起来。哎，不，我们完蛋了，我们全都要完蛋了。系统奔溃了 < 尖叫声 >
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.english: Come on... Come on... Ah, no we are going down. We are going down. System failure < Scream >

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.chinese: 我要完了， 我要完了。救命，请救救我！
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_deaththroes_s.english: I'm out. I'm out. Help. Please help!

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyfire_.chinese: 看好你的武器！我是你那边的。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyfire_.english: Check your fire! I'm on your side.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyfire_.chinese: 看好哪个才是你该射的。

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyfire_.english: Check your fire! They're on your side.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.chinese: 好吧，准备好吧，看来我们有一个新的敌人要关照关照了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.english: Okay, get ready. Looks like we've got a new hostile to take care of.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.chinese: 在多次违规之后，我宣布你的队友为敌方。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.english: After repeated violations, I'm declaring your teammate a hostile.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.chinese: 似乎我们的一个自己人背叛了我们。大家做你们该做的吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_friendlyturns.english: Seems one of our own's turned against us. Do what you gotta do, everybody.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_killed_teamma.english: Lost one of ours. Damn it.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_killed_teamma.chinese: 驾驶员倒下了，重复，驾驶员倒下了！

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 你现在是毫不留情的抛下我了吗。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: You got a lotta nerve quitting on me right now.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 如果你没注意到，现在抛下我们可不是给好时机啊。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: In case you hadn't noticed, this is a pretty crap time to bail on us.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 现在可不是丢下工作的最佳时机啊。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: Not really the best time to bail on a job.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 你知道吗，我不能忍受工作还没做完就擅离职守的人。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: You know, I can't stand people who bail on a job before it's done.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 给你个忠告，除非你想把工作做完，否则不要接它。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: Piece of advice, don't take a job unless you're gonna finish it.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.chinese: 你要跑路了？ 太棒了。真是谢谢你浪费我的时间啊。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playeradandon.english: You're quitting? Great. Thanks for wasting my time.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playerturnsho.chinese: 是吗，你想惹麻烦？ 好的，现在你如愿以偿了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playerturnsho.english: Okay, fine. You want trouble? Well, now you got it.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playerturnsho.chinese: 够了，你不要以为干了这事后还能逍遥法外。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_playerturnsho.english: Enough. You can't get away with acting like this.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_underattack_i.chinese: 这些该死的混蛋是从哪里来的？
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_underattack_i.english: Where the hell did these assholes come from?

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_underattack_i.chinese: 你特么就这么点本事吗？ 哈？ 就这？！
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_general_underattack_i.english: That all you got? Huh? That all you got?!
Come on, come on. You got this...

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_arrivescan.english: All right, let's have a look around.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.chinese: 计划有变。一大群敌人正向我的位置移动，你得以最快速度赶回来。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.english: Change of plans. A swarm of hostiles are moving on my position. Need you back here ASAP.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.chinese: 该死。信息显示敌人朝我这边来了，我需要你立即提供战斗援助。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.english: Damn it. Enemy contacts heading my way. Gonna need some immediate combat assistance.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.chinese: 我的探测器都快要炸掉了，那些亡命之徒一定发现了我的位置。你得马上回来赶回来。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_backuprequ.english: My scopes blowing up. Outlaws must've found my position. Get your ass back here, now.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.chinese: 知道了，谢谢。这对文书工作真的很有帮助。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.english: Got it, thanks. This should really help with the paperwork.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.chinese: 谢谢，我会通过适当的渠道转走这些的。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.english: Thanks. I'll forward these on to the appropriate channels.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.chinese: 明白了，我会确保这些信息得到处理。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_c.english: Got it. I'll make sure this info gets processed.
