pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 你能EVA出去帮我确认一下船长的遗体吗？ 当你在外面的时候要小心，肇事者可能还在附近。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: Do you think you could EVA over and ID the captain's remains? And be careful while you're out there, the perps responsible could still be nearby.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 过去试着拿到船长的ID，不过要保持警惕，不管是谁干的，都有可能回来。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: Head over and try to pull the captain's ID. Stay alert though. There's a chance whoever did this could come back.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 公司想让我们查出船长的身份。过去检查一下，但要保持警惕知道不？ 可能有谁还在这潜伏着。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: Corporate wants us to pull an ID on the captain. Head over and check it out but keep your eyes open, okay? No telling who's lurking around.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 我需要你过去记录飞行员的遗体以用于事故报告。小心点，肇事者可能还在附近。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: I need you to head over and log the pilot's remains for the incident report. And be careful, the perps responsible could still be nearby.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 出舱飘去残骸那看看你能不能认出飞行员的遗体。保持警惕，肇事者有可能会回现场。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: EVA to the wreckage and see if you can ID the pilot's body. And stay alert, there's a chance who ever did this could come back.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.chinese: 我们需要你从飞行员身上查到ID。但一定要小心知道吗？ 可能有谁还在这潜伏着。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_f.english: We need you to pull an ID off the pilot. But keep your eyes open, okay? No telling who could still be lurking around out here.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.chinese: 我们得继续前进，我已经把残骸报告给了搜救队。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.english: We have to keep moving. I've forwarded the wreck onto a retrieval team.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.chinese: 你知道，我跑这来是为了摆脱罪犯。让我们继续前进吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.english: You know, I moved out here to get away from all this crime. Let's keep moving.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.chinese: 公司让我们暂时离开残骸，他们想让我们优先完成巡逻。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_derelict_n.english: Corporate's telling us to leave the wreck for now. They want us finishing the patrol.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_encouragen.english: Come on, let's keep it moving.
I said you're done here. Let's go.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_encouragen.chinese: 我把坐标发出去了，该走了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_encouragen.english: I sent the point. Time to go.
What are you waiting for? Move.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_encouragen.chinese: 别再拖延了，继续移动吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_encouragen.english: Quit stalling already and get moving.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.chinese: 看起来我们丢了一艘船，靠我们自己继续吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.english: Looks like we're down a ship. Let's go ahead and finish without them.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.chinese: 其中一个承包商没有不干了，所以剩下的巡逻队就只有我们了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.english: One of the contractors didn't work out so the rest of the patrol is just us.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.chinese: 顺带一提，你将不得不在少一艘船的帮助下完成巡逻。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_friendlyad.english: FYI. You're going to have to finish the patrol with one less ship helping.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: I think that's the last of them.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 我们安全了吗？我们安全了。

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: All right. I think you're good.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 敌人都已击毁，我们成功了。
视野净空，我觉得你安全了。
好的，准备给你标出最后的巡逻点。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: All right. Let me get the last patrol point ready for you.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 下一站是最后一个，马上就把坐标给你。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: This next point's the last stop. Should have it for you in a moment.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 给我点时间，我把最后的巡逻点发给你。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: Give me a sec and I'll send you the final patrol point.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 待命，等待下一个巡逻点。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: Stand by. Calling up next point.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 等一下，我正在发送下一个巡逻点。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: Hold on a sec. I'm sending the next patrol point.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.chinese: 应该可以了。稍等，我正在标记下个巡逻点的位置。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_patrolpoin.english: That should do it. Hang on. I'm plotting our next stop.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.chinese: 嘿，巡逻队不能再等了，所以我要取消你的合约。不过，祝你好运。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.english: Hey, the patrol can't wait any longer, so I'm gonna go ahead and cancel your contract. Good luck, though.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.chinese: 嘿，我想告诉你，既然你没赶到这来办事，那我不得不取消你的合约，抱歉。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.english: Hey, wanted to let you know that since you're not here to do the work, I've got to cancel your contract. Sorry.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.chinese: 听着，你的合约被取消了。官方政策。只有积极巡逻的承包商才能拿到工资。就是这样。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerkick.english: Listen, your contract's been canceled. Official policy. Only contractors on active patrol get paid. Just the way it is.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.english: Where the heck are you going?

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.chinese: 嘿，那不是我们的巡逻路线，专心在任务上。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.english: Hey, that's not our patrol route. Let's stay on task.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.chinese: 检查一下你的航线，你的方向完全不对。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.english: Check your course. You're heading's all wrong.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.chinese: 注意你的飞行路线，你正在偏离航线。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_playerouto.english: Watch your flight path. You're drifting off course.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.chinese: 坏消息是，没人会来支援我们。
妈的... 好吧，听着，我们没有预备的援军。这事你只能靠自己了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.english: Shit... all right, look, it's a no-go on backup. You're your own for this one.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.chinese: 公司表示，他们没有任何可用的支援单位，抱歉。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.english: Corporate says they don't have any available support units. Sorry.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.chinese: 指挥部派了一些增援部队来帮忙。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.english: Command's tasking some reinforcements to help out.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.chinese: 得到了些支援。稍微等会。
别死，我这就派人来帮忙。
我刚拿到派遣增援部队的许可。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_reinforcem.english: I just got clearance to send reinforcements.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 嗯...真是不幸。我发现有全副武装的敌军正朝你过来。让我看看能不能给你找些后援。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Um... this is not good. I've got heavily armed hostiles headed your way. Let me see if I can get you some backup.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 有敌人，这些家伙看起来还是有两把刷子的。我去联系指挥部，看看能不能找点支援。这段时间内稍微看着点自己。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Got hostiles. These guys look really strapped. I'll contact Command and see if I can pull up some support. Watch yourself in the meantime.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 我刚发现了支强大的敌军正朝你的方向驶来。你懂的，我可不喜欢这帮怪家伙，让我看看能不能给你找点帮手。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: I just picked up a significant enemy force heading your way. You know, I'm not liking these odds. Let me see if I can dredge up some help.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 发现目标...看来已经被摧毁了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Picking up a contact... looks destroyed.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 啊...不是好消息，附近传来黑匣子的信号。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Huh... That's not good... Black box signal coming from nearby.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 扫描出附近有很多碎片，可能是一艘被摧毁的舰船。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Scans showing a lot of debris nearby. Probably a downed ship.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 发现目标，发现目标。有敌人在附近。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Contact, contact. Got hostiles on site.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 我发现有接敌信号。准备好， 很快就会有趣起来了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: I'm picking up hostile contacts. Get ready. It's about to get interesting.
Ready up. You've got hostiles inbound.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 集中精神，有未知信号朝你方向过来。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Get focused. Got unknown contacts heading your way.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 好的... 看来—— 接敌！接敌！ 敌军接近。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Okay... looks pretty- Contact! Contact! Hostiles inbound.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 好的... 看起来挺不错的。嗯，好像没什么人。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Okay... looks pretty good... Yeah, I don't see anyone.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 看来周围已经净空了。我们再给点时间确认一下...是的，我们干的不错。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Scope's looking clear... let's give it a second to confirm... Yeah, we're good.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 我的视野范围内已净空，嗯，我想我们没事了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: My scope's clear... Yeah. I think we're clear.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.chinese: 没事。没事。嗯，我们都没事。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_scanresult.english: Nothing... Nothing... Yeah. We are all clear.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_thanks_res.chinese: 我想我们安全了。感谢你的协助。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_thanks_res.english: I think we're clear. Appreciate the assist.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_thanks_res.chinese: 看起来就这些了。嘿，谢谢你救了我。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_thanks_res.english: Looks like that was all of them. Hey, thanks for saving my ass.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_midmission_thanks_res.chinese: 我们安全了。谢谢你的帮助。

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_briefing.chinese: 所以事情是这样的，我会在这里指挥通讯。你去一个巡逻点，把它清理干净，然后我给你发下一个坐标。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_briefing.english: So here's how this is gonna work, I'll be here running the op over comms. You head to a patrol point. You clear it. I send you the next one.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.chinese: 这是第一个巡逻点，快去吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.english: Here's the first patrol point. Move out.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.chinese: 发送第一个巡逻点，快走吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.english: Sending the first patrol point. Get going.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.chinese: 你现在应该可以看到第一个巡逻点了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_patrolpo.english: You should be seeing the first patrol point now.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.chinese: 看起来没事了，你可以走了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.english: Looks like you're all cleared to go.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.chinese: 好的，你已经准备好了。准备好出发吧。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.english: All right. You're all set. Get ready to move out.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.chinese: 好了，巡逻目标很清楚了，准备好。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_missionstart_rendezvo.english: All right , the patrol's been cleared. Ready up.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_postmission_thanks_mi.english: We're all done. Thanks for the help.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_postmission_thanks_mi.chinese: 所有巡逻点安全，谢谢你的协助。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_postmission_thanks_mi.english: All patrol points clear. Thanks for the assist.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_postmission_thanks_mi.chinese: 好的，我想这就够了，合约完成。谢谢。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_postmission_thanks_mi.english: Okay, I think that about does it. Contract complete. Thanks.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.chinese: 嘿，你是来巡逻的，对吧？ 太棒了。稍等片刻，我们马上就出发。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.english: Hey, you're here for the patrol, right? Great. Hang out for a sec, we'll get going shortly.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.chinese: 嘿，我猜你是来执行任务的。我是你的管理员，再等最后一下我们就能开始了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.english: Hey. I'm assuming you're here for the op. I'm gonna be your handler. Just waiting for final clearance and then we can get started.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.chinese: 嘿，你一定是承包商。很高兴你能加入我们，我会为你处理后勤事宜，一旦我们从总部弄清楚了一切，我会通知你的。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_greeting_i.english: Hey, you must be the contractor. Nice to have you on board. I'll be handling logistics for you. Once we get the all clear from HQ, I'll let you know.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.chinese: 抱歉，我还在为老板清理一些文件。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.english: Sorry, still clearing up some paperwork for the bosses.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.chinese: 抱歉耽搁了时间。我们还没有得到上级的正式批准。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.english: Sorry for the delay. We still haven't gotten official 'go' from the higher ups.

pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.chinese: 嘿，看来负责这事的小天才们还没有批准巡逻路线。应该不会等太久了。
pu_crupatrol1_m_cv_premission_waitlonger.english: Hey look. The geniuses in charge still haven't approved the patrol path. Shouldn't be much longer.

pu_crupilot1_cv_allclear_ig_002_scansare.chinese: 扫描没有任何目标。清理完毕。
pu_crupilot1_cv_allclear_ig_002_scansare.english: Scans aren't showing anything. We're clear.

pu_crupilot1_cv_allclear_ig_003_thatwast.english: That was the last of them, I think.

pu_crupilot1_cv_allclear_ig_004_lookslik.chinese: 这看起来就是他们所有人了。
pu_crupilot1_cv_allclear_ig_004_lookslik.english: Looks like that was all of them.

pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_001_heythisi.chinese: 嘿，这里是十字军安保。跟你说一下，我们只是例行检查一下这个区域，没什么好担心的。
pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_001_heythisi.english: Hey, this is Crusader Security, wanted to give you a heads up that we're just doing a routine sweep of the area. Nothing to be worried about.

pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_002_hithereh.chinese: 你好，希望今天你一切顺利。十字军安保派我们在这里巡逻，有什么需要请告诉我们。
pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_002_hithereh.english: Hi there, hope everything's going all right. Crusader Security has us patroling the area, so let us know if you need anything.

pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_003_crusader.chinese: 十字军安保呼叫飞行员。你现在处于十字军的管辖区，如果在我们在这里巡逻时你遇到任何问题，请直接打给我们。
pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_003_crusader.english: Crusader Security to pilot. You are currently in Crusader controlled space. You run into any problems while we're on patrol here, just give us a comm.

pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_005_pilotcru.chinese: 飞行员，这里是十字军安保。请注意，我们正在对该地区进行清查，感谢你的合作。
pu_crupilot1_cv_greeting_ig_005_pilotcru.english: Pilot, Crusader Security here. Be advised that we're conducting sweeps of the area. Appreciate your cooperation.

pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_001_werealld.chinese: 我们的任务完成了，注意安全。
pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_001_werealld.english: We're all done in this sector. Stay safe, all right.

pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_002_heythisa.chinese: 嘿，这片区域看起来一切正常，所以我们要离开了，祝你一路平安。
pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_002_heythisa.english: Hey, this area looks all clear, so we're moving on. Good flying.

pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_003_crusader.chinese: 十字军安保呼叫飞行员。这里一切正常，我们现在要离开了，你可以继续做你要做的事情。
pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_003_crusader.english: Crusader Security to Pilot. Wanted to let you know that everything looks good around here. Gonna head out now, but feel free to carry on with your business.

pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_004_heythere.chinese: 你好飞行员，我们已经扫描完毕，没有可疑情况，祝你玩得愉快。
pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_004_heythere.english: Hey there Pilot, finished our scans and nothing suspicious to report. Have yourself a good one.

pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_005_thatabou.chinese: 我们的工作到此结束，祝你在十字军中度过愉快的时光。
pu_crupilot1_cv_movingon_ig_005_thatabou.english: That about wraps it up for us out here. Enjoy the rest of your time in Crusader.

pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_001_dammi.chinese: 妈的，我被撞得不轻，得修一修才能继续了。
pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_001_dammi.english: Dammit, I'm pretty banged up. Gonna need some repairs before continuing.

pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_002_theyd.chinese: 他们把我害惨了，我得去服务站看看。
pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_002_theyd.english: They did a real number on me. Gonna have to visit a service station.

pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_003_after.chinese: 打完这场仗我得去寒宇一趟。
pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_003_after.english: After that fight, I better drag over to a Cry-Astro.

pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_004_tooka.chinese: 我受到了一点伤害，也许我应该去修一下了。
pu_crupilot1_cv_needrepairs_ig_004_tooka.english: Took a bit a damage there. Probably should re-up while I can.

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_001_pil.chinese: 飞行员，请注意，我们发现了敌对分子！
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_001_pil.english: Pilot, be advised, we've got hostile contacts!

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_002_pil.chinese: 飞行员，这里是十字军安保。小心点，有不法分子来袭。
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_002_pil.english: Pilot, this is Crusader Security, watch yourself. We've got outlaws incoming.

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_003_ale.chinese: 警报！全面警报！发现敌军进入本区域！
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_003_ale.english: Alert! Full alert! Hostiles inbound to sector.

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_004_hey.chinese: 嘿，你最好趁早离开这里，我们有麻烦了。
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsattack_ig_004_hey.english: Hey, you might want to get out of here while you can. We've got trouble coming.

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsescape_ig_002_the.chinese: 他们走了...至少现在是这样。
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsescape_ig_002_the.english: They're gone... for now at least.

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsescape_ig_004_loo.chinese: 看那些混蛋溜得有多快。

pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsescape_ig_005_gue.chinese: 看起来这个问题我们只能记作“待续”了。
pu_crupilot1_cv_outlawsescape_ig_005_gue.english: Guess we'll mark that one down as 'to be continued.'

pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_001_mayda.english: Mayday! Mayday! I'm in need of assistance.

pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_002_atten.chinese: 请注意！该区域的所有飞船，十字军安保需要援助。
pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_002_atten.english: Attention! All ships in the area. Crusader Security vessel in need of assistance.

pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_003_thisi.chinese: 这是紧急通信，请求支援。
pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_003_thisi.english: This is an emergency comm. Back up requested.

pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_004_alert.chinese: 所有飞行员注意。这是一艘十字军安保的飞船，请求紧急战斗援助。
pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_004_alert.english: Alert, all pilots. This is a Crusader Security ship requesting emergency combat assistance.

pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_005_emerg.chinese: 紧急情况！十字军安保受到攻击！我需要帮助！
pu_crupilot1_cv_requesthelp_ig_005_emerg.english: Emergency! Crusader Security under attack! I need help!

pu_crupilot1_cv_retreat_ig_004_itsnogood.chinese: 糟了！启动紧急跳跃程序。
pu_crupilot1_cv_retreat_ig_004_itsnogood.english: It's no good! Initiate emergency jump protocols.

pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_001_pilots.english: Pilot, stand clear of the engagement.

pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_002_pilotf.chinese: 飞行员，清退后。我们不希望这里有任何平民伤亡。
pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_002_pilotf.english: Pilot, fall back. We don't want any civilian casualties here.

pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_003_thisis.chinese: 这里是十字军安保，我们需要平民离开该区域。
pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_003_thisis.english: This is Crusader Security. We need civilians to clear the area.

pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_004_pilotc.chinese: 飞行员，我是十字军安保。你不会想和这些混蛋纠缠的。
pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_004_pilotc.english: Pilot, Crusader Security here.  You don't want to tangle with these bastards.

pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_005_donote.chinese: 不要和他们交战，飞行员。交给专业人士处理吧。
pu_crupilot1_cv_standclear_ig_005_donote.english: Do not engage, Pilot. Leave this to the professionals.

pu_crupilot1_cv_thanks_ig_004_gottasayyo.chinese: 不得不说，你很擅长做这种事。
pu_crupilot1_cv_thanks_ig_004_gottasayyo.english: Gotta say, you're pretty good at this sort of thing.

pu_crupilot2_cv_futurework_ig_002_ifyous.chinese: 如果你还看到类似的阵列，你可以重新激活它们。当然了，是那些不是被官方关闭的。
pu_crupilot2_cv_futurework_ig_002_ifyous.english: If you see any more Arrays like this one, wouldn't mind you reactivating them. Unofficialy of course.

pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_001_ahhe.chinese: 嘿，你一定是亚希多的技术人员。这里安全了，你可以下去重设阵列了。
pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_001_ahhe.english: Ah hey, you must be the tech from Aciedo. The area's clear so you're good to go down and reset the Array.

pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_002_arey.chinese: 你是亚希多的技术人员吗？看来暂时不会有什么麻烦了，你可以下去把阵列重新连接起来。
pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_002_arey.english: Are you one of the Aciedo techs? It doesn't look like there's going to be any more trouble for now so feel free to go down and bring the Array back online.

pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_004_glad.chinese: 很高兴你们的技术人员这么快就到了。现在风平浪静，你可以开始重新连接阵列了。
pu_crupilot2_cv_mistakentech_ig_004_glad.english: Glad you technicians got here so quick. Things are quiet now so you might as well get started reconnecting the Array.

pu_crupilot2_cv_outlawsattack_ig_001_mul.chinese: 有多个敌对目标正在靠近。

pu_crupilot2_cv_outlawsattack_ig_001b_mu.chinese: 有多个敌对目标正在靠近。

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerattacks_ig_001_wha.english: What the hell are you doing?!

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerattacks_ig_003_gam.chinese: 诡计3号呼叫指挥中心！我们需要支援。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerattacks_ig_003_gam.english: Gambit-3 to Central! We need backup here.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_001.chinese: 飞行员注意，离开这里，不要交火。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_001.english: Attention pilot, stand clear and do not engage.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_003.chinese: 嘿，不知道你来这里有什么事，但你来的不是时候。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_003.english: Hey, not sure what you're business here is, but now's not the time.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_004.chinese: 这片区域不安全，请离开。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_high_ig_004.english: This area is not safe. Please move along.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_001_.chinese: 飞行员注意，离开这里，不要交火。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_001_.english: Attention pilot, stand clear and do not engage.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_002_.chinese: 这里是十字军安保，我们已经把事情处理好了。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_002_.english: This is Crusader Security. We've got the situation handled.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_004_.chinese: 这片区域不安全，请继续前进。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerenters_low_ig_004_.english: This area is not safe. Please keep moving.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_001_thats.chinese: 那是他们最后一个了。去吧系统重置了吧，我们会帮你盯着的。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_001_thats.english: That's the last of them. Go ahead and restart the system. We'll keep an eye out.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_002_scans.chinese: 没有扫描到其他人了。我们会在周围警戒，你能降落然后重新启动阵列吗？
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_002_scans.english: Scan's clear. We'll set up a perimeter, can you land and bring the Array back online?

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_003_ifyou.chinese: 如果你想继续帮忙，就出舱飞过去重启阵列，我们会保护你的。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_003_ifyou.english: If you want to keep helping, EVA down and reset the Array. We'll watch your back.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_004_youse.chinese: 你看起来控制能力很好，要不你把阵列连上吧？我们会确保在你出舱飞行的时候不会有其他人来打扰你的。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_004_youse.english: You seem like you can handle yourself pretty well. How about you bring the Array online? We'll make sure no one jumps you while you're EVAing.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_005_heyth.chinese: 嘿，你的驾驶技术真不错，那你的出舱飞行技术又如何？我们需要守住外围，如果你能去重置下阵列，那就太好了。
pu_crupilot2_cv_playerhelps_ig_005_heyth.english: Hey, that was some pretty decent flying. How are you at EVA? We need to guard the perimeter, but if you could reset the Array, that'd be great.

pu_crupilot2_cv_playerleaves_ig_004_fine.english: Fine. We'll take it from here.

pu_crupilot2_cv_rebootrequest_ig_003_ify.chinese: 如果你想继续帮忙，就出舱飞过去重启阵列，我们就当什么都没看见。
pu_crupilot2_cv_rebootrequest_ig_003_ify.english: If you want to keep helping you could EVA down and reset the Array. We'll pretend we didn't see anything.

pu_crupilot2_cv_rebootrequest_ig_004_ahy.chinese: 你看起来控制能力很好，要不你把阵列连上吧？虽然你不是官方人员，但是也能帮的上忙。
pu_crupilot2_cv_rebootrequest_ig_004_ahy.english: Ah, you seem like you can handle yourself pretty well. How about you go down and bring the Array online? Not officially or anything but it'd help us out.

pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_001_ar.chinese: 这片区域看起来没啥问题，去重置阵列吧。
pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_001_ar.english: Area looks clear. Go ahead and reset the Array.

pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_002_yo.chinese: 你必须出舱飞行到阵列控制面板。
pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_002_yo.english: You'll have to EVA down to get to the Array control panel.

pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_003_go.chinese: 出舱飞行到控制面板吧。
pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_003_go.english: Go ahead and EVA to the control panel.

pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_004_yo.chinese: 你还要不要去重连阵列的？
pu_crupilot2_cv_reminderprompt_ig_004_yo.english: You gonna bring the Array back online or not?

pu_crupilot2_cv_thanks_ig_005_notbadnot,.english: Not bad. Not bad at all.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_announce_mission_fleetb.chinese: 这里是赫斯曼指挥官。我们已经定位了九尾主舰队的位置，希望你能加入帮助我们一起打破这个封锁线。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_announce_mission_fleetb.english: This is Commander Herdsman. We were able to ID the location of the main Nine Tails fleet. I'm hoping you'll sign up to help us put an end to this blockade.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_damagedealt_scanship_3r.english: Got a scanning ship in trouble. Help them out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_damagedealt_scanship_3r.chinese: 扫描船遭受敌方炮火攻击。
九尾正在攻击我们的扫描船，快去帮帮忙。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_damagedealt_scanship_3r.english: Nine Tails are chewing up the scan ships. Help them.
Scan ship in need of immediate assistance.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_deactivated_mainobj_fle.chinese: 小心，阵列下线了。我猜他们在呼叫增援？收到 在途的增援部队确认。做好准备，形势即将变得更复杂了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_deactivated_mainobj_fle.english: Heads up. The array just went dark. I think they're calling in back up? Got it. Reinforcements confirmed. Be ready. Things are going to get intense.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 很不错的开始，看起来我们在星域内联合起来的努力已经有了成效，敌人的数量正在减少。继续努力。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: Good start everyone. Seems our combined efforts across the sector are paying off and their numbers are starting to thin. Keep it up.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 全星域各个地方发来了初获战果的战报。让我们不要松懈，继续施加压力。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: Getting reports in from across the sector and we're starting to see results. Lets keep the pressure up.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 大家听好，星域传来的最初战报看起来很不错。保持这个势头，九尾将毫无还手之力。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: All right, everyone. Early reports from across the sector are looking good. We keep this up and I don't think the Nine Tails stand a chance.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 九尾在整个星域开始遭受大量损失，他们的封锁撑不久了。别掉链子，我们没问题的。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: Nine Tails are starting to take heavy losses across the sector. Their blockade won't last much longer. Don't let up. We can do this.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 九尾在整个星域损失惨重。乘胜追击朋友们！让我们结束这次封锁！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: We're seeing heavy Nine Tails losses from all over the sector. It's now or never, people! Let's end this blockade!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 我们优势很大，目标阵列已经被削弱。保持专注，彻底击溃他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: We've got them against the ropes. The array is starting to weaken. Focus and finish them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 他们剩余兵力不多了。这应该就是他们最后的作战力量，让我们把封锁彻底打破吧！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: There's not much fight left in them now. This should be the last of their forces. Let's put an end to this blockade!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.chinese: 大家听好了，我收到的报告声称目标阵列已经摇摇欲坠了，让我们给它划上句点。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_fleetbattle_a.english: All right, people. My reports are saying the array is barely hanging on. Let's take them down.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 量子抑阻船已被击毁，好极了。
干得好，你击毁了一艘量子抑阻船。继续努力。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.english: Nice job taking out that quantum dampener. Keep it up.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 太好了，又一艘量子抑阻阵列里的船被我们击毁了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.english: Good. That's another ship in the quantum dampening array eliminated.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 另一艘阵列里的船只被击毁了。打得漂亮。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_mainobj_fleet.english: Another ship in the array taken out. Good shooting.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 操，我们失去了一艘扫描船。别让悲剧重演。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Damn it. We lost a scanning ship. Don't let it happen it again.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 扫描船被击毁，我们承担不起更多的损失了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Scanning ship down. We can't afford to lose another.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 九尾击毁了一艘扫描船。谁去阻止下这些狗娘养的?
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Nine Tails took out a scan ship. Would somebody please stop these bastards?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 扫描船被击毁。朋友我们得上点心了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Scan ship lost. Let's do better people.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 操！扫描船被击毁。专心点！我们不能再损失更多扫描船了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Damn. Scan ship down. Focus up! I don't want to lose any more.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 我们就剩一艘扫描船了。不惜一切代价保护它。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: We're down to our last scanning ship. Protect it at all costs.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 各位咱只剩一艘扫描船了，控制住敌人！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Only one scanning ship left, people. Get on them!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 我要所有的飞行员都集中精力去保护最后一艘扫描船！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: I want all pilots guarding the last scanning ship!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 扫描船被摧毁！我们不能让九尾把最后一艘也击毁了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Scan ship down! We can't let the Nine Tails get the last one!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 九尾又击毁了一艘扫描船；我们就剩最后一艘了，不能连它也被拿下。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Nine Tails took out another scan ship. Only one left. We can't lose it.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 扫描船已被全数击毁；我们得赶去下个扫描点了；准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: All scanning ships down. We're going to have to move on to the next scan point. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 去他丫的；各位，那是最后一艘扫描船了。没办法了，得撤退去下个扫描点，准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Damn it, that was the last scan ship, people. No choice. We got to retreat to the next scan point. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 九尾拿下了最后一艘扫描船，到此结束；我们得往下个扫描点移动然后再试一次，准备好接收坐标？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: Nine Tails got the final scan ship. We're done here. Let's move on to the next scan point and try again. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 我们的扫描船已被全数击毁，这片区域算是失守了；所有飞行员准备向下个扫描区域移动，准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: We're out of scanning ships. This area's lost. All pilots ready to move to the next scan area. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.chinese: 那是我们最后一艘的扫描船了，各飞行员准备向下个扫描点撤退，准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_scanship_3rdp.english: That was our last scanning ship. Pilots prepare to retreat to the next scan point. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_turret_fleetb.chinese: 敌方炮塔已摧毁；干得漂亮。

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_cruis.chinese: 成功击毁九尾的巡逻舰！这一定让他们吓到发抖了吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_cruis.english: Nine Tails cruiser destroyed! That's gotta have them shaking.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_cruis.chinese: 已确认；敌方巡逻舰已被击毁！
看来九尾的那艘巡逻舰已经完蛋了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_cruis.english: Looks like that Nine Tails cruiser's done for.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fight.chinese: 敌方战机已被击毁；干得好。
很好，成功击毁九尾的战机。

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.chinese: 你成功了！九尾的旗舰已被击沉！咱把这群混蛋整了个落花流水。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.english: You did it! Nine Tails flagship is down! We got the bastards.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.chinese: 到此为止！成功拿下了旗舰而且抑阻已经结束！我们赢了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.english: That's it! Flagship's destroyed and the blockade is offline! We won!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.chinese: 不错！旗舰已被摧毁！算给九尾上了一课，不要惹十字军。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.english: Yes! Flagship eliminated! That should teach the Nine Tails not to mess with Crusader.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.chinese: 成了！我们赢了！九尾夹着尾巴逃走了！算给他们上了一课。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.english: There! We got them! Nine Tails are running scared! That'll teach them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.chinese: 我去，你成功了！旗舰已击毁，抑阻结束了，咱还把这群混蛋打的落荒而逃。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_flags.english: I'll be damned, you did it! Flagship's down, blockade's over, and we got the bastards on the run.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 又少了个九尾需要我们担心。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: That's one less Nine Tails to worry about.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 敌人已被歼灭；干得不错。
很好，继续保持；就能在这群九尾都来不及反应前灭了他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Well done. Keep it up and these Nine Tails will be done before they know it.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 各位，雷达已净空；看来那是最后一波了，至少暂时是。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Radar's clear, people. That looks like the last of them. For now at least.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 区域内敌人已清空；干得漂亮。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Area's clear of hostiles. Good work.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 行了，雷达上的敌对目标已全数清除；区域已安全。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: That's it. Radar is clear of enemies. Area secure.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 看来那应该是最后一波了，多留个眼以防还有更多会来。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Looks like that might have been the last of them. Stay on alert in case more arrive.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 我想那是最后一波了，至少暂时是；还是多注意下，继续巡逻区域以防万一。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: I think that was the last of them for now. Be we need to be vigilant. Keep patrolling the area just in case.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 没看到再有九尾出现在这附近，我想我们暂时安全了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Not seeing any more Nine Tails in the area. Think we?re good for now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 敌人已全数歼灭。给自己喘口气缓下吧，但还是留个心眼以防还有九尾再回来。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: All hostiles down. Go ahead and catch your breath but be ready in case the Nine Tails try again.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 敌人已被全数消灭，我们成功了。
确认了；区域内的九尾都已被歼灭，保持警惕以防又来更多。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: Confirmed. All Nine Tails in the area eliminated. Stay sharp in case they send more our way.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.chinese: 大家，这波成了；敌方已被消灭，雷达已净空。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_destroyed_vehicle_fleet.english: That did it, people. Hostiles are clear and the radar looks good.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.chinese: 我们真的很需要你。希望你能尽快回来参与行动。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.english: We could really use you out here with us. I want you to rejoin the operation as soon as you can.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.chinese: 对抗九尾的进度正稳步进展着，但依旧需要你的参与；尽快回来这边，越早越好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.english: We're making progress against the Nine Tails, but could use you back in action. Get over here as quick as you can. The sooner, the better.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.chinese: 我非常希望你能回来参与行动，我们需要尽可能多的飞行员，你能来帮忙改变局势。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.english: I sincerely hope you're making your way back to the operation. We need all the pilots we can get. Your help could make all the difference.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.chinese: 只是想确认下你是不是已经在路上了，如果到时我们要对付九尾，就需要全部舰船一起出动。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_encourage_mission_retur.english: Just checking in to make sure you're on your way. I need every ship out here fighting if we're going to deal with these Nine Tails.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你的工作很简单 — 消灭那些在生成量子抑阻力场的飞船阵列，祝你好运。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Your orders are simple - neutralize the array of ships responsible for generating the quantum dampening field. Good luck.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴你能回来，进去里边把这一切了结了吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Glad to have you back. Get in there and let's end this.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 欢迎回来，找到目标，让他们见识见识你的本事。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Welcome back. Find a target, and let them know you mean business.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很好，你回来了。进去里边看看你能帮上哪些忙。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good. You're back. Get in there and help where you can.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴你能回来，准备上工，让自己发挥点作用。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Nice to have you back. Now get to work and make your shots count.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 一直希望你能回来，我们需要所有能够获得的帮助，找出目标并给九尾这帮人瞧瞧你的本事。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Hoping you'd come back. We can use all the help we can get. Find a target and show these Nine Tails what you can do.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 欢迎，飞行员。我们正在进行扫描，在完成之前，我需要你巡视下这片区域以防任何九尾接近。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Welcome pilot. We're underway with the scan, but until it's complete, I want you sweeping the area in case any Nine Tails arrive.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 嘿你好，扫描船正在进行它的工作，在它完成前，需要你巡视下周围区域；如果有九尾出现，就交给你处理了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Hey there. The scan ships are doing their thing. Until they finish, I need you patrolling. If any Nine Tails show up, handle them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴你来了，扫描船刚开始搜集资料；我需要你保护他们以防九尾出现攻击他们，保持警惕。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Glad you could make it. The scan ships have begun collecting their data. I want you protecting them if any Nine Tails decide to attack. Stay ready.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 感谢你加入我们，扫描已经开始了，所以我要你保持高度警戒，九尾随时都可能发动攻击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Thanks for joining us. The scans are already underway, so I need you on full alert. Nine Tails could attack at any moment.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 扫描结果还不错，但得先把九尾解决了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Scans are looking good but I need those Nine Tails taken care of now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 欢迎来到战场，飞行员。我需要你保护这些扫描船，以便他们完成他们的工作。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Welcome to the fray pilot. I need you to protect those scanning ships so they can do their job.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 如果我们没把九尾处理干净，那些扫描船可就麻烦了，去吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: The scanning ships are going to be in trouble if we don't take care of these Nine Tails. Go.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你的职责就是去和九尾交战，保护好扫描船的安全；我们得靠他们才能找出主要舰队。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Your priority is to engage the Nine Tails and keep the scan ships safe. We're going to need them if we want to find the main fleet.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你到的时间正好，九尾正在试图摧毁我们的扫描船，全力保护他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: You got here just in time. The Nine Tails are trying to take out our scanning ships. Protect them at all costs.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你回来的正好，要不先去给那群九尾亲切的打个招呼？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: You're back. Perfect timing. Now how about giving those Nine Tails a hearty hello?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴看到你，去给那些混蛋九尾点颜色瞧瞧吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Glad to see ya. Go on and give those Nine Tail bastards everything you got.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 回来的正好，我们需要帮忙；把火力集中在九尾身上。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: About time you got back. We need the help. Focus fire on those Nine Tails.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 好嘞，你回来了；立刻过去里边，把那些九尾全部干掉。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good. You're back. Get in there. I need these Nine Tails put down now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 欢迎回来，让咱看看你能不能给那群九尾来点教训。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Welcome back. Let's see if you can't teach those Nine Tails a lesson.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴看到你回来了，你负责保护任务，别让任何人妨碍扫描船。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good to see you back in action. You're on protection duty. See that no one interferes with the scan ships.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你回来了，时机正好；刚好需要点额外的火力，全力保护这些扫描船。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: You're back. Good timing. We could use the extra firepower. Protect the scan ships at all cost.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很高兴你回来了，我需要你保护那些扫描船，了解了？那就上吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Glad you made it back. I want you guarding those scan ships, clear? Get to it.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 现在你回来了，我需要你保护那些扫描船以防九尾攻击，确保它们万无一失。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Now that you're back in action, I need you to guard the scanning ships from the Nine Tails. Make sure nothing happens to them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 欢迎回来，飞行员。我们还需要些额外的支援来保护这些扫描船，记得留意九尾。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Welcome back, pilot. We definitely could use the extra support in guarding the scanning ships. Be on the alert for Nine Tails.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 这块区域看来已经净空了，雷达上没有任何敌对目标，正在派遣扫描船。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: This site looks clear. No hostiles on radar. Sending for the scan ships now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 这片区域很安静，扫描船正在路上，咱准备下让他们就位。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Area's quiet. Sending for the scan ships now and let's get them into position.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 好消息，视野内没有发现九尾的踪迹。扫描船赶来前，保持原位。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good news. No Nine Tails in sight. Hold position while the scan ships make their way here.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 我没在雷达上看到任何九尾的踪影，正在派遣扫描船。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: I'm not seeing any Nine Tails on radar. Sending for the scan ships now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 扫描区看上去很清静，正在部署扫描船只过来我们这边。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: The scan area appears to be clear. Deploying the scanning ships to our location now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 毫不意外九尾会在这等着我们，这块区域到处都是这些畜生。得先拿下他们我们才能进行扫描。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Shouldn't be surprised the Nine Tails were waiting for us. Bastards are crawling all over the area. We need to clear them out before we scan.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 我们要先确保这块区域的安全，才能部署扫描船。去把九尾杀的一个片甲不留。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: We need to secure this area before we can redeploy the scanning ships. I want all Nine Tails eliminated.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 看着点，大伙们；保护好这片区域，给九尾点颜色瞧瞧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Look alive, people. Let's get this area secured and these Nine Tails taken care of.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 好了，得先把九尾消灭干净了我们才能进行扫描，把这事先处理了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: All right. We're not going to be able to scan the area until the Nine Tails are eliminated so let's get it done.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 注意，需要将所有敌对目标驱离扫描区域，越快越好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Look alive. I want all hostiles cleared out of the scan area ASAP.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很好，你来了。我要你先去除掉九尾那些人，这样扫描船才能就位。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good, you're here. Need you to clear those Nine Tails out before the scan ships can move into position.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 好了，飞行员。在我们能开始扫描前，我需要你把区域内的所有敌对目标清理干净，赶紧的。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: All right, pilot. We need all hostiles in the area cleared before we can begin scanning.  Get to work.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你的工作是与九尾交战，敌人全数消灭前我们没法让扫描船就位。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Your priority is to engage the Nine Tails. We can't move the scan ships into position until all hostiles are clear.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 飞行员，我需要你去除掉九尾这帮家伙，这片区域安全之后我们才能部署扫描船。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Pilot. I need you to clear these Nine Tails out. As soon as the area is secure we can move the scan ships into position.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 很好，你来了。我们需要歼灭所有的敌人，确保这片区域的安全；越早恢复安全我们就能越快开始扫描他们的主力舰队。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_enter_missionarea_fleet.english: Good, you're here. We need all hostiles eliminated and the area secured. The sooner it's safe the sooner we can scan for the main fleet.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.chinese: 行了，行动结束；你可以去忙你的事了，谢谢。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.english: That's it. The operation is over. You're free to go about your business. Thank you.
We're all done here. You can go.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.chinese: 这边都整完了，你可以离开了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.english: Nothing left to do here. You're free to head out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.chinese: 我想这儿应该没啥需要你做的了，你可以离开了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_fleetbat.english: I don't think there's anything left for you to do here. Feel free to go.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.chinese: 罗斯特主管，抑阻已经结束了，但九尾他们... 他们逃走了，长官，我们尽力了，但是，还是没能阻止他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.english: Director Rust. The blockade is over but the Nine Tails... they escaped, sir. We tried, but? it wasn't enough.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.chinese: 罗斯特主管，我们没能歼灭整支舰队，长官。但好消息是量子抑阻已经结束了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.english: Director Rust. We weren't able to eliminate the fleet, sir. Good news is that the quantum blockade is over for now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.chinese: 罗斯特主管，很抱歉地向您报告，九尾成功溜走了，长官。虽然抑阻已经结束，但我担心威胁仍未完全遏制。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.english: Director Rust. Sorry to report, but the Nine Tails managed to slip away, sir. The blockade is over, but I am afraid that the threat isn't fully contained yet.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.chinese: 罗斯特主管，很抱歉，长官。我们没能成功制伏九尾，但至少抑阻已经结束了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.english: Director Rust. Apologies, sir. We were unable to successfully contain the Nine Tails. At the very least though, the blockade is over.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.chinese: 罗斯特主管，有些坏消息，长官。我们没能抓住罪魁祸首，他们关闭了抑阻装置然后逃跑了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_mission_tochief_.english: Director Rust. Some bad news, sir. We were unable to capture the ones responsible. They turned off the blockade and escaped.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_warning_5mins_fl.chinese: 他们关闭了量子抑阻装置！他们准备跑了，我们得阻止九尾！十字军增援部队在路上了，不过要等他们抵达估计已经为时已晚。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_warning_5mins_fl.english: The quantum dampener is off! They're going to try to run. We need to stop the Nine Tails! Crusader reinforcements are inbound but it may be too late.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_warning_5mins_fl.chinese: 看来他们准备逃跑了，发起最后的攻势，别让他们跑了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_failed_warning_5mins_fl.english: Seems like they're gearing up to make a run for it. This is the final push. Don't let them get away.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 下一个扫描点的位置在这，立刻过去，确保那片区域的安全。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Here's the location of the next scan point. Head there now and secure the site.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 下个扫描点的位置发个你了，所有人准备动身，保护好那片区域。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Sending the next scan point location. Everyone roll out and secure the area.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 这是下个扫描地点，所有飞行员准备过去；武器就位，九尾可能在那等着我们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: That's the next scan location. All pilots head there now. Weapons ready. Nine Tails may be waiting for us.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 拿到下个扫描区域了位置，飞过去确保区域的安全。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Got the next scan area. Fly there and secure the site.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 这是下个需要扫描的区域，能不能守住就看我们了，准备动身。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Here's the next area that needs to be scanned. It's up to us to secure it. Move out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 正在发送我们的下一个扫描点；停止交火，立刻赶过去。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Sending the location of our next scan point. Break off engagement and head there now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 正在发送我们下一个扫描点的坐标；停止交火，立刻赶过去。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Sending the coordinates of our next scan point. Break engagement and relocate to the next site now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 收到了下一个扫描区域的位置，消灭这边的敌对目标不再是首要任务了，我们需要过去确保那片区域的安全。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Got the location of the next scan area. Hostiles here are no longer a priority. We need to get to the site and secure it.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 刚把下个扫描点的位置发给你了，所有飞行员立刻停止交战，迅速赶去指定位置。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Just sent the location of the next scanning site. All pilots should disengage and head there now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 这是下个扫描点的位置，首要目标是确保它的安全，停止交火立刻飞过去。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: This is the next scan site. Securing it takes priority. Break engagement and fly there now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船马上要就位了，让九尾远离他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Scanning ships are moving into position now. Keep the Nine Tails away from them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船正在移入扫描位置了，让我们在他们周围建出一排防线，做好准备，以防九尾出现。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Ships moving into scanning positions now. Let's establish a perimeter around them and get ready in case the Nine Tails decide to show.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船已经到了，所有人保持高度警戒留意任何威胁；我们不能让他们有任何闪失。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Scan ships have arrived so everyone be on high alert for threats. We can't let anything happen to them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船刚从基地离开；他们应该马上就到了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: The scan ships just deployed from base. They should be here momentarily.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船已部署，准备迎接他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Scan ships deployed. Prepare for their arrival.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船们在路上了，准备好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Scan ships are en route now. Stand by.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 好了，扫描船正在赶来我们这的路上。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: All right. Scan ships are making their way to us now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.chinese: 扫描船在来我们这的路上了，眼睛睁大点，大伙们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_fleetfin.english: Scan ships are heading our way. Look alive, people.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.chinese: 你好飞行员，我们刚结束上个扫描点的战斗，正前往下一处，坐标点更新中。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.english: All right, pilot. We finished up at the last scan site, and are making our way to the next. Updating the coordinates.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.chinese: 好消息，我们在上个地点成功完成扫描，正前往下一处。我们那里见。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.english: Good news. We were able to complete our scan at the last location and are now moving on to the next site. See you there.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.chinese: 通知你一声，我们在上个扫描区域完成了数据收集。需要你前往下一个扫描点。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.english: Wanted to give you a heads up that we finished collecting data at the last scan area. Need you to head to the next scan point.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.chinese: 你好，扫描船完成了当前区域的任务，我们正前往下一个扫描点。我们在那儿见。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.english: Hey, the scanning ships just finished their pass at the current location, so we're going to head to the next scan point. Meet us there.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.chinese: 看起来上个扫描点搞定了；需要你前往下一个坐标处帮助我们防守那个区域。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_mission_lastsucc.english: Looks like we're all set with the last scan point. Need you to head to the next coordinates and help us secure the site there.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 扫描船开始扫描区域了；这会引来他人的注意，所以要警惕敌对行为。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scanning ships are beginning their sweep of the area. It's going to draw attention, so be on the look out for hostile action.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 扫描已经开始了，九尾肯定很不爽，做好准备。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scanning has begun. Nine Tails aren't going to be happy about it, so get ready.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 扫描进行中，所有飞船注意九尾的行动。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scanning is underway. All ships be on alert for a Nine Tails response.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 飞船已经开始扫描，我希望所有人准备好应对九尾的袭击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: The ships have started their scans. I want everyone at the ready in case the Nine Tails decide to attack.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 正在扫描当前区域。所有飞行员准备好应对九尾出现的可能。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scan of the area is now underway. All pilots ready up for a possible Nine Tails response.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 扫描船已开始收集数据；所有飞行员，准备好应对袭击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scanning ships have begun collecting data. All pilots, stand ready in case of attack.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 好了，扫描已经开始；战斗船只，保持高度警惕，防止九尾再回来捣乱。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: All right. Scans have started. Combat ships, eyes open in case the Nine Tails come back.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 扫描已开始；巡逻此区域并保障扫描船的安全。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Scans are being carried out. Patrol the area and make sure those ships are protected.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 好了，扫描已经开始；扫描船收集信息的时候，其他人请多加留意，以防敌对势力干预。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Okay. Scans have kicked off. While the ships are gathering info, everyone else needs to be on the look out for hostile interference.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.chinese: 飞船已开始扫描，其他人请高度戒备防止九尾袭击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_begin_f.english: Ships are now actively scanning. Everyone else, you're on high alert for any Nine Tails attack.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 该区域的扫描已完成，数据已准备好送回基地处理，我们将前往下一个扫描区域。准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Scans of this area are done and the data's ready to be analyzed back at base while we head to the next scan area. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 好了，扫描完成；数据需要带回基地分析，而我们需要确保下一个区域的安全。准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: All right. Scans are complete. Data needs to be brought back to base so it can be analyzed while we secure the next location. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 好样的，扫描完成；数据正被带回去分析，我们将前往下一个扫描区域确保那里安全，准备好接收坐标了吗？
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Good. Scanning's done. While the data is being brought back for analysis, we'll head out to secure the next scanning area. Stand by for coordinates?

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 扫描完成；正在将他们召回基地，在成功返航前保护好他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Scan complete. Recalling them back to base now. Protect them until they're clear.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 扫描已完成；飞船将返回基地分析数据。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Scans have finished. Ships will head back to base so the data can be processed.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 扫描完成；撤退并掩护扫描船安全返航。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Scans are done. Fall back and protect them until they're clear.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 扫描全部完成；掩护他们带着数据返回基地。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Scans are all done. Cover them so they can fall back to base with the data.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.chinese: 区域扫描完成，数据已准备好运回基地。在他们离开前阻挡九尾的攻击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_done_fl.english: Area scans complete and data's ready to return to base. Keep the Nine Tails off of them until they clear the area.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描十分顺利，再一会儿就好了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scans are progressing nicely. Should be just a bit longer.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描进度可观，在我宣布完成前请守住防线。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: We're making good progress on the scans. Maintain the perimeter until I give the all clear.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描很快就能完成了，继续巡逻该区域以防敌人攻击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scans should be done soon. Continue patrolling the area for hostile threats.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描数据仍在进行中。请保持警惕，九尾随时可能袭击。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scan data collection is still progressing. Stay alert. Nine Tails could attack at any moment.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描收集到了很棒的数据，但仍需一段时间才能完成。所有人保持警惕。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: We're gathering solid data from the scan, but need more time. Everyone stay alert.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 数据收集仍在进行中，很快就能好了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Data collection is still proceeding along. Shouldn't be much longer, now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 各位再接再厉，我们很快就能完成本区域的扫描了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Keep up the good work everyone. We should be done scanning the area soon.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 目前一切平静，但别放松警惕。我们还需要更多时间扫描，九尾随时可能会来砸场子。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Everything still seems quiet, but don't get comfortable. We still need a bit more time scanning, and the Nine Tails could crash the party at any moment.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 保持警惕，各位。扫描进展顺利，但还没有完成。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Let's stay sharp, people. Scans are making good progress, but we're not done yet.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描船工作进度可观，很快就能完成了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scanning ships are making good headway. Not much longer now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描进行中，但我们需要更多时间！让那些九尾离我们远点。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scans progressing, but we need more time! Keep those Nine Tails clear.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描仍在进行中，保护好扫描船！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: The scans are still going. Protect those ships!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 我们的扫描已经尽可能快了，但需要更多时间。拦住那帮九尾！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: We're scanning as fast as we can, but we need more time. Hold the Nine Tails off!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 让九尾离扫描船远点，不然他们就要完蛋了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Keep the Nine Tails off the scanning ships, or they won't be able to finish!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 我希望各位解决那些九尾，扫描船必须完成数据收集。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: I want these Nine Tails dealt with, people. The scan ships have to finish collecting data.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 我们需要更多时间来完成扫描！快干掉那些九尾！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: We need more time to finish the scans! I want these Nine Tails cleared!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 保护好扫描船！他们需要更多时间才能完成扫描！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Protect the scanning ships! They need more time to finish!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描船需要更多时间，在他们完成之前分散那些九尾的注意。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scanning ships need more time. Keep these damn Nine Tails busy until they can finish.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.chinese: 扫描进度可观，但如果我们不去保护他们的话一切都完了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_inprogr.english: Scans are making good progress but it won't matter if we don't protect them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.chinese: 数据扫描受到干扰，要换一个队形重新尝试，请跟着他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.english: We're getting some interference on the scan data. Going to reposition the scanning ships to a new formation to try and compensate. Stay with them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.chinese: 扫描船需要重新校准位置。请跟随他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.english: The scan ships need to recalibrate their positions. Stay on them as they reposition.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.chinese: 扫描船将调整队形来更好地收集数据。掩护他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.english: The ships are going to adjust their formation to improve the scan data. Cover them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.chinese: 信号遇到问题，需要扫描船调整位置。现在开始重新定位。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.english: Signal's running into issues. Need to adjust the scan ships. Repositioning now.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.chinese: 我们需要重新定位扫描船来防止干扰。请掩护他们。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_inform_scanning_interfe.english: We're going to have reposition the scan ships to compensate for some interference. Keep them covered.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.chinese: 看起来你得到了犯罪等级。解决之前十字军安保无法聘用你。我的建议？去自首吧。指挥官赫斯曼，完毕。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.english: Looks like you got yourself a crimestat. Crusader Security can't use you until you get that sorted. My advice? Turn yourself in. Commander Herdsman, out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.chinese: 飞行员，请注意。有着犯罪等级的个人无法参与十字军安保的行动。就这么简单。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.english: Attention, pilot. Individuals with crimestats can't be a part of any Crusader Security operations. Simple as that.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.chinese: 这是一份正式声明，十字军安保现在起与你断绝本次行动的合作关系。我们无法与任何罪犯共事。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.english: This is a formal notice that as of now Cursader Security is going to sever its ties with you on this operation. We can't be working with active criminals.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.chinese: 谨此通知，由于你目前的犯罪等级，十字军安保不再需要你的协助。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_kicked_mission_criminal.english: This is to let you know that due to your current crimestat, Crusader Security will no longer be requiring your assistance.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你要抛下我们不管？ 我不是很意外，就是很失望。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.english: You're bailing on us? Not surprised really. Just disappointed.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 不敢相信你要中途放弃。大概是我看错人了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.english: Can't believe you're not going to see this through. Guess I was wrong about you.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 你要放弃任务？就这么走了？无所谓，没有你我们干得更好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.english: You're leaving the operation? Just like that? Fine. We're better off without you.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.chinese: 我承认，我从来没想过你会逃避战斗。看来是我错了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_leave_missionarea_fleet.english: I'll admit. I didn't think you were the type to just leave a fight. Seems I was wrong.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 他们重新启动了量子封锁！快去摧毁它。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.english: They've reactivated the quantum blockade! Figures it was too good to last.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 妈的，量子抑阻阵列又上线了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.english: Damn it. The quantum dampening array is back online!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 他们重新启动了量子封锁。看来他们想留下来战斗。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.english: They brought the quantum blockade back online. Guess they want to stay and fight.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 量子抑阻器又启动了！我们需要报销掉这个该死的阵列。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.english: The quantum dampeners are back up! We need to take this damn array out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 抑阻阵列重新上线了。摧毁它之前无法使用量子航行。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_reactived_mainobj_fleet.english: Dampening array is back online. No more quantum travel until we take it down.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 他们正在强化量子抑阻阵列。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.english: They're reinforcing the quantum dampener array.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 探测到更多量子抑阻飞船，他们不打算让封锁轻易结束。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.english: Detecting more quantum dampening ships. They're not letting this blockade go easy.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 九尾派了更多飞船来强化阵列。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.english: Nine Tails are sending in more ships to strengthen the array.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 各位注意，更多量子抑阻飞船加入了阵列。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.english: Look alive, people. Got more quantum dampening ships joining the array.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.chinese: 九尾派了更多飞船来巩固量子抑阻阵列。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_respawned_mainobj_fleet.english: Nine Tails are bringing in more ships to maintain the quantum dampening array.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.chinese: 妈的，他们跑了。不敢相信他们从我们手里溜走了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.english: Damn it all. They're gone. Can't believe we let them slip away.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.chinese: 我们做得还不够，他们逃走了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.english: It wasn't enough. They got away.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.chinese: 我们怎么他妈能让他们逃走呢。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.english: How the hell could we let them escape.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.chinese: 所有人停火，他们逃走了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.english: Everyone stand down. We lost them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.chinese: [叹气]结束了，这帮混蛋逃走了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_escape_done_fle.english: [Sigh] It's over. The bastards managed to get away.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: We've got more Nine Tails inbound!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 注意！更多九尾即将加入战斗！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: Heads up! More Nine Tails on the way!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 雷达显示九尾的增援部队来了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: Radar's showing Nine Tails reinforcements inbound.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 更多九尾部队正飞往你那儿，准备好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: Additional Nine Tails forces coming your way. Ready up.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 九尾的增援来了！准备好！
小心！更多九尾加入战斗。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: Heads up! We've got more Nine Tails coming in hot.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 各位注意。九尾的增援到了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: Look alive people. Nine Tails reinforcements inbound.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.chinese: 更多九尾正飞往你那儿！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_reinforcements_.english: More Nine Tails headed your way!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.chinese: 太好了！搞定了。我们打得他们抱头鼠窜！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.english: Hell yes! That did it. We got them on the run!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.chinese: 好了！他们放弃了！我们成功了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.english: That's it! They're giving up! We did it!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.chinese: 快看，他们撤退了！我们赢了！
成功了！他们逃跑了，空间站得救了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.english: That did it! They're on the run and the station's safe!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.chinese: 他们逃跑了！九尾的封锁结束了！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_retreat_begin_f.english: They're retreating! The Nine Tails blockade's done for good!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 九尾旗舰！小心它的火炮！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: Nine Tails flagship! Watch its fire!
Look alive! Nine Tails cap ship on site!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 这就是九尾旗舰！别被他干掉了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: This is it! Nine Tails flagship. Don't let that thing catch you out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 旗舰出现！这些九尾不是闹着玩的。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: Flagship sighted! These Nine Tails mean business.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 九尾旗舰！他要掩护其他人撤退！把他们都干掉！
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: Nine Tails flagship! It's going to cover their retreat! Take them out!

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 九尾想用他们的旗舰尽可能撤走更多船只。我们不能让他们跑了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: The Nine Tails are going to use their flagship to get as many ships out as they can. We can't let them get away.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.chinese: 这艘旗舰就是他们的掩护！这帮杂碎想用它来逃跑。门儿都没有。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_flagshi.english: The flagship's their cover! The slippery bastards are going to try to use it to escape. That can't happen.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_fleetfi.chinese: 飞行员们，准备好。九尾冲着我们来了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_fleetfi.english: Pilots, at the ready. We got Nine Tails headed our way.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_fleetfi.chinese: 雷达显示有敌人，准备好。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_spotted_vehicle_fleetfi.english: Radar's showing hostile contacts. Get ready.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.chinese: 大家听好了。扫描结果出来了，我们知道那些混蛋藏在那儿了。我们去把他们干掉吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.english: Listen up, people. The scans paid off and we know where the bastards are hiding. Let's go and shut them down once and for all.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.chinese: 好了，各位。我们成功了。我们定位到了九尾舰队。是时候结束这场量子封锁了，我们出发吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.english: All right, everyone. We did it. We found the Nine Tails fleet. Time to put an end to this blockade. Let's move out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.chinese: 我们拿到了等待已久的信息，九尾舰队所在。所有飞行员出发，我们去结束这场战斗。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.english: We got what we were waiting for. Location of the Nine Tails fleet. All pilots move out. Let's finish this.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.chinese: 现在我们知道了九尾舰队的方位，终于可以干掉这些混蛋了。所有飞行员，出发。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_fleetfi.english: Now that we know the location of the Nine Tails fleet we can finally take these bastards down. All pilots, move out.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 罗斯特主管，封锁已解除，长官。九尾已被消灭。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Director Rust, the blockade is cleared, sir. Nine Tails have been eliminated.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 罗斯特主管，我们成功了，九尾的封锁结束了，长官。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Director Rust, we did it. The Nine Tails blockade is over, sir.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 罗斯特主管，我是指挥官赫斯曼。九尾问题已经解决，长官。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Director Rust. Commander Herdsman, here. The Nine Tails have been dealt with, sir.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 罗斯特主管，我是指挥官赫斯曼。好消息，九尾的威胁已被清除。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Director Rust. This is Commander Herdsman. Good news. The Nine Tails threat has been taken care of.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 罗斯特主管，很自豪地告诉您，我们的部队击败九尾消除了威胁，长官。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Director Rust. I am proud to say that our forces were able to overcome the Nine Tails and neutralized the threat, sir.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 太好了长官，我们将前去交战。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Excellent, sir. We will move to engage.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 听到这个我就放心了，长官。交给我们吧。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Relieved to hear it, sir. You can count on us.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 很高兴扫描奏效了，长官。那些九尾不会知道被谁攻击了。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Glad the scans worked out, sir. Those Nine Tails won't know what hit them.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 确实是个好消息，长官。这个封锁必将解除。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Good news indeed, sir. This blockade is all but over.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.chinese: 太好了，长官。解决掉威胁后我会通知您。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_succeed_mission_tochief.english: Wonderful, sir. I'll let you know when the threat has been dealt with.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.chinese: 我谨代表十字军感谢你们所做的一切。你们都在危难时刻挺身而出，我们将永远铭记。请收好，这是你们应得的。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.english: On behalf of Crusader, I want to thank you for everything. You all stepped up when you didn't have to and I won't forget it. Here. You've earned this.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.chinese: 我想真诚地感谢所有人的努力。我们团结一心并取得了胜利。请收好，这是你们应得的。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.english: I sincerely want to thank everyone for what we accomplished here. We all came together and we won. Here. You've earned this.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.chinese: 祝贺各位飞行员。这场胜利来之不易，十字军人民感谢各位的奉献，干得漂亮。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.english: Congratulations, pilots. It was a hard fought victory and you all deserve the thanks and appreciation of the people of Crusader. Well done.

pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.chinese: 今天我们所取得的胜利，离不开各位的帮助。大家做出了重大贡献，对此我深表感激，感谢大家。
pu_cscdr01_m_deh_thanks_withpayment_flee.english: What we did here today, could not have been done with out the help of all of you. This was a momentous effort and you have my appreciation. Thank you.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_failed_mission_tocdr_.chinese: 太让人失望了，指挥官。至少现在封锁已经解除，我希望你返航后到我的办公室来。罗斯特主管，完毕。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_failed_mission_tocdr_.english: That is disappointing, Commander. At least the blockade is over for now. I want to see you in my office when you get back. Director Rust, out.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 我得知你已成功送达补给，飞行员。很高兴你能施予援手。如果你还能帮上其他忙的话，我们将分外感激。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: I was just informed of your successful delivery, pilot. Happy you were able to lend a hand. Anything else you're able to contribute will be very appreciated.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 我想亲自感谢你完成首个补给任务，飞行员。空间站亟需这些补给，希望你还能运送更多物资。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: Reaching out to personally thank you for completing your first delivery. And as badly as these supplies are needed, hopefully it's the first of many.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 希望能让你知道这些补给对我们的工作大有脾益。你的辛苦没有白费。请继续努力。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: Wanted to let you know how much these deliveries are helping our efforts. Your hard work is not going unnoticed. Keep it up.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 不得不说，你为空间站运输补给的工作让我印象深刻。从中能看出真正的奉献精神，每个人的贡献都意义非凡。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: I must say, I've been impressed by your ongoing work to resupply the station. It shows real dedication. Every contribution makes a difference.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 干得漂亮，飞行员。又一趟补给成功送达。我们急需这些补给，所以请继续努力。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: Well done, pilot. Another successful delivery. These supplies are very much needed, so stay the course.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.chinese: 我得知你已经完成了另一趟补给任务。干得漂亮，空间站迫切需要你带来的每一箱补给，所以请继续加油。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_received_supplies_tra.english: I see here that you've completed another delivery. Excellent. Every supply you bring to the station is very much needed, so carry on.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_tocdr.chinese: 太棒了，指挥官。董事会听到这个一定会非常高兴。为那些志愿者提供奖励，并返回总部汇报。主管罗斯特，完毕。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_tocdr.english: Fantastic, Commander. The board will be thrilled to hear. Reward the volunteers for their efforts and report back to headquarters. Director Rust, out.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.chinese: 恭喜你成功完成补给任务。你的努力极大地帮助了空间站，我谨代表十字军对你表示感谢。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.english: Congratulations on a successful supply run. Your effort has done a lot of good for that station. On behalf of Crusader, thanks.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.chinese: 我是主管罗斯特。为大家带来空间站补给的最新信息。我收到报告称他们收到了所有需要的物资，感谢各位的贡献。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.english: Director Rust here. I have an update on the station resupply. Just got word that they have everything they need. Thanks for contributing to the effort.

pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.chinese: 注意，空间站现已成功完成补给，目前无需进一步协助，感谢各位的帮助。
pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade.english: Attention. The station has been successfully restocked. No further assistance with supplies is needed at this time. Thank you for your offer to help.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 听着。我是安保官Vanzant，我有义务特此通知您，由于违约，您的雇佣关系在此终止。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: Listen up. This is Security Officer Vanzant and it is my obligation to hereby notify you that due to breach of contract, your employment is hereby terminated.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 请注意合约执行者，由于您未能履行对十字军安保应有的义务，我在此被授权终止与您的雇佣关系，立即生效。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: Attention contractor. Having failed in your obligations to Crusader Security, I am hereby authorized to terminate your employment. Effective immediately.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 听着，我不想这样做，但以你的所作所为让我别无选择。我将取消与你的合约，抱歉。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: Look, I don't want to do this but with the way you've been acting, you've given me no choice. I'm canceling your contract. Sorry.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badper.chinese: 这里是联络官Vanzant。我原先对你充满了期待，但是你的表现让我不得不终止与你的合约。抱歉，合约失败了。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badper.english: Officer Vanzant here. I was rooting for you, but with your performance I have no choice but to unfortunately terminate your contract. Sorry, it didn't work out.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badper.chinese: 这里还是联络官Vanzant。情况并不好，你的表现低于要求，我将取消合约。不是针对你个人，一路顺风，好吧。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badper.english: This is Officer Vanzant again. It's not good. Your performance has been sub-par and I'm canceling the contract. Nothing personal. Have a good one, okay.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_breaks.chinese: 嘿，虽然我不清楚具体发生了什么，但是一个活跃的犯罪等级代表着你不能为十字军安保工作。我得让你走了，合约结束了。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_breaks.english: Hey, not sure what the hell happened, but an active crimestat means you can't work for Crusader Security. I gotta cut you loose. Contract's over.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_statu.chinese: 嘿，只是来检查一下。看起来你的进度非常不错。继续保持，我们应该马上就能完事了。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_statu.english: Hey, just checking in. Looks like you're making solid progress. Keep it up and we should have everything wrapped up soon.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_respa.chinese: 嘿，很高兴看你重新站起来。合约还在继续，所以如果你还愿意的话，我们依然需要你来完成它。我相信你这次会做的很好。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_respa.english: Hey, glad you're back on your feet. Contract is still open, so if you're up for it, could use your help in closing it out. I'm sure you'll do great this time.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall.chinese: 嘿，还是我联络官Vanzant。刚刚收到确认，你成功送达了违禁品。干的漂亮，十字军安保感谢你的付出。
