pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall.english: Hey again. Officer Vanzant. Just saw the confirmation that you dropped off the contraband. Great work. Crusader Security thanks you for your effort.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aall.chinese: 嘿，恭喜你完成了合约。干得不错，十字军需要可以靠得住的人。希望我们能很快有下一次合作。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aall.english: Hey, congrats on wrapping up the contract. Good work. Crusader needs people we can count on. Hopefully we can do it again sometime soon.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_drug.chinese: 好消息，收到报告称所有在该设施里违禁品都被销毁了。感谢你的帮助，让十字军保持安全。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_drug.english: Good news. Got reports that all the contraband on the site has been destroyed. Appreciate all your help in keeping Crusader safe.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 嘿，这里是联络官Vanzant。看起来你可能有点走偏了。你应该再次检查合约并尝试回到正轨，谢谢。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Hey, it's Officer Vanzant. Looks like you might be getting a bit turned around. You should check the contract again and try to get back on track. Thanks.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 我开始对你失去耐心了。要么回去把这个任务做完，不然我将取消这个合约，你来决定。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: I'm starting to run out of patience with you. Either get on task and take care of this job, or I'm gonna pull the contract. Your choice.

pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 你脑袋是被门挤了么？你依然在偏离目标。把自己整顿好，不然我就得让你提早下岗了！就这么简单。
pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Did you get hit on the head or something? You're still way off course. Get yourself sorted, or I'm pulling you off the job. It's that simple.

pu_customs1_sk_access_deny_ig_002_sorryy.english: Sorry, your access has been denied

pu_customs4_sk_access_deny_ig_002_sorryy.english: Sorry, your access has been denied

pu_darneely_mg_busy_ig_001_myapologiesto.english: My apologies, too much to do.

pu_darneely_mg_busy_ig_003_weshallhave.chinese: 我们待会再聊吧。我现在手头上的事有点多。
pu_darneely_mg_busy_ig_003_weshallhave.english: We shall have to talk later. I am positively overwhelmed at the moment.

pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.chinese: 我很赏识你的忠实，因为很多人都是接完任务，就跑了。
pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.english: I appreciate your honesty. Most would have taken the job and let it languish.

pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.chinese: 嗯，也是，选择权在你手上。
pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.english: That, of course, is your prerogative.

pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.chinese: 也许哪天你事少些了，会再来考虑的。
pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.english: Perhaps if your schedule clears you will reconsider.

pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.chinese: 如果改变主意了就过来吧，毕竟很遗憾，我只会呆在这儿。
pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi.english: Come back if you change your mind. Sadly, I will still be here.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_0.chinese: 你好啊，已经有段时间了。我们都做过令自己后悔的事，不是吗。也许是时候向前看了，对了，名叫克洛夫斯。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_0.english: Hello there. It's been a while. We both did things we regret, you and I. Maybe it's time to try and move on. It's Clovus by the way.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_00.chinese: 有空就来罗威尔看看我。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_00.english: Come see me in Lorville if you're free.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_00.chinese: 有空就过来看看，这段时节的罗威尔可是一年中最好的，才怪。还是和平时一样死寂，但有空就顺道过来吧。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_00.english: Please visit. Lorville is lovely this time of year. I kid. It's dreadful as always, but you should come by.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_.chinese: 嗯，看来一切都很不错。谢谢你。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_.english: Yes, this all seems to be in order. Thank you.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_.chinese: 非常好，细节处理的可说是一丝不苟，非常感谢你的努力。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_.english: Wonderful, all i's dotted and t's crossed so to speak. Your efforts are appreciated.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_w.chinese: 不客套了。我刚收到消息，有些不错的活能给你。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_w.english: Why hello. I've just received word about some exciting employment opportunities.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_004_h.chinese: 你好啊，我是你的朋友兼恩人，克洛夫斯·达尼利。看来是有个能让我们一同获利的机会出现了。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_004_h.english: Hello there, it's your friend and benefactor, Clovus Darneely. Seems an opportunity has arisen that could profit both of us.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002_.chinese: 欠你的报酬已经发过去了。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002_.english: The credits you are owed have been issued.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_003_.chinese: 我会把该给的钱一次付清的。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_003_.english: I will send you your fee at once.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_failbou.chinese: 尽管我想用文明的方式解决，但你还是得逼我动手。我已经对那些失物标定悬赏了。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_failbou.english: Despite my attempts to be civil, you have forced my hand. A bounty has been placed for the retrieval of my stolen property.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_failbou.chinese: 好心提醒，已经有些专业猎人在等着帮我归还失物了。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_failbou.english: Fair warning, there are now professionals hunting you down to collect what is mine.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwar.chinese: 你还是没把我的东西还回来。如果你不当回事，那也就别怪我不客气了。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwar.english: You still have not returned my property. If that oversight is not rectified shortly, I will be forced to take action.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwar.chinese: 如果你再不把我的东西还回来，那就请你后果自负。你应该知道我可不是那种只是说说而已的人。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwar.english: If you do not return my property at once, there will be consequences. You should know that I am not one to make idle threats.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_reminde.chinese: 当然，你还是得把属于我的东西还来。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_reminde.english: Of course, you will have to return any property that rightfully belongs to me.

pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_reminde.chinese: 我提醒你下，你手上可还有我的东西，别忘了要迅速归还。
pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_reminde.english: Need I remind you that any property of mine that is currently in your possesion will need to be returned post haste.

pu_darneely_mg_convorejoin_ig_003_ohyouv.chinese: 哦，你回来了，很好。我刚在说...
pu_darneely_mg_convorejoin_ig_003_ohyouv.english: Oh, you've returned. Splendid. As I was saying...

pu_darneely_mg_decide_encouragelookandde.chinese: 看下吧，有啥想法就告诉我。
pu_darneely_mg_decide_encouragelookandde.english: Please review at your convenience and let me know.

pu_darneely_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_.chinese: 我就把你的无作为当作是回绝了。
pu_darneely_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_.english: I shall take your inaction as a no.

pu_darneely_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_.chinese: 看来你的犹豫说明了一切，不多说了。就当没这回事吧。
pu_darneely_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_.english: Your hesitancy speaks volumes. Say no more. Consider the offer null.

pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_001_apol.chinese: 实在抱歉，今天这空气可真是糟透了，这儿，还活着，算是吧？
pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_001_apol.english: Apologies, the air is especially dreadful today. There, still alive. I think?

pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_002_hell.chinese: 你好，欢迎来到奥林森回收站，我的名字是克洛夫斯·达尼利， 很高兴见到你。
pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_002_hell.english: Hello and welcome to Reclamation & Disposal. My name is Clovus Darneely. Wonderful to meet you.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_g.chinese: 我对你上次的任务感到很抱歉。你离成功只差一步了，我想这也是为啥大家常说，鱼跟熊掌，不可兼得。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_g.english: Apologies on your last assignment. You were on the cusp of success, but I guess that's why the prevailing wisdom espouses that you can't win them all.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_n.chinese: 我希望，你能从上次的失误中吸取教训。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_n.english: I hope we've learned from our mistakes on that last assignment.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_n.chinese: 我们所有人都得学会面对失败。再说白点就是，你得从上次任务中的失败找到应对的方法。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_n.english: Failure is something we all have to learn to cope with. More to the point, after your last assignment, failure is something you have to cope with specifically.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_failst.chinese: 你就像西西弗斯一样，永远被束缚在艰苦的抗争中，一次又一次，不断的失败。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_failst.english: Like Sisyphus, you seem to be perpetually locked in an uphill struggle only to fail time and time again.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_failst.chinese: 看来上一个任务标记你又失败了，而且还是一连串的失败。够让我失望的了。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_failst.english: That last assignment marks yet another failure in what seems destined to inevitably be a very long line of failures. Dissappointing to say the least.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastch.chinese: 尽管我有更好的选择，但我还是倾向于再给你一次机会，去挽回你的处境。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastch.english: Despite my better judgment, I am inclinded to grant you one more chance to turn the tide of your misfortunes.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolong.chinese: 恐怕我们别无选择了。我们之间的合作关系，如果还能被称为合作关系的话，现在开始彻底失效 ，祝你今后愉快。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolong.english: There are no options left for us, I am afraid. This partnership, if it ever could be called such, is henceforth null and void. I wish you good day.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed.chinese: 看来你已经从上次的失败中振作起来了，我很欣慰。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed.english: I am relieved to see you back on your feet after your misfortune during the last job.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed.chinese: 还能看到你可真是令我意外，在被那些无赖搭上后，居然还能安然无恙。我想你若能越早把之前的事放下，会对你越好。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed.english: It is fortuitous that you emerged, life intact, after being accosted by such scoundrels. The sooner we put the previous assignment behind us the better I say.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 我对你最近干活的方面有些话想说，非常不错，真的。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: I was reflecting upon the completion of your most recent task. Fantastic work. Really.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 如果让我来说，你做起事来既有波尔托斯的优雅，又兼具伊卡洛斯的神速。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: If I may say so, you accomplished your task with Porthos' grace and Icarus' speed.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 我能给你上次的工作打个满分。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: Full marks for that last bit of work you saw to.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 我想花点时间来表扬下你最近的工作，就像我妈常说的，“把事做好，就值得表扬”。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: I wanted to take a moment to congratulate you on your recent work. As my mother always canted, "A good job, deserves a good word."

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 不得不说，看来没什么是能难得了你的。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: I must say, it seems there is nary an egg that your touch cannot turn to gold.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.chinese: 你最近的努力我可都是有看在眼里的，没骗你，我对那些我们的小工作都感到更加兴奋了。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes.english: Your efforts of late have not gone unnoticed. Truely, I could not be more ecstatic about our little arrangement.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhar.chinese: 算我求你了，上点心，想办法为推动我们的财运来出点力。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhar.english: I implore you, reach deep into yourself and find new strength with which to pursue our fortunes.

pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhar.chinese: 你就再给力点吧，除此外没啥好说。不然，我就把这些活留给别人做了。
pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhar.english: You must try harder. You simply must. Otherwise, I must cast my employment services elsewhere.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_.chinese: 这下可尴尬了，看来我得取消我俩之间的工作合约，为你的不便感到抱歉。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_.english: This is embarassing, but I'm afraid I must cancel our arrangement. Apologies for the inconvenience.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_.chinese: 因为诸多预料之外的琐事，看来必须把我们直接的协议了结了。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_.english: Due to a cavalcade of unforseen circumstances, I must render our agreement null.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_im.chinese: 我想你是彻底错失这次机会了。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_im.english: I'm afraid you've thoroughly fumbled this opportunity.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_im.chinese: 我不想吼人。真的不想。但这...太令人失望了。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_im.english: I'm not going to yell. I'm not. But this... is most disappointing.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_0.chinese: 这可令人兴奋了，但事也相对变得有些复杂。好好看下吧。真不骗你。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_0.english: This is very exciting, but things have gotten a little more complicated. Have a look. Very exciting indeed.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_0.chinese: 和你手上那差事有关的新消息出来了。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_0.english: New information pertaining to your current task has come to light.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_.chinese: 听到这消息可真令我沮丧。还以为你接下了任务，就会一路做完呢。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_.english: I am most dismayed to hear that. When you agree to perform a service, one assumes that you will see it through to the end.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_.chinese: 真是业余，一点也不专业...
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_.english: This is most unprofessional. Most unprofessional...

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig.chinese: 收到你传给我的了，万分感谢。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig.english: I received your upload. Many thanks.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig.chinese: 感谢你传给我，谢了朋友。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig.english: Thank you for the transfer, my friend.

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig.chinese: 可能是年纪大了，也容易焦虑了。但一般来说你也应该快把事情处理完了，我想是吧？
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig.english: It may be that I am growing nervous with age, but ideally you should be getting close to wrapping up this job for me, correct?

pu_darneely_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig.chinese: 你应该快处理完我之前和你定下的合约了吧，是不？不是我想找茬，我挺相信你的。我知道你能做的来。
pu_darneely_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig.english: You are nearing completion on your current assignment for me, are you not? Not that I'm checking in. I trust you. I'm sure everything is fine.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiona.chinese: 真不错。祝你冲锋陷阵顺利，我很快会再跟你联系的。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiona.english: Excellent. Good luck on your charge and I will speak to you soon.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiond.chinese: 那我就先祝你有个美好的日子吧。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiond.english: I will bid you a fond day then.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.chinese: 啊，我的老友，挺久没见了是不。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.english: Ah, my old friend, it's been too long.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.chinese: 至少，来了个有趣的家伙。今天原本还挺拉跨的。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.english: At last, someone interesting. This day has been absolutely dragging.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.chinese: 欢迎，欢迎。我的魂魄下凡归来，与你相见。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig.english: Welcome, welcome. My soul vaults to the heavens to see you again.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_nolonge.chinese: 如果你来这是想用回收服务，可以自己去用那边的终端，不然，就请让我一人静会。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_nolonge.english: If you are here for reclamation services you may avail yourself at the terminal, otherwise, kindly leave me alone.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_nolonge.chinese: 我没什么想跟你聊的，祝你今日愉快。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_nolonge.english: I haven't a single thing I wish to discuss with you. Good day.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_stillmi.chinese: 很不幸，你的时间正在流逝，还有你的报酬也是如此。或许你该加快脚步了。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_stillmi.english: Time is fleeting and unfortunately, so is your charge. Perhaps you should expedite things.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_stillmi.chinese: 还待在这干吗？该走了。时间不等人的。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_stillmi.english: What are you doing here? Off you go. There's no time to waste.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_wrongde.chinese: 我想你搞错了。这东西不该来这。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_wrongde.english: I believe you are mistaken. That doesn't come here.

pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_wrongde.chinese: 我不知道你希望我拿这个能做什么。我建议你把它带到更正确的地方。
pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_wrongde.english: I'm not quite sure what you expect me to do with that. I suggest you take it to a more suitable destination.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_har.chinese: 如果想做些具有挑战性的，这边可能有些能符合你期望的东西。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_har.english: If you are up for a challenge, I may know of something that would fit the bill.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 我算是为了钱跟利益，豁出去了。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: I have procured quite a little adventure for profit and gain.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.chinese: 又是一次硝烟弥漫，充满化学污染的破晓，但它也是令我们有机会利用现今局势的曙光。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_.english: Another soot-filled, chemical stained sunrise brings another chance to avail ourselves of our current situation.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_i.chinese: 虽然不想让你失望，但看来我手上现在没有活能给你做。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_i.english: I am loathe to dash your hopes, but the job well seems to have run dry for the moment.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_i.chinese: 很好的问题，但恐怕答案不尽人意。很遗憾我没有什么工作能派给你。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_i.english: An excellent question, with a dissapointing answer I'm afraid. I regrettably have nothing to offer.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_fin.chinese: 我收到了些和打捞事务相关的线索，遗憾的是，他们并不乐意直接说出具体位置。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_fin.english: I received another tip about some salvage. Sadly, they were not as forthcoming about exactly where it could be found.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_gen.chinese: 我收到了个打捞的工作能让你做，非常令人振奋，我知道。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_gen.english: I have received word that there is salvage to be had. Very exciting, I know.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_gen.chinese: 我需要你去回收一些残骸回来，如果你有意愿，那就去把它们取来吧。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_gen.english: I require the retrieval of some salvage. If you are willing, you shall go fetch it.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_inv.chinese: 又是新的一天，又是一簇机遇。我收到了一列潜在的打捞地点，如果你有兴趣，那它们就是你的了。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_inv.english: Another day, another cluster of opportunity. I have received a list of potential salvage sites and if you agree, they shall be yours for the taking.

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_pir.chinese: 我想我可能知道些刚刚出炉的打捞地点。但有些不幸，你可能得用些战斗手段去争取，惊险又刺激，对吧？
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_pir.english: I may know of some very fresh salvage. Unfortunately, you might have to battle your way to it. Thrilling, yes?

pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_steal_retri.chinese: 实话跟你说，我有个特定的残骸要回收，而且很急。急到我恨不得叫你现在去帮我自己整个残骸出来。
pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_steal_retri.english: Truth be told, I have been in dire need of some very specific salvage. Dire enough to encourage you to go ahead and create the salvage yourself.

pu_darneely_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_0.chinese: 只是这份共事的机会，令我感到不知所措。太多事情要处理了。如果你能来帮把手，请一定要告诉我。
pu_darneely_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_0.english: I am simply overwhelmed with the prospects of employment. Far too many to keep track of. Let me know if you may alleviate me.

pu_darneely_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_0.chinese: 我就像尼斯她本人一样，是一切机遇的聚合点，自己看下吧。
pu_darneely_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_0.english: Like Nisces herself, I have become a confluence of opportunity. See for yourself.

pu_darneely_mg_playergoofsoff_ig_001_wha.chinese: 你这是在干什么迷惑行为。

pu_darneely_mg_playergoofsoff_ig_003_are.english: Are you feeling quite all right?

pu_darneely_mg_prompt_missionorscrap_ig_.chinese: 在这还算过得去的日子里，有什么我能帮到你的？
pu_darneely_mg_prompt_missionorscrap_ig_.english: What can I do for you on this fine day?

pu_darneely_mg_prompt_missionorscrap_ig_.chinese: 那，有什么我能帮到你的吗？
pu_darneely_mg_prompt_missionorscrap_ig_.english: And how may I help you?

pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.chinese: 你知道不？我历经了赫斯顿家族，四个世代的朝迁市变。他们就如同我喜爱的那些芝士一样，随着时间推移，也会变得更软，更令人反感。
pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.english: Do you know I've met four generations of Hurstons? And just like my favourite cheeses they get softer and more repugnant with age.

pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.chinese: 做个好人，辛勤付出，但得到的回报却少之又少，每次看到这些就会令我挺伤感的。但人生何尝不是如此，是吧？
pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.english: It saddens me to see good people toil so hard and have so little to show for it. But that is our lot in life is it not?

pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.chinese: 被这样的人类工业所包围，除了感到惊叹之外，也格外有些伤感。
pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme.english: Surrounded by such Human industry, I am both profoundly awed and deeply saddened.

pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.chinese: 啊，对。我想应该又是一堆破铜烂铁。行吧，你可以去终端机那里看看能不能解决问题。
pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.english: Ah. Yes. More metal for the pile, I say. Well, the terminal will be able to sort you out.

pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.chinese: 好的，去使用那边的终端，然后就能帮你处理后面的了。
pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.english: Well then, access the terminal over there and we'll get you started.

pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.chinese: 我想你可以直接去找我的那位同事，终端机它可乐于助人了。
pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina.english: Might I direct you to consult with my colleague over there. The terminal is most accommodating.

pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.chinese: 以下是这次小小践行的细节内容。
pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.english: Here are the particulars to this little excursion.

pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.chinese: 我相信细节决定成败。还是仔细看下吧。
pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.english: The devil's in the details, I believe. Read them well.

pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.chinese: 我这有份详细的清单能供你检阅。
pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_.english: I have a list of the pertinent details for you to peruse.

pu_darneely_mg_transition_commenttogivin.chinese: 但我想，听我这把老骨头在这抱怨，应该不是你此行的真正目的吧，是不？
pu_darneely_mg_transition_commenttogivin.english: But I suppose that hearing an old man's opinions was not the real focus of your visit, correct?

pu_darneely_mg_transition_commenttogivin.chinese: 那就不多废话了，说正事吧...
pu_darneely_mg_transition_commenttogivin.english: But let us move on, shall we...

pu_dataheistsv01_f_servercoolingenabled.chinese: 服务器冷却可用。温度回归正常。
pu_dataheistsv01_f_servercoolingenabled.english: Server cooling enabled. Temperature returning to normal.

pu_dataheistsv01_f_warningserveroverheat.chinese: 警告：服务器过热，请注意。

pu_dataheistsv01_f_warningservertemperat.chinese: 警告：服务器严重过热，数据即将丢失。
pu_dataheistsv01_f_warningservertemperat.english: Warning. Server Temperature Critical. Data Loss Imminent.

pu_dataheistsv01_m_warningsecuritybreach.chinese: 警告：检测到入侵，响应小组已派出。
pu_dataheistsv01_m_warningsecuritybreach.english: Warning. Security Breach. Response Team has been dispatched.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.chinese: 防务展现已开幕。大家请尽情参观。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.english: DefenseCon is a go, people. Enjoy yourselves.
And we're off. DefenseCon is open for business.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.chinese: 防务展现已开放。感谢光临，祝您参观愉快。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.english: DefenseCon is now open. Thanks and enjoy your day.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 大家好，防务展即将开放。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Hello everyone, DefenseCon will be opening really soon.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 很高兴见到大家。防务展马上就要开放了。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Glad to see you all. DefenseCon will be open soon.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 大家好呀，感谢你们的等待，防务展不久后就要开放了。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Hey there, everybody. Thanks for waiting, DefenseCon will be opening shortly.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_001_h.chinese: 喂，我可没有开玩笑。你不该到这来，等着安保来找你麻烦吧。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_001_h.english: Hey, I wasn't joking. You aren't meant to be here. You better sit tight for security.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_002_u.chinese: 呃，你没有权限到这来，我也不想赶你走，但规矩就是规矩。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_002_u.english: Um, you're not allowed to be in here. I hate to narc you out, but rules are rules.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.chinese: 大家好，我们的展览马上就要结束了。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.english: Hey everybody, we're gonna be closing up soon.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.chinese: 大家好，提醒各位防务展马上就要结束了。大家不要着急，请有序前往出口。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.english: Hi all, just a head's up that DefenseCon going to be closing soon. No rush, but start making your way to the exits.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.chinese: 提醒大家防务展马上就要结束了，请有序前往出口。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_ig_0.english: Just wanted to let you know that DefenseCon will be closing up soon, so start making your way to the exit.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_last.chinese: 离开展厅的最后机会了。游客不能留在展馆内，你必须离开。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_last.english: Last chance to get out of here. We can't have any attendees in the halls, so you've gotta leave.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.chinese: 大家好，我们很快就要闭馆了，请尽快离开本馆。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.english: Hey all, we're closing up soon so you'll have to head out.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.chinese: 提醒大家，本次活动马上就要结束了。大家可以不急着回家，但不能留在场内。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.english: Just a quick announcement, the event's due to close up soon. You don't have to go home but you can't stay here.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.chinese: 再次提醒各位，防务展马上就要关闭了。我知道最难是离别，但你们还是得出去。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe.english: Another reminder that DefenseCon will be closing soon. I know it's tough to leave, but you've got to.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_001.chinese: 好了，到点了，防务展正式闭馆。希望大家都听从我之前的通知乖乖出去了。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_001.english: All right, that's it. DefenseCon is closed. I hope everybody listened to my previous announcements and got out.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_002.chinese: 防务展正式结束。真心希望没人被锁在里面。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_002.english: DefenseCon is now closed for the day. Really hope that nobody stuck around after they locked the doors.

pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_003.chinese: 好了，们都锁了。大家好样的，希望没有来参观的大聪明以为自己能躲在展厅里面。
pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_003.english: All right, doors are locked. Great work everybody, and I really hope none of our attendees thought they'd be clever and hide out in here.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 那些轰炸机要是不停下来，我们可就完蛋了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Those bombers are gonna wreck us if you don't stop them.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 该死，轰炸机来了。你得想办法对付它们。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Damn it. Bombers. You got to do something about them.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 轰炸机正在靠近。你得在太晚之前把它们干掉。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Got bombers coming. You gotta take 'em out before it's too late.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 他们快把所有东西都毁了！我们绝不能让他们得逞！
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.english: They almost destroyed everything! We can't let them win!

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 我们已经快撑不住了！赶紧解决掉他们，不然我们就完蛋了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.english: We're hanging on by a thread here. Take them out now or we're done for.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 这是你阻止他们的最后机会了，再晚就全完了！
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage25targets.english: This is your last chance to stop them before everything's destroyed!

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 我们损失惨重，你能不能想想办法？
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.english: We're taking a lot of damage. Can't you do something?

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 他们已经摧毁了一半的东西。再这样下去，剩下的也保不住。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.english: They've knocked about half of everything out. If they keep this up, they're going to get the rest.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 你能不能多做点什么来阻止他们？他们已经毁掉了一半的东西了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_damage50targets.english: Can't you do anything more to stop them? They've taken out half of everything already.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 这可给他们点颜色瞧瞧了！
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: That showed them a thing or two!

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 爽啊！那飞行技术太牛了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Hell yeah. That was crack bit of flying.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 干得漂亮！我有没有说过有你在这儿我有多高兴？
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Nicely done. Have I said how happy I am you're here?
Look at that! You're not half bad you know.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 干得好！看来你确实知道自己在干嘛。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Good work there. Guess you know what you're doing after all.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 有更多的混蛋朝我们这边来了！
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.english: There's more of those bastards coming our way!

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 小心！更多的飞船正在靠近！

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 这些混蛋把最后一个也毁了！看来我们没啥能及时阻止他们的希望了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: The bastards destroyed the last of 'em! Guess it was too much to hope that we'd stop them in time.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 该死！他们把最后一个也毁了。我打赌那些混蛋现在正得意呢。不过，至少你尽力帮忙了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Damn it all. The destroyed the last one. Bet those bastards are feeling pretty smug about themselves. Well, at least you tried to help.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 不！他们把所有的都毁了！真是气死我了。我早该知道不该抱太大希望的。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: No! They destroyed all of them! Damn it. Guess I should have known better than to get my hopes up.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 我的天啊，真不敢相信我们挺过来了。你在外头小心点，我得开始检查修理了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: God damn. I can't believe we made it through that. You be safe out there. I'm gonna start looking at repairs.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 太棒了！去死吧，你们这些混蛋。你刚才的飞行技术真是没话说，真的救了我们的命啊。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: Yes! Take that, you bastards. That was some nice flying out there. You seriously saved our bacon.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 我们成功了吗？你刚才的表现真是太牛了，要不是你，我们根本撑不过来。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: We good? That was a helluva job you did out there. No way we would've made it through that.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 干得好！回来把剩下的那些家伙清理一下。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: Nice work. Just come on back and sweep up these stragglers.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 干得漂亮。把这些残兵败将收拾干净，咱们就能收工了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: Helluva job. Clean up these stragglers and we can call it a day.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 真是见鬼了，你居然做到了。现在只需要把最后那些家伙解决掉就行了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: I'll be damned, you did it. Just gotta finish off the last of 'em now.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 本来就已经够让人头疼了，现在看来又得处理这个了...
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.english: As if we didn't have enough to worry about, guess we got to deal with this now too…

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 嘿，我知道你已经有很多事要忙了，但又出了点新状况...
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Hey, I know you got a lot to handle already, but something else came up…

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 真不想打扰你，但还有件事需要你关注一下...
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Hate to bother you, but got something else that can use your attention…

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 好吧，我知道我已经要求很多了，但你觉得还能再处理一件事吗？
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Okay, I know I'm asking a lot, but think you can take care of one more thing?

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 真他妈的高兴见到你。实话跟你说，我们这边麻烦大了，所以你能做什么就赶紧做吧。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Damn happy to see you. Not gonna lie, we're in a heap of trouble here so just do whatever you can.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 太好了，你来了。这些不法分子要是继续闹下去，一切就全完了，我们真的很需要你的帮助。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Great. You're here. We really could use your help dealing with these outlaws before they destroy everything.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 谢天谢地你来了。这些不法分子要是你不拦住他们，他们就会把一切都毁了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Thank goodness you're here. These outlaws are going to destroy everything unless you stop them.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 你来得正好。你也看到了，我们手忙脚乱的。赶紧加入战斗，尽你所能阻止他们吧
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Nice of you to show up. We got our hands full as you can see. Jump in and do what you can to stop 'em.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 嘿，很高兴你能来帮忙。这些混蛋正想毁掉我们的一切呢。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Hey there. Glad you could help us out. These assholes are trying to destroy everything we got.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 该死。真希望刚才的情况能好点，但这还没完呢。我们还能挺过去的。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: Damn. Wish that had gone better, but this isn't over yet. We can still get through this.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 唉，算了。没时间纠结这个了，我们还有更大的麻烦要处理。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: Oh well. No time to worry about that. We got bigger fish to fry.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 估计指望你搞定那个也太难了。咱们还是先集中精力解决主要问题吧。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: Guess it was too much to hope you could take care of that too. Let's just focus on the main problem for now.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivesuc.chinese: 开心啊，这事儿终于搞完了。现在我们可以专心对付真正的大问题了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivesuc.english: Happy that's done. Now we can focus on the real problem.

pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivesuc.chinese: 行了，那事儿搞定了。接下来就只剩收拾烂摊子了。
pu_defendnpc01_civ_m_pmh_subobjectivesuc.english: All right, that's taken care of. Just got to take care of the rest.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 如果我们不干掉那些轰炸机，它们可就要了我们的命了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Those bombers are going to be the end of us if we don't take them out.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 在那些轰炸机干掉我们之前，集中火力先把它们打下来。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Focus fire on those bombers before they can take us out.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.chinese: 必须赶紧清理掉那些轰炸机，不然它们会造成严重破坏。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_bomberscallout_.english: Got to clear out those bombers fast before they do some serious damage.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 我们快没时间了！他们几乎要摧毁一切了！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.english: We're running out of time! They've almost destroyed everything!

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 嘿，这是我们的最后机会了。现在就阻止他们，不然他们会把所有东西都毁掉！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.english: Hey, this is our last chance. Stop them now, or they're gonna destroy them all!

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.chinese: 你得现在做点什么，不然这些混蛋会把一切都毁了！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage25targets.english: You need to do something now before these assholes destroy everything!

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 空间站的情况不太妙啊。在他们摧毁剩下的部分之前，你得赶紧做点什么。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.english: The station's not looking too good. Need to do something before they take out the rest of it.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 我们在这儿被揍得够呛。你能不能在这些混蛋造成更多破坏之前阻止他们？
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.english: We're really getting beat up here. How about you stop these assholes before they do too much more damage.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.chinese: 我们得认真起来了。他们造成的伤害已经超出我们能承受的范围了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_damage50targets.english: We need to get serious here. They're doling out more damage than we can take.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 太棒了！这就让他们这些混蛋尝尝厉害！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Yes! Way to show these bastards a thing or two.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 干得好。让这些渣滓付出代价吧。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Good. Let's make this scum pay.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 没错！我打赌他们现在已经开始后悔招惹我的空间站了！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Yeah! Bet they're regrettin' messin' with my station now!

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 太解气了。我希望那家伙没法重生。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Hell yeah. I hope that asshole can't regen.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 太好了。没有什么比看到有人自食其果更让人开心的了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Lovely. Nothin' better than someone getting what they deserve.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 嘿，打起精神来。有更多的飞船来了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostilereinforc.english: Hey, look alive. We got more ships arriving.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 你看到了吗？这些渣滓叫来了增援。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostilereinforc.english: Did you see? These scum called in reiforcements.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 该死。又来了更多的敌人。

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 真是该死透顶。他们把一切都毁了。我猜我最好去看看还能抢救点什么。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Damn it to hell. They got it all. Guess I better go and see what I can salvage.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 糟了。那是最后一个了。看来这些混蛋得逞了。真不知道我们该怎么重建。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Shit. That was the last one. Guess the bastards got what they wanted. No idea how we're gonna rebuild after this.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 真不敢相信。五年的努力和积蓄就这么没了。我都不知道该怎么翻盘了。不过，还是感谢你尽力了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Can't believe it. 5 years of work and savings wiped out just like that. Don't know how I'm gonna come back from this. Anyway, thanks for trying.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 干得漂亮！这次真的欠你个人情，不过我还得赶紧回去忙了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: Ace flying out there. I really owe you for this one, but I gotta get back to it.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 我觉得没问题了。虽然还有些工作要做才能完全恢复，但情况本可能更糟的。谢谢你。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: I think we're clear. Got some work to do to get us back to 100%, but could've been a lot worse. Thank you.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.chinese: 警报解除。多亏你帮忙，不然我们早就完蛋了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_missionsuccess_.english: Scope's clear. Appreciate the help. We would've been cooked if you hadn't shown up.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 现在情况看起来很不错了，把剩下的那些家伙解决掉就完事了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: We're looking real good now. Just finish off the last of 'em.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 哦，太棒了！就剩下几个要处理的，搞定了咱们就轻松了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: Oh hell yeah. Just got a couple more to deal with and we should be good.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.chinese: 干得漂亮。还有几个在捣乱，解决了就没事了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_mopupremaining_.english: Nice one. Still got a few causing problems and then we should be good.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Hey, there's one more thing we gotta deal with…

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 真是屋漏偏逢连夜雨啊。看看你能不能顺便把这个也搞定。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Guess when it rains it pours. See if you can sort this out too.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 本来事情就够多的了，你觉得还能顺便搞定这个吗？
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.english: Like there wasn't enough going on already. Think you can tackle this too?

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.chinese: 我知道你已经忙得不可开交了，但我还需要你再帮一个忙。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_newsubobjective.english: I know you got a lot on your plate, but I need your help on one more thing.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 总算有人来帮忙了。趁这些混蛋还没造成更大的破坏，见到就开火。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: About time we got some help. Shoot any of these bastards you can before they can do any real damage.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 很高兴看到救兵来了。这些家伙铁了心要毁了我的前哨站，希望你能阻止他们。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Glad to see the calvary. These idiots are hell-bent on destroying my station. Hopefully you can stop them.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 欢迎来到这烂摊子。希望你已经准备好战斗了。这些走狗想毁了我的前哨站，绝不能让他们得逞，听到了吗？
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Welcome to the shit. Hope you're ready to fight. These bootlicks are trying to destroy my station and that can't happen, you hear me?

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 看到一张友好的脸真好。你觉得能在这帮混蛋对我下手之前干掉他们吗？
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Nice to see a friendly face. You think you can blow up these bastards before they do the same to me?

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.chinese: 欢迎来参加这场派对。有些不请自来的客人需要赶走，免得他们再搞破坏。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_playerarrives_g.english: Welcome to the party. Got some uninvited guests that need to be kicked out before they can break anything else.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 你不可能每次都赢，但我们没时间纠结了。别管那些，集中精力继续干吧。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: You can’t win them all, but we ain't got time dwell. Forget it and focus up.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 这次搞砸了吧，没事。如果你能把剩下的那些混蛋干掉，还是能帮上忙的。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: Cocked that one up, didn't ya. No matter. You can still help if you take out the rest of these bastards.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.chinese: 说实话，这确实是个挫折。不过我们还在战斗，所以赶紧搞定它吧。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivefai.english: Not gonna lie, that's a setback. But we're still in this so let's get it done.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.chinese: 好，又少了一件事要处理。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.english: Okay, one less thing to deal with.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.chinese: 不错，希望这事儿总算搞定了，接下来咱们就能一劳永逸地收拾剩下的那些混蛋。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.english: All right, hopefully now that's done, we can deal with the rest of the assholes once and for all.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.chinese: 很好，这事儿解决了，现在咱们可以专心对付剩下的那些飞船了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_f_pmh_subobjectivesuc.english: Good. Now that's sorted, we can focus on taking care of the rest of these ships.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 太棒了！就是要让这些混蛋尝尝厉害！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Yes! Way to show these bastards a thing or two.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 好样的！让这些渣滓付出代价吧。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Good. Let's make this scum pay.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 没错！我打赌他们现在肯定后悔招惹我的站点了吧！
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Yeah! Bet they're regrettin' messin' with my station now!

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 干得漂亮！我希望那家伙没法重生。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Hell yeah. I hope that asshole can't regen.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.chinese: 太好了！没什么比看到有人遭报应更爽的了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostiledestroye.english: Lovely. Nothin' better than someone getting' what they deserve.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 嘿，打起精神！又有更多的船来了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.english: Hey, look alive. We got more ships arriving.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.chinese: 你看见了吗？这些渣滓叫来了增援。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_hostilereinforc.english: Did you see? These scum called in reiforcements.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 真是该死！他们全拿下了。我最好去看看还能打捞点什么。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Damn it to hell. They got it all. Guess I better go an see what I can salvage.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 糟了，最后一个也没了。那些混蛋得逞了。真不知道我们接下来该怎么重建。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Shit. That was the last one. Guess the bastards got what they wanted. No idea how we're gonna rebuild after this.

pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.chinese: 真不敢相信，五年的努力和积蓄就这么没了。不知道我能不能熬过去，还是谢谢你帮忙了。
pu_defendnpc02_civ_m_pmh_missionfailallt.english: Can't believe it. 5 years of work and savings wiped out just like that. Don't know how I'm gonna come back from this. Anyway, thanks for trying.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 哇，这就撂挑子了？说实话，我有点惊讶，但也理解，生活总有意外。只是别养成习惯就行，好吗？回见。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Woah, quitting, huh? I'll be honest, I'm a bit surprised, but I get it, life happens. Just don't make it a habit, okay? Later.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 等等，你要取消合约？真的吗？好吧...如果你认为这是最好的选择...
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Wait, you're canceling the contract? Really? Okay then… If you think that's what's best…

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 嘿，我是 DD。谢啦接这活儿，我觉得你简直太合适了。咱一步步来，在外面注意点安全，好吗？
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Heya, DD here. Thanks for hopping onto this job. I think you're gonna be perfect for it. Just take it one step at time and be safe out there, okay?

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 又是我，DD。正琢磨你啥时候回来接新单子呢。反正时间不等人，咱们赶紧动起来！
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Hey again. It's DD. I was wondering when you'd come back for another contract. Anyway, time's a wasting so we better hop to it!

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 嗨，还是我 DD。老看到你的名字出现在合约上真开心。细节你都清楚了，在外头多保重，回头再聊。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Hi! It's DD again. Always love seeing your name pop up on a contract. You have the details so be good out there and we'll talk later.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 我是 DD。呼叫你只是想告诉你，我很欣赏你这样可靠的人。这正是旅者联合俱乐部需要的飞行员类型。祝飞行平安，别成了陌生人，听到了吗？
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: It's DD. Just calling to say I appreciate that you're the dependable sort. Just the kind of pilot Wayfarer needs. Safe flying and don't be a stranger, you hear?

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 看看。合约已完成。总是很高兴见到你。总之，好好休息，我们稍后再聊。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Look at that. Contract complete. Always good to see. Anyway, get some rest, and we'll talk soon.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 旅者联合俱乐部确实需要更多像你这样的飞行员，这毫无疑问。好好享受报酬吧，我相信很快就会有新的合约找你。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Wayfarer could use a few more pilots like you, that's for sure. Enjoy the pay, and I'm sure we'll have another contract for you soon.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 我是 DD。活儿没成总是挺难受的，咱们只能吸取教训继续干。歇会儿吧，下一次再见！
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: DD here. Always tough when the job doesn't work out. Only thing we can do is learn and move on. Take a little break and I'll see you on the next one.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: UWC的 DD 呼叫。看来这活儿不太顺，但谁都有失手的时候。别灰心，赶紧振作起来接着干！
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: DD calling from UWC. Doesn't look like that job's working out. It happens to the best of us. Don't let it bring you down and get back out there soon.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 哎哟，这真是倒霉透顶了。真抱歉这次没如愿。打起精神来，好吗？
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: Oof. That's a tough break. I'm so sorry this one didn't go your way. Keep your chin up, okay?

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.chinese: 哎呀，这事儿有点不对劲...小心点！
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.english: Uh oh. Something doesn't feel right here… Look out!

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.chinese: 真怪，我都没看见飞船...小心！这是个陷阱。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.english: That's weird. I don't see a ship… careful! It's a trap.
Hey! It's a set up! Watch out!

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.chinese: 好了，看来你刚到，我这就把你转接给客户。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.english: Alrighty, looks like you just arrived, so I'm gonna patch you into the client.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.chinese: 太好了，你总算到了。我现在就把客户连上线给你。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.english: Great, you made it. I'll patch the client into you now.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.chinese: 行，既然你已经到地方了，我这就帮你跟客户接通...
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingarriveonsit.english: Okay, now that you're onsite I'll get you patched in with the client…

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.chinese: 嘿，注意啦！有麻烦正朝你这边来了，打起精神来。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.english: Hey, heads up! You got trouble coming your way. Look sharp.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.chinese: 嘿，准备一下！很快就有不法分子要到了。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.english: Hey. Get ready. You got some hostiles that'll be there any moment.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.chinese: 坏消息了，侦测到一些敌人正冲你而来。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelinghostilesdet.english: Bad news. Picked up some hostiles heading right for you.

pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingmissionacce.chinese: 嘿，又是我 DD。看来已经给你安排好了加油的活儿。祝你好运，在外面千万小心。
pu_deloit_uwc_f_pmh_refuelingmissionacce.english: Heyo, it's DD again. Looks like we got you booked for a refueling job. Good luck and be safe out there.
