pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 你已到达预设的伏击地点。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.english: You've arrived at the proposed ambush site.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 这里就是被标记的理想伏击区域。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.english: This is the area operations flagged for the ideal ambush site.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 你已就位，稍等片刻，我会提供些额外情报。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambusharriveatloca.english: You're on site. Stand by and I'll provide some additional intel.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 给你发了个适合藏飞船的理想位置。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.english: Sending you an ideal spot to hide your ship.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 正在定位一个能隐藏飞船信号的区域。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.english: Pinging a location that should hide your ship's signature.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 正在标记一处供你埋伏的地点。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushhideinmarked.english: Flagging a spot to take up a position for the ambush.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 有敌方接触...我没看到目标。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.english: Enemy contacts… I'm not seeing the target.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 有敌对势力靠近，看起来目标没和他们在一起。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.english: I've got hostiles approaching. Doesn't look like the target's with them.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 侦测到一些敌对目标，还没确认目标是否在其中。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetmissin.english: Picking up some hostiles. Don't have a confirmation on the target.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushtargetspotte.english: Got confirmation that the target's on site.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushwait_gp_001,.chinese: 你该藏好了，关掉动力，等待消息。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushwait_gp_001,.english: You should be hidden. Power down and wait.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushwait_gp_002,.chinese: 你已就位，目标马上就到。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushwait_gp_002,.english: You're in position. Targets should be here soon.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ambushwait_gp_003,.english: Hold here. Targets should be arriving soon.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_arriveonbarge_gp_0.chinese: 门多就藏在这附近。眼下先集中精力收拾九尾，再去找他。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_arriveonbarge_gp_0.english: Mendo's hiding here somewhere. For now, focus on dealing with these Nine Tails forces and then we can find him.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackcompleted_.chinese: 我们太迟了，传输已经完成了。我得告诉十字军，他们有些数据现在落到了九尾手里。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackcompleted_.english: We're too late. The transfer completed. I'll have to let Crusader know that some of their data is now in Nine Tails' hands.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdisableenc.chinese: 快！在数据传输结束前想办法阻止。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdisableenc.english: Quickly. Find a way to stop the breach before the data transfer is done.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdisableenc.chinese: 时间不多了，传输就要完成了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdisableenc.english: We are almost out of time. The transfer is nearly complete.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdiscovered.chinese: 九尾是在窃取十字军的数据吗？难道这就是整个袭击的原因？管他呢，赶紧把它关掉。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdiscovered.english: Are the Nine Tails stealing Crusader data? Could this be the reason for the whole assault? It doesn't matter. Shut it down if you can.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackstopped_gp.chinese: 十字军会很高兴知道我们成功保护了他们的数据没落入九尾手里。谁知道他们到底想要什么，又为什么这么做。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackstopped_gp.english: Crusader will pleased to know we managed to protect their data from getting into the Nine Tails' hands. Who knows what they were after and why.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_elitedeadsearchbod.chinese: 我觉得你找到带着访问密码的人了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_elitedeadsearchbod.english: I think you found the access code holder.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_eliteweaponcacheke.chinese: 有意思。这是个访问密码，可惜打不开转换器。附近肯定还有别的东西能用它打开，多留意点。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_eliteweaponcacheke.english: Interesting. That's an access code, but sadly not for the inverter. There must be something else around here it opens up. Keep an eye out.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_findkeyheadinside_.chinese: 好，现在能开门去找门多·雷恩了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_findkeyheadinside_.english: Good. Now we can open the door and get to Mendo Ren.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.chinese: 这下搞定了。安保网络这一分支已恢复上线，希望电梯也能用。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.english: That should do it. This branch of the security network is back online and hopefully the elevator's working.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.chinese: 这是最后一个需要重置的节点。该安保网络分支已全部恢复，电梯应该也重新启动了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.english: That was the last node needing to be reset. This security network branch has been fully restored and the elevator should be back online.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.chinese: 该分支的所有节点都处理完了。安保网络应该重置好了，去电梯那儿看看能不能用。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_.english: That was all of this branch's nodes. The security network should be reset. Head to the elevator and see if it's operational.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionaban.chinese: 这里是北境之岩。作为一家公司，我们需要我们的承包商信守合约承诺。没干完就撂挑子可不叫个事儿。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionaban.english: This is Northrock. As a company, we need our contractors to fulfill on the promise of the contract. Leaving before it is complete is not that.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionaban.chinese: 这里是北境之岩，在今后，要是看不清楚干不完活儿，就别接我们的合约。这样才算是懂规矩。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionaban.english: Northrock here. In the future, please don't accept our contracts if you aren't able to see them through. It is the considerate thing to do.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissioncomp.chinese: 这里是北境之岩。你已圆满完成合约所需的所有要求，合约已结清。感谢你在这件事上的尽职尽责。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissioncomp.english: This is Northrock. You have hereby completed all necessary requirements to close out that contract. I appreciate your diligence in this matter.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissioncomp.chinese: 又是我艾德里安。我这边一切顺利，这就把这份合约结了。感谢你的辛苦付出。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissioncomp.english: Adrienne again. Everything looks good on my end, so I'm going to conclude this contract. Thank you for your effort.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_001,p.chinese: 干得漂亮，处理得太专业了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_001,p.english: Nicely done. That was expertly handled.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_002,p.chinese: 太棒了，这正是我们一直盼着的结果。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_002,p.english: Wonderful. Just the result we had been hoping for.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_003,p.chinese: 真不错，活儿干得相当出色。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_003,p.english: Excellent. Fine work to be sure.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesobjectives.chinese: 有敌人正朝你位置靠近。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesobjectives.english: Got hostiles inbound to your position.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesobjectives.chinese: 已辨认数个敌对威胁，小心点。

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 敌方增援部队正在靠近。
我发现了一艘敌人的主力舰。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem.english: I've identified a hostile capital ship.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 扫描发现一艘提防主力舰。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem.english: Scans just flagged a hostile capital ship.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 小心，探测到敌方主力舰。

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_island2secondsecti.chinese: 九尾在这区域集结了不少兵力，你得想办法穿过这里去搞定转换器。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_island2secondsecti.english: The Nine Tails have built up their forces throughout this area. You'll need to find a way through to reach the inverter.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_island2secondsecti.chinese: 准备好，增援部队正在逼近，解决他们。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_island2secondsecti.english: Prepare yourself. Reinforcements are closing in. Take care of them.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.chinese: 是被九尾训练过的寇骈犬，别让他们靠近你。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.english: Nine Tail trained kopions. Don't let them get close.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.chinese: 有寇骈犬，尽量保持距离。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.english: Kopion units. Keep your distance if you can.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.chinese: 一群九尾的寇骈犬嗅到了你的气味，别被它们缠住。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0.english: A pack of Nine Tail kopion have your scent. Don't let them pin you down.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_leaveiktihint_gp_0.chinese: 这台 ATLS 你得留在这儿了，真没办法把它带过去。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_leaveiktihint_gp_0.english: You'll have to leave the ATLS here. Sadly, there's no way to bring the units through there.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2confirm.chinese: 看，中尉终于登场了。动手把他们干掉！
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2confirm.english: There. The Lieutenant's finally joined the party. Engage and take them out.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2deadenc.chinese: 干得漂亮！赶紧搜身找转换器密码。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2deadenc.english: Nicely done. Go ahead and search them for the inverter code.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2iffiacc.chinese: 正如我们预想的。现在你可以关闭这个转换器单元了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2iffiacc.english: Just as we hoped. Now you can shut down this inverter unit.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2moredro.chinese: 小心点，又有一艘运输船正朝你飞过来。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2moredro.english: Be alert. There's another dropship headed your way.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2takeout.chinese: 注意！他们派了空中支援，优先干掉它们。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2takeout.english: Heads up. They brought air support. Focus on taking them out.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2takeout.chinese: 好消息，十字军那边说附近存着些防空武器，你看看能不能找到它们。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2takeout.english: Good news. Crusader has informed me that there should be some anti-air weapons stored nearby. See if you can find them.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantappearsc.chinese: 那是门多·雷恩手下的一个中尉，这平台上的转换器密码肯定在他们身上，批准开火。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantappearsc.english: That is one of Mendo Ren's lieutenants. They must have the inverter code for this platform. You're cleared to engage.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantdeadenco.chinese: 处理得漂亮，快搜身，看看有没有转换器密码。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantdeadenco.english: Expertly handled. See if they have the inverter code on them.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantiffiacce.chinese: 太棒了，现在你可以用这个密码关掉这个平台的单元了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantiffiacce.english: Excellent. Now you can use the inverter code to deactivate this platform's unit.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.chinese: 只要安保网络没重置，这电梯就开不了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.english: This elevator will be offline until the security network is reset.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.chinese: 九尾还控制着安保网络的话，你就没法用这电梯。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.english: You won't be able to use the elevator while the security network is still under Nine Tails control.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.chinese: 试试重置一下安保网络，让电梯重新上线。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_.english: Try resetting the security network to get the elevator online again.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockediffiintereac.chinese: 没密码就没法关掉转换器。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockediffiintereac.english: There's no way to shut the inverter down without the code.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockediffiintereac.chinese: 只有门多或者他手下的指挥官才有关掉转换器的密码。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockediffiintereac.english: Only Mendo or his commanders will have the codes needed to shut the inverters down.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.chinese: 锁着的，估计九尾的高层才有权限开。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.english: Locked. A senior Nine Tails member might have access to it.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.chinese: 想打开这玩意儿，你得有九尾高层的访问密码。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.english: You'll need the access codes of a senior Nine Tails member if you want to open it.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.chinese: 没九尾高层的密码，这东西打不开。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache.english: It won't open without the code from a senior Nine Tails member.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendodeadsearchbod.chinese: 确认击杀，恭喜。之前好多人想除掉门多·雷恩都没成功。搜搜他的身，看看他手里有没有最后一个转换器密码。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendodeadsearchbod.english: Kill confirmed. Congratulations. Many have tried to eliminate Mendo Ren before you. Search his body and see if he's holding the last inverter code.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendoreniiffiacces.chinese: 在这。这就是我们要的最后的密码，有了它就能彻底关掉这个转换器信号了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendoreniiffiacces.english: There. That's the final code we need to shut down this inverter signal once and for all.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdateislan.chinese: 现在我们正赶往下一座平台，我现在就把雷诺兹舰长接进频道做个情况更新。舰长，你在吗？
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdateislan.english: Now that we're underway to the next platform, I will patch Captain Reynolds in for a status update. Captain, are you there?

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdateislan.chinese: 九尾帮的势力增多了，这可不是好兆头。咱们赶紧跟雷诺兹舰长会合，看看能不能联手起来找到转换器。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdateislan.english: An increase in Nine Tails presence doesn't bode well. Let's rendezvous with Captain Reynolds and see if we cannot combine our efforts to get to the inverter.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.chinese: 节点重置了一个，再把剩下的搞定，系统就能重新上线了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.english: That's one node reset. Just need to complete the rest to bring the system back online.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.chinese: 这个安保节点已经重置好了，把其他的也照做一遍，咱们就稳了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.english: That security node has been reset. Do the same to the rest and we shall be in good shape.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.chinese: 这个节点已经上线了，等你们把别的也都重置完，整个安保网络分支就能全部重启了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres.english: That node is back online. Once you finish resetting the others, we can bring this whole branch of the security network back online.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_puzzledooropenconf.chinese: 有意思，我都不知道这儿还能通。你们先去看看，然后赶紧回到正事上来。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_puzzledooropenconf.english: Interesting. Didn't even know this area was accessible. Check it out and then let's get back on track.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_reinforcementsarri.chinese: 大家准备好！九尾的增援到了。看他们这架势，对咱们目前的进展相当不爽啊。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_reinforcementsarri.english: Prepare yourselves. Nine Tail reinforcements arriving. They don't seem to be happy about our progress so far.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_requireaniktitosol.chinese: 看来我们都卡在这儿了。你们或许可以用那台十字军的 ATLS 机甲试试能不能过去。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_requireaniktitosol.english: Seems we are at an impasse. You might be able to use one of those Crusader ATLSes to proceed.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondstomendoren.chinese: 不出所料，门多知道我们要来。让咱们做个了结。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondstomendoren.english: No surprise that Mendo knows we are coming for him. Let's finish this.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondtoikitilead.chinese: 该死！赶紧进入九尾的飞船，趁这威胁还没彻底爆发前把它解决掉。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondtoikitilead.english: Shit. Make your way into the Nine Tails ship and deal with this threat before it can become even more of an issue.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_securityresetfirst.chinese: 第一个节点已经搞定，把这条网络分支上的其他节点也全弄好，你们就能进电梯了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_securityresetfirst.english: That's the first node reset. Get the rest of the nodes on this branch of the network back online and you'll be able to access the elevator.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_securityresetfirst.chinese: 这个安保网络分支的所有节点都重置完毕了，电梯现在应该又能用了。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_securityresetfirst.english: That's all the nodes on this branch of the security network back online. The elevator should now be operational again.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.chinese: 小心点，有狙击手已经锁定了你们的位置。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.english: Careful. There are snipers locked onto your position.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.chinese: 保持警惕，附近可能藏着狙击手。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.english: Be on alert. There are sniper nests nearby.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.chinese: 提醒一下，这附近说不定藏着狙击手，大家注意点。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0.english: Word of warning. There may be snipers in the area. Use caution.

pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_weaponcacheopenedf.chinese: 原来这就是那个访问密码的用途。进去看看，你觉得有用的东西尽管拿。
pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_weaponcacheopenedf.english: So that's what the access code was for. Take a look inside and feel free to grab anything you deem useful.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.chinese: 那是边境战士的头目艾米莉亚·博伊德。别被她唬住，保持专注完成任务。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.english: That was Amelia Boyd, leader of the Frontier Fighters. Don't let her faze you. Stay focused and let's get this done.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.chinese: 她以为能说服谁呢？要是真觉得我们会放任他们偷走北极星，那她比我想的还疯。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.english: I don't know who she's trying to convince. If she honestly expects us to let them get away with stealing a Polaris, she's crazier than I thought.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.chinese: 艾米莉亚嘴上功夫了得，但边境战士说到底就是群杀人犯。我们指望你当场解决他们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto.english: Amelia talks a good game, but at the end of the day the Frontier Fighters are just glorified murderers. I'm counting on you to shut them down here and now.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia1_gp_.chinese: 刚才是边境战士领袖艾米莉亚·博伊德。别受影响受影响，集中精神执行任务。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia1_gp_.english: That was Amelia Boyd, leader of the Frontier Fighters. Don't let her faze you. Stay focused and let's get this done.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia2_gp_.chinese: 不知道她想糊弄谁。要是真指望我们放任他们偷北极星，那她比我想的更疯狂。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia2_gp_.english: I don't know who she's trying to convince. If she honestly expects us to let them get away with stealing a Polaris, she's crazier than I thought.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia3_gp_.chinese: 艾米莉亚很会蛊惑人心，但边境战士本质上就是杀人犯。现在就靠你解决他们了。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_responsetoamelia3_gp_.english: Amelia talks a good game, but at the end of the day the Frontier Fighters are just glorified murderers. I'm counting on you to shut them down here and now.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_001,p.chinese: 看来我们先到了。找好埋伏点等着。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_001,p.english: Looks like we beat them here. Find a good place to post up and we'll wait.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_002,p.chinese: 还没发现他们。选好位置保持隐蔽，应该快来了。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_002,p.english: No sign of 'em yet. Pick a spot and go dark. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_001,p.chinese: 随时可以行动，不过我建议等亲眼看到北极星再说。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_001,p.english: Go when you want to go, but I'd wait until you have eyes on the Polaris.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_002,p.chinese: 总算走运了。准备就绪就动手。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_002,p.english: Finally some luck. Hold until you're ready to go.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_defendshipobjective_g.chinese: 注意，UEE 巡逻队截住了北极星正在交火。快去支援。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_defendshipobjective_g.english: Heads up. A UEE patrol intercepted the Polaris. They're currently engaged. Go help them out.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambusharri.chinese: 看来我们我们抢先到了。找好埋伏位置等着。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambusharri.english: Looks like we beat them here. Find a good place to post up and we'll wait.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambusharri.chinese: 目标尚未出现。选好隐蔽点，应该快来了。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambusharri.english: No sign of 'em yet. Pick a spot and go dark. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambushwait.chinese: 随时可以行动，不过我建议等亲眼看到北极星再说。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambushwait.english: Go when you want to go, but I'd wait until you have eyes on the Polaris.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambushwait.chinese: 总算走运了。准备就绪就动手。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisambushwait.english: Finally some luck. Hold until you're ready to go.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisdefendship.chinese: 注意，UEE 巡逻队截住了北极星，正在交火。快去支援。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarisdefendship.english: Head's up. A UEE patrol intercepted the Polaris. They're currently engaged. Go help them out.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.chinese: 扫描发现几个紧急信号标。其中一个可能是那艘北极星。去看看。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.english: Scans picked up some emergency beacons. One of them might be that Polaris. Go take a look.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.chinese: 那些像是边境战士的船。没看到北极星。干掉他们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.english: Those look like Frontier Fighters. No Polaris though. Take 'em out.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.chinese: 发现目标。边境战士的飞船。自由开火。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_huntpolarissearchobje.english: Contact. Frontier Fighter ships. Weapons free.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes1_gp_00.chinese: 该死，北极星量子逃走了。清理这些边境战士，然后我们去追它。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes1_gp_00.english: Dammit, the Polaris quantumed away. Clean up these Frontier Fighters and we'll go after it.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes1_gp_00.chinese: 操。北极星逃跑了。肃清这片区域，然后我们去追他们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes1_gp_00.english: Shit. The Polaris made a break for it. Secure the area and then we'll go after them.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes2_gp_00.chinese: 我真受够了这些边境战士一见情况不对就开溜。清除这些敌人，继续追击。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes2_gp_00.english: I'm getting a little sick of these Frontier Fighters hauling ass at the first sight of trouble. Clear these hostiles and keep after 'em.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes2_gp_00.chinese: 北极星在移动。艾米莉亚·博伊德似乎不介意抛弃她的人。干掉他们，我们继续追踪她。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes2_gp_00.english: Polaris is on the move. Amelia Boyd doesn't seem too concerned about abandoning her people. Take them out and we'll stay on her.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjective_gp_00.chinese: 扫描到几个紧急信标。可能有个是那艘北极星。去确认下。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjective_gp_00.english: Scans picked up some emergency beacons. One of them might be that Polaris. Go take a look.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjectivefronti.chinese: 那些是边境战士的船。不过没看到北极星号。干掉他们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjectivefronti.english: Those look like Frontier Fighters. No Polaris though. Take 'em out.

pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjectivefronti.chinese: 发现敌情。边境战士的飞船。自由开火。
pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_searchobjectivefronti.english: Contact. Frontier Fighter ships. Weapons free.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissioncom.chinese: 北极星击沉。干得漂亮伙计们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissioncom.english: The Polaris is down. Helluva job y'all.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissioncom.chinese: 漂亮，没让它有机会再次逃脱。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissioncom.english: Nice job taking out that Polaris before it could run again.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionfai.chinese: 北极星跑了。情况不妙啊各位。天知道博伊德那群疯子会拿它干什么。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionfai.english: That Polaris got away. This isn't good people. God knows what Boyd and the rest of those lunatics are gonna do with it.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionfai.chinese: 该死...跟北极星失联了。估计追不回来了。我得向上汇报。你们解散吧。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionfai.english: Shit… lost contact with the Polaris. I don't think we're gonna pick them up again. I gotta make some calls. You're dismissed.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missioncomplete_gp_00.chinese: 北极星已击沉。干得漂亮伙计们。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missioncomplete_gp_00.english: The Polaris is down. Helluva job, y'all.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missioncomplete_gp_00.chinese: 漂亮，没让它有机会再次逃脱。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missioncomplete_gp_00.english: Nice job taking out that Polaris before it could run again.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missionfail_gp_001,p.chinese: 北极星跑了。情况不妙啊各位。天知道博伊德那群疯子会拿它干什么。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missionfail_gp_001,p.english: That Polaris got away. This isn't good, people. God knows what Boyd and the rest of those lunatics are gonna do with it.

pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missionfail_gp_002,p.chinese: 该死...跟北极星失联了。估计追不回来了。我得向上汇报。你们解散吧。
pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_missionfail_gp_002,p.english: Shit… lost contact with the Polaris. I don't think we're gonna pick them up again. I gotta make some calls. You're dismissed.

pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_ig_002_allrighti.chinese: 好了，我还有事要做，之后再叫你来。
pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_ig_002_allrighti.english: All right, I got stuff to do. I'll catch you later.

pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_missionaccepted_i.english: Let me know when it's done.

pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_missiondeclined_i.chinese: 好吧，等你真正想要工作时再来。
pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_missiondeclined_i.english: Fine. Come back when you actually want to work.
Your loss. Talk to you later.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_acceptsmission_v_w.chinese: 很好，这是所追踪到的飞船信号，你拿到黑匣子数据后就告诉我吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_acceptsmission_v_w.english: Great. Here's the tracking address for the ship. Let me know once you have the blackbox data.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_001_heyh.chinese: 嘿，你好吗？在下迈尔斯·埃克哈特。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_001_heyh.english: Hey, how are you? Miles Eckhart.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_003_ifyo.chinese: 如果你有兴趣接一些额外的工作，我们应该谈谈。我会把我的详细资料发给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_003_ifyo.english: If you're interested in picking up some extra work, we should talk. I'll send my details.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_leavesmoon_v_wp_00.chinese: 所以...找到什么好东西了吗？
如果不介意的话，我就自己看一下。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_leavesmoon_v_wp_00.english: If you don't mind, I'll just have a look myself.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_playersits_v_wp_00.chinese: 抱歉叫你来这，看上去不咋滴，但这自制的东西还挺不错的。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_playersits_v_wp_00.english: Sorry for the locale, don't look like much but the homemade stuff has some kick.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_playersits_v_wp_00.chinese: 我会把细节发给你的。如果你感兴趣，请告诉我。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_playersits_v_wp_00.english: I'll send the details. Let me know if you're interested.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_sentbbdata_v_wp_00.chinese: 拿到了黑匣子的数据并进行了验证。我会把它寄出去的，干得好。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_sentbbdata_v_wp_00.english: Got the blackbox data and verified it. I'll send it off. Great job.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_sentbbdata_v_wp_00.chinese: 再说一遍，我在这里什么也没说，我只是要发送一个卫星上的位置给你，然后...做你想做的。
pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_sentbbdata_v_wp_00.english: Again, I'm not saying anything here, I'm just gonna send along a location on that moon and... do what you want.

pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_spotsplayer_v_wp_0.english: Glad you could make it, grab a seat.

pu_eckhart_mg_greetings_bad_ig_004_iaint.chinese: 我现在没时间听你废话。
pu_eckhart_mg_greetings_bad_ig_004_iaint.english: I ain't got time for your shit right now.

pu_eckhart_mg_idleconvo_v_004_noimseriou.chinese: 不，我是认真的，告诉他，我会等的。
pu_eckhart_mg_idleconvo_v_004_noimseriou.english: No, I'm serious, tell him that. I'll wait.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_comm_v_wp_bad_001_he.chinese: 嘿。我的几个同事告诉了我你的名字。如果你想找些暴力活的话，我正好一直在找优秀的士兵。这是我的详细信息。
pu_eckhart_mg_intro_comm_v_wp_bad_001_he.english: Hey there. A couple associates of mine passed me your name. If you're looking for some strongarm stuff, I'm always looking for good soldiers. Here's my details.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.chinese: 时不时，就会有些“不正当”的活找上我这。
pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.english: From time to time, jobs find their way to me that aren't "orthodox" requests.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.chinese: 有个更好的说法... 但得说那种行动可不是随便谁都能做得来的。那可是十分的挑人。
pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.english: There's a better way to say that... but let's just say they aren't the kind of ops you can give to just anyone. They require a very specific type of person.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.chinese: 好了，咱俩都认识的那三俩朋友，告诉我说，你应该就是那些可贵之人的其中之一。绝对能毫无疑问的完成合约。
pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.english: Now, mutual friends have told me that you might be one of those precious few who are capable of completing a contract without question.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.chinese: 但如果我说准了，那可就有个能用上你的机会了。
pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_.english: But if I'm right, then I might just have a gig that I could use you for.

pu_eckhart_mg_intro_takeseat_v_wp_good_0.english: Hey there, sport. Grab a seat.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.english: You're making good progress. Keep it up.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.chinese: 继续保持，滑头。我希望这事能尽快结了。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.english: Keep going, slick. I want this whole thing wrapped up soon.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.chinese: 客户会很高兴听到咱们正在取得进展。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.english: Client will be glad to know we're making progress.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.chinese: 这部分结束了。接着把剩下的处理完吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_.english: That part's done. Now you just got to handle the rest.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_001_.chinese: 你到底咋做到把事情整糊的？
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_001_.english: How the hell did you lose it?

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_003_.chinese: 你把包裹给丢了！有啥毛病哦。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_003_.english: You lost the package! What the hell.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_004_.chinese: 扯淡吧？没搞清楚状况？这算个啥？就个外行人搁我这整活？
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_004_.english: Seriously? You didn't get it? What is this? Amateur hour?

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_005_.chinese: 你怎么就让他从你手上溜了？
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_005_.english: How could you let it slip through your fingers?

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.chinese: 任务参数有变。正在更新给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.english: Mission parameters have changed. Updating you now.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.chinese: 有个新消息给你，滑头。事变得有些复杂了。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.english: Got an update for you, slick. Things got a little more complicated.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_001_fin.chinese: 行。你不想干了，那就把这忘了吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_001_fin.english: Fine. You don't want the job, forget it.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_002_did.chinese: 没想到你就有始无终。大概之前看错你了。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_002_did.english: Didn't take you for a quitter. Guess I was wrong.

pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_003_you.chinese: 就这样一走了之？头也不回？可以啊你。
pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_003_you.english: You're just gonna walk away? Just like that? Real nice.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_kill_.chinese: 客户需要除掉某人。他们提供了份详细的分析数据，能让我们知道目标的动向，并希望借此机会来场伏击。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_kill_.english: Client's need to get someone gone. They've provided a detailed analysis of the target's movements and want you to set up an ambush.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_kill_.chinese: 据说最近出了个挺有搞头的目标。别问我咋知道的，但我有些和他们飞行路线有关的线索，所以咱得拿下他，不对，是你得。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_kill_.english: Word is that a High Value Target has come out of hiding. Don't ask me how, but I got a line on their flight path, so we're gonna hit 'em. Well, you are.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_good_.chinese: 如果想找点简单的活做，这还有笔赏金闲着没人做。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_good_.english: If you're looking for some easy creds, got another bounty wasting away on the pile.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_breakout_sec.chinese: 又有个客户被捕了。他们目前关在一个安保站里。介意把他们带出来吗？
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_breakout_sec.english: Another client's gone and gotten pinched. They're currently being held at a security post. Would you mind retrieving them?

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find.chinese: 我在找一批货物。唯一的阻碍是物主不打算交给我。但我知道这可阻挡不了你这样的人。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find.english: There's some cargo I'm looking to get ahold of. Only snag is that the owner is unwilling to part with it. I'm sure that won't stop someone like you.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find.chinese: 又接到个人说有批货物正在深空中漂浮，你有兴趣的话我就把细节发给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find.english: Got another line on some cargo on the drift. I'll send the details if you're interested.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_inve.chinese: 事情是这样。有几个残骸飘在外边，而你需要去找下咱们的客户。看你能找到点什么。回报给我。一切从简。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_inve.english: Here's the deal. There's a couple wrecks on the drift and you're going to go take for look for the client. See what you can find. Report back. Simple as can be.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_inve.chinese: 我们被雇去调查几个这附近的残骸地点。如果你有空，我就把细节发给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_inve.english: We've been hired to check out some wrecks in the area. If you got some time, I'll send the details.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pira.chinese: 有个回收任务要给你。客户说那附近还有些敌对目标驻守着，所以得小心点。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pira.english: Got a retrieval op for you. Word from the client is that enemy contacts are still in the area, so watch yourself.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_contractkill.chinese: 又有人传了个空棺的消息给我，你忙不？
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_contractkill.english: Got another empty casket come over the comm. You busy?

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_defend_good_.chinese: 我们被雇去帮忙增援防御，并对抗潜在的袭击。好好看下行动细则，看下你能帮到点什么。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_defend_good_.english: We've been hired to help bulk up defenses against a prospective assault. Take a look at the op specs, see if it's something you can help with.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_bad_.chinese: 嗯 ... 我这有些货物需要在不被严格搜查的前提下，进行星系内的运输，懂我意思吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_bad_.english: Hmm ... I've got some cargo that needs to move through the system without a lot of extra scrutiny, if you catch my meaning.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pick.chinese: 我平时找的那家伙刚好不在，你觉得你能来跑这趟不？他们可能也有些你需要拿的东西。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pick.english: One of my usual guys fell through, you think you could do a run? They might have something for you to pick up as well.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_time.chinese: 又有一单需要你跑一趟。要准时，所以别浪费时间。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_time.english: Need another runner job. You'd be on a clock, so don't mess around.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_time.chinese: 接到了单急送。你需要把包裹准时送达目的地，没余地商量。看下路线吧，看对你来说可行不。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_time.english: Got a rush delivery. You'll need to get the package to the location on time, no exceptions. Have a look at the route and see if it's feasible.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_atob_.chinese: 嘿，我有个客户需要护航，按常规走：保持低调并确保他们能活着抵达，懂不？
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_atob_.english: Hey, I got a client who's looking for an escort. Standard deal: keep a low profile and make sure they arrive alive, okay?

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_atob_.chinese: 有个客户需要护送，既然宇宙都一团糟，我想这肯定不是儿戏，所以保持警惕。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_atob_.english: Got a client that needs an escort. Way the universe's been going to shit, I figure this isn't going to be for show, so stay sharp.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passe.chinese: 我可能需要你去接个客人。确保他们能坐得安稳，而且不会多问点啥。你知道的越少，越好。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passe.english: I might need you to take on a passenger. Make sure they got a comfy seat and don't ask any questions. The less you know, the better.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passe.chinese: 你不是有艘船可以载客的，对吗？我这有个客户需要运输，应该挺好赚的。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passe.english: You got a ship that can carry passengers, right? I got a client that's looking for a transport. Should be easy credits.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_sever.chinese: 我这有个VIP，需要个保镖来好好护住他。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_sever.english: I've got a VIP who needs a bodyguard for a series of stops.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.chinese: 这个客户需要个强大的后盾。你同时当他们的打手跟护卫，所以需要兼顾除掉目标，跟护好客户这两点。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.english: Client needs a heavy-hitter to back them up. You're going to be muscle and escort, so tune up the target while keeping the client alive.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.chinese: 你忙吗？我缺个人来帮我爆几颗头，我会把细节再给你的。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.english: You busy? I need somebody who's willing to crack some heads. I'll send the details.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.chinese: 区域内的执法人员需要点支援。我会把目标跟地点发给你的。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi.english: Local Law's been calling and need some more backup. I'll send the location and target.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.chinese: 你有兴趣的话，我这有个要你去窥探的工作。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.english: I have another snoop job if you're interested.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.chinese: 我需要些货物。原本为它们准备了不薄的筹码，但卖家看来不咋识相。所以就得靠你帮我拿来了。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.english: There's some cargo I need. I've made them some generous offers, but they don't seem interested in selling. I'd like you to get it for me.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.chinese: 听说有些贵重货物被抢走了。我已经做好了准备，就差你去帮我拿来。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.english: There's talk that some valuable cargo got snatched. I've got a fence already lined up, so I need you to get it for me.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.chinese: 你有空的话，我这还有个工作能给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig.english: Got another boost job if you got the time.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.chinese: 看来事情做完了。正在把钱转给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.english: I think we're good. Transferring the funds.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.chinese: 感谢你帮我处理这事。咱俩清了。干得不错。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.english: Thanks for taking care of that. We're all set. Nice work.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.chinese: 我会把报酬发给你。去买点好东西吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.english: I'll send your pay. Go buy something nice.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.chinese: 我会转告给客户的... 谢谢。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00.english: I'll let the client know... thanks.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_002_ith.chinese: 看来事情做完了。正在把钱转给你。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_002_ith.english: I think we're good. Transferring the funds.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_003_tha.chinese: 感谢你帮我处理这事。咱俩清了。干得不错。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_003_tha.english: Thanks for taking care of that. We're all set. Nice work.

pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_004_ill.chinese: 我会把报酬发给你。去买点好东西吧。
pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_004_ill.english: I'll send your pay. Go buy something nice.

pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_001_.chinese: 有得必有失。我想拿到这份活的也不止我们。
pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_001_.english: You win some, you lose some. I guess we weren't the only outfit the job got shopped too.

pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_002_.english: You should've moved a little faster.

pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_003_.chinese: 对不起，情况变得更复杂了，所以我得终止这次行动。
pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_003_.english: Sorry, situation's gotten more complicated, so I gotta pull the plug on the op.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_001_whatthe.chinese: 你在外边特么的到底怎么办事的？
pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_001_whatthe.english: What the hell happened out there?

pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_002_damnity.chinese: 该死的，你真的给我把事办砸了，这可不好，滑头，这真的不好。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_002_damnity.english: Damn it. You really screwed me on this. Not good, Slick. Not good.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_003_igaveyo.chinese: 我曾给你一个简单的任务，你却就这打发我。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_003_igaveyo.english: I gave you a simple job and you boned me.

pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_004_doyouha.chinese: 你知道你让我们损失了多少钱吗？
pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_004_doyouha.english: Do you have any idea how many creds you just cost us?

pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_005_itruste.chinese: 我曾相信你能办踏实这事，没想到你居然搞砸了。
pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_005_itruste.english: I trusted you to handle this and you really dropped the ball.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_002_soit.chinese: 看来，我可能需要你的帮助了。
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_002_soit.english: So, it turns out, I might be in need of your services.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_003_anot.chinese: 又有一份新工作，我觉得你很合适。
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_003_anot.english: Another job's popped up. Thought you'd be a good fit.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_001_got.chinese: 如果你有兴趣的话，我这搞了份新工作。
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_001_got.english: Got a new job if you're interested.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_002_don.chinese: 虽然不知道你有什么排程，但我这有份零工。
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_002_don.english: Don't know what your sched is looking like, but I got a gig.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0.chinese: 给你找了份新工作，这是完全合法的，所以要好好表现。
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0.english: Got a new gig for you. This one's straight-up legit, so be on your best behavior.

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0.chinese: 我这缺人而且有个行动要搞定，它超出了你平时的工作范围。但是，嘿，钱就是钱，对吧？
pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0.english: I'm really shorthanded and I've got an op that needs handling that's outside your usual purview, but hey, credits are credits, right?

pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0.chinese: 这有件事要办，我想把它丢给你做。
