pu_edl2_ghex_fo_revokelanding_ig_001_due.chinese: 由于多次违反机库安全规程，你的着陆权已被取消。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_revokelanding_ig_001_due.english: Due to repeated violations of hangar safety protocols, your landing privileges have been revoked.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_revokelanding_ig_002_you.chinese: 由于多次违反机库安全规程，你的着陆权已被取消。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_revokelanding_ig_002_you.english: Your landing privileges have been revoked.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_delivered_h.chinese: 你的飞船已被运送至以下机库。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_delivered_h.english: Your ship has been delivered to the following hangar.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_delivered_p.chinese: 你的飞船已被运送至以下停机坪
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_delivered_p.english: Your ship has been delivered to the following landing pad.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_noavailable.chinese: 对不起，我们暂无可用的闲置停泊位。你的请求已被受理，飞船将会运送至下一个可用机库。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_noavailable.english: I'm sorry, we have no available landing bays. Your request has been processed and your ship will be delivered in the next available hangar.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_outstanding.chinese: 由于未支付停泊费，请求被拒绝。（某人大吼）快给我们把钱掏出来！
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_outstanding.english: Request denied due to outstanding landing fees. (person yelling) Pay us the creds!

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_selected_ig.chinese: 稍等片刻，正在检索飞船信息。

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_terminal_ig.chinese: 请求飞船请使用着陆终端。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shiprequests_terminal_ig.english: Please request ships using the landing terminal.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shipstorageprocedure_ig_.chinese: 启动飞船储存程序。为了你的安全，请撤出该区域，谢谢你的合作。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_shipstorageprocedure_ig_.english: Initiating ship storage procedure. For your safety, please vacate the area. Thank you for your cooperation.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_switchtotractorassist_ig.english: Stand by for EDL tractor assist.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_takepayment_ig_001_theow.chinese: 该设施的所有者已经实行了强制着陆费制度。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_takepayment_ig_001_theow.english: The owner of this facility have implemented a mandatory landing fee.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_vacatelandingarea_ig_001.chinese: 请所有人员尽快撤出，为同行旅客腾出着陆区。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_vacatelandingarea_ig_001.english: All personnel are expected to vacate the landing area as soon as possible to accommodate fellow travellers.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_blockingflightla.chinese: 警告。你正阻挡飞行航线。（某人大吼）你个傻逼！
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_blockingflightla.english: Warning. You are blocking an active flight lane. (person yelling) You dick!

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_ig_001.chinese: 对不起。你已经超过时间了。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_ig_001.english: I'm sorry. You have exceeded the allotted time.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_landin.chinese: 请继续前往指定着陆区。持续推迟将会导致没收着陆许可。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_landin.english: Please proceed to landing assignment. Continued delays will result in forfeiture of landing permission.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_takeof.chinese: 请及时从着陆平台起航。感谢您的帮助。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_timelimit_takeof.english: Please launch from the landing platform in a timely manner. Thank you for your assistance.

pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_violateprotocol_.chinese: 警告。你违反了机库安全规程。
pu_edl2_ghex_fo_warning_violateprotocol_.english: Warning. You are in violation of hangar safety protocols.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.chinese: 伤检组待命。急救组马上就到，准备好。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.english: Stand by, triage. Emergency rescue team inbound. Full ready.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.chinese: 蓝色警报。蓝色警报。神经机械组请到急诊。神经机械组到急诊。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.english: Code Blue. Code Blue. Cybernetic response to Emergency. Cybernetics to Emergency.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.chinese: 黄色警报。黄色警报。三号手术室急需二级消杀组。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.english: Code Yellow. Code Yellow. Need a level two decom team to surgery three.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.chinese: 安保请到南翼，安保请到南翼四楼。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.english: Security to south wing, level four. Security to south wing, level four.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.chinese: 危机小组到五号急诊，危机小组到五号急诊。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_eme.english: Crash team to emergency five. Crash team to emergency five.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 温馨提醒，诊疗室内禁止吸食斯酊姆，请到指定区域吸烟。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Reminder that stims are not allowed in exam rooms. Please restrict stim use to designated areas.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 瓦里克医生，需要你来诊断室。瓦里克医生请到诊断室。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Dr. Warrick, you're needed in diagnostics. Dr. Warrick to diagnostics.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 卡尔波夫技术员请到成像科，卡尔波夫技术员到成像科报到。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Technician Karpov to imaging services. Technician Karpov, please report to imaging services.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 埃隆·卡迪娜，请联系印记储存科。埃隆·卡迪娜，联系印记储存科。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Elon Cadena, please contact imprint storage. Elon Cadena, contact imprint storage.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 森古达医生请到纳米生物实验室。森古达医生到纳米生物实验室。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Dr. Sengupta to the nanobiology lab. Dr. Sengupta, to the nanobiology lab.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 请病人妮科尔·阿迈恩回到神经科。病人妮科尔·阿迈恩，神经科正在找你。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Would patient Nichole Armine please return to the Neurology department? Patient Nichole Armine, the Neurology department is looking for you.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 马纳贝医生，二号手术室为你准备好了。马纳贝医生，二号手术室准备好了。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Dr. Manabe, surgery two is ready for you. Dr. Manabe, surgery two is ready.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 哈玛·德容，需要你到行政处。哈玛·德容到行政处。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Hamal Dejong, you're needed in admissions. Hamal Dejong, to admissions.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 请门罗·德威特的家人到康复病房来。请门罗·德威特的家人到康复病房来。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Would the family of Monroe Devitt please come to the recovery ward? Would the family of Monroe Devitt please come to recovery.

pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.chinese: 温馨提醒，请注意保管随身财物。帝国医疗服务对任何财物丢失概不负责。
pu_ehsdisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_sta.english: Reminder, please keep an eye on your belongings. EHS is not responsible for lost items.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_che.chinese: 请注意，所有就诊病人需在自助终端登记后，方可获得病房分配。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_che.english: Attention, all arriving patients should please check in at a self service kiosk to receive a medical room assignment.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_gen.chinese: 帝国医疗服务不存在歧视，请所有病人向医疗人员如实描述病情。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_gen.english: The EHS is a Bias Free Zone. We urge all patients to be open and honest with their health provider.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_gen.chinese: 作为UEE内骄傲的一份子，帝国医疗服务局为大家带来平等公正的医疗服务。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_gen.english: As a proud part of the UEE, Empire Health Services is here to provide equal and fair medical treatment to all.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_wel.chinese: 为了方便您就医，本设施内安放了多台消毒站。在您的帮助下，我们可以防止病毒传播。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_wel.english: For your convenience, there are sanitizing stations located throughout the facility. With your help, we can stop the spread of germs.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_wel.chinese: 人人都有权过得更好。今天就报名成为义体捐赠者吧，让一些运气不好的人收到最好的礼物。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_wel.english: Everyone deserves a chance at a better life. Sign up today to become a cybernetic donor and give someone less fortunate the greatest gift of all.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_done_i.chinese: 注意，紧急情况已解决。重复，紧急情况已解决。大家可恢复自行活动。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_done_i.english: Attention. The emergency situation has been resolved. Repeat. The emergency has been resolved. You are free to go about your business.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_inprog.chinese: 注意，我们正着手解决紧急情况。请继续听从工作人员的指引，谢谢。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_inprog.english: Attention. We are currently working to resolve the emergency situation. Please continue to follow all instructions and obey staff. Thank you.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_remain.chinese: 请注意，这是一则紧急警告。在情况得到控制前请在原地等待。重复，请原地待命。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_remain.english: Attention. This is an emergency alert. Please remain where you are until the situation is resolved. Repeat, please remain where you are.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_vacate.chinese: 请注意，这是一则紧急警告。请冷静有序撤离该建筑。重复，请撤离该建筑。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_vacate.english: Attention. This is an emergency alert. Please vacate the premises in a calm manner. Repeat. Please vacate the premises.

pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_ehs_.chinese: 欢迎来到帝国医疗服务局。三个世纪以来，我们一直致力于为所有人提供更好的医疗服务。
pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_ehs_.english: Welcome to Empire Health Services. Dedicated to providing better care for all for over three centuries.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.chinese: 小心点，有艘飞船正朝你过来，已经干掉了好几个厉害的繁荣公民飞行员了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.english: Watch yourself. Got an inbound ship that's already taken out some skilled CFP pilots.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.chinese: 注意啊，我听说过那艘船的事，来者不善，最好准备好。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.english: Look out. I've heard stories about that ship. Better be ready.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.chinese: 有个危险的飞行员正朝你这边来，千万当心。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp.english: Got a dangerous pilot heading your way. Watch out.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.chinese: 我在想那飞行员身上会不会带着啥值钱的东西，说不定值得你去翻一翻。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.english: Wonder if that pilot was carrying anything interesting. Might be worth checking out.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.chinese: 说一句，像这种级别的飞行员，身上通常都带着些好东西，要是有兴趣就去瞅瞅吧。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.english: Just to say, pilots of that caliber tend to carry some interesting gear. Maybe have a look if you want.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.chinese: 顺便说一句，那艘飞船的残骸里你要是找到啥东西，那都归你了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl.english: By the way, anything you find in the wreckage of that ship is all yours.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.chinese: 挺遗憾事情发展到这一步，不过还好是你赢了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.english: Sorry it had to come to this, but glad you came out on top.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.chinese: 真希望咱们能坐下来谈，但说实话，少了一艘这么闹心的船，我也松了口气。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.english: I wished we could've talked it through, but I'm glad to be rid of that ship.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.chinese: 我知道繁荣公民是想用更和平的方式推动改变，但那个飞行员根本就是在添乱。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_.english: I know CFP is hoping for more peaceful ways to ways to enact change, but that pilot wasn't helping.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.chinese: 要是你能把那艘船干掉就太好了，不过就算这样，我也觉得咱们繁荣公民这次算赢了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.english: Would've been great if you took out that ship, but I still consider that a win for CFP.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.chinese: 那飞行员还算聪明，知道打不过就跑。算了，改天再收拾他。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.english: That pilot was smart enough to clock a losing battle. Guess we'll deal with them another day.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.chinese: 行，他们人跑了。希望他们下次惹咱们繁荣公民之前能多掂量掂量。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp.english: Good. They're gone. Maybe they'll twice before messing with CFP again.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 很好，你到了。赶紧找个地方躲好，把信号降下来。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.english: Great, you're there. Find a spot and lower your signature.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 想让这计划成功，你最好藏严实了，信号越低越好。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.english: For this to work, you better hide and keep your sig as low as possible.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.chinese: 行，你已经到位了。找掩体藏好，趁他们还没到，赶紧关掉所有信号。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca.english: Okay. Now that you're there, find cover and go dark before they get here.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 我们先头小队找了个不错的藏身点，我发给你。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.english: Our advance team recommended a good spot to hide. I'll share it with you.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 给你标了个位置，过去待着，能帮你把信号藏住。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.english: Marked a location for you. Head there and it should help hide your sig.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.chinese: 有个还行的点能让你藏起来，已经给你标出来了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked.english: Got a decent spot where you can go dark. Flagged it for you.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 注意，有飞船正在靠近，但我这边还没看到目标。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.english: Heads up. Ships are inbound but not seeing the target.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 有人来了...不过目标还没露面。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.english: You've got company... But I don't see the target yet...

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.chinese: 发现目标接近，但暂时没看到我们要找的那个。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin.english: Contacts heading your way. Don't see the target though.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetspotte.english: Get ready. Here comes the target.
That's who we want. Target sighted.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetspotte.chinese: 目标确认，看准时机动手。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetspotte.english: Target confirmed. Go on your mark.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_001,.chinese: 再等等，目标马上就要进来了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_001,.english: Hold tight. Targets should be inbound soon.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_002,.chinese: 先歇会儿，等他们靠近我马上通知你。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_002,.english: Go ahead and relax. I'll let you know when they're close.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_003,.chinese: 待在原地别动，应该快到了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_003,.english: Stay in position. Shouldn't be long now.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.chinese: 干得好！真不敢想他们要是带回去能搞出多大乱子。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.english: Good work! No telling how many they would've brought back.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.chinese: 漂亮！要是让那船跑了，以后可就麻烦了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.english: Nice, that ship would've been a problem if it got away.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.chinese: 平时繁荣公民不鼓励追打逃跑的船，但这回他们跑了只会让事情更糟。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy.english: Normally CFP doesn't advocate engaging fleeing ships, but they would've made this situation worse.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.chinese: 该死，让他们溜了。估计回头就得带帮手来。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.english: Damn, that ship got away. Bet they'll be back with friends.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.chinese: 糟了，他们跑了。我猜用不了多久就会搬救兵过来。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.english: Uh oh. They got away. I'd expect them to get reinforcements soon.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.chinese: 可惜让那船跑了，希望你子弹够多，等他们卷土重来时顶得住。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes.english: Too bad you lost that ship. Hope you've got enough ammo to deal with what's coming back with it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.chinese: 你之前没搞定的那艘船回来了，还带了帮手。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.english: That ship you couldn't take care of earlier is back. With friends too.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.chinese: 扫描显示又有新目标进来了。我就知道那艘船肯定得回来找麻烦。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.english: Scans are showing that you got more incoming. I knew that ship was gonna come back to haunt us.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.chinese: 马上要麻烦了，那个逃兵回来了，还带了一群朋友。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor.english: Things are about to get intense. That runner is back and brought friends.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.chinese: 有船想跑，最好拦住，不然它回头就得叫来援军。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.english: We got a runner. Better stop it or it'll return with reinforcements.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.chinese: 那船要溜了，别让它跑了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.english: That ship's running for it. Don't let it escape.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.chinese: 小心！那船要去搬救兵，能拦就赶紧拦下。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_.english: Watch out! That ship's running for reinforcements. Stop it if you can.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.chinese: 得靠你了，我们的船快顶不住了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.english: Need you to step up. Our ship's in serious trouble.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.chinese: 我们的船需要支援，不知道还能撑多久。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.english: Our ship needs your help. Not sure how long it'll last.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.chinese: 上吧，那艘船得靠你保护了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress.english: Let's go. You gotta protect that ship.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 好险啊，多亏你及时帮忙。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: That was close. Thanks for stepping up for us.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 幸好你在附近能搭把手，没你真不知道该怎么办。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Glad you were available to help. Don't know what we would've done without you.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 这事儿算搞定啦，干得漂亮。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: I'll check that off the list. Good work out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 该死，他们完了。我真讨厌这种日子。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Damn. They're gone. I hate days like this.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 船没了...在繁荣公民干这么久，我明白一件事：有时候就算拼尽全力，还是不够。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: We lost the ship... If working for CFP has taught me anything, it's that sometimes even when you do all you can, it's still not enough.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 谢了，尽力了。<叹气> 我得去跟团队说一声，船没保住。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Thanks for trying. [Sigh] I better go let the team know the ship didn't make it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 这份工作教会我一件事，坏人有时候确实会赢。但关键是要一直坚持做对的事，别管结果怎样。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: If this job has taught me anything, it's that sometimes the bad guys win. But what's important is keeping up the good fight no matter what.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 说真的，我本来挺指望你能搞定的。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Gotta admit, I was really hoping you'd pull that off.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 这下没按计划来，不过别灰心啊。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: That didn't go to plan, but don't let that discourage you.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 咱们的船看到你来了肯定高兴，想办法保住它的安全。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Bet our ship is happy to see you. Do everything you can to keep it safe.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 太好了，你总算到了。接下来才是最难的部分，祝你好运，保护好我们的船。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: Great, you made it. Now comes the hard part. Good luck protecting our ship.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.chinese: 别磨蹭了，再不帮忙就来不及了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv.english: No time to waste. Better start helping before it's too late.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.chinese: 别忘了，保护那艘船是你的头等大事。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.english: Remember, defending that ship is your primary objective.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.chinese: 事儿是挺多，但别忘了还得护着咱们的船。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.english: Know there's a lot going on, but don't forget to protect our ship.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.chinese: 赶紧去帮那艘船，这应该是你最优先的事。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder.english: Please help that ship. It should be your top priority.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.chinese: 有意思，附近发现一艘废弃船，你可以去看看，不过我劝你小心点。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.english: Interesting. Found a derelict nearby. Feel free to check it out, but I'd be careful if I were you.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.chinese: 扫描发现你附近不远有艘报废的船，想看看就去呗。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.english: Scans picked up a derelict ship not too far from you. You can have a look if you want.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.chinese: 那个区发现一艘废弃船，查不查随你，你自己决定。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone.english: Scans found a derelict ship in that sector. I'll leave it up to you whether you want to investigate it or not.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.chinese: 咱们可以继续前进了。等等...别动，这边好像有点情况。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.english: Think we can move on. Wait... hold tight. Might have something here.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.chinese: 稍等...刚才以为安全了，但外面确实有点东西。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.english: One second… Ok, thought we were clear but there's definintely something out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.chinese: 让你久等了，我再确认一下...嗯，现在确实看到目标了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega.english: Thanks for your patience. Let me just double check... Yup, I'm seeing something now.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfindsnoth.chinese: 行，没问题，扫描没发现啥。
这儿没事儿了，可以走人。

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.chinese: 保持位置，我扫一下这片区域。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.english: Maintain position while I scan the area.
Do me a favor. Sit tight while I do a scan.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.chinese: 往前走之前先扫一下，心里踏实点。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.english: Want to do a scan before moving on.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.chinese: 再扫一遍，别漏了啥东西。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.english: Gonna run a scan to make sure we didn't miss anything.
Let me do a quick scan here.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.chinese: 歇会儿，我得把这地儿扫一遍。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat.english: Take a breather. Got to scan the area.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.chinese: 我调了点繁荣公民的人手，正往你那边赶，马上就到。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.english: I scrambled some CFP forces and sent them your way. Should be there soon.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.chinese: 别担心，繁荣公民罩着你呢，支援已经在路上了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.english: Don't worry, CFP has your back. Sending you some help.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.chinese: 把你的位置发给了其他几个繁荣公民的兄弟，他们正全速赶来。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem.english: Shared your location with some other CFP members. They're flying in fast.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesdestroyede.chinese: 就这样，干得漂亮，太给力了！
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesdestroyede.english: That's it. You're doing a helluva job.
Yes! One less bad guy to worry about.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.chinese: 安全了，刚才那阵子够刺激的吧？
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.english: You're clear. That was intense, huh?

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.chinese: 敌人清掉了。不管你怎么想，我这心跳都快从嗓子眼蹦出来了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.english: Hostiles clear. Don't know about you, but my heart's almost beating outta my chest after that.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.chinese: 没再发现敌人了，刚才那波打得真漂亮。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec.english: Not seeing any more hostiles. That was impressive.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectives.english: I'm seeing hostiles in your area.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectives.chinese: 麻烦来了，希望你准备好了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectives.english: Here comes the heat. Hope you're ready.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectives.chinese: 当心点，敌人正往你那儿去。

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 我看到支援已经开始进场了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.english: I'm seeing reinforcements flying in now.
Careful. Got a cap ship inbound.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 哎哟，有大家伙正朝你那边飞呢。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.english: Uh oh. I'm seeing a big ship heading your way.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.chinese: 主力舰来了，大场面要来了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem.english: Capital ship inbound. Here comes the big guns.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.chinese: 我刚确认了下这个繁荣公民的卫星，状态正常，没问题了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.english: Just checking that this CFP satellite is functioning properly. Yup, good to go.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.chinese: 看来这颗卫星是咱们的，可以继续前进了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.english: Looks like that satellite is ours. We're good go move on.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.chinese: 挺好，这是繁荣公民的卫星，不用担心。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit.english: Cool. That's a CFP satellite. Nothing to worry about.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdmovetonextscan_g.chinese: 那咱们去查下一个点吧？
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdmovetonextscan_g.english: How about we check the next one?
Head out to the next scan point.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdnothingfound_gp_.chinese: 好嘞，这个区域没问题了。
我这边扫描结果看着挺正常。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdnothingfound_gp_.english: Scans look good on my side.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdobjectivecomplet.chinese: 差不多搞定了，谢啦，帮大忙了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdobjectivecomplet.english: That should do it. Thanks for the help.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdobjectivecomplet.chinese: 多亏你帮忙清理这片区域，真是感激。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdobjectivecomplet.english: Appreciate the help sweeping through the sector.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.chinese: 能在这儿做个聚焦扫描吗？谢了啊。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.english: Can you do a focused scan for us here? Thanks.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.chinese: 这儿得看仔细点，做个聚焦扫描吧。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.english: We need a better look here. Run a focused scan please.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.chinese: 得麻烦你在这儿做个聚焦扫描了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_.english: Gonna need you to run a focused scan here.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.chinese: 这卫星肯定不是咱们的，可以动手拆了它。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.english: That satellite's definitely not ours. You're clear to eliminate it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.chinese: 我刚核对过繁荣公民的记录，没登记过这儿有咱们的卫星，直接处理掉吧。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.english: Ok, I've double-checked CFP records and not seeing anything about one of our satellites being there. Let's get rid of it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.chinese: 咦...上次查这片区域的时候还没这玩意呢，赶紧清掉。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite.english: Huh... that satellite wasn't there the last time we checked this sector. Better clear it away.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.chinese: 行，我这儿有份清单，是你需要检查的几个点，去每个地方扫一下，看看有什么情况。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.english: Ok, got my list of areas you need to check for us. Go to each one and run a scan to see what's there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.chinese: 咱们来扫一遍这片区域，飞到每个标记点，打开扫描仪探一下。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.english: Let's do a sweep through the sector. Head to each marker and ping your scanner.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.chinese: 谢啦，帮忙清查一下。去我标出的那些点位扫一下，看看有没有啥异常。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g.english: Thanks for doing this sweep. Ping your scanner at the POIs I marked and let's see if there's anything out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.chinese: 嗨，我是利玛。这些船一直骚扰我们，能干掉他们可就太好了，祝你好运。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.english: Hi, it's Lima. These ships have been terrorizing us for a while, so getting rid of them would be a big win. Good luck.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.chinese: 我是利玛。我已经把埋伏的每个细节确认了三遍，你出发吧，到了现场我再指挥。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.english: Lima here. Letting you know that I've triple confirmed all the ambush details. Head out and I'll advise when you're on site.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.chinese: 我们这边都安排好了。这情报是繁荣公民最靠谱的线人提供的，别浪费机会啊，加油。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep.english: Everything's set on our side. CFP got this intel from one of our best sources, so let's make the most of it, ok? Good luck.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.chinese: 我是利玛，在这儿得谢谢你出手帮忙。我之前待过那个地方，真不想看到繁荣公民把那儿给丢了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.english: Lima here. Thanks for fighting the good fight. I've spent some time at that site and would hate to see CFP lose it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.chinese: 嘿，我是繁荣公民的利玛。刚收到消息，那边的攻击越来越猛了，你最好准备充分点，多带家伙。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.english: Hey, it's Lima with CFP. Getting reports that the assault on that location is getting pretty intense. Better be prepared and bring plenty of gear.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.chinese: 嘿，谢谢你挺身而出保护我们的基地。这星系要是多几个你这样的人，咱们就安全多了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep.english: Hey, thanks for stepping up to help protect our base. CFP needs more people like you to make this system safe.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.chinese: 嘿，我是繁荣公民的利玛。那艘船上的人都快撑不住了，赶紧准备好，越快到越好。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.english: Hey, it's Lima with CFP. Our crew on that ship are growing desperate. Grab what you need and get there as fast as you can.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.chinese: 利玛报个信。我已经联系过那艘船，告诉他们援军在路上了。谢谢你这次帮我们扛下来。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.english: Lima here with a quick update. I've commed the ship and let them know help is en route. Appreciate you stepping up for us.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.chinese: 我是利玛。真高兴你能顶上，那艘船必须安全抵达目的地，一点闪失都不能有。祝你好运。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona.english: It's Lima. Really glad you're available to help because it's essential that ship arrives at its destination. Good luck.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.chinese: 嗨，我是繁荣公民的利玛。谢谢你通知我们你不干这活了。希望下一个任务更适合你。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.english: Hi, it's Lima with CFP. Thanks for letting us know you won't be finishing that job. Hopefully the next one will be more your speed.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.chinese: 我是利玛。看到你退出了接的任务，没事，我再扔回系统里。希望你那边一切正常啊。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.english: Lima here. Saw you opted out of the contract you took. No problem I'll put it back into the system. Hope everything's ok out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.chinese: 嘿，我是利玛。系统提示你放弃了任务，我懂，有时候活儿就是不合适。相信下一个会更好。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban.english: Hey, it's Lima. Got flagged that you dropped that contract. I get it. Sometimes a gig just isn't the right fit. Sure you'll do better on the next one.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.chinese: 嗨，我是繁荣公民的利玛。谢谢你接这活儿，真帮大忙了，祝你一路顺风啊。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.english: Hi, it's Lima with Citizens for Prosperity. Just wanted to thank you for coming on board. Good luck out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.chinese: 出手帮忙多谢啦。繁荣公民真的很感激你这样的支持。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.english: Thanks for lending a hand. Citizens for Prosperity truly appreciates your help and support.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.chinese: 嘿，我是繁荣公民的利玛。谢谢你接了这单任务，我们正缺你这样的帮手呢。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce.english: Hey, it's Lima from CFP. Just wanted to thank you for picking up that contract. We can really use your help.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissioncomp.chinese: 嗨，我是利玛。我再确认一下，不过看样子你该干的都干完了。报酬马上给你打过去，再谢一次啊。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissioncomp.english: Hi, it's Lima. I'm just double-checking, but I think you knocked out everything we needed. I'll get your payment settled. Thanks again.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissioncomp.chinese: 嘿，系统提示你搞定了那个任务。多亏你帮忙处理了，我这就给你结算报酬。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissioncomp.english: Hey, got a notice that you've closed out that contract. Appreciate you taking care of it for us. I'll process your payment now.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.chinese: 看来上个任务出了一点状况啊。知道外面不容易，别太自责。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.english: Looks like you ran into some trouble with that last contract. Know it's rough out there, so don't be too tough on yourself about it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.chinese: 我是利玛。可惜这次没成，要不接个新任务，把这次的经验用上，下回肯定能成。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.english: Lima here. Sorry this contract didn't work out. Maybe grab another one and apply what you learned on this run to make the next one a success.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.chinese: 嘿，我是利玛。上个任务搞砸了是挺糟心的，但别因此就不干了啊。繁荣公民现在就缺人手，多靠你了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail.english: Hey, it's Lima. Sucks about that last contract, but hope it doesn't discourage you from doing another. CFP needs all the help it can get.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.chinese: 谢了，接下这个巡逻任务。繁荣公民想在这星系维持安全，就得靠你这样的好人出力。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.english: Thanks for grabbing that contract. Only way CFP can bring security to this system is if good folks like you are out there patrolling it.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.chinese: 我是利玛，繁荣公民的。出发前记得补满装备，真不想你遇到突发情况时措手不及。祝你好运。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.english: Lima here with CFP. You should stock up before going out. Would hate for you to not be ready for anything that comes up. Good luck out there.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.chinese: 谢谢你接下这次巡逻。咱们得让那些坏蛋知道，我们可不是闹着玩的，这地盘我们守定了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep.english: Thank you for picking up this patrol. We have to prove to the bad guys that we're here to stay.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.chinese: 这片区域安全了，该往下一个点了。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.english: Sector is clear. Time to move on to the next one.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.chinese: 谢了，去查了那个区域。我这边看数据也正常，继续下一处吧。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.english: Thanks for checking that sector. Looks good on my side. Let's go to the next one.

pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.chinese: 地方扫干净了，希望下个点也这么顺利。
pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared.english: Area is clear. Hope the next one is too.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.chinese: 你浪费了我一些最优秀的战士。我永远不会忘记的。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.english: You wasted some of my best fighters. I won't forget this.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.chinese: 你肯定觉得自己在这里干出了什么了不起的事。但你只是在自己的头上留下了一个标记而已。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.english: You must think you've done something here. All you've done is put a mark on your head.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.chinese: 他们应该得到更好的对待。我会让你为他们所有的死负责。记住我的话。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00.english: They deserved better than that. I'm gonna take out all their deaths on you. Mark my words.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.chinese: 你想杀多少我们就杀多少。我们会一次又一次地回来。没有什么能让我们屈服。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.english: Take out as many of us as you like. We’re gonna keep coming back, again, and again, and again. Nothing’s gonna put us down.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.chinese: 你绝对不可能活着离开这里。现在就放弃吧，我保证我的战士让你死的干脆。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.english: There's no way you're coming out of this alive. Give up now, and I promise my fighters will end you quick.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.chinese: 你就这么想当 UEE 的走狗吗？你肯定是为了给他们干那些卑鄙的勾当。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst.english: You enjoy being a lapdog for the UEE? You must to keep doing their dirty work for them.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.chinese: 你死定了，死得痛快点吧。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.english: You're gonna die now so make it a good death.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.chinese: 终于！我手底下的人早就憋着想打一架了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.english: Finally, my people have been itching for a fight.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.chinese: 行啊，小杀手，亮出你的本事让我瞧瞧。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_.english: All right, killer, show me what you’ve got.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushcomp.chinese: 你挺能扛啊，是吧？先干掉剜犊子，现在又冲我下手？我可不会再让你占上风了，下次我们早有准备。我保证。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushcomp.english: You’re a tough one ain’t you? First the 'duul, now my people? I ain't gonna let you get the best of us again. We'll be ready next time. Trust me on that.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushinit.chinese: 抱歉啊，小杀手，不是针对你，但你今天别想活着离开。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushinit.english: Sorry, killer. Nothing personal, but you ain’t leaving this place alive.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstplayerarri.chinese: 喂！你能听见吗？我的人需要帮手！你再不动手，这帮剜犊子就要把他们全灭了！求你了！
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstplayerarri.english: Hey! Can you hear me? My people need help! These 'duul are gonna wipe them all out if you don't do something. Please.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatdatadecry.chinese: 你以为干掉我一帮人、偷了我们数据就挺牛了？你在咱地盘上连五分钟都撑不过去。你就是个渣。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatdatadecry.english: You think you’re tough, taking out my gang and stealing our data? You wouldn’t last five minutes where I’m from. You’re nothing.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.chinese: 哟，这不是老在咱们仓库周围转悠的小耗子吗？进来吧，我们肯定给你个热闹的欢迎仪式。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.english: If it isn’t the little rat that’s been scurrying around our storage sites. Come on in, we’ll be sure to give you a big, warm welcome.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.chinese: 又来找虐？你懂不懂什么叫适可而止？上回算你运气好逃了，这回可没那么好的事儿了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.english: Back for more? You just don’t know when to quit, do you? You were lucky to get away last time, but that luck’s about to run out.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.chinese: 这不是咱们最爱的小杀手吗？正想着你啥时候来呢！还愣着干啥？快进来打个招呼啊！
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr.english: If it isn’t our favorite killer! I was wondering when you’d show up. Well, what are you waiting for? Come say hello already!

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxtauntplayerdeat.chinese: 希望你死了再生之后打架比你本人强点。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxtauntplayerdeat.english: Hope your regen's better at fighting than you are.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxtauntplayerdeat.chinese: 如果你想知道什么对你好：躺下。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxtauntplayerdeat.english: If you know what's good for you: stay down.
It was only gonna end this way.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_001.chinese: 真的，咱们本来过得挺安稳的，各自忙各自的，可现在倒好，一转身就能撞见你们这些 UEE 的混蛋。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_001.english: You know, we had a really nice thing going. We were left alone doing our thing, but now we can't turn around without running into one of you UEE assholes.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_002.chinese: 你知道我们费了多大劲儿把这儿加固成这样吗？
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_002.english: You have any idea how long it took us to fortify this place?

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_003.chinese: 给你个建议，要不我雇你滚蛋得了？反正你们这些雇佣兵最在乎的不就是钱嘛，对吧？
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_003.english: Here's an idea, can I hire you to just piss off? That's all you mercs care about anyway, right?

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.chinese: 真是见鬼，怎么又是你。看来是甩不掉你了，是吧？算了，希望这次运气好点，直接把你送地狱去。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.english: Well shit. It's you again. Can't seem to be rid of you, can I? Oh well, maybe we'll have better luck this time and put you in the fucking ground.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.chinese: 又回来了？我还指望有人把你干掉了呢。好吧，看来我们得亲自出手解决这事儿了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.english: Back again? I was hoping someone killed you by now. Well, guess we'll have to take care of that.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.chinese: 我这就直说了，真高兴能再碰到你。你害死了太多好人了。现在是该算账的时候了，混蛋。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g.english: I'm gonna say it, I’m glad I ran into you again. You killed a lot of good people. Time for payback, asshole.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_001.chinese: 这个怎么样？咱们直接把那个伊德里斯轰个稀巴烂，然后你爱走就走。这主意咋样？到时候你就没理由赖在这儿了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_001.english: How about this? We blast the shit out of that idris and you can leave. That sound good? You won't have any reason to stay then.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_002.chinese: 人民联盟本来可以拍拍屁股走人的，你也能啊。可现在他们得死。这事儿本来简单多了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_002.english: People's Alliance could've just walked away. You could have too. But now they die. This should have been so much simpler.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_003.chinese: 行吧。那咱们就搞焦土政策，彻底毁灭。这可是剜度人最擅长干的事儿。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_003.english: Fine. We're gonna go scorched earth, pure annihilation. It's the one thing the Vanduul do right.

pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase5taunt_gp_002.chinese: <疯狂的杂音> 你见过剜度怎么对付人类吗？那场面太惨了...野蛮、残酷、毫不留情。要是你没见过的话也别担心，马上就能见着了。
pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase5taunt_gp_002.english: <crazy scrambled sound> Have you seen what Vanduul do to Humans? It's ugly… raw… merciless. Don't worry if you haven't. You're about to.

pu_fwdrakpa02_m_lpa_announce_drakehall_g.chinese: 防务展是一次绝佳的机会，让您能亲眼参观那些每天真真切切地在宇宙中穿行、捍卫自由并建设帝国的飞船。
pu_fwdrakpa02_m_lpa_announce_drakehall_g.english: DefenseCon's a great opportunity to take a look at the real ships that are out there every day, defending your freedom and moving the gears of this Empire.

pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_generalinfo_.chinese: 数个世纪以来，不败舰队周都是与亲朋好友一起庆祝责任、服务、与公民精神这三大帝国支柱的绝佳时机。
pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_generalinfo_.english: For centuries, Invictus has been a time for friends and family to come together and celebrate the pillars of duty, service, and civic pride.

pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.chinese: 职责、传统、服务。我们向那些进入UEE海军开始新生活的人们致敬，欢迎参加不败舰队启航周。
pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.english: Duty. Tradition. Service. We salute those taking their first step to their new life in the UEE Navy. Welcome to Invictus Launch Week.

pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.chinese: UEE海军欢迎您来到不败舰队展厅。请前往展厅内部一睹海军舰队最新最棒的装备。
pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.english: The UEE Navy would like to welcome you to the Invictus Expo Hall. Make your way inside for a look at the latest and greatest additions to the Navy fleet.

pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.chinese: 大家好，欢迎参加不败舰队启航周，我们在这里庆祝挺身而出保卫帝国的人们。
pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i.english: Hello and welcome to Invcictus Launch Week, a celebration of the men and women stepping forward to defend the Empire.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_deck_obstructi.chinese: 检测到载具平台上有障碍物。请清除。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_deck_obstructi.english: Obstruction on vehicle platform detected. Please clear.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_fleetmanager_b.chinese: 舰队管理器初始化中。正在访问您的记录。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_fleetmanager_b.english: Fleet Manager initiating. Accessing your records.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_fleetmanager_f.chinese: 舰队管理器服务完成终止连接。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_fleetmanager_f.english: Fleet Manager services complete Terminating connection.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_alre.chinese: 该载具已被取回，不再存放。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_alre.english: That vehicle has already been retrieved and is no longer in storage.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_impo.chinese: 载具选择被拒绝。载具目前被扣押中。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_impo.english: Vehicle selection denied. Vehicle currently impounded.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_inqu.chinese: 载具取回已挂起。当前无可用空间。请等待。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_inqu.english: Vehicle retrieval pending. No available space. Standby.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_inva.chinese: 载具选择悲拒绝。无效请求。

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_paid.chinese: 付款已收到。现在可以取回载具。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_paid.english: Payment received. Vehicle is now available for retrieval.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_stor.english: Your vehicle has been moved into storage.

pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_toob.chinese: 载具选择被拒绝。无法满足载具大小要求。
pu_genasop02_m_atc_inform_retrieval_toob.english: Vehicle selection denied. Unable to accommodate vehicle size.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_aneut.english: An available space has been located.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_decline_payment_aneutr.chinese: 付款被拒绝。感谢您联系EDL自动化载具服务系统。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_decline_payment_aneutr.english: Payment declined. Thank you for contacting EDL automated vehicle services.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_tpla.chinese: 感谢您的光临。祝您一路平安。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_tpla.english: Thank you for visiting. Safe travels.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_give_payment_aneutral_.chinese: 非常感谢。已收到付款。请前往指定位置。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_give_payment_aneutral_.english: Thank you. Payment received. Please proceed to the designated location.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_impounded_vehicle_aneu.chinese: 兹通知你的载具已被扣押。可查阅ASOP终端以取回载具。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_impounded_vehicle_aneu.english: This is to inform you that your vehicle has been impounded. Consult an ASOP terminal to retrieve it.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneutral.chinese: 注意。您没有使用此设施的权限。请尽快离开此地区。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneutral.english: Attention. You do not have permission to use this facility. Please leave the area as soon as possible.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_crimesta.chinese: 注意。该载具的登记船主有犯罪记录。不允许使用本设施。请尽快离开此地区。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_crimesta.english: Attention. This vehicle's registered owner has an active crimestat. Use of this facility is not permitted. Please leave the area as soon as possible.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_stolenve.chinese: 注意。该载具已报挂失。不允许使用本设施。请尽快离开此地区。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_stolenve.english: Attention. This vehicle has been reported stolen. Use of this facility is not permitted. Please leave the area as soon as possible.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_newbabbage_clos.chinese: 新巴贝奇空港目前处于关闭施工中。请在数月后再访。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_newbabbage_clos.english: The New Babbage Spaceport is currently closed for construction. Please check back in a few months

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_notavai.chinese: 十分抱歉。该设施当前没有任何可用空位。请稍等片刻，如有空位将立刻为您分配。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_notavai.english: Apologies. This facility currently does not have any available space. Please stand by and one will be assigned when available.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_notposs.chinese: 十分抱歉。该设施不能容纳这个类型的载具。请另寻可用的降落服务系统。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_notposs.english: Apologies. This facility cannot accommodate vehicles of that type. Please seek alternative landing services.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_vehicle_notdete.chinese: 十分抱歉。EDL系统只能协助客户主动操作载具。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_vehicle_notdete.english: Apologies. EDL Services can only assist customers actively operating a vehicle.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_vehicle_toobig_.chinese: 十分抱歉。该设施不能容纳这个尺寸的载具。请另寻可用的降落服务系统。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_vehicle_toobig_.english: Apologies. This facility cannot accommodate vehicles of that size. Please seek alternative landing services.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.chinese: 十分抱歉。由于意外的重大技术问题，本着陆区目前无法接受新的访客。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.english: I'm sorry. Due to unforeseen technical complications, this landing zone is unable to accept new visitors at this time.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.chinese: 本着陆区已被帝国医疗服务局隔离。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.english: This landing zone has been quarantined by order of Empire Health Services.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_departure_aneu.chinese: 离场协议已启动。请稍等，最后的准备工作正在进行中。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_departure_aneu.english: Exit protocols initiated. Please stand by, final preperations underway.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_payment_aneutr.chinese: 欲要使用此空位，需先支付必要费用。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_payment_aneutr.english: To utilize this space, please pay the necessary fees.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_storage_alread.chinese: 已为该载具分配空位。请前往指定地点。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_storage_alread.english: This vehicle already has a space assigned. Please proceed to the designated location.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_storage_aneutr.chinese: 感谢您联系EDL自动化载具服务系统。请等待分配空位。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_request_storage_aneutr.english: Thank you for contacting EDL automated vehicle services. Stand by for a space assignment.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_revoked_storage_aneutr.chinese: 您的空位已被撤销。若要获得新的分配，请再次联系EDL服务系统。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_revoked_storage_aneutr.english: Your space assignment has been revoked. To acquire a new assignment, please contact EDL services again.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_revoked_storage_crimes.chinese: 注意。该载具的登记船主有犯罪记录。不允许使用本设施。你的空位分配已撤销。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_revoked_storage_crimes.english: Attention. This vehicle's registered owner has an active crimestat. Use of this facility is not permitted. Your space assignment has been revoked.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_stored_vehicle_departt.chinese: 兹通知您的车辆已寄存。请查阅ASOP终端以取回载具。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_stored_vehicle_departt.english: This is to inform you that your vehicle has been stored. Please consult an ASOP terminal to retrieve it.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_arrivetim.chinese: 注意。请及时降落到指配空位，否则将会撤销并分配给其他客户。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_arrivetim.english: Attention. Please utilize your assigned space or it will be revoked and assigned to a different customer.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_departtim.chinese: 注意。请尽快驶离设施否则载具将被收回寄存。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_departtim.english: Attention. Please leave the space as soon as possible or this vehicle will be placed into storage.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_storageti.chinese: 注意。该载具将被移入仓库以供此地接收其他客户。请尽快清出本区域。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_storage_storageti.english: Attention. This vehicle will be moved into storage to accommodate other customers. Please clear the area as soon as possible.

pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructi.chinese: 警告。您的载具正阻塞一个关键的路径。请立即清出本区域否则您的载具将会被扣押。
pu_genatc01_m_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructi.english: Warning. Your vehicle is blocking a critical path. Please clear the area or it will be impounded.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_approved_departure_ane.chinese: 出发申请已批准。一路顺风。

pu_genatc02_m_atc_assigned_storage_aneut.chinese: 载具存放申请已批准。已分配存储空间。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_assigned_storage_aneut.english: Vehicle storage request approved. Storage space assigned.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_decline_payment_aneutr.chinese: 付款取消。载具存放申请被拒绝。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_decline_payment_aneutr.english: Payment declined. Vehicle storage request denied.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_give_payment_aneutral_.chinese: 付款接受。载具存放申请已批准。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_give_payment_aneutral_.english: Payment accepted. Vehicle storage request approved.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_banned_aneutral.chinese: 你未被授权使用该设施。请立即离开。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_banned_aneutral.english: You are not authorized to use this facility. Vacate immediately.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_cargo_clear_ane.english: Air space is clear. Stand by for launch.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_cargo_congested.chinese: 空域太过拥挤，无法起飞。请等待。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_cargo_congested.english: Air space is too congested to launch. Stand by.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_cargo_warning_a.chinese: 请注意，机库内发现散落货物。任何遗留货物都将被视为遗弃物。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_cargo_warning_a.english: Attention, loose cargo has been detected in the hangar. Any cargo left behind will be considered abandoned.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_crime.chinese: 请注意，你身上有已激活的犯罪等级。安全部队已经出动。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_crime.english: Attention, you have an active criminal rating. Security forces have been dispatched.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_encou.chinese: 扫描显示跳跃点已打开。请继续前进。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_encou.english: Scans indicate the jump point is open. Please proceed forward.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_proce.english: You are now authorized to access the jump point.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.chinese: 该跳跃点目前的流量高于平时。在进入跳跃点之前，请勿离开。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.english: This jump point is experiencing higher than usual traffic. Stay close until cleared to access jump point.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.chinese: 请等待进入条约点的授权。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.english: Stand by for authorization to access jump point.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.chinese: 你已失去在此排队中的位置。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.english: You have forfeited your position in this queue.***** Used the same for Timer Expired *****

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.chinese: 你正在离开等候区。请返回，否则你将失去排队位置。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.english: You are leaving the accepted waiting area. Please return or risk losing your position in the queue.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.chinese: 你已失去在排队中的位置。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_jumppoint_queue.english: You have forfeited your position in this queue.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_storage_notavai.chinese: 目前没有可用的存储空间。请等待。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_storage_notavai.english: Storage space is not currently available. Stand by.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_storage_notposs.chinese: 载具存放申请被拒绝。载具类型无法容纳。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_storage_notposs.english: Vehicle storage request denied. Unable to accommodate vehicle type.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_vehicle_notdete.chinese: 载具存放申请被拒绝。未检测到载具。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_vehicle_notdete.english: Vehicle storage request denied. No vehicle detected.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_vehicle_toobig_.chinese: 载具存放申请被拒。载具过大。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_vehicle_toobig_.english: Vehicle storage request denied. Vehicle too large.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.chinese: 错误。载具存放目前无法使用。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_inform_zone_closed_ane.english: Error. Vehicle storage not currently available.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_departure_aneu.chinese: 出发申请已确认。请等待。

pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_payment_aneutr.chinese: 载具存放申请已挂起。等待付款。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_payment_aneutr.english: Vehicle storage request pending. Awaiting payment.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_storage_alread.chinese: 正在进行载具存储。请在完成后再进行其他申请。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_storage_alread.english: Active vehicle storage in progress. Complete before making additional requests.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_request_storage_aneutr.chinese: 载具存放请求已确认。请等待。

pu_genatc02_m_atc_revoked_storage_aneutr.chinese: 分配的存储空间已被取消。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_revoked_storage_aneutr.english: Assigned storage space has been revoked.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_stored_vehicle_departt.chinese: 你的载具已入库。请使用舰队管理器终端进行访问。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_stored_vehicle_departt.english: Your vehicle has been placed into storage. Use fleet manager terminal to gain access.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_arrivetim.chinese: 警告。未使用的指定存储空间将被取消。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_arrivetim.english: Warning. Assigned storage space will be revoked if not utilized.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_departtim.chinese: 警告。请离开该设施，否则你的载具将被收回。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_departtim.english: Warning. Exit the facility or your vehicle will be placed into storage.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_storageti.chinese: 警告。请立即移开你的载具，否则将予以收回。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_storage_storageti.english: Warning. Relocate your vehicle immediately or it will be placed into storage.

pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructi.chinese: 警告。请移开你的载具，否则将予以扣押。
pu_genatc02_m_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructi.english: Warning. Relocate your vehicle or it will be impounded.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_accept_drink_tobuy.english: Yeah. Thanks. That's really nice of you.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Dang, I can't decide what I want.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 上周我在光谱上看了这玩意儿的评测。不确定我该选哪个。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I saw a review for these on spectrum last week. Not sure which one I should get.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 实话说，今天真累，很高兴终于能休息了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I'll be honest, today was a tough one. Glad I'm finally able to relax.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 这周可真是漫长，求求它快结束吧。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: This week has just been dragging. Can not wait for it to be over.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 今天我创下了新纪录，如果这都不值得庆祝的话，我不知道还有啥值得了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I set a new record on the line today. If that doesn't call for a little bit of celebration, I don't know what does.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 不想在正式消息公布之前乌鸦嘴，但我感觉自己一直参与的那个项目终于快落地了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I don't want to jinx anything before it's official, but I think that project I've been trying to get off the ground might finally be happening.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 嗯，这个真好喝。你觉得你那杯如何？
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Yeah, this is good. What do you think about your drink?

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 这里的酒保真是行家，这杯喝的真棒。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: The bartenders here knows what they're doing. This drink's amazing.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 你好啊！我就知道是你。最近如何？好久没见了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hey! I thought that was you. How's it going? It's been a while.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 你好啊，好久不见，近况如何？
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hey, long time no see. How's it going?

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 好吧，我该走了，很高兴能遇见你。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Okay, I gotta head out. But it was great seeing you.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我该走了，之后再见，好吗？
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I should probably get going. Let's get together soon though, okay?

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 你知道吗，我觉得这里的景色真是百看不腻。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: You know, I don't think the view here is ever going to get old.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我还以为都是营销噱头，但来奥里森亲眼看看之后，不得不说，这里的景色是真美。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I thought it was all hype, but now that I've spent time in Orison, gotta say, it's pretty darn nice.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 嗯，我不知道...这个好像有点太贵了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hmm. I don't know... this seems a little overpriced.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我很喜欢这个东西，就是希望他们能有其他颜色的款。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I really like this, I just wish they had it in a different color.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 噢，这个真是完美。正是我想要的。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Oh, this is perfect. I think this is exactly what I was looking for.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 这个真棒，有个朋友几周前买了这个，我正想着买一个呢。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: This is really nice. A friend of mine got this a few weeks back and I've been thinking about getting one of my own.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 别看我，你知道我会选哪个。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Don't look at me, you know which one I'd pick.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 考虑价格的话，我可能会选这个吧。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: If price is a factor, then probably that one.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 嗯，我听到了。我现在就想暂时忘掉所有烦恼。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Yeah, I hear that. I'm definitely in the mood to try and forget my problems for a bit.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 感同身受，能够放松片刻真好，不去考虑所有烦恼。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: I feel you. It's nice to be able kick back for a little while. Take your mind off things.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: （笑）噢，是吗。听起来下一轮该你请了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: (Laughing) Oh damn. Sounds like you should be buying the next round.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 这杯酒不错，但我下次应该会点别的。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: My drink's okay, but I think I'll order something else next time.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 我非常喜欢这次点的这杯，以前没喝过，下次我还会再点的。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: I'm really liking what I ordered. Never tried it before, but I'd get it again.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 事业不错，家庭也还行。基本上一切顺利。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Job's good, family's good. Pretty much good all around.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 和往常一样，你了解我的。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Same as always. You know me.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 别担心，我们可以下周或是什么时候再聚。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: No worries. Maybe we can meet up early next week or something.
Yeah, I should probably get going too.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 可不是吗，这样的日落景色总是美得让我窒息。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Tell me about it. These sunsets take my breath away every time.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 是的，奥里森很棒。我越来越喜欢那些风暴鲸的公仔了。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Yeah, Orison is great. Even that Stormwal mascot is starting to grow on me.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 好的，我会等你看看能不能找到更便宜的。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: Yeah, I'd wait and see if you can find something cheaper.
If you're not feeling it, you don't have to get it.
Agreed. You totally should get it.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.chinese: 我可能也会给自己买一个。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_chat_response_abou.english: I might have to get one of those for myself too.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_decline_drink_tobu.chinese: 我不用了，不过你可以再来一杯。
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_decline_drink_tobu.english: I'm good right now. But feel free to get another for yourself.

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_offer_drink_tobuy_.chinese: 下一轮算我账上，你想喝什么呢？
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_offer_drink_tobuy_.english: Next round's on me. Can I get you anything?

pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_offer_drink_tobuy_.chinese: 我准备好再来一杯了，你想喝么？
pu_gencivchat01_f_lbg_offer_drink_tobuy_.english: I'm ready for another drink. You want one?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_accept_drink_tobuy.english: I would love another one of these.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我不知道该选哪个？这个看起来更好，但许多人都说那个牌子好。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I wonder which of these I should get? This one seems better, but a lot of people swear by that brand.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 不知道，我是该买这个呢，还是加点钱买那个呢？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I don't know. Should I get this one, or spend the few extra credits for this one?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 不知道你听说没有，我最近分手了。我挺好的，就是想喝点什么。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Not sure if you heard, but my partner and I broke up. It'll be fine, but I am definitely ready for some drinks.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我不想细说，但今天原本可以好得多。现在我只想来杯喝的。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I'm not gonna get into it, but today could have gone a lot better. If I ever needed a drink, it's right now.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 算是个好消息吧。你知道我的船出毛病了吗？结果发现轻轻松松就修好了，现在飞起来就跟新的一样。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: So a bit of good news. You know how my ship was acting up? Turns out it was a real easy fix. Flying like new now.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 呃，好像我那个烦人的同事下周终于要调去别的部门了。这下工作起来就舒服多了。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Ugh, looks like that annoying coworker of mine might finally be transferred to another department next week. It's going to make work so much better.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 呃，这杯啤酒有点变质，他们该洗洗龙头了。你的喝起来还好吗？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Oh, this beer's a little stale. Think they need to clean their tap or something. Your's okay?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我就不该点这杯喝的，对我来说太甜了，下次我可能会点你那杯。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I shouldn't have ordered this drink. It's way too sweet for me. Maybe I'll get what you're having next time.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 你好，抱歉我迟到了。希望没让你久等，一切还好吗？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hey, I'm sorry I'm late. Hope you weren't waiting too long. How's everything?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 嘿，最近怎么样？过得还好吗？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hey, what's up? You doing all right?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 天哪，我没意识到现在多晚了。我该走了，我们下次再见，好吗？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Oh geez, I didn't realize how late it was. I gotta get back. I'll see you later okay?

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 虽然我也不想，但我得走了。和你聊天很开心。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Hate to do this, but I gotta head out. It was great catching up, though.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 十字军显然知道如何照顾自己的人民。在斯坦顿星系的所有星球中，我只想住在这儿。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Crusader sure knows how to take care of their people. Out of all the places in Stanton, this is where I would want to live.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 当然，十字军处理法外之徒的工作还能做得更好，但大部分时候他们都干得不错，我喜欢住在这里。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Sure, Crusader could be doing a bit better about handling these outlaws, but for the most part, they're doing a good job. I love living here.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 我不知道谁会真的买下这个。
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: I have no idea who would actually buy this thing.

pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.chinese: 呃，最新的款式看起来真糟糕，他们为什么就不能留着原来的款式呢？
pu_gencivchat02_m_lbg_chat_comment_about.english: Ugh, the updated version of this is terrible. Why couldn't they just leave it as is?

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesomethi.chinese: 你在逗我吗？那边什么都没有。
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesomethi.english: You having a laugh? Nothing's there.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesound_t.chinese: 我还以为我听见了什么东西？

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.english: Yeah, I think I heard something.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.chinese: 从那边传过来的。我听到了。
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.english: From over there. I heard it.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.chinese: 应该是你的耳朵玩你呢。
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.english: Think your ears are playing tricks on you.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.chinese: 我他妈怎么知道你听见了什么？
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticesoundre.english: How the hell should I know what you heard?

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisual_.chinese: 还有人看到那个东西了吗？
我觉得有什么东西刚刚过去。
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisual_.english: I think something just moved over there.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisualr.english: Yeah, I think I saw it too.

pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisualr.chinese: 我就瞥了一眼，但我肯定我看到什么东西。
pu_genoutlaw4_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisualr.english: Only caught a glimpse, but I'm sure I saw something.

pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_001_th.chinese: 这是打劫，给我老实点。叫两声可以，不过也没啥必要。
pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_001_th.english: This is a raid. Act accordingly. Screaming is preferred, but not required.

pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_002_ah.chinese: 啊，看看我们发现了什么...
pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_002_ah.english: Ah, look what we have here...

pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_003_ye.chinese: 是的，不是针对你们，你们只是不讨巧出现在了错误的地方。
pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_003_ye.english: Yeah, this is one of those 'wrong place, wrong time' scenarios. Nothing personal.

pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_004_ye.chinese: 是的，我们这一天也有点不好受，全副武装但是一枪都开不了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_004_ye.english: Yeah, we had a bit of a long day, all armed up and no one to shoot.

pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_005_do.chinese: 帮我们个忙，反抗一下呗。我不喜欢你们这么配合的样子。
pu_genpilot1_cv_announceattack_ig_005_do.english: Do us a favor and fight back. I don't like it when people just roll over.

pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 什么？你是来这里收钱的？
如果你认为我听一个微不足道的赏金猎人的话那你就大错特错了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: If you think I'm gonna roll over for some two-bit bounty hunter then you are very mistaken.

pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 是啊，我还在想什么时候有人能来抓我去领钱呢。
pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Yeah I was wondering when somebody'd have the sack to try and cash me out.

pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 你？他们把就把你派过来干掉我？天啊，我觉得你们真是小看我了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: You. They sent you to get me. Jeez, I think people undervalue me.

pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 这场战斗绝不会是你想要的，你的报酬远远不够你接下来要面对的麻烦。
pu_genpilot1_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: This is not a fight you want. No amount of credits is worth this kind of trouble.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Just need a few more seconds!

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 你听见我的通讯了？太好了。我需要来几个人帮我把这些混球给解决了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: You heard my comm? That's amazing. I need some help mopping up these bastards.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 啊，我不敢相信有人来了。我需要有人帮我把这些人渣收拾了，你来吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Ah, I can't believe someone actually showed up. I need a hand taking out these scumbags. You in?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 我刚刚还有点担心不会有人过来。现在既然你来了，那想帮我一起清理这些法外狂徒吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: I was little worried no one would show. Now that you're here, you wanna dust some outlaws?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 啊，感谢上帝终于有人来了。我的船已经完全不行了，我修理的时候能掩护我吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Ah, thank god somebody came. My ship's completely offline. Can you cover me while I fix it?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 哦，你真是我的救星。这些混蛋把我的船搞坏了，你能给他们找点麻烦让我专心修船吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Aw, you're a lifesaver. These bastards crippled my ship. Can you keep 'em busy while I fix it?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 嘿！我修船的时候能帮我处理这些敌人吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Hey! Can you handle these fighters while I fix my ship?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Help me, please. I'm under attack.
Can anybody hear me? I need help.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 求救，求救。这些法外狂徒在攻击我的船。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Mayday, mayday. Outlaws are attacking my ship.
Anybody out there? I need help!

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 如果有人能听见，我正遭受攻击。我需要支援！
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: If anyone can hear this, I'm under attack. Send help!

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 全频道！我正遭受攻击！拜托了！如果收到这则信息，请帮帮我！
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: All channels! I'm under attack! Please! If you hear this, help me!

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 所有频道，所有频道。我正遭受攻击，请求支援。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: All channels, all channels. I'm under attack and need help.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 请来个人帮帮我。这些强盗不知道从哪里跳出来并且在朝我开火。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Please, somebody help. These outlaws came out of nowhere and opened fire.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 有人在吗？！我这里全是海盗。我需要支援！
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Anybody out there?! I've got pirates all over me. Need assistance here!

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 求援，求援。我被海盗包围了。我需要帮助。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Mayday, mayday, I'm dead in the water and got outlaws circling. I need help.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 我不想再碰运气了。再见。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: I'm through pushing my luck. Later.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我操...我以为我完了。我以为我真的玩完了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: Holy shit... I thought that was it. I thought I was done for.
I can't believe we made it.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 这真的结束了？就这样了？
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: Is that really it? It's over?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 谢谢你。我以为我们完蛋了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Thank you. I thought we were done for.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 我以为我已经是个死人了。谢谢。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: I thought I was a goner. Thanks.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 你刚才真是救了我的命。非常感谢。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: You really saved me back there. Appreciate it.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 收下吧，这就是我能做到的了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Take this, it's the least I can do.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 拿着吧。绵薄小礼不成敬意，但是我欠你太多了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here. It's not much, but I figure I owe you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_finishedrepairs.english: That's it! We're good to go.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 系统依然不能运作。我还需要一点时间来修理。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: System's still offline. Just need a little more time to fix it.
We're working as fast as we can.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 啊，还不太行。系统还是不能运作。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Ah, it's not good enough. Systems are still down.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 我会给你任何你想要的东西。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: I'll give you whatever you want.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 什么，你要钱吗？给你钱，请放过我。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: What, you want money? I'll give you money. Just leave me alone.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 求你了，我会给你钱，然后我们各回各家各找各妈。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: Please, I'll pay, then you go your way and I'll go mine.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_playerattacks_i.english: What the hell are you doing?

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 你得让他们远离，样我们才能干活。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: You've gotta keep them off us so we can work.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 我们承受的伤害太高了。我们不能在这样的情况下工作。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: We're taking too much damage. We can't work like this.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 拦住这些战机这样我才能干活。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Keep the fighters off me so I can work.

pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.chinese: 我们要走了。感谢你的帮助。
pu_genpilot1_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.english: We're out of here. Thanks for the assist.

pu_genpilot1_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 嘿伙计们，感谢你们的帮助。
pu_genpilot1_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: Hey there, boys, thanks for the assist.
Shit's about to get real now.

pu_genpilot1_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 我跟你说过，你应该走开的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: I told you, you should've walked away.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我觉得那是最后一架了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: I think that's all of them.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我没看见有别的敌人信号了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: I got zero hostiles on the scope.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 哇哦！<紧张的笑>好吧，希望这种事没第二次了，好吧？
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Whoa! <nervous laugh> Okay, let's not do that again... okay?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我没看见别的了。应该完事了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: I don't see any more. I think we're good.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_001.english: I'm not going to last much longer.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.chinese: 求援，求援，我要撑不住了。

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.english: I can't... hold out... much longer.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.chinese: 如果你还有啥绝活，现在使出来！
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: Whatever you're gonna do, do it now!

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.chinese: 在这里，我们的导航点快到了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.english: Here. Our nav point's coming up.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.chinese: 在这里，我们的导航点快到了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.english: Here. Our nav point's coming up.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: I'm gonna need you to take care of them.
You're gonna have to cover me.
You're up. Time to show what you got.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 呃噢，他们看起来并不友好。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Uh oh. They don't look friendly.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 有一些不怀好意的人来了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Got some contacts with bad intentions inbound.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 嗯，我猜他们不是来帮忙的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Hmm. I'm gonna guess they aren't here to help.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: Got more bad guys on my scope.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.chinese: 准备好了，更多的混蛋进来了。

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 谢谢？我是说，我们还活着，所以我想这是一场胜利。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: Thanks? I mean, we're alive, so I guess that's a win.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 好吧，本来可以做得更好的。不管怎样，我走了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: Well, that could've gone better. Anyway, I'm out.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 如果就这些，我想我们完成了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: If that's everything, I think we're done here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 我得去找个地方歇会儿。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: I'm going to go collapse somewhere.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: Thanks for the assist. Take care.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 有你在我身后真好，注意安全。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: It's been good having you on my six. Stay safe.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 我们下次再一起并肩作战吧。
谢谢你所做的一切，回头见。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: Thanks for everything. I'll see you around.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 我操刚才实在太吓人了。
< 轻松的笑声 > 哇噢... 别再这样了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: < relieved laughter > Wow... let's not do that again.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 好吧，比我想的还要危险一点。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Okay. That was a little closer than I would've liked.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 真不敢相信我们成功了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: I can't believe we made it out of there.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 就和我想看到的一样，一场漂亮的，干净利落的胜利。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Just what I like to see, a nice, clean victory.
Looks like we're in the clear.
I see I didn't waste my credits on you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_ig_0.english: Stop shooting me. I'm on your side.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: Ah shit! Sorry, that was me.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.chinese: 噢，我的错！我不是故意打你的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: Oh my bad! Didn't mean to hit you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.chinese: 对不起，我以为你是坏人。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: Sorry, I thought you were the bad guy.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 妈的，我们失去了一艘友舰。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Shit, we lost one of our own.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 友舰被毁。重复。友军被毁。
天哪，那是一艘我们的船。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Holy shit, that was one of our ships.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_h.chinese: 你好，你一定是护卫。很高兴见到你。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_h.english: Hey there. You must be the escort. Good to meet you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_y.english: Yo. You ready to do some escortin'?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 打起精神，留意任何看起来不友好的东西。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: You're up. Keep a look out for anything that looks unfriendly.
Time to earn your creds. Keep a look out.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_letsgo_urgent_ig_.english: Come on, come on. Let's go!
Let's get the hell out of here!

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: That's what you want? You're fired.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 别操心了，知道吗，我去找别人就行。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: You know what? Never mind. I'll find somebody else.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 工作结束了，谢谢你浪费我的时间。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: Job's over. Thanks for wasting my time.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 这有用吗？去他的吧，我们完犊子了。
