pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: This isn't gonna work, is it? Screw it, we're done.
You had your chance. You blew it.
Screw it. I'm done waiting for you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我们稍后出发，有些事情需要处理一下。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: We'll head off in a sec. Just sorting some stuff out.
We are gonna need a minute or two.
We're making some last minute adjustments.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我们马上出发，只是还有一件事需要处理。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: We'll leave soon. Just waiting on one more thing.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 很抱歉，但我们出发前还得弄一些东西。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Sorry to do this, but we got a couple things to lock down before we head off.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_005_i.english: I could use a hand here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 我们还不能走，我还在工作。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: We can't leave yet, I'm still working.
Gonna need a little more time.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 就快搞定了，再坚持一小会儿。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: We're almost done here. It'll just be a little longer.
Just gonna need a little more time.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 这里还有点忙，可能还得一会儿。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Still crunching away over here. Might be a little longer.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 挡住他们，我们还有活儿要干。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Keep 'em off me. We're still working.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们马上就好了，再等会儿。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: We've almost got it. Just need a little more time.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playercollideship.chinese: 啊，妈的，这肯定得留点划痕。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playercollideship.english: Argh, dammit, that's gonna leave a mark.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 你是不是靠得有点太近了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: Drifting a little close, aren't you?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 你介意往旁边退一点吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: You mind backing off a bit?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 小心点，你飞得有点太近了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: Careful, you're flying a little too close.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 你终于来了，我还以为得派人去搜救呢。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: There you are. Thought we were gonna need to send a search party.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 可算来了，我都开始担心你了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: About time. I was getting worried.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 量子航行点发送给你了。
准备好接收量子航行点。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Stand by for quantum travel point.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 下一个导航点马上发过去。
正在前往下一个量子航行点。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Moving onto our next QT point.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 正在发送下一个导航点给你。

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Let's spin up and head out.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 已锁定目的地，现在出发。

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_002_.chinese: 好了，感谢等待，我们准备好了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_002_.english: Okay, thanks for waiting. We're all set here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_003_.chinese: 应该可以了，抱歉久等了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_003_.english: That'll do it. Sorry for the delay.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: And that's that. Let's head back.
We're all good here. Heading home.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 我想应该完事儿了，我们可以回去了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: I think that's everything. We can head back.
And we're done. Wasn't too bad, right?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 快回来，你应该为我提供护航。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Get back here. You're supposed to be guarding me.
Hey, I'm gonna need you back here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_underattack_high_.english: Could definitely use some support about now.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.chinese: 糟了，我可能还是需要护航。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.english: Oh shit. I probably needed that.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.chinese: 需要帮助，飞船系统正在失控。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.english: Need help. I'm losing ship systems.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 你知道吗？我觉得我们等得够久了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: You know what? I think we've waited long enough.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 去他妈的，我们只能靠自己了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Screw it. We'll have to make do.
I guess they aren't showing up.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 嗯...我们可能不用等他们了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Hmm. We might have to get going without them.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 真淦，我想知道他们在哪儿...
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: That sucks. I wonder where they are...

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We're waiting on some other people.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 等大家到齐了我们就出发。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We'll head out when everyone's here.
Still waiting on a couple people.
Got a few more showing up.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 再等一会儿，我们没有到齐。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Hang out for a sec, we aren't all here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 该死，别打我！要么停要么滚。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Dammit. Stop hitting me! Stop it or this is over.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 别动我的飞船。最后一次机会。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Stop messing up my ship. Last chance.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 真不敢相信我需要这么说，请别打我的飞船了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I can't believe I have to say this, but stop wrecking my ship.
Let's get back on mission, okay?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 快点儿，我们还有活儿要干。我都催腻了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Come on, we've got a job to do. I'm getting tired of saying it.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我们把这件事办完，好吗？我不想再说第二遍了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Look, let's get this done, okay? I'm not gonna say it again.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 如果你不完成工作，就没有酬劳。明白了吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: If you don't do the job, you won't get paid. Understand?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我雇你来办事，如果你不做的话，我们可能得重新考虑一下你的工作了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I've hired you to do a job. If you won't do it, we need to reconsider your employment.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 快滚回来，不然就解雇你。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get your ass back here or you're fired.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你要是敢飞走我们的雇佣关系就结束了，你听懂了吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You fly away from me and we are done. You hear me?

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 喂，我雇你来是当护卫的，快回来保护我！
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hey, I hired your to protect me. Now get back here and protect me!

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 快回到这儿来，好吗？我不会再说第二遍了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get back over here, okay? I'm not going to tell you again.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 别闲逛了，我们还有事儿要办。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Stop wandering off, we got a job to do.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 听着，如果你不马上回来，我会严肃考虑和你之间的雇佣关系。
pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Look, if you don't get back here right now, I will seriously reconsider your employment status.

pu_genpilot1_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.english: There. We should be good now.
We're all set on this end.

pu_genpilot1_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 你增援叫得再多也没有用。
pu_genpilot1_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: Bring all the backup you want, won't change a thing.

pu_genpilot1_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 不是吧，又叫了更多人来送死？呵？
pu_genpilot1_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: Nah, brought more people to die, huh?

pu_genpilot1_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.chinese: 听着，也许我们可以谈谈。
pu_genpilot1_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.english: Look, maybe we can work something out.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.chinese: 快走吧，你不想管这事儿的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.english: Drift on. You don't want any part of this.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.english: Just turn around and fly away.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.chinese: 我打算帮你个小忙，准备好了吗？快滚。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.english: I'm gonna do you a favor here. Ready? Piss off.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.chinese: 这里没什么好看的，老兄。你懂我意思吧。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.english: Nothing to see here, sport. If you catch my meaning.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.chinese: 你现在闯进了一个我喜欢叫做“包含潜在致命因素场景”的地方。我建议你现在立马离开。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.english: You just wandered into what I like to call, a potentially lethal scenario. I'd advise leaving. Now.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 那句话怎么说来着？谁找到就归谁的...这是我们先找到的，所以你快走吧。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: What's the saying? Finder's keepers... well we found it first, so keep on flying.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 如果你认为自己能偷偷拿点好东西，那你可摊上事了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: If you think you're gonna snag any of this sweet 'tritus, you got another thing coming.

pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 这里没什么好看的，接着干你的事儿去。
pu_genpilot1_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: Nothing to see here. Just move the hell along.

pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_001.english: Oh (laughs), so that's how it's gonna be.

pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.chinese: 你是想打架吗？现在就来打一场。
pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.english: Oh, you wanna fight? You got one now.

pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_004.english: (Sighs) Now why'd you have to go and do that?

pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_005.chinese: 你刚犯了人生中最大的错误之一。
pu_genpilot1_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_005.english: You just made one of those life-changing mistakes.

pu_genpilot1_cv_retreat_ig_001_youknowwh.chinese: 你猜怎么着？不管了，我先撤了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_retreat_ig_001_youknowwh.english: You know what? Hell with it. I'm out of here.

pu_genpilot1_cv_retreat_ig_002_jeeznever.chinese: 天哪，别在意了。我会去挑点软柿子捏的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_retreat_ig_002_jeeznever.english: Jeez, never mind. I'll rob someone easier.

pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 瞧瞧这是谁啊。我们找了好你一阵子呢，赏金猎人。
pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: Well, look who we got here. Took a while to find you, bounty hunter.

pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你会为你对我们兄弟做的事儿而付出代价的。
pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You're gonna pay for what you did to our friend.

pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你认为你可以杀掉我们兄弟而不付出代价吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You think you can just kill our friend and not expect payback?

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_chase_ig_001_wher.english: (Laughs) Where do you think you're going?

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_chase_ig_002_youh.chinese: 给过你机会离开，现在可不能改变主意了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_chase_ig_002_youh.english: You had your chance to leave. Can't change your mind now.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_chase_ig_003_imno.chinese: 我跟你的账还没算清呢。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_chase_ig_003_imno.english: I'm not through with you yet.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_greet_ig_001_ahth.chinese: 哈！你在这儿呢。我收了一大笔钱来拿下你的人头。那么我们开始吧？
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_greet_ig_001_ahth.english: Ah! There you are. Been paid quite a lot of money to take you down. Shall we get started?

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_greet_ig_002_imno.chinese: 我不想多浪费口舌，不过我还是要说找到你真不容易。是时候收赏金了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_greet_ig_002_imno.english: I'm not one to get poetic, but it's been quite a long road to get to you. Time to collect.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_hone.chinese: 说真的，这样下去你可不会有什么好结局。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_hone.english: Honestly, this isn't going to end well for you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_look.chinese: 听着，你应该也玩够了，在我真的伤到你之前投降吧。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_look.english: Look, you've had your fun, now give up before I really have to hurt you.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_itho.english: I thought you were supposed to be tough!

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_ican.chinese: 不敢相信真会有人花钱买你这样货色的人头，这笔赏金真是白捡了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_ican.english: I can't believe someone's actually paying to take you out. I am seriously overcharging.

pu_genpilot1_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_dont.english: Don't think you'll get out of this one.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 什么，你以为这会很轻松吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: What, did you think this was gonna be easy?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 很遗憾告诉你，你现在可遇上大麻烦了。
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Hate to break this to you, but you might be a little over your head.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 你觉得你是我要解决的第一个赏金猎人吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Do you think you're the first bounty hunter I've had to deal with?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_com.chinese: 来啊，看看你有什么本事。
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_com.english: Come on, let's see what you're made of.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_thi.chinese: 对事不对人。实话说，大家都得混口饭吃，是吧？
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_thi.english: This is nothing personal. Honestly. We all have to eat, you know?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_iha.chinese: 不得不说，你不会觉得自己能赢吗吧，不会吧？
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_iha.english: I hate to say this, but you don't think you can win, do you?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_002_imreal.chinese: 很遗憾事情发展成这样。
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_002_imreal.english: I'm really sorry it had to come to this.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_ohnoth.english: Oh no (laughing)... that had to hurt.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_004_yousur.english: You sure you still wanna fight?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_awthat.chinese: 呀，那是你们的人吧？不是吗？
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_awthat.english: Aw, that was one of yours. Wasn't it?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_missile_ig_003_her.english: Here's something with your name on it.

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 你可不想惹上这样的麻烦。
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: Yeah, you don't want this kind of trouble.
Is this really what you want?

pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 马上你就要进入痛苦世界了，别说我没提醒过你。
pu_genpilot1_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: You're about to enter a world of pain. Don't say I didn't warn you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_001_we.chinese: 好吧，你知道自己在干什么。看来今天我们还是能赚上一笔。
pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_001_we.english: Well what you do you know. Seems we're going to make some creds today after all.

pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_002_oh.chinese: 好吧，又来了一些美味多汁的受害者。我就喜欢这样。
pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_002_oh.english: Oh, here we go. Some nice, juicy victims. That's what I like to see.

pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_003_co.chinese: 恭喜，看来你明天就会上新闻了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_003_co.english: Congratulations, looks like you are going to make the news tomorrow.

pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_004_ju.chinese: 我正觉得今天无聊呢，就遇上你这么个乐子人。
pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_004_ju.english: Just when I think it's going to be a shit day, I come across a nice score like you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_005_he.chinese: 嘿，就想让你知道，这事儿不是针对你，纯粹公事公办。
pu_genpilot2_cv_announceattack_ig_005_he.english: Hey, just wanted to let you know that this isn't personal, strictly business.

pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 讲真？他们就派你来干掉我？
pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Really? They sent you to take me down?

pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 无论我头上有多少赏金，希望那钱值得你送死。
pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Whatever the price on my head is, I hope its worth your life.

pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 如果你真认为自己能拿下我的赏金，我告诉你，门都没有。
pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: If you actually think you can collect on me, I'm telling you, it's not gonna happen.

pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 看来还真有人够胆来收我的赏金啊。大错特错。
pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: I guess someone was actually brave enough to try to collect on my bounty. Big mistake.

pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 你是什么人来着？赏金猎人吗？那祝你好运。
pu_genpilot2_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: What are you supposed to be? Some kind of Bounty Hunter? Good luck with that.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Almost done. Just a bit more.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.chinese: 我们快恢复了，再坚持一会！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: We're almost back online. Hold on.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.chinese: 再坚持一会，我们快到了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Just a little bit longer. We're getting close.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 你受伤的眼睛还看得到吗？还能继续战斗吗，我可以给你搭把手。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Aren't you a sight for sore eyes. If you can fight, I could sure use the hand.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 老兄，很高兴你来了。咱们一起也许还能打赢这场战斗。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Man, I'm happy you're here. Maybe together we stand chance in this fight.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 天呐，没想到真有人会来。快来帮我把他们干掉。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Oh god. I didn't think anyone was coming. Hurry and help me take them out.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 不敢相信真的有人听见了我的遇险呼叫！现在我们可以扭转战局，打败这些渣滓了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Can't believe someone actually heard my distress call! Now we can turn the table on these lowlifes.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 妈的，见到友军可太开心了，一起来教育教育这些混蛋吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Damn, I am so glad to see a friendly face. Let's teach these assholes a lesson.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 谢天谢地你来了，在我修船的时候帮忙掩护一下。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Thank goodness you're here. Cover me while I fix my ship.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 太好了！我正担心没人会来呢！现在你跟他们战斗，我维修一下飞船。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Yes! I was worried no one was coming! Now you can fight them while I do repairs.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 谢天谢地你来了。我修理船时需要一点掩护。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Thank god you came. I need some cover while I bring ship back online.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 妈的，见到你我可太高兴了。我能自己修船，不过需要你掩护一下。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Damn. I am so happy to see you. I can fix my ship but I need you to watch my back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 不敢相信真的有人来了。如果你能拖住他们足够久，我就能让船重新运作起来。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: I can't believe someone actually showed. If you hold them off for long enough, I can get my ship running again.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: You don't have to do this.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 一定是有什么误会。求你了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: This is some kind of misunderstanding. Please.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 求救，有人吗？我正遭受攻击。重复，我正遭受攻击。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Help. Anyone. I'm under attack. Repeat, I'm under attack.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 这是一通遇险呼叫。我需要紧急支援。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: This is a distress call. I am in immediate need of assistance.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 致通讯范围内的所有飞船。我正遭受攻击。求求大家，请来帮帮我。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: All ships in range. I'm under attack. Please. Please help me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 警告！正在遭受攻击！速来支援！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Alert! Attack in progress! Send help now!

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 嘿...如果有人能听到这通呼叫，我现在正遭受攻击...这里的情况非常严重，我非常确定我需要一些帮助，我的意思是马上需要支援。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Hey... if anyone can hear this, I'm being attacked and well... things are looking pretty dire over here. I damn sure could use some help and I mean now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 这是一通紧急通讯。我正遭受攻击，需要支援。请回应。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: This is an emergency comm. I am under attack and in need of assistance. Come back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 致所有飞船，这是一通紧急呼叫，我正遭受攻击。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: All ships. This is an emergency. I'm being attacked.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: S.O.S.我正遭受攻击。不知道我还能撑多久！如果你听到这通呼叫，请速来支援！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: S.O.S. I'm under attack. I don't how much longer I can hold out! If you hear this, send help!

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 求救！我正遭受攻击！重复，一些混蛋正在想杀掉我！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Help! I'm being attack! Repeat, some assholes are trying to kill me!

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 求救！求救！我正遭受攻击，需要支援！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Mayday! Mayday! Being attacked and I need assistance!

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 好了，趁现在没什么麻烦我先走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: All right, I'm getting out of here before something else goes wrong.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 好了，我可没一整天时间在这儿呆着。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: Anyway, can't sit around here all day.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 趁着没什么事我先走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: I should go before anything else happens.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 好吧，我可不想在这多久留。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: Well, hell if I'm going to wait around here any longer.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 好吧，趁现在有机会我就先走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: Okay. I'm gonna go while I still can.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 好吧，我最好先走了。一路顺风。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: All right, I better head out. Fly safe.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 我应该接着上路了。回头见。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: I should get going. See you around.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 好吧，我最好上路了。祝您好运。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: Well, I better get moving along. Good luck out there.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 无论如何，希望您的运气比我好。一路平安。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: Anyway, hope you have better luck than I did out there. Fly safe.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 好了，我最好去让大家知道我没事。保重。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: Okay. I better go and check in and let everyone know I'm fine. Be good.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 不敢相信我们居然打赢了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I can't believe we came out the other side of that one.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 该死，真险啊。我还以为我们肯定完蛋了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: Damn, that was close. I swear we were done for.
I thought we were goners for sure.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 不知道我们是怎么活着撑过来的，不过很高兴我们成功了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I don't know how we got through that alive, but I'm sure glad we pulled it off.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 你的飞行技术真厉害。我想这些杂碎下次再攻击无辜飞行员的时候可得三思了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: That was some impressive flying. I think those bastards will think twice before attacking and innocent pilot again.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 感谢您的帮助，如果你没出现的话，我都不知道我们该怎么办才好。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Thanks for the help. I don't know what we would have done if you hadn't shown up.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 非常感谢您的帮助。不然我们就死定了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Seriously appreciate all your help. We would have been dead for sure.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 您刚才的表现真是让我大开眼界。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: The way you handled that? Color me impressed.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 来，我希望您能收下这个。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here. I want you to have this.
Please, take this. It's the least I can do.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 虽然不多，但我希望您能收下。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: I know it's not much, but I want you to have this.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 这点小礼送给您，感谢您的帮助。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here. A little something for all your trouble.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 为了表示我对您的感谢，请收下。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: To show just how much I appreciate the help, here.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_urgen.english: Time to get the hell out of here.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_fightover_urgen.chinese: 量子航行离开这里，现在！快走！

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 马上修好了，再给我一点时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Almost done with repairs, just need a bit more time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 我们正试着把船修好，但需要一段时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: We're trying to get the ship up and running, but it's going to take some time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 为了离开这里我们正在试着修理，但这些混蛋不断纠缠我们，维修工作没法完成。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Got repairs underway to try to get out of here, but we can't finish with these assholes hounding us.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 听着，你想要什么？信用点？我会给你信用点的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: Listen, what do you want? Credits? I'll give you credits.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 如果你想要钱，我可以给你。求求你停下来吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: If you want money, I can pay you. Just, please stop.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 你赢了，我付钱给你。给，拿了钱就走吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: You win, I'll pay. Here, take it and just go.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_playerattacks_i.english: What the hell are you doing?

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_playercollidesh.chinese: 认真的？你是喝醉了还是怎么的？
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_playercollidesh.english: Seriously? You've been drinking or something?
You did not just do that.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 这样没法修理。让他们离我们远点。
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Can't work like this. Get them off us.

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 给我们争取一点工作的空间！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Clear us some space to work!

pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 如果他们接着攻击，我们就没法完成了！
pu_genpilot2_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: If they keep this up, we're not going to finish!

pu_genpilot2_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 他们是来帮助我干掉你们剩下的这群蠢货的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: They're here to help me take out the rest of you idiots.

pu_genpilot2_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 他们也是时候出现了。现在我们可以结束这场战斗了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: About time they showed up. Now, we can finish this.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 雷达显示安全。我想那是这帮混蛋里的最后一个。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Radar's clear. I think that was the last of those assholes.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 结束了？这就是他们全部的人吗？
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Is that it? Is that all of them?

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我没有看见更多的敌人。我觉得我们安全了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: I can't see any more of them. I think we're good.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_001.english: Not gonna hold out much longer!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.english: Gonna be goners in a second!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.english: Can't take much more of this!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.chinese: 我的飞船已经开始解体！

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.chinese: 你再不做点什么我就要死了！
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: I'm dead if you don't do something!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.chinese: 马上就要完事儿了。保持警惕。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.english: Just about done over here. Stay alert.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_002.chinese: 马上就搞定了，应该不会太久。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_002.english: Almost finished. Shouldn't be too much longer.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_004.english: Not too much left to do now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_005.chinese: 还有最后几个东西要处理，然后我们就可以走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_005.english: Taking care of the last few things and then we can go.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.chinese: 罩子放亮点儿，我们到了。

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.english: All right, everyone. This is us.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_004_.english: That's what I like to see!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 你得在太晚之前赶紧阻止这帮杂碎。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: You need to stop these creeps before it's too late.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 趁现在我们还可以，把他们都干掉。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: Take 'em out while we still can.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 做好你的工作，干掉这些蠢货。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: Do your job and end these assholes.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 看来想轻松离开是个奢望了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Guess it was too much to hope we'd get off easy.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.chinese: 更多飞船朝我们这儿过来了！
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: We've got more ships heading our way!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 如果没别的事，我想我们就到这儿吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: If there's nothing else, I think we should call it there.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 没别的事了，你可以走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: I've got nothing else for you, so you can take off.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 和您一起执行任务很棒，回头再见。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: It was good running with you. I'll see you around.
I'm heading off, but you be good.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 跟您一起飞行很愉快，祝您好运。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: It was a pleasure flying with you. Good luck.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 真是险啊，没想到我们还能活下来。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Talk about a close one. Didn't think we were going to make it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 以前我也经历过一些惊险时刻，不过妈的...这次是真险。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: I have had some close calls before, but shit... that was close.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 不知道你怎么想的，我刚才觉得我们死定了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Don't know about you, but I thought we were done for back there.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 那场战斗结束之后我们还能活着真是走运。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: We are lucky to be in one piece after that fight.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 刚才真的好险，不知道我们是怎么挺过来的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: That was touch and go for a while. Still not sure how we pulled it off.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Looks like we managed to pull it off.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 看来这次战斗很轻松嘛。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Seems we got off pretty easy this time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 这场战斗我们表现的还行，真不赖。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: We did okay for ourselves in that one. Not too bad at all.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 这已经是你能想象的最好结果了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: That was about as good of an outcome as you could hope for there.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 我们还能继续飞行，所以我认为这算得上成功。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: We're still flying, so I'd call that a success.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: Sorry. Shot got away from me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.chinese: 非常抱歉，我没想朝你开火。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: Sorry about that. Didn't mean to shoot you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 我们不能再失去任何人了。
我们不能再失去任何人了。
这帮混蛋，他们会为此付出代价的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Those bastards. They're going to pay for that.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_h.chinese: 嘿，你一定就是我的护航机了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_h.english: Hey, you must be my escort.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_y.chinese: 你是来护送我的对吧？很高兴见到你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_y.english: You're the escort, right? Nice to meet you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_h.chinese: 你好呀，很高兴终于有人接下了合约。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_h.english: Hey there. Good to finally put a face to the contract.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Keep an eye out for trouble.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 请确保没人会在我们工作的时候来骚扰我们。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Make sure we're not bothered while we're working.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 如果你看到任何麻烦，搞定它。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: If you see any trouble, take care of it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 如果有任何人想来找我们的麻烦，你就解决掉他。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Anyone tries to mess with us, you handle it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 注意雷达，确保没人来偷袭我们。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Watch your radar and make sure no one catches us off guard.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_002.english: Let's go to the next stop.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_004.chinese: 我们该动身去下一站了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_004.english: We should head out to the next stop.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_005.chinese: 如果大家都准备好了，我们就去下一站了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_005.english: If everyone's ready, we got another stop to make.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.chinese: 算了吧，我觉得没你更好！
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: Forget it. I'm better off without you!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: Forget it. I can't work with you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 你知道么？我们掰了，工作取消。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: You know what? We're done. Job's canceled.
I can't take this. You're fired.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 这样下去可不行。你就到这里吧，你被开了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: This isn't going to work out. You're done. Fired.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: Let's get the hell out of here!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.chinese: 算了，不值得为这点钱那么拼命。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: Forget it. It's not worth the credits!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.chinese: 我受够了这破差事，大家趁早撤吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: Enough of this shit. Everyone bail before it's too late.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我们马上就能出发，只是还有一两件事要解决。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: We'll get on our way in a moment, just need to finish squaring away a thing or two.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 差不多准备好出发了，就是还有最后一点准备工作。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: I'm almost ready to head out, just wrapping up some last minute preparations.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 出发前我还需要一点时间，请稍等。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: I'm gonna need a second or two before we go, so just sit tight.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 正在处理最后一件事，我们马上就能出发了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: I'm finishing up one last thing, but we should get going in a second.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 给我一分钟，我们就能出发了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Give me a minute and we can roll out.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 我们现在进度不错，但需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: We're making good progress, but were gonna need a bit more time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 一切妥当，如果没有任何问题的话，很快就能完成。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Everything's underway. If we don't run into any problems, we should be done in a few.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 我们进展不错，我想应该不会花太长时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Got off to a solid start. I don't expect the job to take too long.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 告诉你一声，我们这边一切顺利。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Thought I'd let you know that everything's looking good so far on our end.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 顺便告诉你，我们遇到了一点小问题。我们自己能解决，就是要花点时间。有情况再通知你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: So you know, we had slight hiccup. We can sort it, but it's going to take some time. I'll keep you updated.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 给我们争取点时间，马上就弄完了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Buy us some time, we're almost done.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们需要更多时间，拖住他们。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: We need more time. Keep them busy.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们已经尽可能快了，但还是需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Going as fast as we can, but we need more time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们已经尽可能快了，但还是需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Going as fast as we can, but we need more time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 你看看能不能在我们完工前拖住他们。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: See if you can occupy them long enough for us to finish.
Almost finished here. Just give us some cover.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playercollideship.chinese: 你他妈在哪学的开飞船？
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playercollideship.english: Where the hell did you learn to fly?
What the hell are you thinking?

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: How about giving me some space?
Hey, you're flying a bit close.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 小心点。注意你在往哪儿飞。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: Careful. Pay attention to where you're going.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: I don't like being kept waiting.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 让你的客户干等着，这可不怎么专业。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Not very professional to leave your client waiting.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 很高兴你终于加入我们了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Nice of you to finally join us.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: I'm uploading coordinates to you now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 我现在把坐标上传给你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: I'm uploading coordinates to you now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 来，量子导航点发给你了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Here. Sending you the quantum nav point.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 量子航行标记已启用，现在发送给你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Got the QT marker queued up. Sending now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 量子航行信息发送给你了。
正在将量子航行导航点上传至你的导航系统。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Transferring quantum point over to your nav.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 下一个导航点发给你了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Have our next nav point for you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 正将下一个坐标发送给你。
正在给你发送下一个导航点的信息。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Transferring the next nav info over to you now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 正在给量子驱动器充能，准备好。
正在进行量子航行的最后准备。

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 我们完事儿了，是时候回去了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: That's it for us. Time to head back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 好了，今天就到这儿，返航吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: All right. Let's call it a day and head back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 我想今天就到这儿了，是时候返航了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: I think we're done for the day. Time to head back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 收拾收拾我们就返航吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Let's wrap things up and head back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 今天就到这，我们返航吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: I think that's enough for today. Let's head back.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_startwork_ig_004_.english: Time to get on the clock, people.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_startwork_ig_005_.chinese: 我们越早开动，就能越快离开这里。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_startwork_ig_005_.english: Quicker we get started, quicker we can get going.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: Where do you think you're going?

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 你要把我们留在这里等死吗？
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: You're just gonna leave us here to die?

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 你应该给我护航，你是不是忘了？
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: You're supposed to be escorting me, or did you forget?
Stay on me, you're drifting off course.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 你要去哪？我需要你跟紧我。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Where are you going? I need you to stay on me.
Need you to follow my lead, stay close to me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 你要去哪？工作还没完呢，跟紧点。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Where are you going? Job's not over yet. Stay close.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 好吧，如果他们到现在还没出现，我觉得他们是不会来了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Yeah, if they haven't turned up yet, I don't think they're going to.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 好吧，我们可没时间一直等下去。只能丢下他们先走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Well, we can't wait around all day. We're going to have to go ahead without them.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 好极了，看来他们放我们鸽子了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Great. Looks like they're a no-show.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 再等下去我们就要落后进度了，看来我们几个得凑合凑合了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: We're gonna fall behind schedule at this rate. Guess we got to make do shorthanded.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Just waiting now for the rest of the group to arrive.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 等船队的其他人到了，我们就出发。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Once the rest of the convoy arrives, we'll head out.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 还有几艘飞船正在路上，然后我们就出发。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Got a few more ships on their way and then we'll get going.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 出发前还要再等几个人。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We're just waiting on a few more to arrive before we go.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 我们必须等剩下的飞船都到齐。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We got to wait for the rest of the ships to arrive.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你要再打我一下，就别干这份工作了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You hit me any more, and you can forget this job.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 够了，再打我一下你就滚蛋。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Enough. Do that again, and you're done.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你要再打我一次，你就完蛋了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hit me one more time, and that is it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你要再接着打，就别想要这份工作了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You keep that up, and you can forget this job.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 再乱来我就得请你走了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Keep screwing around and I'm pulling the plug.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我警告你，我对乱搞事的人可没有什么耐心。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Just warning you now, I got no tolerance for people acting like that.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我受够了，你至少得装作想要这份工作吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I'm getting tired of this. I need you to start acting like you actually want this job.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不会再说一遍了，打起劲来，不然我就把你开了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I'm not going to say this again. Shape up or I'm cutting you loose.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 马上回来，不然你就被解雇了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get back here now, or you're fired.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 快过来，不然你就别想要报酬了！
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get over here or you can forget getting paid!

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你继续飞，我就把你炒了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You keep going, and I will fire you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 听着，你到底要不要和我们一起？我可没时间等你纠结。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Listen. Either you're flying with us or not. I can't wait around for you to make up your mind.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你在那四处乱飞我一眼就识破了。好好表现，不然就别想着要报酬。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You flying all over the place is getting pretty old fast. Pull it together or you can forget being paid.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不知道你想要干什么，快回到正确的航线上来，不然你就与这份工作无缘了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I don't know what you think you're doing, but you need to course correct or this job's over for you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.english: Looks like that's the whole group.

pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.chinese: 那是最后一个，全部搞定了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.english: That was the last of it. All done.

pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 你的朋友们这次可没法救你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: Your friends aren't going to help you out of this one.

pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 我不管你们来了多少人，都是没有用的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: I don't care how many of you there are, it's not gonna help.

pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 更多的飞船只意味着我报酬的增加。
pu_genpilot2_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: More ships just mean I get a bigger payday.

pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.chinese: 你以为你打败了我，但这事儿还没完。
pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.english: You think you have me, but this isn't over.

pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.chinese: 别高兴得太早，我还能打。
pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.english: Don't start celebrating. I got plent of fight still in me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.chinese: 你现在是占了上风，但局势马上就要逆转了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.english: You may be doing all right now, but tides about to turn.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.chinese: 这儿跟你一点儿关系都没有。趁你还能飞，赶紧走吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.english: This has nothing to do with you. Get out of here while you can still fly.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.chinese: 听我一句劝，趁你还能走快调头吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.english: Take my advice and turn around while you still can.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.chinese: 我不知道你认为你在这儿正在干什么，但相信我，这么做不值。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.english: I don't know what you think you're doing here, but trust me it ain't worth it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.chinese: 喂，不管你是谁，现在马上离开这儿。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.english: Hey, whoever the hell you are, get out of here now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.chinese: 现在调头离开吧，不然我们会做出一些让你后悔的事儿。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.english: Turn around and leave now, before we do something you'll regret.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 这片空域是我们的，接着飞你的，不然就会受伤。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: This tritus is ours. Keep on flying before you get hurt.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 这片残骸是我们的，我们可以用武器来证明。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: This salvage is ours and we got the guns to prove it.

pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 你可能得重新思考一下你来这儿干的事情。
pu_genpilot2_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: You might want to rethink if you want you're doing here.

pu_genpilot2_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.english: You want to throw. Fine. Let's throw.

pu_genpilot2_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_004.chinese: 看来你有了自己的选择。

pu_genpilot2_cv_retreat_ig_002_dontthink.chinese: 我想我可不会忘了这事儿。
pu_genpilot2_cv_retreat_ig_002_dontthink.english: Don't think I'm gonna forget this.

pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你杀了我们中的一个，这可不是我们能忍的事。
pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You took one of ours. That's not something we can let stand.

pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你犯了个错，打了我们中的一员。现在该你偿还了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You made a mistake, hitting one of ours. Now you're going to pay.

pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 我们听说了你对我们朋友做的事，你会为此而后悔。
pu_genpilot2_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: We heard what you did to our friends. You're gonna regret that.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_chase_ig_001_yout.chinese: 你以为你能跑掉？想多了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_chase_ig_001_yout.english: You think you can run? Think again.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_chase_ig_002_whyd.chinese: 为什么这些人总是想跑呢？
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_chase_ig_002_whyd.english: Why do they always try to run?

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_chase_ig_003_imno.english: I'm not done with you, yet.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_001_iveb.chinese: 我正四处找你呢，现在终于能收到赏金了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_001_iveb.english: I've been looking everywhere for you, and now I am gonna finally collect.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_002_inca.chinese: 可能你不知道，你项上的人头是有价格的，而我就是来收这个钱的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_002_inca.english: In case you didn't know, there's a price on your head. One I'm looking to collect.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_003_heyb.chinese: 嘿，一点小建议。下次如果你头上顶着赏金，出来飞还是再谨慎点吧。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_greet_ig_003_heyb.english: Hey, bit of advice. Next time you have a contract on your head, you might want to be a bit been more careful about flying around.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_youm.chinese: 你最好现在就放弃抵抗。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_youm.english: You might as well go ahead and give up now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_come.chinese: 快来接受你的惩罚吧。别再浪费我时间了。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_come.english: Come on and take your punishment. Enough wasting my time.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_your.english: You're not weasling your way out of this one.

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_whyd.chinese: 为什么你不让我直接结束这一切呢？
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_whyd.english: Why don't you just let me end this already?

pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_allt.chinese: 所有的这些战斗不过是在浪费时间。这件事只会有一个结局。
pu_genpilot2_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_allt.english: All this fighting's just a waste of time. Only one way this is going to go.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 接着来啊，你永远都干部掉我的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Keep trying. You'll never take me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 我的赏金收起来没你想得那么简单，对吧？
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I'm not gonna the easy payday you were hoping for, am I?

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 开始后悔接我这个赏金了吗？
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Starting to regret taking contract on me, aren't ya?

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_doe.chinese: 无论你开什么飞船，用什么武器，你都没法打败我。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_doe.english: Doesn't matter the ship, doesn't matter the guns. No way you're beating me.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_don.chinese: 别担心，很快就会结束的。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_don.english: Don't worry. This will be over soon enough.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.chinese: 如果你认为这事儿会按你的方式发展，那你就是在做白日梦。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.english: You're living a fantasy if you think this is gonna go your way.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_imn.english: I'm not done with you yet.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_iha.chinese: 我都不敢想象你的飞行服现在闻起来会是什么味道。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_iha.english: I hate to imagine what your flight suit must smell like right now.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_kill_ig_002_thatsw.english: That's what I like to see.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_youcan.chinese: 他们死在专业人士手里，这么想可能会让你舒服点。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_youcan.english: You can take some comfort that they we're killed by professionals.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_missile_ig_001_let.chinese: 让我们看看你有多喜欢这个。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_missile_ig_001_let.english: Let's see how you like this.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 无论现在发生什么事，都要怪你。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: What ever happens now, is on you.

pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 让我们看看你究竟有多大本事。
pu_genpilot2_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: Let's see how good you really are.
Hope your insurance is paid up.

pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_001_we.chinese: 呦呦呦，瞧瞧这是谁来了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_001_we.english: Well, well, well, look what we got here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_002_li.chinese: 听好了，这是一场抢劫，规矩很简单： 照我们说的做你就可能不会死。不过你大概率还是会死的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_002_li.english: Listen up. This is a robbery. Rules are very simple: do what we say and maybe you won't die. But you probably will.

pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_003_th.chinese: 今天不是你的幸运日，对不？不过从现在起只会变得更糟。
pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_003_th.english: This isn't your day, is it? It's just going to get worse from here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_004_he.chinese: 这是接下来要发生的事。首先，我杀了你。然后，我从你尸体上拿点喝酒的钱。
pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_004_he.english: Here's how this is going to break down. First, I kill you. Second, I pick your corpse for drinking money.

pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_005_st.chinese: 坐稳了，接下来要闹出点人命了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_announceattack_ig_005_st.english: Strap in. This is about to get deadly.

pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 我现在头上有多少赏金来着？ 这话只跟你说，这钱不值得你面对的麻烦。
pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: What's the price on my head up to? Between you and me, it's not enough for the trouble you got now.

pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 我就知道迟早有人要找上门来的。来看看你有什么本事吧。
pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: I figured someone would come for me sooner or later. Let's see what you got.

pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 妈的，赏金猎人就像蟑螂，你刚踩死一只又冒出来两只。
pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Goddamn bounty hunters are like roaches. You stomp one and two more show up.

pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 你选错赏金目标了，蠢蛋。
pu_genpilot3_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: You picked the wrong bounty, asshole.

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 系统崩溃，系统崩溃，我遭到过多火力攻击，不，不，不，不，不，不，不！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: Systems failing, systems failing, I'm taking too much fire no no no no no no no!

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 我撑不住了，系统崩溃，谁能救救我，不！！！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: I can't hold it, systems failing somebody get these off me, nooooo!

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 我撑不下去了，他们人太多了，呃啊！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: I can't hold it there's too many of them, argh!

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 系统崩溃！系统崩溃！我撑不住了！我撑不住了！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: Systems failing! Systems failing! I can't hold it! I can't hold it!

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 我撑不住了，我撑不住了， 系统崩溃，我遭到过多火力攻击，我遭到过多火力攻击！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: I can't hold it, I can't hold it, systems failing I'm taking too much fire, I'm taking too much fire!

pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 我遭到过多火力攻击！遭到过多火力攻击！不，不，不！
pu_genpilot3_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: I'm taking too much fire, taking too much fire! No, no, no!

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Keep them busy. I'm almost there.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 啊，有人来了，是想来分一杯羹吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Ah. Somebody came. Up for a scrap?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 很高兴你能赶到，这下局面平衡一些了，不过前提是你愿意打一架。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Glad you could make it. This evens the odds a little. That is, if you feel like fighting.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 嘿，兄弟。你想找些人渣发泄发泄吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Hey there. You up for venting some scumbags?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 有人就是喜欢华丽登场呀。你愿意帮我给这帮傻逼好好上上课吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Someone likes to make dramatic entrances. You mind lending me a hand teaching these assholes a lesson?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 还是头一回有人响应了遇险信号。你想干掉这些人渣吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: This is a first, someone responds to a distress call. You wanna help ghost these scumbags?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 喂，我的飞船瘫痪了。我需要一段时间才能把它修好，你能掩护我一下吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Hey. My ship's dead. I need some time to get it back online. Can you cover me?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 我不敢相信真的有人来了。我需要你在我维修时拖住那些敌人。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: I can't believe somebody came. I need you to engage the hostiles while I get back up and running.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 还是头一回有人响应了遇险信号。听着，我修复系统的时候需要一些掩护。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: This is a first, someone responds to a distress call. Look, I need some cover while I get these systems back online.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 看来有人就是喜欢华丽登场啊。你介意在我修船的时候挡住他们吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Well, someone likes dramatic entrances. You mind keep them off me while I fix my ship?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 很高兴你能赶到。我的飞船有点破损，你介意在我维修时引开他们吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Glad you could make it. Ship's a little worse for wear. You mind keeping them busy while I work?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 什么？想让我求饶？去你妈的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: What, you want me to beg? Screw you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 你有机会杀了我，动手吧。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: You have your shot. Take it.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 全频段呼叫、全频段呼叫。我正遭受攻击。重复。我正遭受攻击。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Gen comms, gen comms. I'm under attack. Repeat. I'm under attack.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 有人吗？我正遭受攻击，需要支援。有人吗？我正遭受攻击，需要支援。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Anyone out there? I'm taking fire and need assistance. Is anyone out there? I'm taking fire and need assistance.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 求救，求救。遭遇敌人，需要支援。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Mayday, mayday. Hostile contact. Need help.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 如果有人在听的话，我需要帮助。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: If anyone's listening, I need a hand.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 所有飞船，这是一则紧急通讯。我正遭受攻击，需要支援。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: All ships. This is an emergency comm. I'm under attack and need assistance.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 全频段呼叫。我的飞船正遭到攻击。需要支援。完毕。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: All channels. My ship is being attacked. Need assistance. Over.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 全频段呼叫，正遭受多名敌人攻击，需要支援。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Gen comms. Under attack from multiple hostiles. Need backup.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 注意。我陷入危险需要帮助，请回应。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Attention. I'm in danger and need help. Come back.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 有人在吗？我正与多名敌人交战，需要帮助。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Anybody out there. I'm engaged with multiple contacts and need assistance.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 求救、求救、求救。我正遭受攻击，需要支援。请回应。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Mayday, mayday, mayday. I am under attack and need of assistance. Please respond.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.english: Don't think there's anything else to say.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: I'm gonna head off. Stay safe.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我们安全了。<停顿几秒>真是太险了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: We're clear. <long pause> That was close.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 这种惊险的战斗总是让人刻骨铭心。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: The close fights are always the toughest to forget.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 你觉得现在很糟， 等会儿肾上腺素效果过了更难受。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: You think it's bad now, wait til the adrenaline wears off.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: You made short work of them.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 退役之后我还从没见过这般战斗效率。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Haven't seen that kind of efficiency since the military.
They didn't stand a chance, huh.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 打算给你点儿小礼以示感激。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Gonna send you a little something for your help.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 给，我希望这能对你的修理有点儿帮助。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here. I hope this helps with repairs.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 转了一些信用点，你应得的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Transferring some credits. You earned it.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 嗨，这是一点额外的谢礼。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Hey, here's a little extra thanks.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 飞船仍在瘫痪，还需要一点点时间。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Ship's still down. Need a bit more time.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 仍在维修中，还得再久一点。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Still working on the repairs. Gonna be a little longer.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 修理工作比预期中的更费时间。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Repairs are taking longer than anticipated.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 我没有时间跟你耗下去了，你收多少钱才肯离开？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: I don't have time for this. What'll it take for you to go away?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 不如我给你钱，你放我走？
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: How about I make it worth your while to let me go?

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 我们遭受太多攻击。解决他们。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: We're taking too many hits to work. Handle them.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 我说拦住他们可不是在开玩笑，这样下去我没法修理。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: I wasn't kidding when I said keep them off me. I can't work like this.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 被打成这样我没法修理。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: I can't work if I'm getting shot up.

pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.chinese: 正在充能，让我们离开这里。
pu_genpilot3_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.english: Spinning up. Let's get out of here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 船大一级压死人，现在你可走不了了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: Your out classed. No way out now.

pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 你现在可能得重新想想该怎么做了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: You're probably reconsidering your approach to this situation right about now.

pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 我赌你已经开始后悔和我们打交道了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: Bet you're regretting tangling with us now.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 这看起来就是他们所有人了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: That looks like all of them.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我们安全了，敌人已消灭。

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_001.chinese: 你是在休假还是怎么着？！我在这儿都快死了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_001.english: You on a break or something?! I'm dying here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.chinese: 系统马上就要到临界危急状态了！
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.english: Systems are about to go critical!

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.english: I can't hold out much longer.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.chinese: 除非你快点儿做些什么，不然我就只剩几秒钟了！
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.english: I got seconds left unless you do something fast!

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.chinese: 除非你快点儿做些什么，不然我就只剩几秒钟了！
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.english: I got seconds left unless you do something fast!

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.chinese: 介意过来提供点儿该死的帮助吗？我都快完蛋了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: How about some goddamn help? I'm almost done for.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.chinese: 介意过来提供点儿该死的帮助吗？我都快完蛋了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: How about some goddamn help? I'm almost done for.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_002_.english: Okay, okay, let's not get too cocky.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Get on the clock. Hostiles inbound.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: Shit, they called in some more.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.chinese: 保持警惕，还有更多敌人来了。

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: That it? Glad to hear it.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: A little closer than I would have liked.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 记住，我们只是走运而已。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: We got lucky there. Remember that.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 好吧，希望这能让你清醒点儿。

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Nothing like a brush with death to kick off your day.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Hopefully there won't be any more distractions.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 混账，我们失去了一位队友。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Dammit. We lost one of ours.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_s.english: So, you're the escort, huh? Okay.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_greeting_ig_005_h.chinese: 你好，你是来护卫的吧？好。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_greeting_ig_005_h.english: How's it going? Escort, right? Good.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Time to earn your money. Keep a look out.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_letsgo_ig_001_let.english: Let's get this show on the road.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_002.english: Come on. We got shit to do.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_003.english: Let's go, we're on a clock.
Let's go, we're on a clock.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.chinese: 你从我这什么也拿不到。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: You ain't getting shit from me.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 就这样了，我和你没戏了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: That's it. I'm done with you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 算了吧，这事已经没戏了。
这事结束了，我不和业余人士合作。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: We're done. I don't work with amateurs.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: Do me a favor. Handle them.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我还在处理点事情，就一点。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Still wrapping a few things up. It'll be a few.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 你自己玩会儿。我还要做最后的检查。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Entertain yourself for a few. I need to make some final checks.
It'll be a minute or two.
It'll be a minute or two.
Relax. We'll be a little bit.
Relax. We'll be a little bit.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 比想象中花的时间要长。再等一下。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Taking a little longer than expected. Hold tight.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 还要再等一会儿，我还在努力。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: It'll be a little longer. I'm still working

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 把他们赶走，我快搞定了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Keep 'em off me. I'm almost done.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我还没搞定，你要继续掩护我。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: I'm not done yet. You're gonna have to cover me.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 清理掉这些飞船。我还在努力。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: I need these ships cleared. I'm still working.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我需要更多掩护，快搞定了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Gonna need some more cover. Almost there.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 把他们赶走，我快搞定了。

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playercollideship.english: I told you to look out.
I told you to look out.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Don't ever keep me waiting like that again.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 听着，你替我干活就要按我的时间表做事。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Look, when you work for me, you work on my timetable.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 你搞什么鬼？我雇你是来护送我的，不是到处闲逛让我干等着。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Where the hell were you? I hired you to escort me, not hang around and keep me waiting.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 这就是我们要去的地方。
准备量子航行。这是我们要去的地方。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Prep for quantum travel. Here's where we're going.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 好了，下一个量子航行点。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: All right, next quantum travel point.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 好了，这就是我们要去的下一站。
正在发送下一个量子航行点。

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 量子倒计时三... 二... 一...
量子倒计时三... 二... 一...

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 拿到我想要的东西了。准备返航。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Got what I need. Prep to head back.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 这是最后一个了。我们返航。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: That's the last one. Let's head home.
We're good. Time to wrap this up.
That was it. Let's head back.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_startwork_ig_003_.english: Okay. Going offline line for a bit while we work.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: You're drifting. Get back in this.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 你可不能就这么飞走了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: You can't just fly away like that.
Where you going? Come back and fight.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_underattack_high_.chinese: 我雇你干什么吃的？保护我。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_underattack_high_.english: What am I paying you for? Protect me.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.english: This is starting to piss me off.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We're waiting on a couple more.
We're waiting on a couple more.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 等一下，还有几个人要来。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Hold on for a sec. There are a few others inbound.
Got a few more people coming.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 我们队还有几个人要来。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We have a few more on our team showing up.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 我们队还有几个人要来。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We have a few more on our team showing up.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 该死的最后说一次：停止 攻击 我。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Last goddamn time: Stop. Hitting. Me.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 再打我一次我就拉闸走人。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hit me one more time and I'll pull the plug on all this.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 再打我一下你就完蛋了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You keep hitting me and we're done.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 专注一点搞定这个事情。我没时间搞别的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Let's focus and get this job done. I don't have time for this.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 嘿，你到底做不做这个工作？
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hey, you doing this job or what?

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我们现在分秒必争，赶紧回到正轨。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: We're on a clock here. Let's stay on track.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 如果你想做别的事，我可以直接解雇你。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: If you got other things you'd rather be doing, I can just fire you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 给你最后一次机会，要么好自为之要么我们一拍两散。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: This is your last chance. Shape up or we're done.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 快回来帮我，不然合约就作废。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You get back here and help me out. Otherwise, your contract's dead.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 什么？你在摸鱼？回来干活，不然就找别的工作去吧。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: What, are you on a break? Get back here or find another job.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 什么，你在休息？回来干活，不然就找别的工作去吧。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: What, are you on a break? Get back here or find another job.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 最后的机会：回这里来，要么我就和你没有任何关系了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Last chance: get back here or I wash my hands of you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你明白我不是雇你来闲逛的，对吗？给我干活。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You realize I didn't hire you to wander around, right? Do the job.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 到这来，我不想再说一遍。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get over here. I'm not telling you again.

pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 任务是护送我。这意味着你必须离我近点。别让我重新考虑我的选择。
pu_genpilot3_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: The job was to escort me. Which means you have to be near me. Don't make me revisit our arrangement.

pu_genpilot3_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 你该带一百条船来，现在这样不会改变任何事情。
pu_genpilot3_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: You could bring a hundred ships. It's not going to change anything.
Just in the nick of time...

pu_genpilot3_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.chinese: 我可还没死呢，你个狗娘养的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.english: I'm not dead yet, you bitch.

pu_genpilot3_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.chinese: 你觉得你抓到我了？好啊，来啊。
pu_genpilot3_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.english: You think you got me? Well, come on!

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.chinese: 保持航向，这不关你的事。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.english: Drift on. This doesn't concern you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.english: You're gonna want to keep on flyin'.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.chinese: 你不会想卷进这件事的。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.english: You don't want to get involved in this.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.chinese: 免费建议，转个身，忘了你在这里看到的东西。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.english: This advice is free. Turn around and forget what you saw here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.chinese: 好好想想你在这儿要怎么做，这决定了你是死是活。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.english: Think real hard about what you do here. These are the moments where lives are decided.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 飞走，这是我们找到的搜刮物。
你管好你的废品，我们管好我们的。如果你对这事儿有疑问，我们很乐意解决。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: You mind your scrap and we'll mind ours. You got a problem with that, we're happy to settle it.

pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 继续飞吧，这里是我们的废品堆。
pu_genpilot3_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: Just keep on drifting, this here's our scrap heap.

pu_genpilot3_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.english: Oh, you want a fight? Well, shit...

pu_genpilot3_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_004.english: Fine. That's how it's going to be.

pu_genpilot3_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_005.chinese: 让我们看看你有什么本事。

pu_genpilot3_cv_retreat_ig_002_letsgetth.english: Let's get the hell out of here.

pu_genpilot3_cv_retreat_ig_003_screwitit.english: Screw it. It's not worth it.

pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你以为杀了我的人可以不承担任何后果吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You think you can kill one of mine without consequence?

pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 怎么，你以为可以贿赂我的人然后就这么走了吗？
pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: What, you thought you could just cash in on my people and walk away?

pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 虽然花了些时间，但我终于找到了你。现在，你要为你的所作所为付出代价。
pu_genpilot3_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: It took some time, but I finally found you. Now you're gonna pay for what you've done.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_chase_ig_003_ohyo.chinese: 哦，你觉得你可以就这么溜了？我可不这么认为。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_chase_ig_003_ohyo.english: Oh, you think you can just walk away now? I don't think so.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_greet_ig_001_iveb.chinese: 我一直在找你。我都忘了合约上是想要死的你还是活的你，所以我假设是前者。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_greet_ig_001_iveb.english: I've been looking for you. I forgot to see if the contract wanted you alive or dead or alive, so I'll assume the former.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_greet_ig_003_some.chinese: 有人愿意为你支付一笔不小的数目。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_greet_ig_003_some.english: Someone's willing to pay a nice little sum for you.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_this.chinese: 你就这点儿本事？你他妈是怎么活这么久的？
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_this.english: This all you got? How the hell did you last this long?

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_forw.chinese: 对于他们为你付的价钱，不能说让我印象深刻。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_forw.english: For what they're paying for you, can't say I'm impressed.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_your.chinese: 你准备好重新考虑投降了吗?
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_your.english: You ready to reconsider giving yourself up?

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_ofal.chinese: 在所有我追捕过的人里，你可能都排不到前50。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_ofal.english: Of all the people I've hunted, you're barely cracking the top fifty.

pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_this.chinese: 哈！这都算不上一个活儿。今天的标准降得真低。
pu_genpilot3_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_this.english: Ha! This barely counts a job. Standards today are slipping.
