pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 我在边缘生存几十年了，你不会是终结我的人。
pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I survived on the fringe for decades, you won't be the end of me.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 我要让你这赏金赚得每一分都物超所值。
pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I'm gonna make you earn every credit of that bounty.
You picked the wrong bounty, friend.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_sav.chinese: 细细品味这最后的时刻吧。

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_don.english: Don't worry. It'll be over soon.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.chinese: 你感受到了，对不？那慢慢增长的这就是尽头的恐惧。
pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.english: You feel it, don't you. That growing fear that this is the end.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_jus.chinese: 就让它这么发生吧。这是个容易点儿的方式。
pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_jus.english: Just let it happen. It's easier this way.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_yourfr.chinese: 你的朋友们像苍蝇一样掉落下去了。
pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_yourfr.english: Your friends are dropping like flies.

pu_genpilot3_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 我们觉得我们讲的够多了。

pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_001_he.chinese: 嘿！猜怎么着！我会把你炸得渣都不剩，然后把你所有的东西都拿走。
pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_001_he.english: Hey! Guess what! I'm totally going to blow you up and take all your stuff.

pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_002_ch.chinese: 叮咚，看来我在你们这些人身上找到金矿了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_002_ch.english: Cha ching. Looks like I hit a gold mine with you lot.

pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_003_ju.chinese: 只是想让你知道是怎么来的。第一步，我杀了你。第二步，我把你所有的东西都卖了。就是这么直截了当，认真的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_003_ju.english: Just to let you know how this works. Step one is I kill you. Step two, I sell all your belongings. Pretty straight forward, really.

pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_004_wh.chinese: 看看我们这里有什么呢？一个丰厚肥硕的美好发薪日。
pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_004_wh.english: What do we have here? A nice big fat payday for yours truly.

pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_005_ca.chinese: 你能相信么？我只是碰巧发现了一些像你这样容易搞定的目标。这就是运气吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_announceattack_ig_005_ca.english: Can you believe it? I just happen to stumble across some easy pickings like you. Talk about lucky.

pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 现在呀，让我猜猜，你以为你就这么直接过来，然后很轻松的从我脑袋上拿走赏金。你猜怎么着？这可不是那么容易的事儿。
pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Hey now. Let me guess, you thought you'd show up and collect some easy credits off my head. Guess what? It's not gonna be that easy.

pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 无论他们为了我给你多少钱，我现在可以告诉你是远远不够的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Whatever they're paying you for me, I can tell you now it's not nearly enough.

pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 噢，看看呀。又一个觉得可以拿下我的废物。你凭什么觉得你比其他来拿我赏金的人厉害？
pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Oh look at that. Another punk who thinks they can take me down. What makes you think you're gonna do better than everyone else who's tried to collect on me?

pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 来拿我的赏金你还是挺有勇气的。勇敢还是真的蠢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Aren't you brave trying to collect the price on me. Brave or really stupid.

pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 我好奇如果我把你干掉了，我的赏金会上涨多少呢？
pu_genpilot4_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: I wonder how much the price on me is going to go up after I take you down?

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 你没有回应，你没有，你没有回... 呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: You're not responding, you're not, you're not resp... argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 求救，求救，求救，求... 呃啊！！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: May day, may day, may day may...argh!!
May day, may day, may day may argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 他们靠近了，他们靠近呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: They're getting close, they're getting close argh!
He's coming at you, he's... argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 求救？求救，求救，求救，有人吗，嘿，有人...呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: May day? May day, may day may day, anyone there, hey, anyone... argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.chinese: 你能听见我吗？能吗？能吗？呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_scream_ig_ex_.english: Can you hear me? Can you? Can you? Argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: I can't, I can't, I, Argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 会有用的，会有用的，我要死了我发誓，呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: It's going to work, It's going to work, I will die I swear, argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 哦求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，求求了，呃啊！
pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.english: Oh please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, please, argh!

pu_genpilot4_cv_deaththroe_sudden_ig_ex_.chinese: 求求了，求求了，求求了，呃啊！

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.chinese: 我们快搞定了，再多一点儿时间。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: We're getting close. A little bit longer.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.chinese: 维修马上完成。你做的很棒。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Repairs almost done. You're doing great.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 天哪，见到你真高兴。希望你有兴致打一架。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Holy shit, am I glad to see you. Hope you're in the mood for a fight.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 太好了！我还以为没有人会来了！快来帮我一起战斗吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Yes! I thought no one was coming! Now you can help me fight.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 噢，感谢上帝你来了。也许现在是时候向这些混蛋开炮了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Oh, thank god you came. Now maybe I have shot against these assholes.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 天哪，真的有人回应了。看来我真能活着离开这儿了。来吧，让我们把他们干掉。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Damn. Someone actually responded. I might actually get out of this alive. Come on, let's take 'em out.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 天，你到这儿的时候我还以是我的幻觉。希望你准备好战斗了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Geez. I thought I was hallucinating when you got here. I hope you're ready to fight.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 你简直就是上帝派来的。我修理的时候帮我拖住这帮混蛋。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: You are a god send. Hold off these assholes while I do repairs.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 我都说不出来你在这儿我有多高兴了。我的船坏了，但如果你能帮我争取一些时间，我就可以把它修好。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: I cannot tell you how happy I am you're here. My ship's broken, but I can fix it if you can buy me some time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 哦天哪。我以为不会有人过来了。我修船的时候，尽量帮我拖住他们。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Oh god. I didn't think anyone was coming. Try to hold them off while I fix my ship.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 真的有人收到了我的呼救信息！听着，我正在让我的系统重新上线。但那些混蛋攻击我的时候我没办法弄，你看看能做些什么吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Someone actually heard my distress call! Listen, I'm bring my systems back online, but I can't do it while these prats are attacking me. See what you can do.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 该死，能看到一张友善的脸我简直太开心了。我的船现在趴窝了，但如果你能拖住他们，我就可以让它重新活过来。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Damn, I am so glad to see a friendly face. My ship's dead in the water, but if you hold them off, I can get it up and running again.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: Hey, it doesn't have to be like this.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 别做任何让你后悔的事儿，好吗？
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: Don't do anything you're going to regret, okay?
This is just some big misunderstanding.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 如果任何人能听到这条。我现在需要立即的帮助。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: If anyone can hear this. I am in immediate need of assistance.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 呼救。飞船遭遇攻击，需要帮助。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Mayday. Ship under fire. Help is requested.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 紧急呼救！紧急呼救！我遇到了严重的麻烦。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Emergecy! Emergency! I'm in serious trouble.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 任何人！请回复！他们要杀了我！
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Anybody! Please respond! They're going to kill me!

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 你好？有人能听见我吗？你好？哦天呐，我要死了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Hello? Can anyone hear me? Hello? Oh god. I'm gonna die.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 通用频道。我飞船遭遇攻击，需立即协助，请回复。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Gen Comms. My vessel is under attack. Assistance is needed. Please respond.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 注意，如果你能听到这条信息，我需要战斗支援。我不知道我还能挺多久。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Attention. If you can hear this, I need combat assistance. I don't know how much longer I can hold on for.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 求救！极度需要紧急支援，派支援来。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Mayday! Emergency assistance desperately needed. Send help.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 所有舰船，非法分子正在攻击，请立即向我坐标支援。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: All ships. Outlaws attack in progress. Send help to my coordinates immediately.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 救命！任何人！看在亲爱的上帝的份儿上，救救我吧！
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Help! Anybody! Please for the love of god, help me!

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_bad_ig.chinese: 我觉得我们这儿结束了。

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 好了，我最好现在走了，好运。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: Okay, I better get going. Be good.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 我可能该走了，注意安全，好吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: I should probably go. Stay safe, okay.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 我逃出来了，但是谁知道呢，也许某一天我能报答你。不是说我想让你被不法分子或者什么的攻击...我还是走吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: I have head out, but who knows, maybe I can repay you the favor one day. Not that I want you to get attacked by outlaws or anything... I'm just gonna go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 我最好把船开去修理一下，后会有期。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: I better get ship seen to. I'll see you around.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.chinese: 听着，在外面照顾好自己。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_farewell_good_i.english: Listen. Take care of yourself out there.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我没有想到我还能活着看到明天。我都以为我死定了，但我猜奇迹还是发生了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I didn't think I'd live to see another day. I was sure I was dead, but I guess miracles do happen.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我不知道你怎么想的，但这一切过后，我会为再也不用飞行而高兴。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I don't know about you, but after that, I'd be happy to never fly again.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我们他妈是怎么活下来的？
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: How the hell did we survive that?

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 天，他们经常会告诉你在这一片飞行会有危险，但你从来想不到会发生在自己头上。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: Geez. They tell you it's dangerous flying out here, but you just never think it's gonna happen to you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 唔，真是惊险，但至少我们都还活着，对不？
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: Well, it was close, but at least we're still alive, right?

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 哇靠，你能回应我的求救呼叫可真是谢天谢地了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Crap. Am I glad you answered my distress call.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 你刚才飞得真是棒极了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: That was some pretty fantastic flying you just did.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 我不知道你是从哪儿学的这些，但我非常庆幸你搞定了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: I don't know where you learned how to do that, but I'm so glad you did.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 你刚才救我的时候，简直就像是大片里的剧情。我到现在还是不敢相信。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: The way you just rescued me? That was like something straight out of a vid. I still don't believe it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here. Take this. You've earned it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 虽然没多少，但我希望您收下。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: This isn't much, but I want you to have it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 麻烦了，给您打了一笔小钱。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: I'm sending you a little something for your trouble.
Every good turn deserves another, so here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 我的感激之情无以言表，收下这个，希望能让我少欠点人情债。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: I really can't tell you how much I appreciate what you did. Here, I hope this makes us a little bit more even.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 还在维修中，需要再等一下。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: Still working on the repairs. Gonna be a little longer.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 我们正在尽快修理了，但还需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: We're working as fast as we can, but we need more time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 快好了，再拖住他们一会儿。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: It's slow going. Just hold them off a bit more.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 听着，你是想要钱吗？我可以给你钱。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: Look, do you want credits? I can give you credits.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 求求你了，如果你放过我，我不会让你空手而归的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: Please. If you leave me alone, I'll make it worth your time.
Okay. Okay. How about I pay you?

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_playerattacks_i.english: What the hell's wrong with you?

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_playercollidesh.english: You tryin' to get us killed?

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 该死，我们的损伤更严重了。如果我们一直被攻击就没法完成修理。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Damn it, we took more damage. We can't finish if we keep getting hit.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 把他们赶走，不然我们永远也修不完。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Get them off us, or we're never gonna finish.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 这很不妙，如果他们一直把我们当做目标，就没办法干活了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: It's no good. We can't work as long as they keep targeting us.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.english: Spooling, now. Let's get out of here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.chinese: 趁我们还能走，快离开这里。
pu_genpilot4_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.english: Let's get going while we still can.

pu_genpilot4_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: Well, the tables are turned now!

pu_genpilot4_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 这就对了。我朋友来了，他们会好好教训你的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: That's right. I got friends, and they're gonna kick you're ass.

pu_genpilot4_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.chinese: 似乎所有人都和我一样想把你干掉呢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_enemiestoplayerarrive_ig.english: Seems like everyone in the 'verse is as eager to take you down as I am.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 我不想乌鸦嘴，但我觉得他们都没了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Hate to jinx it, but I think they're all gone.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 嘿！看看呀，我觉得我们好像真的活下来了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Hey! Look at that. I think we might have actually survived.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 这是真的吗？没想到真能打赢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Is that really it? I was not expecting to actually win that.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 区域安全，我们好像成功了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Scope's clear. We might have pulled it off.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 不相信我会这么说，但敌人已全部肃清。我想我们暂时安全了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Can't believe I'm saying this, but hostiles clear. I think we're safe for now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.chinese: 如果还有谁藏着什么绝招，是时候该秀一秀了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.english: If anyone has a hail mary up their sleeves, now's the time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.chinese: 如果我这回没挺过去，转告我妈我永远原谅不了她。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.english: If I don't make it through this, tell my mom I never forgave her.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.chinese: 讨厌这么说，但我想我们要输了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.english: Hate to say it, but I think we're losing.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.chinese: 现在的形式非常不容乐观。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: Things are looking pretty damn dire right now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.chinese: 最后一点，要不了多久了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.english: We're in the final stretch. Shouldn't be too much longer.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_002.chinese: 差不多搞定了，最后一点。

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_003.chinese: 还剩一点就搞定了，要不了一两分钟。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_003.english: Got only a few more things to take care of. Should be done in a second or two.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_004.chinese: 我们这边已经接近完成了，不会太久了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_004.english: We're approaching the finish line on our side. Won't be much longer, now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_005.chinese: 快要搞定了，应该马上就可以走了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_005.english: Near the end now. Should be able to move on soon.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_001_.chinese: 看你战斗就像是门艺术。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_001_.english: It's like watching an artist at work.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_004_.chinese: 卡尔·梅森也做不到更好了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_celebrate_ig_004_.english: Cal Mason couldn't have done it better.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 现在都就看你的了。干掉他们。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: It's all you now. Take them out.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 自用开火！还是怎么说的来着。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: Weapons free or whatever the term is.
Time to unleash a little hell.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 去杀了他们。很简单的，想象一下你在玩儿竞技场指挥官就行。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: Go ahead and kill them. It's easy. Just pretend like you're playing Arena Commander.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 我给你所有授权去干爆他们。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: You have my full permission to kick their ass.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 我们这儿来了个搞事的。
该死，本来一切都这么顺利。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Damn. And everything was going so well.
Guess you're gonna get a chance to earn your pay.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.chinese: 增援赶到了，正是我们需要的。
一定要来是吧，仿佛事情还不够糟似的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: Of course. Like thing's weren't bad enough.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemyshipdestroye.chinese: 希望他们把后事都安排妥当了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemyshipdestroye.english: Sure hope they had their affairs in order.
And another one bites the dust.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemyshipdestroye.chinese: 你觉得会有人想他们吗？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_enemyshipdestroye.english: You think anyone's gonna miss them?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_expletives_ig_004.english: No good, rotten piece of shit!
No good, rotten piece of shit!

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 我也希望能说很高兴和你一起飞行，但不是这样的，所以我先走了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: I wish I could say it was nice flying with you, but I can't. So, I'm just gonna go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 不如我们没什么事，直接分道扬镳得了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: Why do you say we don't drag this out any longer, and just head our seperate ways.
I'm gonna call it quits. Later.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 我们都搞定了，你可以走了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: We're all done. You can go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 总的来说这一趟就是灾难。祝你余生幸福。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: And so concludes that disaster of a run. Good luck with the rest of your life.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 好嘞，和你做生意是我的荣幸。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: All right. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 和你一起飞行非常愉快，再见啦。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: It was nice flying with you. See ya.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 我走了。你自己保重，好吗？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: I gotta go. Take care of yourself, okay?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 好了，我要走了，注意安全。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: Okay, I have to head out, but fly safe.
I'm gonna go. Have a good one.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 除了我还有谁刚才觉得自己要死了回想起自己的一生？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Anyone else see their life flash before their eyes back there?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 虽然事情办得不咋地，但还好我们依然健在。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Zero points for style, but full marks for us not being dead.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 这之后我估计好几天都睡不着了。天呐，真是太险了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: I'm not gonna be able to sleep for days after that. Crap that was close.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 我不知道你那边怎么样，但我得去换一套飞行服。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Don't know about you, but I could use a change of flight suit after that.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 没想到我们能挺过来，真的是险胜啊。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: I didn't think we were going to make it out of that. Talk about snatching victory from the jaws of defeat.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 没什么比干掉几个混蛋更能让你感受到活着的气息了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Nothing like kicking some ass to make you feel alive.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 刚才那场战斗就是为什么你要多花几个子儿找个靠谱的护航。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: That right there is why you always pay the extra credits for an escort.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 你干掉他们的样子可太牛逼了！人们会把这场史诗般的战斗传颂很多年的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: The way you handled yourself? Stuff of legends. People are going to be singing about our epic battle for years to come.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 不得不说你刚出现的时候我还挺担心的，但是你的确对得起你的酬金。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: I'll admit I was a bit worried when you first showed up, but you have been credits well spent so far.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 不得不说，除了稍微受到一点攻击以外，进展还挺顺利的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Gotta say, short of not being attack at all, that went pretty well.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyfire_ig_0.chinese: 你不会真的在朝我开火吧？

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyfire_ig_0.english: Hey, asshole! We're on the same side.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Damn, that was one of ours.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 靠，我们不能再损失任何一个人了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Crap. We can't affort to lose any one else.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.chinese: 这些混蛋不是闹着玩儿的。

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_o.chinese: 好啊，你要么是海盗要么就是来护航的，你没开火，那我猜你是来护航的喽？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_o.english: Okay, you're either an outlaw or my escort, and since you haven't shot me yet, I'm guessing escort.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_002_h.chinese: 你是来护送我的吧，欢迎。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_002_h.english: Hey, you're my escort right? Welcome.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_a.english: All right. The escort has arrived.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_w.chinese: 你好，你来护航我是吗？我需要你发血誓不计一切代价保护我。别当真，开个玩笑而已，合约没问题。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_w.english: Welcome. If you're going to be my escort, I'm gonna need you to swear a blood oath to protect me with your life. Just kidding, the contract was fine.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_005_h.chinese: 嗨，谢谢你能来保护我们。希望能一切顺利，但是万一遇到问题，有你在能干掉他们挺不错的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_greeting_ig_005_h.english: Hey, thanks for keeping an eye on us. Hopefully it'll be smooth sailing, but if we do hit stormy seas, it's nice to know you'll blow them up.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 我希望你留意任何可疑事物，比如向我们开火的飞船这些。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: I want you to keep an eye out for anything that look's suspicious. Like a ship shooting at us or something.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 在这个区域内巡逻，确保没人能偷袭我们。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Patrol the area and make sure no one gets the jump on us.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 有任何不速之客出现，你就把他们通通干掉，OK？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Any unexpected visitors show, you take care of them, okay?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 注意你的扫描器，以免有什么麻烦找上门。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Keep an eye on your scanner in case any trouble shows up.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 有你在旁守护，我就能集中精力了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: It's gonna be easier to focus knowing you're watching our backs.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsgo_urgent_ig_.chinese: 该出发了！我再说一遍，该 出 发 了 ！
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsgo_urgent_ig_.english: Time to go! Time, to, Go!
C'mon, let's get the hell out of here!

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_001.english: Let's get going to the next stop.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_002.chinese: 我们该动身去下一站了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_002.english: We should move on to the next stop.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_004.english: Let's head over to the next stop.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_005.chinese: 还有一站等着我们，所以我们出发吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_letsmoveon_ig_005.english: We got another stop, so let's get going.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: You're done. Get away from me.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.chinese: 就这？以后再没人会雇你的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: No one's gonna hire you again after this.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 要不您先保证自己安全吧？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: You know what, why don't you just go escort yourself the hell out of here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 算了吧，我受够了。合约解除。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: That's it. I've had enough. Contract's canceled.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 你想做个小丑？那随意，但我可不会付钱。你被解雇了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: You want to be an asshole? Fine. But I'm not paying you for it. Job's canceled.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 你猜怎么着？你被炒鱿鱼了。祝你万事如意嗷。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: Guess what? You're fired. Have a great life.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 不，不行，不可能。不会再和你这种废物合作了，这活儿结束了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: Nope. No way. Not gonna deal your crap any more. Job's over.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: Forget it. No credits are worth this.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.chinese: 我们没别的选择，趁还能跑路的时候赶紧跑吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: No choice. Gotta run while we still can.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我们正在进行最后准备，好了我会通知你。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: We're finishing final prep, right now. I'll ping you when we're ready to go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 希望你有点儿东西来打发时间，我们还需要等一会儿才能出发。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Hope you brought something to read, cause we're going to need a few more moments before we can go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 正准备最后一点儿东西呢，应该马上就能出发。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Just wrapping up a few last things. Should be ready to leave soon.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 稍安勿躁，出发前还得做一些准备。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Got to finish our prep before we can head out. Sit tight for now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我正在做最后一次出发前检查，指我需要用下浴室。我们马上就出发。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: I'm working my way through the last pre-checks before we start, a.k.a. I need use the bathroom. We'll get going in two seconds.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_001_h.english: How about some help over here!

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 进展很不错，但是我们离结束还早着呢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Making good progress, but we're not quite finished here yet.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 正在做了，但是要点儿时间。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Things are underway, but it'll be a while yet.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 目前进展很不错，但是我们还需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Things are going good so far, but looks like we'll need a little more time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 开头进展不错，我觉得我们应该能按时完成。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Got a good solid start. I think we'll be able to finish on schedule.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 我们遇到一点儿小麻烦，但是不会拖延我们太长时间，应该很快就能离开这里。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: We hit a snag or two so far, but I don't think it'll slow us down too much. Should be able to get out of here soon.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们已经尽可能快了，但是还需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: We're going as fast as we can, but we need more time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 你需要帮我们拖一段时间才能完成。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: You need to buy us some time so we can finish up.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我不管你用什么手段，把他们挡住，这样我们才能完成。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: I don't care how you do it, just hold them off so we can finish.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 让他们离我们远点，我们会尽快完成。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: If you can keep them off us a little longer, we'll finish as fast as we can.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我们快结束了，再稍微挡住他们一小会儿。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: We're getting close. Just hold them back a bit longer.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playercollideship.english: Damn it, I just had hull fixed.
Seriously? You got to be kidding me!

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 再近一点你就要怼我船里了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: Any closer and you're going to be inside my ship.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 你来了，我们还担心你出事了呢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: There you are. Was getting worried about you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 日，你居然来了，害得我输了五毛。赌的是你迟到是因为翘辫子了。啊，我是说，很高兴你还活着。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Damn. You showing up cost me five creds. I bet that you were late cause you were dead. Oh well, glad you're alive, I guess.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 你这么晚才到，让我白担心。你真丢人。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: You had me worried sick, showing up that late. Shame on you. Shame.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Here. I'm uploading coordinates to you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 正在向你的导航系统传输量子数据。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Sending your nave the quantum data.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 量子标记已经准备好了，现在发给你。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Have the QT marker ready. Sending now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 正在传输量子导航数据。
正在向你的导航系统传输量子数据。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Sending QT over to your nav.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 下一个导航点发给你了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Got the next nav point for you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 正在给你传输下个集合点。
正在给你发送下个导航点信的息。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Sending the next nav info over to you now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 正在准备量子航行，做好准备。
正在给引擎充能进行量子航行，准备好。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Powering up the drive for quantum, get ready.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_005_.chinese: 不知道你怎么样，但我已经准备好嗨起来了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_005_.english: Don't know about you, but I'm ready to get this party started.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 都完成了，我想我们可以返航了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: All done. I think we can head back.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 这就是全部的事了，今天就到这儿，返航吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: That's everything. Let's call it a day and head back.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 今天差不多完成了，我觉得是时候返航了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: We are done for the day, and I for one am ready to head back.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: OK，我觉得应该结束了，咱们回去吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Okay, I think that's it. Let's head back.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 没别的安排了，我们可以结束了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Nothing else on the schedule which means it's quiting time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_001_.chinese: 是时候撸起袖子加油干了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_001_.english: Time to roll up our sleeves and get down to business.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_002_.chinese: 我们现在有一票活儿要干。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_002_.english: Now, we just have to do a bunch of work.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_005_.chinese: 有人准备好干活儿了嘛？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_startwork_ig_005_.english: Who's ready to do some work?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 嘿，赶紧回来！你不应该保护我嘛？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: Hey, get back here. You're supposed protect me!

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 你要去哪？你脑壳被敲懵了？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: Where you going? You get hit in the head?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 哪门子护航中途离开战斗？！
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: What kind of escort leaves in the middle of a fight?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 你不会已经想着跑路了吧？不会吧？那你为啥不和我一起飞？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: You're not thinking about leaving already, are you? Cause otherwise you need to actually fly with me.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 嘿兄弟，我们在这儿，靠近点。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Hey hot shot, we're over here. Stay close.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 就算你要跑路，你也至少是偷偷遛啊。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: If you're going to try to sneak off, you could at least try to be more subtle about it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 嘿，你能不能在活儿干完之前靠得近一点？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Hey, you mind staying close till the job's over?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 可以请您别在任务中途随意闲逛吗？谢谢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: If it's not too much trouble, you think you could stop randomly wandering off in the middle of a contract. Thanks.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_thanks_ig_004_you.english: You did pretty good out there.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_thanks_ig_005_you.chinese: 你那份合约完成得不错，要是我孩子以你为名可别吃惊。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_thanks_ig_005_you.english: You did great on that contract. Don't be surprised when I name one of my children after you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_underattack_high_.chinese: 有没有人冲他们来一梭子？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_underattack_high_.english: Would somebody shoot these people, please?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.english: Not gonna lie, that one hurt.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.chinese: 这会在船上留个划痕的。

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 我不觉得其他人会来了。这就像我九岁生日聚会一样。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: I don't think anyone else is showing. It's like my ninth birthday party all over again.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 我们等过他们了，但是我们不可能一直等下去。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: We gave them a chance, but we can't wait around here all day.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 哼，这群人应该不会来了，真他妈吉利。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Huh. I guess they're not coming. Talk about an auspicious start. Oh well.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 还没到，估计是找别的护航去了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Still not here. Seems like the other escorts should've hired escorts.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 现在他们还不来，估计永远也不会来了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: If they're not here by now, I don't think they're coming.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 我们现在等其他人到了就可以出发了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We just need to wait for the others to show, and then we can head out.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 并不是看不起你的意思，只是等一下别的护航者到了我们就出发。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: This isn't a comment on your abilities, but we're waiting on few more escorts before we start.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 还有别人没来，我们得等等他们。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: I have a few more people showing up, so we have to wait for them.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 差不多要出发了，现在就差剩下的人到齐了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Almost ready to go, just have to wait for the rest of everyone to get here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 差不多该出发了，就是不知道其他人在干什么，这么长时间还没到。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: About ready to leave, just have to figure what the heck's taking everyone else so long to get here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 最后一次警告，你再攻击我，你就完了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I won't say this again. Hit me again, and you're done.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 继续干这种破事儿，你就准备滚吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Keep up with this crap and you're gonna be out on your ass.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你再打我就中止合约了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I'm canceling the contract if you hit me again.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 听好，你要是不把这活儿当回事儿，我就得请你离开了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Listen, if you're not going to take this job seriously, I'm gonna have to let you go.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我觉得你是不太想要这份工作了，我或许该找别人来做。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I'm starting to feel like you don't want this job. That maybe I should find someone else to do it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不想做带恶人，但是你一直胡闹，我要取消你的合约了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Not to be one of those people, but you keep messing around, I'm gonna cancel your contract.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你已经耗尽我的耐心了，这可不是开玩笑。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: You've used up most of my patience, and that's really saying something with me.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不确定还能忍你多久。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I don't know how much longer I can put up with you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你再不回来就别回来了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: If you don't get back here right now, you can forget this job.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 最后一次机会，赶紧爬回来。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Last chance. Get your ass over here now.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 给我回来。你还要不要报酬了？
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Get back here. Do you want to get paid or not?

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你是不是不知道如何遵守命令？还是你路痴？总之我有点不太想和你一起飞了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Seems like you're either terrible at following directions or you're bad at navigating. Whichever one it is, I'm not sure if I want to keep flying with you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 不和你说笑，要不表现得像一个付费保镖一样，要不就自己走吧。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Okay, seriously now, start flying like you're an actual paid escort or you can forget this job.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我可是花钱请你给我护航，再不更改航线，你这份工作就无了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Yo, person I am paying to escort me, if you don't change course, don't expect to keep this job.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.chinese: 所有人都到了，是时候嗨起来了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.english: Everyone's here. Time to get this party started.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.chinese: 我可不想再等下去了，所以现在就算是全部人都到齐了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.english: Well, I don't really want to wait any longer so I'm just going to say that we're all here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.english: That's it. We're all done here.
Okay, that's everything. We're done here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 你觉得多点儿火力你就能跑了？
pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: You think some extra fire power is going to get you out of this?

pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 噢噢噢噢，要是他们和你一样菜，我可太害怕了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: Oooo. If they fly anything like you, I'm real scared.

pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.chinese: 不敢相信你居然邀请了这么多人见证你被干掉。
pu_genpilot4_cv_friendliestoplayerarrive.english: Can't believe you invited more people here to watch you get taken out.

pu_genpilot4_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.chinese: 行吧，你或许不是那么废物。
pu_genpilot4_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.english: All right. So maybe you're not such a push over.

pu_genpilot4_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.english: Well this isn't so fun anymore.

pu_genpilot4_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.english: I bet you think you're so great, don't you?

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.chinese: 嘿，一点儿小建议。趁你现在还能飞，赶紧离开这里。
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.english: Hey there. Bit of friendly advice. Get the hell out of here while you can still fly.

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.chinese: 你知道俗话说的“错误的时间错误的地点”吧？你现在就挺错的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.english: You know the saying wrong place at the wrong time? Well let me tell you, it doesn't get much wronger than this.

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.chinese: 让我猜猜，你迷路了对吧？要不是，你就赶紧滚，懂？
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.english: Let me guess, you're lost. And if you're not. Then you should damn well get lost. Understand me?

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_004_.english: Unless you've got a death wish, you'll want to turn that ship around.

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.chinese: 很简单，要么你滚要么我们杀了你。对我来说都无所谓。
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.english: I'll make this easy for ya. Leave now, or we'll kill you. I'm happy either way.

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 不好意思，这是我们的地盘。
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: Hate to break it to you, but this our turf.
You can stop right there. This claim is ours.

pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 忘了你扫描到的东西然后赶紧滚。你在这儿能找到的只有麻烦。
pu_genpilot4_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: You can go ahead and forget what your scans say. The only thing you're gonna find here is a shit ton of trouble.

pu_genpilot4_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_001.chinese: 喔，似乎这里来了个见义勇为的英雄。
pu_genpilot4_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_001.english: Oh, looks like we got ourselves a hero.

pu_genpilot4_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_003.english: You just had to do things the hard way.

pu_genpilot4_cv_retreat_ig_001_screwthis.english: Screw this. I'm out of here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_retreat_ig_002_whatevery.chinese: 随便吧，你还真以为我在乎输赢？
pu_genpilot4_cv_retreat_ig_002_whatevery.english: Whatever. You think I care about any of this? Guess again.

pu_genpilot4_cv_retreat_ig_003_fineyouwi.chinese: 好好好，你赢了，开心了吗？

pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 有件事要告诉你：搞我们的人就得死。
pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: I got message for you. Mess with one of ours and you die.

pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你以为杀了我们的人还能逃掉？痴心妄想。
pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You thought you could get away with taking one of ours, but you thought wrong.

pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 在我们宰掉你之前，让你知道这就是你杀了我朋友的报应。
pu_genpilot4_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: Before we kill ya, know that this is payback for what you did to my friend.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_chase_ig_001_what.english: What? You don't play with me anymore?

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_chase_ig_002_your.english: You're not gonna get away that easy.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_chase_ig_003_ohno.english: Oh no. You're not going anywhere.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_001_nots.chinese: 虽然不知道你做了什么，但是他们让我来肯定是非常坏的事情。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_001_nots.english: Not quite sure what you did, but it must have been pretty bad if they sent me.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_002_noww.chinese: 现在，我来这单纯是要干掉你，不过我只是为了钱而已。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_002_noww.english: Now, while I am here to take you down extreme prejudice, just want you to know I'm only doing it for the credits.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_003_just.chinese: 在做掉你前告诉你一声，我们是为了一大笔钱才来的。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_greet_ig_003_just.english: Just so you know before we do this, the credits I'm getting for taking you down are going to a very worth cause.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_ally.chinese: 你不过是在浪费我的时间而已。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_001_ally.english: All you're doing is wasting my time.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_youk.chinese: 知道什么最好玩吗？我赌你肯定在想办法脱身，而我现在在想我该怎么花杀掉你后拿的钱。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_002_youk.english: You know what's funny? I bet you're trying to figure a way out of this mess, and here I am thinking about how I'm gonna spend all the credits I get for you.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_ibet.chinese: 我赌你一定在想到底是什么错误的抉择让你陷入这种境地。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_003_ibet.english: I bet you're starting to rethink whatever bad life decisions got you here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_woul.chinese: 哇哦快看，你打得好像你有机会赢一样。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_004_woul.english: Would you look at that. You're fighting like you actually have chance here.

pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_beli.chinese: 你也许不信，但其实你越反抗，我越享受，让我的工作有满足感，感觉这是我实打实挣来的钱。
pu_genpilot4_cv_target_taunt_ig_005_beli.english: Believe it or not, I actually like it when you fight back. Gives me greater job satisfaction. Feel like I really earn my credits.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 派你这样的人来抓我可真是看不起我啊。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I'm a bit insulted that they'd someone like you after me.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 天哪，他们就随便派个有船的小丑来缉拿我吗？也太丢脸了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Geez. Did they just let any clown with a ship take the contract on me? It's embarassing.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 我很好奇他们下一个派来的人应该会比你强点儿吧？哼，他们肯定得是。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I wonder if the next person they send will do better than you're doing. They'd pretty much have to.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_ont.chinese: 往好处想，你还能在医院里摸好长一段时间的鱼呢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_ont.english: On the bright side, think about the free time you're going to have in the hospital.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_ami.chinese: 啥？你是在唬我吗？没人能飞这么烂吧？
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_ami.english: What? Am I on Fake Outs? No one could possibly fly this bad in real life.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_are.chinese: 你是故意想输吗？那你可演得和真的一样。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_are.english: Are you trying to lose on purpose? Cause that's what it looks like.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_ill.chinese: 我告诉你，如果你要是故意撞船而且还活下来了，我就放你走...<大喘气> <轻笑声>不好意思，我想着你会那么做呢。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_004_ill.english: I'll tell you what, if you intentionally crash your ship and survive, I'll let you walk... <long pause> <chuckle> Sorry, I was hoping you'd do it.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_thi.chinese: 这也太没眼看了。把你干掉其实是一件好事。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_thi.english: This is just painful to watch. Putting you down will be doing you a favor.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_001_ihopey.english: I hope you weren't too close to them.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_002_whatas.chinese: 这个杯具有一个多么壮观的结局啊。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_002_whatas.english: What a spectacular end to a miserable little shit.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_004_didyou.chinese: 你看到了吗？上一分钟你朋友还在那儿飞来飞去，下一刻他就变成了太空垃圾，很刺激，对吧？
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_004_didyou.english: Did you see that? One minute your friend's flying around, next they're space trash. Crazy, right?

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_yougot.chinese: 现在你是不是有点小害怕？
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_yougot.english: You got to be feeling a bit worried after that.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 我正想着做点射击练习。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: I've been wanting some target practice.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 看来今天还是能找点乐子了。
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: Looks like I get to have some fun today, afterall.

pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 你应该安排好后事了吧？
pu_genpilot4_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: Hope all of your affairs are in order.

pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_001_ok.chinese: 我只说一次，我们是危险的人，别找事。
pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_001_ok.english: Okay, I'm only gonna say this once. We're very dangerous people, so don't screw with us.

pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_002_yo.english: You flew into the wrong corner of space.

pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_003_we.english: Well, well, well, look what we got here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_004_li.chinese: 听好了，你的一切都是我们的了，你的东西，还有你的命。
pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_004_li.english: Listen up. Everything you got is ours now. That means your stuff... and your life...

pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_005_yo.chinese: 侵犯我们的地盘，你现在要付出代价。
pu_genpilot5_cv_announceattack_ig_005_yo.english: You're on our turf. You gotta pay the price now.

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_enemiestoplayer_i.chinese: 感谢上帝，你现在有麻烦了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_enemiestoplayer_i.english: Oh thank god. Now you're in trouble.

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_enemiestoplayer_i.chinese: 他们他妈的是时候出现了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_enemiestoplayer_i.english: About frickin' time they showed up.

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_enemiestoplayer_i.chinese: 终于，现在你要付出代价了。

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.chinese: 这些人他妈是谁？你不觉得这样有点不公平吗？
pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.english: Who the hell are these people? That's a little unfair, don't you think?

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.chinese: 好吧，瞧，我们都做过后悔的事情，要不我们就重新考虑下立场吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.english: All right, look, we've both done things we regret, maybe we just reconsider our position here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.chinese: 你觉得这就能吓到我？我...额...我是说你即使带来20艘船，这...这也并不能救你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_arrive_friendliestoplaye.english: You think this scares me? I... uh... I mean, you could bring twenty ships... it's... it's not going to save you.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_001_w.chinese: 什么？你来逮我的？是不是搞错了什么？
pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_001_w.english: What, you're here for me? Gotta be some kinda mistake.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_002_i.english: I think you got the wrong guy.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_003_n.chinese: 不，这里没有罪犯。要是我看到了，我会通知你的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_003_n.english: Nope, no criminals here. If I see any, I'll let you know.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_004_y.chinese: 你找错人了，听到了吗？你应该...应该赶紧走人。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_004_y.english: You picked the wrong guy. You hear me? You should...you should just get out of here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_005_y.chinese: 你以为你是第一个来抓我的人？并不是，而且你也会像其他人一样被干掉。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bounty_greeting_ig_005_y.english: You think you're the first person to hunt me down? Well, you're not and you'll end up like the others. They're dead.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_chase_ig_00.chinese: 告诉你，你要是把我想要的东西给我，我们本不必走到这一步的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_chase_ig_00.english: You know, if you'd just given me what I wanted, it wouldn't have come to this.
Where do you think you're going?

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 听好了，我可是收了一大笔钱来干掉你，而且我也打算这么干。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Attention, I got paid good money to hunt you down. And that's what I intend to do.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 你活着的日子...不管你曾经干过啥...都要结束了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: Your days of doing... whatever it is you did... are over.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.chinese: 清算的日子来了，正义虽迟但到。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_greeting_ig.english: The time has come for a reckoning. A reckoning of justice.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_taunt_ig_00.chinese: 这是你的所作所为导致的结果。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_taunt_ig_00.english: This is... for whatever you did.

pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_taunt_ig_00.chinese: 这一天总会来的，你也清楚吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_bountyhunter_taunt_ig_00.english: You knew this day would come, didn't you?

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: I'm not done. I'm not done!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.chinese: 把这个...这个...还有这个...我们差不多要完成了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_almostdone_unde.english: Got that... and that... and that... we're almost back up.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 有人来了！谢谢谢谢，你得帮我战斗才行。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Somebody came! Thank you. Thank you. You have to help me fight.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 老天啊，我以为我死定了。这些歹徒在袭击我，我需要帮助。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Oh my god. I thought I was done for. These outlaws just attacked. I need help.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 求求你，你得帮帮我，我不能就这样死掉。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Please, you have to help me. I can't die like this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 你收到了我的求救！请一定帮我战斗。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: You heard my call! Please, you gotta help me fight.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.chinese: 谢天谢地。请帮我干掉这些无法无天的贱货。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_combat_i.english: Oh thank god. Help me against these lawless reprobates. Please.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 你好！你听到我求救了！我船抛锚了，你得帮我把那些人赶走。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Hello! Your heard my call! My ship's dead in the water. You gotta keep 'em off me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 终于有人来了！你得保护我，我正在尝试让我的船动起来。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Somebody came! You gotta protect me. I'm trying to get my ship working again.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 感谢上苍，你把他们都解决掉了。我要回去开始修船了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: Oh thank god. You take care of them. I'll get back to repairing the ship.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 我不能动了！不能动了！把他们赶走，这样我才能修船。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: I can't fly! I can't fly! Keep them away so I can fix it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.chinese: 我以为我死定了，那些混蛋不给我机会去修船。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_arrive_shipbrok.english: I thought I was done for. These bastards won't let me fix my ship.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: Please don't kill me. I'm begging you. Please don't kill me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 我不能死在这里，孤零零地在虚空之中，请别杀我。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: I can't go out like this. Not out here. In space. Alone. Please don't.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.chinese: 等等等等等！你没必要这么做。让我走吧，我一句话都不会多说。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_begforlife_ig_0.english: Wait, wait, wait. Wait! You don't have to do this. You can just let me go. I won't say a thing.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 有人吗？！我正在遭受攻击！快来帮帮我！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Anybody?! My ship's under attack. Please help me!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 救命！救命！有好多飞船...我需要帮助！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Help! Help! I got... there are ships... a lot of ships... I need help!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.chinese: 有人能听到吗？我正遭受攻击，需要帮助。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_comm_ig_00.english: Can anybody hear me?! I'm under attack and need help.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 随便谁请来帮帮我！我正遭受攻击。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Please, somebody help me! I'm being attacked.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 我需要帮助！到处都是他们的人，救命！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: I need help! They're everywhere! Help!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 喂？！喂？！我被战机围困了，需要帮助！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Hello?! Hello?! I got fighters all over me and need help.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 有人在吗？这里有紧急状况！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Is anyone out there? This is a major emergency!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.chinese: 救！救！我！我被一堆战机糊脸了！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_call_underattac.english: Help! Help goddamit! I got fighters all over me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我不敢相信我们居然挺过来了。噢老天，我一直发抖停不下来，我觉得我心脏病要犯了。<大喘气> 好了，我现在好多了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I can't believe we made it. Oh god. I can't stop shaking. I think I might have a heart attack. <pause> Okay, I'm better now.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我...呃...我...操，刚才实在太险了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I, uh, I... shit that was close.
I don't know how I'm not dead.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我不能在这呆着了，我受不了了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I can't be out here anymore. I can't do it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.chinese: 我不知道怎么说...我猜我们活下来了，这真是个奇迹。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_bad_i.english: I don't even know where to start... I guess we're alive, so that's something...

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 谢谢谢谢。谢谢你救了我一条命。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Thank you, thank you. You totally saved my life there.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 他们跑了？就这？我们赢了？赢了！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: Are they gone? Is that it? Did we win? We won!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 我还活着！难以置信！<开怀大笑> 谢谢你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: I'm alive! I don't believe it! <relieved laughter> Thank you.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 我以为我死定了。你是救命恩人，是圣人，或者两个都是！我不清楚，但我还活着！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: I thought I was dead, for sure. You're a lifesaver! Or a saint! Or both! I don't know. I'm alive!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.chinese: 不敢相信我还活着，我以为我死定了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_good_.english: I can't believe I'm alive. I thought I was dead for sure.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 这点儿肯定不够，但算是救我一命的谢礼吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: It's not nearly enough, but here's something for saving my life.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 给你的一点儿小礼物，别拒绝，我认真的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: Here's a little something. Don't say no. I insist.
Take this. You've totally earned it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 不整那些口头感谢了，这些应该更能展现我的诚意。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: I can keep thanking you, but honestly I think this'll say it better.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.chinese: 你得拿上这些钱，我认真的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_fightover_offer.english: You have to take this. I insist.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: I'm not done yet. Give me a second.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 船还不能动，肯定还有其他东西坏了，我需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: I can't bring the ship online. Something else must be broken. I need more time.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.chinese: 我在干了！我在干了！再等一会儿！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_needmoretime_re.english: I'm working! I'm working! More time!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 我会给你钱的，怎么说？我全部的钱都在这儿了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: I'll pay you. How does that sound? Here's everything I've got.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 说吧，你要什么？钱？都给你，放我走吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: What'll it take? Credits? Here take them. Just let me go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.chinese: 什么你想要钱？好，我不在乎，都给你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_offerbribeforli.english: What, you want credits? Fine. I don't care. Here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerattacks_i.chinese: 见鬼，你跟他们是一伙儿的？！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerattacks_i.english: Holy shit! Are you one of them!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerfliestooc.chinese: 不觉得你离太近了吗，嗯？
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerfliestooc.english: Cutting it a little close there, huh?

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerfliestooc.chinese: 不好意思。你...那个...快要撞到我的船了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_playerfliestooc.english: Excuse me? You're... uh... gonna hit my ship.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 他们一直射我的话我是没法修好船的！把他们赶走！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: I can't fix the ship if they keep shooting me! Keep 'em off me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 日了，又一个系统下线了！能不能保护下我！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Goddammit! Another system down. How about some protection!

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.chinese: 给我点儿时间！我他妈怎么在一直受攻击的情况下修好船啊？
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_takingtoomuchda.english: Give me a second! How the hell am I supposed to fix this if we keep taking damage?

pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.chinese: 让我们赶紧离开这个鬼地方！
pu_genpilot5_cv_distress_urgentqtravel_l.english: Let's get the hell out of here!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.chinese: 等等...这就结束了？我们干死他们了？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_allshipsdestroyed.english: Wait... is it over? Did we get them?
Is that really all of them?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_002.english: Oh my god, help me, please.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_003.english: I'm gonna die. I'm gonna die.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.chinese: 我不能就这样死掉，做点儿什么吧！
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_004.english: I can't die like this. Do something!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdead_ig_005.english: Please don't let them kill me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.chinese: 对不起，我还在努力，应该很快就好了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_001.english: Sorry, I'm still working. I should be done soon.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_002.english: Just a couple more things to do.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_003.chinese: 马上就好了伙计们，抱歉花这么长时间。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_almostdone_ig_003.english: Almost there, everyone. Sorry it's taking so long.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.chinese: 很好，我们离下一站很近了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.english: All right. We're pretty close to our next stop.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_arriveatdest_ig_0.chinese: 这就是我们要去的地方。

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: So here's where you need to defend me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: OK，关键时刻到了，祝你旗开得胜。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: Okay, moment of truth. Good luck with the fight.
Time to do what you do.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.chinese: 不是他们死就是我们亡。我一般不推崇暴力，但是请一定干掉他们。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_encourageattack_i.english: It's us or them. I'm not a violent person typically, but please make sure it's them.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 额...他们看起来不太友好。
额...你好？额，看起来好像有敌人朝我们来了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Um... hello? It, uh, looks like we got company.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 卧槽，有，有好多船朝我们来了，速度很快。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: Oh shit. There's, um, some ships coming in really fast.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.chinese: 我扫描到一些东西...啊噢。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_ig_.english: I've got something on my scans... uh oh.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: No, no, no, there's more of them.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.chinese: 我靠，他们到底有多少人？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemiesarrive_mor.english: Oh come on. How many of them are there?
Look out! I got even more coming in.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_enemyshipdestroye.english: I told you not to mess with me!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: I gotta get out of here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 我得找点儿别的工作了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: I really need to find a new line of work.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 这也太可怕了，你保重吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: Well, that was horrifying. Take care.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.chinese: 你应该不需要我了吧？好。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_bad_ig_0.english: You don't need anything else from me, right? Good.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.chinese: 离别总是甜蜜的悲伤 <低声轻笑> OK，再见。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_farewell_good_ig_.english: Parting is such sweet sorrow <nervous chuckle> Okay, bye.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 你...呃...操他妈刚才太危险了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: You... uh... holy shit that was close.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 我...额...不是很...我真不太适应这种高强度战斗...嗯...
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: I... uh... don't really... I'm not really good with high intensity situations... yeah...

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 这...这也太可怕了！怎么会有人做这种工作？简直疯了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: That was... that was terrible! How can people choose this as a job? It's mental.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.chinese: 额，看来这能在医院里当谈资了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_bad_ig_.english: Well, that'll be something to talk about in therapy.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 这...这有点儿惊险。我得说，挺刺激的，但是很惊险。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: That was... that was crazy. A little exciting, I'll admit, but crazy.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 哇哦，刚才真紧张，对吧？我不太能适应这种...惊喜？让我休息下。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Wow. That was intense. Right? I'm not used to that kind of... excitement? Give me a second here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 我们甩掉他们了？我不太喜欢战斗...我心理承受不了...但刚刚那...哦，没事，刚刚那太可怕了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Did we lose them? I'm not usually into combat... my heart can't really take it... but that was... no, nevermind, that was terrifying.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 我只能说，这钱付得值。刚刚太精彩了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: Can I just say, you are worth every credit. That was... that was incredible.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.chinese: 感觉真棒！我算知道为啥会有人把这个当成工作了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_fightover_good_ig.english: What a rush? I can totally see how people can choose this as a job.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_friendlyfire_ig_0.english: Do I look like an outlaw?!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.chinese: 我不是故意的！我以为你是对面的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_friendlyfire_play.english: I didn't mean to do that! I thought you were one of them.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_friendlyshipdestr.english: Oh shit, that was one of ours.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_h.chinese: 嗨，你好。你是来做护航任务的，对吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_001_h.english: Hi. Hello. You're here for the escort job, right?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_002_e.chinese: 打扰了，你应该是我的护航者，对吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_002_e.english: Excuse me. Hi. Sorry to bug you, but I think you're my escort.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_003_h.english: Hi there. Hello. Thanks for showing up.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_w.chinese: 哦，你好啊，你肯定是我的保镖，我们去跳舞吗？ <轻笑声> 开玩笑的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_greeting_ig_004_w.english: Well, hello. You must be my escort. Shall we to the dance? <nervous laughter> I'm kidding.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: So, uh, do you mind keeping an eye out?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 要是有闲杂人等搞事，通知我，OK？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Let me know if we attract any unwanted attention, okay?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 我会有点儿忙，所以帮我注意着点儿，OK？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: Gonna be a little occupied with my work, so do me a favor and keep a lookout, okay?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 我干活儿的时候你要注意着点任何可疑的、危险的、不协调的地方。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: So, while I'm working, keep a look out for anything dangerous. Or suspicious. Or out of place.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.chinese: 好，我尽职尽责的保镖，是时候完成你的护卫使命了。<怪笑声>
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_keeplookout_ig_00.english: All right, my dutiful escort. Time to fulfill your escorting duty. <nervous laugh>

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_letsgo_ig_001_ith.chinese: 我觉得我们该走了，可以吗？对啊，应该我来决定，那走吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_letsgo_ig_001_ith.english: I think we should go, right? Sorry, that's my call. Let's go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_letsgo_urgent_ig_.english: Come on, come on. Let's go.
Let's get the hell out of here.
What are you waiting for? Run!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.english: Hell with it. I'm done with you!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_fir.chinese: 去他妈的，这活儿结束了。

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 我很抱歉，但是这效果太差了。我觉得我们最好就此分别吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: Look, I'm sorry, but this isn't working out. I think it's best if we just part ways.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 我很不想这么做，但是我要取消与你的合约了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: I hate to do this, but I'm cancelling your contract.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 我不知道发生了什么，但是你不太能做好这个，抱歉。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: I don't know what's happening with you, but I don't think you're in a place to focus on a job like this. I'm sorry.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 很抱歉，我尝试讲道理了，但是我也有底线。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: I'm sorry, I tried to be reasonable, but I have my limits.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.chinese: 就这样了，我不会付你钱的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_ig_.english: That's it. I'm not paying you.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.chinese: 这儿有点儿太热了，我不能再待了，你应该不会有事吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: It's just too hot. I can't stay here. You're okay, right?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.chinese: 我不能再做下去了，太不值了。抱歉。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_missionfailed_lea.english: I can't do it anymore. It's not worth it. I'm sorry.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我很抱歉，但是我们还不能走。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: I'm really sorry, but we can't leave yet.
It's just be a little bit longer. I'm so sorry.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 你能再坚持一会儿吗？正在解决最后一点儿小问题。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: Can you hang out for a bit? Just sorting some last minute issues out.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.chinese: 我还有点儿事没做完，稍放松一下，我们马上就走。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needasecond_ig_00.english: So I've got about a dozen things going on. Maybe relax for a second. I'm sorry. We'll be ready soon.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_004_o.chinese: 哦上帝啊，真主啊，快帮我。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_004_o.english: Oh god, oh god, help me please.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_005_w.chinese: 我付你钱是干啥的？！快帮我！
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needhelp_ig_005_w.english: What am I paying you for?! Help!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 新消息，我们还在干活儿，所以还得再等等。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Just wanted to give an update, we're still working, so it might be a little longer.
Gonna be just a little longer, okay?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 还在忙着呢，可能还得再等一会儿。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Still chugging away over here. Might need a little more time.
Just going to need some more time.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.chinese: 正在努力干活儿，好了我会通知你的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_ig_0.english: Still hard at work. I'll let you know when we've finished.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: I need a little more time.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 让他们滚开，ok？我需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Keep 'em off me, okay? I'm not done.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 我还没好！我还没好！我需要更多时间。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: I'm not ready! I'm not ready! I just need more time.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 多保护我一会儿，我们马上就好。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Protect me a little longer. We're nearly there.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.chinese: 再多一会儿！我们马上就完成了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_needmoretime_unde.english: Just another second! We've almost got it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playercollideship.english: I told you not to fly so close.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: Flying a little close, aren't ya?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 你是在炫耀你的精密飞行技术吗？我信了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: If you're trying to show off your precision flying, I believe you.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.chinese: 你可以停下了，你要撞上我了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerfliestooclo.english: You can stop now. You're going to hit me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 你是半路去恰饭了还是怎么着？开玩笑的，但是我们时间有点儿紧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Did you stop off for a meal or something? I'm just kidding, but we're kinda on a schedule here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 一切正常吗？怎么花了这么久才过来啊。算了，你来了就好。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: Is everything cool? It's just that you took a long time to get here. Anyway, you're here. Never mind.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.chinese: 虽然不是什么大事，但我们必须同时启动量子引擎。深空是很容易将我们打散的，你懂我意思吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_playerlatescoldin.english: It's no big deal, but we should just make sure we all quantum together. It's easy to get separated in the black, you know?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 请待机，我这就把量子目标点发给你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.english: Standby, I'm gonna send over the quantum travel coordinates.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_ig_00.chinese: 正在发送量子航行数据。

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 好的，移动中，这是我们的下一个兴趣点。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Okay, moving on. Here's our next POI.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.chinese: 准备好前往下一个坐标了？给你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtraveldest_next_.english: Ready for another travel point? Here you go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 待命，正在启动量子驱动器。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Stand by, spinning up quantum drive.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 准备好了？行，我们出发吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Everyone ready to go? Cool. Let's go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 好的，所有人，开始为量子驱动器充能。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Okay. Everybody start spooling your quantum drives.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.chinese: 所有人准备好，量子时间到。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_qtravelspooling_i.english: Everybody get ready. It's quantum time.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_001_.chinese: 嘿，又是我。我们准备好出发了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_001_.english: Hey, it's me again. We're all set to go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_002_.chinese: 你好？你准备好了吗？我好了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_002_.english: Hello? Hi. If you're ready, I'm ready.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_003_.chinese: 迟到了不好意思，我们可以走了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_003_.english: Sorry about the delay. We should be good to go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_004_.chinese: 好的，看样子我们准备好了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_004_.english: Okay. I think we're set here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_005_.chinese: 好了，一切正常，我们可以出发了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_readytogo_ig_005_.english: All right. All set. We can go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Let's head on back, shall we?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 看来完成了，我们回家吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: Looks like that's it. Let's head on home.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 我得到了我想要的了，总结一下吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: I've got what I need. We can wrap this up.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.chinese: 到这儿应该就没问题了，回起点吧。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_returntostart_ig_.english: I should be good from here. Let's head on back.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_startwork_ig_001_.english: All right . We're going to get started here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_startwork_ig_005_.english: Let's get this going, shall we?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.chinese: 你往哪儿跑呢？回来保护我。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_high_ig.english: Where are you going?! You gotta help me.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Would you be able to stay close?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 你觉得这很牛逼？靠近点，我谢谢你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: If it's cool with you, could you stick close? Thanks.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 不好意思，我需要你靠近一点。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Sorry, but I need you to keep a little closer than that.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.chinese: 不好意思，但你不能那样到处乱跑。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_stayclose_low_ig_.english: Excuse me, but you can't wander off like that.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_thanks_ig_001_tha.english: Thank you for all your help.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_underattack_high_.chinese: 救命！救命！让他们离我远点！

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_underattack_high_.english: Ahhh shit! They're all over me!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.chinese: 我中弹了！我天，我中弹了！
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_underattack_low_i.english: I'm hit! Oh god, I'm hit!
That one hit. That one hit!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 就是...我也不清楚。我们不能在这儿待下去了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: I just... I don't know. We can't wait any longer.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 对不起，我不知道他们在哪儿。这也太操蛋了。罢了。我们走吧好不好？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: I'm so sorry. I don't know where they are. This is really frustrating. Screw it. Let's just go, okay?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 我也不知道出了啥事儿，他们说他们会在这儿的，我觉得我们还是走吧，抱歉啊。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: So I don't know what's going on. They said they'd be here. I think we should probably go. Sorry about this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 那帮人也太不专业了。不好意思让你等这么久，我们走吧，那帮人是真的不专业。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: This is very unprofessional. I'm so sorry to keep you waiting. We'll head out. Very unprofessional.
