pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.chinese: 行吧，看来他们不来了。令人失望。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitedtoolong_ig_.english: Well, I guess they aren't coming. That's very disappointing.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: We're still waiting on some people.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 还有几艘船没来，在稍微等等，马上。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Waiting on a couple more ships. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 对不起，但是还有几艘船正在路上，不知道他们到哪里了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: Sorry, but there are still a couple ships coming. I wonder where they are...

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.chinese: 估计还要几分钟，还有几艘船在路上，真的不好意思。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_waitingforothers_.english: It might be a minute or two. There be a few more showing up. I'm sorry about this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Why are you doing this to me?!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 啥？你是那边的人吗？！付你钱的是我！
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: What, are you helping them?! I'm the one who's paying you!

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不是雇你来炸我船的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I'm not paying you to blow up my ship.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 嘿，我也不想逼你，但你必须回到任务上来。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hey, I hate to do this, but I'm gonna need you to get back on task.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我不知道你这工作是怎么干的，但我需要你干你的工作。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I don't want to tell you how to do your job, but I kinda need you to do your job.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我需要你开始认真工作。不然...不然我也不知道要咋办...我只能找别人了，好吗？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I need you to start taking this job seriously or... or I don't know... I'll just have to find someone else, okay?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 听着，我也不想像个老大一样发号施令，但你必须开始认真干活。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Look, I'm sorry to get all authoritative, but you have to start taking this job seriously.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 好好工作，别逼我整一些狠活儿，还有别以为我不敢。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: If you don't focus on the job, I'm going to have to do something drastic. And I will.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我说回来。不回来就炒了你。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I said come back. Come back or you're fired.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我需要你的帮助。如果你不过来的话，我就...我就不付款了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: I need your help here. Not over there. Help me or... or you don't get paid.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 不！你必须回来帮我。是我雇佣了你，我有权享受相应的服务！
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: No! You will get back here and help me. I am your employer and I demand to be treated as such.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 嘿，不好意思，我需要你离我的船近一点，这是工作内容，你懂我意思吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Hey, sorry. I kinda need you to stay close to my ship. Part of the job, you know?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 你去哪里？我和你一样爱到处探索，但工作优先。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: Where'd you go? I love exploring as much as the next guy, but we have a job to do.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.chinese: 我们需要你回来完成你的工作，好不好？能不能来和我们回合，先把活儿干完？
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_warningmissionfai.english: We need to get back to the job, okay? Could you please meet up so we can finish it?

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.chinese: 看起来大家状态都不错。
大家都在吗？<停顿> 哦哦，看来都在。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.english: Is that everybody? <long pause> Yeah, looks like it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.chinese: 嘿，大家，看来我们全部安全抵达了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_wereallhere_ig_00.english: Hi everyone, so I think we're all here.
That's the last one. Very exciting.
That should do it. All present and accounted for.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.chinese: 好的，完事儿了。谢谢你的等待。
pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_workfinished_ig_0.english: Okay. All done. Thanks for waiting.

pu_genpilot5_cv_escort_workfinished_unde.chinese: 我人要没了，我人要没了！

pu_genpilot5_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.chinese: 好的，听着，也许我们可以谈谈。
pu_genpilot5_cv_losingfrustration_ig_001.english: All right, look, maybe we can work something out.

pu_genpilot5_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.chinese: 不不不！这和我想的不一样啊。
pu_genpilot5_cv_losingfrustration_ig_002.english: No, no, no! It's not supposed to go down like this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_losingfrustration_ig_003.english: You... you're just making me angrier...

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.chinese: 你...你不会想掺和进来的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_001_.english: You... you don't want any part of this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.chinese: 给我圆润的滚远点儿，这是对你好。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_002_.english: If you know what's good for you, you'll get the hell out of here.

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.chinese: 掉头，离开，这儿的人你惹不起。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_003_.english: Turn around, fly away, this is trouble you don't want.

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.chinese: 滚远点，别让我说第二次。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_ig_005_.english: Drift on. I'm not gonna tell you twice.

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 这破事跟你没关系，滚去该干嘛干嘛。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: This is our garbage. Go find your own.
Don't even think about trying to horn in on our turf.

pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.chinese: 这儿是我们的地盘儿，而你...快滚。
pu_genpilot5_cv_mindyourbusiness_salvage.english: This here's our property. You just... screw off.

pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.chinese: 哦吼，你想这么玩儿是吧？
pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_002.english: Oh. That's how you want to play it?

pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_003.chinese: 好的，你...你他妈把老子惹火了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_003.english: That's it. You really... you really pissed me off now.

pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_004.chinese: 你...你不知道你惹了谁，兄弟。
pu_genpilot5_cv_playerattackfirst_ig_004.english: You just... you just poked a sleeping giant, my friend.

pu_genpilot5_cv_retreat_ig_002_fineforge.english: Fine, forget everything I said. We'll go.

pu_genpilot5_cv_retreat_ig_003_imsorryok.chinese: 我很抱歉！行了吧？我走就是了！

pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 我们找你很久了，你将会为你对我们的人做的事情付出代价。
pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: We been looking for you. You're gonna pay for what you did to our friend.

pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 你真以为你能把我们的人干掉以后还当做无事发生？想得美伙计。血债血偿，世道如此。
pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You thought you could take out a friend of ours and just walk away? Uh uh. Blood for blood. That's how this works.

pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.chinese: 就是你干掉了我们的人对吧？让我们来给你上一课吧，教教你犯了错误怎么补偿。
pu_genpilot5_cv_revengeposse_greeting_ig.english: You were the one who took down my friend. We're gonna show you how much of a mistake that was.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 你以为我会对你温柔一点？想得美。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: You thought I was gonna be easy. Didn't you?

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 我还以为赏金猎人都很牛逼呢。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: I thought bounty hunters were supposed to be tough.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.chinese: 伙计，看样子你挑错专业了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_bountyhunter_ig_00.english: Think you might've picked the wrong profession, friend.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_you.chinese: 这是你自找的，记住了吗？这是你自找的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_001_you.english: You wanted this. Remember? You wanted this.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_002_you.english: You had enough?! You had enough?!

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.chinese: 这是你逼我们的。如果你乖乖听话的话就没这么多事了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_003_you.english: You brought this on yourself. You could'a just done what we said.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_isa.chinese: 我说过了，你要付出代价。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_general_ig_005_isa.english: I said I was gonna make you pay.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_001_itoldy.chinese: 跟你说过了你惹错人了。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_001_itoldy.english: I told you we were dangerous.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_ohmygo.chinese: 我的老天，这可太漂亮了。有点悬，但很漂亮。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_003_ohmygo.english: Oh my god, that was beautiful. Unnerving, but beautiful.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_004_bowbef.chinese: 在我们庞大的舰队前屈服吧！

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_yousho.chinese: 我们给了你台阶下，你不听，不听，这就是不听的后果。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_kill_ig_005_yousho.english: You should've listened to us when we gave you an out. This is what you get when you don't listen.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: You wanted it, well you got it.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 给过你机会了，你应该跑的远远的。
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: You should've run away when you had the chance.
You want a fight? You got one.

pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.chinese: 你...你这是自找没趣，听到没？
pu_genpilot5_cv_taunt_warningattack_ig_0.english: You... you're about to pet a burning dog. You hear me?

pu_gensciv01_m_bsg_beg_forlife_kneel_ig_.chinese: 求求你不要，我求求你了。
我不会给你添麻烦的，求你了！
pu_gensciv01_m_bsg_beg_forlife_kneel_ig_.english: I won't give you any trouble. Please.

pu_gensciv01_m_bsg_runaway_forlife_fromh.english: Oh god. Oh god. Oh god.

pu_gensecr1_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.chinese: 这次巡逻我可是信了你才让你上，别给我掉链子。
pu_gensecr1_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.english: I went out on a limb trusting you for this patrol. Do not let me down.

pu_gensecr1_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.chinese: 别以为我忘了你上周那点破事，我可一直盯着你呢。

Enemy contact right of my position.

You got this, you got this.
Come on, come on, stay frosty.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_combat_reinforcementsar.chinese: 看看是谁终于现身了啊。

This isn't gonna end well for you.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_ig_00.english: Give up now and this'll go a lot easier!

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_ig_00.chinese: 只有疯子才会找条子交易。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_combat_taunt_high_ig_00.english: You gotta be out of your mind trading with a cop.

What idiot gave you a gun?

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_combat_taunt_shotsmiss_.english: You done playing yet? You ready to give up?

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.english: Look alive. We're definitely on to something.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.chinese: 大家小心点。可能有敌人。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.english: Look sharp people. Looks like we a possible hostile.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.english: Dispatch, potential hostile in area. Tracking now.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.chinese: 呼叫总台，我们可能找到了些东西。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.english: Be advised, Dispatch. We may have something here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_escalatesearch_.chinese: 可能与敌人接触。准备好。

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm_thre.english: Never mind. Was not a hostile.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm_thre.chinese: 呼叫总台，这里一切正常。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm_thre.english: Be advised, Dispatch. We're all clear here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_falsealarm_thre.chinese: 总台，我们这里一切正常。

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_hurston_taunt_s.english: This is Hurston Security, come out with your hands up.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_investigate_thr.chinese: 原地待命。我去检查一下。

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_investigate_thr.english: Stand by. I'm gonna check this out real quick.
Be advised. Looking into a disturbance.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_investigateorde.english: Take a look and see what it is.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.chinese: 找到任何踪迹了吗？妈的...
不知道啊。感觉他们应该不在了。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.english: I don't know. I think they're gone.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.chinese: 呼叫总台，已丢失可疑对象。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.english: Dispatch, be advised. Lost the suspect.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.chinese: 各单位注意。敌方仍然在逃。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.english: Be advised. Hostile is still at large.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.chinese: 可疑对象好像已经离开了。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_know.english: Suspect seems to have left the area.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_searchfail_thre.english: Where they hell did they go?

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: Come on. Let's hunt them down.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.chinese: 一定不能让他们跑掉，走！
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: Can't let them get away. Come on.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.chinese: 仍未发现目标。打起精神来，找到他们。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: Target's in the wind. Stay sharp and find them.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.chinese: 总台，未发现敌人。正在待命。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: Dispatch, don't have eyes on the hostile. Stand by.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.chinese: 各单位注意。敌人下落不明。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: Be advised. Hostile is unaccounted for.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.chinese: 我跟丢他们了。正在寻找可疑痕迹。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_not.english: I lost 'em. Starting a sweep to pick up the trail.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 疑似与嫌犯接触！正在追捕！
疑似发现敌人！正在追踪！
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Likely hostile threat detected! Tracking them now!

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 总台，这个区域可能有敌人。正在试图交火！
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Dispatch, we got likely enemies in area. Attempting to engage!

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 这里肯定有人。找到他们。
看起来像敌人。咱试试能不能把他们引出来。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Looks like hostiles. Let's see if we can flush 'em out.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 我们这边可能有敌情。睁大眼睛。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: We got a possible threat. Eyes open.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 总台。疑似发现敌情。正在调查。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Dispatch, possible threat detected. Taking a look.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 总台，正在搜索潜在敌人。请等待汇报。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Be advised, Dispatch, searching area for possible enemy. Will inform.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.chinese: 正在调查疑似威胁。做好准备。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearch_thr.english: Looking into a possible threat. Stand by.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 散开。我们一定要找到是谁干的。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Spread out. We need to find who did this.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 不论是谁干的，他肯定还没跑远。找到他们。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Who ever did this is probably still here. Find them.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 走。我们一定要找到罪魁祸首。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Come on. Let's find who's responsible.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 发现尸体。正在调查现场。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Body found. Searching the scene now.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 这里有一具尸体，开始搜查现场。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Got a corpse, here. Starting a sweep of the area.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.chinese: 总台，发现一具尸体。正在确定嫌犯位置。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_startsearchcorp.english: Dispatch. Got a body. Attempting to locate the suspect now.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost_high.english: The longer you hide, the worse it'll be for you.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost_high.chinese: 出来。别逼我亲自去找你。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_lost_high.english: Step out now. Don't make me come looking for you.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_searching.english: I know you're there. Come on out.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_searching.chinese: 如果有人在那里，慢慢走出来。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_hunting_taunt_searching.english: If someone's there, come out nice and slow.
Step out slowly with your hands up.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_relaxed_noticecorpse_th.english: Found a body. Hasn't been here long.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_relaxed_noticefriendlyt.english: Hostiles! They hit one of ours!

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisual_th.english: I think I saw something moving.

pu_gensecr2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisualres.chinese: 你看到了不存在的东西。
pu_gensecr2_m_cb_relaxed_noticevisualres.english: You're seeing things that aren't there.

Get the hell out of here.
Drift, all right? You aren't supposed to be here.
Sorry. you can't come through here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_confront_areaofflimits_.english: This area's for authorized personnel only.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_confront_loitering_warn.english: Clear out of here. There's no loitering.
What do you think you're doing? Move.
Get the hell out of here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_confront_loitering_warn.chinese: 不想今晚在医护站里住上的话，就给我走开。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_confront_loitering_warn.english: Unless you wanna spend the rest of the night in a medstation, I'd move.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 所有人都要被扫描，没有特例。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: Everybody's got to be scanned. No exceptions.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 准备好所有需要的证件准备让海关检查。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: Have all relevent information ready for inspection.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 别想从扫描仪底下藏匿任何违禁品。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: Do not attempt to sneak contraband past our scanners.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 我不管你是不是初犯，罪犯就是罪犯。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: We don't care if you're a first time offender. Criminals are criminals.
Just move through and keep your mouth shut.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 所有人都要接受扫描，抱歉。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: Everybody's got to get scanned. Sorry.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 做好被扫描的准备，配合我们，这样就可以速战速决。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: Have everything ready to be scanned and we can make this as painless as possible.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.chinese: 越早接受扫描，越早离开这里。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_customs_customsinstruct.english: The quicker you get scanned, the quicker you can get out of here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.english: I'm gonna need a clean-up crew dispatched.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.english: Dispatch, send a sanitation team to this position.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.chinese: 妈的。指挥，派一个清洁人员过来。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.english: Goddammit. Dispatch, send a clean-up crew.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.chinese: 需要一个卫生小队到我的位置来...该死的畜生。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.english: Need a sanitation team sent to my position... Goddamn animals.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.chinese: 指挥，我需要一个清理小队到这儿来。有傻逼在这里乱搞了一通。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_cleanuprequest_i.english: Dispatch, I need a clean up team on my position. Some idiots done a number over here.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_makeway_high_ig_.english: Security! Get out of the way!

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_makeway_neg_ig_0.english: Get the hell out of my way.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_nextarea_intocom.chinese: 正在前往下一个巡逻点。

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_statusupdate_int.english: Not too much action along the patrol route.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_statusupdate_int.chinese: 一切都在掌控中，不用担心我。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_statusupdate_int.english: Everything's under control. I don't need you checking up on me.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_statusupdate_int.chinese: 倒不是在抱怨什么，但咱这轮挺安静的。
到目前为止检查点都很安静。

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_ig_001.english: Stay sharp. There's a lot of crazies out today.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_ig_003.english: Got word that there's been some commotion in the next sector. Look out for any suspicious behavior.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.chinese: 集中注意，这附近有不少人渣废物。
一点建议，手指不要离开扳机，估计你今天需要扣几下它。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.english: Piece of advice, keep your trigger finger ready. You'll probably need it today.

pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.chinese: 不论是什么人，一旦过线，你必须当场把他撕成两半。不要犹豫，不然被撕成两半的就是你。
pu_gensecr2_m_cp_patrol_stayalert_neg_ig.english: Anyone steps out of line, you break them in half. Don't hesitate otherwise they'll do the same to you.

pu_gensecr3_m_cp_confront_areaofflimits_.chinese: 没有身份证明，任何人都不允许通过。
pu_gensecr3_m_cp_confront_areaofflimits_.english: Can't let anyone past without the right credentials.

pu_gensecr3_m_cp_confront_areaofflimits_.chinese: 这个区域被封锁了，快走。

What are you shooting at?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer.chinese: 你敢再犯的话我就不客气了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_aplayer.english: You push me, there's no turning back.
Final warning! Stand down!
Hold your fire! I won't say it again.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_heavyda.chinese: 收手，不然我再给你船上开个洞。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_heavyda.english: Stand down or I will not hesitate to do that again.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_heavyda.chinese: 这下你可能连飞直线都难了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_heavyda.english: You're gonna have a hard time flying straight after that.
All right. I'll give you that one.
Guess you got skills after all.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshi.chinese: 让我看看没了护盾你还能怎么办。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_damagedealt_lostshi.english: Let's see how you do without shields.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_3.chinese: 妈的，那群人本来今年就要退休了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_3.english: Damn it. They were gonna retire this year.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_3.chinese: 你只会让自己陷入更糟糕的境地。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 就剩你一个人了，投降吧。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: You're all alone now, give up.
There's no one left to save you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 只剩你一个了，希望你做足了觉悟。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: It's all you now. Hope you're ready.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 逮捕你是我的职责，而且我会履行它。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: It's my duty to bring you in, and I'm gonna do it.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 无论我们有多少人，你都休想逃走。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: Doesn't matter how many of us there are, you won't get away with this.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 我要是拿下你应该能得到嘉奖。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: I bet I get a medal for taking you down.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 他们不知道该何时投降，你呢？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: They didn't know when to quit. Do you?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 那是他们逼我的，你可以免受他们的下场。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: They forced my hand, you can be different.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 介意我打扰一下你们的小聚会么？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.english: Mind if we crash the party?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 我们没能达成共识该怎么办。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.english: Let's see if we can't settle this.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 看来我们到得正是时候。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_arrivingrein.english: Looks like we arrived just in time.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apl.chinese: 嘿！除非你有危险，不然别开火。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_missalot_apl.english: Hey! Don't fire unless you're under threat.
What's wrong? Do you need assistance?
What the hell are you shooting at?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_switchtohost.chinese: 我以干扰执法者的罪名逮捕你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_switchtohost.english: I'm arresting you for interfering with an officer of the law.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_switchtohost.chinese: 你觉得我们不是督导局你就能为所欲为了？你错了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_engage_switchtohost.english: You think cause we're not Advocacy you can just push us around? Think again.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aene.chinese: 你以为会有这么轻松么，嗯？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aene.english: You didn't think it was going to be that easy, did you?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aene.chinese: 看来你也不擅长射导弹啊。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_aene.english: Looks like you not good at launching missiles either.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.chinese: 你现在越是反抗，你的处境就会越艰难。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.english: The more you fight, the harder this is gonna be on you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.chinese: 随便你怎么躲，这事只会有一个结果。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.english: Dodge all you want. This is only ending one way.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.chinese: 这次你走运了，但运气总是会用完的。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_evaded_missile_apla.english: You got lucky that time, but it'll run out sooner or later.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_launched_missile_ae.chinese: 我们一般管这叫显摆武力。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_launched_missile_ae.english: This calls for a show of force.
This is what happens when you disobey the law.
You had to do this the hard way.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_launched_missile_ae.chinese: 让我们看看你到底有多大能耐。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_launched_missile_ae.english: Let's see how good you really are.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_launched_missile_ap.chinese: 你在把自己往火坑里推！

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_a.chinese: 你需要从这里让开，马上动。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_proximity_vehicle_a.english: You need to clear out of here, right now.
Get the hell out of my face!
You're interfering with an officer of the law.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_retreating_announce.chinese: 去他妈的，以后再来收拾你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_retreating_announce.english: Screw it. I'll bag you later.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_retreating_announce.chinese: 你以后会再见到我的，我保证。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_retreating_announce.english: I'll see you again. I promise.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_continue_.chinese: 你以为自己能逃脱法律的制裁？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_continue_.english: You can't hide from the law.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_continue_.chinese: 自己出来，别让我去找你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_continue_.english: Come out. Don't make me find you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_lostconta.english: Damn it! Where the hell did you go?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_lostconta.chinese: 无论你跑到哪儿，我们都能找到你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_searching_lostconta.english: Doesn't matter where you go. We will hunt you down.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.chinese: 你真以为你那帮狐朋狗友能救走你？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.english: You really think your idiot friends are gonna get you out of this?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.chinese: 我完全可以把你们全都抓起来。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.english: I'll arrest the whole lot of you if I have to.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.chinese: 无论你们有多少人，也无法逃脱正义的制裁。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_reinforceme.english: Doesn't matter how many of you there are. Justice will be served.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 逃犯们注意了，我受命来逮捕你们。乖乖就范，不要抵抗。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: Attention fugitives. I've been authorized to arrest the lot of you. Do not resist.
Attention suspects. You are all under arrest!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你们所有人都被控违反了当地法律，你们都被捕了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: You all have been charged with violating local law and are under arrest.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你他妈是从哪里冒出来的？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: Where the hell did you come from?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 根据法律赋予我的权力，你被捕了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: Under the authority granted to me, you are under arrest.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 请注意，逃犯。你因犯下罪行而遭到通缉。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: Attention fugitive. You are wanted for crimes commited.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.chinese: 由于你之前的犯罪行为，我有权扣押你和你的船只。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_aen.english: For criminal violations, I am hereby authorized to detain you and your vessel.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_pre.english: Bet you thought you gave us the slip!
You're not going to get away this time.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_pre.chinese: 只要你是个罪犯，我们就会追你到天涯海角。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_bs_spotted_vehicle_pre.english: As long as you're a criminal, we'll find you no matter where you go!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_arrest_initiate_aen.english: It's over. Taking them into custody.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 你知道我们追了你多久么？把你抓起来的感觉一定很棒。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: You have any idea how long we've been chasing you? Gonna be great to finally bring you down.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 你逃亡了这么久。但今天到此为止了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: You've been able to avoid punishment this long, but that ends now.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 不敢相信，你居然逃亡了这么久还没被捕。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: Can't believe you've evaded capture for this long.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 要是我能成功抓住你这条大鱼，大概每个人都会请我喝一杯。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: Everybody's gonna want to buy me a drink for netting a big fish like you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 没想到居然是我来抓捕你这个大魔头。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: Can't believe I'm gonna be the one to take down a big time criminal like you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.chinese: 不知道我会不会因为抓了你而升职加薪呢。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_bounty_want.english: Wonder if they'll promote me for bagging someone with your record?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_keepmoving_.english: Hey, let's keep it moving okay.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_keepmoving_.chinese: 请保持一个合理的速度离开该区域，谢谢配合。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_keepmoving_.english: Please maintain a reasonable speed and clear the area. Thank you.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_leavecombat.chinese: 这事关安保，抱歉我没法让你这样的平民插手。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_leavecombat.english: This is a secruity matter. I can't have civilians like you interfering.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_leavecombat.chinese: 嘿，飞行员！请即刻撤离这个区域。
一切都在控制中。但你最好离开这里。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_chatter_leavecombat.english: We got everything under control here. Best if you clear off.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 我去转移他们的注意力，请你尽快撤离这个区域。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: I'll distract 'em. Get out of here as soon as you can.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 一旦我吸引到他们的注意力，你就快离开这里，好吗？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: Once I have their attention, get out of here, okay?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 趁现在还安全，快离开交战区域。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: Leave the area of engagement as soon as you have a clear exit.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 听我指挥，我们就能活命。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: Follow my lead and we should both come out of this in one piece.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 尽管并不喜欢这个说，但我觉得我们得联手合作才行。找准时机开火，但请务必谨慎。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: Hate to say it, but I think we need to work together on this. Engage but be careful.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.chinese: 如果你觉得自己能打，可以来助我一臂之力。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_commentary_engagear.english: If you think you can fight, I could use the assist on this one.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.chinese: 这里是安保，看起来你需要帮助。坚持住，我们正在前往你的坐标。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.english: This is security. Saw you needed help. I'm heading to your location now. Just hang on.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.chinese: 你好，刚收到了你的求救信号，正赶往你的坐标。请坚持住，我马上就到。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.english: Hey, picked up your request for assistance. I'm traveling to your coordinates now. Hold on.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.chinese: 这里是安保，我们收到了你的求救信号，正在赶来的路上。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_confirms_help_distr.english: Security. Received the request for help. On my way now.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 这是最后一个坏家伙了。幸好我没来得太晚。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: That's the last of them. Glad I wasn't too late.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 敌人已全部解决，现在你应该安全了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: All clear. You should be safe now.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 看起来我们安全了。我觉得这些坏家伙一时半会应该没有闲工夫来骚扰你了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: Looks like we're clear. Don't think they'll be bothering you again anytime soon.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 我明白你想帮忙，但这事关安保。请不要插手。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: I know you meant well, but this is a security matter. Stand down.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 感谢帮助，但是下次这种事情请交给专业的来。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: Appreciate the help, but next time let the professionals handle it.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.chinese: 谢了。别有心理压力，他们活该。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_destroyed_vehicle_a.english: Thanks. And don't worry. They deserved it.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 抱歉，路上耽搁的时间有点长。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.english: Sorry it took me so long to get here.
Glad you were able to hang on.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 这里是安保部门。我们会尽快赶来。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.english: Security. Got here as soon as I could.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 嗨，我们收到了你的呼救。看到你没事真的是太好了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.english: Hey, got your message. Glad to see you're still hanging in.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.chinese: 这里是安保部门。已收到你的求助。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_arrivingrein.english: Security. Understand you need some assistance.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_complyfail_a.chinese: 我现在指控你拒绝服从执法命令。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_complyfail_a.english: You are hereby charged with failing to comply with a lawful order.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_complyfail_a.chinese: 到此为止了。我警告过你的。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.chinese: 这里是安保部门。看起来你需要帮助。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.english: Security. Looks like you could use some help.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.chinese: 我还以为是搞事的人来了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.english: I thought my scanners picked up some trouble.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.chinese: 要我帮你一起揍这些坏东西需吗？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_engage_switchtoally.english: You need a hand with these bastards?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tpla.chinese: 总之，我得回去巡逻了。一路顺风。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tpla.english: All right, I have to head back on patrol. Safe flying.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tpla.chinese: 好的，那我先走一步。注意安全。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_farewell_aally_tpla.english: Okay, I'll leave you to it. Be safe out there.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_crimi.chinese: 请注意，我们将会以“驾驶注册在已知罪犯名下的载具”的罪名逮捕你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_crimi.english: Attention. You are under arrest for piloting a vehicle owned by a known criminal.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_crimi.chinese: 请注意，驾驶员。你所驾驶的载具注册在一个重罪通缉犯名下。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_crimi.english: Attention pilot, your vessel is registered to a wanted felon.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_fines.chinese: 根据法律赋予我的执法权，我将以“未按时缴纳罚款”的罪名逮捕你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_fines.english: Under the civic authority granted to me, you are hereby under arrest for failure to pay your outstanding fines.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_fines.chinese: 在此通知您，因为你拖欠罚款，我们已经发布了针对你的悬赏。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_fines.english: I'm hereby informing you that a warrant for your arrest has been issued for dereliction of monetary payments.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_noreg.chinese: 你因“未出示载具注册标签”的罪名而被逮捕。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_noreg.english: You are under arrest for failure to broadcast your regtag.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_noreg.chinese: 你的载具未显示注册标签，我们将立刻依法逮捕你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_noreg.english: Your ship is not broadcasting a regtag, this is a criminal offense punishable by immediate arrest.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_stole.chinese: 我们将以“持有被盗载具”的罪名逮捕你！
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_stole.english: You are under arrest for the possession of a stolen vehicle!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_stole.chinese: 你被逮捕了，大聪明！你不会真觉得没人发现你开着偷来的船吧？
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_arrest_stole.english: You're under arrest, hot shot! Did you really think you could get away with flying a stolen vehicle?

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_clearafterre.chinese: 完事了。你可以走了，下次别再让我们逮到你。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_clearafterre.english: We're done here. Move along and don't let us catching you trying anything like this again.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_clearafterre.chinese: 好的，这样就没事了。你可以走了，但请你洁身自好。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_clearafterre.english: Okay. That's settled. You can go, but watch yourself.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_almo.chinese: 我快到了，你再坚持一小会儿就好。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_almo.english: I'm almost there. You just need to hang on a little bit longer now.
Hey, I'm getting close. Stand by.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_almo.chinese: 这里是安保部门。我快到了，再撑一下就好。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_almo.english: Security. I'm nearly there. Just keep hanging on.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.chinese: 跟你说一下最新情况。我还在路上，正尽快赶来。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.english: Wanted to check in and give you update. Still en route. I'll be there as soon as I can.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.chinese: 喂，我还在路上，一定要撑住。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.english: Hey, I'm still making my way to you. Do what you have to and hold out as long as you can.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.chinese: 这里是安保部门。离你的坐标还有一半航程，增援马上就到。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_enroute_gett.english: This is security. I'm about halfway to your coordinates. Assistance is on its way.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_finegenmisde.chinese: 侦测到你的违法行为，现在处以罚款。务必及时缴纳罚金。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_finegenmisde.english: An infraction of the local law has been detected and a fine is hereby issued. See that it gets paid.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_finegenmisde.chinese: 根据扫描结果，我将对你处以正式罚款。请尽快缴纳罚金。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_finegenmisde.english: According to the results of these scans, I am hereby issuing a formal fine. Please pay it as soon as possible.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineillegalc.chinese: 根据本地法律，我将没收这些违禁物品，同时你将会因为持有这些违禁物品而被处以罚款。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineillegalc.english: Under local statutes, I'm confiscating these illegal items and you are being issued a fine for possession.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineillegalc.chinese: 你因为持有违禁物品而被处以罚款，同时我们会没收这些违禁货物。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineillegalc.english: You are hereby issued a fine for possession and your illegal cargo confiscated.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 我在你的记录上看到了未缴纳的罚款。你可以走了，但是请尽快补缴。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: I'm seeing that you've got an outstanding fines on your record. You can go, but I need you to pay that ASAP.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 看起来你还有罚款未缴齐。请务必尽快补缴。没什么其他事了，你可以走了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: Seems like you got fines that you still need to pay. You should take care of that as soon as you're able. Go on, get out of here.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 这艘船的成员中有人未按时缴纳罚款。请尽快补清罚款，快走吧。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: I'm seeing that individuals onboard have outstanding fines. Make sure those get taken care of ASAP. Get out of here.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 这艘船的成员中有人未按时缴纳罚款。这次我先放过你们，但请尽快补请罚金。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: There are individuals aboard that have fines to pay. I'll let you go this time, but those should be taken care of as soon as possible.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 这艘船的成员中有人未按时缴纳罚款。你们最好尽快前往最近的安保终端补缴。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: I'm seeing here that you have outstanding fines. You're gonna want to go to the nearest security center and take care of that right away.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.chinese: 正在查阅你的记录，你有数笔未缴纳的罚款。请及时补缴以避免不必要的麻烦。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoutstand.english: Looking at your record, you owe some outstanding fines. Save yourself some trouble and go get that squared away with security as soon as you can.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoverdue_.chinese: 一点微小的提醒。如果你继续把罚款当耳边风的话，这事就不止是钱能摆平的了。答应我，多一事不如少一事，好吗。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_fineoverdue_.english: Bit of advice. You put off paying your fines any longer, and it's going to become a bigger problem than a few creds. Take care of it, all right.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_reinforcemen.chinese: 通信已恢复。正在呼叫增援。
通信已恢复。我叫点增援过来。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_reinforcemen.english: Comms restored. Let me get some help down here.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.chinese: 我们在你的船上检测到了管制物品。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.chinese: 请注意。我们在你的船上检测到了管制物品。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.english: Looks like you have some stolen goods aboard. Nothing better than catching a thief red handed.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.english: Attention. We have detected individuals with active crimestats aboard your vessel.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.english: Attention. The transport of wanted criminals through UEE space is a crime.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.chinese: 在逃罪犯注意，你已经被我们发现了。准备好接受正义的铁拳吧。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.english: Attention, wanted criminal. We know you have an active crimestat. Prepare to be dealt with accordingly.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_c.chinese: 在逃罪犯注意，你已经被我们发现了。准备好接受正义的铁拳吧。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.english: Attention. A scan of your cargo shows that you are attempting to tranport controlled substances which is a crime.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.chinese: 请注意。我们在你的船上检测到了大量管制物品。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.english: Attention. Large amounts of controlled substances have been found aboard your vessel.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.chinese: 我们刚刚扫描了你的货舱，检测到你在运输非法管制品。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.chinese: 我们在你船上检测到了大量管制品。运输这些物品是违法行为。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.english: Woah, quite the haul here. Look at all these stolen goods. That's not gonna stand.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.chinese: 请注意。我们检测到这艘船上运有赃物。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_scanresult_t.english: Attention. This vessel has been found to be trafficking stolen goods.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_shipscanallc.chinese: 好的，一切正常。你可以走了。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_shipscanallc.chinese: 好的。感谢配合。你可以走了。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_inform_shipscanallc.english: Okay. Thanks. You're clear to proceed.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_ceasecombat_a.chinese: 请立即停火并离开当前空域，否则我们将会采取强制措施。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_ceasecombat_a.english: Cease combat at once and vacate the area or you will be arrested.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_ceasecombat_a.chinese: 注意，我命令你立刻停火。请立刻离开当前空域，否则我会采取强制措施。

最后警告。如果你继续一意孤行，我将采取强制措施。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 这里是安保部门！不许动！
这是最后警告。立刻停下，否则我们将采取强制措施。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.english: This is your final warning. Come to a complete stop or we will be forced to take action.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 最后警告。请你立刻停下载具，否则我们将采取强制措施。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.english: Last chance. Stop your vehicle now or else.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 请注意，请立即停下载具并接受扫描检查。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.english: Attention, please come to an immediate halt and hold for your vessel to be scanned.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 请注意，我将依法扫描你的载具以确保安全。请停下载具并保持静止。

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 我再说一遍，请立即停下载具并接受扫描检查，否则你将被逮捕。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.english: I repeat, bring your vessel to an immediate halt and submit to a scan or you will be arrested.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.chinese: 驾驶员，这是必要的检查。请立即停下载具，否则你将被逮捕。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_holdposition_.english: Pilot, this scan is compulsory. You will be arrested if you do not bring your vehicle to an immediate halt.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 请停下你的载具并保持静止。如果你不配合，我将依法使用致命武力。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Power down your ship and remain stationary. I am authorized to use deadly force if you fail to comply.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 请立刻停下并保持原地不动！如果你不配合，我将依法使用致命武力。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: I need you to power down, right now and remain where you are. Failure to comply will result in the use of deadly force.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 请停下你的载具并留在原地。我将在必要时采取致命武力。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Power down your vessel, immediately and remain still. We will use deadly force if necessary.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 最后警告。请立即停下你的载具，否则我将开火！
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Last warning. Power down your vehicle now or I will open fire!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 最后警告。你如果再不停下，我将不得不开火！
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Last chance. Power down your vehicle or else I will be forced to fire!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 最后警告！立即停下！勿谓言之不预。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: For the last time! Power down! Don't make me do something you're gonna regret here.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 请停下你的载具并留在原地。任何多余的行为都会被认定为袭警。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Power down your vessel and hold your position. Any further action will be seen as hostile.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 请停下你的载具并留在原地，否则我将采取强制措施。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Power down and halt or I will be forced to take action.

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 你还有机会停下并投降，我们会宽容对待！
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: It's not too late. You can still power down and surrender!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.chinese: 趁你还有机会，快投降吧！拜托了！
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_order_powerdown_aen.english: Surrender while you still can! Please! Power down!

pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_requests_help_comms.chinese: 还好你来了。通讯一直被干扰，这种情况下我根本没办法叫支援。
pu_gsecrpilot01_m_ca_requests_help_comms.english: Good thing you're here. Comms are being jammed and I can't get any additional support till they're back online.

pu_hawker4_sk_inspecting_ig_007_awyoudbe.chinese: 哦傻子才不下手买这个。
pu_hawker4_sk_inspecting_ig_007_awyoudbe.english: Ah you'd be a fool not to buy that.

pu_hawker4_sk_knockstuff_ig_004_youbreak.chinese: 你要弄坏了，你就得买了。
pu_hawker4_sk_knockstuff_ig_004_youbreak.english: You break it, you buy it!

pu_hawker4_sk_knockstuff_ig_005_heythati.english: Hey! That is it! Get out of here!

pu_hawker4_sk_knockstuff_ig_006_idontwan.chinese: 你这种人在这里不受欢迎。走，滚出去！
pu_hawker4_sk_knockstuff_ig_006_idontwan.english: I don't want your kind in here. Go on. Get out!

pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_001_thatisall.chinese: 这些就行了？没别的想买的了？
pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_001_thatisall.english: That is all? Sure I can't interest you anything else?

pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_002_ahyesvery.chinese: 哦，棒极了，眼光不错，选了好东西。
pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_002_ahyesvery.english: Oh yeah, very good choice. Very good.

pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_004_youknowyou.chinese: 要知道，以这么夸张的低价卖你几乎跟白给没区别了。不过卖都卖了。
pu_hawker4_sk_purchase_ig_004_youknowyou.english: You know, you are basically robbing me this price is so good, but a deal is a deal.

pu_hawker4_sk_termdirection_ig_001_there.chinese: 那儿有个便民终端，就那里。
pu_hawker4_sk_termdirection_ig_001_there.english: There's a terminal for your convenience, right over there.

pu_hawker4_sk_termdirection_ig_002_ifyou.chinese: 如果你需要，那儿有个终端。
pu_hawker4_sk_termdirection_ig_002_ifyou.english: If you need it, the terminal is right there.

pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nobuy_ig_001_your.english: You're passing on the deal of the century.

pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nobuy_ig_004_allr.chinese: 罢了，回头再见，你知道在哪儿找我。
pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nobuy_ig_004_allr.english: All right some other time then. You know where to find me.

pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nostop_ig_001_you.chinese: 我打包票你会后悔没停下来看看。
pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nostop_ig_001_you.english: You'll regret not stopping. Trust me.

pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nostop_ig_002_non.chinese: 没时间停下来看看吗？一点时间都没有？

pu_hawker4_sk_walkpast_nostop_ig_004_ohc.english: Oh come on. Not even a peek inside?

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: <气得直冒火>我真不敢相信你居然敢接了任务又甩手不干。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: <bristling with anger> I can't believe you have the gall to take a job and then abandon it.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: 别再干这种事了。我需要能靠得住的人。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: Don't ever do this again. I need people I can depend on.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: 我是卡迈克尔。你有责任完成你接下的合约，这既是对你自己的承诺，也是对赫斯顿和我的承诺。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: Carmichael here. You have an obligation to Hurston and to me to finish a contract you accept.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿的卡迈克尔。承包商不兑现承诺是绝对不能接受的。要么把事情搞清楚，要么去找别的工作。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: This is Carmichael from Hurston. It is unacceptable for contractors to not deliver what was promised. Get your shit in order or find another line of work.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: 什么鬼...那个合约再简单不过了。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: What the hell… that contract couldn't have been any easier.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.chinese: 真让人难以置信。赫斯顿对承包商的要求可比这高多了。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm.english: I can't believe it. Hurston demands better from its contractors.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggiverewa.chinese: 嘿，这里是赫斯顿。刚刚得到消息，上面批准了一笔奖金，算是给你点动力。我们希望你拿到奖金后能更卖力地干活。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggiverewa.english: Hey, this is Hurston again. Just got word that the higher ups approved a bonus to help keep you motivated. We expect you to work even harder after this.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 我是卡迈克尔。赫斯顿真的需要抓紧时间追上进度了。你已经拿到了合约的细节，赶紧去完成吧。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: This is Carmichael. Hurston really needs to make up some ground. You have the contract parameters, so get this done.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 这里是卡迈克尔。拿上你需要的东西，赶紧出发。赫斯顿需要你完成这个任务，好让我们重回正轨。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: Carmichael here. Grab what you need and get out there. Hurston needs this done to get back in this race.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 承包商关系部呼叫。成功完成这个合约将帮助赫斯顿重新回到竞争中。请一定要全力以赴。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: Contractor Relations calling. Successfully completing this contract will help get Hurston back into this race. Be sure you give it your full attention.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿动力。我看到你已经接受了这个合约。所有你需要的信息都在你的 mobi 里了，赶紧去搞定吧。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: This is Hurston Dynamics. I see you accepted this contract. Everything you need is in your mobi. Get it done.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 我是卡迈克尔。你已经拿到了详细信息。赫斯顿非常感谢你的努力和认真。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: Carmichael here. You have the details. Hurston appreciates your diligence.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 我是卡迈克尔。赫斯顿未来的辉煌就靠你了。请按时完成分配的任务喔。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: This is Carmichael. Hurston's continuing greatness relies on you. Please complete the task as assigned and on time.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 所以你就是我们的承包商啊……行吧。你知道要做什么，赶紧开始吧。赫斯顿必须得赢下这场。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: So you're our contractor... Fine. You know what needs to be done, so let's get to it. Hurston needs to win this thing.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 卡迈克尔呼叫。这事得快点处理，而且得按规矩来。绝不能在我负责的时候出任何差错。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: Carmichael calling. Need this taken care fast and by the numbers. Can't have any losses on my watch.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 赫斯顿需要这个任务尽快完成。确保你准备好了所有东西，然后赶紧搞定它。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: Hurston needs this job done quickly. Make sure you have everything you need and take care of it.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.chinese: 我是赫斯顿的卡迈克尔。我会监督你的工作。我不想听任何借口，只管完成任务就行。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona.english: This is Carmichael with Hurston. I will be supervising you. I don't want any excuses, just get this done.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 赫斯顿呼叫。货物应该已经安全送达了。我的上司对这次的工作非常满意。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Hurston calling. Cargo should be arriving safely. My supervisor was pleased with our work on this.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 刚刚收到消息，货物已经顺利通过了。干得漂亮！我会把这记为一次胜利。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Just got word that cargo got through. Well done. I'll put this down as a win.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 运输部门刚发来通讯，说货物已经在路上了。我的上司听到我解决了那个问题，非常满意。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Shipping just commed to say that the cargo is on its way. My supervisor was pleased to hear I resolved that situation.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 太好了，这是个胜利。我会确保这次记录在案。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Great, that's a win. I'll make sure this gets logged.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 刚刚收到消息，你已经交了那份合约。这应该能帮助赫斯顿占点优势。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Just got word you turned in that contract. That should help Hurston gain some ground.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 正在检查你的交付清单。看起来不错。我会把这个推进到工资发放流程。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Checking your turn-in manifest. Looks good. I'll push this through payroll.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 看到你的交付记录了。交付过程可以再高效一点，不过赢了就是赢了。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Saw your delivery come through. Could have been a little more efficient on your delivery, but a win's a win.

pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.chinese: 我是卡迈克尔。已经记录了你的合约交付。我会把它标记为赫斯顿的一次胜利。
pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc.english: Carmichael here. Logged your contract delivery. I'll mark it down as a win for Hurston.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。我们特此将你的服务终止，立即生效。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: This is Hurston Security. We are hereby terminating your services, effective immediately.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 注意，干员。这里是赫斯顿安保。我们不在需要你的服务。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: Attention, operator. This is Hurston Security. Your services will no longer be required.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.chinese: 这里是你的赫斯顿安保联络员。我前来通知你，由于你近期的行为，我们将终止你的雇佣状态。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_.english: This is your liason with Hurston Security. I'm calling to notify you that due to recent behavior, we are terminating your employment status.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_badper.chinese: 这里是你的赫斯顿安保代表。由于你最近的表现我们已做出决定，你已不再适合继续在公司工作。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_badper.english: This is your rep with Hurston Security. Due to your recent performance, we have decided that you are unfit to continue your current employment with the company.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_badper.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。在你多次违反条款协议后，我们将终止与你的合约。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_badper.english: Hurston Security here. After numerous violations of the terms of your agreement, we're terminating your contract.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_breaks.chinese: 注意，干员。由于你最近的犯罪等级，赫斯顿动力公司不得不终止与你的合约。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_breaks.english: Attention, operator. Due to your recent crime stat, Hurston Dynamics is forced to cancel their contract with you.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_inform_mission_statu.chinese: 这里是你在赫斯顿安保的代表。你现在的效率在可接受范围内，请保持。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_inform_mission_statu.english: This is your Hurston Security rep. You have been operating at an acceptable work efficiency level. Maintain this progress through the completion of the mission.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。既然你已经被包扎好了，你应尽快回到并完成现有的合约。谢谢。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.english: Hurston Security here. Now that you've been patched up, you should get back to completing your active contract. Thank you.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.chinese: 你好，承包商。这里是赫斯顿安保。既然你已经得到了足够的医疗照顾，是时候完成你现有的合约了。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.english: Hello, contractor. This is Hurston Security. Now that you have received adequate medical attention, it is time to complete your current contract.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。我们得知你已经康复了，既然如此，你没有理由不完成你现有的合约。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa.english: This is Hurston Security. We've heard you're back on your feet, so you have no reason to not complete your active contract.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall.chinese: 这里是你在赫斯顿安保的代表。感谢你及时的送达了违禁品，尽你的本分消除了赫斯顿的犯罪。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall.english: This is your Hurston Security Rep. Thank you for promptly delivering the contraband and doing your part to eliminate criminality in Hurston.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 这里是你的赫斯顿安保代表，你正在偏离你的任务路径。请你回到既定路线，完成我们雇你做的工作。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: This is your Hurston Security rep, you are diverting from the appropriate mission path. Please get back on track and complete the job we hired you for.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。你似乎偏离了既定的任务路径。我不确定你要干嘛，但是请回来做任务，现在就回来！
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: This is Hurston Security. You appear to deviating from the prescribed mission path. I don't know what you're doing, but get back on task. Now.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 注意，干员。你违反了任务要求。请回到正轨，否则你将受到惩罚。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Attention, operator. You are violating the requirements of your mission brief. Get back on track or you will be disciplined.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。你正在违反任务协定，我需要你回来继续执行任务。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: This is Hurston Security calling. You're breaking mission protocol right now, so I need you to get back on mission.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 注意，这里是赫斯顿安保。这是你重返任务的最后机会，否则我们将终止与你的合约。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Attention. This is Hurston Security. This is your last chance to get back on mission or we will terminate our contract with you.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 听着，承包商。你即将因玩忽职守而面临处罚。请回去执行任务。我不会再说第二遍。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Listen here, contractor. You are dangerously close to facing executive action for dereliction of duty. Get back on mission. I won't say it again.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。你正在违反任务条约。回到任务，干员。这是最后通牒。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: This is Hurston Security. You are violating the mission parameters. Get back on task, operator. This is your final warning.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 这里是赫斯顿安保。你需要回去执行任务。我不会再警告你了。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: This is Hurston Security. You need to get back on mission. I'm not going to warn you again.

pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.chinese: 注意，这里是你的赫斯顿安保代理人。你仍在违反规定的任务协议。这是你回到正轨前的最后警告。
pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_warn_missionarea_aba.english: Attention. This is your rep with Hurston Security. You are still violating the prescribed mission protocols. This is your final warning to get back on track.

pu_hurston_mg_busy_ig_001_imsorrythis.chinese: 抱歉，现在可不是好时机。
pu_hurston_mg_busy_ig_001_imsorrythis.english: I'm sorry. This isn't a great time.

pu_hurston_mg_busy_ig_002_imneckdeep.chinese: 我已经忙得不可开交了。我没时间跟你说话。
pu_hurston_mg_busy_ig_002_imneckdeep.english: I'm neck deep in requisition orders. I don't have time to talk.

pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission.chinese: 好了，好了，我这就给你找文件。
pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission.english: Okay, great. I'll just assign you to the case file.

pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission.chinese: 听起来不错，让我确认一下你的资料...好了。
pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission.english: Sounds good. Let me just validate tag you... there we go.

pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissio.chinese: 嗯，行，我猜这就是你的决定了。
pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissio.english: Um. Sure. It's your call I guess.

pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissio.chinese: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，告诉我。
pu_hurston_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissio.english: All right, well, let me know if you change your mind.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_00.chinese: 我知道我们过去有过分歧，主要还是因为你引起的，但我愿意给你一个挽回自己的机会。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_00.english: I know we've had our differences in the past. Mostly on your end, but I'm willing to give you a chance to redeem yourself.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_00.chinese: 阿奇博尔德·赫斯顿(Archibald Hurston)曾经说过，“上级必须教导工人变得卓越，”所以我决定以儆人教，再给你一次机会。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_00.english: Archibald Hurston once said that "the workers must be taught excellence by their betters," so I've decided to lead by example and give you another chance.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001.chinese: 请尽快到我在交易所的办公室来。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001.english: Please report to my office in Transfers as soon as possible.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_002.chinese: 到我的办公室来，我们可以谈谈。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_002.english: Come by my office and we can talk.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_0.chinese: 就是这样，谢谢你的帮助。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_0.english: That's that. Thank you for your help.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_0.chinese: 看来我们处理完所有事了，谢谢。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_0.english: Looks like we're all set. Thanks.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_ir.chinese: 我最近看到了一个很适合你的合约。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_ir.english: I recently came across a contract that would be perfect for you.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_iw.chinese: 我查看了一些待处理的工作，我想可能有一个适合你来做，如果你有时间的话。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_iw.english: I was looking through open jobs and think I might have found one for you. If you have the time.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_001_i.english: I'll put through the approval for your payment.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002_i.chinese: 我会把酬款请求提交给系统的。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002_i.english: I'll get your payment into the system.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.chinese: 没办法了，我对你好声好气，这是你自找的，我已经以偷窃的罪名悬赏了你。
pu_hurston_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.english: That's it. I tried to be nice, but you brought this on yourself. I've placed a bounty on you for theft.

pu_hurston_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.chinese: 在多次要求归还赫斯顿的财产后，我有义务向有关部门报告此事。

pu_ikticaptain_cru_f_mc_death_gp_001,p.english: They got the drop on us... The whole thing… it was…

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 从2541开始庆祝的不败舰队周，让公众们有机会一睹UEE海军舰队最新最好的装备。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: Celebrated since 2541, Invictus gives the public an opportunity to see the latest and greatest additions to the UEE Navy fleet.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 使命、传统、服务。在UEE海军中生活就是为了给所有爱的人打造一个更好的宇宙。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: Duty. Tradition. Service. A life in the UEE Navy is about building a better universe for your loved ones.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 从内到外近距离参观你最爱制造商的飞船。详情请查看日程表安排。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: Get an inside look at some of your favorite manufacturers' ships. Check the daily schedule for directions.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 海军希望感谢我们的私人以及企业合作伙伴，将今年的不败舰队周办成有史以来最棒的一届。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: The Navy would like to thank our private and corporate partners for making this year's Invictus the best yet.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 想看看主力舰上的生活是什么样的吗？今年的不败舰队周将为大家提供这样一个罕见的机会，亲自探索一艘现役标枪驱逐舰的内部。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: Ever want to see what life is like aboard a capital ship? This year's Invictus is offering a rare opportunity to explore an active duty Javelin destroyer.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.chinese: 参加不败舰队周，感谢所有过去、现在以及未来的海军将士们为保卫帝国的忠诚付出。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_.english: While at Invictus, take a moment to honor all Naval starmen, past, present and future, for faithfully defending the Empire.
The UEE Navy. United in Purpose.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_welcome_invictus_2.chinese: 欢迎来到2951不败舰队周展览会场。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_welcome_invictus_2.english: Hello and welcome to the 2951 Invictus Expo Hall.

pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_welcome_invictus_i.chinese: 欢迎来到不败舰队周展览会场。
pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_welcome_invictus_i.english: Hello and welcome to the Invictus Expo Hall.

pu_iongreet01_ad_greeting_v_bg_003,p.chinese: 欢迎来到IO北塔。这里是18区首屈一指的商业发展中心。如需帮助或租赁咨询，请联系我们的任何一位工作人员。
pu_iongreet01_ad_greeting_v_bg_003,p.english: Welcome to Io-North tower. Area18's premier center for business development. Please consult any of our associates for help or rental opportunities.

pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_deaththroe_gp_001.chinese: 等等，等一下，等一下 [尖叫]

pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.chinese: 我倒是说你应该加入冰碛帮，但我觉得你还没那个本事。
pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.english: I'd say you should join up with the Moraine, but I don't think you've got what it takes.

pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.chinese: 你是个战士，嗯哼？你胆子可比那些在民联当安保的软蛋强多了。
pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.english: You're a fighter, huh? Got more spirit than most of the PA wimps they have running security.

pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.chinese: 当初有机会跑的时候，你就该跑了。
pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3combattaun.english: You should've run when you had the chance.

pu_isaac_mor_m_cmb_rbmmission3needhelp_g.english: Hey, I need some help here!

pu_isaac_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3intransitco.chinese: 那我该怎么办？我又不能就这么回来。
pu_isaac_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3intransitco.english: So what am I supposed to do? It's not like I can just come back.

pu_isaac_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3moraineambu.chinese: 你就是雷科派来的人？我喜欢你的船...希望我们别把它打得太烂。
pu_isaac_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3moraineambu.english: So you're the one Recco sent, huh? I like your ship... Hopefully we won't damage it too much.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_alert_trespass_ig_001.english: Security has been dispatched. Stand down

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_alert_trespass_ig_002.chinese: 你已违反UEE法律，不许动，安保人员正在赶来。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_alert_trespass_ig_002.english: You are in violation of UEE law. Stand by. Security are en route.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_alert_trespass_ig_003.chinese: 发现未授权人员，已派出安保。

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_begin_tour_ig_001_att.chinese: 请注意，UEES战锤号已向公众开放。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_begin_tour_ig_001_att.english: Attention, the UEES War Hammer is now open to the public.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.chinese: 你好，各位不败舰队周参访者，我们即将结束参观，请移步至出口处。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.english: Hello all Invictus attendees, we're closing down the tours, so please start making your way to the exit

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.chinese: 这是一则全舰通告，本日的参观即将结束，请移步至出口处，谢谢。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.english: This is a ship-wide announcement, we will be wrapping up tours for the day. Please start heading to the exit. Thank you.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.chinese: 各位民众请注意。本日的参观活动即将结束。请前往出口处，并祝你不败舰队周愉快。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.english: Attention, civilians. We are ending the tours for the day. Please make your way to the exit and have a great Invictus.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.chinese: 至所有不败舰队周参访者，UEES战锤号参观即将结束；谢谢。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_almost_tos.english: To all Invictus attendees, tours of the UEES War Hammer will be ending soon. Thank you.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.chinese: 本舰已禁止未授权民众进入，如果你仍错留在船上，请立即离开。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.english: This ship is now off limits to unauthorized members of the public. If you have remained on board in error, you must vacate immediately.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.chinese: 注意，民众参观已经结束；请立刻离开本舰。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.english: Attention, civilian tours are now over. Please vacate the ship immediately.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.chinese: 战锤号现已禁止平民登舰，若你还未离开，请尽速离开舰船。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_toshi.english: The War Hammer is now off-limits to civilians. If you haven't already, please exit the ship immediately.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_tosta.chinese: 感谢各位参与今年的不败舰队周，但UEES 战锤号目前已结束参观。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_close_tour_done_tosta.english: Thanks to everyone who came out to support this year's Invictus, but the UEES War Hammer is now closed for tours.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 请注意，各位不败舰队周参访者，提醒各位，一艘孟加拉级航母：UEES巴巴里号，正在接近本站。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention, Invictus attendees, just wanted to give you a head's up that a Bengal carrier, the UEES Barbary, is currently inbound to this station.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 请注意，作为舰队周活动的一部分，UEES战锤号即将停靠本站。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention. The UEES War Hammer is en route to this station as part of the Invictus festivities.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_barb.chinese: 请注意，巴巴里号航母即将启航离开，如果想看的话请抓紧了。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_barb.english: Attention, the Barbary carrier will be departing soon in case any of you were planning to take a look.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_barb.chinese: 抱歉打扰各位，如果想一睹孟加拉级航母的话请抓紧了，这艘战舰即将启航离开。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_barb.english: Excuse the interruption, but if anyone was interested in taking a look at the Bengal carrier, you should go now. It's about to depart.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_warh.chinese: UEES战锤号即将出发，感谢各位参访者，祝大家不败舰队周愉快。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_departure_warh.english: The UEES War Hammer is ready to disembark. Thank you to all our attendees and enjoy your Invictus.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.chinese: 大家请注意，如果你还没有见过的话，可以观看停靠本站的孟加拉级航母。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.english: Attention all, if you haven't had a chance, you should check out the Bengal carrier that's docked at the station.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.chinese: 舰队周活动参访者们请注意了，之前提到的UEES巴巴里号航母现已停靠本站。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.english: Attention Invictus attendees, the UEES Barbary Bengal carrier I mentioned earlier has docked at the station.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_w.chinese: UEES战锤号现已对接，即将开放参观。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_done_w.english: The UEES War Hammer has now docked and will be open for tours soon.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 请注意，刚收到消息称孟加拉级航母巴巴里号正在接近中，感兴趣的话就快准备吧。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Attention, I just received word that the Bengal carrier Barbary is on approach for those interested.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 抱歉打扰各位，UEES巴巴里号航母现已抵达本空间站附近，感兴趣的话可以前去观看。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Sorry for the interruption, but the UEES Barbary carrier has arrived outside the station for any of you interested in taking a look.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: UEES战锤号即将完成对接，进一步消息敬请等待。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: The UEES War Hammer will be docking momentarily. Stand by for further updates.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_flyby_barbary_.chinese: 大家好，我是战锤号通讯官，为各位带来最新资讯。一艘孟加拉级航母目前正在本空间站外巡航，感兴趣的话可以前去观看。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_flyby_barbary_.english: Hello everyone. This is the War Hammer's comms officer with an update. A Bengal carrier is currently passing the station for anyone interested in taking a look.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_trespass_done_.chinese: 擅闯者已被控制，正在移交当地政府。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_inform_trespass_done_.english: Trespassers have been secured. Transfering to local authorities.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_001_.chinese: 最后警告，所有留在舰上的未授权人士都将被逮捕。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_001_.english: This is a final warning. Anyone still on board without authorization will be arrested.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_002_.chinese: 请注意，本舰已经实施军事封锁，所有擅闯者都将被逮捕。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_002_.english: Attention. This ship has entered a military lockdown. Any trespassers will be arrested on sight.

pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_003_.chinese: 舰队周活动参观者请注意，继续留在舰上将违反UEE海军安保规程。
pu_javcoff01_f_lpa_warn_trespass_ig_003_.english: Attention Invictus attendees, if you are still on board, you are in violation of UEE Navy security protocols.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_cap_ig_001.chinese: 目前，想参观现役海军主力舰内部的可以进入参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_cap_ig_001.english: Tours are now available for anyone interested in seeing the inside of an active Navy capital ship.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_idr_ig_001.chinese: 请注意，我们正式开放伊德里斯的参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_idr_ig_001.english: Attention, we're officially opening tours of the Idris.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_jav_ig_001.chinese: 请注意，我们正式对公众开放标枪的参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_jav_ig_001.english: Attention, tours of the Javelin are now open to the public.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_pol_ig_001.chinese: 各位请注意，我们即将开始北极星的不败舰队周之旅。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_begin_tour_pol_ig_001.english: Attention everyone, we're starting Invictus tours of the Polaris.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_cap.chinese: 所有不败舰队周参访者请注意，飞船参观即将结束；谢谢。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_cap.english: Attention Invictus attendees, they will be shutting down our ship tours soon. Thank you.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_idr.chinese: 至所有不败舰队周参访者，伊德里斯参观即将结束；谢谢。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_idr.english: To all Invictus attendees, they will be shutting down tours of the Idris soon. Thank you.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_jav.chinese: 至所有不败舰队周参访者，标枪参观即将结束；谢谢。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_jav.english: To all Invictus attendees, tours of the Javelin will be ending soon. Thank you.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_pol.chinese: 至所有不败舰队周参访者，北极星之旅即将结束；谢谢。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_almost_pol.english: To all Invictus attendees, Polaris tours will be ending soon. Thank you.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_cap_i.chinese: 感谢各位参与今年的不败舰队周，但参观目前已结束。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_cap_i.english: Thanks to everyone who came out to support this year's Invictus, but tours are now closed.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_idr_i.chinese: 感谢各位参与今年的不败舰队周，但伊德里斯目前已结束参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_idr_i.english: Thanks to everyone who came out to support this year's Invictus, but the Idris tours are now closed.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_jav_i.chinese: 感谢各位参与今年的不败舰队周，但标枪目前已结束参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_jav_i.english: Thanks to everyone who came out to support this year's Invictus, but the Javelin tours are now closed.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_pol_i.chinese: 请注意，北极星参观现已关闭。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_close_tour_done_pol_i.english: Just a quick announcement that the Polaris tours are now closed.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 舰队周活动参访者们请注意了，一艘孟加拉级航母正在路上，我会持续为您更新它的动态。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention Invictus attendees, there's a Bengal carrier on its way in. I will keep you updated as it gets closer.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 通知，一艘孟加拉级航母正在驶向本站，当它靠近时我会通知你的，谢谢，祝你生活愉快。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: I just wanted to notify you that a Bengal carrier is on approach to this station. I'll let you know when it gets closer. Thank you and enjoy your day.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 请注意，作为今年活动的一部分，一艘UEE海军的主力舰正在前往本站。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention. As part of this year's festivities, a UEE Navy capital ship is heading to this station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.chinese: 请注意，作为今年活动的一部分，一艘UEE海军的伊德里斯正在前往本站。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention. As part of this year's festivities, a UEE Navy Idris is heading to this station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_arrival_inprog.english: Attention. As part of this year's festivities, we've got a UEE Navy Polaris heading to the station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_ben_.english: Excuse the interruption, but if you're interested in checking out the Bengal carrier, you should go now. It's about to depart.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_ben_.chinese: 大家好，这是最后的机会一睹停靠本空间站的孟加拉级航母。他们即将启航离开。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_ben_.english: Hello everyone. Last chance to check out the Bengal carrier that's docked with the station. They're going to be moving on shortly.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_cap_.chinese: 海军的飞船即将启程离开，任何想要参观的人请加紧时间，好好享受不败舰队周吧。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_cap_.english: The Navy ship is about to depart for anyone who'd like to take a look. Enjoy your Invictus.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_idr_.chinese: 请注意，伊德里斯即将离开。船员们希望我向所有与会者表示感谢，希望你们在不败舰队周中玩得愉快。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_idr_.english: The Idris is about to depart if you're interested. The crew wanted me to thank all the attendees and hope you enjoy your Invictus.
