pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_jav_.english: The Javelin is ready to disembark. Thank you to all our attendees and enjoy your Invictus.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_pol_.chinese: 北极星即将出发，如果想一睹北极星的话请抓紧了。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_departure_pol_.english: The Polaris is about to disembark for anyone interested in watching.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.chinese: 大家请注意，如果你还没有见过的话，可以观看停靠本站的孟加拉级航母。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.english: Attention all, if you haven't had a chance, you should check out the Bengal carrier that's docked at the station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.chinese: 舰队周活动参访者们请注意了，之前提到的孟加拉级航母现已停靠本站。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.english: Attention Invictus attendees, the Bengal carrier I mentioned earlier has docked at the station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.chinese: 给您带来了来自孟加拉级航母的最新消息。他们现已对接本空间站，感兴趣的话可以前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_b.english: I just wanted to relay an update from that Bengal carrier. They have docked with the station in case any of you would like to have a look.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_c.chinese: 海军的飞船现已抵达，即将开放参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_c.english: The Navy ship has arrived and will be open for tours soon.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_i.chinese: 伊德里斯现已对接，即将开放参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_i.english: The Idris has now docked and will be open for tours soon.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_j.chinese: 标枪现已对接，即将开放参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_j.english: The Javelin has now docked and will be open for tours soon.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_p.chinese: 北极星现已抵达，即将开放参观。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_done_p.english: The Polaris has arrived and will be open for tours soon.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 请注意，孟加拉级航母正在接近中，感兴趣的话就快准备吧。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Attention, the Bengal carrier is on approach for those interested.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 抱歉打扰各位，孟加拉航母现已抵达本空间站附近，感兴趣的话可以前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Sorry for the interruption, but the Bengal is now outside the station for anyone interested in taking a look.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 即刻通告：海军的飞船很快就要对接了，我会持续为你们更新最新消息。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Quick announcement, the Navy ship will be docking soon. I'll keep you updated.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 即刻通告：伊德里斯正在进行最终的进近，很快就要对接了。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Quick announcement, the Idris is on its final approach and will be docking soon.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 标枪即将完成对接，进一步消息敬请等待。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: The Javelin will be docking momentarily. Stand by for further updates.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.chinese: 即刻通告：北极星即将抵达。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_docking_inprog.english: Quick announcement, the Polaris will arrive shortly.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.chinese: 请注意，感兴趣的话，一艘孟加拉级航母目前正在本空间站外巡航。如果你没有见过，强烈建议前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.english: Attention, for those of you interested, a Bengal carrier is currently passing the station. If you haven't seen one before, I highly recommend taking a look.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.chinese: 请注意，各位不败舰队周参访者，我们得知了一艘孟加拉级航母目前正在本空间站外巡航。建议你们在它经过之前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.english: Attention Invictus attendees, we've got a Bengal carrier currently passing the station. I invite you to check it out before it passes.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.chinese: 大家好，为各位带来最新资讯。一艘孟加拉级航母目前正在本空间站外巡航，感兴趣的话可以前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_ben_ig_0.english: Hello everyone. Have an update. There's a Bengal carrier currently passing the station for those interested.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.chinese: 请注意，各位不败舰队周参访者，我们得知了一艘海军的主力舰目前正在本空间站外巡航。建议你们在它经过之前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.english: Attention Invictus attendees, we've got a Navy capital ship doing a fly-by of the station if you're interested.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.chinese: 常规通告：我们得知了一艘海军的飞船目前正在本空间站外巡航。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.english: General announcement, we've got a Naval ship currently passing the station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.chinese: 大家好，如果你在窗户旁，你将会看到一艘海军的主力舰经过本站。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_cap_ig_0.english: Hello everyone. If you're near a window, you should see a Navy capital ship passing the station.

pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_pol_ig_0.chinese: 参访者们请注意，我们得知一艘现役的北极星目前正在本空间站外巡航。建议你们在它经过之前去观看。
pu_javcoff02_m_lpa_inform_flyby_pol_ig_0.english: Attention attendees, we've got an active-duty Polaris doing a fly-by of the station, if you're interested.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_innerring_trespass_alert.chinese: 请注意：你出现在这里违反了十字军法律，已通知安保部队，请关闭载具电源并等候他们到来。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_innerring_trespass_alert.english: Attention: Your presence is a violation of Crusader law. Security forces have been notified. Power down your vehicle and await their arrival.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_innerring_trespass_warni.chinese: 警告：这里仅供受到许可的十字军安保人员通过。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_innerring_trespass_warni.english: Warning: Only authorized Crusader Security Personnel are allowed beyond this point.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_outerring_stationclosed_.chinese: 请注意，加利亚安保空间站此时处于关闭状态。请与其他的十字军安保设施寻求帮助。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_outerring_stationclosed_.english: Please be advised, Security Post Kareah is currently closed. Please seek assistance at another Crusader Security Facility.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_outerring_stationclosed_.chinese: 加利亚安保空间站此时处于关闭状态。如果你需要紧急帮助，请在紧急通讯网络中发送呼救。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_outerring_stationclosed_.english: Security Post Kareah is closed. If you are in need of emergency assistance, please alert the ECN.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_station_trespass_alerted.chinese: 请注意：你未受获准进入本站点，已通知十字军安保。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_station_trespass_alerted.english: Attention: You are unauthorized to enter this station. Crusader Security has been notified.

pu_kareah1_m_sy_station_welcome_ig_001_o.chinese: 我谨代表十字军安保感谢您对加利亚安保空间站的访问，一路平安。
pu_kareah1_m_sy_station_welcome_ig_001_o.english: On behalf of Crusader Security, thank you for visiting Security Post Kareah. Safe travels.

pu_kepler_mor_m_df_rbmmission3combattaun.chinese: 我看你还是去投奔冰碛帮吧，不过我觉得你根本没那么硬气。
pu_kepler_mor_m_df_rbmmission3combattaun.english: I'd say you should join up with the Moraine, but I don't think you've got what it takes.

pu_kepler_mor_m_df_rbmmission3combattaun.chinese: 你是个战士，对吧。比那些在安保岗位上混日子的和平联盟软蛋有骨气多了。
pu_kepler_mor_m_df_rbmmission3combattaun.english: You're a fighter, huh? Got more spirit than most of the PA wimps they have running security.
You should've run when you had the chance.

pu_kepler_mor_m_df_rbmmission3needhelp_g.english: Hey, I need some help here!

pu_kepler_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3intransitc.chinese: 那我还能干啥？我又不能原路返回。
pu_kepler_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3intransitc.english: So what am I supposed to do? It's not like I can just come back.

pu_kepler_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3moraineamb.chinese: 所以你就是雷科派来的那个？我喜欢你的飞船...希望我们不会把它弄得太破。
pu_kepler_mor_m_mc_rbmmission3moraineamb.english: So you're the one Recco sent, huh? I like your ship... Hopefully we won't damage it too much.

pu_klim_mg_busy_ig_001_hitmeup.chinese: 待会再来找我吧，我现在不方便说话。
pu_klim_mg_busy_ig_001_hitmeup.english: Hit me up later. I can't talk right now.

pu_klim_mg_busy_ig_002_gotthingsto.chinese: 抱歉我还有事儿要干，而且应该没有聊天这一项。
pu_klim_mg_busy_ig_002_gotthingsto.english: Got things to do, posito. Talkin' ain't one of them, I'm afraid.

pu_klim_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission_ig.chinese: 很好， 这正是我想听到的。
pu_klim_mg_chosen_playeracceptmission_ig.english: Ay, posito. That's what I like to hear.

pu_klim_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_i.chinese: 这很酷，自由的宇宙和一切。

pu_klim_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_o.chinese: 如果你改变了主意，找我就好。
pu_klim_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_o.english: Hit me up if you change your mind.

pu_klim_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_o.chinese: 这活应该这一段时间都能干，所以你可以再考虑一下。
pu_klim_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemission_o.english: Job might stick for a bit, so feel free to reconsider.

pu_klim_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_001_w.chinese: 你好我是华莱士，真希望我在打给你之前好好看看我脑子抽没抽，但是我实在是需要人来帮忙。希望上次我们聊完后你已经提高了你的水平。
pu_klim_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_001_w.english: Wallace here. I should have my goddamn head examined calling you up, but I need a hand. Hopefully you've upped your game since we last talked.

pu_klim_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001_co.chinese: 到店里来，我给你补补课。
pu_klim_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_001_co.english: Come by the shop and I'll fill you in.

pu_klim_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_002_sw.chinese: 下次你到附近的时候，记得来这一下。
pu_klim_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_002_sw.english: Swing on by next time you touch down.

pu_klim_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_002_.chinese: 你可真他娘的是个奇迹缔造者，合作愉快。
pu_klim_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_002_.english: You're a goddamn miracle worker, posito.

pu_klim_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_heypo.chinese: 嗨伙计，我这有些你可能感兴趣的新活。
pu_klim_mg_comms_newmission_ig_001_heypo.english: Hey, posito. Might have something for you.

pu_klim_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_heyit.chinese: 嘿，这里是华莱士，我这又有新活了。
pu_klim_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_heyit.english: Hey. It's Wallace. Got something that needs doing.

pu_klim_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_001_ills.chinese: 我会把钱打到你的账户里。
pu_klim_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_001_ills.english: I'll shift the creds to your account.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_failbounty_.chinese: 你知道么，如果你不给我把东西带回来，我就给你发个新任务，名叫“逃脱追杀”。祝好运。
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_failbounty_.english: Tell you what. If you're not gonna bring my stuff back then I've got a new job for you. It's called "Evade the Murderers." Good luck.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_failbounty_.chinese: 你搞砸了，想把我的东西据为己有？准备受死吧。
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_failbounty_.english: You fucked up now. Want to keep my property? Then get ready to defend it with your life.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarning.chinese: 我最后说一遍，把我的货带回来。
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarning.english: This is the last time I'm gonna say it. Bring my shit back.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarning.chinese: 我不会把这话再说一遍，把我的货给我。
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarning.english: I'm not going to tell you again. I want my stuff.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder_ig.chinese: 我想要回我的货物，如果你现在把他带回来，我们可以还可以把它归结为一个不幸的小失误。
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder_ig.english: I want my cargo. You bring it back and we can chalk this up to an unfortunate mistake.

pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder_ig.chinese: 把我的货带回来，现在就带回来！
pu_klim_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder_ig.english: Bring my property back to me. Now.

pu_klim_mg_convorejoin_ig_001_whatthehel.english: What the hell was I saying...

pu_klim_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_greatyoure.chinese: 棒，你回来了...我们说到哪了来着...哦，对。
pu_klim_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_greatyoure.english: Great. You're back. I don't even remember where I was... oh, yeah.

pu_klim_mg_decide_encouragelookanddecide.chinese: 看一眼吧，看完之后我想知道你怎么打算。
pu_klim_mg_decide_encouragelookanddecide.english: Check it out. Let me know what you think.

pu_klim_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_001_.english: Hell with it. I'll find someone else.

pu_klim_mg_decide_warningmissiontimeout_.chinese: 如果你做好决定的话，随时都可以来。
pu_klim_mg_decide_warningmissiontimeout_.english: Any time you'd like to make a decision.

pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_criminalrep_ig.chinese: 等等...我听说过你...是的...人们经常谈起你，据称你是个挺调皮的人。我是华莱士，很高兴见到你。
pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_criminalrep_ig.english: Wait... I've heard about you...yeah... people talk about you. Word is you're quite the naughty one. I'm Wallace. Great to meet you.

pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.chinese: 妈的，抱歉。有一些怪人来这里寻找救济品。
pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.english: Shit, sorry. We get weirdos wandering down here looking for handouts.

pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.chinese: 我是华莱士，很高兴见到你。是的，他说他给自己找了一些新的人才。
pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.english: My name's Wallace. Great to meet you. Yeah, he said that he'd hooked himself up with some new talent.

pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.chinese: 那就走吧，这儿可不是什么停留的好地方。
pu_klim_mg_intro_dontknow_workforeither_.english: Then drift. This ain't a goddamn hangout.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_chemcomple.chinese: 谢谢你的化学品，就当这是一个长期订单吧，如果你能搞到更多这玩意，我照单全收。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_chemcomple.english: Thanks for those chemicals. Consider it a standing offer, if you get your hands on any more while on the drift, I'll always buy it.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.chinese: 这次发生什么了？你以前干的挺不错的啊...
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.english: What happened on that last job? You were doing so good...

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.chinese: 这次工作挺难的是不是？别担心，我们这儿最好的人以前也碰到过这情况，不要让它再次发生就好。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.english: Tough break on that last run. Don't sweat it. Happens to the best of us. Just don't let it happen again...

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 提高你的能力，伙计。我可不给外行人机会。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.english: Up your game, posito. I don't give gigs to amateurs.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 有人跟我说我的批评需要更有建设性，那就让我看看吧。你让我挺失望的，不要再搞成这样了。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.english: I had a guy tell me that I needed to be more constructive in my criticism, so let's give it a whirl, you failed me. Don't do it again.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 你又搞砸了一份工作...啊我开始逐渐习惯这么说了，这有点让人不爽。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.english: Youve screwed up another job... I'm getting so used to saying that, it's a little upsetting.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 事态不总是向你想的方向发展，是不？
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.english: Things just haven't been going your way, have they?

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.chinese: 你觉得我会再雇你一次给你一个机会？在经历过这些事之后？去你的，我只想要那些你也抽过的东西。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.english: You think I'm gonna hire you again? After all that? Shit, I want what you've been smoking.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.chinese: 不，他妈的不，我再也不会雇你去干哪怕任何一件小事。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.english: Oh, hell no. I ain't hiring you for a goddamn thing.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_ig_.chinese: 我不知道你是怎么做到让机会这样从你手中溜走的。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_ig_.english: I don't know how you could let the stuff slip away from you like that.
Don't ever lose my shit again.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.chinese: 我勒个去，你...你可真是猛兽，这次工作做的太棒了。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.english: Holy shit. You... you are a beast. Helluva job on that last run.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.chinese: 你这次工作表现的漂亮利索。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.english: That was some flash work on that last job.
You did good on that last run.
Nice job on that last one.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.chinese: 绝佳的表现！我一个又一个的给你发任务，你一个又一个完美地完成了它们。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.english: Helluva streak. I keep giving you jobs, you keep knocking them down.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.chinese: 上次的工作在你的账面上又添了一笔成功，你无人能挡。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.english: That last job makes another success for the books. You can't be stopped.

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.chinese: 我们都有不足，都会遇到一些不尽如人意的事情，我理解。但是，去搞砸别人的工作别搞砸我的，好吗？
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.english: We all have bad patches. All have runs that don't pan out the way we want them to. I get it. I do. But screw up other peoples' jobs. Not mine. Clear?

pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.chinese: 你得集中精力，听到了吗？有成队的人在等着取代你的位置并且他们可不会想着把活儿搞砸。
pu_klim_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.english: You gotta focus. You hear me? I got people lining up to take these jobs and not screw them up.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_001_.chinese: 是，这是很糟，但是我得把工作继续下去，改天再找活儿补偿你。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_001_.english: Yeah, look. It sucks, but I gotta pull the job. I'll make it up to you some other time.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_002_.chinese: 看起来这活儿得自己把自己干完了。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_002_.english: Looks like the job kinda took care of itself.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_greatj.chinese: 干的很棒，你是这儿的明星。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_greatj.english: Great job. You're a goddamn rock star.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_itstoo.chinese: 现在已经太晚了，下次如果你无法完成任务，一开始就不要接它。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_itstoo.english: It's too late now. Next time, if you can't pull off a job, don't take it.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_002_y.chinese: 能听见么？这里是华莱士。

pu_klim_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_001_g.chinese: 有一些更多的信息给你。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_001_g.english: Got some more info for you.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_002_m.chinese: 可能有一些小细节需要调整。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_002_m.english: Might need to make a tiny change on that gig.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_001_.english: That's a bullshit play right there.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_002_.chinese: 啥玩意儿？你说你要中途退出？退出？！？！
pu_klim_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_002_.english: What do you mean you quit? You quit?!

pu_klim_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_002.chinese: 谢谢你把数据发过来，正在查看。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_002.english: Thanks for the data. Checking it now.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_001.chinese: 时间不多了，让我们快点去把活儿干完吧。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_001.english: Time's getting tight. Let's get a move on.

pu_klim_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_002.chinese: 有什么事么？我的人还在等着。
pu_klim_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_002.english: What's the holdup? I got people waiting.

pu_klim_mg_mission_farewell_missionaccep.chinese: 走吧，离开这去干你该干的事情，事情办好时叫我一声。
pu_klim_mg_mission_farewell_missionaccep.english: Go on. Get out of here. Let me know when it's done.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_001_.chinese: 让我们去把事情做好吧。

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_ig.english: Ain't got nothing to say to you.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_ig.chinese: 听不懂吗？合作关系已经结束了。
pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_ig.english: You really don't learn, do you? We're done.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.english: What are you doing here? Go.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.chinese: 嘿，你帮我干活，我期望着你去把事情好好的干完，而不是在那闲逛。
pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.english: Hey, you work for me, I expect you to get shit done. Not hang around here.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 我已经把任务详情告诉你了，照办就好。
pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: I gave you the drop off details. Follow them.

pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 这什么玩意？这鬼地方看着像交货点么？
pu_klim_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: What the hell is this? Does this look like a goddamn drop off point?

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_generic_.chinese: 你需要去帮我揍个人，我会把时间，地点，人名，以及其他你需要的信息都提供给你。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_generic_.english: I need you to hit someone. I'll provide all the data. Names, locations, et cetera.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_generic_.chinese: 这有几个憨憨想在我的地盘上撒野，我需要给他们一个警示。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_generic_.english: Got some idiots trying to make a move on some of my territory. I'd like to send a little message.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.chinese: 我帮你把清单列好了，留意一点，别在该出手的时候犹豫。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.english: Got a wish list for you, keep an eye out and snag it if you find it.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.chinese: 我找到了一点我会需要的东西，不要在意手段，把他们拿过来就好。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.english: Got some stuff I need. Don't care how you get it. Just get it.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.chinese: 我需要人去帮我取个货。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.english: I need someone to pick up a few things.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.chinese: 我们的一些补给品快没库存了，迫切需要一些进货。这活儿应该不难。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.english: I'm running low on some supplies and could use a re-up. Easy stuff.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_investi.chinese: 远方有一个残骸，里面有一些我们可能会感兴趣的东西。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_investi.english: There's some wreckage on the drift with some potentially interesting salvage.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pirates.chinese: 还有个事儿，那可不会只有一个人，他们可不乐意和你一起分享。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pirates.english: One more thing. Odds are, you won't alone out there and whoever you find won't want to share.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pirates.chinese: 警惕一点，你可能遇到一些不怎么友好的家伙。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pirates.english: Keep an eye open though, you might run into some unfriendly types.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.chinese: 你想接的话，我这有个送快递的差事。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.english: There's a delivery run if you want it.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.chinese: 我需要一些货物需要运输，只要保持低调这个活儿就应该不难。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.english: I have some product that needs to be dropped off. Keep a low profile and it shouldn't be a problem.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.chinese: 事情是这样的，这有个小的接送活。把货放下，把货拿走，就这么轻松。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.english: Here's the deal. Gonna need a little drop-off, pick-up action. You give, you take. Simple.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.chinese: 我这有个需要被寄出去和取回的快件清单。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.english: Got a list of things I need picked up and dropped off.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_timed_i.chinese: 我需要一个快递服务，当日达那种。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_timed_i.english: I need some product delivered in a hurry.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_timed_i.chinese: 这个快件要加急，你得在时间到之前把它送到。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_timed_i.english: This one comes with a clock. You'll have to make the drop before the deadline.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.chinese: 我这有些头等快件，需要额外保护的那种。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.english: I got a shipment loaded with some primo haul that's gonna need some protection.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.chinese: 经历了这些冲突之后，我感觉有个大人物已经盯上我了，我需要一些人帮我护航并且确保这些货到达他们该到的地方。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.english: With all the clashes, I feel like I've got a big target on my back. I need someone to go along and make sure this batch gets to where it's going.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.chinese: 我们有个货船需要护航。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_drugs_ig.english: Got a haul that needs an escort.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.chinese: 有传言称有人要来我的航线上搞事情，因此我需要一个人和一些额外的武装来帮我留意着点。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.english: Word is some people have been making noise about roughing up my routes. I'd like an extra set of eyes and guns out there.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.chinese: 那里的状况正在变糟，所以我需要一些额外的保护。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.english: Things are heating up out there and I need some extra protection on my ships.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passenge.chinese: 喜欢当司机么？我有个同事需要搭车。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passenge.english: Feel like playing chauffeur? Associate of mine needs a lift.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_raid_ig_.chinese: 我们正在组件一个小型突击队，你的一些技能可能会很有用。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_raid_ig_.english: Putting together a little raiding party and could use some of your skills.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_raid_ig_.chinese: 我找到了是谁袭击了我的船队，所以我派了一队人去送他们进棺材，我需要你去支援他们。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_raid_ig_.english: Found out who knocked over some of my ships, so I'm sending a crew to knock them down. Permanently. I want you to back them up.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_rivals_i.chinese: 听说这星系里有个杀手团体，是那些奥托尼黑帮的人渣组建起来的。我需要一些额外的人手来留意他们。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_escort_rivals_i.english: Heard there was a hit team in system, compliments of those Otoni Group scumbags. I need some extra muscle to keep an eye out for them.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.chinese: 是这样，我这有个挺难的活儿需要高手来处理，来的人必须得是专家。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.english: Here's the deal, I got something cooking that needs a surefire, no-doubt pro to handle.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.chinese: 如果你有空的话，我需要你这样一个专家来帮我们完成一些高端业务。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.english: If you got the time, I need a pro to take care of some high level business for me.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.chinese: 有个活儿需要人来帮我干点事，如果你能帮忙的话就再好不过了。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.english: It'd be great if you could help me out. Got a job that needs some doing.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_002_.chinese: 有个活儿引起了我的注意，我觉得它应该挺合你胃口的。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_002_.english: A job's come to my attention, think it might be a good fit for you.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 抱歉伙计，今天华莱士·克里姆职业介绍所暂时歇业。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Sorry, posito, the Wallace Klim Employment Office is closed for the day.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 现在暂时没有工作提供给你。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Ain't got anything for you right now.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_generic_i.chinese: 这里有些货物需要你帮我取回，不是什么难事。唯一可能的难点在于货物的主人...你等会就会知道了。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_generic_i.english: There's some cargo I'd like you to grab for me. Should be pretty simple. The only problem might be the owner, but you'll figure it out.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_kill_ig_0.chinese: 我需要你帮我去取个货，没有目击者那种。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_kill_ig_0.english: I need you to boost something for me. No witnesses.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_kill_ig_0.chinese: 这是一个非常简单的杀人越货任务。把货拿回来并且送所有其他想拿它的人下地狱。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_kill_ig_0.english: This is a simple smash and grab job. Grab the product I need and smash the hell out of everyone with it.

pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_otoni_har.chinese: 奥托尼黑帮的一批货正在经过这个星系，我要截了它。
pu_klim_mg_missionbriefs_steal_otoni_har.english: Otoni have a shipment heading through the system. I want it.

pu_klim_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_001_g.chinese: 我现在事有点多，所以委托也在手上越积越多，我把我目前的委托都发给你，有感兴趣的话告诉我就好。
pu_klim_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_001_g.english: Got a lot of things going on right now, so the work's been piling up. I'll send you what I've got, let me know if there's one you'd like to take off my plate.

pu_klim_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_002_i.chinese: 如果你想找点活儿干，我这正有一堆等着你。看看吧，有没有你感兴趣的。
pu_klim_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_002_i.english: If you need work, I got plenty to offer. See if any of these sound like a win.

pu_klim_mg_playergoofsoff_ig_002_youmust.chinese: 你一定是搞到了一些好东西。
pu_klim_mg_playergoofsoff_ig_002_youmust.english: You must've gotten some of that good shit.

pu_klim_mg_routine_tunnel_farewell_ig_00.english: You... You have a good one...

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_automaticl.chinese: 飞行员请待命，我们正在启动 EDL 降落程序。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_automaticl.english: Standby pilot we are initiating EDL landing protocol.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_clearlandi.chinese: 请前往安保和海关处办理手续。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_clearlandi.english: Please proceed to customs and security area for processing.
Please proceed to the spaceport at your earliest convenience.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingare.chinese: 注意，请尽快完成业务并离开该区域。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingare.english: Attention, please complete any necessary business and clear the area.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingare.chinese: 请在降落后清理降落区。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingare.english: You are required to clear the area after landing.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingcom.chinese: 着陆完成，欢迎来到罗威尔。

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 您已经被分配过一个停机坪了。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: You have already been given an assignment.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 抱歉，您的飞船已经有一个分配好的泊位了。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: I'm sorry, you have an active space already assigned to you.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 这艘飞船已经有指定的泊位了。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: There is already a space assigned to this vehicle.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 你未被授权使用此设施；请立刻掉头离开。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: You are not authorized to use this facility. Divert your course immediately.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 注意，飞行员，你不被允许进入罗威尔，请立即离开该区域。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: Attention, pilot. You are not permitted to enter Lorville. Please vacate the area.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 根据你的档案记录，你已被禁止进入罗威尔，不要试图进入这座城市。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: According to your case file, you are banned from Lorville. Do not attempt to access the city.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 感谢您使用罗威尔降落服务；请稍等，我们在为您找寻找合适的泊位。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: Thank you for contacting Lorville Landing Services. Stand by for an available space.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 这里是罗威尔降落服务。请稍等，我们正在查询是否有可用的泊位。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: You have reached Lorville Landing Services. Please hold while I check for an available space.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.chinese: 这里是罗威尔降落服务。请稍等，我们正在为您的船查找空位。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingreq.english: Lorville Landing Services. One moment. I am checking availability.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 这里有一个可用的车库。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: There is a garage space available.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 没错，看起来我们有个机库空着。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: Yes it seems we have a hangar available.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 这里有一个可用的机库。

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: I found a hangar for you.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 所有泊位都在使用中，请稍等片刻。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: All of our spaces are currently occupied. Please stand by.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 现在没空位了，请先保持等待，有空位会通知你。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: There are no spaces available. Please hold for the next available one.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 目前确实没地方了，不过我已经把你加进等待队列，应该很快就有空位。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: There aren't any spaces currently available, but I have added you to the waiting queue. Should be something available soon.
We have a pad that's open.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 我找了个合适的停机坪。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: I have found a pad that should be suitable.
There is a landing pad available.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 非常抱歉，我们的设施暂时无法容纳这么大的载具。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: I'm sorry. We are currently not outfitted to accommodate a vehicle of that size.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.chinese: 正为您分配可用的泊位。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingres.english: I'm assigning you an open spot.
Yes it seems we have a spot free.
You can store your vehicle here.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingtim.chinese: 请您立刻前往指定的停泊处。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_landingtim.english: Please proceed immediately to landing assignment.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_proceedtol.chinese: 请前往我们为您指定的泊位。

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_revokeland.chinese: 您对指定泊位的访问权已被回收。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_revokeland.english: Your landing assignment has been revoked.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_revokeland.chinese: 飞行员请注意。经过审核，你的降落许可被取消了。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_approach_revokeland.english: Attention, pilot. After review, your landing permission has been denied.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_clearedtakeo.english: You are cleared for lift off.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_clearedtakeo.chinese: 飞行员请注意，你已获准起飞。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_clearedtakeo.english: Attention, pilot. You are cleared for take off.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_farewell_ig_.chinese: 赫斯顿动力向你表示感谢。
感谢您访问赫斯顿，别忘了，赫斯顿动力公司一直在寻找努力勤劳的人才。感兴趣的话，记得去看看我们的招聘公告。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_farewell_ig_.english: Thank you for visiting Hurston and remember, Hurston Dynamics is always looking for hard workers. Please consult our job board if interested.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_farewell_ig_.chinese: 为什么不把赫斯顿当成家呢？罗威尔这里有各种预算都能负担得起的住处，赶紧联系房产代理，今天就安排一次看房吧。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_farewell_ig_.english: Why not call Hurston home? Lorville has multiple living quarters for all budgets, check with a residency agent to schedule a tour today.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_takeofftimel.chinese: 请注意，如果您不将您的载具移走的话，它将会被入库存放。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_depart_takeofftimel.english: Please remove your vehicle from the area, or it will be stored.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_clearflight.chinese: 请注意，飞行员，您正位于一条活动航道上；请立即规避。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_clearflight.english: Warning, pilot, you are in an active flight lane. Please vacate immediately.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_clearflight.chinese: 您已违反交通安全部门的规定。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_clearflight.english: You are in violation of Traffic Safety Bureau protocols.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_enteringnfz.chinese: 最后警告；请不要在这条航道上继续飞行，否则我们将接管您载具的控制权。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_enteringnfz.english: This is your final warning. Do not continue on this flight path or we will assume control of your craft.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_enteringnfz.chinese: 请注意，你正在接近禁飞区；请立即改变航向。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_enteringnfz.english: Be advised, you are approaching a No Fly Zone. Divert you approach immediately.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.chinese: 请净空机库，便于载具收纳进仓库。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.english: Please clear hangar for ship storage.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.chinese: 准备开始飞船存储，请做好准备。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.english: Stand by to initiate ship storage.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.chinese: 所有人员请注意立即撤离，准备存储飞船。
pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_storingship.english: All personnel please clear for ship storage.

pu_lorvilleatc1_m_fo_general_trafficvoil.english: Warning, you have been issued a citation.

pu_lucas_peo_m_mc_rbmmission1emergencybo.chinese: 路障还能撑住，但我不确定能撑多久。真不想麻烦你干这个，但看来你不得不跟他们打一架了。
pu_lucas_peo_m_mc_rbmmission1emergencybo.english: Barricade's still holding, but I'm not sure for how much longer. I hate asking you to do this, but I think you're going to have to fight them.

pu_lucas_peo_m_mc_rbmmission1emergencypo.chinese: 电力恢复了。看来你不光枪法准，摆弄多功能工具也是一把好手。多谢帮忙。等你那边搞定，我们就立刻返回。
pu_lucas_peo_m_mc_rbmmission1emergencypo.english: Power's back online. Seems you're as handy with a multi-tool as your are with a gun. Thanks for your help. We'll start heading back as soon as you're clear.

pu_macken_fo_levski_alreadygranted_ig_00.chinese: 哇哦，这就是既视感吗；我们刚已经进行过这段对话了，对吧？
pu_macken_fo_levski_alreadygranted_ig_00.english: Whoa. Just had some crazy dejavu. We've had this conversation before, right?

pu_macken_fo_levski_banned_ig_001_heylis.chinese: 嘿，我觉得你可能想要调个头，我们这没有适合你的位子，懂？
pu_macken_fo_levski_banned_ig_001_heylis.english: Hey, listen. I think you should maybe turn around. We're not really the right place for you. Got me?

pu_macken_fo_levski_banned_ig_002_uhlist.chinese: 嗯...听我说...我很抱歉，我不能放你进来，委员会的决定，抱歉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_banned_ig_002_uhlist.english: Uh, listen. I'm sorry, but I can't let you in. Council's orders. Sorry.

pu_macken_fo_levski_bringyouin_ig_004_se.chinese: 现在就把机库许可发给你。
pu_macken_fo_levski_bringyouin_ig_004_se.english: Sending you the hangar assignment now.

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.chinese: 噢，让我看看能不能给你找个合适的车库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.english: Oh, let's see if we got any garage space for ya.

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.chinese: 让我们看看能不能在这边的老停机坪里找个位置给你。
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.english: Let's have a look in the old terminal here and see if there's a spot for you to park.

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.chinese: 好的好的，我知道你需要停船。让我们看看...
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkgaragespace_ig_.english: Okay. You need parking. Let's have a look.

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.chinese: OK，让我看看哪个机库现在是开着的...
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.english: Okay, let's just take a look see what's open right now...

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.chinese: 棒，我看下咱有没有空机库能给你停...
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.english: Cool. Let me see if we got any hangars for you...

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.chinese: 让我看看我们有没有合适的空机库能给你...
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.english: Taking a look at what hangars we got free...

pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.chinese: 好，让我看看能不能帮你找个机库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_checkhangarspace_ig_.english: Alright, let's get you sorted with a hangar...
Let's go ahead and check the hangars...

pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.chinese: 额...嘿！你的船稍微有点挡道，能挪一下吗？
pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.english: Uh, hey, your ship's sorta in the way. Think you could move?

pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.chinese: 嘿，如果你能谦让点给你的邻居让个路，我将感激不尽。
pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.english: Hey, I'd appreciate if you showed your neighbors a little respect and got out of the way.

pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.chinese: 我并不是想用什么“权威人士”的角度跟你说话，但是你得挪一挪你的船。
pu_macken_fo_levski_clearflightpath_ig_0.english: Not to be all 'authority figure' on you, but you got to move your ship now.

pu_macken_fo_levski_cleartakeoff_ig_003_.chinese: 机库门已开启，航道已净空；升空吧。
pu_macken_fo_levski_cleartakeoff_ig_003_.english: Hangar's open and the flight path's clear. Go ahead and launch.

pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.chinese: 听着，我不想催你，但还有其他飞船在等着，你得赶紧离开机库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.english: Hey listen. I hate to rush you, but I've got other ships waiting, so you need to clear the hangar.

pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.chinese: 我知道你刚着陆，但我还有其他客人在等着，如果你能离开机库就太好了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.english: I know you just landed, but I've got other customers waiting. It'd be great if you could leave the hangar.

pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.chinese: 嘿，很抱歉让你费心了，但我真的需要你把机库腾出来。
pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavehangar.english: Hey, sorry to be a pain, but I really need you to clear the hangar.

pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavelandin.chinese: 嘿，抱歉当个讨人嫌的家伙，但是我们真的很需要你把这里腾出来。
pu_macken_fo_levski_encourageleavelandin.english: Hey, sorry to be a pain, but I really need you to clear out of here.

pu_macken_fo_levski_farewell_ig_005_hope.chinese: 希望下次还能再见到你。
pu_macken_fo_levski_farewell_ig_005_hope.english: Hope to see you again one day.

pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_001_w.chinese: 哦，我们可以帮你加油和装弹，但是如果你需要其他服务的话，恐怕就得另寻去处了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_001_w.english: Oh, we can take care of fuel and restock for you here, but anything more complicated and you'll have to figure something else out.

pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_002_i.chinese: 如果你想先补给完再出去，终端机可以帮你解决。
pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_002_i.english: If you want to top off before you head out, the terminal will sort you out.

pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_003_u.chinese: 终端机可以帮你把油加满，如果你想的话。
pu_macken_fo_levski_fuelrestock_ig_003_u.english: Use the terminal to fill up your ship, if you want.

pu_macken_fo_levski_garageassignment_ig_.chinese: 是的，我们可以帮你把车停进车库里。
pu_macken_fo_levski_garageassignment_ig_.english: Yeah, we're gonna have to park you up in the garage.

pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.chinese: 嘿！看起来我们有能给你用的车库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.english: Hey, look at that. We got some garage space.

pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.chinese: 看起来我们有个可用的车库，走着？
pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.english: Hey, there we go. There's a garage available. How about that?

pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.chinese: 嗯，我们这有个泊位在等着你来了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_garageavailable_ig_0.english: Hmm, we got a parking spot just waiting for you.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarassignment_ig_.chinese: 让我帮你把机库位给安排上。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarassignment_ig_.english: Let me send you your hangar assignment.
Sending you your hangar assignment now.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangaravailable_ig_0.chinese: 棒极了，看，有个正和你意的空机库正等着你。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangaravailable_ig_0.english: Nice. Look at that. Got a hangar free that's perfect for ya.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangaravailable_ig_0.chinese: 好了；有个机库正在等着你了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangaravailable_ig_0.english: Well there we go. One hangar all ready to go.
One landing pad coming right up.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_001_oh.chinese: 啊...非常抱歉，看起来我们的机库已经塞满了船，你可能得多等会了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_001_oh.english: Oh man, hate to say it, but it looks like we're full up with ships right now. You're gonna have to wait a bit.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_002_id.chinese: 我们没有多余的位子了，看起来我们现在有点儿忙。可能需要你多等会了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_002_id.english: I don't have any room left. Guess we're pretty busy or something. It's gonna be a few moments.

pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_003_do.chinese: 啊，没搞懂我是怎么搞砸的，但是我们好像目前没有空着的机库了。给我点时间我看看能不能给你腾一个出来。
pu_macken_fo_levski_hangarfull_ig_003_do.english: Ah, I don't know how I missed it, but we're actually all out of open hangars. Give me a few seconds to get you all sorted alright?

pu_macken_fo_levski_invalidrequest_ig_00.chinese: 等等，我有点懵，你想让我干啥？
pu_macken_fo_levski_invalidrequest_ig_00.english: Hmm. I'm lost. You want me to do what? No. No.
I'm really sorry, but I can't do that.

pu_macken_fo_levski_landingcomplete_ig_0.chinese: 成功着陆，欢迎来到列夫斯基。
这里一切都好，欢迎光临。

pu_macken_fo_levski_leavelandingarea_ig_.chinese: 嘿，我不想催你，但是外面还有很多船在等着，所以你恐怕得走了...
pu_macken_fo_levski_leavelandingarea_ig_.english: Hey listen. I hate to rush you, but I've got other ships waiting, so I need you to leave...

pu_macken_fo_levski_leavelandingarea_ig_.chinese: 我知道你可能刚停船没多久，但我可能需要清空一下机库来给别的顾客腾位子，抱歉了...
pu_macken_fo_levski_leavelandingarea_ig_.english: I know you just landed, but I kinda need to clear the area to make room for other customers. Sorry.

pu_macken_fo_levski_moveplayership_ig_00.chinese: 行，我会把他挪开给你腾地方。
pu_macken_fo_levski_moveplayership_ig_00.english: Fine. I'll just move it for you.

pu_macken_fo_levski_moveplayership_ig_00.chinese: 如果客气的请求没用的话...我可能就只能自己来了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_moveplayership_ig_00.english: If asking nicely doesn't work, then I'll just do it myself.

pu_macken_fo_levski_openfire_ig_001_woah.chinese: 哇哦，这么激动干啥，这可一点都不好玩。
pu_macken_fo_levski_openfire_ig_001_woah.english: Whoa, what's with all the aggression. It's uncool.

pu_macken_fo_levski_openfire_ig_003_ohyo.english: Oh, oh, you've done it now.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.chinese: 嗯，我不想扫人兴致，但是我现在得取消你的降落许可。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.english: Hmm, I hate to be a downer, but I had to cancel your landing request.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.chinese: 嗯...我很抱歉，但我等你降落等的太久了，现在我必须得把机库让给别人。希望我们都从这件事里面吸取教训。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.english: Uh, look, I'm sorry, but you waited too long to land, so I had to give it away. Hopefully we've all learned a lesson here.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.chinese: 嗯...对，额，我得把你的泊位给别人了。我很抱歉，但我本以为你能快点降落的。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_landing_ig.english: Hey, yeah, uh, so I had to give your spot to someone else. I'm sorry, but I thought you were gonna land quicker.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.chinese: 我很抱歉，但我以为你在这个时候本该已经起飞了，我可能得取消你的起飞许可了，抱歉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.english: I'm really sorry, but I thought you would've taken off by now. I'm gonna have to cancel your launch.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.chinese: 啊，赖在这不走，是吧？我没在责怪你...但是我得把你的船收回仓库了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.english: Ah, couldn't bring yourselves to leave, huh? I don't blame you... but am I gonna need to put your ship back in storage.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.chinese: 嘿...抱歉。我平时不怎么催人的，但是你起飞实在是花太久了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outoftime_takeoff_ig.english: Um... Hi, sorry. I normally don't like to rush people, but you've taken a really long time to launch.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outstandingfees_ig_0.chinese: 哦吼，看起来你在这里欠了点帐。你可能得把它还完才能离开这儿。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outstandingfees_ig_0.english: Uh oh. It says here you owe some money. Won't be able to let you leave until your debt's settled.

pu_macken_fo_levski_outstandingfees_ig_0.chinese: 哦，虽然这听上去有点怪，但是，看起来你在这欠了点钱。我们可能得在你还清之前把你的船扣这儿。
pu_macken_fo_levski_outstandingfees_ig_0.english: Oh, it's a bit awkward, but it seems you still owe some credits. Have to hang onto your ship until you're all paid up.

pu_macken_fo_levski_ramsomething_ig_001_.chinese: 哇！你到底在做什么？这可一点也不好玩！
pu_macken_fo_levski_ramsomething_ig_001_.english: Woah! What the hell are you doing! It's not cool!

pu_macken_fo_levski_ramsomething_ig_002_.chinese: 嘿！嘿！小心点儿！悠着点儿！

pu_macken_fo_levski_ramsomething_ig_003_.english: What's with the flying? You on something?

pu_macken_fo_levski_repairs_ig_001_ifyou.chinese: 哦，如果你需要维修服务，可以去找自由港的劳拉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_repairs_ig_001_ifyou.english: Oh, if you need repairs, Laura over at Liberty can help you.

pu_macken_fo_levski_repairs_ig_002_ifyou.chinese: 如果你的船需要维护的话，这儿的人大多都会去找自由港，劳拉干这活很在行。
pu_macken_fo_levski_repairs_ig_002_ifyou.english: If your ship needs maintenance, most folks around here use Liberty. Laura does good work.

pu_macken_fo_levski_return_ig_002_ohthou.chinese: 啊，我想我记得你，再见到你很高兴。
pu_macken_fo_levski_return_ig_002_ohthou.english: Ah, thought I recognized you. Nice to have you back.

pu_macken_fo_levski_return_ig_003_heywel.english: Hey, welcome back to the land of the free.

pu_macken_fo_levski_return_ig_004_lookyt.chinese: 哦，看看这谁；欢迎回来，朋友。
pu_macken_fo_levski_return_ig_004_lookyt.english: Well, Looky there. Happy returns, friend.

pu_macken_fo_levski_revokelanding_ig_001.chinese: 抱歉忘了这事儿吧，你不能在这里着陆。
pu_macken_fo_levski_revokelanding_ig_001.english: Ah, forget it. You can't land here.

pu_macken_fo_levski_revokelanding_ig_002.chinese: 你知道么？我死也不会让你降落在这里。
pu_macken_fo_levski_revokelanding_ig_002.english: Know what? No way in hell am I gonna let you land here.

pu_macken_fo_levski_revokelanding_ig_003.chinese: 你的停船许可已被撤销。

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_allset_i.chinese: 载具已经在机库里等着你了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_allset_i.english: There. Should be waiting for you in the hangar.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_encourag.chinese: 你可以用终端来呼叫你的载具。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_encourag.english: You can call your ship up on a terminal.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.chinese: 看起来机库全都满了，你可能得多等会了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.english: Looks like all the hangars are full. Gonna be just another second.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.chinese: 那个，你能多等会不，机库现在都已经满了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.english: Actually, can you hold on for a bit. All the hangars are full right now.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.chinese: 呃...看起来我们这儿没多的机库了，让我看看能不能给你清一个出来。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_nospace_.english: Er, looks like there's no hangars available. Let me see if I can clear one out.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_spaceava.chinese: 让我把那儿给你腾出来。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiprequest_spaceava.english: Let me get that for you.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.chinese: 嘿，我正要把你的飞船存放起来，可以不？可以吧。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.english: Hey, so I gotta take your ship down into storage. Okay? Okay.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.chinese: 嗯...我可能得把你的飞船收进仓库里...成吗？
pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.english: So... I'm gonna have to move your ship... Cool?

pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.chinese: 呃，我希望你把你需要的东西都从你的船上拿出来了，因为我得把它收进仓库里，当然；我不会偷它的，相信我。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shipstorageprocedure.english: Uh, I hope you got everything you need from your ship, cause it's gonna go into storage. Until you need again, of course. I'm not gonna steal it. I'm serious.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_001_ih.chinese: 我不想这么说，但是你的船比我们最大的机库还大；所以你可能得...找找别的去处了，抱歉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_001_ih.english: I hate to do this, but your ship's too large for our hangars. So you're gonna like, have to figure something else out. Sorry.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_002_oh.chinese: 哦，额，啊这，看起来你的船太大了塞不进我们的机库；这...额，我也没辙。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_002_oh.english: Oh, oh jeez, yeah, it looks like your ship's too big for our hangars. You know, that, that's a bummer.

pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_003_wh.chinese: 哇偶，刚发现你的船对我们来说太大了，估计没地方能给你落，抱歉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_shiptoobig_ig_003_wh.english: Woah, damn. I just noticed your ship's too big. Got no where for you to land. Apologies.

pu_macken_fo_levski_specificgarage_03_ig.chinese: 我应该能让你挤进3号车库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_specificgarage_03_ig.english: I should be able to squeeze you into Garage Three.

pu_macken_fo_levski_specificgarage_04_ig.chinese: 来，4号车库，最适合你的了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_specificgarage_04_ig.english: Here. My finest garage. Number four.

pu_macken_fo_levski_specifichangar_01_ig.chinese: 你应该是被分配到了...呃...1号机库。
pu_macken_fo_levski_specifichangar_01_ig.english: You're gonna be in Hangar Uno... that's one.

pu_macken_fo_levski_specifichangar_03_ig.english: Uh, you're gonna be in hangar three.

pu_macken_fo_levski_standbymsg_ig_001_he.chinese: 嘿伙计，这里是列夫斯基降落管制，但我现在手头有点忙，稍等一下，等会就来为你服务。
pu_macken_fo_levski_standbymsg_ig_001_he.english: Hey there. You've got Levski landing control, but I'm occupado at the moment. Hang out for a second and I'll be with you soon.

pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_001_i.chinese: 我不想扫人兴致，但是看起来我们的机库现在都塞满了船，你可能得多等会了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_001_i.english: I hate to say it, but it looks like we're all full up with ships right now. You're gonna have to wait a bit.

pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_002_o.chinese: 我们机库都满了，看来我们这会儿是真的忙的一批，你可能得再等会了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_002_o.english: Huh, I don't have any room left. Guess we're pretty busy or something. Uh, it's gonna be a few moments.

pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_003_y.chinese: 啊，我不知道这里是咋搞的，但我们真的没啥空位子了，给我一小会，我去给你找个地方停。
pu_macken_fo_levski_stationfull_ig_003_y.english: Yeah, I don't know how I missed it, but we're a little tight on space. Just give me a few seconds to get you sorted all right?

pu_macken_fo_levski_storeship_ig_001_nee.chinese: 我需要你把船清空，这样才好把她放进仓库里。
pu_macken_fo_levski_storeship_ig_001_nee.english: I need the ship clear so I can move it into storage.

pu_macken_fo_levski_storeship_ig_002_hey.chinese: 嘿，让船员都下来吧，不然我们没法把你的船挪到库房里。
pu_macken_fo_levski_storeship_ig_002_hey.english: Hey, gonna need the crew all off so I place your ship into storage.

pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_ig_001_a.chinese: 剩下的事儿就是等你把钱给我了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_ig_001_a.english: All that's left for you is to send me a payment.

pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_ig_002_g.chinese: 事都办妥了，就剩交钱了。

pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_ig_003_j.chinese: 好了，把停泊费转给我然后一切就都妥了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_ig_003_j.english: Right, just need your landing fee and then we're all set.

pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_notenoug.chinese: 如果你没带钱的话，我实在没法让你在这里降落，抱歉。
pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_notenoug.english: Sorry. If you don't have the credits, I can't let you land.

pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_notenoug.chinese: 我真希望能为你免除费用，但天下可沒有白吃的午餐，懂我意思吧？
pu_macken_fo_levski_takepayment_notenoug.english: I wish I could waive the fee for you, but food ain't free. Yet. You hear me?

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.chinese: Hmm...我不喜欢催人，但是你花的时间实在有点太长了...你懂吧？
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.english: Hmm, I hate to rush you, but you're kinda taking a little too long... You know?

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.chinese: 嘿，抱歉你能快一点么？谢了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.english: Hey, sorry, could you hurry up a little? Thanks.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.chinese: 嘿，抱歉你能快一点么？谢了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.english: Hey, sorry, could you hurry it up a little? Thanks.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.chinese: 嘿，你介意把它移开么?这会可真够忙的...
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ig.english: Would you mind moving it along? This is kind of a busy operation...

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.chinese: 嘿，你打算停进去么？我已经把我的工作做好了，该你了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.english: Hey, are you gonna land? Cause, I've done my part. Now it's time to do yours.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.chinese: 我需要知道你到底打不打算降落，如果你不打算的话，也完全没关系，但是请尽快把你的决定告诉我。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.english: So, I kinda need you to land. If you're not, that's cool, that's cool too. I just kinda need to know. Like soon.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.chinese: 呃...你已经有地方可停了，所以...为啥不去呢。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_la.english: Uh, You got a spot to land. Just waiting for you. So... Let's get landing.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.chinese: 呃...你还...还好么？只是，你已经可以起飞了，但你还没飞。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.english: uh, you, uh, okay? It's just that uh you've got like everything you need to take off, but you're not.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.chinese: 嘿，你知道你已经可以走了，对吧？
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.english: Hey, you know you can leave, right?

pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.chinese: 我已经给过你起飞许可了对吧？哦我给了，棒，只是再确认一下。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warning_timelimit_ta.english: I gave you permission to launch, right? I did. Okay, cool. Just making sure.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warningleavehangar_i.chinese: 好了最后一次机会，离开机库，否则你会被强行带走。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warningleavehangar_i.english: Okay, last chance to leave the hangar, or you're gonna be forcefully removed.

pu_macken_fo_levski_warningleavelandinga.chinese: Ok，再不走的话我们就得使用强制手段了。
pu_macken_fo_levski_warningleavelandinga.english: Okay, last chance to leave, or you're going to be forcefully removed.

pu_macken_levski_convocont_ig_002_ohiwas.chinese: 我刚刚在说啥来着...哦！哦对...
pu_macken_levski_convocont_ig_002_ohiwas.english: Oh, I was saying something... Oh! Uh, right...

pu_macken_levski_farewell_ig_002_alright.english: All right, have a good one.

pu_macken_levski_farewell_ig_stand_002_a.english: All right, have a good one.

pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_001_ohwe.chinese: 哦，我们可以帮你加油和装弹，但是如果你需要其他服务的话，恐怕就得另寻去处了。
pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_001_ohwe.english: Oh, we can take care of fuel and restock for you here, but anything more complicated, you'll have to figure something else out.

pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_002_ohif.chinese: 如果你想在出门前加满，终端机可以帮你解决。
pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_002_ohif.english: Oh, if you want to top off before you head out, the terminal over there will sort you out.

pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_003_uset.chinese: 终端机可以帮你把油加满，如果你想的话。
pu_macken_levski_fuelrestock_ig_003_uset.english: Use the terminal to fill up your ship, if you want.

pu_macken_levski_greetings_ig_004_ohsorr.chinese: 哦抱歉，我当时不在这儿。
pu_macken_levski_greetings_ig_004_ohsorr.english: Oh, sorry, I was somewhere else.

pu_macken_levski_outstandingfees_ig_001_.chinese: 哦，系统显示你好像欠了某个人一笔账，在你还清之前我们没法让你走。
pu_macken_levski_outstandingfees_ig_001_.english: Oh. It says here you owe some money. Won't be able to let you leave till your debt's settled.

pu_macken_levski_outstandingfees_ig_002_.chinese: 哦，有点尴尬，你好像还欠了点钱；我们得暂时把你的船扣在这，直到你还清欠款。
pu_macken_levski_outstandingfees_ig_002_.english: Oh, bit awkward, but it seems you still owe some credits. Have to hang onto your ship till you're all paid up.

pu_macken_levski_physicalbump_ig_002_ohy.chinese: 你是个小调皮鬼，是不是?
pu_macken_levski_physicalbump_ig_002_ohy.english: You're a frisky one, ain't you, huh.

pu_macken_levski_physicalbump_ig_left_00.chinese: 哇哦，你挺能闹腾的啊，是吧？
pu_macken_levski_physicalbump_ig_left_00.english: Wow, you're a frisky one, ain't you.

pu_macken_levski_physicalbump_ig_right_0.english: You're a frisky one, ain't you.

pu_macken_levski_randomtonpc_ig_001_yous.chinese: 你真该见见当年这儿的样子。那时的我们年轻气壮，个个满腔热血，为的只是更好的明天，说来还挺光荣的是吧。
pu_macken_levski_randomtonpc_ig_001_yous.english: You should have seen this place back in the day. All of us young and full of fire to build something better. Ah man, it was something.

pu_macken_levski_randomtoplayer_ig_001_y.chinese: 你真该见见当年这儿的样子。那时的我们年轻气壮，个个操着满腔热血，为的只是更好的明天，说来还挺光荣的是吧。
pu_macken_levski_randomtoplayer_ig_001_y.english: You should have seen this place back in the day. All of us young and full of fire to build something better. It was something.

pu_macken_levski_repairs_ig_002_ohifyour.chinese: 如果你的船需要维护的话，这儿的人大多都会去找自由港，劳拉干这活很在行。
pu_macken_levski_repairs_ig_002_ohifyour.english: Oh, if your ship needs maintenance, most folks around here use Liberty. Laura does good work.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.chinese: 载具已经在机库里等着你了。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.english: There. Should be waiting for you in the hangar.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.chinese: 一切就绪；你的船在等着你了。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.english: All right. Your ship's all ready for you.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.chinese: 一切就绪；你的船在等着你了。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_allset_ig_0.english: All right. Your ship's all ready for you.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_encouragete.chinese: 你准备好出去了的话，可以用那边的终端，然后我就去帮你取出你的船。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_encouragete.english: Once you're ready to head out, you can use the terminal and I'll get your ship for you.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_encouragete.chinese: 哦，你可以用那边的终端呼叫你的船。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_encouragete.english: Oh, you can call your ship on the terminal over there.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.chinese: 看来机库全都满了，你可能得多等会了。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.english: Hm, looks like all the hangars are full. Gonna be just another second.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.chinese: 其实...你可能得稍等下。机库现在都满了。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.english: Actually, can you hold on for a bit. All the hangars are full right now.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.chinese: 呃...看起来我们这儿没多的机库了，让我看看能不能给你清一个出来。
pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_nospace_ig_.english: Er, looks like there's no hangars available. Let me see if I can clear one out.

pu_macken_levski_shiprequest_spaceavaila.english: Let me get that for you.

pu_macken_levski_welcome_v_wp_004_alrigh.chinese: 好了，我想我也唠叨的差不多了；好好享受吧。哦，有空的话一定要去那些小餐馆瞧瞧啊。
pu_macken_levski_welcome_v_wp_004_alrigh.english: All right. Now, I've preached at you long enough. Have a good time. Oh, and a make sure you check out the cafes.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.chinese: 有艘满载伤员的船准备停靠了，预计15分钟后抵达；交通事故小组请就位，准备好紧急手术台。
pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.english: Got a hot ride coming in fully loaded. ETA 15. Need RTA on standby and prep a crash couch.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.chinese: 二号手术室发生状况，代号171，注意，这不是演习；二号手术室代号171。
pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.english: Code 171 in operating suite 2. This is not a drill, people. Code 171 in suite 2.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.chinese: 注意点，大伙。伤员正在路上。5个1级，6个2级。预计17分钟后抵达。准备好空床位。
pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.english: Look alive, folks. Have a drop coming this way. 5 tier 1's. 6 tier 2's. ETA in 17 minutes. Gonna need some beds cleared stat.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.chinese: 皮德瓦里医生，停下手边工作立即前往三号手术室，马上。
pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.english: Dr. Pidwari, drop whatever you're doing and get to OR 3 now. Hurry.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.chinese: 我们需要全部有空的护士前往紧急泊位C，现在马上。
pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_e.english: We need every availble nurse to emergency bay C right damn now.

pu_mercydisp01_f_lpa_announce_hospital_s.chinese: 伊顿医生，泌尿科找您，伊顿医生至泌尿科。

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.chinese: 我是微科公司的雷米。你有一份未完成的合约已经超出了我们的时间限制，所以我们会把它转交给其他人。别再让这种情况发生了，好吗？
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.english: It's Remy from microTech. There's an unfinished contract on you that's exceeded our time limits, so moving it to someone else. Don't let it happen again, okay?

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.chinese: 嘿，我是雷米，正在你的承包商记录里记下你放弃了一份合约。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.english: Hey, it's Remy, making a note in your contractor record that you dropped a contract.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.chinese: 让我直奔主题。微科不喜欢承包商随便放弃任务。下次最好准备好完成工作。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.english: Let me cut to the chase. microTech doesn't like contractors to simply abandon jobs. Better come prepared to do the job on the next one.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.chinese: 我是雷米。很抱歉这么做，但必须撤回那份合约了。你现在能做的最好的事情就是把这事儿放下，专注于下一个任务。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.english: It's Remy. Hate to do this but gotta pull that contract. Best thing you can do now is put that behind you and focus on the next one.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.chinese: 听着，我实话实说吧。从你这儿撤回这份合约对谁都不好，但这事是必要的。所以，请确保这种事情别再发生了，好吗？
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggenericmission.english: Look, I'm going to be honest. Pulling this contract from you isn't good for anyone but it's necessary. Just be sure it doesn't happen again, okay?

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggivereward_gp_.chinese: 微科感谢你最近的辛勤工作。留意一下，很快就会有特别的东西送到你那儿哦。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggivereward_gp_.english: MicroTech thanks you for all the hard work you've done recently. Keep your eyes peel for a special something heading your way.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggivereward_gp_.chinese: 我是雷米。我跟老板们提了你最近做的好工作，他们批准了一笔不错的奖金给你。好好享受吧。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsggivereward_gp_.english: It's Remy. I spoke to my bosses about all the good work you've been doing, and they've approved a nice bonus for you. Enjoy.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptc.chinese: 嘿，我是雷米。微科在资源竞争中落后了，我的老板让我把数量翻倍。这任务必须又快又好地完成。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptc.english: Hey, Remy here. microTech is losing the resource race, and my bosses want me to double our numbers. This job needs to get done fast and right.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 这里是微科公司的雷米。很高兴你接了我们的资源收集合约，非常感谢你的帮助。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Remy from microTech here. Glad you're running a resource collection contract for us. Glad to have your help.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 谢谢您又接了一份合约。我现在正在用您的承包商 ID 更新收集订单。好了，您可以出发了。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Thanks for grabbing another contract. Updating the collection order with your contractor ID now. Ok, you're good to go.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 我是雷米。想让您知道，微科非常感谢您与我们合作这份合约。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Remy here. Wanted to let you know that microTech truly appreciates you partnering with us on this contract.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 您与微科的合约已经准备就绪。继续加油，并且常回来看看。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Your contract with microTech's ready to go. Keep up the good work, and keep coming back.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 嘿，我是明。咱们得确保这份合约顺利完成。我们的完成率比平常低，我可不能再承受一次失败了。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Hey, it's Remy. Let's make sure this contract gets done right. Our closure percentage is lower than normal, and I can't afford another failure.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.chinese: 这里是微科公司的雷米。您现在应该已经熟悉流程了。我这边没有什么更新的，只是想祝您在外面好运。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissionacceptg.english: Remy with microTech again. You should know the drill by now. No updates on my side. Just wanted to wish you luck out there.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.chinese: 我是雷米，确认您的资源运送成功了。现在正式关闭合约。再次感谢。

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.chinese: 我是雷米。感谢您完成了那份合约。微科非常感激您的辛勤工作。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.english: It's Remy. Thanks for knocking out that contract. microTech appreciates your hard work.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.chinese: 谢谢您。真是艰难的一天，失败比成功还多。要是我们的承包商都能像您这样处理事务就好了。
pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.english: Thanks for that. Been a rough one today. More failures than successes so far. Wish all our contractors handled their business like you.

pu_mrep_remy_mic_m_pmh_rsgmissioncomplet.chinese: 我是雷米。从我们这边看，您的合约一切正常。现在正在处理，您很快就能拿到报酬。
