pu_mtechrep1_mg_comms_returnitems_remind.chinese: 请务必将微科公司之财产归还予我司，否则我们将采取强硬措施。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_comms_returnitems_remind.english: Please return any microTech property to us, or we will be forced to take appropriate action.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_comms_returnitems_remind.chinese: 我们特此提醒您，请务必在时限内归还微科公司之财产。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_comms_returnitems_remind.english: You are hereby notified that any microTech property in you possession must be returned in a timely matter.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_allri.english: All right, let's take another look...

pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_encouragelookandd.english: Take a look and see what you think.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_encouragelookandd.chinese: 仔细读一读，看看适不适合你。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_encouragelookandd.english: Have a read through and we'll see if its a match for you.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig.chinese: 你看上去对这不太走心吧。那咱下次再看看。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig.english: You seem distracted. Why don't we pick this up another time.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig.chinese: 抱歉。如果你下不了决定的话，我就把这机会让给别人了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig.english: Sorry. If you can't decide I'm going to have to help other people.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_002_wel.chinese: 欢迎来到微科，我们致力于让每天都更加美好。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_002_wel.english: Welcome to microTech, where we work to make each day better.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.chinese: 我看到您在最后一份合约上遇到了麻烦，但您之前的记录看起来还不错。现在请不用担心。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.english: I see that you had a bit of trouble on that last contract, but before that your record looks pretty good. I wouldn't worry too much about it for now.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.chinese: 到目前为止，您似乎做得非常不错。当然最后一份合约除外。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.english: Looks like you've been doing really well so far. Except for that last contract of course.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.chinese: 很遗憾看到您最后一份合约完成的不怎么样。希望下次再接再厉。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.english: I'm sorry to see that your last contract didn't go so well. I hope your next one will be more successful.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.chinese: 您的上一份合约看起来是无法完成了。希望您下一个运气好点。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_.english: Looks like your last contract was unable to be completed. I hope you have better luck on the next one.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fails.chinese: 不是什么最好的记录就是了...
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_fails.english: Not exactly the best record is it...

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastc.chinese: 这就是我能做的。我可以请求试用，并允许您尝试其他合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastc.english: Here's what I can do. I can request a trial and allow you to attempt another contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastc.chinese: 微科致力于提供人工支持。你在试用期还有一次机会，看看你是否可以扭转局面。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastc.english: microTech is very committed to providing worker support. We can try you one more time on a probationary basis and see if you can turn things around.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolon.chinese: 这意味着我目前无法为您提供合约。很抱歉给您带来不便。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolon.english: That means I'm unable to provide you with a contract at this time. Sorry for the inconvience.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolon.chinese: 也就是说，根据微科的相关规定，我目前无法为您提供新合约
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolon.english: Which means, according to microTech policy, I will not be able to give you a new contract currently

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 我这里注意到您上次合约完成情况堪称楷模。太棒了！
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: I have it noted here that your performance on the last conract was exemplary. That's great!

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 看起来您上次合约完成得太棒了，您已经被选为了每月最佳承包人。单纯被提名就是一项不小的殊荣了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: Seems your last contract performance was so good that you're in the running for contractor of the month. It's quite an honor just to be nominated.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 恭喜您成功完成了上一项合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: Congratulations on the successful completion of your last contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 档案显示您准时完成了上次合约。这种情况总是很棒的。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: The file says you completed your last contract on time. That's always great to see.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 看起来您干得还不错啊。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: It seems you've been doing quite well overall.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.chinese: 微科当然注意到了您为我们完成的优质工作。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_succe.english: microTech has definitely taken notice of the quality of work you've been doing for us.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryha.chinese: 我相信您能够扭转局面。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryha.english: I'm sure you can turn things around though.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryha.chinese: 谁又知道呢，没准您能按时完成下一个合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryha.english: Who knows though, maybe you'll actually complete the next contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_disclaimer_ig.chinese: 为了确保服务质量，本次通讯可能会录音。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_disclaimer_ig.english: This comm may be recorded for quality reasons.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_u.chinese: 非常遗憾，由于您未能按照要求完成合约，本次合约已经无效。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_u.english: Unfortunately, due to your failure to complete the contract to the required specifications, we consider it null and void.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_t.chinese: 特此通知您，我们与您之间的合约已经解除，不再需要您的服务了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_t.english: This is to let you know that your contract with us has been terminated and your services no longer required.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_u.chinese: 非常遗憾我们必须取消您当前的合约。对此造成的不便我们感到非常抱歉。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_u.english: Unfortunately we've had to cancel your current contract. We're extremely sorry for the inconvience.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_004_i.chinese: 很遗憾地通知您，派发给您的合约已经不再有效。抱歉为您带来任何不便。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_fail_ig_004_i.english: I regret to inform you that the contract you were assigned to is no longer valid. We apologize for any undue inconvenience.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_.english: Hi, I'm contacting you from microTech.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_.chinese: 您好，这是来自微科的问候通讯。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_.english: Hi, this is a courtesy comm from microTech.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_.chinese: 我们想通知您，您的合约内容有所更新。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_.english: We wanted to inform you that there has been an update on your contract parameters.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_.chinese: 我已经将您的当前合约更新了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_.english: I have update on your current contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig.chinese: 特此通知您取消合约的请求已经通过。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig.english: Following up to let you know that your contract cancellation request has gone through.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_receivedata_i.chinese: 您发送给我们的数据已经成功收到，特此告知。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_receivedata_i.english: Just confirming that we have succesfully recieved the data you sent us.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_receivedata_i.chinese: 我们已经收到了您传输的数据。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_receivedata_i.english: We have recieved the data you transfered to us.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_warningfail_i.chinese: 我们想要提醒您，您的合约即将逾期，最好尽快完成。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_warningfail_i.english: Wanted to give you a heads up that your contract is closing in on it's deadline so it might be good to finish it up soon.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_warningfail_i.chinese: 我们收到通知称您当前的合约即将到期。如果您能完成它那就再好不过了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_midmission_warningfail_i.english: We have a notification that your current contract is nearing it's deadline. It would be great if you could go ahead and finish it.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_farewell_ig_002_.chinese: 祝您接下来的一天过得愉快。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_farewell_ig_002_.english: Enjoy the rest of your day.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_farewell_ig_003_.english: Thanks for visiting us at microTech.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_farewell_mission.english: And good luck with your contract.
And best of luck with your work.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_create.chinese: 看起来您以前没有接受过我们的合约，所以我将为您创建一个新的档案。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_create.english: It looks like you haven't got a contract with us before, so I am going to go ahead and creat a new one.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_create.chinese: 我在系统中找不到您的档案，所以我将为你创建一个新的。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_create.english: I don't have a record of you in the system, so I'm going to go ahead and create one for you.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_lookup.english: Let me look up your file.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_lookup.chinese: 让我找找您的合约记录。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_lookup.english: Let me look up your contract history.
Let me go ahead and bring up your account.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_nolong.chinese: 嗯...您的档案已经被停用了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_nolong.english: Hmm. Your profile has been flagged.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_nolong.chinese: 抱歉，您已经被系统除名了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_nolong.english: Apologies, but you have been flagged in our system.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_offera.chinese: 有什么我能帮到您的吗？
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_offera.english: Is there something I could assist you with?

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_player.chinese: 微科一直在寻找能够执行合约的独立承包人。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_player.english: microTech is always looking for independant operators to assist on contracts.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_player.chinese: 帮助人们介绍合约是我在工作中最喜欢的部分了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_player.english: Connecting people to contracts is one of my favorite parts of the job.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_reason.chinese: 似乎您的声誉并没能满足微科的用人标准。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_reason.english: Seems you have a reputation that doesn't quite align with microTech's corporate ethos.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_reason.chinese: 您过去的表现似乎存在一些问题。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_reason.english: Seems there have been some issues with your past performance.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.chinese: 似乎您已经接受了我们的一项合约。在您完成那份合约之前恐怕我不能为您发放一份新的合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.english: Seems you are already engaged in a contract with us. I'm afraid you won't be able to initiate a new contract until that one is completed.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.chinese: 我这边看见您正在为微科执行合约。我建议您先完成这个工作后再来寻找新的合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_stillm.english: I see here that you are already on a job for microTech. I suggest completing that one first, before seeking a new contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_wrongd.chinese: 似乎您对在哪里投放物品有些疑惑。建议您查看mobiGlas手环。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_wrongd.english: It looks like you may be a bit confused as to where to drop off items. I suggest checking your mobiGlas.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_wrongd.chinese: 很抱歉，我们这里不受理物品投递。您的mobiGlas手环应该会提示您正确的投放地点。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_mission_greetings_wrongd.english: I'm sorry, but we don't handle drop offs here. Your mobiGlas should have instructions about the proper drop off location.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_gen.chinese: 微科的行动最近遇到了一些暴力侵扰者。希望您能为我们解决这些麻烦。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_gen.english: There have been some violent offenders interfering with microTech operations. We're hoping that you will be able to resolve this problem for us.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_gen.chinese: 微科最近在这片区域内与特定个人有数次冲突。这个麻烦的优先级已经提高，以便采取更加主动的应对措施。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_gen.english: microTech have been having numerous difficulties with certain individuals in the area. The problem has been elevated so that more proactive steps can be taken.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_collect_ge.chinese: 我们某个特定材料的订单目前无法定位，我们希望有人能够追查到足够的货源。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_collect_ge.english: We have an outstanding order for some specific materials that we have not been able to source yet. We would love for someone to track down an adequate supply.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_collect_ge.chinese: 我有一个征收物品的任务需要有人来完成。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_collect_ge.english: I have an requisition request that needs fufillment.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.chinese: 某个特定区域的安全问题已经越来越引人注目。我们希望在该区域办公的员工人身安全得到保障。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.english: A particular sector has become a growing concern due to security issues. We would like to ensure the safety of our employees conducting business there.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.chinese: 一个需要额外安保的请求已经通过，我们希望能尽快满足这个需求。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_defend_gen.english: A request for extra protection has been approved, so we are looking to staff that as soon as possible.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.chinese: 此前数次投递该货物的尝试，由于各种问题均已失败告终。我司致力于确保该货物送达。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.english: The last few attempts to deliver this shipment have not been successful for various reasons. Corporate is committed to making sure this delivery arrives.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.chinese: 一位重要的微科客户刚下了一个订单，管理层迫切希望货物能够安全送达。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.english: An important microTech client has just placed an order with us and management is very eager for it to arrive without complications.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.chinese: 这里有一个货运的请求。
有一趟货运任务需要完成。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.english: Have a delivery that needs fufillment

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ge.chinese: 这个合约或许不错，运送货物。

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_in.chinese: 有一些高度敏感的数据需要快速安全地转移。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_in.english: There is some highly sensitive data that needs to be securely and efficiently transferred.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_in.chinese: 我们需要将一些数据送到其中一个研究所去。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_in.english: We need some information delivered to one of our off-site operations.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pi.chinese: 我们意外地收到了一趟错误的订单。我们需要你将这些货物退送回去，然后将正确地货物运回来。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pi.english: We accidentally received an incorrect shipment. We need the cargo returned and the correct order delivered.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pi.chinese: 我们有一个来回运货的订单。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pi.english: Have a two part delivery order.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ti.chinese: 我们有一趟交货时间较短的紧急货运任务。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ti.english: We have an urgent shipment that has a very narrow delivery window.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ti.chinese: 有一批货物需要在规定时间内送达。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_ti.english: There's a shipment that needs to be delivered within a very specific timeframe.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_escort_gen.chinese: 我们正需要您来为我们的一艘飞船提供安保与支援。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_escort_gen.english: We would be looking for you to accompany one of our ships in a support and security role.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_escort_gen.chinese: 我这里有一个微科喜欢称为“预防协调人”的工作， 不过实际上就是一个护航合约。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_escort_gen.english: Have something here for what microTech likes to call an "Preventative Facilitator" but it's basically an escort contract.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ha.chinese: 这里有一个...比普通合约要复杂一点的任务，不过对您来说应该正合适。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ha.english: Have one... it is a little more complicated than the typical offerings, but should still be a good fit.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ha.chinese: 有个合约，可能比较有挑战性，不过我知道有的承包人就喜欢这样的任务呢。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ha.english: Got something. It might be a little more on the challenging side, but I know that some of our contractors really enjoy that.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig.chinese: 合约在这里，这个应该还不错。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig.english: There we go. Got one that should work well.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig.chinese: 有个合约，我认为您应该会很喜欢的。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig.english: Got one. I think you'll be very happy with it

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_investigat.chinese: 我们有一个请求，需要收集一些特定的信息。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_investigat.english: We have a request in for some specific data that needs to be collected.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_investigat.chinese: 我们最近收到了一些含有奇怪异常的读数，需要有人在现场确认这个数据。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_investigat.english: We've been picking up some strange anomalies in some of our readings and we need on site confirmation of the data.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.chinese: 很抱歉。看起来目前暂时没有合约。欢迎稍后再来查看。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.english: I'm sorry. It looks like we haven't got any available contracts at the moment. But please feel free to check again later.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.chinese: 很遗憾，我们目前没有适合您的合约。您换个时间再来看看吧。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_.english: Unfortunately, we don't have any contracts for you available currently. You'll have to try us again some other time.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_recover_st.chinese: 有人盗窃了属于微科的财产，我们需要将其追回。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_recover_st.english: Property belonging to microTech was stolen. We need it retrieved.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_recover_st.chinese: 一些属于微科的财产在最近的交易中失踪了。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_recover_st.english: Some microTech property went missing during a recent transaction.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.chinese: 一些位于某个遥控基站的设备失去了信号。我们需要将其维修好后重新接入网络。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.english: We've lost signal contact with some equipment at a remote installation. We need it repaired and reconnected to the network.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.chinese: 一些微科设备需要维护。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.english: Some microTech equipment is in need of servicing.

pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.chinese: 我们需要一位熟练的技术员来维护微科设备。
pu_mtechrep1_mg_missionbriefs_repair_gen.english: We need a skilled technician to service some microTech equipment.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.chinese: 谢谢光临，希望你待得愉快，路上小心。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.english: Thanks for visiting. Hope you enjoyed your stay and safe travels.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.chinese: 我们所有人都希望你在微科——帝国科技领域的领军者——玩得开心。不一样才叫好。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.english: Everyone here hopes you enjoyed your visit to microTech, the Empire's leading innovator in all things technology. Different is good.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.chinese: 看你准备出发了，能帮上你真不错，也希望你能尽快再来新巴贝奇看看。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.english: Looks like you're on your way. It was great being able to help you and I hope you're able to visit us here at New Babbage again real soon.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.chinese: 感谢访问新巴贝奇，微科的骄傲故乡。在这里，创意创新遇上创新创意。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_farewell_aneutral_tplay.english: Thank you for visiting New Babbage, the proud home of microTech. Where creative innovation meets innovative creativity.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.chinese: 很好，你的飞船已经安顿好了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.english: Great. Your vehicle should be all set.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.chinese: 干得不错，接下来交给我们来处理就行。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.english: Nicely done. We can take care of your vehicle from here.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.chinese: 到啦，欢迎来到新巴贝奇。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_arrival_complete.english: There you are. Welcome to New Babbage.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.chinese: 嗨，有点坏消息要告诉你，你现在没法进入我们的设施，抱歉啊，不过还是祝你今天过得愉快。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.english: Hi, I have some bad news. You're currently not allowed access to our facilities. Sorry about that and I hope you have a great day.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.chinese: 嘿，真不巧，你现在被禁止进入新巴贝奇，所以今天我这边帮不了你了。不过还是谢谢你过来一趟。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.english: Hey. Unfortunately, you are currently restricted from entering New Babbage, so I'm not going to be able to assist you today. Thanks for stopping by though.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.chinese: 呃，糟了，我这边记录显示你现在不能使用微科的设施。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_aneutral_.english: Uh oh. My records show that you're not allowed access to microTech facilities right now.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_crimestat.chinese: 嘿，抱歉啊，你这船登记人的犯罪记录问题，今天我这边没法帮你办理。路上小心，平安吧。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_banned_crimestat.english: Hey. I'm afraid that the crimestat of your vehicle's registered owner means I won't be able to assist you today. Hope you have safe travels.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.chinese: 看起来现在暂时没位置了，不过一旦有空位，我马上通知你。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.english: It looks like we don't have any spaces available at the moment, but I'll let you know as soon as one becomes free.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.chinese: 哎呀，真不巧，现在有点忙，要是你能再等一会儿，我尽快给你安排个位置。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.english: Oh darn. We're a bit busy at the moment. If you could just wait a little bit longer, I'll have a space assigned to you as soon as possible.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.chinese: 目前确实没空位了，不过我已经把你加进等候名单，很快就会有位置腾出来。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_inform_storage_notavail.english: So, there aren't any spaces free right now, but I've added you to the waiting list. Should be something available soon.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.chinese: 正在为你出发做最后准备，稍等一下。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.english: Making final preparations for your journey now. Please stand by.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.chinese: 咱们这就出发，麻烦等一下，马上就好。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.english: Let's get you on your way. Hold for one moment, please.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.chinese: 好了，稍等片刻，我们马上把一切都准备好。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_departure_aneut.english: All right. Hold for one moment, and we'll get everything ready.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.chinese: 又见面了啊，我记得你已经有位置了...没错，就在那儿。你现在就可以把飞船开进来了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.english: Hello again. I think you already have a space assigned to you... Yeah, there it is. Feel free to go ahead and bring in your vehicle.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.chinese: 嗨，又碰上了。你的位子还留着呢，随时能用。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.english: Hi again. Your spot is still assigned to you and ready for use.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.chinese: 又见面啦，看来你还留着一个位置没用呢。直接把船开进来就行，剩下的交给我们。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_already.english: Hello again. It looks like you still have a space waiting for you. Just bring your vehicle in and we can take care of the rest.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.chinese: 嘿，想给你的飞船找个停靠位是吧？没问题，稍等一下，我给你找找有没有空位。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.english: Hey there. Looks like you want a spot for your vehicle. No problem. Hold on while I find you an available space.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.chinese: 嗨！欢迎来到新巴贝奇。我看看，应该能给你腾个位置。稍等一下，我确认清楚。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.english: Hi! Welcome to New Babbage. I think we might have a free spot for your vehicle. Wait one moment while I double-check.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.chinese: 哟，要停船是吧？我觉得有个特别合适的位置。稍等，我马上帮你确认是不是空着。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.english: Hi there. Trying to bring in your vehicle, huh? I think I have the perfect spot. Hang on and I'll make sure it's free.
Hi. Let me find a free spot for your vehicle.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.chinese: 你好，稍等一秒，我给你找个体面的空位。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.english: Hello. Wait one second while I find an available space.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.chinese: 嗨，我这就给你找地方，马上就好。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_request_storage_aneutra.english: Hi. I'll go ahead and locate a free spot for you. One second.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.chinese: 通知你一下，你的停靠位申请已经被取消了。如果需要帮助可以再联系我们，谢谢。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.english: This is to inform you that your space request has been canceled. Please contact us again if you need further assistance. Thanks.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.chinese: 我们已经把分配给你的位置取消了，感谢配合。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.english: We have gone ahead and canceled the space assigned to you. Thanks.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.chinese: 行，你之前那个停靠位已经取消了。要是还需要帮忙随时找我们。谢谢啊。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_revoked_storage_aneutra.english: All right, so the space assigned to you has been canceled. Feel free to contact us again if you need any more help. Thanks.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.chinese: 请记得及时把飞船开走，不然会被自动转移到存储区，谢谢。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.english: Please be sure to clear your vehicle from the area, or it will be moved into storage. Thanks.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.chinese: 得麻烦你把飞船挪一下，不然我们就要帮你收进存储了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.english: We're going to need you to move your vehicle or we will place it in storage for you.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.chinese: 现在得清空你的位置，好给别人腾地方。最好你自己把船开走，不然我们就只能动手存起来了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_storage_departtime.english: So we have to clear your space to make room for others. It'd be great if you could move your vehicle or we're gonna have to go ahead and store it.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructin.chinese: 嘿，不知道你有没有注意到，你的船正堵着关键通道呢。要是不赶紧移走，我们就得按规定扣了它。谢了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructin.english: Hey there. Not sure if you're aware, but your vehicle is blocking a critical path. If you do not clear the way, we'll be required to impound it. Thanks.

pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructin.chinese: 嗨，出了一点小状况，你的飞船挡到重要路线了。麻烦马上挪一下，不然就要被收走了。
pu_nbatc01_f_atc_warn_vehicle_obstructin.english: Hi. Little bit of an issue. Your vehicle is blocking a critical path. Please move it right away or it will be impounded.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_001_all.chinese: 好的，和你聊天很开心。祝你接下来的参观愉快。
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_001_all.english: All right, it was nice chatting with you. I hope you enjoy the rest of your visit.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_002_oka.chinese: 好的，和你交谈很愉快。祝你今天过得愉快。
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_002_oka.english: Okay, it was great talking with you. I hope you have a wonderful day.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_003_wel.chinese: 嗯，谢谢你的倾听。希望你在新巴贝奇玩得开心。
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_farewell_ig_003_wel.english: Well, thanks for listening. I hope you enjoy your time in New Babbage.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.chinese: 当你准备好探索星球上更多地点或启程前往其他星球时，可以乘坐 MT 地铁环线前往新巴贝奇星际空港。
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.english: Once you're ready to see more of the planet or head off world, use the MT MetroLoop to make your way to the New Babbage Interstellar Spaceport.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.chinese: 我给你讲个笑话。哪个标准地球月份有 28 天？——全部都有！
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.english: I have a joke for you. Which standard earth month has 28 days in it? All of them!

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.chinese: 你听过这个吗？没有飞行员却在飞行的飞船叫什么？——危险！
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.english: Have you heard this one? What do you call a spaceship that's flying without a pilot? Dangerous!

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.chinese: 我有一个搞笑的笑话。完全由氦气制成的移动腕部计算设备叫什么？——mobiGas！
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_inform_generalinfo_.english: Here's a funny joke. What do you call a mobile wrist computational unit that is completely made out of helium? mobiGas!

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_anythingelse_.chinese: 还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_anythingelse_.english: Can I help you with anything else?

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_assistance_ig.chinese: 嗨！有什么我能帮你的吗？
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_assistance_ig.english: Hi! Is there something I can help you with?

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_assistance_ig.chinese: 你好呀！今天需要什么帮助吗？
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_offer_assistance_ig.english: Hi there! How can I assist you today?
Hi. What can I do for you?

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_welcome_ig_001_hian.english: Hi and welcome to New Babbage.

pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_welcome_ig_002_hell.chinese: 你好，欢迎来到新巴贝奇，微科的首府城市，创造性创新与创新创造力相遇。
pu_nbgreeter01_f_lgr_welcome_ig_002_hell.english: Hello and welcome to New Babbage, capital city of microTech, where creative innovation meets innovative creativity.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.chinese: 急救服务小组请前往救护船库。急救服务小组请到救护船库。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.english: Paging Emergency Service Crew to the Ambulance Bay. Emergency Service Crew to the Ambulance Bay.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.chinese: 清创单位请前往危重伤患中心。清创单位请到危重伤患中心。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.english: Paging Decon Unit to the V.I.C. Decon Unit to the V.I.C.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.chinese: 监护反馈小组请前往手术室。监护反馈小组请到手术室。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.english: Paging Custodial Response Team to the Surgery Suite. Custodial Response Team to the Surgery Suite.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.chinese: 安保服务请前往调解室。安保服务请到调解室。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.english: Paging Security Services to the Mediation Room. Security Services to the Meditation Room.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.chinese: 技术支持请前往影像科。技术支持请到影像科。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_emer.english: Paging Technology Support to Imaging Services. Technology Support to Imaging Services.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 伊顿医生，请前往康复病房前台。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Would Dr. Eaton please visit the Recovery Ward desk. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 南达姆利医生，请联系药房。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Dr. Nandamuri, could you please contact the pharmacy. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 温特医生，手术室急需您的帮助。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Dr. Wendt, you are needed in surgery. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 马特利医生，您的病人正在康复病房等您。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Dr. Martelli, your guest is waiting for you at the recovery ward. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 病人本·艾维斯，请立刻回到病房。谢谢配合。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Would Patient Ben Alvis please return to their room as soon as possible. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 马哈利·芬顿，请联系最近的护士站。谢谢配合。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: Would Mahari Fenton please contact the nearest nurses station. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 请病人法兰·阿布舍注意，您的家人已经到了。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: This is a courtesy page for Patient Fran Absher, your family has arrived. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 请病人詹姆斯·哈顿注意，您的快递已经到接待处了。谢谢。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: This is a courtesy page for James Hatton. Your delivery has arrived at reception. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 请看到推车D2-A19的人立刻联系影像科。感谢配合。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: If anyone has seen cart D2-A19, please contact imaging services right away. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.chinese: 请停泊在装卸区的弯刀船主立刻联系机库工作人员。谢谢配合。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_staf.english: If you are the owner of the Cutlass parked in the loading dock, please contact the hangar crew right away. Thank you.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_well.chinese: 许多时候并不是越多越好，药物便是如此。用药请遵循医嘱。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_well.english: More isn?t better. At least when it comes to medication. Be sure to always follow your doctor's recommended dosage amounts.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_done_ig.chinese: 请注意。我们很高兴通知大家，情况已经得到妥善处理。对任何造成的不便我们深表歉意。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_done_ig.english: Attention. We are happy to inform you that the situation has been resolved. Apologies for any inconvenience.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_inprogr.chinese: 请注意。请注意。我们的工作人员正在尽全力解决目前的紧急情况。感谢大家的配合。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_inprogr.english: Attention. Attention. Our staff is diligently working to resolve the emergency as quickly as possible. Thank you for your ongoing cooperation.

pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_newba.chinese: 布林特沃斯护理中心欢迎您的到来，我们为您提供最棒的医疗服务。
pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_newba.english: Welcome to Brentworth Care Center, where getting better has never been better.

pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_thats.english: That's the way it goes, I guess.

pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_iu.chinese: 我以前认为那些老古董在胡说八道。但我发誓，每当暴风雨要来时，我这道老伤疤就会痒得不行。
pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_iu.english: I used to think all those old timers were spoutin' nonsense. But I swear, this old scar of mine itches something fierce whenever a storm's about to hit.

pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ih.chinese: 听说有两个新手在争论武器和能量武器哪个更好。你想知道哪个更好？无论哪个你能及时拿到的枪就是好枪。
pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ih.english: I heard two greenhorns arguing over whether ballistic or energy weapons are better. You wanna know which is better? Whichever bloody gun you can reach in time.

pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_th.chinese: 有传言说十字军可能在考虑出售他们的星球，我想拥有一个完整的世界可能并没有想象中那么好。
pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_th.english: There's a rumor going around that Crusader might be looking to sell their planet. I guess owning an entire world might not be everything it's cracked up to be.

pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_si.chinese: 现在在处理几件事。不过我还不太确定。还在试探情况，但如果一切顺利的话？可能会很大。
pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_si.english: Sitting on a couple things right now. I don't know though. Still testing the waters, but if they line up right? Could be big.

pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_la.chinese: 我之前的那件小事没成功，但你得继续努力。总不能一直输，对吧？不过我对下一次有个好感觉。
pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_la.english: Last little thing I had didn't quite work out, but you gotta keep at it. Can't lose all the time, right? But I got a good feeling about the next one.

pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_hadar.chinese: 有一次我跑到废墟空间站的深处，那里还有种特别的疯子想要住在那儿。我心里只想赶紧跑路。
pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_hadar.english: Had a run take me down into the bowels of Ruin Station. There's a special kind of crazy that wants to live down there. I couldn't get out of there fast enough.

pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_im.chinese: 我还好，不过说实话，我可能偶尔会试探一下，但你看看这些公司的作为，那真全是犯罪。
pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_im.english: I'm all right, but I'll be honest. I may occasionally dip my toe, but you look at the shit some of these corps are doin'? That's real criminal.

pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_we.chinese: 我参加了那种在奥里森的鲸鱼之旅，结果连一根毛都没看到。说真的，你花了钱还看不到鲸鱼，那就该退钱！
pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_we.english: Went on one of those whale tours on Orison. Didn't see shit. You ask me, if you pay for a tour and don't see one, you get your money back.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_te.chinese: 告诉我，有什么新消息吗？

pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_ivehe.chinese: 我听过更奇怪的事，如果你能相信的话。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_ivehe.english: I've heard stranger, if you can believe that.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_allth.chinese: 所有有趣的事情都发生在你身上。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_allth.english: All the fun stuff happens to you.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bu.chinese: 生意一直在好转。有一些后勤问题阻碍了我们的扩张，但我正在解决这些问题。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bu.english: Business has been improving. There have been some logistical issues that have mitigated some of our expansion, but I'm resolving them.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_forbe.chinese: 作为一个无序的战区，我发现当地的一些美食相当不错。我是说，这里的人可能在社会底层，但他们是有创造力的底层。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_forbe.english: For being a lawless warzone, I do find some of the local cuisine quite good. I mean, the people here may be dregs, but they're creative dregs.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_on.chinese: 我的一艘飞船在从18区出来时被碰了一下。不知道他们的空中交通管制是傻子还是飞行员们都是疯子...也可能两个都是。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_on.english: One of my ships got clipped coming out of Area18. I don't know if their ATC is stupid or people are just insane pilots… probably both, actually.

pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_iv.chinese: 我刚刚去过奥里森，我越来越喜欢哪个地方了，我现在一直在考虑把我的公司设在那里。
pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_iv.english: I've just been visiting Orison. I've grown quite fond of that place. I've actually been thinking about basing my company out of there.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_002,p.chinese: 啊，我不知道。听起来很有压力。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_002,p.english: Yeah, I don't know. Sounds stressful.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 这些边境战士可能有他们的道理。如果人们不想被当作不法分子，那他们就不该生活在派罗。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: These Frontier Fighters might have the right idea. If people don't want to be treated like outlaws, then they shouldn't live in Pyro.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 整个边境战士的事情是真的烂。我们还在跟剜度打仗，人类能自己先内讧呢？
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: This whole Frontier Fighter thing is awful. How can Humans even be fighting each other when we're in the middle of a war with the Vanduul?

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.chinese: 挺好的，大概？（更确定）是的，我挺好的。试着乐观一点，你知道吗？有时候还真管用。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.english: Good, I think? (more certain) Yeah, I'm good. Trying to be more positive, you know? Sometimes it works.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.chinese: 最近一直在试着远离城市。只是感觉太频繁地被压得喘不过气来了，休息一下挺好的。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.english: Been trying to get away from cities lately. Just been feeling overwhelmed way too often. It's good to take a break.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 这里的情况越来越疯狂了。我只是在尽量保持低调，别被人爆头了。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: Things are getting nuts out here. I've just been trying to keep my head down and not get it shot off.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 我迫不及待想回家了。每次经过这里，我都紧张得没法好好睡一觉。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: I can't wait to get home. Every time I pass through here, I'm so on edge I can't ever get a decent night's sleep.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.chinese: 我想知道到底发生了什么。我想有人检查一下我的印记，确保它正常工作。他们说这玩意儿应该是安全的。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.english: I want to know what's going on. I want somebody to check my imprint and make sure it's working. They said this shit was supposed to be safe.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.chinese: 我快要崩溃了。我基本无法离开我的公寓，因为我害怕会被飞船撞到，然后我就完蛋了。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.english: I'm freaking out. I can barely leave my hab because I'm terrified I'm gonna get hit by a ship or something and that's gonna be that.

pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p.chinese: 我发现了一个追踪进出太空港商业飞船的服务，看着它简直让人着迷。我一直在用它助眠。
pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p.english: I found this service that tracks commercial ships in and out of spaceports. It's hypnotic as hell to watch. Been using it to help fall asleep.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_greetinggeneric_ig_.chinese: 你那边事情进展得咋样了？
跟我聊聊你那边的情况呗。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_greetinggeneric_ig_.english: Fill me in on what's going on with you.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_.chinese: 有时候你就得顺其自然呗。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_.english: Sometimes you just gotta go with the flow.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 还是不敢相信袭击斯坦顿的居然是边境战士。我还跟很多人夸过他们来着。现在真是让我自己啪啪打脸了。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: Still can't believe the Frontier Fighters are the ones who attacked Stanton. I talked 'em up to so many people. Sure making me eat my words now.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 本来还指望边境战士能让派罗对我们这些打工人更安全点呢，但结果嘛，屁用没有。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: Was really hoping the Frontier Fighters would make Pyro safer for us working folks. But that sure as shit ain't happening.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.chinese: 哦，你知道的，就是尽量把事情简单化。工作去哪儿我就去哪儿，努力比麻烦快一步。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.english: Oh, you know, focused on keeping thing simple. Going where the work takes me, and trying to stay a step ahead of trouble.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.chinese: 最近有点不太顺，但岁数大了也知道抱怨没用。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.english: Been better, but old enough to know there's no use in chewing your ear off about it.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 前两天打捞到一个27年的冷冻之星冷却器，本来以为捡到宝了，结果太阳耀斑直接把它烧坏了。真是倒霉透顶。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Salvaged a '27 Cryo-Star cooler the other day. Thought I'd hit the jackpot but the solar flares fried it good. Can't catch a break.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 我一整天都在跑诊断检查和校准组件。在派罗干活之前，确保一切正常总是没错的。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Spent the day running diagnostic checks and calibrating components. Always good to know everything's in tip-top shape before working Pyro.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 有时候真不知道自己为啥还在这儿。我已经不知道在这个操蛋的星系里失去了多少朋友了。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Wondering why I'm even here. Can't tell you how many friends I've lost to this damn system.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.chinese: 我现在感觉不太好。不知道怎么回事，自从上次再生之后，我就一直觉得不对劲。
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.english: Not feeling too good right now. Don't know what's going on, but I haven't felt right since my last regen.

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.chinese: 你有没有听过帕克·特雷尔关于再生能力是希安人对我们搞的某种大阴谋的长篇大论？现在听起来也没那么疯狂了，对吧？
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.english: You ever catch the Parker Terrell rant about regen being some grand Xi'an conspiracy against us? Doesn't seem so crazy now, does it?

pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsestanton_ig_.chinese: 不知道是不是我自己的问题，每次我去奥里森的时候嘴里总有一种奇怪的味道。我在想是不是那里的空气里有什么气体，我特别敏感？
pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsestanton_ig_.english: Not sure if it's just me, but every time I visit Orison I get this weird taste in my mouth. Wonder if there's some gas in the air there that I'm sensitive to.

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_greetinggeneric_ig_.english: So anyway, what's going on with you?

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_.chinese: 我真心希望那对你有帮助。
pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_.english: I sure hope that works out for you.

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 我很高兴大家终于意识到这些边境战士就是一群混蛋。我一直以来对他们的感觉就很不好。
pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: I'm glad people finally figured out that these Frontier Fighters are a bunch of assholes. Always had a bad feeling about them.

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 我真的搞不懂这些边境战士到底在想什么。杀无辜的人就为了证明一个观点？这对我来说完全讲不通。
pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: I just don't know what these Frontier Fighters were thinking. Killing innocent people just to prove a point? It doesn't make sense to me.

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 如果你不多问问题的话，派罗似乎有很多活儿可以干。前几天有个人付钱让我帮他处理一个箱子。这是我赚得最轻松的一笔钱了。
pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Seems like there's a lot of work in Pyro if you don't ask questions. The other day some guy paid me to dispose of a box for him. Easiest creds I've ever made.

pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responseregenhospit.chinese: 嘿，嘿，嘿——别无视我。我在跟你说话。你到底什么时候能解决这个问题？“我们已经尽力了”这种话根本不够！我需要知道到底发生了什么！
pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responseregenhospit.english: Hey hey hey - don't ignore me. I'm talking to you. When are you gonna fix this? "We're doing the best we can" isn't good enough! I need to know what's going on!

pu_npcvp16_bdc_greeting_ig_002,p.chinese: 最近有什么有趣的事可以讲讲吗？

pu_npcvp16_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_003,p.chinese: 我从没听说过这种事情。
pu_npcvp16_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_003,p.english: I have never heard anything like that.

pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 我原本和边境战士有几个工作安排，但现在不能做了。显然这会让我成为 UEE 的敌人什么的。真烦人。
pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: I had a couple of jobs lined up with the Frontier Fighters which I can't do anymore. Apparently it'll make me an enemy of the UEE or something. So annoying.

pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.chinese: 呃，别提了。我刚买了个新的 mobiGlas，默认音量设置成 100%。第一次收到通知时差点把我耳膜震烂了。
pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.english: Urgh, don't even ask. I just got a new mobiGlas and the default volume was set to 100%. Almost burst an eardrum when I got my first notification.

pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.chinese: 我真受够这些软件更新了。我刚买了这个 AR 镜片，似乎每天都有新的更新弹出来。给我烦死了。
pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.english: I am so sick of these software updates. I just bought this AR lens and every day it seems like I get another update popping up. Freaks me out.

pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 派罗这里的技术太过时了。我发誓我用过的马桶都比这些飞船终端复杂。
pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: The tech here in Pyro is so outdated. I swear I've used toilets more sophisticated than these ship terminals.

pu_npcvp16_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.chinese: 这是个笑话吧？如果你们的技术不保证有效，你们公司绝对不会发布这个技术，对吧？
pu_npcvp16_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.english: This is a joke, right? There's no way your company would release this technology if it wasn't guaranteed to work. Right?

pu_npcvp17_bdc_greeting_ig_001,p.english: You're not doing too bad, I hope?

pu_npcvp17_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p.english: That's the way it goes sometimes.

pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.chinese: 哦，没什么好抱怨的。昨天被困在电梯里几个小时而已，但没关系。
pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.english: Oh, can't complain. Got stuck in an elevator yesterday for a few hours, but it's fine.

pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.chinese: 我还过得去。我的儿子本来要来探望我，但临时取消了，所以有点难受。不过其他方面我还好。
pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.english: I'm getting by. My son was supposed to come visit me but had to cancel last minute, so that was hard. But otherwise I'm fine.

pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p.chinese: 你知道生活就是这样。起起伏伏的。我的公寓生命维持系统出了点问题，但也没那么糟。至少我还有地方住，对吧？
pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p.english: You know how life is. It has its ups and downs. My hab's life-support is on the fritz, but it could be worse. At least I have somewhere to live, right?

pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 我已经一个多星期没收到我儿子的消息了，我有点开始担心。他总是很忙，所以可能没什么事，但你永远不知道派罗的情况。
pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: I haven't heard from my son in over a week and I'm starting to get worried. He's so busy all the time so it's probably nothing, but you never know with Pyro.

pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 这里的情况变得太糟糕了，我在考虑自己组建一个帮派。也许那样我就能赚到一些体面的钱。
pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: It's gotten so bad out here I'm debating starting up my own gang. Maybe that way I could finally make some decent credits.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p.english: Yup, it's some bullshit, ain't it.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 最近琢磨着要不要武装起来干几个边境战士。我这人不好斗，但这些混蛋必须收拾。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: Been thinking about arming up and hunting down some Frontier Fighters. I'm not a violent person, but those assholes got to go.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 刚接了几单活，帮我那个被边境战士弄死的兄弟跑腿。妈的，希望这帮畜生早点被灭。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: Had to pick up a couple runs for a buddy of mine that got killed by the Frontier Fighters. God, I hope they get stomped out soon.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.chinese: 老一套破事。日常打工。跟个乖孙子似的拼命赚钱糊口。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p.english: Same ol' bullshit. Different day. Trying to make ends meet like a good little consumer.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.chinese: 昨晚通宵没睡光坐着想事情。没放音乐、没开光谱、灯都没开。就坐在窗边发呆。这感觉挺震撼的。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p.english: Stayed up all night last night and just thought. No music, no spectrum, no lights even. Just sat by the window and thought. It was powerful.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 这儿的人根本不懂珍惜自由。对他们来说自由就是互相伤害的通行证。真特么可悲。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: People out here don't even appreciate the freedom they have. To them, it's just an opportunity to exploit and hurt each other. It's a shame, really.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 我说不定真会搬来派罗。都说这是战区，但我觉得这儿的人活得特别真实，跟我气场很合。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: I might actually move out here. I know people say Pyro's a warzone, but I don't know. I kinda just vibe with the people I feel like they're living right.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.chinese: 以前收钱的时候什么都好，现在要讨说法就突然装死了？常规操作。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.english: You've always been happy to take my creds in the past, but now that I need answers, suddenly you can't do anything for me? Typical.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.chinese: 得了，浪费时间。调我账户出来。立刻删除印记数据，全额退款。现在就要。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_.english: You know what? This is a waste of time. Pull up my account. I want you to erase my imprint and I want you to give me a full refund. Now.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.chinese: 其实挺高兴印记技术垮台的。不会死的人生还能叫人生吗？...对，我现在就这心态。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.english: I'm actually kinda glad this regen thing's falling apart. Life's not really life if it doesn't end…. So yeah, that's where my head's been at.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.chinese: 我把印记数据删了。说实话，连能不能用都没保障的东西留着干嘛。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.english: I scrapped my imprint. To be honest, I don't think it's even worth having if I'm not sure it'll work.

pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p.chinese: 整天看着这个星系的社畜们为老板疲于奔命。太可悲了，这些人就是不愿醒过来。
pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p.english: Just spending my time watching all the drones of this system scurry around trying to do Master's bidding. It's pretty pathetic; they just need to wake up.

pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_thatsh.english: That's how it goes, I guess.

pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bee.chinese: 我一直在准备另一次运输，但眼下资金有点紧，所以干些副业挣点外快。
pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bee.english: Been looking to put together another haul, but credits are a bit tight at the moment, so, pulling some hustles on the side.

pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ifi.chinese: 要么这个，要么那个。不过嘿，这就是这个大宇宙的运作方式，对吧？无论好坏，总是在变。
pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ifi.english: If it ain't one thing, it's another. But hey, that's just how this big ol' 'verse works, right? For better or worse, things just keeps on turning.

pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_imnots.chinese: 我不太确定在这里跑腿还有没有意义。就因为外面那些疯子，十次里有九次，我花在修船上的钱比赚的还多。
pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_imnots.english: I'm not sure it's worth doing runs through here anymore. With all the lunatics out there, nine times out of ten I spend more on repairs than I get on the run.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 我听说以前学校的一个同学，把生活中的一切和所有人都抛下了，跑去加入了边境战士。从那以后就没人再听说过他的消息。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: Guess this kid I went to school with dropped everything and everyone in his life to join the Frontier Fighters. No one's heard from him since.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.chinese: 切割者在斯坦顿发动袭击的时候我也在那儿。场面太疯狂了。边境战士肯定攒了一大堆因果要偿还了。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig.english: I was in Stanton when the attacks by the Slicers went down. It was wild. Frontier Fighters sure have a whole lotta bad karma coming their way.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.chinese: 感觉快闷出毛病了。这几天一直躺着跟感冒作斗争，真是烦死了。我感觉市面上的药都吃遍了，可还是没好利索。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_.english: Going a little stir-crazy. Been laying around the past few days battling this nasty cold. Think I've taken every med on the market and still can't kick it.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 我遇到一个在这儿住了快百年的老人。我向她讨教生存技巧，结果她只跟我说了一句“管住嘴就对了”。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: I met this old timer who's lived here for almost a century. Kept asking her for tips about how to survive, and all she would say is "keep ya' trap shut".

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 又收到我爸发来的通讯了。他关心我的状况真的很贴心，但我不知道该怎么回他。如果他知道我在派罗，估计会气疯吧。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Got another comm from my dad. Sweet of him to care about how I'm doing, but not sure how to respond. He'll lose his mind if he finds out I'm in Pyro.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.chinese: 我有没有告诉过你，我顺道去了一个繁荣公民的定居点？那边感觉挺正常的，甚至无聊到让我觉得自己好像回到了家一样。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie.english: Did I tell you I swung by a CFP settlement? Things felt normal there. Like almost boring enough to make me think I was back home.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenhospit.chinese: 我得知道我是不是有问题。六个月前我刚重生过一次，现在感觉挺好的，但最近大家都在说印记出问题了，搞得我也开始担心了。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenhospit.english: I need to know if something is wrong with me. I regened about six months ago, and I feel fine, but all this talk about imprints being messed up has me worried.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.chinese: 回想整个重生的烂摊子，真是疯狂。政府当时说“我们解决了死亡”，然后所有人就真的信了。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.english: Thinking back on this whole regen debacle, it's wild how the goverment was like "we solved death," and everyone just believed them.

pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.chinese: 唉，估计我那些莽撞的日子也到头了。现在没法保证我还能重生，以后想做点刺激的事情都得三思而行了。
pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic.english: Well, guess my days of being reckless are over. Now that there's no guarantee I'll regen, I might have to think twice before actually doing something fun.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_greeting_ig_003,p.english: So, come on, talk to me.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p.english: Well, do what you gotta do.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 早说边境战士那群人全是混蛋。他们非要硬闯派罗那劲儿就特么离谱。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: I knew the Frontier Fighters were a bunch of assholes. They were just way too gung-ho about busting into Pyro.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.chinese: 真希望猎头帮能收拾边境战士。要不是活太多走不开，老子亲自送他们上路。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_.english: I hope the Headhunters get ahold of the Frontier Fighters. I'd kill them myself, but I got too much work keeping me busy.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 还在找门路。听说有几单活不错，正琢磨着呢。走着瞧吧。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: Still trying to make some moves. Caught wind of a couple opportunities that I'm looking into. We'll see.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.chinese: 暂时还没被人爆头。不过照派罗这尿性，谁知道能撑多久。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0.english: Haven't gotten my head blown off yet. Way Pyro's headed, we'll see how long I can keep saying that.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.chinese: 巴不得印记技术彻底崩溃。以前人怕死的时候多省心，现在啥阿猫阿狗都敢来挑事。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00.english: I'll be glad if this whole regen thing totally collapses. Made my life a lot easier when people were scared of dying. Made them less eager to mess with this.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p.chinese: 说真的，在斯坦顿待越久越觉得这儿的人都是软蛋。<冷哼> 真特么可悲。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p.english: You really wanna know? The more I hang out in Stanton, the more I'm convinced the people around here are soft as hell. <derisive snort> It's pathetic.

pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p.chinese: 得喘口气。每次来斯坦顿就冒出无数人想雇我干活，累得要死。
pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p.english: I need a break. Every time I come to Stanton, people come out of the woodwork trying to hire me to do shit. It's exhausting.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_001_sot.chinese: 那么，告诉我你最近怎么样了？
pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_001_sot.english: So, tell me a bit about what's going on with you?

pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_wellth.english: Well, that's the way it goes, right?

pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wouldn.chinese: 我自己可不会这么说，但我懂你。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wouldn.english: Wouldn't have put it like that myself, but I get what you mean.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.chinese: 上周我遇到了一些边境战士。一群混蛋在抢我的时候还试图解释我为什么是在“帮助他们的事业”。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.english: Ran into some Frontier Fighters last week. Bunch of douchebags tried to explain why I was "helping the cause" while they were robbing me.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.chinese: 老实说，我最近有点迷茫。派罗那边的事情不断升级，边境战士又在攻击斯坦顿，我很难离开我的公寓。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.english: Been in a bit of a tailspin honestly. With everything popping off in Pyro and Frontier Fighters attacking Stanton, it's been hard to leave my hab.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.chinese: 我不在乎为什么它不管用。你们的工作就是做再生，快把印记扫描器修好。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.english: I don't care why it's not working. It's your job to do Regens, so fix the imprint scanner already.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.chinese: 你确定我今天不能做印记吗？我刚刚有一个非常重要的记忆，我不想失去它。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.english: Are you sure I can't do an Imprint today? I have a really important memory that I just made and I don’t want to lose it.

pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001.chinese: 这整个再生失效的事儿真是糟糕透顶。我刚花了一大笔信用点报了个飞船赛车课程。
pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001.english: All this regen failing business couldn't have come at a worst time. I just dropped a bunch of credits on a ship-racing class.

pu_npcvp3_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_any.chinese: 你那边有什么新鲜事吗？

pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_ivebee.chinese: 其实我一直在观光。我从小就听说派罗是个鬼地方，但我得说，这里有些地方真的很漂亮。
pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_ivebee.english: I've been doing some sightseeing actually. I grew up hearing about what a hellhole Pyro is, but I gotta say, there are some pretty places around here.

pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_pickin.chinese: 在这里找些零工做做。所有这些帮派互相争斗的好处就是，总有一些人需要点帮手。
pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_pickin.english: Picking up some work here and there. Nice thing about all these gangs at each other's throats is that there's always someone who could use an extra gun or two.

pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_gotjum.chinese: 我刚出住处就被袭击了，那家伙的表现就像我杀了他的全家一样...也许我真该杀他全家。谁知道呢，我现在连他们是谁都分不清了。
pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_gotjum.english: Got jumped heading out my hab earlier. Guy acted like I'd killed his family or something… maybe I had. I don't know. I can't even tell 'em apart anymore.

pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_guesst.chinese: 我想这有时候就是这样。
pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_guesst.english: Guess that's the way it is sometimes.

pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_ihopee.english: I hope everything works out for you.

pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_imnots.chinese: 我不太确定这些繁荣公民的人到底想干什么。他们真的认为自己能造成改变吗？我一直在想，他们到底能从中得到什么。
pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_imnots.english: I'm not sure what to make of these Citizens for Prosperity people. Do they actually think they can make a difference? Just keep wondering what's in it for them.

pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_feelsg.chinese: 能有些信用点在手真不错。终于可以给自己买一顿体面的饭了。真不确定自己还能吞下多少个卡拉菲能量块。
pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_feelsg.english: Feels good to have a few credits to my name. Finally can buy myself a decent meal. Not sure how many more carafi cubes I was gonna be able to choke down.

pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_ido.chinese: 我真搞不懂人们怎么能整日在奥里森生活。我需要坚实的地面，而那些漂浮的平台根本不行。
pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_ido.english: I don't know how people can live in Orison full time. I need solid ground under my feet, and some floating platform doesn't cut it.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_greeting_ig_001,p.chinese: 最近生活对你还不错吧？
pu_npcvp5_bdc_greeting_ig_001,p.english: Life been good to you recently?

pu_npcvp5_bdc_greeting_ig_003,p.english: What's been going on with you?

pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p.chinese: 就像我老爸说的，生活是无法控制的，只能尽力去过好。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p.english: As my Pops says, you can't control life, just gotta live it the best you can.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_002,p.english: Gotta take things a day at a time, right?

pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_003,p.english: Some things just boggle the mind.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.chinese: 我听说了阿梅利亚·博伊德的过去，真的很难过。这并不能为边境战士所做的事情辩解，但我还是为她感到难过。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.english: I heard about Amelia Boyd's past and it was really sad. It doesn't excuse what the Frontier Fighters have done, but still. I feel bad for her.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.chinese: 我一直为那些边境战士受害者的家庭感到非常难过。真是太可惜了。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.english: I've been feeling really bad for all those families of the Frontier Fighter victims. It's such a shame.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.chinese: 我希望政府至少能听听边境战士的声音。如果他们能多关注一下，或许就能阻止这一切发生。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i.english: I wish the government would have at least listened to the Frontier Fighters. They probably could have stopped all of this if they just paid attention.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_00.chinese: 昨天我去了一个繁荣公民的前哨站。这个星系真需要更多这样的地方。我可能会考虑为他们多做点工作。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_00.english: I stopped by a Citizens for Prosperity outpost yesterday. This system could use a few more places like that. Might look into doing some more work for them.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.chinese: 我想知道到底发生了什么。我想让人检查一下我的印记，确保它能正常工作。他们说这玩意儿应该是安全的。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0.english: I want to know what's going on. I want somebody to check my imprint and make sure it's working. They said this shit was supposed to be safe.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001.chinese: 我很害怕，我承认。知道如果发生悲剧，人们并不会真的消失，这感觉真的很美好。但现在...一切又回到了从前。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001.english: I'm scared. I'll admit it. It was really wonderful to know that if tragedy struck, people weren't really gone. But now… it's back to the way it was before.

pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_003.chinese: 我现在小心多了，这点我得承认。自从这再生技术出事以来，我在漂流时确实变得更加谨慎。
pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_003.english: Being a lot more careful, I'll tell you that. Ever since this regen thing blew up, I'll admit I've been a lot more cautious on the drift.

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_001_soh.english: So how you been? You good?

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_fee.chinese: 感觉好像很久没见你了。你最近在忙什么？
pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_fee.english: Feels like I ain't seen you for ages. What you been doing?

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_you.chinese: 你看起来不错。最近忙什么呢？
pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_you.english: You're looking good. Been up to much?

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_yeahye.english: Yeah. Yeah, yeah, I feel that.

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_priceo.chinese: 我想这就是做生意的代价吧。
pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_priceo.english: Price of doing business, I guess.

pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_let.chinese: 我告诉你，有事情在发生。大事情。那种能把普通人变成传奇的事情。你懂我的意思吗？
pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_let.english: Let me tell you. I got things happening. Big things. Kinda things that turn a regular guy into a legend. You know what I mean?

pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_had.chinese: 我有一次任务去到赫斯顿的一个行政中心。跟你说，那帮人可能是宇宙里最大的傻逼，但他们知道怎么享受生活。
pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_had.english: Had a run take me to an executive center on Hurston. Let me tell you, they may be the biggest assholes in the 'verse, but they know how to live.

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_bee.chinese: 你最近有什么刺激的事情吗？

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_how.english: How are things in your neck of the woods?

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_youcan.english: You can only do what you can, right?

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_weallh.chinese: 我们每个人都有自己的要背负的东西。
pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_weallh.english: We all have our crosses to bear.

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wellev.chinese: 嗯，我想一切发生都是有原因的。
pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wellev.english: Well, everything happens for a reason I guess.

pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_its.chinese: 这段经历真是一次冒险刺激！见过一些我从未想过会见到的事情，还有一些，我老实说真希望没见过。但我想这就是旅程。
pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_its.english: It's been an adventure, you know? Seen some things that I never thought I'd see and others, I honestly wish I hadn't. But that's the journey, I guess.

pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_imetan.chinese: 前几天我遇到一个有趣的导游，她带我参观了派罗 III，好像是叫“盛放星”，她也不知道为什么叫这个。总之，那地方真的很美。
pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_imetan.english: I met an interesting guide the other day who showed me around Pyro III, which I guess they call Bloom. She didn't know why. Anyway, it was really pretty.

pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_bee.chinese: 好久不见，你最近怎么样？
pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_bee.english: Been a while, how have you been?

pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_allill.chinese: 我只想说，感谢每一个不用面对剜度的日子。
pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_allill.english: All I'll say is appreciate any day where you don't gotta deal with the 'duul.

pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_iverea.chinese: 我真的开始接受派罗了，以前我像躲瘟神一样避开它，但现在斯坦顿也全是不法分子，感觉一样危险。
pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_iverea.english: I've really come around on Pyro. Used to avoid it like the plague, but now that Stanton's also crawling with outlaws, it almost feels just as dangerous.

pu_npcvp9_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_everyd.chinese: 每一天都很珍贵，不是吗？
pu_npcvp9_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_everyd.english: Every day's a gift, isn't it?

pu_npcvp9_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_myo.chinese: 我姐姐们最近计划来看我。我在考虑带她们坐我的小刀，可能找个地方去越野一下。
pu_npcvp9_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_myo.english: My older sisters are planning to visit me soon. I was thinking of taking them on a ride in my Cutter and maybe landing somewhere to do a little off-roading.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 他们要封船了，你应该移步出口处。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: They're closing up the ship. You should head to the exit.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 今天的参观到此结束，大家请移步出口。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: We're wrapping up tours for the day. I need you to make your way to the exit.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 本船夜间将封船，大家请移步出口。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Ship's locking down for the night so please head to the exit.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 参观结束了，请大家离舰。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: Tours are over. Make your way off the ship.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 本区域不开放，请你离开。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: This area's off limits. You need to leave.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 你不能继续待在船上了。

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.chinese: 你是在违反法律，请你离开。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.english: You're breaking the law. You need to leave.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.chinese: 这里是禁区，快离开这里不然就逮捕你。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.english: You're trespassing. Get out of here or you'll be arrested.

pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.chinese: 如果你接着待在这里就会被逮捕。
pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.english: If you stay here you'll be arrested.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 看来我们今天的活动结束了，你该离舰了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Looks like we're wrapping up for the day. You should take off.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 他们马上就要封锁整条船了，你该走了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: They're locking down the ship soon. You should head out.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 嘿，活动就要结束了，你该动身出去了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Hey, we're closing up soon. You should roll out.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 你好，本舰马上就要封锁了，你该离开这里了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: Hey, ship's being locked down. You need to get out of here.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 我是认真的，你不能呆在这儿。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: I'm serious. You can't be here.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 今天的参观结束了，你得从船上下去了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: Tour's are done for the day. You need to get off the ship.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.chinese: 正经的，如果你待在这里，就会被拘捕。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.english: Seriously, if you stick around, you're gonna get arrested.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.chinese: 封船后你还在的话安保不会你好受的，你该走了。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.english: Security will mess you up if you stick around after lockdown. You should leave.

pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.chinese: 我们封船的时候你可不想在船上，如果是我就赶紧下去。
pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.english: You do not wanna be on board when we lock down. I'd get out of here.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Please head to the exit immediately.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 今天的参观结束了，是时候离开了。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Tours are over for today. Time to go.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 感谢大家参观，请移步至出口处。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: Thank you for coming, but please make your way to the exit.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 你不能再待在这里了，请立刻前往出口。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: You can't be here anymore. Head to the exit immediately.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.chinese: 本舰现在不对民众开放，你必须离开了。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_close_tour_done_ig_00.english: This ship is now off-limits to civilians. You have to leave.
I need you to leave. Now.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.chinese: 擅闯海军舰船是犯罪行为，下次我不会警告你了。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_001_.english: Trespassing aboard a Naval vessel is a crime. I won't warn you again.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.english: You are in violation of UEE law. Leave.

pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.chinese: 如果你继续留在本舰上，就会被拘留。
pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.english: You will be detained if you stay aboard this ship.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 很抱歉参观结束了。请你立刻离开本舰。
pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: I'm sorry but the tours are over. I'll need you to disembark the ship.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 我们今天不接待更多游客了，请稍后再来。
pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: We aren't letting any more visitors in today. Try again later.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.chinese: 今天的参观到此结束，请你离舰。
pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_close_tour_almost_ig_.english: We aren't giving any more tours today. You have to leave.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_farewell_ig_001_thank.chinese: 感谢参观，祝大家舰队周愉快。
pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_farewell_ig_001_thank.english: Thank you for coming and have a wonderful Invictus.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_farewell_ig_004_enjoy.english: Enjoy the rest of your Invictus.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.chinese: 对不起，但非法登舰违反了UEE法律。
pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_002_.english: I'm sorry, but illegally boarding is a violation of UEE Law.

pu_ntguide04_m_ntg_warn_trespass_ig_003_.english: Trespassing aboard a military vessel is a crime.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 没什么比激情的战斗更能让我躁动起来。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Nothing like a good fight to get my juices flowing.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 没什么比激情的战斗更能让我热血沸腾。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Nothing like a good fight to get my blood pumping.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 扣下扳机、喷出尾焰、爆炸四起。这就是生活的全部意义。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Squeeze of a trigger, flash of a thruster, and destruction all around. This here is what life's all about.
You're gonna wish you had never met me.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 或许我应该单手飞，这样对你公平点。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Maybe I should start flying one-handed, make things more fair.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 是不是感觉到自己大限将至了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: You feel the end coming. Don't you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I'm gonna enjoy putting you down.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 有什么遗言就现在说吧。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Now's the time for any last words.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 希望你已经准备好受死了，杂种。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Hope you're ready to die, asshole.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 看来你这辈子就到此为止了，兄弟。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Looks like it's end of the line, friend.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 你烧得和过光灯节的时候一样亮。

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Like shootin' crabs in a crate.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: That better have been an accident.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我还没死呢，你们这些狗腿子。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm not done yet, you punter.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 比这更惨烈的战斗我都活过来了。

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm not out of this yet.
It's going to take more than that.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 来啊，接着打啊，看看你有什么能耐。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Go on. Keep it up. See what it gets you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我要把你们全都活剥了！
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm going to flay you alive!

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 别做什么自己会后悔的事儿。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Don't do anything you're going to regret.
You lookin' to rile me up?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 这是你的最后一次警告！

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm not gonna warn you again.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 来啊，接着试探我的底线啊。

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 你肯定吓得牙齿打颤呢。
哈，我还以为那下能干掉你呢。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Huh. Figured that would have finished ya.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 那下可够你喝一壶的了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: You're gonna feel that one for a while.
Are you trying to get me killed?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 混蛋！ 我们是一边的！
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Hey asshole! We're on the same side!
Oh, you're going to pay for that.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Shields down! I could use some help!
Shields are gone! I need help!

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 好，护盾都没了，你是我的了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: There. Shields gone. Now I got you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 噢哦，你的护盾都没了哦。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Uh Oh. There go your shields.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 护盾失效，是时候让你肉疼了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Shields down. Time to do some real damage.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 有没有护盾，我都能干掉你。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Shields or no shields, I can still handle you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 想干掉我，光是打破护盾还远着呢。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Gonna take more than knocking out my shields to bring me down.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 等我护盾恢复了有你好看。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You're gonna pay once my shields are back.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 你觉得自己还能抗下多少发？
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: How many more of those you think you can take?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: Eye for an eye, you bastard.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 我要他妈的杀了你，你等着。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: I'm gonna get you for that. You wait.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 看到了吗？不费吹灰之力就干掉了那个混蛋。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: You see that? Took that bastard down easy.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 好了，又少一个麻烦要担心。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: There we are. One less problem to worry about.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 不得不说，我还挺擅长干掉这些杂碎的。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: I gotta say, I'm getting pretty good at taking down bastards like these.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 看到了吗？你就是下一个。
我还得杀掉你们多少人，你们才能醒悟过来。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: How many more of you I gotta kill before you get the point?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你们会比刚才那个可怜虫更能打吗？
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: You gonna put up more of a fight than that sorry bastard?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你的朋友们可真是擅长送死呢，是吧？
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Your friends are real good at gettin' ghosted, aren't they?

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 杀掉你们比我之前想的更好玩儿。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Killin' you all is turning out more fun than I thought it'd be.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: You showed that bastard right up.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 有你在这儿帮忙可真是太好了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: Sure as hell glad you're here.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: And here I thought we were friends.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 这年头真是谁都不能信。
总算知道你是哪边的了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Guess we know which side you're on.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好了，杂种。你把我惹毛了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: All right , bastard. You got me mad now.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Hell with it. I'll see you later.
Fine. We'll call it a draw.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 我溜了，希望你庆祝的时候把自己噎死。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: I'm gone. Hope you choke on vac.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 还没完呢，我会记住你的。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: This isn't over. I'll remember you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Let's see what you think of this.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 导弹送你了，看你怎么办。
pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Here you are. Deal with that.

pu_ntpilot01_f_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: Nice of you to drop in.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 这个应该能让你们尝尝九尾的厉害。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: This should teach you some respect for the Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你们应该庆幸量子航行到现在为止还能用。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: You're probably wishin' your QT still worked right about now.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 这里完事以后得去六角弯的老38酒吧来一杯。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Gonna need a drink at the Old '38 after this.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 现在你知道为什么全宇宙都怕九尾了吧。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Now you see why Nine Tails are feared across the 'verse.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 与我们作对只有死路一条。就这么简单。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Stand in our way, you die. Simple as that.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 你敢相信我们收了钱来坏你们的好日子吗？这笔生意很棒吧？
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Can you believe we get paid to ruin your day like this? Pretty sweet deal, eh?

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我们可是收了大价钱来捣乱呢。我很好奇十字军到底干了什么，值得这么大费周章。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Got paid primo creds to cause this kind of chaos. Makes me wonder what Crusader did to deserve it.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 至于我们的目的到底是什么，你肯定心急如焚地想知道吧。我会让你真的烧起来的。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Bet you're dying to know what we're doing all this for. I'll at least help you with the dying part.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 能派你们这帮半吊子佣兵过来，看来十字军真的是孤注一掷了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Crusader must be desperate if they're sending half-ass mercs like you in.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 这片区域全被我们封锁了，没有人能量子航行过来救你们这帮倒霉催的。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: We got this whole area on lockdown so forget about anybody QT'n in to rescue your sorry ass.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 知道自己无路可退的感觉还挺刺激的，不是吗？
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Kinda thrillin' isn't it? Knowing there's no way to run.
