pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 这是你这辈子最糟糕的决定。
什么，你以为我在开玩笑？
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: What, did you think I was bullshitting you?

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 你会为此付出血的代价。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: You're going to bleed for that.
You little shit. You're gonna regret that.
Fine. I was getting bored anyway.
You just signed your own death warrant.
Sorry about this. You should've left.
You should have left when you had the chance.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我不想这么做，但你让我别无选择。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I don't wanna do this, but you forced my hand.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 你想碰碰运气是吧，行，我们今天就来看看你运气有多好。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: You wanna push your luck, fine. Let's see how lucky you really are.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: [ 叹气 ] 狗改不了吃屎。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: [ Sigh ] You just can't help some people.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 算了，雇九尾来不是为了对付你们这种杂兵。我们还有更大的棋要下。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Forget this. Nine Tails didn't get hired to deal with scrubs like you. We got bigger hulls to vent.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 够了，我要是死了可没法花这些信用点。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Enough of this. Can't spend the creds if ya dead.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 今天的小打小闹就到此结束吧，你觉得呢？
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: I think that's enough mischief for one day, don't you?

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 看在我们是朋友的份上，就让你过去吧。但是帮我个忙，别去掺和九尾那档子事儿，行了快走吧。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Since you're a friend, happy to let you pass on through. Just do me a favor and don't get in the way of Nine Tails business. All right, get the hell outta here.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 你好啊，很高兴见到你，我们现在正忙着弄点事。你自己飞吧，但别在这块儿待太久了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Hey there, happy to see you but we're a bit busy right now. Feel free to head on your way. Just don't stick around for long.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 嘿，看在你是九尾盟友的份上，就让你过去吧。但要记住我们有活儿要干，我不会让任何人坏事的，包括你。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Hey, since you're a friend of the Nine Tails, I'm gonna let you pass through. Just know that we've got business and I can?t let anyone interfere, including you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 见到是朋友你，我挺高兴的；但是真不巧，你不应该来这儿。爽快点儿，在碰上什么麻烦前跑路吧。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: It's good to see a friendly face and all, but now's not the time for you to be here. Be a good sport and head on out before there's trouble.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你好呀，搁平时我们九尾还是挺高兴见到你的，但是现在你最好还是打道回府吧，别怨我，只是公事公办而已。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey there, normally us Nine Tails would be happy to see you but right now it'd be better if you just turned back around. Nothing personal.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 看在你是九尾的朋友份儿上，我就礼貌地请你离开这个地方吧。我们在这里有一票生意要做，任何人，包括你在内，都不能打扰。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Gonna ask nicely since you're a friend of the Nine Tails, but you need to clear out. We've got business and I can?t let anyone interfere, including you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嗨，我知道你和九尾关系挺好，我平时还挺高兴见到你的，可是前面那地儿现在封锁了，就算是你也不能进去。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey there, I know you're on good terms with the Nine Tails, and normally I?d be thrilled to see ya, but this area's off limits. Even to you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你不会不知道前面是九尾的地盘吧。就给你一次机会：掉头滚蛋或者我们把你干掉。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Guess you didn't hear, but this is Nine Tail's turf. You got once choice: reverse course or we're gonna ghost you.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 我有一个好消息和一个坏消息给你。好消息是你现在还没死；坏消息是你再不滚开就差不多到点儿了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: I got good news and bad news. Good news is you're not dead yet. Bad news is that's gonna change right quick if you don't get the hell out of here.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你要给你自己找上大麻烦了。我给你一次回头的机会，把握好。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Looks like you just flew into a bit of trouble. I'll give you one chance to get out of here. Take it. Now.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 瞧瞧是谁来我们这儿了？你是迷路了还是怎么滴。要是你不马上爬开，你就得永远留在这儿了。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: What do we have here? You look like you're lost. And if you don't leave right now, you're gonna stay lost. Permanently.

pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 九尾现在封锁了这个地方。做个小乖乖，赶紧跑路吧。我只会警告你这一次。
pu_ntpilot01_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: This area's under lockdown, Nine Tails order. Be a good little pilot, and run away. I'm only gonna warn you once.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你以为你对上我们有一丁点儿机会？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: You really think you got a chance against us?

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你不会以为你能干掉我吧？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Can't believe you actually think you can take me down.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你觉得你之后会成为什么英雄是吗？可太他妈蠢了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: If you think you're going to be some kind of hero after this, you're dumber than I thought.
Nothing like a dogfight to cure a hangover.
Whatever you're getting paid for this, it's not worth it.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 这就是你战斗的方式吗？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: What the hell kind of way is that to fight?
That's your strategy? Running into people?
Get the hell away from me.
You better back the hell up right now.
You're really starting to piss me off.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 你这飞行技术是语文老师教的吗？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Where the hell you learn to fly?
You seriously just run into me?

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: You should've run when you had the chance.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 现在我会杀了你，公事而已。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I'm gonna kill you now. Nothing personal.
You got heart. I'll give you that.
Guess you weren't up for the job.
It's only gonna get worse for you.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Watch where you're shooting.
Stop shooting me.
What was that? You shot me.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 要让你这种废物干掉我那可太丢面子了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'll be damned if I let some skag like you punch me out.
I ain't down yet.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你觉得你比我强？再想想。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You think you're better than me? Think again.
Yeah, all right, I'll give you that one.
You hit me. You happy?
You got a bit of skill.
Okay. Not bad.
I owe you one for that.
Hope you're enjoying this.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你打的每一下待会儿都如数奉还。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm gonna make you pay for each and every one of those.
Enough of this bullshit.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你继续，我保证你会后悔。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Keep this up and you're gonna regret it.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 仔细想好你接下来该怎么做。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Think real hard about what you do next.
I just about had enough of you.
Do that again, and you're going to regret it.
Final warning.
My patience is running out.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: I'm impressed you're still hanging in after that.
You're starting to piss me off.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 我开始觉得你是故意的。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: I'm starting to think that wasn't an accident.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 我的护盾离线了，需要帮助。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: My shields are down. Need backup.
Your shields are gone. You're screwed.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 看看你护盾恢复前我能干你多少？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Wanna see how much damage I can do before your shields recharge?

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 没有护盾，我要把你手撕了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Without shields, I'm gonna tear right through you.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 你觉得打掉我的护盾有用？好咋？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You think taking my shields out matters? So what.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 你觉得我没护盾就赢不了？再想想。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You think I can't win without shields? Think again.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 没有护盾我也能干烂你。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: I don't need shields to kick your ass.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 那一下快把你打碎了吧？
吃了一发还活着，不错呦。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Surprised you're still flying after that.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 我不会让你再杀我们的人的。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: I can't have you taking my people out.
Don't think for a second I'm just gonna let that go.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: They didn't put up much of fight did they.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 好，干掉一个，谁是下一个？
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: Okay. That's one done. Who's next?

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你朋友挂了，快逃吧不然你就是下一个。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Your friend's dead. Run away or you're gonna be next.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你们又死一个，待会儿就轮到你了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Got one of yours. Just a matter of time till it's your turn.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 和刚才挂掉那个比起来你水平如何？我们马上就会知道了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Do you think they were a better or worse pilot than you? Guess we'll find out.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 希望你有看到，刚刚那个被干掉的是你们的人。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Hope you're paying attention. That was one of yours we just got.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 瞧见了没？刚杀了你们一个。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: You see that? One of yours just got spaced.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: That was a nice bit of flying.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: Good. One less thing to worry about.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: You need to learn to listen better.
Don't say I didn't warn you.
Turning on the Nine Tails? Big mistake.
I've put up with enough of this shit.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 看来你比我想象的要厉害点。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Turns out you were better than I thought.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 今天不会成为我的忌日。

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Fine. You win. I'm out of here.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 导弹送你了，看你怎么办。

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Let's see how you do with a missile.

pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.chinese: 如果你是来打架的，那你来对地方了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: If you came to fight, you came to the right place.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: You really shouldn't have messed with Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 不敢相信十字军居然忽悠你去给他们卖命。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: I can't believe Crusader tricked you into fighting for them.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 我差一点就打破九尾内部的单日最高击杀记录了，也许你能帮我一把呢。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: I almost got the Nine Tails record for most kills in one day. Maybe you'll be the one to put me over.
I'm getting a little tired of you.
Nine Tails never back down from a scrap.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: This is just the beginning. You'll see.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 如果你真知道我们在干什，恐怕就不会这么想干架了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: If you really knew what was going on here, not sure if you'd be so eager to fight.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 看看你们，一个个连理由都不知道，但却气成这样。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Look at you all riled up and you don't even know the real reason why.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 你喜欢封锁吗？还不错吧？
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: You liking the blockade? It's a doozy, right?

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我告诉你吧，看到十字军吃瘪挺有意思的。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I tell you what, it's pretty fun seeing Crusader this pissed off.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 你知道封锁最有意思的地方在哪吗？你想逃也逃不掉。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: You know the best part of the blockade? You don't get to run.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 到此为止，你的机会用完了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: That's it. You had your chance.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I was hoping you'd do that.
That's one way to settle this.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 记住，你自找的，你本来可以走的。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Remember, this was your choice. You could have left.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好的，看来客气礼貌环节结束了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: All right. I guess we're done being polite.
There's only so much you can do to help some people.
I tried to give you a chance. I really did.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我还希望我们能避免闹到这一步。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: And here I was hoping we could avoid all this.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 够了。比起你这样的搅屎棍，九尾还有更重要的事情要考虑。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Enough of this. Nine Tails got bigger things to worry about than scrubs like you.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 你猜怎么着，我要撤了，但这还没完，九尾有周密的计划。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: You know what. I'm out of here, but this isn't over. Nine Tails got plans.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 可去他的吧。我收到的那点钱还不值得我这么拼命。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Hell with it. I'm not getting paid enough for this.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 既然九尾认得你，那我就让你过去一会儿吧。但别晃悠太久，不然你就有麻烦了。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Since the Nine Tails know you, I'll let you pass through. But don't hang around too long, or there'll be a problem.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 看来你在九尾那里还有点名声，那你过去吧。但我劝你别耍小聪明。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Seems you got a bit of rep with the Nine Tails so I'll let you fly through. Don't push your luck though.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 去干你的事情吧，别干扰我们就行。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Go about your business. Just see that you don't interfere with ours.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 九尾在这儿有事要干。只要你别来干扰我们，我们也不会妨碍你的事情。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Nine Tails got some business out here. As long as you stay out of our way, got no reason to stop you from conducting yours.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 你可以过去。我不会阻止你，除非你弄出点什么幺蛾子。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: You can head on through. I won't stop you. Unless you give me reason to.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 听着，公事公办，你不能来这里。掉头离开，不要不识好歹。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Look. Nothing personal, but you can't be here. Do yourself a favor and turn around.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿，九尾跟你没有任何过节，所以快离开这里。我不能让任何人在附近转悠，知道了吗？
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey. The Nine Tails don't have any beef with you, so get out of here. I just can't have you hanging around, okay?

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 听着。一般来说，你爱干啥干啥，但九尾在这儿有活儿要办所以我不能让你在附近闲逛。帮我个忙，快走吧。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Listen. Normally, I'd be happy to let you do whatever, but the Nine Tails got business here and I can't have you poking around. So do me a favor and clear out.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 我不知道你跑这儿来干嘛，但请你掉头离开。你不会想和九尾交恶的，我能告诉你的只有那么多。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Don't know what you're doing out here, but do yourself a favor and turn around. You don't want bad blood with the Nine Tails, I can tell you that much.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 两个选择。自己离开或者过会儿装进裹尸袋里离开，你选吧。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Here's the deal. You either fly outta here now, or later in a body bag. It's your choice.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 九尾在这里有要务，趁你还有机会，掉头离开。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: This here's Nine Tails business. Turn around while you still can.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你只有这一次机会离开。如果错过，后果自负。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: This is your one chance to turn around. If you don't take it, that's on you.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 现在掉头离开我们之间就没有任何问题。赖着不走的话，没有你好果子吃，信我。
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: If you turn around and leave right now, you won't have any issues. You stay, you're gonna have a problem. Trust me.

pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 简而言之，你飞进九尾的禁区了。自己掉头或者我们让你开花，清楚了吗？
pu_ntpilot02_f_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Let me make this simple. You just flew in to Nine Tails turf. Turn around or we put you down. Got it?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 令人欣慰的是，尽管科技进步了不少，人们还是可以在太空中射击对方。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: It's comforting to know that despite all our technological advances, two people can still go out into space and shoot each other.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 我只是想花点时间谢谢你，我在这儿很开心。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: I just wanted to take a moment to thank you. I'm having a great time out here.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 不知道有没有人和你说过，但你的飞行技巧让我想起了埃尔罗伊·卡斯。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: I don't know if anyone's ever told you this before, but you remind me of a young Ellroy Cass. At least in terms of how you fly.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你还记得我们为啥打起来吗？不过那也不重要了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Do you even remember what we're fighting about? Guess it doesn't really matter.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你在狗斗时会不会脑子里一直重复响起一段音乐啊？那也太糟了，对吧？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Do you ever get a song stuck in your head in the middle of a dogfight? It's the worst, isn't it?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我靠，给点个人空间好吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Woah, how about some personal space?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我靠，给点个人空间好吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Woah, how about some personal space?
You trying to tell me something?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我开始感觉你根本不知道怎么开你屁股底下那个机器了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: I'm starting to think you don't know how to fly that thing.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 有些人就是喜欢来硬的，你说是不是。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Somebody likes it rough, don't they.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 你作战的方式真的很独特。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: You got a real unique way of fighting.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 你有没有想过，额，不要这么做？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: You ever think about, you know, not doing that?
Crazy idea - stop frickin' ramming me!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 好吧，我也很高兴见到你。
让我猜猜，你飞行员课上学的是撞机速成班吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Let me guess, you took a crash course on being a pilot.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 在你咽气之前我得告诉你，和你一起战斗我很荣幸。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Before you die, let me just say it's been a real pleasure fighting you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 不敢相信这么快就结束了，我感觉我们才开始互相了解。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I can't believe it's going to be over so soon. Feels like we were just starting to get to know each other.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 看来你不太擅长狗斗吧？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Dogfighting doesn't really seem to be your thing, does it.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 着实有点惊讶，我本以为你能更厉害些。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I'm a little surprised. I thought you would be much better at this.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我得了结你了，别太难过哦。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I know I'm about to finish you off, but no hard feelings okay?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 以前我们在海军喜欢对这种情况说一句“命中”。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: As we used to say back in the Navy, that is a confirmed hit.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 看看我还能再来一次不。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Let's see if I can't do that again.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我不得不说，你真是个有意思的靶子。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I gotta say, you're pretty fun to shoot.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我已经开始享受这场战斗了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I'm really starting to enjoy this.
I feel like I could do this all day.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You feeling okay there?
Was it something I said?
How about we don't shoot our friends?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 帮我个忙，如果我死了，告诉我妈替我报仇，行吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Do me a favor. If I die, tell my mom to avenge me, okay?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 这就是个小剐蹭，我遇到过更糟的。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: This is nothing but a scratch. I've had worse.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我承认，你比我强那么一点吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'll admit it, you might be a bit better than I am.
You enjoy that?
Ouch? asshole.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你搁着到处射人你爸妈知道吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Do your parents know you go around shooting people?
Shooting at me make you feel big?
You got lucky.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我是真的有点恶心你了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I am seriously getting sick of you.
Isn't your trigger finger getting tired yet?
Hey, how about you ease up a little.
You sure you wanted to do that?
That was not the best idea.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 这样的话我开始喜欢你了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: And here I was just starting to like you.
What the hell is your problem?
Well, that sure sucked.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你知道吗，你这样真的伤我心。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You know? You're starting to hurt my feelings.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Did that hurt? It looked like it hurt.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 我希望你买了最高档的保险。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: I hope you have good insurance.
Geez. What the hell was that for?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 你和我有仇还是怎么的？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Are you mad at me or something?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 我的天，你打我这么狠的吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Geez. What the hell did you hit me with? A small moon?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 郑重声明，我一点也不喜欢那样。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: For the record, I did not enjoy that at all.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 大家都看见星星在转吗，还是我脑震荡了？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Anyone else seeing spots or is that head trauma?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 呃，嘿。我的护盾失效了，帮帮我。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Uh, hey. My shields are down. Maybe a little help.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 我的护盾没了，需要支援！
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Lost my shields. I would love some back up.
Uh oh! You lost your shields!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 哎呀不好了！你的护盾呢？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Oh no! Where did your shields go?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 哎呀，你的船前一秒还有护盾的啊？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Wait. Didn't your ship have shields like a second ago?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 淦，真希望我的护盾还在。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Damn. I really wish I still had shields.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 喂！我盾没了就别再打我了！
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Hey. No shooting me when my shields are down!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 如果能让我的护盾回一会儿我可谢天谢地了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: I'd really appreciate it if we could take a break until my shields came back.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 完全没觉得那下还能打中。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: I totally didn't think that was going to hit.
I can't believe that actually hit you!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 提醒你一下，你刚刚被一枚导弹击中了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Heads up. You just got hit by a missile.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 看来我那枚导弹没有白买。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Glad the credits I spent on that missile weren't wasted.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 向击中你的那枚导弹致以敬意，瑞斯拜。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Let's take a moment and salute that missile's dedication to taking you down.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 不敢相信你把他们杀了！他们几乎都没向你开过火。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: I can't believe you killed them! They were barely shooting at you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 你怎么能对他们下手呢？他们还有一个礼拜就要金盆洗手了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: How could you do that to them? They were one week away from leaving the pack.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 你个混账东西！他们还欠我钱呢。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: You bastard! They still owed me credits.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 不是我吹，我把那坨垃圾射穿了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: Not to brag, but I killed the crap out of that ship.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 你看见我把那丑逼干掉了吗？我可太优秀了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: You see me take that scag down? Am I good or am I good?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 干掉这群混蛋中一员的感觉太好了，强烈推荐。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: It feels so good to kill one of these bastards. Really recommend it.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你和他们不熟吧？不然感觉把你关心的家伙杀了我都有点过意不去呢。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: You weren't close to them were you? Hate to think we're out here killing people you care about.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你喜欢赌博吗？我和一朋友赌你是下一个死的。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: You like to gamble? I'm betting a friend that you're the next one to die.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 看着你朋友被炸飞一定不太好受吧，如果需要的话你可以哀悼一下。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Seeing your friend get blown up like that can't be great. Feel free to take a moment if you need it.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你朋友上一秒在自由翱翔，下一秒就骨灰飞扬，你是不是怀疑人生了？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: One minute your friend was here flying, the next minute gone. Makes you think doesn't it.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 不好意哦，把你朋友杀了。其实并不，但还是客套一下。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Sorry about killing your friend. Not really, but still.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: Yeah! You blew 'em up real good!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.chinese: 作为一起杀敌的战友，请让我说句打得漂亮。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: As one murderer to another, let me say nice kill.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.chinese: 好样的，兄弟，真是个把人炸飞的好办法。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: Good job, buddy. Way to blow someone up.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 妈的，你真是帮了大忙了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: Dang. Aren't you the helpful sort.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 你救了我一命，我可以留你在队里。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: You saved my bacon. I think I'm going to keep you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我猜我今年不会邀请你来我的生日派对了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Guess I won't be inviting you to my birthday party this year.
Ouch. This hurts coming from you.
Can't say I saw that coming.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 认真的吗？你这就要开火了？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Seriously? You're just going to start shooting people?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 真优秀，我没想到你还真有种。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: I'm impressed. Didn't think you had it in you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 行了！我不想当你友军了
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: That's it! We're not friends anymore!

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好的，我觉得我现在有一万个理由杀了你。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Okay. I feel totally justified killing you now.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 感觉我们没法友好相处了。

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 你猜怎么着，仔细想想，我还是闪人吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: You know what, on second thought, I'm just going to leave.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 完蛋，我都忘了我等下还有个约会，拜。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Ah crap. Completely forgot I had an appointment somewhere else. Later.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 瞧瞧现在都几点了，不早了。我们先到这吧，和你打得很享受。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Would you look at the time? It's getting late. Think we better call it there. Thanks for the fun fight and everything.
Sorry, hate to do this, but I gotta run.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 如果有人问起，那一定是你从我这溜了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: If anyone asks, you ran away from me.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 别紧张，我就朝你射了一发导弹。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Don't be alarmed, but I may have just shot a missile at you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 我们来看看你的狗斗技术如何。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Let's find out how good you are at dodging.
Sending you a little special something.

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 交个朋友别用任何反制手段，如何？
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Be a friend and don't use any countermeasures, okay?

pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.chinese: 你好啊，你长得有点像我的靶子。
pu_ntpilot03_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: Oh hey there. You look like someone I want to shoot.
A new fighter has entered the ring.
Welcome. So glad you could join us.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 今天就让你知道为什么不要找九尾麻烦。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: You're gonna learn the the hard way why you never pick a fight with Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你最近去过六角湾吗？我发誓见过那条船。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Have you been to Grim HEX recently? I swear I recognize that ship.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你知道他们为什么叫我们九尾吗？其实我也不知道。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Do you know why they call us the Nine Tails? Actually, neither do I.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你知道加入九尾有什么好处吗？可能是朋友？还可以杀你这样的人。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: You know the best thing about joining the Nine Tails? The friendships? and killing people like you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 你根本不懂惹怒一个星球的人有多爽，这比随便挑人下手有趣多了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: You have no idea how fun it is to be giving an entire planet a bad day. So much better than just randomly attacking people.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我在想，会不会因为我们大家开始才反思把星球卖给企业其实不是什么好主意？
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I wonder if thanks to us, people are starting to realize why giving a company their own planet might have been a bad idea.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 不能用量子航行不是很棒么？没机会逃跑的同时，你有充足的时间来盘点自己的一生。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Isn't having no QT great? Really gives you the time to take stock in your life. It also makes it impossible for you to run away.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 你知道我为谁感到遗憾吗？那些困在休息站里的人，他们现在估计真的安息了吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: You know who I feel sorry for? The people stuck on the Rest and Relax. They're probably way too rested and relaxed by now.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 这次封锁真是太棒了，这个年代都没人静下心来享受太空飞行了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: This blockade really is for the best. No one takes the time to really appreciate flying through space these days.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 我很高兴你深思熟虑后做了错误的决定。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: I'm glad you thought it over and came to the completely wrong decision.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 你刚才真的应该离开的。
你刚到这里的时候，我脑子里就一闪而过必须要杀掉你的念头。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: When you first got here, I had a sneaking suspicion I was going to have to kill you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好吧，如果这是你真正的感受。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Well, if that's how you really feel.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 看来有的人就是不听劝啊。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Looks like some people can't take a hint.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 开始播放我的狗斗专用曲。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Time to put on my dogfighting playlist.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 上一秒我们还称兄道弟，下一秒就是敌人了。噢，多么残酷的世界！
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: One moment we're cool and the next, enemies. Oh, cruel world!

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我不太清楚你的动机是什么，不过好啊，来开打吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Not sure I get your motivation here, but sure, let's fight.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 如果这就是你吸引注意力的方法，那可太成功了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: If this was your way of asking for some extra attention, you got it.
And I was really hoping I wouldn't have to kill you.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 就算我正在逃跑，我还是想说这永远是计划的一部分。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Even though I'm running away, I just want to say that was always part of the plan.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 我就先打到这，可是相信我，九尾给斯坦顿准备了不少大的。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: I'm gonna call it here, but trust me, Nine Tails got bigger stuff in store for Stanton.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 对于今天来说这点乱子已经够了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: I think that's enough chaos for one day.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 噢，看看来了个谁，我听说过你。不觉得我们放你走很良心吗？一路平安。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Oh, look who we have here. I've heard about you. Pretty nice of us to let you go, don't you think? Safe flying.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 吼，看看这是谁，我听说过你。不觉得我们放你走很良心吗？一路顺风。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Oh, look who we have here. I've heard about you. Pretty nice of us to let you go, don't you think? Safe flying.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 能在这看到你还真是吃惊。不过你不如帮我们个忙继续行驶，穿过此地。如果你的船出了什么意外，那可就讨厌了。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Nice surprise seeing you here. But why don't you do us a favor and keep on moving through. Hate for anything to happen to that ship of yours.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 见鬼，你怎么会在这种地方出现。我们这里要处理九尾的相关事件，我觉得你还是继续往前走比较好。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Oh shit, I didn't expect to see you here. We got a bit of Nine Tails business going on, but I think it's safe for you to go ahead.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 欢迎来到这个社区。我们目前有点忙，所以我就不管你了，你继续往前走。尽量别在这个区域逗留，祝你一帆风顺。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Welcome to the neighborhood. We're a bit busy here, so I'm just gonna let you fly on through. Try not to linger though. Have a good one okay.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 嘿，很高兴见到你。我今天太忙了，没法停下和你闲聊。你尽管忙你的，但是别在这里逗留，行吗？
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Hey. Nice to see you. Can't really stop and chat. Busy day and all. Feel free to go on with whatever you're up to. Just don't hang around here, okay.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿！没时间和你聊天，我们正在忙着给九尾弄点事情。你赶紧走，我不太想看到你在这里搞事情。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Oh hey! Wish I had time to chat, but we're pretty slammed doing Nine Tails stuff. You should head out. Don't want you getting caught up in anything.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿，听着。我知道你是九尾的朋友，但是你真的不能呆在这里，最好还是走吧。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey, listen. I know you're a friend of the Nine Tails and everything, but we really can't have you here. It'd probably be for the best if you head out.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 看到九尾的盟友固然很不错，但是事情现在变复杂了，所以我感觉你还是离开这里比较好。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: So, as great as it is to see a Nine Tails ally, things are a bit complicated at the moment so I'm gonna need you to head on out of here.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿，我不想说得难听，但是我们现在不能受一点干扰，就算你是朋友也不行。你最好还是现在掉头。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey, not to be rude, but we can't really have anyone interfering with us out here, even a friend like you. Best thing would be for you to turn around.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 好吧，有点尴尬，虽然你是九尾的朋友但是你介意还是离开吗？ 不能让你在这里增加风险，希望你理解。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Okay, this is a bit awkward since you're a friend of the Nine Tails, but would you mind leaving? We just can't risk having you here. You understand.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 我就当你不是故意飞入九尾地盘的，趁你还可以的时候赶紧离开这里。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: I'm gonna do you a favor and assume that you didn't fly into Nine Tails turf on purpose. Go on and get out of here while you still can.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿，我们正在忙着处理九尾的事情。好兄弟赶紧离开这，别逼我杀了你，谢谢。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey, we're a bit busy here doing Nine Tails stuff. Be a pal and leave before I have to go through all the trouble of killing you. Thanks.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嘿，现在可不是你来这里的好时机。你最好趁现在掉头离开。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey. Now's not really a good time for you to be here. You should probably turn around while you still can.

pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 友情提示：用飞船离开这，或者用灵魂离开。
pu_ntpilot03_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Bit of friendly advice - leave right now or we'll light your ass up.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 继续求饶吧，没用的。不过我倒是乐在其中。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Go ahead and beg for your life. It won't help you, but I get a kick out of it.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 看上去挺不公平的是吧，我对上你这样的飞行员。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Almost doesn't seem fair does it. Me versus a pilot like you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你的一生最终只会成为我人头数里的一个，不觉得可笑吗？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Ain't it funny that your whole life is going to end up being just another notch in my headcount.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 告诉你，不如你求我饶你一命。说不定我能放过你，虽说大概率不行，但是万一呢？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: I'll tell you what, why don't you beg for me to spare you. Maybe I'll let you live. Probably not, but who knows, maybe you'll get lucky.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 我几秒之内就能杀了你。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: The seconds are counting down until I kill you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我感觉他们就不该让你开飞船。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: I'm starting to think they shouldn't have given you a ship.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 你飞得比希安厨子还烂。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: You fly worse than a Xi'an cooks.
Geez. What the hell is with you?
You tryin' to get us both killed?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 你个怂包，能不能像个真正的飞行员一样战斗。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: Freaking coward. Fight like a real pilot.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我发誓如果你还继续这样，我可要喂你吃你的牙了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: I swear if you don't knock it off I'm gonna feed you your teeth.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 我血压已经被你拉的快爆了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: You are really starting to piss me off.
Do that one more time. I dare you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.chinese: 脑瘫，学学怎么开飞船吧！
要是我的涂装有刮花，你可要付出代价。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: If my paint is scratched, you're gonna pay.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我感觉你就要到头了，赶紧放弃吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I can feel it. I can feel it you're done. Just give it up.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 基本结束了，我吃定你了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: It's almost over now. I have you.
I can't wait to end you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 从现在起我随时都能干掉你。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Any moment now and it'll be all over.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 就是这样，这就是你的死法。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: This is it. This is how you're gonna die.
I'm gonna enjoy ripping you apart.
Woah, you even trying to dodge me?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我还以为你多大能耐呢，看来并没有。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: And here I thought you might be a challenge. Guess not.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 靠，什么玩意，你对我开火？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Damn it. What the hell. You shooting me?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 哇哦，我还以为我们是一伙的。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Woah. I thought we were on the same side.
Hey, you tryin' to be funny?
I'm just getting started.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你觉得你有本事干掉我？来让我见识见识。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You think you're good enough to bring me down? I'd like to see you damn well try.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 如果你觉得就凭你这样的二流飞行员能打败我那就来吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Go on, finish me if you think a second-rate scav like you can.
That was nothing.
Let's see you try that again.
You got lucky.
You're gonna pay for that.
I'm gonna make you bleed for that.
This the best you got?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你以为自己很厉害？这啥都不算。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You think you're good? This is nothing.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 来啊，让我尝尝你的能耐。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Come on! Bring it! Give me everything you got!
You're walking a fine line there.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你想打架是吧？那来好好打一架吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: If you want a fight, I'll give you a damn fight.
Go on, try that again.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我不会警告你第二次，停下。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm not gonna warn you again. Stop.
You're heading for some serious pain.
Knock it the hell off!

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 来看看你能抗下多少这玩意儿。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Let's see how many more of those you can take.
You've got to be kidding me with that.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 那真是个自杀的好办法！
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: If you want to get yourself killed, that's a pretty good way to go about it.
Something is seriously wrong with you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 你等着，我的下轮攻击会更加猛烈。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: I'm gonna hit you twice as hard. Just you wait.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 你不会以为那个有用吧？不会吧？不会吧？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: You think that's gonna stop me. Don't make me laugh.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 就这这也想拿下我？你还要努力啊。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: It's gonna take a hell of a lot more than that to put me down.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 护盾停机！快来个人帮我！
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Shields down! Someone get their ass over here to help me now!
No shields! I need back up!

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 我倒要看看没有护盾你能怎么办。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Let's see how you do without any shields.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 仔细瞧瞧你的护盾，你完了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You should have kept a closer eye on your shields. You're screwed now.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 没有护盾，看我活生生把你掐死。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Without shields, I'm gonna snatch the life right outta you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 你以为我需要护盾才能解决你？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You think I need shields to deal with you?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 打掉我的护盾对根本毫无影响。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You got my shields, but that's not gonna make a difference.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 等我护盾回来你就完了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Once my shields are back, you're done for.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 难以相信你居然这都能活下来。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Hard to believe you're still alive after that.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 你杀掉我们多少人，我都要让你双倍奉还。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: For everyone of us you take down, I'm going to make you pay double.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 哦，杀掉他们你可要后悔的。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: Oh, you're going to regret killing them.
You kill my friend, I kill you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 看见没？我就是靠那种漂亮的击杀赢得荣誉的。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: You see that? Kills like that are how I earned my rep.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 看，又少一个我们需要担心的家伙。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: There. One less thing we have to worry about.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 我正在这群菜鸡中砍瓜切菜
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: I'm cutting my way through these idiots no problem.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 刚刚干掉一个你的同伴，你猜下一个是不是你？
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: I just killed one of you. Think you're gonna be next?

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你的朋友已经魂归西天了，别担心，你马上就能和他团聚。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Your friend's a ghost, but don't worry. You'll be joining them soon enough.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你要是觉得自己的技术还不如刚才那个被我杀掉的家伙，那就赶紧跑吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: You think you're a better pilot than your friend I just killed? If not, you should run.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 我就很好奇，你们这种家伙今天我还得杀多少个。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: I wonder how many more of you I'm going to kill today.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 我曾经短暂地觉得你们可能不会太菜，不过现在我打算悠闲地享受弄死你们的过程。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: For a second I thought you and your friends would be a challenge, but I think I'm going to enjoy killing all of you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: I could have handled it myself.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.chinese: 噢，这一下那帮畜生知道不该惹我们了吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: Oh, that'll teach the bastard not to mess with us.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 嘿，能干掉那垃圾真有你的。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: Hey nice job taking that scav down.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 看来你根本不值得信任。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Guess you couldn't be trusted after all.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 又一个怂包小人，真是个惊喜。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Another gutless backstabber, big surprise there.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 呵，敢进九尾的地盘你会后悔的。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Argh, you're gonna regret crossing the Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我之前还在想你什么时候会漏出尾巴。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: I was wondering when you were gonna turn on us.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 终于露出你的真面目了。
我已经受够你的鬼话了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: I've had enough of your shit.
Oh, you've gone and done it now.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 和你这种垃圾战斗毫无意义。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: There ain't no point in fighting a worthless piece of shit like you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 下次再见，我可不会让你这么容易脱身。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Next time we fight, I'm not gonna let you off so easy.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 你晚上睡觉可别太死，我发誓一定会找到你。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: You better sleep with one eye open, because I swear I'm gonna come for you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 你今天走了狗屎运，但是好运可不会永远都有。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: You got lucky today, but that luck won't last for ever.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 好好好，这次是你赢了，可是下次你他妈死定了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: All right, this one's yours, but you damn sure won't survive the next one.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Let's see you try to run from this.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 试试看能不能摆脱这个。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Try and get away from this one.

pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.chinese: 让我看看这是谁？哦又一个受害者。
pu_ntpilot04_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: Well what do we have here? Another victim.
You made a big mistake coming here.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 希望你现在会好好想想自己对抗九尾的行为是有多愚蠢。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Hope you're starting to see just how stupid it was to try to go against the Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 现在你知道为什么九尾能掌控这片区域了吧？因为我们屌得一批。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Are you getting now why the Nine Tails control this sector? It's cause we're the best there is.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 我今晚一定回去给你敬杯'38黑啤。”敬一个今天被我干掉的蠢货。“
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: I'll make sure to toast you at the Old '38 tonight. "To the dumb scag I killed today."

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 别再惦记十字军星了，整个星系都马上是九尾的了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Forget Crusader. This whole system's gonna belong to the Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你会和那些所有碍事的家伙一样，死亡是你们唯一的归宿。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Same thing's going to happen to you that happens to anyone who stands in the our way: you're gonna die.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 每干掉一个像你一样的小崽子，老大就会开心一点。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: For every little welp like you I put down, my bosses get that much happier.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我会告诉老大，我把你们这些十字军狗腿子都给干掉了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Wait till I tell the big bosses how I just decimated all you Crusader lackeys.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 真是遗憾，你们可能活不到见证九尾伟大计划落实的那一天了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: It's too bad you're not going to be alive long enough to see the big plan us Nine Tails got cooking.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我之前还以为自己对这个封锁线计划没太大兴趣，不过看着你们这些胆小鬼挨打时想量子航行逃跑却束手无策的感觉真是有趣。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Didn't think I'd like this blockade as much as I do, but it turns out fighting's a lot more fun when cowards like you can't just QT away.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我还以为夺下这个区域对九尾来说将是苦战，没想到这么容易。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I didn't think it was gonna be so easy for the Nine Tails to take over a sector like this, but here we are.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我打赌你一定在祈祷你的量子引擎还能正常工作吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Bet you're starting to wish your quantum drive still worked right about now.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: Oh, I was hoping I'd get to kill you.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 你刚刚做犯了你一生中最的严重的错误。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: You've just made the biggest mistake of your life.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 你会后悔你刚刚的决定。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: I'm gonna make you regret that choice.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 你刚刚亲笔签下了自己的死刑令。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: You just signed your own death warrant.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 你早该离开，否则你会生不如死。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: You should've left. You're in for a world of pain.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: You wanna die, fine with me.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 哦，你会为你的愚蠢付出代价。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Oh, you're going to pay for that scag.
You just picked the wrong fight.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我喜欢他们，因为他们想加大难度。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I love it when they don't pick the easy way.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好吧，看来我们得拿你杀鸡儆猴了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Fine. Guess we're gonna make an example outta you.
Not gonna lie, was hoping things might go this way.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 本想放你一马，看来我得亲自动手了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I tried to give you the easy way out, now we do this my way.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我等得够久了，你用过你的机会了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Enough waiting around. You had your chance.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 时间到，你早该听我的赶紧离开。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Time's up. You should've left when I told you to.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我给过你机会了，你倒是非要碰碰运气。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I gave you a chance. You wanted to push your luck.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 你猜怎么着，我改天再来收拾你，今天我们的任务已经完成了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: You know what? I can just deal with you another day. We did what we set out to do and that's enough.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 很好，你赢得了战役，却不是整个战争，走着瞧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Fine, you won the battle. But not the war. You'll see.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 好了，收手吧，我觉得我们已经干的够多了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: All right, enough. I think we did what we needed to do here.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 你该庆幸你和九尾有不错的交情，否则你早就粉身碎骨了。现在赶紧离开，趁我反悔之前。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: You're lucky that you're in good with Nine Tails, otherwise I'd be dusting you right now. So here's your chance to get out of here before I change my mind.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 没想到在这儿见到你，帮我个忙，继续走别回头，我不想看到有人在这闲逛，你懂我意思吧。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Didn't expect to see the likes of you out here. Do me a favor and keep on moving. Can't really have people hanging out here if you get my meaning.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 听着，我不知道你在这干嘛，但是这绝不是一个闲逛的好地方，所以赶紧飞离，那样会更安全。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Look, not sure what you're doing out here, but it's not a good idea for you to hang around, so keep flying. Safer for you that way.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 看在你和九尾关系还不错的份子上，我给你个掉头走开的机会如何？
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Since you're on good terms with the Nine Tails, I'm going give you a chance to leave before there's any trouble. Fair?

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 好吧，是这样的，因为你和九尾关系还不错，所以我会放你走，不过如果你拒绝的话，哼，场面可就会很难看了。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: All right, here's how this is going to work. The Nine Tails know you so I'm gonna let you fly on out of here. If you don't, well, things are going to get messy.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 话说简单点让你明白，要么滚，要么死。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Gonna make this simple so you can understand. Leave now or get killed.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 这里是九尾的地盘，你只有一次机会掉头走开，不然我送你和你的飞船一起上路。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: This is Nine Tails turf now. You get one chance to leave before I vent you and your ship.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你今天运气不错，在我开火之前给你一个滚蛋的机会，我建议你抓住这个机会。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Today's your lucky day. I'm gonna give you a chance to turn around and get the hell out of here before I start shooting. I suggest you take it.

pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 听好了，你要么掉头滚，不然就受死。反正对我来说都一样。
pu_ntpilot04_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Here's what's going to happen. You either turn around and fly the hell away, or you die. Doesn't make a bit of difference to me either way.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你觉得谁能赢？你还是我？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Who do you think's gonna win? Me or you?

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 这样打不爽吗？我可太他妈喜欢了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Isn't fighting like this just the best? I freakin' love it.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 哦耶！搞起来！枪炮和引擎！马力全开！
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: Yeah! Let's do it! Guns and thrusters! Full burn!
All the practice I've been doing is really paying off.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.chinese: 你觉得我之前的小把戏如何？不错吧？玩竞技场指挥官学的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_chatter_commsilence_a.english: What did you think of that last little move I did? Pretty sweet right? Learned that one playing AC.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_collided_vehicle_apla.english: What the hell do you think you're doing?
Have you lost your bleedin' mind?

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: You know, it's not too late for you to just run.
I think I got you now.
You're done for. This fight's mine.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 我很快就会杀了你，应该不难过吧？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: I'm probably gonna kill you soon. No hard feelings right?
Got you right in my crosshairs.
Yeah, that's how you do it!
I got you locked in now!

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.chinese: 来吧，我已经掌握窍门了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aenemy_tp.english: Here we go. I got the hang of it now.
Yeah! I got you so good.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 喂！你应该知道我们是友军吧？！
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Hey! You know I'm on your side right?
Hey! Watch your fire.
Hold fire! I'm a friendly.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 哎等等，你确定你要这么做？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Hey, come on. You sure you want to do this?

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 我不会就这样挂了的，你等着瞧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: I'm not going out like this. You'll see.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 你自我感觉不错是吧？咱们看看谁能笑到最后。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: You think you're so good don't you? We'll see who has the last laugh.
How are you hitting me?
What the hell?
Hey! Knock it off!
Okay, you got me there.
Damn it! Stop shooting me.
Come on. Knock it off already!
Seriously, stop it.
How do you keep doing that?
Are you sure you want to do this?
Hey! Come on. Don't push me.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 那可不是什么好主意。你最好趁还有机会的时候停手。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: That's not a good idea, okay. Back off while you still can.
You better knock that off right now.
You're really starting to make me mad.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.chinese: 艹，停下，我不会再说一次了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_aplayer_t.english: Damn it. Stop it. I'm not gonna tell you again.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: That was a pretty great hit right there.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.chinese: 幸亏吃这一下的是你不是我。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_heavydama.english: Talk about a hit. Sure glad I ain't you right now.
Geez. What the hell is going on with you?
Holy shit! What the hell are you doing?
Oh, damn it! That really hurt.
You're not messing around are you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: My shield are down! I need help!

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 你没盾了，现在我要干死你！
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: There went your shields. I got you now!

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 护盾下线了，你有麻烦了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: No shields. You're in trouble now.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 嗯，你把我盾打掉了，但猛男不需要护盾。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: Yeah you got my shields, but who needs 'em.
Ah shit. My shields. That's not good.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.chinese: 等我护盾回满你就要完蛋了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_lostshiel.english: You're gonna be in trouble once my shields are back.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: I did it! I got you!
That was incredible. What a hit.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.chinese: 哈哈！我还怕你能躲掉啥的，并没有。直接命中。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_damagedealt_missile_a.english: Hell yeah! I was worried that you'd dodge or something but nope. Direct hit.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: Hey! You're going to pay for that.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 我不会让你就这么一走了之的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: I'm not gonna let you get away with that.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.chinese: 不！你这混蛋。他们什么也没做。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_3rd.english: No! You bastard. They didn't deserve that.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 哦草，你看到了吗？我干掉一个！是我干的！
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: Holy crap, you see that? I took that ship out! That was me!

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.chinese: 我做到了！我杀掉他们了！

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aal.english: Hell yeah! That's one all me!

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 哈！你看到了没？我们抓到你了！你要完犊子了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Yeah! You see that? We got you! You're done for now.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 我们把你干得一塌糊涂。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: We're really kicking all of your asses out here.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 你们人越来越少了，确定你不要夹起尾巴跑路？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Your numbers are going down. Sure you don't want to cut your losses and run?

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.chinese: 哈，这下怎么样。看来我还挺擅长杀你们的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_aen.english: Well how about that. Guess I'm pretty good at killing you all.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.chinese: 哈哈！你让那群混蛋了解了谁才是老大。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: Hell yeah! You showed that bastard who's boss.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.chinese: 靠，也许我应该从你这儿学学飞行。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_apl.english: Damn. Maybe I should be taking flying lessons from you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 我感谢你在那里的帮助。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: I appreciate the save back there.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 干得漂亮！我以为我死定了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: That was amazing! I thought I was done for.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.chinese: 谢谢你！你算是救了我一命。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_destroyed_vehicle_ass.english: Thank you! You probably saved my life.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 你认真的吗？我觉得你不至于这样啊？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Seriously? I figured you were better than this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 什么鬼？你准备背叛九尾？
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: What the hell? You gonna cross the Nine Tails like that?
Hey! What the hell is this?

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 等其他九尾成员知道这事儿以后，他们肯定不会给你好脸色的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Wait till the other Nine Tails here about this bullshit. They're not gonna be happy with you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 你个混蛋！我以为你和我们是一伙儿的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: You bastard! I thought you were on our side.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 你要知道，算了不说了。你要完了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: You know what, forget this. You're done.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 行吧，你想打架，那就打吧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Fine. You want to fight? Then let's fight.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 很好，我本来就差不多要受够你了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_engage_switchtohostil.english: Okay, I've had just about enough of you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 忘了这事儿吧，我得赶紧离开这地方了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: Forget this, I'm getting the hell out of here.
I can't take any more of this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.chinese: 你知道吗？你其实不值得我费力气。我要走了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_inform_retreating_aen.english: You know what? You're not even worth it. I'm gone.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.chinese: 让我们来看看你怎么对付这个。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_launched_missile_aene.english: Let's see what you do with this.
Here. A little surprise for you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: Stay right there! I'm coming for you!
I see you. I see you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.chinese: 希望你是来打架的，因为你刚刚找到个对手。
pu_ntpilot05_m_bsp_spotted_vehicle_aenem.english: Hope you're looking for a fight, cause you just found one.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 我呆在九尾，就是喜欢像现在这样的生活。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: It's days like this that I really love being in the Nine Tails.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 今早出六角湾溜达时候，谁能想到我现在在干这事儿呢。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Who would've thought this is what I'd be doing when I rolled out of Grim HEX this morning.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 你猜我为什么加入了九尾？看看你身旁吧。我们是最牛逼的，每个在十字军的人都知道。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: You know why I joined the Nine Tails? Just look around you. We're the best. Everyone in Crusader knows it.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 九尾是十字军的老大，而且很快我们就会是整个斯坦顿的老大了。没人可以阻挡我们。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: Nine Tails runs Crusader, and soon we're gonna be running all of Stanton. Nothing nobody can do about it.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.chinese: 在这一票以后，十字军的人听到九尾的名字都要吓尿了吧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_n.english: I bet all of Crusader's gonna be shitting in their suits at the mention of Nine Tails after this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 开始他们告诉我这次大行动的时候我还不相信，但现在我们做成了，很疯狂对吧？
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I didn't believe it at first when they told me what the big plan was, but here we are. Crazy right?

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 要是我把你干掉，很大可能他们会奖励我。说不定还能见一见那些人口中的大老板呢。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I think there's a pretty good chance if I take you out, they might reward me. Maybe I'll get to meet the big boss everyone keeps talking about.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我真希望我能把事情内幕讲出来，想看看你会有什么反应。唉。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I really wish I could tell you what all this is really about. Would have loved to see your reaction. Oh well.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我从没想到我有生之年能参与这么个大行动，彻底封锁一整个空间站。哈，真是值得纪念的一天。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: Never in a million years thought I'd get to help out with something as big as actually blockading a whole station. Talk about a day to remember.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我好奇有多少气急败坏的人，在外面没有量子引擎，只能漫无目的地漂流？
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I wonder how many pissed off pilots there are just floating out there on the drift, complete screwed without their quantum drives.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.chinese: 我真想看看那些空间站里的傻瓜，发现自己不能用量子航行以后的样子。肯定很好玩。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_chatter_commsilence_s.english: I would have loved to see all those poor saps on the station's reaction when they figured out they couldn't QT anymore. Bet it was priceless.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.chinese: 让我们瞧瞧你有多少几斤几两。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_openhostilitie.english: Let's see what you got then.
If you want to fight, then let's fight.
Hey, if you don't want to listen then that's on you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 靠，你咋就不能乖乖滚蛋？
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Damn it. Why couldn't you just leave?
Didn't have to be like this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好吧，那就来打吧。正好想活动下身体。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: All right, let's do this. I could use the practice.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 见鬼，我一直给你机会走掉的。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: What the hell? I was trying to let you get out of here.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 好吧，如果你就想要这么做的话。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Fine, if that's how you want to do this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我真的尽力给你机会离开了，算了不说了。来吧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: I really tried to give you an out, but fine. Let's do this.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 不敢相信，给你机会离开你却不走。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Can't believe you didn't leave when you had the chance.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 我很抱歉，但是你让我没得可选。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Sorry about this, but you?re not really giving me a choice here.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 既然你还呆着不走，那就是你已经做出决定了吧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Since you're still here, I guess you made your choice.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.chinese: 不知道你到底想干啥，但是为时已晚。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_engage_switchtohostil.english: Not sure what's going on with you, but it's too late now.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 他们说过在我们制造了足够多的麻烦以后就可以撤了，我觉得差不多了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: They said once we caused enough trouble we could leave. I think this is enough.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 你知道不？不管是不是什么大行动，我可没准备好为九尾或者他们的老板而死。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: You know what? Big plans or not, I'm not ready to die for the Nine Tails or their bosses.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.chinese: 够了！计划里可没说我得搭上我这条命。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_inform_retreating_sec.english: Enough! The plan said nothing about me needing to die.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.chinese: 嘿，九尾可以让你通过这里，只是你不能在附近瞎逛，懂吧？
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_confi.english: Hey, it's fine with the Nine Tails if you want to pass on through here. Just can't have you hang around okay?

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嗨，我不是故意不礼貌或是啥的，只是九尾需要肃清整个区域。就算是你是盟友也一样得离开。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey, I don't mean to be rude or nothing, but the Nine Tails need this whole area clear. That holds true even for allies like you.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 嗨，我很抱歉，但是九尾不想让任何人在附近瞎晃，就算是你一样。我得要求你离开了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey, sorry about this, but the Nine Tails don't want anyone flying out here, even you. I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 飞行员请注意，这里是九尾的地盘。现在就掉头离开，否则我们就不得不使用武力了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Attention, pilot. This here is Nine Tails' turf. Turn around and leave now or we will be forced to take action.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 好了，规矩是这样：你滚蛋就可以活命，你停留就得丧命。你自己选吧。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: All right, here's how it going to go. You leave and you live, you stay and you die. The choice is yours.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 喂，我是九尾的人，你最好听着。你现在就得离开，否则你就有麻烦了。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Hey. I'm a Nine Tails, so you better listen. You need to leave right now, okay? Or there's going to be trouble.

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 九尾有一条警告给你，驾驶员。要不掉头走人，要不就那啥，懂了没？
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: Nine Tails got a warning for you, pilot. Turn around and leave right now or else. We clear?

pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.chinese: 你现在在九尾的空域里，驾驶员。你不被允许在这里。最好放聪明点儿，趁你还有命离开的时候赶紧滚。
pu_ntpilot05_m_dep_spotted_vehicle_deny_.english: You're in Nine Tails space now, pilot, and that's somewhere you're not allowed to be. So be smart and just fly away while you still can, okay?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 你可能觉得自己一切顺利。没错，我们或许一开始低估你了。但别得意，这只是暂时的。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: You probably think you're making good progress so far. And yeah, maybe we started off underestimating you, but don't worry, that'll change.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 太好了，你活到了现在。但如果你觉得接下来会更简单的话，那就大错特错了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: Yeah, great. You survived this far. But if you think it's gonna get any easier you're in for a world of hurt.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 啊，你当然还没死呢。走了狗屎运。相信我，你不会活多久了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: All right, you made it this far, sure. You got lucky. It's not gonna last. Trust me.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 你怎么还没死啊？我才不会栽在你们这帮民防部队傻逼手上。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: Why the hell won't you just die already? No bloody way am I'm losing to you CDF shitheads.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 你们为什么非要来多管闲事呢？好像十字军有多么值得保护一样。拉倒吧，我们给你们准备了点“惊喜”。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: Why won't you all just walk away? You're acting like Crusader is someone worth protecting. Hell with it, we got something special cooked up for you.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 妈的！你们这帮志愿者就非得来捣乱是吧？比起应付你们这群瓜皮，我有更要紧的事要办。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: Goddammit! You volunteers couldn't just keep out of our business, could you? I got better things to do than deal with your stupid ass.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 你不会觉得自己掺和进来有什么用吧？相信我，一切都还在我们的控制之中。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: You don't really think you're going to make a difference here, do you? Trust me, we're still in control here.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 直话说吧，我已经受够你来打扰我们九尾办事了。我要动真格的了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: I gotta tell ya, I'm getting pretty sick and tired of you interfering with Nine Tails business. Gloves are coming off.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.chinese: 所以，你想办法稍微干扰了我们的计划，你是想要点奖励还是什么吗？无所谓，我已经受够你了，现在就结束这一切。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionar.english: So you managed to slightly interupt our plans here, you want an award or something? Whatever, I'm getting tired of dealing with you. This ends now.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionbo.chinese: 只剩我们俩了，看看你有什么本事吧。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionbo.english: Just you and me now. Let's see what you've got.
Where the hell you at?! Let's do this.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionbo.chinese: 来啊，混蛋，我们来分个胜负。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionbo.english: Come on, asshole. Time to settle this shit.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.chinese: 你以为你赢了？你什么都阻止不了！
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.english: You didn't win here. (pained laugh) You didn't stop shit?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.chinese: 别担心，我们很快会再来的。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.english: Don't you worry. We'll do this again real soon?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.chinese: 行吧，好吧。那只是一堆好的垃圾？
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission.english: Yeah, all right. That was a good scrap?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.chinese: 我告诉过你们，民防部队不会有机会打败九尾的。所有侥幸活下来的人，你们记住，不要再和我们九尾作对。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.english: I told you the CDF wouldn't stand a chance against the Nine Tails. To anybody who survived, remember this and don't ever cross us again.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.chinese: 抱歉我们不得不杀了你们中的一些人，但也许在未来，你们都应该在为一些组织卖命之前三思而后行。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.english: Sorry we had to kill some of you, but maybe in the future, you all should think twice before fighting some company's battles for them.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.chinese: 感谢你在我们干活的时候为我们提供的娱乐项目，民防部队。你们确实有让事情变得生动有趣起来。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_.english: Thanks for keeping us entertained while we did our work, CDF. You certainly kept things lively.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionboss_.chinese: 好吧，该死。我想我的人已经死光了。那么好吧，你们都想打一架？到驳船上，我们来打。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionboss_.english: Well, shit. Guess I'm all out of people. Then fine, you all want a fight? Head to the barge and let's fight.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 听的见吗，雷米？你有一些同伴。如果他们造成麻烦，你就让他们看看九尾的本事。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: You hear that, Remy? You got some company. If they cause a problem, you show them what Nine Tails can do.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 雷米，听得见吗？你有另一个民防部队的傻瓜正在向你走来。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Remy, you copy? You got another CDF sucker heading your way.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 雷米，看仔细了。你的民防部队正在前往你的岛屿的途中。如果他们不回到他们的舰船上，你一定回后悔。
