pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Remy, look alive. CDF's en route to your island. If they don't get back on that shuttle, you make 'em regret it.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 嘿，阿克，你在吗？有麻烦来找你了。别手软。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Hey Acker, you there? You got some trouble coming in. Make it hurt.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 阿克，注意看。民防部队朝着你的方向过去了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Acker, look alive. CDF's making their way to you.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 认真起来，阿克。你有一些帮手到了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Get your game face on, Acker. You got some company.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 现在你得对付斯考奇了。你能搞定他们吧，斯考奇?
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Now you gotta deal with Scorch. You all right with that, Scorch?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 嘿，斯考奇。我又给你找了些蠢木头来烧。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Hey Scorch. Got some more kindling for you to burn.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 斯考奇，我相信你能处理好这件事。你明白我的意思吗？
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Scorch, I'm trusting you to handle this. You got me?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 斯塔克斯，你有一些麻烦正在向你的方向去。注意点。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: Stax, you got some trouble headed your way. Watch yourself.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 就看你了，斯塔克斯。你能解决吧？
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: It's up to you, Stax. You got this?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.chinese: 全副武装，斯塔克斯。注意这个人，明白吗？
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t.english: You're on deck, Stax. Watch out for this one, okay?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 你可能已经干掉了雷米，但与即将发生的事情相比，他不算什么，所以别以为之后会变得更轻松。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: You may have taken out Remy, but he was a newby compared to what's coming, so don?t think it's gonna get any easier from here.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 你们这些人得到了雷米的帮助并不奇怪。这孩子话太多了。如果他闭嘴，可能会活得更久。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Not surprised you lot got the better of Remy. Kid talks too much. Probably could've lasted longer if he wasn't shooting his mouth off.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 什么玩意儿？我承认，我没料到阿克会被打成这样。你们民防部队就是不死心，是吧？
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Goddammit? I'll admit, I wasn't expecting Acker to get punched out like that. You CDF just won't quit, will you?

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 可恶。干掉阿克并不是什么大不了的事。但是，谁知道呢，也许他只是出门没看黄历。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Shit. Taking out Acker ain't nothing to sneeze at. But, who knows, maybe you just caught him having a bad day.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 我靠。一些无名的民防部队志愿兵居然干掉了斯考奇...一定是运气好。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: I'll be damned. Some nobody CDF volunteers took out Scorch... Must've gotten lucky.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 我有点讨厌民防部队干掉我的人，但我想这就是生活，呵呵。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Getting kinda sick of the CDF taking out my people, but I guess that's life, huh.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 妈的，看来你让斯考奇脱离了苦海，哈哈哈。你知道，你们民防部队真的真的开始让我生气了。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Shit? guess you put Scorch out of his misery, huh. You know, you CDF are really starting to piss me off.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 你们到底是怎么这么快就找到了斯塔克斯？他不应该就这样离开。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: How the hell did you get to Stax so fast? He didn't deserve to go out like that.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 我不敢相信你这么快就找到了他。斯塔克斯陪我一路走来。民防部队要为把他当垃圾处理掉而付出代价。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: I can't believe you got to him so quick. Stax and I came up together. The CDF's gonna pay for taking him out like some scag.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 斯塔克斯不应该就这么走了，你这个狗娘养的。你们最好都给我准备好，因为我不可能让你们这些民防部队的混蛋从这里轻易走掉。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: Stax didn't deserve to go out like that, you scag shit. You all better get ready because there's no way I'm letting of you CDF bastards walk away from this.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 我要为你们对斯塔克斯的所作所为狠狠地教训你们这些混蛋。你们谁敢踏上这艘船，我就会让你们知道我有多可怕。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: I'm gonna hurt you bastards real bad for what you did to Stax. Any of you step foot on this barge and I'll show you how serious I am.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 我没办法接受你们对斯塔克斯做的事情？你们都死定了。听到我说的了吗？你们杀的是我的朋友。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: I can't believe you all did Stax like that? You're all dead. You hear me? That was my friend.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 那是我的朋友。我要让你们这些民防部队的混蛋为你们的所作所为付出代价。不要以为你们会死得很痛快。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: That was my friend. I'm gonna make you CDF bastards pay for what you did. And don't think for a second that you're gonna get a quick death.

pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.chinese: 你们杀害了我的朋友。这简直是滔天大罪。我要找到你们每一个人，把你们折磨得死去活来，让你们一遍遍的在再生中痛苦的尖叫。
pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj.english: You killed my friend. Big mistake. I'm gonna find each and every one of you and torture you so bad, your regen's gonna be screamin' in pain.

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 你知道吗？我已经厌倦了看那些无能的蠢货试图把你干掉。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: You know what? I'm sick of watching inept dipshits try and take you out.

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 你知道吗无法彻底杀死我的都会让我更加强大？无论输赢，我都会回来，比以前更强大。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: Did you know that every time you regen you get stronger? Win or lose, I'll be back stronger than ever before.

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 来吧，你和我，开干吧! 噢噢噢噢哦哦哦!
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: Come on, you and me, let's do this! Whooo!

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 你以为这就结束了？我还会回来的。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.english: You think this is over? I'll be back?

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 我准备好了。我准备好了。我准备。

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 哦，是的，老大。你不用担心。我找到了他们。我会把他们打得很惨，他们会在再生中一遍遍痛苦的醒来。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Oh yeah, boss. Don't you worry. I got 'em. I'll beat them so bad, their regen's gonna wake up in pain.

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 我现在要秽土转生，是的但是，我们把这个地方封锁了。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: I'm going by Phoenix now, but yeah, we got this place on lock.

pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 哦，当然。我会快速快掉他们，他们甚至重生了都不知道是什么打的他们。
pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Oh, hell yeah. I'll smoke 'em so fast, they'll regen before they know what hit them.

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 你以为你可以看个烟花就走了吗？没有人可以走开。它会波及我们所有人。
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: You think you can just look into fire and walk away? Nobody walks away. It gets us all.

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 是时候了。你准备好了吗？你准备好面对接下来的事情了吗？
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: It's time. Are you ready? Are you ready to face what comes next?

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 火焰杀不死我。你凭什么认为你会做得更好？
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: The fire couldn't kill me. What makes you think you'll do any better?

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 我的火不见了。它去了哪里？它去哪儿了？
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.english: I lost the fire. Where did it go? Where did it go?

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 发生什么事了？发生什么事了那是啥？

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 什么？ 是的，我们准备好了。
是的，他们会被烧死。他们会像其他所有人一样被烧死。
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Yeah, they'll burn. They'll burn like all the rest.

pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 当然，我们有一个特别的欢迎计划。
pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Sure, we got a special welcome planned.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 见鬼去吧，我会亲手杀了你。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: Hell with it, I'll kill you myself.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 我要把你送入无尽黑暗的深渊，而且我将乐此不疲。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: I'm gonna send you to a deep dark place and I'm gonna have fun doing it.
Time to go to sleep, shithead.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 去你的，你不会是最后一个吧？
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.english: Screw you? you ain't gonna be the last of?

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.chinese: 你知道，你会认为人们会按照全副武装的罪犯的命令去做。令人惊讶的是，居然有很多人没有这样做，哈？
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.english: You know, you'd think people would do what the heavily armed criminals order them to do. Pretty surprising how many didn't, huh?

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.chinese: 哦，他们？是的，我不太确定我的枪是否工作正常。如你所见，它们工作得非常好。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.english: Oh, them? Yeah, I wasn't quite sure if my guns were working right. As you can see, they're working fine.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.chinese: 雷恩告诉我，要控制好人质。在我看来，他们看起来很受控制。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta.english: Ren told me to control the hostages. They looked pretty controlled to me.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 没问题。我将让他们感到真正的热情。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: No problemo. I'll make 'em feel real welcome.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 哦，不。他们是来拯救所有人的吗？（笑）祝他们好运。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Oh no. Are they here to save everybody? (laugh) Good luck with that.

pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 带上他们，我在这里已经越来越无聊了。
pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Bring 'em on, I've been getting bored over here.

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 好吧，这是你自找的。那我就不客气了。
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: All right, you asked for it. I'm not gonna go easy on you.
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_approach_missionobj.chinese: 你准备动手了吗？那我们出发。
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_approach_missionobj.english: You ready to do this? Let's go then.

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.chinese: 我会受伤？这真的伤的到我？
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono.english: I'll be damned? that really hurts?

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 放心吧，老大。我们会准备好的。
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: You got it, boss. We'll be ready.

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 是的，好的。这整件事开始让我想起我们在46年做的那次突袭。
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: Yeah, all right. This whole thing's starting to remind me of that raid we did back in '46.

pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.chinese: 我掩护你，老大。我们会处理他们的。
pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_.english: I got your back, boss. We'll handle 'em.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxgener.chinese: 嘿，看你有心事的样子。行吧，说说呗。我在这儿陪着你，兄弟。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxgener.english: Hey, you look like you have something on your mind. Alright, spill it. I'm here for you, buddy.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.chinese: 嗯，我能理解你。我觉得大家在尼克斯都是为了活下来。我们只是想找一个能让大家都满意的办法罢了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.english: Yeah, I get you. I think everyone is just trying to survive in Nyx. We just need to find a better option that suits everyone.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener.chinese: 我懂你的感受。尼克斯的生活确实挺奇怪的，但比起斯坦顿还是好很多了，对吧？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener.english: I feel ya. Life in Nyx is strange but it's still better than Stanton, am I right?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.chinese: 非常感谢，我确定还会再来的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.english: Thank you very much. I'm sure to come back here again.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.chinese: 谢谢，很高兴这儿的物资还不错。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.english: Thanks, I'm glad that supplies are good around here.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.chinese: 虽然不法分子和一些鬼鬼祟祟的商人混在我们中间，但我很高兴能找到一个可以信任的人。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia.english: With outlaws and shady merchants hiding among us, I'm glad that I can find someone I  can trust.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 你知道吗，我想要这个。下次我们出发采矿的时候，我那帮矿工肯定会眼红的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.english: You know what, I want this. My mining crew is going to be jealous the next time we head out.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 行吧，我要这个。卡尔看到这个一定会高兴的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.english: Alright, I'll have this. Carl is going to be happy when he sees this.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 给我这个。这会给大家提升士气的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde.english: Give me this. This will be a morale boost for everyone.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.chinese: 你这话是什么意思？一定是弄错了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.english: What do you mean by that? It must have been a mistake.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.chinese: 嗯？什么？这不可能啊。我等了整个晚上了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.english: Hmm, What? That can't be true. I've been waiting all evening.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 嘿，我的采矿轮班快开始了，如果你能帮我一下的话，我真的很感激。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: Hey my mining shift is coming up, and I would really appreciate it if you would help me out.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 主管让我在出发前跟你确认一下，确保他交代的任务完成了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: The chief wants me to check in with you before heading out to make sure the task he requested is done.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 卡尔的采矿飞船被砸得惨不忍睹。能在下个班次前帮他处理一下吗？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: Carl's mining ship got bust up really bad. Can you work things out for him before the next shift?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 听着，我没时间在这儿耗着。我的下一次趟采矿马上就要开始了。我的队员们已经在催我了。怎么这么慢？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: Look, I don't have time for this. My next mining run is coming up. My crews are already calling me. What is taking so long?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 该死，我要迟到了，去采矿轮班。嘿，你能告诉我这里到底怎么回事吗？我真的很需要它赶紧准备好。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: Shit, I'm late to my mining shift. Hey, can you let me know what's going on here? I really need this to be ready.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 我觉得这事儿花的时间比预想的要长。有什么原因吗？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: I think this is taking longer than it's supposed to be. Is there a reason for that?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 库存不可能这么差。所有好东西都被冰碛帮走私掉了？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: There is no way stocks can be this bad. Did all the good shits get smuggled to the Moraine?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我感觉看到的都是些剩菜剩饭。难道环带的不法分子又抢先拿货了？
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: I feel like I'm looking at nothing but leftover scraps. Did the outlaws from the Ring got first dip on the hauls again!?

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 没法补给，我们就没法采矿。我知道你需要赚钱，但我爸跟我说过，“咱们居民之间得互相照应。”
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: We can't mine if we can't resupply. I know you need to make a profit but my Dad told me "We residents need to look out for each other."

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 这里的价位看起来挺公道的。很高兴咱们这儿还有些靠谱的商贩。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: The prices here seem fair. I'm glad we still have some decent vendors around.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 你们的货物对我们这些矿工来说简直是救命稻草。嘿，我和我的船员很感激你的辛苦付出。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: You're wares are a lifesaver to us miners around here. Hey, my crew and me appreciate you're hard work.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 好久没看到这么多好东西了。你们的运输工干得不错。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: It's been a long time since I saw so many good shit around. You're haulers are doing good work.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 马上就好，很高兴我们的物资能帮到你一点点。你可以把它们直接加到你的库存里了，朋友。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Right away, I'm glad our supplies can help you out even a little bit. You can consider it already in your inventory, friend.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 当然可以。现在就把物资发送到你的库存里。如果你知道还有其他人可能对我的商品感兴趣，可以直接把他们带到这里来。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Sure thing. Sending it to your inventory. If you know anyone else who might be interested in my wares, do direct them here.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 好的，应该马上就会出现在你的库存里了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Alright, I got you. It should be in your inventory in a minute.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 也许你可以试试那边的终端。我们商人有时会在这里共享库存，所以你可能会在那里找到你需要的东西。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.english: Maybe you should try the terminal over there. We merchants sometimes share our stock around here, so you might find what you need in it instead.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 我会尽我所能，让你能以最好的状态出发。所以，请告诉我你需要什么。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: I'll do my best so you can head out there in the best condition possible. So, let me know what you need.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 这里有吸引你的东西吗？如果没有，你可以放心，我会帮你的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: Anything here caught your eye yet? If not, you can count on me.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 请理解，由于到处都是不法分子，我们的运输工和矿工们工作都非常困难。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Please understand, with all the outlaws out there, our haulers and miners are having a tough time doing their work.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 我们还是冷静点吧？尼克斯的不法分子在扰乱我们所有人，我们不要内讧了。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: How about we just keep it cool? Nyx's outlaws are messing with all of us, let's not fight among ourselves.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 放轻松。我知道这里的情况很艰难，但我们必须团结一致。无论你需要什么，我都会尽力在下次采购时弄到。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Just take a deep breath. I know it's rough in around here, but we need to stay strong together. Whatever you need, I will try get it in the next haul.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 请慢慢看看我的商品。这些都是我们最新采购的。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Take your time and browse through my wares. They are from our latest haul.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 相信我，有了这个，就连剜度舰队也阻止不了你。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Trust me. Not even a vanduul fleet can stop you if you have one of these.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 我想让你知道，这些商品在我们这里的矿工们中非常受欢迎。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Just to let you know, these items are really popular with our miners around here.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 欢迎光临。我的物资可以让我们的社区更强大。来看看吧。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Welcome. I have supplies to keep our community strong. Have a look.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，朋友，你会发现我这里有你需要的所有物资。我们的运输运输工不辞辛劳地穿越星系，把它们运到尼克斯。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey friend, you'll find that I have just the supplies you need. Our haulers travel tirelessly across the verse to get these to Nyx.

pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，这是来自卡斯塔的最新采购物资。这些货可不常到货哦。
pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey there, fresh new haul from Castra. These don't come in very often.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.chinese: 我受够了被人利用。我们在这里努力建设一些东西，而这些混蛋却来把一切都搞砸了。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.english: I'm just tired of being taken advantage of. We're trying to build something here and these assholes come in to screw it all up.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener.chinese: 我猜，在边缘地区生活就是这样吧。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener.english: Guess that's life on the fringe, huh.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxueeen.chinese: 管他们呢。UEE 来了只会带来麻烦。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxueeen.english: Screw 'em. UEE won't bring nothing but problems here.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxvandu.chinese: 对啊，而且如果他们老是待在这儿，我觉得 UEE 迟早会过来，说是要“控制这星系”。到时候我们都完了。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxvandu.english: Yeah, plus if they keep hanging around here. I feel like the UEE's just gonna come in and try to 'secure the system.' Then we're all screwed.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxueeen.chinese: 老实说，我不确定 UEE 能不能帮帮自己。他们确实不再是那些梅塞尔了，但一个腐败的体系还是腐败的体系。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxueeen.english: Honestly, I don't know if the UEE will be able to help themselves. Yeah, they're not the Messers any more, but a corrupt system is a corrupt system.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerapprecia.english: Thanks for coming in. Have a good one.
You're all set. Til next time I guess.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 算了。虽然贵，但我还是买了。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.english: Screw it. It's pricey but I'll go for it.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 嗯，我觉得我得试试这个。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.english: Yeah, I think I'll give it a shot.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.chinese: 我买了。人生只有一次，对吧？
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde.english: I'll take it. You only live once, right?

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerreactser.chinese: <叹气> 这真是太蠢了。这简直太蠢了...
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerreactser.english: <heavy sigh> This is stupid. This is so stupid…

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 嘿，不好意思，我发了个请求，被告知要过来问问你能不能帮忙。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.english: Hey, sorry, I sent along a request and was told to come by to see if you could help.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 最近我遇到一堆麻烦，听说你能帮我。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.english: I've been having a bunch of issues lately and heard you could help me.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 我是被安排来找你的。外面的情况越来越乱了，急需帮助。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests.english: I got sent your way. Things have been getting a little crazy out there and could use some help.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 听着，我厌倦了每次都跑这里来。我今天就必须把这事给解决了。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.english: Look, I'm tired of coming here. I need to get this resolved today.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 你们这些人已经让我等了好几天了。我现在还能把这个事情解决掉吗？
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.english: You people have been giving me the runaround for days. Is there any chance I can get this taken care of now?

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 我现在就要处理完这件事。别再打电话或者让我排队等着了。现在就办。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec.english: I need this handled now. No more comm calls or sitting on hold. Now.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我上周从你们这儿买的东西，才一周就坏了，我想知道你们到底打算怎么处理这件事。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: I bought something from you last week and it's already busted so I want to know what the hell you're gonna do about it.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我怎么又回来了？我从你们这买的每样东西都烂得跟垃圾一样，这是什么情况啊？怎么回事？
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: Why am I back here again? Every thing I buy from you turns out to be a piece of shit, so what's up. What's going on?

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我不知道你们从哪儿搞来的垃圾货，也别指望人们会为这种东西付真钱。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: I don't know where you get this shit, but you can't expect people to pay real credits for this stuff.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 哦不错。我听说过这些。据说还挺棒的。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: Oh nice. I've heard about these. They're supposed to be pretty good.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 这个是新品吗？看起来挺好的。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: Is this thing new? Looks nice.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我以前好像没见过这个。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping.english: I don't remember seeing this here before.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 太好了。我马上把它送到你的机库。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Great. I'll have it sent to your hangar.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 哦，你要这个？不错。我马上给你送过去。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Oh, you want it? Cool. I'll have it sent over.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 太好了。我觉得你会很喜欢这个的。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: That's great. I think you'll really like this.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 看看这个控制台。它知道的比我多得多。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.english: Check out the console. It knows a lot more than I do.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 你也看看那个终端吧。里面有些东西货架上没有。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.english: Have a look at the terminal too. There are some things in there that aren't on the shelves.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 对，如果你有啥问题的话，可以去终端查一下。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons.english: Yeah, maybe check the terminal if you have questions.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 有需要帮忙的时候尽管喊一声。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: Give a shout if you need a hand with anything.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 我还在努力了解我们这里卖的是什么，不过我能回答的都会尽力回答。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: I'm still trying to get up to speed on what we sell here, but I'll answer what I can.
Let me know if I can help.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 我不知道你让我做什么，我只是在这里顶替一下。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: I don't know what you want me to do, I'm just filling in here.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 你得等老板回来的时候去问他们。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: You'll have to take it up with the owner when they're back.
I'm sorry, but there's nothing I can do.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 尽管试试看吧。最近它们特别受欢迎。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Feel free to try it out. They've been really popular lately.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 据我所知，这些东西卖得挺快的，所以，想买就赶紧的吧。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Been moving a lot of these from what I'm told, so yeah, act quick, I guess.
I've heard good things about that.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，谢谢你过来。随便看看。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey, thanks for coming in. Have a look around.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 你还好吧？有什么想要的尽管看。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: You good? Feel free to see if there's anything you want.

pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，最近怎么样？我觉得我们进了一些新货，去看看吧。
pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey, how's it going? I think we got some new merch, check it out.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener.chinese: 谢了啊，你总能把事儿说得挺有意思。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener.english: Appreciate your input. You always put an interesting spin on things.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxvandu.chinese: 剜度这事儿真不妙，哪怕来个最小的氏族盯上列夫斯基，咱们都得完蛋。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxvandu.english: This Vanduul situation isn't good. If even a small sized clan targeted Levski, we'd be in real trouble.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.chinese: 你们真是把浪费时间的行家。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.english: Y'all are pros at wasting my damn time.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.chinese: 谁特么让我来这儿求助的？你们压根儿帮不上忙啊！
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.english: Why the hell did someone say to come down here for help when you can't help?

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.chinese: 行，我头都快炸了就因为这破事。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser.english: Great. Now I have a migraine because of all this bullshit.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 这事儿我都折腾一礼拜了，今天必须给我弄明白。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: Been trying to get this issue resolved for over a week. Really need this figured out today.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 我昨天就发了通讯说这问题，结果让我亲自跑一趟，行吧，我现在来了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: Send y'all a comm yesterday about the problem I'm having, and was told I had to come talk to someone in person. So, yeah, now I'm here.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.chinese: 呃……我也不太清楚到底咋回事，但真希望你能帮忙。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests.english: So... I'm not exactly sure what happened here, but really hoping you can help.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 听好，我不是冲你个人发火，但这整个流程真他妈把我气炸了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: Look, I'm not mad at you personally, but this entire process has done nothing but piss me off.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 搞不懂你们为啥这破事老解决不了？看着就是你们自己写错了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: Not sure why the hell it's so hard for y'all to get this resolved. It seems like a simple clerical error on your side.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.chinese: 我也不知道怎么告诉你，上一任管理员就给了我这些信息，说我只要这些就够了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec.english: Don't know what to tell you, but that's all the info the last Admin gave me. She said it was all I needed to take care of this.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 咱们都不在泰拉了，你咋还拿泰拉的价坑我？
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: Not sure why you're expecting me to pay Terra prices when we're not in Terra.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 你真该好好打理下这地儿，东西上一层灰，谁看了不心里打鼓？
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: You really should take better care of this place. Never a good sign for customers when there's a layer of dust covering everything.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 这儿搞得我老想回基尼那边的老店了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: This place makes me miss Gene's old shop.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 就是想说一句，你这儿东西选得真不赖。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: Just wanted to say that you've got a nice selection of stuff here.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 我不晓得你是咋做到的，但每次我想要啥你这儿都有。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: I don't know how you do it, but you always have exactly what I need.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.chinese: 逛了一圈，发现你这儿居然有几样东西，真让我惊喜，好的那种。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping.english: Lookin' around, I was surprised by a few things you got for sale. In a good way, I mean.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancegene.english: No one's allowed through here right now.
Can't let anyone in this way.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.chinese: 抱歉老兄，这儿只对人民联盟的人开放。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.english: Sorry, buddy, People's Alliance members only.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.chinese: 这片区域只限人民联盟成员进入。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.english: This area's restricted to members of the People's Alliance.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.chinese: 没得商量，只有联盟的人才能过这道门。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop.english: No can do. Only Alliance members past this point.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_directtrafficgen.chinese: 快点走，这儿得保持通畅。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_directtrafficgen.english: Let's go. Gotta keep this area clear.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loitergeneric_ig.english: Time to find someplace else to rest.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loitergeneric_ig.chinese: 行了行了，别赖这儿了，该走啦。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loitergeneric_ig.english: Ok, let's go. You've been here long enough.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.chinese: 麻烦你把这地儿清一下，谢了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.english: Gonna need you to clear this area for me. Thanks.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.chinese: 真不想说这事儿，老兄，但你得挪个地儿。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.english: Hate to do this, my friend, but I've gotta ask you to move.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.chinese: 要不你找个别处歇着？我挺感激的。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall.english: I'd appreciate it if you found somewhere else to rest.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: One second while I ring it up, and you'll be good to go.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 选得不错，我这就给你发过去。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: You picked a good one. I'll have it sent to you shortly.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.chinese: 完美，我确认下你家仓库地址...好了，货马上发你机库里。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde.english: Perfect. Let me confirm your preferred destination here... ok, I'll have it sent to your hangar now.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 想看全点？去终端上瞅瞅更方便。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.english: Probably easier to see everything we have at the console.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.chinese: 所有东西都能在购物终端上买，省事儿。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons.english: You could use the shopping terminal too for all purchases.
Might be more convenient for you to use the terminal.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 有啥不明白的，随时问我。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: I'm here to help if you've got any questions.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.chinese: 想找啥特定东西？跟我说一声就行。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_.english: If you're looking for anything in particular, just let me know.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Complaining ain't gonna get you a discount.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 我家这店传了几代了，你走你的，我们照样活得挺好。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: My family's had this shop for generations. We'll be just fine if you wanna take your business elsewhere.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 这儿是不完美，但咱已经尽全力了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Know this place ain't perfect, but we're doing the best we can 'round here.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 顺带一说，后头存货快见底了，看上啥赶紧下手，迟了就没啦。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: By the way, I'm low on backstock. If you see anything you like, better grab it before it's gone.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 要找点特别的？那边那件，大伙儿都夸好。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Well, if you're looking for something special, that right over there comes highly recommended.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 这儿每一样东西都挂我名儿，有啥问题直接拿回来，咱总能给你解决。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Everything here comes with my personal guarantee. If you have any issues, just bring it back and we'll figure something out.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 今天到了一批好货，赶紧来看看，晚了可就没了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Some good stuff came in today. Better check out it before it's gone.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 想找划算的？你来对地方了。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: If you're looking for a good deal, you've come to the right place.

pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，来得正好，刚把货全补上。
pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey there, perfect timing. Just finished restocking everything.

pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.chinese: 这日子真没法过了，得有人出面管管了。
pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi.english: Sure as hell can’t go on like this. Something needs to be done.

pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener.chinese: 这儿是越来越难混了，对吧？
pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener.english: Things are just getting harder and harder around here, aren’t they?

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Hey, you don't like it, my friend, you don't have to buy anything.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 哈，你在这儿找找看，有哪家比我还地道？
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Ha. Good luck finding a shop around here that's better.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 别跟我抱怨，这店是我老舅的。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: Don't complain to me. It's my Uncle's shop.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 挑花眼了是吧？今天先拿一件，不满意随时回来找我退。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: If you're having a hard time deciding, you can always get something today, and if you're not happy, just come back and let me know.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 我这儿卖的，都是我觉得大伙儿会喜欢的，随便挑，错不了。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: I only carry stuff I think my customers are gonna like. You really can't go too wrong with anything here.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.chinese: 那边那件，最近问的人可多了，这周最火的货。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco.english: I've got a lot of people asking after that one over there. Really popular this week.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 嘿，随便看看，我这东西多着呢。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Hey, feel free to take a look at what I got.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 咋样？东西齐全，总有一款合你心意。
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: You all right? Got plenty on offer, so see what suits you.

pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.chinese: 别愣着啊，过来瞅瞅，怕啥！
pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig.english: Come on. Don't be shy. Take a look.

pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_001_sinc.chinese: 自2399年以来，哈索尔集团作为行业领导者，致力于挖掘价值。我们可以共同重塑帝国。
pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_001_sinc.english: Since 2399, Hathor Group has built its name as an industry leader in extracting value. Together we can reshape the empire.

pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_002_itse.chinese: 避免代价高昂的事故是每位员工的责任。安全始于你，也终于你。
pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_002_itse.english: It's every employee's responsibility to avoid costly accidents. Safety starts and ends with you.

pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_003_reme.chinese: 请记住，哈索尔信任你，帮助我们保持业务私密性。不要与员工之外的人讨论工作。
pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_003_reme.english: Remember, Hathor trusts you to help keep our business private. Do not discuss work with non-employees.

pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_004_lets.chinese: 让我们一起努力，避免工作场所的干扰。时间是宝贵的资源。保持专注，否则要付出代价。
pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_004_lets.english: Let's all work together to avoid distractions in the workplace. Time is a valuable resource. Stay focused or pay the price.

pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_005_unsu.chinese: 不确定正确的程序或规定？查阅你的手册。了解规则，保持安全。
pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_005_unsu.english: Unsure of the proper procedure or regulation? Check your manual. Know the rules and stay alive.

pu_orbolptan_dpa_laserinitiated_gp_002_a.chinese: 注意！激光发射协议已启动。请保持距离。
pu_orbolptan_dpa_laserinitiated_gp_002_a.english: Attention! Laser firing protocol initiated. Stand by.

pu_orbolptan_dpa_lasersetupcomplete_gp_0.chinese: 发射授权已批准。激光激活已就绪。
pu_orbolptan_dpa_lasersetupcomplete_gp_0.english: Firing authorization granted. Laser ready for activation.

pu_orbolpterm_cantactivatelaser_gp_002_r.chinese: 请求被拒绝。冷却周期正在进行中。
pu_orbolpterm_cantactivatelaser_gp_002_r.english: Request denied. Cooldown cycle in progress.

pu_orbpaftan_dpa_bladeinserted_gp_002_at.chinese: 注意。平台校准程序正在开始。

pu_orbpaftan_dpa_bladeinserted_gp_003_se.chinese: 正在将坐标发送到轨道激光平台。
pu_orbpaftan_dpa_bladeinserted_gp_003_se.english: Sending coordinates to Orbital Laser Platform.

pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase2complete_gp_006_a.chinese: 调整完成。待命以进行传输。
pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase2complete_gp_006_a.english: Adjustment complete. Standing by for transmission.

pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase3complete_gp_007_p.chinese: 电池充电完成，准备进行轨道平台部署。
pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase3complete_gp_007_p.english: Power battery charged and ready for Orbital Platfom deployment.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_a.chinese: 下一班穿梭机即将到达本站。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_a.english: The next shuttle is approaching the station.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_a.chinese: 穿梭机即将到站；请大家有序排队，先下后上。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_a.english: Shuttle now arriving. Please make way for disembarking passengers.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_c.chinese: 奥里森天路穿梭机服务仍在扩张业务区域！本站将与更多未来航线一起投入使用。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_c.english: Orison Skyway Shuttle Service is expanding! This station will be opening soon with even more connecting flights.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_d.chinese: 请注意。我们的穿梭机服务将会有些许延误，请耐心等候。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_d.english: Attention. We're experiencing a slight delay in service. Please stand by.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_d.chinese: 最后登机广播，穿梭机即将离站。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_d.english: Last call for passengers. The shuttle is preparing to depart.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_o.chinese: 请注意；本站暂不提供服务。对您造成的不便我们深表歉意。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_o.english: Attention. This station is currently out of service. Apologies for the inconvenience.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_s.chinese: 请注意；穿梭机服务现已恢复，感谢您的耐心等候。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_s.english: Attention. Shuttle service has now resumed. Thank you for your patience.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.chinese: 奥里森天路穿梭机服务，我们竭诚为您的旅途增添乐趣，请享受您的飞行时光。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.english: At Orison Skyway Shuttle Service, we aim to make getting there half the fun. Please enjoy your flight.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.chinese: 景色不错？我们最新改款的十字军工业穿梭机，以其标志般的水晶天幕为特色，更多的景致便能就此一览无遗。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.english: Enjoying the view? Our recently redesigned Crusader Industries shuttle craft feature expanded vista opportunities with their signature crystal canopies.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.chinese: 没赶上穿梭机？不用担心；另一艘穿梭机很快就到。奥里森穿梭机服务，更多航班、更少担忧。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen.english: Miss your shuttle? Not a problem. Another shuttle will be along shortly. At Orison Skyway Shuttle Service, more flights means less worries.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.chinese: 欢迎光临奥古斯特·顿洛空港，这里是十字军通往星空的大门。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.english: Welcome to the August Dunlow Spaceport, Crusader's gateway to the stars.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.chinese: 感谢您造访奥里森，这里是十字军工业的总部与中心，梦想从这里启航。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.english: Thank you for visiting Orison, the heart and headquarters of Crusader Industries. Where dreams take flight.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.chinese: 请务必探索并发现奥里森的一切；景色与活动数不胜数，绝对能让您的十字军之旅不虚此行。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_.english: Be sure to explore and discover all Orison has to offer. With so much to see and do, Crusader is a journey worth making.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_delay.chinese: 我们目前出现了意外延误；请稍等片刻，我们正在处理。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_delay.english: We are currently experiencing an unexpected delay. Please remain where you are while we work to correct the situation.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_doors.chinese: 请远离舱门，穿梭机即将离站。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_doors.english: Please clear the hatch. Shuttle will be departing.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_malfu.chinese: 本穿梭机遇到了技术问题。请留在原地等待我们解决这个问题。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_malfu.english: This shuttle is experiencing technical issues. Please remain where you are while we work to correct the situation.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.chinese: 下一站，奥古斯特·顿洛空港，十字军通往星空的大门。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.english: Next stop - August Dunlow Spaceport, Crusader's gateway to the stars.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.chinese: 下一站，云景中心，造访者能够在此享受壮观的美景、难以忘怀的艺术品、美味的食物，以及帝国级别的住宿服务。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.english: Next stop - Cloudview Center, where visitors can enjoy stunning views, memorable art, delicious dining and drinks, and Empire-class accommodations.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.chinese: 即将抵达下一站，需要下船的乘客请提前做好准备。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.english: Approaching next station. If this is your stop, please prepare to disembark.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.chinese: 下一站，天意工业平台，著名的十字军工业造船厂所在地。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.english: Next stop - Providence Industrial Platform, home to the famous Crusader Industries' shipyards.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.chinese: 下一站，远见中心。你通往世界级活动和娱乐的大门。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts.english: Next stop, the Vision Center. Your gateway to world-class events and entertainment.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.chinese: 即将抵达奥古斯特·顿洛空港。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.english: Now Arriving at August Dunlow Spaceport.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.chinese: 现在到达哈特莫尔平台。只邀请经授权的乘客下船。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.english: Now arriving at Hartmoore Platform. Only authorized passengers are invited to disembark.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.chinese: 现在到达了接待中心站。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.english: Now arriving at the Valet Station.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.chinese: 现在到达了布拉什伍德平台。
前方到站，天意工业平台。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar.english: Now arriving at Providence Industrial Platform.
Now arriving at the Vision Center.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_stand.chinese: 舱门开启中，请注意安全。

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_d.chinese: 注意，环境危害现已得到控制，大家可以恢复正常活动。感谢各位，祝您愉快。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_d.english: Attention. The environmental hazard has been contained. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_i.chinese: 警告，环境危害仍在持续中，我们正尽力解决这个问题。请保持冷静，感谢大家的耐心。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_i.english: Warning. The environmental hazard is still in progress. We are working to resolve the issue. Please remain calm and thank you for your patience.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_r.chinese: 警告，检测到环境危害。另行通知前请原地待命，重复，请原地待命。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_r.english: Warning. An environmental hazard has been detected. Please remain where you are until notified otherwise. Repeat. Please remain where you are.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_v.chinese: 警告，检测到环境危害。请保持冷静、有序从本区域撤离。重复，请有序撤离本区域。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_v.english: Warning. An environmental hazard has been detected. Please vacate the immediate area in a calm and orderly fashion. Repeat. Please safely vacate the area.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_platformcorrec.chinese: 请等待平台完成高度校准。
平台高度校准现已完成，大家可以恢复正常活动。感谢各位，祝您生活愉快。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_platformcorrec.english: Platform Elevation Correction is now complete. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_platformcorrec.chinese: 注意，当前平台目前正在遭受严重的推进器故障。我们建议所有乘员冷静地撤离平台，等待进一步通知。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_platformcorrec.english: Attention, this platform is currently suffering a critical thruster failure. We advise all occupants to calmly evacuate the platform until further notice.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_restrictedarea.chinese: 警告。本平台周围的限制区将在片刻后启动。所有未经授权的飞行员请立即离开该区域。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_restrictedarea.english: Warning. The restricted area around this platform will activate in a few moments. All unauthorized pilots are advised to leave the area immediately.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_restrictedarea.chinese: 请注意，限制区将立即启动。这是对你的最后警告，请你立即离开该区域，否则将被标记为非法入侵者。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_restrictedarea.english: Attention, the restricted area will actively momentarily. This is your final warning to clear the area or be flagged as a trespasser.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_securitythreat.chinese: 注意，十字军安保已解除警报。大家可以恢复正常活动。感谢各位，祝您愉快。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_securitythreat.english: Attention. Crusader Security has given the all clear. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_securitythreat.chinese: 注意，这是一则十字军安保警报。请安全冷静地撤离本区域。重复，请安全冷静地撤离本区域。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_securitythreat.english: Attention. This is a Crusader Security alert. Please safely and calmly vacate the area. Repeat. Please safely vacate the area.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_collision.chinese: 警告，前方侦测到碰撞，请做好冲击准备。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_collision.english: Warning. Collision detected. Brace for impact.

pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_emergency.chinese: 注意，紧急情况。请快速安全地离开本穿梭机。
pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_emergency.english: Attention. This is an emergency. Please safely and quickly exit the shuttle.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_approved_departure_.english: All right. You are cleared to go.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_approved_departure_.chinese: 看起来你已经准备好要出发了。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_approved_departure_.english: Looks like you are all set to leave.
You are cleared to head out.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_an.chinese: 好了，看来我们给你腾出地方了。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_an.english: Okay, looks like we have a space for you.
There we go. One spot for you.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_an.chinese: 啊，完美，这个位置挺不错。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_an.english: Ah, perfect. This space should do nicely.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.chinese: 非常感谢您造访奥里森，期盼您能尽快再次来访！
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.english: Thank you so much for visiting Orison. We hope that you visit us again real soon.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.chinese: 我代表十字军工业感谢您造访奥里森，祝您一路平安。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.english: On behalf of Crusader Industries, I'd like to thank you for visiting Orison. Safe travels.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.chinese: 希望您在奥里森玩得愉快，接下来的旅途也顺顺利利。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.english: I hope you enjoyed your time here at Orison and you have a pleasant rest of your journey.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.chinese: 我得说，能在您造访奥里森期间帮上忙真是我们的荣幸，也期待很快能再见到您。祝您今天过得愉快！
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t.english: Let me say that it has been a real pleasure to assist you during your visit to Orison and I look forward to seeing you again real soon. Have a great day.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.chinese: 我的系统显示您已经抵达了，祝您在奥里森过得愉快。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.english: My system's showing that you've arrived. Enjoy your stay in Orison.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.chinese: 就是这样，你已经正式抵达了。祝你在此度过愉快的时光。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.english: And there you go. You've officially arrived. Have a great time.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.chinese: 这样就可以了。在您停留奥里森期间，我们会妥善照看您的飞船。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_arrival_comp.english: That should do it. We'll be sure to look after your vehicle during your time in Orison.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.chinese: 非常抱歉，但您似乎被禁止在奥里森停放您的飞船。祝您有美好的一天。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.english: I'm very sorry, but it appears that you're prohibited from storing your vehicle on Orison. Have a nice day.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.chinese: 根据我的系统显示，您的账户当前已被冻结。很遗憾，这意味着您目前无法使用奥里森的设施。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.english: According to my system, there's a hold on your account. Sadly that means that you are prohibited from using Orison's facilities at the moment.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.chinese: 嗯。很抱歉必须告诉您这个消息，但您似乎被禁止使用我们的设施。深感抱歉。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_banned_aneut.english: Hmm. I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but it seems that you are prohibited from using our facilities. I'm very sorry.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_nota.chinese: 嗯，非常抱歉，我们目前似乎没有可用的停泊位提供给您。请您稍等片刻，一旦有空位，我将立即通知您。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_nota.english: Hmm, I'm very sorry, but we don't appear to have any available spaces for you. If you'll please stand by, I'll let you know if one opens up.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_nota.chinese: 您能稍等一会儿吗？我们设施目前全部停满，但一旦有空位，我立刻通知您。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_inform_storage_nota.english: Would you be able to hold on for a little bit. Our facility is all full up at the moment, but I can let you know when a spot is available.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_request_departure_a.chinese: 当然。我现在就开始进行最终准备，请您稍等。
pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_request_departure_a.english: Sure thing. I'll begin the final prep now. Please stand by.

pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_request_departure_a.chinese: 没问题。请稍等片刻，我们马上为您安排启程。

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_th.chinese: 事情开始有点起色了，我正好需要些额外的帮手。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_newmission_ig_002_th.english: Things are starting to pick up pace and I could use some extra hands.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_if.chinese: 如果你还在找工作的话，我这有些事儿可能需要你。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_if.english: If you're still looking for work, I may have found something.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_001_i.chinese: 我刚把你的薪酬结清了。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_001_i.english: I'll get payment cleared right away.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.chinese: 我让你把那东西带回来，可你不听我的。接下来会发生什么都是你自己的事。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.english: Now I told you to bring that stuff back, but you didn't listen. What happens next is on you.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.chinese: 你是真不知道自己惹上谁了，是吧？你很快就会知道了。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_failboun.english: You really don't understand who you're dealing with, do you? You're gonna find out real soon.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarn.chinese: 好，我上一次检查时，你手里还拿着几个我们的东西。我姑且相信这只是你的一个小疏忽。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarn.english: So, last I checked, you were still holding onto a few things of ours. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt that this was just a slight oversight on your part.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarn.chinese: 我从某些非常不高兴的人那里听说你还没把东西还回来。希望那些东西能自己找路回来，立刻马上！这样对我们俩个都好。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwarn.english: I've got some very unhappy people breathing down my neck about that stuff you still haven't returned. Be best for both of us if it finds its way back, fast.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder.chinese: 记住把你拿到的东西都拿回来，别到时候让我亲自去找你。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder.english: Remember to return what you have. Don't make me have to track you down for it.

pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder.chinese: 确保你带了捡到的所有东西回来。
pu_pacheco_mg_comms_returnitems_reminder.english: Make sure to bring back everything you picked up.

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_001_allrigh.chinese: 好吧，让我们回到刚才的话题...
pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_001_allrigh.english: All right, let's get back to it...

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_imnotgo.chinese: 我不会从头到尾再唠叨一遍，就接着我们断掉的地方继续说。
pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_002_imnotgo.english: I'm not going to repeat myself, so I'll just pick up from where we left off.

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_003_readyto.chinese: 准备好听我讲话了吗，好的...

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_004_letstry.english: Let's try and stay on track this time, ok?

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_005_ivegoto.chinese: 你懂的，我还有其他破事要干，别浪费我的时间。总之...
pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_005_ivegoto.english: I've got other shit to do, you know. Stop wasting my time. Anyway...

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_sit_001_all.chinese: 好吧，让我们回到刚才的话题...
pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_sit_001_all.english: All right, let's get back to it...

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_sit_003_rea.chinese: 准备好听我讲话了吗？很好...

pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_sit_005_ive.chinese: 你懂的，我还有其他破事要干，别浪费我的时间。总之...
pu_pacheco_mg_convorejoin_ig_sit_005_ive.english: I've got other shit to do, you know. So Stop wasting my time. Anyway...

pu_pacheco_mg_decide_encouragelookanddec.chinese: 看一下然后告诉我你怎么想。
pu_pacheco_mg_decide_encouragelookanddec.english: Have a look and see what you think.

pu_pacheco_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_s.chinese: 如果你不想要这份工作就直说。
pu_pacheco_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_s.english: If you didn't want the job, just say it.

pu_pacheco_mg_decide_warningmissiontimeo.chinese: 你是有兴趣呢还是怎样？

pu_pacheco_mg_farewell_bad_ig_001_ivegot.english: I've got better places to be.

pu_pacheco_mg_greetings_bad_ig_002_ohjoy.english: Oh joy, look who it is.

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_001_yeahokits.chinese: 是的，好吧...这并不是什么重要的事。
pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_001_yeahokits.english: Yeah, ok... It's not like this was important or anything.

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_004_youregonn.english: You're gonna disrespect me like that?

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_005_iswearyou.chinese: 我说真的，你的注意力和内拉虫有的一拼。
pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_005_iswearyou.english: I swear, you got the attention span of a nela bug.

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_001_yeaho.chinese: 是的，好吧...这也没什么大不了的。别担心。
pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_001_yeaho.english: Yeah, ok... not like this was important or anything. Don't worry

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_001b_yeah.chinese: 是的，好吧...这也没什么大不了的。
pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_001b_yeah.english: Yeah, ok... not like this was important or anything.

pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_005_iswea.chinese: 我说真的，你的注意力和内拉虫有的一拼。
pu_pacheco_mg_interrupt_ig_sit_005_iswea.english: I swear, you got the attention span of a nela bug.

pu_pacheco_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_001_yo.chinese: 你有点走岔路了是吧？嗯，我知道，就闲逛这点，这块对你太陌生了，但我挺喜欢这儿的。很安静。额，可能太安静了。
pu_pacheco_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_001_yo.english: You're Kinda off the beaten path, aren't you? I know, I know, its a strange place to hang out, but I quite like it here. It's quiet. Well, quieter.

pu_pacheco_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_002_im.chinese: 我是特西亚·帕切科，但是人们通常叫我“刺痛”。
pu_pacheco_mg_intro_approach_v_wp_002_im.english: I'm Tecia Pacheco, but people call me Twitch.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_go.chinese: 发生了什么事？你刚刚做得很好，非常好，然后就都崩了。这就命啊，嗯。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_go.english: What happened? You were doing so well. So well. Then it all fell apart. But that's life, huh.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_go.chinese: 在你为我做了这么多好事之后，我不应该因为这次的工作失败而生气... 但我确实生气了，完成接到的工作是最基本的要求。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_go.english: Well After all the good you've been doing, I shouldn't be mad about the way that last job went down... but I am. Completing a job should be the standard.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_ne.chinese: 让我给你解释一下。你把事办砸了，会让我觉得当初不该决定雇你。所以不要再这样做了。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_ne.english: Let me explain something to you. When you screw up, it reflects poorly on me for hiring you in the first place. So don't do it again.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_ne.chinese: 不要把失败当成一种习惯，好吗？对于那些无法完成合约的和合约人来说，他们的处境会变得非常糟糕。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_ne.english: Don't make failure a habit, ok? Things get real ugly for contractors who can't pull off their contracts.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstr.chinese: 你不可能每次都赢，但如果你还想留在我身边怎么也得偶尔能赢一次。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstr.english: You can't win them all, but you're going to have to win one every once in awhile if you want to stay on my good side.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstr.chinese: 都这到这种地步了，我还挺好奇你能不能在不搞砸的情况下完成一次任务。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstr.english: At this point, I'm kinda curious to see if you can do a run without screwing it up.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastcha.chinese: 好吧，事情是这样的，我只能给你另一份工作，因为我有麻烦了。你搞砸了，咱们就到此为止，明白了吗?
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastcha.english: Ok, here's the thing, I'm only you another job 'cause I'm in a bind. Blow this and we're done. Got it?

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastcha.chinese: 我对你已经忍无可忍了。完成下一个任务，否则我们岌岌可危的合作关系就到此为止了。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastcha.english: I'm at the end of my rope with you. Come through on this next assignment or this little partnership is over.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonge.chinese: 我不能和信不过的人一起工作，我可以建议你做别的工作吗，我听说卡莎巴正在招人。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonge.english: I can't work with someone I can't trust. Might I suggest another line of work. I hear Casaba is hiring.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonge.chinese: 你完蛋了。走吧，别再回来了。如果我们在行动时候看到你，你就死定了。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonge.english: You're done. Walk away and don't come back. We see you anywhere near our operations, you're dead.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_.chinese: 你一定是在开玩笑，你怎么会让自己被抢的？
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_.english: You've got to be kidding me. How the hell do you let yourself get robbed?

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_.chinese: 上一份工作失败后你肯定很高兴你还活着， 但我的人可不高兴，一点也不。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_.english: I'm sure you're thrilled to still be alive after how that last job went down, but let's just say my people are not. At all.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 我不得不说，我难得的被惊艳到了。也许是我童年过的太艰苦了。谁知道呢。但你上次那票给我留下了非常深刻的印象。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: I gotta say, I'm seldom impressed. Maybe it was a rough childhood. I don't know. But you, you impressed me on that last run.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 好吧，我承认上次那单做的令人印象深刻。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: Ok, I'll admit it, that last gig was impressive.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 听说了。我手底下的人对你上次的表现非常满意。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: Got word. My people were pretty pleased with your last performance.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 你上次的工作做的很好。再接再厉。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: You did good on that last job. Keep it up.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 你在这为自己赢来了不少声誉。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: You're earning quite the rep around here.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.chinese: 我认为如果你能保持下去这种状态，你的未来会有不少不错机会等着你。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_success.english: I think there's some promising opportunities in your future if you keep pulling off jobs like you have been.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhard.chinese: 你最好尽快拿出你的本事来。如果我是你，我会非常努力争取下次把事情做好。
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhard.english: You better get your a-game on and soon. Yeah, If I were you, I'd focus real hard on getting this next one right.

pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhard.chinese: 让我给你看点东西。对我们来说你的能力在这。但是我们需要你的能力到这。明白了吗？
pu_pacheco_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhard.english: Let me show you something. This is where your performance for us has been. And this is where we need it to be. Got it?

pu_pacheco_mg_late_ig_001_donttakeit.chinese: 不是针对你，但是我现在不行。
pu_pacheco_mg_late_ig_001_donttakeit.english: Don't take it personally, but I just can't right now.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_0.chinese: 所以是你在做这事？对，不用在管它了。情况比我们想的要复杂的多。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_0.english: So that thing you were on? Yeah, don't worry about it anymore. Situation was a little more fluid than we thought.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_0.chinese: 我得叫停你了。交易终止了。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_0.english: Gotta shut you down. The deal's dead.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_wha.chinese: 发生什么事了？我还以为你说你是专业的。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_wha.english: What happened? I thought you said you were professional.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_fail_ig_004_you.chinese: 你不知道你给我惹了多大的麻烦。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_fail_ig_004_you.english: You have no idea how much you messed this up for me.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.chinese: 嗯，计划有一点点变动。去看一下。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.english: So, there's a slight change of plans. Check it out.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.chinese: 刚刚收到消息，我们需要对原计划做一点调整。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00.english: Just got word we need to make a few adjustments to the original plan.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_0.chinese: 这种活儿你中途跑路，胆儿挺肥啊你。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_0.english: You've got a lot of nerve walkin' away from a gig like this.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_0.chinese: 给我们留个烂摊子可不是什么好点子。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_0.english: Leaving us high and dry is not a good idea.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_.chinese: 在出问题之前赶紧TM给我把事办好。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_.english: Get your shit together before it's too late.

pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_.chinese: 你TM在干啥？给我回来做任务。
pu_pacheco_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_.english: What the hell's going on out there? Get back on mission.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_farewell_missionac.chinese: 就这些。（敲击声）你可以出发了。
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_farewell_missionac.english: That should be it. (beat) You can go now.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_farewell_missionde.english: Probably best for you to get out of here then.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_s.chinese: 真是惊喜啊...你居然还活着？
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_bad_ig_s.english: What a surprise... you're still alive?

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger.chinese: 都结束了。我以为我说的够清楚了。
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger.english: We're done. I thought I was clear on that.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_stillmis.chinese: 我要是你我就赶紧收拾包裹出发了。和我共事的应该都不像我一样是残疾人吧？
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_stillmis.english: I'd get back out there, if I was you. Not everyone I work with is a patient as I am.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_stillmis.chinese: 我雇你是来干活儿的，不是闲逛的。
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_stillmis.english: I hired you to do a job. Not to hang out here.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdel.chinese: 哼，我想今天我们都学到点儿东西。你不知道如何遵守指令。
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdel.english: Well, I guess we both learned something today. You don't follow instructions.

pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdel.chinese: 你在干啥？你不该把这个带到这里。
pu_pacheco_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdel.english: What are you doing? You're not supposed to bring this here.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_gener.chinese: 这此活计是这样的。我需要你去伏击一些人。我会给你安排好所有事和路线的。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_gener.english: Right Here's the deal. I'm gonna need you to ambush some people. I'll hook you up with routes and everything.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_gener.chinese: 我需要让一些人消失。我们会你他们在哪，你去把他们做掉。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_gener.english: Ive got some names we'd like erased. We'll let you know where they'll be, you clip them out.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_assault_blac.chinese: 有个突袭黑杰克那群王八蛋的活儿。小菜一碟，还很好玩。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_assault_blac.english: Got a gig pouncing on some Blackjack shitheads. Should be a breeze. Fun too.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_assault_riva.chinese: 有些本地人一直跟我的一些熟人过不去。现在是时候给他们点儿教训了。要声势浩大，刻进DNA的那种。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_assault_riva.english: Some local crews have been targeting some of my associates. Word's come down that a message needs to be sent. A loud and undeniable one.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_bla.chinese: 有个给黑杰克打工的蠢货一直纠缠我的一个熟人，我需要你去回报一下他们。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_bla.english: Some numbnut working for BlackJack tagged an associate of mine. Need you to repay the favor.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_bla.chinese: 有个黑杰克的佣兵给我们找了很多大麻烦。我老板想要这个麻烦消失掉。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_bla.english: Ive Got a BlackJack merc giving us some real trouble. My boss wants the problem to go away.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_gen.chinese: 有这么个混蛋早该死了还不自知，你去纠正一下。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_gen.english: I've got an asshole living on borrowed breath. Rectify that.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_ret.chinese: 还记得那个制作“灵感源泉”的瘾君子不？我们刚刚找出他的手下，干掉他们。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_contract_ret.english: Remember that junkie cooking the designer light? Yeah we just ID'd another of his crew. Take them down.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard.chinese: 嗯，有个棘手的活儿给你，老板直发的。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard.english: All right, I got a tough one for you. This one came direct from the boss.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard.chinese: 上面发话了，他们要你去干点儿特别的活儿。我不想瞎猜，但听起来这像是他们要见你。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard.english: Okay word's come down. They want to use you for something special. I don't wanna speculate, but it sounds like they're auditioning you.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.chinese: 你闲得无聊的话，我有个活儿给你。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.english: I got a job for you if you're looking to keep busy.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.chinese: 你想忙起来的话我有个活儿给你。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.english: I got a job for you if you're looking to keep busy.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.chinese: 刚刚接到个差事需要处理。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_s.english: Just heard about an errand that needs to be sorted.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.chinese: 我们有个伙计声称在运货时候被打劫了，这故事听起来不很靠谱。我要你去查一查，看看他们说的是不是真话。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.english: One of our people claimed they got ambushed on a run. Something sounds shakey about that story. I want you to head out and see if they're on the level.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.chinese: 我们有艘船在外面被炸毁了。我需要你去找到尸体，或者有关凶手的证据。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.english: One of our ships turned into a mystery wreck out there. I need you to either find the bodies or proof of who did it.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.chinese: 有个残骸需要你去调查下。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_.english: Got a wreck I want you to check out.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig.chinese: 嗯，今天没活儿给你，除非你对焚尸炉感兴趣。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig.english: No. Nothing here for you today. Unless you're into incinerators.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig.chinese: 其实我挺欣赏你的热情的，但是那不意味着我有活儿能派给你。
pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig.english: Hey, I appreciate your enthusiasm, but it doesn't mean I got anything for you.

pu_pacheco_mg_missionbriefs_steal_generi.chinese: 有个活儿，当我们的人想要某件东西的时候，我会负责选出正确的人做那件事；对，那个人就是你。

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 我铤而走险，给你弄到了最好的消息，结果你还是搞砸了。

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 你知道么，当你把一个活儿搞得这么糟糕，丢的可是我们俩的脸啊，不是吗？

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 你惹上大麻烦了。我还以为这已经是你的下限了，结果你又搞砸一个活儿。
pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.english: You are in the middle of a serious spiral here. Just when I think you can't get any lower, you mess up another job.

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 不知道你有什么问题。我都不记得有哪个任务是你最后没搞砸的。

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.chinese: 算你走运，今天我心情好，所以我会再给你一次机会。
pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.english: You're lucky I'm in a good mood though, so I'll give you one more chance.

pu_parr_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.chinese: 虽然你的表现一塌糊涂，但我是个大度的人，再给你最后一次机会。

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_decline_deck_noper.chinese: 你未被授权使用此货物设施。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_decline_deck_noper.english: You are not authorized to use this cargo facility.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_decline_deck_noval.chinese: 货物服务请求已拒绝。该载具尺寸超限。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_decline_deck_noval.english: Cargo service request denied. Unable to accommodate vehicle.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_despawn_ship_ig_00.chinese: 你的载具已被锁定。请等待。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_despawn_ship_ig_00.english: Your vehicle is now locked down. Standby.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_queue_deck_cargo_i.chinese: 货物服务请求已挂起。当前无可用空间。请等待。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_queue_deck_cargo_i.english: Cargo service request pending. No current space available. Standby.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_request_deck_cargo.chinese: 货物服务请求已确认。请等待。

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_revoke_deck_alignf.chinese: 载具未对齐。指定的货运甲板已被取消。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_revoke_deck_alignf.english: Vehicle not aligned. Assigned cargo deck has been revoked.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_revoke_deck_ig_001.chinese: 指定货运甲板已被取消。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_revoke_deck_ig_001.english: Assigned cargo deck has been revoked.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_aligntim.chinese: 请对齐载具，否则指定的货运甲板将被取消。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_aligntim.english: Align vehicle or assigned cargo deck will be revoked.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_arrivalt.chinese: 警告。如不使用，分配的货运甲板将被取消。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_arrivalt.english: Warning. Assigned cargo deck will be revoked if not utilized.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig.chinese: 不进行货物运送作业的载具必须离开货运甲板。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_deck_clear_ig.english: Vehicles not transferring cargo must vacate the cargo deck.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_ship_obstruct.chinese: 警告。你的载具未被授权使用货运甲板。请离开，否则你的载具将被锁定。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_ship_obstruct.english: Warning. Your vehicle is not authorized for cargo deck use. Vacate or your vehicle will be locked down.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_ship_obstruct.chinese: 警告。请清空货舱，否则载具将被锁定。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_ship_obstruct.english: Warning. Vacate the cargo deck or your vehicle will be locked down.

pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_shipstate_inv.chinese: 请调整载具结构以进行货物转运。
pu_pyrocgoatc01_m_atc_warn_shipstate_inv.english: Adjusting vehicle configuration for cargo transfer.

pu_raceann1_an_general_bumps_annship_ig_.chinese: 如果你想揍谁，就去撞他的船。
pu_raceann1_an_general_bumps_annship_ig_.english: You wanna hit somebody, hit someone else's ship.

pu_raceann1_an_general_friendlyfire_anns.chinese: 嘿！我他娘的不是参赛者！
pu_raceann1_an_general_friendlyfire_anns.english: Hey! I'm not in the goddamn race.

pu_raceann1_an_general_friendlyfire_anns.chinese: 我说真的，我不是来这当靶子的。
pu_raceann1_an_general_friendlyfire_anns.english: Seriously, I'm not here for target practice.

pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.chinese: 去你的吧，你他妈出局了。
pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.english: Hell with it. You're out of the goddamn race.

pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.chinese: 你出局了，听清楚了吗？没戏了，玩完了。
pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.english: You're finished. You hear me? Done. Finito.

pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.chinese: 就这样吧，我对你没啥好说的，你出局了。
pu_raceann1_an_general_playerkicked_ig_0.english: That's it. I'm done with you. You're out of the race.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.chinese: 这简直是屠杀，他们太强了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.english: This is getting to be a blowout. They are just dominating.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.chinese: 如果再没有人赶上来的话，那这场比赛胜负已定了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.english: If somebody doesn't step up soon, this race is over.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.chinese: 这简直就是一头猛兽，无人能望其项背。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_b.english: Talk about an absolute beast. I don't know if anyone can catch them at this point.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 比赛已经到了最后关头，现在谁都有可能获胜。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: This is getting down to the wire. It's anybody's win for the taking now.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 哇哦，今天这才算是真正的比赛，不知道究竟谁能拿走奖金呢。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: Ooo, we got ourselves a real competition today. Don't know who's gonna snatch the prize.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 我就直说了，今天的这场比赛就是你梦寐以求的比赛，不管是谁赢了，他都浪得虚名。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: I tell you what. This is it right here. This is the kind of race you dream about. Whoever wins is really earning their keep, today.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 快了，这场比赛马上就要结束了。那么问题来了，其他人会让第一就这么赢了吗？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: Getting close here. A little longer and it's gonna be all over. Question is, the rest of you just gonna let 'em win?

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 我们已经可以看出来谁将是最后的胜利者了，除非现在有个人出来终结他的胜利。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: This could be it. We could be looking at a winner here. That is of course unless someone steps up and stops 'em.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.chinese: 我们即将进入比赛的最后时刻，如果你一直在等待时机，现在也许就是你出手的时候了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_n.english: We headin' into the final moments of the race. If you've been biding your time, now might be the time to make your move.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_s.chinese: 又一个检查点，就是没啥意外。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_checkpointtaken_s.english: And checkpoint. Not a real surprise there.
One last racer, one more point.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_encouragelosingra.chinese: 比赛还未结束，不论你现在是什么名次，一个机缘巧合或者对手的一个失误都可能让你拿下这场比赛，一定要加坚持到底。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_encouragelosingra.english: This race isn't over yet. Doesn't matter what place you are right now. One lucky break or stupid mistake and this race is up for grabs, so stay in it.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_encouragelosingra.chinese: 你们可能没办法取胜，但这也不意味着你们就该默默退出。他妈的，输都输了，何不疯一把，是吧？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_encouragelosingra.english: You may not be winning this thing, but that don't mean you should go out quiet. Hell, if you're gonna lose, you might as well go down swinging, right?

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.chinese: 选手已经所剩不多了，现在我们可以看看最后几名选手的真正实力了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.english: The competition has narrowed and now we get too see what the last few bangers can really do.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.chinese: 选手已经所剩不多了，让我们看看谁能笑到最后。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.english: Only a few contenders left. Let's see who can go the distance.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.chinese: 就这样了，选手已经剩下不多了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_fewracersleft_ig_.english: That's it. The herd's been thinned out. We're down to the final few.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.chinese: 伙计们，我真的爱死这个比赛了，这才是混沌之美。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.english: Man, can I just say that I love this race. Talk about beauty in chaos.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.chinese: 我已经记不清这是我看过的第几场比赛了，但这东西就是永远看不腻。速度激情每一天。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.english: I don't know how many of these races I've seen, but they just never get old. Give me speed and bullets any day.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.chinese: 你知道什么这是比赛吗？要我说的话，这他妈就是一场狂欢。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_ig_.english: You know what this race is? This right here is some damn fine entertainment, if I do say so myself.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.chinese: 这场比赛已经变成枪林弹雨了，子弹打折了这是？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.english: This race is turning into a real shooting gallery. Is there a sale on ammo or something?

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.chinese: 真是一场嗜血的盛宴，别误会，我不是在抱怨。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.english: This is some serious bloodlust happening right now. I ain't complaining though.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.chinese: 我不喜欢批判别人，但是这里似乎有很多暴力狂啊。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.english: Now, I'm not one to judge, but it feels like there are a lot of aggression issues being worked out right now.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.chinese: 这些熟练的飞行员正在试图把对方置于死地，太和我胃口了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_gencommentary_int.english: There's something about skilled pilots really going for each other's throats that just does it for me.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.chinese: 来了来了，最后一圈，成败在此一举。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.english: Here we go. Last lap. It's now or never.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.chinese: 大伙们，这是最后一圈了，要么冲要么死。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.english: This is the final lap right here. Time to ride or die, people.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.chinese: 最后一圈了，不成功便成仁。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_final.english: Last lap. It's all or nothing.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_first.chinese: 第一圈结束，比赛仍在继续。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_first.english: One lap done. Let's keep it going.
There we go. First lap done and done.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_ig_00.english: Lap complete. Let's do it again.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.chinese: 我们无畏的第一名刚刚又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.english: Our fearless leader just cleared another lap.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.chinese: 离比赛结束又近了一圈。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.english: This race is one lap closer to completion.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.chinese: 看啊！我们的领头羊又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_leade.english: Look at that. The head of the pack's onto a new lap.
The number one racer notched another lap.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.chinese: 我们唯一的幸存者刚刚又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.english: That's another lap complete for our lone surviving ship.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.chinese: 剩下的最后一位赛手又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.english: And our one remaining competitor finishes another lap.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.chinese: 只剩下一名赛车手，跑圈就是胜利。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_lapcomplete_singl.english: With only one racer left, basically every lap they finish is a victory lap.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.chinese: 好的...看起来有些混蛋闯进了我们的比赛。
