pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.english: Okay... looks like we got some assholes crashing our race.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.chinese: 看起来我们的赛场里来了些不速之客。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.english: Seems we've got some uninvited guests screwing up our race.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.chinese: 注意了赛手们，看来有些瞎子把你们当靶子了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_nonracersinterrup.english: Heads up racers, looks like some blinders have decided to use you for target practice.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_oneracerleft_ig_0.chinese: 好吧，如果我没数错的话，看起来我们只剩一个赛手了。只要他不把自己撞死，胜利应该就是他的了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_oneracerleft_ig_0.english: Well, if I'm doing my math right, there's only one pilot left. So as long as they don't blow themselves up, the race is theirs.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.chinese: 这简直是屠杀，他们太强了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.english: This is getting to be a blowout. They are just dominating.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.chinese: 如果再没有人赶上来的话，那这场比赛胜负已定了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.english: If somebody doesn't step up soon, this race is over.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.chinese: 这简直就是一头猛兽，无人能望其项背。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_blowo.english: Talk about an absolute beast. I don't know if anyone can catch them at this point.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.chinese: 比赛已经到了最后关头，现在谁都有可能获胜。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.english: This is getting down to the wire. It's anybody's win for the taking now.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.chinese: 哇哦，今天这才算是真正的比赛，不知道究竟谁能拿走奖金呢。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.english: Ooo, we got ourselves a real competition today. Don't know who's gonna snatch the prize.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.chinese: 我就直说了，今天的这场比赛就是你梦寐以求的比赛，不管是谁赢了，他都浪得虚名。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_neart.english: I tell you what. This is it right here. This is the kind of race you dream about. Whoever wins is really earning their keep, today.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.chinese: 快了，这场比赛马上就要结束了。那么问题来了，其他人会让第一就这么赢了吗？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.english: Getting close here. A little longer and it's gonna be all over. Question is, the rest of you just gonna let 'em win?

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.chinese: 我们已经可以看出来谁将是最后的胜利者了，除非现在有个人出来终结他的胜利。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.english: This could be it. We could be looking at a winner here. That is of course unless someone steps up and stops 'em.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.chinese: 我们即将进入比赛的最后时刻，如果你一直在等待时机，现在也许就是你出手的时候了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_progression_nearv.english: We headin' into the final moments of the race. If you've been biding your time, now might be the time to make your move.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.chinese: 第一个倒下的赛手出现了，好戏才刚刚开始。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.english: And our first racer is down. Was just a matter of time until things got real.
Mark that as the first kill of the race.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.chinese: 第一名伤员出现了，现在比赛已经变成了战场。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.english: We got a casualty, folks. It's a fight now.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.chinese: 有人能叫一下医生吗？我们这出现了第一个伤员。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.english: Someone wanna call a medic? We got ourselves the first casualty.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.chinese: 哦，一名赛手倒下了！我觉得他站不起来了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_first_i.english: Ohhh, racer down! I don't think they're getting back up.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_002,.chinese: 我们又有一名选手吃灰去了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_002,.english: And another racer bites the dust.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_003,.chinese: 又有一名选手魂归虚空了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_003,.english: Got another pilot merging with the infinite.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_004,.chinese: 又有一名选手倒下了，比赛正在变成一场激烈的斗殴。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_004,.english: Another one down. We're getting into a downright brawl here.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_005,.chinese: 你们看见那个倒下的倒霉蛋了么？我操，比赛燃起来了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_005,.english: Y'all see that fool go down? Damn they got lit up.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.chinese: [笑声] 哦操。我打赌他一定以为自己快要赢了来着。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.english: [ Laughing ] Oh, damn. I bet they thought they were gonna win.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.chinese: 哦！他曾经认为自己高高在上，不可撼动。可惜他的美梦破碎了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.english: Oh! They thought they were on top! That they were untouchable, but that dream came crashing down.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.chinese: 上一秒遥遥领先，下一秒一败涂地。可能这就是命吧。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_leader_.english: One second they're in the lead, and the next they're a flaming wreck. That's life for ya.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.chinese: 杀了冠军，你就是冠军。这场比赛只能有一个胜利者！
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.english: Kill the leader, become the leader. There can be only one!

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.chinese: 这就是生命的循环啊，想要登顶，你必须杀出一条血路。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.english: Cycle of life here, people. It's all about killing your way to the top.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.chinese: 那家伙不但一路杀到第一，而且杀出了风采。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerdies_newlead.english: Not only did that racer just kill their way into first place, but they did it with serious style.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.chinese: 嗯...我们的一名飞行员刚刚中途退出了比赛，既然你都不打算完成了，为什么还要来参加呢？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.english: Um... a pilot just left in the middle of the race. What's the point of starting something you ain't gonna finish?

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.chinese: 一名选手刚刚弃权离开了...有些令人失望。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.english: One of our racers just up and quit... That's a bit dissapointing.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.chinese: 看起来我们有个驾驶员跑路了，希望没人在他身上下了注。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.english: Seems one of our pilots ran away. Hope no one was betting on them.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.chinese: 你们都看到那个跑路的飞行员了吗？我以为不用再强调来着，不要中途退赛。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_00.english: Did y'all see that pilot leave? Thought it went without saying, but don't leave in the middle of a race.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 有人通过了第一个检查点，不知道他们能不能撑到第二个呢？
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: First checkpoint down. Let's see if they can make it two.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 完成第一个检查点了。准备继续，伙计们。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: First one's down. We're off, people.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 好啊，开始了，第一个检查点完成了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: All right, all right. Here we go. First checkpoint.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 看啊，又通过了一个检查点。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: Look at that, another checkpoint down.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 一个飞行员通过了另一个检查点。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: A pilot just snagged another checkpoint.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 又通过一个检查点，干得漂亮。

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: Checkpoint claimed. That's what I like to see.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 啊哈，给那个飞行员加一分。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: There we go. Give that pilot a point.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 看起来第一名刚刚易主了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: Looks like we got ourselves a new leader.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 精彩还没结束，我们的领头羊又换了一个。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: This ain't over yet. New leader's stepping up.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 嚯嚯，这场比赛迎来了新的霸主。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: Hoowee, there's a new boss in town.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.chinese: 又一个检查点，就是没啥意外。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_checkpoi.english: And checkpoint. Not a real surprise there.
One last racer, one more point.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.chinese: 做好准备，下一个检查点出现了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.english: Get ready. Here comes the next marker.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.chinese: 准备好！下一个检查点现身了。
准备好了没有，下一个检查点就要出现了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.english: Ready or not, next marker's coming.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.chinese: 下一个检查点就要出现了，准备好。
准备好，新的检查点要来了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.english: Hold on, got a new maker on it's way.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.chinese: 好了，各位，下一个检查点快要出来了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_scramble_newcheck.english: Okay y'all, new marker's about to drop.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_001,p.chinese: 我平时是挺欣赏特立独行的人，但往错误方向飞可就有点过了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_001,p.english: I'm normally in favor of an independent streak, but flying the wrong direction is a bit much.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_002,p.chinese: 不知道你是没看清楚路标还是什么，但你飞错方向了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_002,p.english: Not sure if you just missed the signs, but you're heading the wrong way.

pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_003,p.chinese: 不知道你是磕上了哪种“竞赛增强剂”，但是你飞错方向了。
pu_raceann1_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_003,p.english: Not sure what "race enhancers" you're on, but you're flying the wrong direction.

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_h.chinese: 好了！到此为止！赢家已经出现了！
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_h.english: That is it! It's all over! We have a winner!

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_h.chinese: 正式公告，我们有了一位优胜者！
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_h.english: And it's official, we have ourselves a winner!
Stick a fork in it! We have a winner!

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.chinese: 比赛结束。至获胜者：恭喜。至其它人：好好练练。
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.english: And that's that. To the winner: Congrats. To everyone else: practice.

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.chinese: 然后...结束了。好了，开始准备下一场吧。如何？
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.english: And... we're done. All right, let's get ready for the next one. Okay?

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.chinese: 我看行了。冠军的表现十分亮眼...让我说可能有点太亮眼了，但干得不错。
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_winnerdeclared_l.english: That'll do it. Helluva show from our winner... probably too good of one if you ask me. But nice work.

pu_raceann1_an_postrace_wrapup_ig_005,p.chinese: 让我先来向我们的获胜者表达祝贺。对于其他人呢，希望很快就能再见到你的身影。真是一场精彩的比赛。
pu_raceann1_an_postrace_wrapup_ig_005,p.english: Let me be the first to say congrats to our victor. And to all the others, hopefully, I'll see you all back here again real soon. It's been a trip.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_entrantleaves_ig_.chinese: 看来我们有位选手改变心意离开了，但嘿，天涯何处无芳草嘛，是吧？
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_entrantleaves_ig_.english: Seems one of our racers had a change of heart and ghosted. But hey, there's always other fish in the sea, right?

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_entrantleaves_ig_.chinese: 看来，有位选手退赛了。估计是有些人受不了这压力吧。管他呢。少了他说不定这场还能比的更好，是吧。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_entrantleaves_ig_.english: Well, we're down a entrant now. Guess some people can't handle the pressure. Screw it. Race's probably better off without 'em, anyway.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_minracersaccepted.chinese: 大伙们，过得如何啊。看来我们已经有足够选手来正式比一场了，现在等人都到齐了后，我们就可以开始了。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_minracersaccepted.english: What's up, people. Looks like we got enough racers to make this official. Now we just need people to show up and we can get this show on the road.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_minracersaccepted.chinese: 一则快讯，女士们先生们。已经有足够的选手来让这场比赛变得有趣了，所有人都准备好了的话，咱就开始。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_minracersaccepted.english: Quick update, ladies and germs. We got enough racers to make this interesting. Once all our people show up, we go.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_raceaccepted_shor.chinese: 怎么了，伙计。这是内斯·卡洛韦。我的人说你准备来参加下场比赛，我们就要开始了，所以过来起点这边吧。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_raceaccepted_shor.english: What's going on, my friend. Nes Calloway here. My people tell me you're up for our next race. We're about ready to go, so head on over to the start line.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig_0.chinese: 行，就这样，比赛取消。没半个人要来那也没啥意义，下次再说吧。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig_0.english: That's it. I'm calling it. Race is canceled. No point in doing this if no one else is coming. Maybe next time.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig_0.chinese: 好吧，听着，虽然我不想这么说，但有一堆选手弃权了，所以我们只能改天再找时间比赛吧。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig_0.english: All right, look. I hate to do it, but I got a bunch of pilots who bailed, so it looks like we're gonna have to race some other time.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_001.chinese: 其实，我打算提前一点开始。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_001.english: Actually, I might kick this off a little early.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_002.chinese: 说实话，我已经等不及让这场好戏上演了。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_002.english: I'll be honest, I'm kinda eager to get this show on the road.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_003.chinese: 看来我们可以开始了，再最后清点一下人数...
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_startearly_ig_003.english: It's looking like we might be all set to go. Just gonna do a last count...

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_001.chinese: 大家都别急。应该要不了多久了。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_001.english: Stay frosty, y'all. Shouldn't be too much longer now.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_002.chinese: 再来几个人，我们就可以出发了。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_002.english: Just a couple more ticks, and we'll be ready to go.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_003.chinese: 我懂你们都想快点开始，但估计还得再等等。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_003.english: I know y'all wanna get this poppin' but it's gonna be a little bit longer.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_longwait_.chinese: 欢迎，欢迎。我们还差一两个没到，所以就再多等一会儿，我们很快就会开始。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_longwait_.english: Welcome, welcome. We're still waiting on a few more stragglers, so hang out for a sec. We'll get going soon.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_longwait_.chinese: 你好啊，赛手，欢迎来到竞技场。赌你已经按捺不住自己一飞冲天的心情了，但我还是得请你再坐一会儿，等等其他的选手到场。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_longwait_.english: Hey there, rambler. Welcome to the heat. Bet you're itching to get started, but I'm gonna need you to just sit tight 'til the rest of the racers show.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.chinese: 嘿！正是时候，比赛就快开始了，但我们有几个选手还在路上。先冷静冷静，他们一到，咱们就开始。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.english: Hey there. Just in time. We're about ready to start the race, but we got a few more racers on their way. Cool your jets and once they show, we go.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.chinese: 欢迎来到比赛现场，好戏马上就要开场了，只需要再多等几个人。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.english: Welcome to the show. The race'll be starting soon. Just waiting on a few more people to show.

pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.chinese: 敬礼！很高兴。剩下的选手一到场咱们就开始，但在这之前，你可以去打量打量你的对手。
pu_raceann1_an_prerace_welcome_shortwait.english: Salutations. Thrilled you made it out. Once the rest of the racers get here, we'll kick things off, but feel free to size up the competition till then.

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.chinese: 你最好把引擎开开，我们就要准备出发了！
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.english: You better get those engines humming 'cause we're about to kick off ?

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.chinese: 比赛开始了，伙计们。是时候，让我们看看谁能做到万无一失，赢取胜利的桂冠。你准备好了吗？好了吗？那就？
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.english: Lock it in, people. It's that time. Time to see who's gonna lay it all on the line and snatch the ring of victory. You ready? You ready? Well ?

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.chinese: 好了，是时候了，各位。让我们看看是谁艺高胆大，又是谁能坚持不懈？
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_init_.english: Okay. It's that time, people. Time to see who's got the mettle and who's got the grind ?

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_readi.chinese: 你最好把引擎开开，我们就要准备出发了！各就位...预备...出发！
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_readi.english: You better get those engines humming 'cause we're about to kick off. Get ready ... get set ... go!

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_readi.chinese: 好了，是时候了，各位。让我们看看是谁艺高胆大，又是谁能坚持不懈？各就位...预备...出发！
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_countdown_readi.english: Okay. It's that time, people. Time to see who's got the mettle and who's got the grind. Get ready ... get set ... go!

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_racemodeexp_nor.chinese: 看起来所有人都在起跑线上了，那我给你们解释一下规则。第一个完成所有比赛圈的船就算获胜。就是这么简单。
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_racemodeexp_nor.english: Looks like we got all our racers in place so let me tell you how this is gonna work. The first ship to complete all the laps wins. Easy as pie.

pu_raceann1_an_racestart_racemodeexp_nor.chinese: 好了，漫步者们，准备好开冲吧。你们都知道规矩的，第一个跑完所以比赛圈的就算获胜。这应该会是一场无比精彩的比赛。
pu_raceann1_an_racestart_racemodeexp_nor.english: All right, ramblers, let's get rambling. Y'all know the drill: the racer that finishes all the laps first wins. Should be a real good time.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_deaththroe_scre.chinese: 不，不...不！！！< 挣扎 > < 尖叫声 >
不，不...不！！！< 挣扎 > < 尖叫声 >
不，不...不！！！< 挣扎 > < 尖叫声 >

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_friendlyfire_ha.chinese: 嘿！我他娘的不是参赛者！
pu_raceann1_m_an_general_friendlyfire_ha.english: Hey! I'm not in the goddamn race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_friendlyfire_ha.chinese: 我很严肃的告诉你，我不是来这当练习标靶的。
pu_raceann1_m_an_general_friendlyfire_ha.english: Seriously, I'm not here for target practice.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_playerkicked_ig.english: Hell with it. You're out of the goddamn race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_playerkicked_ig.chinese: 你出局了，听清楚了吗？你！出！局！了！
pu_raceann1_m_an_general_playerkicked_ig.english: You're finished. You hear me? Done. Finito.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_playerkicked_ig.chinese: 就这样吧，没啥好说的了，你可以滚了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_general_playerkicked_ig.english: That's it. I'm done with you. You're out of the race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_general_shipbumps_handl.chinese: 如果你想揍某个人，去撞他的船。
pu_raceann1_m_an_general_shipbumps_handl.english: You wanna hit somebody, hit someone else's ship.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_encouragelosing.chinese: 比赛还未结束，不论你现在是什么名次，一个机缘巧合或者对手的一个失误都可能让你拿下这场比赛，别轻易放弃。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_encouragelosing.english: This race isn't over yet. Doesn't matter what place you are right now. One lucky break or stupid mistake and this race is up for grabs, so stay in it.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_encouragelosing.chinese: 你们可能没办法取胜，但这也不意味着你们就该默默退出。何不在输前疯狂一把，要输也要输得精彩，不是吗？
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_encouragelosing.english: You may not be winning this thing, but that don't mean you should go out quiet. Hell, if you're gonna lose, you might as well go down swinging, right?

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.chinese: 选手已经所剩不多了，让我们看看他们在这最后的关头能有什么能耐。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.english: The competition has narrowed and now we get too see what the last few bangers can really do.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.chinese: 选手已经所剩不多了，让我们看看谁能笑到最后。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.english: Only a few contenders left. Let's see who can go the distance.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.chinese: 选手所剩无几了，最后关头往往格外精彩。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_fewracersleft_i.english: That's it. The herd's been thinned out. We're down to the final few.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 伙计们我真的爱死这个比赛了，这才是混沌之美。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: Man, can I just say that I love this race. Talk about beauty in chaos.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 我已经记不清这是我看过的第几场比赛了，但这东西就是永远看不腻。速度激情每一天。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: I don't know how many of these races I've seen, but they just never get old. Give me speed and bullets any day.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 你知道这比赛是什么吗？这就是最极致的娱乐，至少我是这么认为的。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: You know what this race is? This right here is some damn fine entertainment, if I do say so myself.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 这场比赛正在变成一个真正的移动靶场，是因为这儿的弹药打折够狠么？
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: This race is turning into a real shooting gallery. Is there a sale on ammo or something?

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 现场发生了一些严重的流血事件。别误会，我不是在抱怨。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: This is some serious bloodlust happening right now. I ain't complaining though.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 我不是裁判，但是可以看得出这里正在发生一些严重的暴力事件。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: Now, I'm not one to judge, but it feels like there are a lot of aggression issues being worked out right now.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.chinese: 这些熟练的飞行员正在试图把对方置于死地。虽然...这正合我胃口。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_gencommentary_i.english: There's something about skilled pilots really going for each other's throats that just does it for me.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.chinese: 来了来了，最后一圈！成败在此一举。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.english: Here we go. Last lap. It's now or never.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.chinese: 这是最后一圈了，要么冲要么死，就看你们的了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.english: This is the final lap right here. Time to ride or die, people.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.chinese: 最后一圈，不要辜负了自己哦。
最后一圈了，成王败寇在此一举。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fin.english: Last lap. It's all or nothing.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fir.chinese: 第一圈结束，可以看得出来赛场正在升温。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_fir.english: One lap done. Let's keep it going.
There we go. First lap done and done.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_ig_.english: Lap complete. Let's do it again.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.chinese: 我们无畏的骑士领队刚刚又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.english: Our fearless leader just cleared another lap.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.chinese: 离比赛结束又近了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.english: This race is one lap closer to completion.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.chinese: 看啊！我们的领头羊又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.english: Look at that. The head of the pack's onto a new lap.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.chinese: 我们的第一名又跑完了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_lea.english: The number one racer notched up another lap.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.chinese: 我们的幸存者刚刚又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.english: That's another lap complete for our lone surviving ship.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.chinese: 最后一位赛手又完成了一圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.english: And our one remaining competitor finishes another lap.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.chinese: 只剩下一名赛车手，每一圈都是胜利圈。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_lapcomplete_sin.english: With only one racer left, it's like every lap they finish is a victory lap.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.chinese: 好的...看起来有一些混蛋闯进了我们的比赛。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.english: Okay... looks like we got some assholes crashing our race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.chinese: 看起来我们的赛场里来了些不速之客。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.english: Seems we've got some uninvited guests screwing up our race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.chinese: 注意了赛手们，看来有些瞎子决定用你们来练习打靶。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_nonracersinterr.english: Heads up racers, looks like some blinders have decided to use you for target practice.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_oneracerleft_ig.chinese: 好吧，如果我没数错的话，看起来我们只剩一个赛手了。只要他不把自己撞死，胜利应该就是他的了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_oneracerleft_ig.english: Well, if I'm doing my math right, there's only one pilot left. So as long as they don't blow themselves up, the race is theirs.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.chinese: 这是绝对的实力碾压...这个人已经主宰了这场比赛。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.english: This is getting to be a blowout. They are just dominating.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.chinese: 如果没有人站出来阻止他的话...那这场比赛可能就大局已定了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.english: If somebody doesn't step up soon, this race is over.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.chinese: 这个人猛得一匹，无人能挡。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_blo.english: Talk about an absolute beast. I don't know if anyone can catch them at this point.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 这真的很难分辨，谁胜谁负尚不可知。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: This is getting down to the wire. It's anybody's win for the taking now.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 哇哦，我们见证了一场势均力敌的竞争，不知道究竟谁能拿走奖金呢。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: Ooo, we got ourselves a real competition today. Don't know who's gonna snatch the prize.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 这他娘的就是我梦寐以求的比赛，这场的冠军一定不是浪得虚名。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: I tell you what. This is it right here. This is the kind of race you dream about. Whoever wins is really earning their keep, today.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 马上了马上了，这场比赛马上就要告终了。那么问题来了，剩下的赛手们，你们能忍得了让第一这么轻松地获胜么？
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: Getting close here. A little longer and it's gonna be all over. Question is, the rest of you just gonna let 'em win?

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 我们已经可以看出来谁将是最后的胜利者了，除非现在有个人出来终结他的胜利。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: This could be it. We could be looking at a winner here. That is of course unless someone steps up and stops 'em.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.chinese: 比赛已经进行到最后阶段了，如果你一直在等待着翻盘的时机，那么现在是时候付诸行动了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_progression_nea.english: We headin' into the final moments of the race. If you've been biding your time, now might be the time to make your move.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.chinese: 第一名倒下的赛手出现。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.english: And our first racer is down.
Mark that as the first kill of the race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.chinese: 第一名伤员出现了，现在比赛已经变成了战场。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.english: We got a casualty, folks. It's a fight now.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.chinese: 有人能叫一下救护船么，我们这出现了一名伤员。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.english: Someone wanna call a medic? We got ourselves the first casualty.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.chinese: 哦哦哦哦哦哦！一名赛手倒下了，我不认为他能重新站起来。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_first.english: Ohhh, racer down! I don't think they're getting back up.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.chinese: 我们又有一名选手半截入土了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.english: And another racer bites the dust.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.chinese: 又有一名选手魂归虚空了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.english: Got another pilot merging with the infinite.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.chinese: 又有一名选手倒下了，比赛正在变成一场彻头彻尾的斗殴。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.english: Another one down. We're getting into a downright brawl here.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.chinese: 你们看见那个倒下的倒霉蛋了么？淦哦他燃起来了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_ig_00.english: Y'all see that fool go down? Damn they got lit up.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.chinese: [ 笑声 ] 哦天哪。我打赌他一定以为自己快要赢了来着。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.english: [ Laughing ] Oh, damn. I bet they thought they were gonna win.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.chinese: 哦！他曾经认为自己是最棒的，不可撼动的！可惜他还是带着自己的梦想一起坠毁了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.english: Oh! They thought they were on top! That they were untouchable, but that dream came crashing down.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.chinese: 上一秒还处于领先，下一秒就化为燃烧的残骸。可能这就是命吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_leade.english: One second they're in the lead, and the next they're a flaming wreck. That's life for ya.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.chinese: 杀了冠军，你就是冠军。这场比赛只容得下一个胜利者！
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.english: Kill the leader, become the leader. There can only be one!

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.chinese: 这就是生命的循环啊，人挡杀人、佛挡杀佛。只有这样你才能成为最强。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.english: Cycle of life here, people. It's all about killing your way to the top.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.chinese: 我们的第一名又一次易主了，这个名次可来之不易。我们的赛手为了这个名次可是下了不少狠手。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerdies_newle.english: Not only did that racer just kill their way into first place, but they did it with serious style.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.chinese: 嗯...我们的一门赛手刚刚中途退出了比赛，不过我有点摸不清他的想法...做事情不应该有始有终么？
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.english: Um... a pilot just left in the middle of the race. What's the point of starting something you ain't gonna finish?

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.chinese: 一名选手刚刚弃权离开了...挺令人失望的。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.english: One of our racers just up and quit... That's a bit dissapointing.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.chinese: 看起来我们有个驾驶员跑路了，希望没人在他身上下了注。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.english: Seems one of our pilots ran away. Hope no one was betting on them.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.chinese: 你们看到那个离开的飞行员了么？我以为不用再强调了来着，不要中途退赛。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_racerleaves_ig_.english: Did y'all see that pilot leave? Thought it went without saying, but don't leave in the middle of a race.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 做好准备，下一个检查点出现了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Get ready. Here comes the next marker.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 准备好！下一个检查点现身了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Ready up! New marker inbound.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 准备好了没有，下一个检查点就要出现了了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Ready or not, next marker's coming.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 下一个检查点就要出现了，比赛可不等人。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Another marker incoming. Get ready.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 正准备投放下个检查点。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Hold on, got a new maker on it's way.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 好了，下一个检查点快要出来了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Okay y'all, new marker's about to drop.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 下一个检查点出现了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Here comes the next marker.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 选手已经通过了第一个检查点，不知道他们能不能到达第二个呢？
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: First checkpoint down. Let's see if they can make it two.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 完成第一个检查点了。准备继续，伙计们。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: First one's down. We're off, people.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 啊终于，第一个检查点完成了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: All right, all right. Here we go. First checkpoint.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 检查点完成。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Checkpoint taken.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 看啊，又通过了一个检查点。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Look at that, another checkpoint down.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 一位选手刚刚又疾驰通过了一个检查点。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: A pilot just snagged another checkpoint.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 又通过一个检查点，干得漂亮。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Another chekpoint taken. Nicely done.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 检查点完成，这才对嘛。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Checkpoint claimed. That's what I like to see.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 啊哈，给那个飞行员加一分。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: There we go. Give that pilot a point.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 看起来第一名刚刚易主了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Looks like we got ourselves a new leader.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 精彩还没结束，我们的领头羊又换了一个。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: This ain't over yet. New leader's stepping up.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 芜湖，来看看这场比赛的新主宰。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: Hoowee, there's a new boss in town.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 虽然毫无乐趣，但是我们的选手又拿下了一个检查点。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: And checkpoint. Not a real surprise there.
< Snoring >... Huh? What happened? Oh...

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.chinese: 最后的选手多拿一分。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_scramble_checkp.english: One last racer, one more point.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_001.chinese: 我平时是挺欣赏特立独行的人，但往错误方向飞可就有点过了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_001.english: I'm normally in favor of an independent streak, but flying in the wrong direction's a bit much.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_002.chinese: 不知道你是没看清楚标识还是什么，但你飞的方向错了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_002.english: Not sure if you just missed the signs, but you're heading the wrong way.

pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_003.chinese: 不知道你是磕上了哪种“竞赛增强剂”，你这是在往错的方向飞。
pu_raceann1_m_an_midrace_wrongway_ig_003.english: Not sure what "race enhancers" you're on, but you're flying in the wrong direction.

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.chinese: 好了！到此为止！赢家已经出现了！
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.english: That is it! It's all over! We have a winner!

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.chinese: 正式公告，我们有了一位优胜者！
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.english: And it's official, we have ourselves a winner!
Stick a fork in it! We have a winner!

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.chinese: 比赛结束。至获胜者：恭喜。至其它人：好好练练。
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.english: And that's that. To the winner: Congrats. To everyone else: practice.

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.chinese: 然后... 结束了。好了，开始准备下一场吧。如何？
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.english: And... we're done. All right, let's get ready for the next one. Okay?

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.chinese: 我看行了。冠军的表现十分亮眼... 让我说可能有点太亮眼了，但干得不错。
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_winnerdeclared.english: That'll do it. Helluva show from our winner... probably too good of one if you ask me. But nice work.

pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_wrapup_ig_005_.chinese: 让我先来向我们的获胜者表达祝贺。对于其他人呢，希望很快就能再见到你的身影。刚那真的太难忘了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_postrace_wrapup_ig_005_.english: Let me be the first to say congrats to our victor. And to all the others, hopefully, I'll see you all back here again real soon. It's been a trip.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_entrantleaves_i.chinese: 看来我们有位选手改变心意离开了，但嘿，天涯何处无芳草嘛，是吧？
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_entrantleaves_i.english: Seems one of our racers had a change of heart and ghosted. But hey, there's always other fish in the sea, right?

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_entrantleaves_i.chinese: 看来，有位选手退赛了。估计是有些人受不了这压力吧。管他呢。少了他说不定这场还能比的更好，是吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_entrantleaves_i.english: Well, we're down a entrant now. Guess some people can't handle the pressure. Screw it. Race's probably better off without 'em, anyway.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_minracersaccept.chinese: 大伙们，过得如何啊。看来我们已经有足够选手来正式比一场了，现在等人都到齐了后，我们就可以开始了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_minracersaccept.english: What's up, people. Looks like we got enough racers to make this official. Now we just need people to show up and we can get this show on the road.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_minracersaccept.chinese: 一则快讯，女士们先生们。已经有足够的选手来让这场比赛变得有趣了，所有人都准备好了的话，咱就开始。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_minracersaccept.english: Quick update, ladies and germs. We got enough racers to make this interesting. Once all our people show up, we go.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_raceaccepted_sh.chinese: 怎么了，伙计。这是内斯·卡洛韦。我的人说你准备来参加下场比赛，我们就要开始了，所以过来起点这边吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_raceaccepted_sh.english: What's going on, my friend. Nes Calloway here. My people tell me you're up for our next race. We're about ready to go, so head on over to the start line.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig.chinese: 行，就这样，比赛取消。没半个人要来那也没啥意义，下次再说吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig.english: That's it. I'm calling it. Race is canceled. No point in doing this if no one else is coming. Maybe next time.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig.chinese: 好吧，听着，虽然我不想这么说，但有一堆选手弃权了，所以以后再找时间比赛吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_racecanceled_ig.english: All right, look. I hate to do it, but I got a bunch of pilots who bailed, so it looks like we're gonna have to race some other time.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.chinese: 其实，我打算提前一点开始。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.english: Actually, I might kick this off a little early.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.chinese: 说实话，我已经等不及让这场好戏上演了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.english: I'll be honest, I'm kinda eager to get this show on the road.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.chinese: 看来我们可以开始了。最后再次检录...
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_startearly_ig_0.english: It's looking like we might be all set to go. Just gonna do a last count...

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.chinese: 大家都别急。应该要不了多久了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.english: Stay frosty, y'all. Shouldn't be too much longer now.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.chinese: 再过个几秒，我们就可以开始了。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.english: Just a couple more ticks, and we'll be ready to go.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.chinese: 我懂你们都想快点开始，但估计还得再等等。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_waitlonger_ig_0.english: I know y'all wanna get this poppin' but it's gonna be a little bit longer.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_longwai.chinese: 欢迎，欢迎。我们还差一两个没到，所以就再多等一会儿，我们很快就会开始。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_longwai.english: Welcome, welcome. We're still waiting on a few more stragglers, so hang out for a bit. We'll get going soon.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_longwai.chinese: 欢迎来到竞技场。赌你已经按捺不住自己一飞冲天的心情了，但我还是得请你再坐一会儿，等等其他的选手到场。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_longwai.english: Welcome to the heat. Bet you're itching to get started, but I'm gonna need you to just sit tight 'til the rest of the racers show.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.chinese: 嘿！正是时候，比赛就快开始了，但我们有几个选手还在路上。先冷静冷静，他们一到，咱们就开始。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.english: Hey there. Just in time. We're about ready to start the race, but we got a few more racers on their way. Cool your jets and once they show, we go.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.chinese: 欢迎来到狂欢，好戏马上就要开场了，只需要再多等几个人。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.english: Welcome to the show. The race'll be starting soon. Just waiting on a few more people to show.

pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.chinese: 你好啊！你能来真是太让人激动了。剩下的选手一到场咱们就发车，但在那之前，尽情把赛场整的更热闹一些吧。
pu_raceann1_m_an_prerace_welcome_shortwa.english: Salutations. Thrilled you made it out. Once the rest of the racers get here, we'll kick things off, but feel free to size up the competition till then.

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.chinese: 你最好让引擎轰鸣起来，我们就要准备出发了！
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.english: You better get those engines humming 'cause we're about to kick off ?

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.chinese: 比赛开始了，大伙儿。是时候，让我们看看谁能做到万无一失，赢取胜利的桂冠。
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.english: Lock it in, people. It's that time. Time to see who's gonna lay it all on the line and snatch the ring of victory ?

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.chinese: 好了，是时候了，各位。让我们看看是谁艺高胆大，又是谁心细如发？
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_ini.english: Okay. It's that time, people. Time to see who's got the mettle and who's got the grind ?

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_rea.chinese: 你们最好让引擎轰鸣起来，我们要准备出发了。各就位...预备...出发！
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_rea.english: You better get those engines humming 'cause we're about to kick off. Get ready ... get set ... go!

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_rea.chinese: 好了，是时候了，各位。让我们看看是谁艺高胆大，又是谁心细如发？各就位...预备...出发！
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_countdown_rea.english: Okay. It's that time, people. Time to see who's got the mettle and who's got the grind. Get ready ... get set ... go!

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_racemodeexp_n.chinese: 看起来所有人都在起跑线上了，那我给你们解释一下规则。第一个完成所有比赛圈的船就算获胜。就是这么简单。
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_racemodeexp_n.english: Looks like we got all our racers in place so let me tell you how this is gonna work. The first ship to complete all the laps wins. Easy as pie.

pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_racemodeexp_n.chinese: 好了，漫步者们，让我们漫步起来。你们都知道规矩的，第一个跑完所以比赛圈的就算获胜。这应该会是一场无比精彩的比赛。
pu_raceann1_m_an_racestart_racemodeexp_n.english: All right, ramblers, let's get rambling. Y'all know the drill: the racer that finishes all the laps first wins. Should be a real good time.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 嘿，今天我就是给你加油的。赶紧申请对接，咱们好开工。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Hey there, I'm gonna be your refueler for today. Go ahead and request to dock so we can started.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 油不多了吧？这事儿谁都能碰上。行了，申请靠对接，咱好让你继续上路。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Low on gas, huh? Happens to the best of us. Well, request to dock and we can see about getting you back out on the move.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 咋样？这儿有专属于你的燃料呢。只要你申请对接，咱就能让你赶紧离开这地儿。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: How's it going? Got some fuel here with your name on it. Just need yo to request to dock and we can get you out of here.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 行，总算结束了。趁现在赶紧把加油的事儿搞定。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Okay, glad that's over. Let's finish up the refueling while we can.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 我看差不多了。在更多人冒出来之前，先把船连上吧。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: I think we're good. Connect the ships before more show up.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 都打完了？好嘞，那咱们赶紧给你加满油。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: That all of them? Good. Let's get you fueled up.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 好了，这下你该没问题了。祝你今天剩下的时间都顺顺利利。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: All right, you should be all set. Hope you have a good rest of your day.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 油箱加满了。在外面小心点啊。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Tank's full. Stay safe out there.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 咱们都搞定了。满舱油，太空等你呢。悠着点开。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: We are all good now. Tank's full and space awaits. Take it easy.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: [ 死亡尖叫 ]
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: [ Death Scream ]

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 行，都连好了。你确认完手环上的加油订单，我就能开始输油了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Okay, we're all connected. Once you confirm the fuel purchase from you mobi I can start the transfer.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 好嘞...链接建立。你现在应该能在手环上看到加油订单了，一旦你确认，我就给你油箱加满。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Alright… link established. You should be able to see the fuel purchase order in your mobi now. Once you confirm I can start filling your tanks.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 搞定，连上了。现在只需要你在 mobiGlas 上签个字确认加油就行。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: And there we go. Linked up. Now we just need you to sign off on the fuel purchase in your mobiGlas.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 行了，我还有其他客户等着呢。这儿完事儿了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: You know what, I got other clients waiting. We're done here.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 行吧，我看懂你想干啥了。我走了啊。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Okay, I think I know where this is headed. I'm out of here.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 我可没空陪你耗着。祝你好运。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: I don't have time for this. Good luck.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 行，现在就开始加油。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Okay, transferring fuel now.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 好嘞，开始加油了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Great, starting fuel transfer.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 看着不错，油已经流过去了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Looks good. Fuel's a-flowing.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 哇！加油还没完成呢。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Woah! The transfer wasn't done yet.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 怎么停了？你还没加满油呢。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Why'd you break? You aren't refueled.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 连接断了，出什么事了？
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Lost the connection. What happened?

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 你要去哪儿？剩下的燃料怎么办？
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Where do you think you're going? What about the rest of the fuel?

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 咋回事？你飞船还没加满呢。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: What's going on? Your ship's not full yet.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 呃...喂？我们还没加完油呢。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Uh… hello? We haven't finished the refueling.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 该死，出麻烦了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Damn it, we got trouble.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 小心点，有敌人。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Look out. Got some hostiles.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 注意点，他们看起来可不是来帮忙的。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Watch it. They don't look like they're here to help.

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 嘿！我这是在帮你啊！
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Hey! I'm trying to help you!

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 你到底在搞什么鬼？
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: What the hell are you doing?

pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.chinese: 见鬼，我不干了，撤了。
pu_refuellingprovider01_uwc_m_atc_refuel.english: Oh hell no. I'm out of here.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 哎呀，刚才那场面简直吓死人了。行吧，赶紧把加油搞定。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Well, that was absolutely terrifying. Okay, let's hurry up and get the fuel transfer done.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 就剩这些了？成，赶紧把这事儿办完，然后离开这鬼地方。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Is that all of them? Alright, how about we finish this and get the hell out of here.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 谢了。这星系一天比一天危险。趁还没更多家伙冒出来，咱们赶紧把这活儿干完。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Thank you. This system's getting more dangerous by the day. Let's finish this before more show up.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 搞定。准备出发。再次多谢，也抱歉给你添麻烦了。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: That's it. Ready to go. Thanks again and sorry for the trouble.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 行了，加油搞定了。多谢你救场，希望没给你添太多麻烦。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Okay. Fuel transfer's done. Thanks for the rescue. I hope it wasn't too much bother for you.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 呼，油加满了。太感谢你的帮忙了，下次我会更注意点仪表读数。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Phew. All refueled. Thanks so much for the help. I'm going to try to be a bit better about watching my gauges next time.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 太好了，咱们已经对接上了。你赶紧授权把加油这事儿办了吧。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Great. We're docked up. Go ahead and authorize the fuel transaction.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 对接完成了，就等你确认一下加油交易的事儿。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Docking complete. Just need you to confirm the fuel transaction.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 这就差不多了。你把加油交易的条款定好，我看一眼。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: That should do it. Set the fuel transaction terms, and I'll take a look.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Hey, I still need more fuel.
Wait, the fuel transfer wasn't done yet.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 嘿，多谢你来了。我居然把燃料用光了，感觉自己像个傻瓜。你要是想快点对接上，咱们这就把这事儿办完。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Hey, thanks for showing up. I feel like an idiot for running out of fuel. If you want to dock up quick, we can get this over with.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 嘿，在这边！真对不住啊。我敢发誓刚才距离算得挺准的...算了，赶紧对接上吧，好让你能继续赶路。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Hey, over here. I'm really sorry about this. I could've sworn I calculated the distance right… Anyway, let's get docked up so you can get on your way.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 行，早点回来啊，我在这等着。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: All right, come back soon. I'll be here waiting.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 没事，你去忙你的吧，等你准备好了我再待在这儿。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: No worries, take care of whatever you have to. I'll be here when you're ready.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 哦，你要走了...行，没问题，我能等。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Oh, you're leaving… yeah, sure, that's fine. I can wait.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 行，咱们重新连上了，这样就能赶紧离开这儿。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Okay, let's get reconnected so we can get out of here.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 欢迎回来，快对接上把加油的事儿办完吧。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Welcome back. Let's dock and finish the refuel.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 你能来我就放心了，你准备好了，我这边就能对接上。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Glad you made it. I'm ready to dock when you are.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricea.english: That's great. Seeing the fuel transfer now.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.chinese: 这价格比我预想的有点高啊。
pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.english: That price's a bit higher than I was expecting.

pu_refuelnpc01_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Holy shit! Who the hell is that?!
What the hell's the matter with you?

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 谢天谢地，刚才那会儿可真够紧张的。现在没事了，咱们赶紧把活儿干完吧。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Thank the powers. Gotta admit it got tense there for a moment. Now that's done, let's finish up.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 真是吓死我了，赶紧加完油我好走人。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: That was close. Let's finish refueling so I can get gone.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 总算结束了，希望接下来别再出什么岔子。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Glad that's over. Hopefully we can finish up without any more issues.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 行，看来事儿办完了，我得撤了。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Alright. Looks like we're done. I'm out of here.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 好了，油加满了，谢啦。刚才要是语气不好别介意，就是倒霉日子赶上了，一路平安。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Okay. I'm refueled. Thanks. And sorry if I was a bit short with you. Just one of those days. Safe flying.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 搞定，油箱满的。我还以为这辈子都走不脱了呢。行嘞，我走了。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: There. Tank's full. Thought I would never get out of here. Okay. I'm off.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 连上了，赶紧把价格定好，咱们好开始。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: We're connected. Get the pricing set so we can get going.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 已对接，继续发报价过来吧。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Docked. Go ahead and send the pricing over.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 连接确认无误，把交易条款定下来，咱就可以开始了。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Connection confirmed. Set the transaction terms so we can get started.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Hey, I wasn't done refueling yet.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.chinese: 搞什么呢？加油还没完呢。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: What's going on? We're not done refueling.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.chinese: 出啥问题了？我还得再加点油呢。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Something wrong? I still need more fuel.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 太好了你来了。赶紧对接过来，咱们好把事儿办起来。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Good, you're here. Go ahead and dock so we can get this show on the road.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 可算来了，再漂一会儿我都要疯了。赶紧对接上好让我离开这。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: About time. Was about to lose my mind if I had to float any longer. Get docked so I can get out of here.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 有人来就好。你动作快点对接过来呗，没必要拖拖拉拉的。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Glad someone showed up. Why don't you hurry up and dock. No reason this has to take any longer than it needs to.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 行...看来我只能在这儿干等着了？
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Okay… Guess I'm supposed to just wait here then?

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 快点回来，成吗？我可不想在这儿耗上一整天等你。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Hurry up and come back, okay? I don't want to spend all day waiting on you.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 好吧...把我一个人扔这儿等，反正我也没别的事儿好干。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Sure... Leave me waiting here. It's not like I have anything better to do.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 你倒是赶紧对接过来把活儿干完啊，还是打算继续浪费我时间？
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: How about you dock so we can finish this. Or are you going to waste more of my time?

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 总算回来了。赶紧对接上，咱们好把这事儿了结。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: There you are. Dock already and we can wrap this up.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 我的救星终于现身了。赶紧对接过来吧，我好走人。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: And my savior returns. How about you dock so I can get going.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricea.chinese: 正在给我油箱加满，马上就好。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricea.english: Filling up my tank now. Should be done soon.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.chinese: 这价格太高了，我付不起。
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.english: That's more than I can pay.

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 该死，今天还能出什么幺蛾子！
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Damn it. What else can go wrong today!

pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 你开玩笑吧？先是加油，现在又这档子事？
pu_refuelnpc02_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: You gotta be kidding me. First the fuel, and now this?
What the hell are you doing?!
What the hell was that for?

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 看来暂时安全了，还是赶紧把加油的事儿办完吧。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Seems we're safe for now. Better finish refueling.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 我想他们应该都跑光了。趁现在有空，赶紧把油加好。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: I think that was the last of 'em. Let's finish sorting my fuel while we can.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 没事了。希望在这之前能把油加完，别再出什么乱子了。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: All clear. Hopefully we can finish refueling before any more trouble shows up.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 搞定，油箱加满准备起飞。谢啦，你这一番忙活真不容易。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: And there we go. Topped off and ready to fly. Thanks for all your hard work.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 搞定，谢了加油。路上小心点。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Done. Thanks for the refuel. Fly safe out there.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 不错，油加满了。不过希望接下来一段时间都不用再麻烦你了。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Great. All fueled up. Though here's hoping I won't need your services again for a while.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 好了，连上了。还挺顺利，就等你确认一下燃料交易了。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: All right. Connected. Not too bad. Just need you to approve the fuel transaction.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 搞定，全都接好了。你那边发来条款，我马上就能看。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: There we go. All hooked up. I'm ready to look at the fuel transaction terms as soon as you send 'em my way.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 看起来都准备好了，直接确认燃料交易吧。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Looks like we're set. Go ahead and confirm the fuel transaction.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.chinese: 呃...你知道我们还没加完吧？
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Uh… you know we're not done yet, right?
Hold on there. I'm still not refueled yet.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.chinese: 哇，出什么事了？我还得再加点油呢。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Whoa, what's happening? I still need more fuel.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 啊，完美。你来了，多谢帮忙。真没想到我油都用光了。反正，你那边准备好了我就能随时对接上去。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Ah, perfect. You're here. Appreciate the help. Can't believe I ran out. Anyway, I'm ready to dock when you are.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 行，你要是急着办别的事，我就先在这等着，等你把剩下的油带回来。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Okay, if you got something urgent, I can just hold tight until you get back with the rest of the fuel.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 哦，你要出去一会儿？没事，我在这等着。赶紧回来哈，行不？
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Oh, you're ducking out for a minute? No worries. I'll hang out here. Just hurry back, okay?

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 咱们要歇会儿吗？别磨太久啊，要是能快点飞回去就好了。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: We taking a little break? Just don't take too long, all right. Would be good to get back flying soon.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 欢迎回来，我随时准备对接上去。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Welcome back. I'm still ready to dock.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 又见到你真高兴，咱们赶紧对接上把油加了吧。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Nice to see you again. Let's get docked and refueled.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 高兴你回来了，要不咱们干脆一次性把加油的事儿搞定？
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Glad you made it back. Shall we go ahead and get this refueling sorted once and for all?

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.chinese: 你这价格是在开玩笑吧？再试试。
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricer.english: You better be joking with that price. Try again.

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 真倒霉。他们偏偏挑这个时候搞事？
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Damn it. Could they have picked a worse time?
What the hell's gotten into you?

pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 嘿，你该帮我的，怎么还朝我开枪？
pu_refuelnpc03_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Hey, you're supposed to help me, not shoot me.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 妈呀，刚太惊险了。趁麻烦没再来赶紧把油加完吧。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Geez. That was too close. Finish refueling before any more trouble shows up.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 就这些吗？赶紧加完油我好赶紧离开这儿。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Was that all of them? Let's finish refueling so I can get the hell out of here.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.chinese: 总算走了。快点儿，赶紧给我加完油！
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcombat.english: Good riddance. Now hurry up and finishing refueling me.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 搞定，全加满了。别想，我可不会给你小费。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: There. All done. And no, you won't be getting a tip.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 就这些了，油加好了，拜拜。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: That's it. Got my fuel. Bye.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.chinese: 太好了，总算弄完了，我得赶紧撤了。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingcomple.english: Good. We're finally finished. I'm out of here.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 对接上了，把交易价格按咱们说好的定好。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Docked. Set the transaction to what we agreed.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 行，已经对接好了，就把交易价定成咱们谈好的那个数。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Okay. We’re docked. Just set the transaction price to what was agreed.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.chinese: 全都连上了，价格就按我说的来，别耍花样。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingdockin.english: Everything's connected. Set the price to what I specified. No funny stuff.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Where the hell are you going with my fuel?

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.chinese: 呃，你是不是没发现，你还没给我加满油呢。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingincomp.english: Uh, if you hadn't noticed, you didn't finish refueling me.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 你肯定就是给我加油的吧。先说好，别想额外收费，我只要加油就行。赶紧对接过来吧。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: You must be my refueler. And before you ask, no, I don't want any extra services. Just the refuel. Now go ahead and dock.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 我还正琢磨我的油船啥时候能到呢。行了，还等啥？赶紧对接过来吧。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: I was wondering when my tanker was going to show up. Anyway, what are you waiting for? Go ahead and dock.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 咱就别客套了行不？你是来干活的，赶紧对接过来吧。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Let's just skip the pleasantries, okay? You're here to do a job, so go ahead and dock.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 你要走？行吧，反正我也没啥别的事干，就在这儿等你回来得了。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: You're leaving? I guess I don't have anything better to do with my time than wait around here for you to come back.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 真不敢相信你居然没加完油就走了。算了，随便你吧，尽快回来就行。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: I can't believe you're leaving without finishing. Fine. Whatever. Just get back as soon as possible.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 哇哦，真有你的。看来我就得乖乖坐这儿，等你什么时候心情好了再回来是吧？行啊，就这样吧。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Wow. How professional. Guess I'm expected to just sit here waiting for you to feel like coming back? Sure. Why not.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 总算来了，赶紧对接过来把这事搞定。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Finally. Dock so we can get this over with.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 哟，是谁终于舍得回来了？赶紧对接好，给我把油加完。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: Look who decided to come back? Dock already and finish refueling me.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.chinese: 可算等到你了。说真的，我都在这儿干等半天了，是不是该给我打个折？算了，赶紧对接过来吧，我都已经够晚的了。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingplayer.english: About time. You know, I should really get a discount after sitting here waiting. Whatever, go ahead and dock. I'm late enough as it is.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricea.chinese: 行，油正在加呢，别跟我废话了。
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingpricea.english: Okay, fuel's transferring. And don't bother with small talk.

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 该死！我现在可没钱修船了！
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Damn it! I can't afford extra repairs right now!

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 他们到底为啥朝我开火啊？
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: What the hell are they shooting me for?

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 哦，没门儿！快把他们给我弄走！
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Oh, hell no! Get them off me!

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 嘿！你就是这么对待客户的吗？
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: Hey! That how you treat a customer?

pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.chinese: 搞什么鬼？你居然朝我开火？
pu_refuelnpc04_civ_m_atc_refuelingshipat.english: What the hell? You're shooting at me?!

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_arrivalbarge_gp_001,p.chinese: 你以为我会就这么让你大摇大摆地闯进来？那你可就打错算盘了。休想靠近最后一个转换器，听清楚没？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_arrivalbarge_gp_001,p.english: If you think I'm just gonna let you waltz in here, you've got another thing coming. You're not getting to the last inverter, you hear me?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_arrivalisland2ikti_gp_00.chinese: 都听好了。我们可能丢了一号平台，但休想让我在这儿也失守。几台 ATLS 改变不了什么。放马过来。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_arrivalisland2ikti_gp_00.english: Listen up. We may have lost the first platform, but no way I'm letting that happen here. Few ATLS ain't going to change that. Try your worst.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_death_gp_001,p.english: <painful scream> Nine Tails are gonna… you….

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_001,p.english: Come on, let's kill this scum already!

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_002,p.chinese: 不管你怎么折腾，九尾早就赢了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_002,p.english: No matter what you do, Nine Tails have already won.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_003,p.chinese: 就算是我能的最后一件事，我也要把你宰了！
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_003,p.english: I'm gonna see you bleed if it’s the last thing I do.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_004,p.chinese: 看来十字军花钱雇你们这帮人还挺值。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_004,p.english: Guess Crusader got their credits worth hiring you lot.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_005,p.chinese: 要不是你把我惹火了，我还有点佩服你了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_005,p.english: If I wasn't so pissed off at you, I might be a little impressed.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_006,p.chinese: 谁能搞定这件事，九尾的晋升机会就归谁。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_generaltaunts_gp_006,p.english: There's a promotion waiting for whichever Nine Tail ends this.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_ironcladelitedeath_gp_00.chinese: 我让他们把那些自动炮塔给炸了，可他们办到了吗？没有。看来跟一群杀手混在一起就是这个下场，根本没人听我的。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_ironcladelitedeath_gp_00.english: I told them to destroy those ATLS, but did they? No. Guess that's what I get workin' with a bunch of cutthroats. Nobody bloody listens.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_laststandtaunt_gp_001,p.chinese: 受够了！老子是门多·雷恩！七个星球的噩梦，九尾的黑心脏！咱们今天就做个了结！
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_laststandtaunt_gp_001,p.english: Enough's enough. I'm Mendo fuckin' Ren! The scourge of seven planets and the black heart of the Nine Tails. We settle this now!

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant1intro_gp_001,.chinese: 行了，雷米。准备一下，有人找你来了。让他们见识见识真正的九尾有多厉害。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant1intro_gp_001,.english: All right, Remy. Get ready. You got some company heading your way. Show them what a real Nine Tails can do.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2death_gp_001,.chinese: 见鬼...斯塔克斯...真没想到会有这么一天。你们尽管去摆弄那个转换器吧。我们手里还留着一个，这就足够了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2death_gp_001,.english: Hell… Stax… Never thought I'd see the day. Go ahead and do you what you want with that Invertor. We still got one and that's more than enough.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2intro_gp_001,.chinese: 行，斯塔克斯，你上场吧。自己小心点，明白吗？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2intro_gp_001,.english: Alright, you're on deck, Stax. Watch out for yourself, okay?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2introresponse.chinese: [轻笑] 有段时间没想这事了。不过嘿，只要你把他们都杀了，这次随便你怎么搞破坏都行。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_lieutenant2introresponse.english: [Chuckles] Haven't thought about that one in a while. But hey, as long as you kill 'em, make as much mess as you want this time.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart1_g.chinese: 你就是不能不要再多事是吧？这下好了，你得拿命来偿。希望你当英雄的过程挺享受的。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart1_g.english: You just couldn't leave well enough alone could you? Now it's gonna cost you your life. Hope you enjoyed playing hero.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart2_g.chinese: 好吧，咱们再试一次。你的运气迟早会用完的。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart2_g.english: All right, let's try this again. Your luck's gotta run out at some point.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart3_g.chinese: 怎么，你以为你能打得过我？好啊，我就站这儿！放马过来，使点真本事。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoappearstauntpart3_g.english: So, you think you can take me? Well here I am! Hit me with your best shot.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart1_gp_.chinese: 咱们把赌注加码吧。来试试你该怎么处理，怎么样？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart1_gp_.english: Let's up the ante, shall we. Go on and see how well you deal with this, eh?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart2_gp_.chinese: 第二次就该见成效了吧？是时候进入下个阶段了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart2_gp_.english: Second time's the charm, right? Time to take things to the next level.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart3_gp_.chinese: 没退路，我全部家底都掏出来了，尽管使出你最狠的招数！
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendoraisescorepart3_gp_.english: No more, this is it. This is everything we bloody got. So bring your worst!

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendotakesdamageandleave.chinese: 你没那么容易就能把我打败。我跟你还没完呢！
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendotakesdamageandleave.english: You won't get the best of me that easy. I'm not done with you yet.
Argh! I'm getting really sick and tired of you.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendotakesdamageandleave.chinese: 该死，该死，该死。老子真他妈烦死了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_mendotakesdamageandleave.english: Damn it, damn it, damn it. I'm seriously fuckin' over this.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.chinese: 你他妈是在逗我玩吧？连这招都挡不住？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.english: You got to be bloody kidding me. Even that wasn't enough?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.chinese: 我觉得你已经够让人火大了，你还搞出这种破事。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.english: Just when I think you can't get any more irritating, you go and do shit like this.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.chinese: 果然连这都能活下来。看来今天不是我的好日子。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdeactivatescorespa.english: Figures you'd survive that too. Guess today isn't my day after all.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_001,p.chinese: 瞧瞧，你那朋友已经变成尸体了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_001,p.english: Look at that, your friend's a corpse.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_002,p.chinese: 这就对了，少了一个垃圾。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_002,p.english: There we go. One less of you slaggers.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_003,p.chinese: 这击杀算我们这边的。你现在还觉得自己很牛吗？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestaunt_gp_003,p.english: That's a kill for our side. You still feeling cocky?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestauntfalling_g.chinese: 你要是就这么摔死，那太没劲了。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_playerdiestauntfalling_g.english: Sort of takes the fun out of it if you're just gonna fall to your deaths.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_001,p.chinese: 在那下面感觉咋样？瞧你这脸色不太行啊。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_001,p.english: How you feelin' down there? You ain't lookin' so hot.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_002,p.chinese: 骨头开始疼了没？我听说这可是最早的症状之一。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_002,p.english: Are your bones startin' to hurt yet? That's one of the first symptoms, I hear.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_003,p.chinese: 我这帮兄弟也不用操心医药费。我都跟他们说了，只要把你们宰了，九尾就买单。
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_003,p.english: My crew don't have to worry about payin' for a doctor neither. Promised them if they kill you, Nine Tails will cover the bill.

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_004,p.chinese: 这些核心本来不是这么设计的，但有时候就得打破常规，对吧？
pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_004,p.english: These cores weren't designed for this, but sometimes you got to think outside the box, eh?

pu_ren_nin_m_mc_radiationtaunts_gp_005,p.chinese: 我打赌你已经热血沸腾了吧？你感觉到了吗？
