pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.chinese: 所以听着，你上个任务是你杰出生涯中的一点污渍，我就假装它没发生过了。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_good_.english: So look, your last job was a bit of a shitshow in an otherwise stellar career. I'm just gonna forget it happened.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 你知道，当你说要帮我执行这些合约时，我是真的希望你能完成这些工作。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.english: You know, when you say you're going to do these contracts for me, I do expect you to actually do the work.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.chinese: 你知道，我就猜到你会把这个合约搞砸，不过，因为一些原因，我当时还是决定把合约给了你。我猜我就是个傻瓜，哈？
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_neutr.english: You know, I thought you might mess up that last contract, but, for some reason, I decided to give it to you anyway. Guess I'm the idiot, huh?

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 又一个...失败的...任务。看来这就是你的行事风格啊，是吧？做什么都失败。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.english: Another... failed... job. Sort of turning out to be your style, isn't it? Failing at everything.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.chinese: 失败、失败，还是失败。看了看之前给你派的几个活儿，虽然我不是个分析师，但这趋势是个人就能看出来吧。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_failstreak.english: Just to review the last couple of jobs I've given you - Fail. Fail. and Fail. Now I'm no analyst, but someone might see a bit of a trend in that.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.chinese: 是这么回事儿，我不会雇我不信任的人。所以把这当做最后一次机会吧。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.english: Here's the thing, I can't hire people I can't trust. So consider this a last-chance type scenario.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.chinese: 我觉得我想说的是，我已经在你身上浪费足够的时间了。你要么中止下一个合约，要么你就给我死。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastchance.english: I think what I'm trying to say is, I'm through wasting my time on you. Either you pull off this next contract or you're dead to me.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.chinese: 哦当然，稍等一下，我这就有一个活儿...
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.english: Oh sure, hold on a sec, I got a job right here...

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.chinese: 你还记得我说过如果你再搞砸，我就让你滚蛋吗？
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolonger_i.english: Remember how I said if you kept screwing up, I'd cut you off?

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_ig_.chinese: 所以...上一个活儿真是场灾难。虽然你被人抢了还挺羞辱的，但你想过我有多尴尬吗？我是说是我把这活儿给了你啊。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed_ig_.english: So... that last job turned into a bit of a wreck. While it's humiliating for you to get robbed, imagine how it looks for me? I mean I gave you the job.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.chinese: 顺便一提，上次那活儿干得真漂亮。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.english: Ace work on that last job, by the way.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.chinese: 你在上次那活儿里的表现爆表，简直堪称魔法。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_ex.english: That was some mystical, next-level shit you pulled on that last job.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.chinese: 如果让我评价一句，上个活儿干得真扎实。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.english: If I can take a moment, gotta say, solid work on the last gig.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.chinese: 顺便一提，上次的活儿干得真棒。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_success_go.english: Nice work on the last job, by the way.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.chinese: 大家对你的工作都非常满意。似乎没什么是你做不了的。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.english: Everyone's been real happy with the work you've been doing. Seems like there's nothing you can't do.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.chinese: 你的效率也太离谱了，你知道吗？你这么厉害让活儿都显得很无聊了。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_successstr.english: Your clearance rate is kinda ridiculous, you know that? You're so good it's almost getting boring.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.chinese: 听着，最近你老搞砸也不是什么秘密。你得加把劲儿，不然我们就会重新考虑咱们之间的协议。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.english: Look. It ain't no secret you've been screwing up lately. Do whatever you gotta do or we'll revisit our little arrangement.

pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.chinese: 这里不是慈善机构，我不会免费送你东西。你为我工作，就得拿出点成绩来。懂了吗。
pu_ruto_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryharder_.english: This ain't an EOC, I ain't gotta give you shit, okay? You work for me, you need to start completing. Period.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_002_.chinese: 很不想这么说，但我不再需要你的服务了。这事儿有人照应了，不过还是感谢。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_002_.english: Sad to say, but your services are no longer required. It got taken care of. Thanks though.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_004_.chinese: 很不想跟你这么说，但你的合约已经取消了。操蛋吧，但就是发生了。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_004_.english: Hate to tell you this, but that contract you're on is canceled. Sucks, but it happens.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_sothat.chinese: 所以...就是你本来应该帮我办那件事？对的，忘了吧。你已经搞砸了。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_sothat.english: So... that thing you were supposed to do for me? Yeah, forget it. You blew it.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_jobsov.chinese: 工作取消，结束。你有过机会。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_fail_ig_002_jobsov.english: Job's over. Done. You had your chance.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_004_h.chinese: 你好，公民！<笑> 我在开玩笑，是我。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_004_h.english: Hello Citizen! <laughs> I'm kidding. It's me.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_greetings_ig_006_i.english: It's Ruto. We need to talk.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_002_g.chinese: 你正在弄的那活儿需要更新一下消息。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_002_g.english: Got an update on that little thing you're doing.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_004_h.chinese: 从客户那边得知的消息，会有点儿变动。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_004_h.english: Heard from the client. There's been a change.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_004_.chinese: 不干了，嗯？这年头的人真是没点儿诚信。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_004_.english: Quitting, huh? People today got no commitment.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_001.chinese: 收到你发过来的数据包了，看起来没问题。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_001.english: Got that data package you sent. Looking good to go.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_003.chinese: 听说你给我发了点东西，我会检查一下的。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig_003.english: Just got word you sent me something. I'll have a look.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_001.chinese: 这会活儿的时间紧迫啊，我的朋友。你可能得快点儿。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_001.english: Clock's ticking on that job, my friend. Might wanna get to it.

pu_ruto_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_002.chinese: 只是一个善意的提醒，搞快点儿。这活儿最好不要弄太久。
pu_ruto_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig_002.english: Just a friendly reminder, hurry the hell up. That job isn't good for much longer.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_farewell_missionaccep.chinese: 我觉得都在里面了，一会儿跟你说。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_farewell_missionaccep.english: I think that covers everything. Talk to you later.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_003.chinese: 哟，这不是我最喜欢的混混吗。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_003.english: Well, if it isn't my favorite hustler.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_007.chinese: 正在启动人工智能程序鲁托...不哈，跟你开玩笑呢。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig_007.english: Booting AI Program Ruto ... Nah, just messing with you.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.chinese: 你已经有需要的指示了，我不知道你还在这里干什么。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.english: You have your instructions. I don't know what you're doing here.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.chinese: 你想跟我聊聊是挺好的，但你还有活儿没干完，干活去。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.english: It's nice you want to chat me up and all, but you got a job to do. Finish it.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 我该拿这玩意儿干什么？把它送到它该去的地方去。
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: What am I supposed to do with that? Take it where it's supposed to go.

pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 嗯...不...你不应该拿到这儿来...
pu_ruto_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: Um... no... you aren't bringing that here...

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_disab.chinese: 有人想要保留点儿隐私。需要你去处理一下通讯阵列，保证他们能获得一点儿隐私。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_disab.english: Somebody wants a bit of privacy. Need you to handle the comm array and see that they get it.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_disab.chinese: 看起来这个特别的通讯阵列急需失灵一下。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_disab.english: It looks like a particular comm array is in desperate need of a malfunction.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_enabl.chinese: 有人想要那片区域的紧急通讯网络重新上线。没说为什么，我也不会问。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_enabl.english: Somebody needs the ECN back on in this area. Didn't say why, and I didn't ask.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_gener.chinese: 有个通讯阵列的活儿可以接。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_gener.english: Got a comm array job available.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_gener.chinese: 客户需要检查一下这个通讯阵列。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_gener.english: Client needs a comm array looked at.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_keepd.chinese: 我有一些客户需要当地的紧急通讯网络暂时下线，方便他们办事。所以你得去关掉它并保持离线。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_keepd.english: I got some clients that need the local ECN brought down long enough for them to work. So you'll need to cut it off and keep it off.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_keepd.chinese: 简要工作内容？客户想让你去关掉一个通讯阵列，并确保它一直离线。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_keepd.english: Basic jist? The client wants you to take down a comm array and make sure it stays off.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_plant.chinese: 需要你去其中一个通讯阵列里，然后帮我安上一个装置。就是个小事儿，装上就可以走了。很有趣，对吧？
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_plant.english: You'll need to access one of the comm arrays and plant a device for me. Just a small thing. Install it and walk away. Fun, right?

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_times.chinese: 我还需要关掉另一个通讯阵列，客户有具体的要求，需要在指定的时间里让它离线。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_times.english: I need another comm array taken down, but the client was real specific. It's gotta go dark at a specific time.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_times.chinese: 这是一次定向屏蔽，所以你必须在指定的时间关掉通讯阵列。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_commarray_times.english: This is a coordinated blackout, so you'll have to offline an array at a particular time.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_distract_hasbou.chinese: 好了，是这样的。我需要转移点儿注意力，既然你头上已经有赏金了， 我寻思咱们刚好能一举两得。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_distract_hasbou.english: Okay, here's the deal. I need a distraction, and since you already have a bounty on you, I figured we could kill two birds and you could be it.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.chinese: 需要有人护送离开这个星系。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.english: Need someone escorted out of the system.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.chinese: 你的保镖生意怎么样？这儿有个客户需要护航。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_generic_.english: How's your bodyguard game? There's a client in need of an escort.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_muscle_i.chinese: 我的一位客户需要发个消息，致命的那种，所以他需要一点点支援。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_muscle_i.english: Client of mine wants to send a message, the lethal kind, and needs a little backup.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_muscle_i.chinese: 有个保镖活儿给你。一定要确保客户安全离开。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_escort_muscle_i.english: Got a strongarm gig for ya. Just make sure the client makes it out of there as well.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.chinese: 有个棘手的活儿，需要个厉害的打手。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.english: Got a tricky one that needs a high level hitter.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.chinese: 好了，这事儿忍一忍。有点儿难办，确实。但这也是为什么它有这样的报酬。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.english: Okay. Bear with me on this one. It's a bit nuts, sure. But that's why it pays what it does.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.chinese: 有个联系人告诉我有件事需要处理一下。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.english: A contact of mine reached out about a little something that needs doing.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_003_.chinese: 这是几天前刚来的活儿。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_003_.english: This one came in a few days ago.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.chinese: 猜你要升职了。九尾需要个强力的打手来做点事儿。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.english: Guess you're moving up to the big leagues. Nine Tails need a heavy hitter for something.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.chinese: 我有一个九尾直接发过来的高级活儿。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.english: I got a top shelf op that comes from the Nine Tails direct.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.chinese: 又一个九尾的活儿来了。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.english: Another request from the Nine Tails came in.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.chinese: 有个九尾的活儿需要一个扎实的执行者。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ninetai.english: Have a Nine Tails job here that needs a solid operator.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_plantde.chinese: 这是更偏技术的活儿，是为你以后的一次大行动做准备的。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_plantde.english: This job is a bit more technical since you'll be laying the ground work for a bigger job later.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_plantde.chinese: 我就不往细了说了，这个活儿比我平时给你的就多几个步骤而已。就是我需要你去装几个科学设备。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_generic_plantde.english: I won't go into too much detail on this one since it's got a few more steps than what I usually throw your way, but I got some tech that needs planting.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.chinese: 那边乱成了一锅粥，我还没法确定那活儿到底办妥了没有。所以要你过去帮我确定一下。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.english: A big hit went and got a bit messy. I haven't been able to confirm that the job got done. That's where you come in.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.chinese: 我需要你为我去一个袭击现场，然后确认一下该死的人都死透了。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.english: I need you to head out to a kill zone for me and double check that everyone who's supposed to be dead got that way.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.chinese: 得到个消息说当地的某个玩家导致了一个轻微的死亡案件。需要你去确认一下这个流言是真是假。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.english: Got word that a local player may have caught a slight case of death. Need you to confirm if the rumors are true or not.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.chinese: 好像有个VIP送到时就死亡了，我想要你过去确认一下。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_con.english: Seems that a VIP may be DOA. I want you to head over and make sure of it.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_clearsecto.chinese: 这边有个大活儿。客户想要清空一整片区域。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_clearsecto.english: Got a big one here. Client wants a whole sector sweeped.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ha.chinese: 需要干掉某人，不过我得提醒你，他们可不好对付。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ha.english: Need someone taken out, but I gotta warn you, they won't go down easy.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ig.chinese: 这儿有个麻烦需要被除掉。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ig.english: There's a problem that needs to be eliminated.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ig.chinese: 收到一个将死之人的名字。我需要你帮他们转世。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_generic_ig.english: Got the name of a future ghost. I need you to help them cross over.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_timesen_ig.chinese: 需要除掉一个目标，但你得快点行动。客户昨天就想要他们死了。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_timesen_ig.english: Need a target erased, but you got to be quick. The client wants them gone yesterday.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_timesen_ig.chinese: 有个目标需要干掉，时间也是不太多，你最好快点儿。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_kill_timesen_ig.english: Got a mark that needs to get punched out. It's on a clock too, so you gotta hurry.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_distress_i.chinese: 刚接到一个求救呼叫。有个活儿出了岔子，船员们陷入了困境。需要你过去帮他们一下。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_distress_i.english: Just got a distress call. A job went sideways and the crew's in trouble. Need you to go give them a hand.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_patrol_ig_.chinese: 我打算深入了解一下这片地区的安保情况，所以需要你去这几个地方看看是否安全。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_patrol_ig_.english: I'm trying to keep a closer eye on security movement in the area, so I need you to hit these points and let me know if they're clear or not.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_patrol_ig_.chinese: 是这样的，我会给你地图上的标记点，你前往这些标记点，你确定这些地方是安全的。轻松愉快。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_merc_patrol_ig_.english: Here's the deal. I give you map points. You go to the map points. You make sure they're empty. Easy peasy.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Ain't got nothing for you to do.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 现在所有任务都派出去了。换个时间再来找我。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: All tapped out at the moment. Hit me up some other time.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.chinese: 我有一趟货需要瞒着安保送进去，但这东西热度可不小，所以想在不被抓到的情况下搞定这件事儿还是有点难度的。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.english: I got a delivery that needs to get creeped by security, but there's some heat on it, so getting it done without being caught might be a bit sticky.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.chinese: 我需要你为一个客户运点东西。私底下弄，不留记录。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.english: I need you to ferry some cargo for a client. Off the books. No records.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.chinese: 你想来拉点儿走私货吗？
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_generic.english: You up for a bit of smuggling?

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_timesen.chinese: 有一份加急快递需要低调的送过去。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_smuggle_timesen.english: Got a rush delivery that's gotta stay off the radar.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_steal_blackbox_.chinese: 需要你在有关部门拿到之前去把那个黑匣子取回来。
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_steal_blackbox_.english: Need you to go snag a blackbox before the authorities get their hands on it.

pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_steal_blackbox_.chinese: 你得去趟犯罪现场帮我取回点儿东西。无证据就无罪，对吧？
pu_ruto_mg_missionbriefs_steal_blackbox_.english: Gonna need you to swing by a crime scene and snag something for me. No evidence means no crime, right?

pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_ig.chinese: 对不起，你是不是认错人了。
pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_nolonger_ig.english: Sorry, you got me confused with someone else.

pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.chinese: 你在干什么？你不是该去别的地方了吗？
pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_stillmissio.english: What are you doing?  Isn't there somewhere you're supposed to be?
Didn't you have something to do?

pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 你疯了吗？把那东西送到目的地去。
pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: Have you lost your mind? Take that where it's supposed to go.

pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.chinese: 对不起，你一定是弄错了，这东西不该送到这里来。
pu_shaw_mg_mission_greetings_wrongdelive.english: I'm sorry, you must be mistaken. That shouldn't be delivered here.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.chinese: 我要的有些东西是你在这个地方买不到的。如果你碰巧在哪看到了，就把它们带回来吧。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find_ig.english: I got some requests for things you can't get in-world. If you happen to see any, maybe snag them and bring them back.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.chinese: 你如果你有兴趣的话，我有东西要给。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.english: Got some things I need if you're in a gathering mood.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.chinese: 如果你有时间，我有几件事需要你帮忙。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_generic.english: If you got the time, there are a couple things I could use.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.chinese: 埃迪刚刚发了消息，像他这样“路子通”的人干这种事，说明他也搞不到这个东西了。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.english: Eddie sent a comm. For someone as 'connected' as him, he's got a lot of difficulty finding shit.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.chinese: 埃迪在找一些东西，可惜我们这里没有，但是也许你能搞来。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.english: Eddie's looking for some stuff. We don't have it here, but maybe you'd be able to find it.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.chinese: 华莱士给我发了一份他需要的清单。我查了一下，但这里好像没有单子上的东西，所以你得去外面找找。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pickup_.english: Wallace sent me a list of shit he needs. I poked around but it doesn't look like we have any of it here, so you might have to look around off-world.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_chemica.chinese: 华莱士又发来了一批需求。我赌100块说他不知道搞到这些东西有多难。总之，我需要你给他送过去。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_chemica.english: Wallace sent another batch of requests. A hundred Credits says he don't know how tough it is to scrounge up. Anyway, I need you to run it over to him.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_chemica.chinese: 有更多货需要送到华莱士那里去。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_chemica.english: Got some more chems to get out to Wallace.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.chinese: 你船上还有空间帮我运个包裹吗？
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.english: Do you think you got space to deliver a package for me?

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.chinese: 我有几件东西需要送到别处去。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_generic.english: I got a couple things I'd like to send off-world.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_import_.chinese: 有批货需要你送下。普通扫描应该能通过，但还是低调点。我们不需要引起别人的注意。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_import_.english: Got a shipment I need brought in. You'll be able to pass simple scans, but keep a low profile. We don't want anyone looking to closely at it.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_import_.chinese: 又有一批货准备好送出去了。别出什么幺蛾子，拿了货避开扫描送过去就是。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_import_.english: Got another shipment collected and ready to come in. Don't need to do anything special. Just pick it up, avoid scans and bring it in.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.chinese: 有些补给需要送到华莱士那里去，他应该会给你点东西送回来。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.english: Got some supplies I need taken to Wallace. He should have something for you to bring back.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.chinese: 你能再跑一趟华莱士那边吗。我有东西要给他，他也有东西要给我。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pickup_.english: Think you can make another run to Wallace. I got some stuff for him and he's got some for me.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_smuggle.chinese: 赫斯顿打算扔掉一批完全没问题的货，但我从焚化炉那里截了下来，还联系到了其他星球的买家。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_smuggle.english: Hurston was going to throw out an entirely good shipment, but I was able to reroute it from the incinerator and line up a buyer off-world.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_smuggle.chinese: 我弄到了赫斯顿最棒的货，都装在这个要送出的包裹里了。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_smuggle.english: I've managed to put together an outbound package of Hurston's finest.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.chinese: 这趟货比较棘手，不过别担心。我会给你足够的报酬来补偿这些麻烦的。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_hard_ig.english: This one's gonna be much tougher, but don't worry. I'll make sure your compensated for your trouble.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.chinese: 好的，你可能会对这个活儿感兴趣。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_001_.english: Okay, you might be interested in this.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_002_.english: There is this one little thing you can do for me.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_003_.chinese: 我觉得你可以解决好这件事。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_003_.english: I think you can handle this one.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_004_.chinese: 我正缺人帮我办这事儿呢。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_004_.english: I been meaning to find someone to help me out with this.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_involve.chinese: 这趟货是给艾迪的，我相信你知道他是谁。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_involve.english: This one'll take you to Eddie, who I believe you know.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_involve.chinese: 你认识华莱士对吧？好的...
你的联系人是我哥们儿，华莱士。他虽然神经兮兮的，但千万别被他吓着，他可是个实在人。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_generic_involve.english: Your contact's gonna be my buddy, Wallace. He's kind of an intense guy but don't let him weird you out. He's on the level.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_generic_.chinese: 所以，我需要你干掉几个人。这事不是他们死就是我亡，我觉得还是他们死要好一点。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_generic_.english: So, uh, I got somebody I need taken down. It's an us or them type scenario. Honestly, I'd rather it be them.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_generic_.chinese: 还有个人需要你去...特殊关照一下。别留下任何蛛丝马迹。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_generic_.english: There's another person I need...dealt with.Just do it clean.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_otoni_ig.chinese: 我找到了一个经常给奥托尼黑帮干活的人。不确定他是帮派成员还是只是个本地人，不过无所谓了...
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_hitman_otoni_ig.english: I identified someone who the Otonis have been using. Not sure if they're actually part of the group or just some local, but either way...

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 不好意思，没有给你的任务。
没有。现在没什么事要处理。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Nah. Doesn't look like anything's really cooking right now.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 我也希望能有活儿给你，但真的没有。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Wish I could say I did but nope. Nada.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.chinese: 好吧，我这真的没什么活儿，不过以我的运气来看，估计你一走我就能收到不少差事。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_ig_00.english: Yeah. I don't have anything right now, but knowing my luck, I'll probably wind up with a ton of stuff right after you leave.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_eddie_ig.chinese: 你能跑一趟微科吗？看来艾迪终于酒醒了给我们弄来一批货。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_eddie_ig.english: Can you stomach a run to microTech? Apparently Eddie was sober long enough to put a shipment together.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_eddie_ig.chinese: 艾迪准备好了一批货。你要是去的话，请千万别跟他喝酒，这些东西我急着要。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_eddie_ig.english: Eddie's got another pickup ready. If you do it, please don't go out drinking with him, I need this stuff relatively soon.

pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_wallace_.chinese: 刚收到消息。华莱士那里有货准备好送过来了。
pu_shaw_mg_missionbriefs_pickup_wallace_.english: Just got word. Wallace is ready for a pickup.

pu_shaw_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_001_l.chinese: 听着，我手头上有好几个活儿，全都给你发过去。
pu_shaw_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_001_l.english: Listen, I got a couple things cooking. I'll send you what I've got.

pu_shaw_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_002_g.chinese: 我这里有好几个活要干。你能帮忙就告诉我。
pu_shaw_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_002_g.english: Got a bunch of things that need resolving. Let me know if you can help.

pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.english: Okay, you go take a look around then.

pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.chinese: 看啊，为什么我不给您一些东西呢。
pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.english: You know what, why don't I give you a few.

pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.chinese: 没事的。如果您需要什么，我就在这里。
pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.english: It's fine. I'll be over here if you need anything.

pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_general_strangebehav.chinese: 您在干什么？您认真的吗？
pu_shipdealer1_m_bs_general_strangebehav.english: Are you doing a bit? Is this a thing?

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_chat_smalltalk_ig_00.chinese: 这周可真忙。大家都想买条飞船。我猜附近又有非法组织猖獗起来了。虽然这不是好事，但对生意来说可太棒了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_chat_smalltalk_ig_00.english: Been a real busy week so far. Seems like everybody wants a ship. Guess an outlaw group went a bit crazy nearby. Real tragedy, but great for business.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 这艘船配备了一些相当舒适的睡眠设施。非常适合在长途旅行中休息一下。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: This one comes with some pretty darn comfy sleeping facilities. Great for taking a break on those longer trips.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 真正厉害的是那个额外的副驾驶座位。当您外出的时候，知道船上还有其他人在支持您，那是一种真正的安慰。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: What's really great is that extra copilot seat. When you're out there, it's a real comfort knowing that there's someone else on board who's got your back.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 如您所见，如果您担心安全问题，而且您想爆几个脑袋，那么这里也有的炮塔。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: And as you can see, comes stock with turrets if security's a concern and you're looking for a little bit more pow.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 如果您想看看导弹，那么这绝对是您清单上一个大大的钩。没有什么比锁定目标，然后等着看烟花更好的事情了，对吗？
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: If you're wondering about missiles, that is a big checkmark in the yes column. Nothing better than getting that lock, and watching those fireworks, am I right?

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 爱上一个开放的座舱。这里没有任何阻碍。只有您和广阔的空间。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: Got to love an open canopy. Nothing in your way. Just you and vast expanse of space.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 这个坡道非常方便您装卸东西。只要把东西放下，它就会滚进去。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: The ramp is super convenient for all your loading and unloading. Just drop it down and roll right in.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 垂直起降推进器真的很好用。准备起飞了？没问题。打开推进器，船头朝上就行了。少操心了一件事。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: The VTOL thrusters really are nice to have. Ready to take off? No problem. Thrusters on, head straight up. One less thing to worry about.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.chinese: 我自己也不太明白，但那些希安工程师在造船方面简直是个奇才。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.english: I don't exactly understand it myself, but those Xi'an engineers are pretty much wizards when it comes to making ships.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.chinese: 南船座的船可能不是最豪华的船，但你总是可以指望它们能比别的做得更好。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.english: Argos may not be the fanciest ships, but you can always count on them to do their job better than anyone else.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_c.chinese: 现在的联合外域可能有点不成熟，但塞拉斯和他的飞船发烧友们正在着手进行一些最有趣的设计。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_c.english: Now Consolidated might be a bit green, but Silas and his gearheads are hands down doing some of the most interesting designs out there.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_c.chinese: 大多数商业航班使用十字军的飞船是有原因的。干净、笔直的设计，而且很耐用。它们出现在工作岗位上，做高该做的工作。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_c.english: There's a reason most commercial shuttles use Crusader. Clean, straight forward design, that holds up to lot of use. They show up to work and do the job right.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_k.chinese: 看着这艘船，很难相信克鲁格是从零件和武器制造商起家的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_k.english: Looking at this ship, it's hard to believe that Kruger got their start as a parts and weapons manufacturer.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_o.chinese: 可以肯定的是，起源的船就是您的一部分声明。只要你驾驶这些美人的其中一个，其他人都会知道你是什么样的人。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_o.english: Origin ships are statement pieces to be sure. You fly one of these beauties and everyone's gonna know what kind of person you are.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_r.chinese: 购买RSI的船是一件很容易的事。这些人基本上可以说是发明了太空旅行。他们已经存在了800多年，而这也是有原因的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_r.english: Buying an RSI is a no brainer. These are the people who basically invented space travel. There's a reason they've been around for 800 years.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_t.chinese: 很高兴看到盾博尔再次归来。它们和以前一样坚固，但还加上了您所期望的所有现代化的升级。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_t.english: It's been great to see Tumbrils kicking around again. They're every bit as solid as the old ones, but with all the modern upgrades you'd expect.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我正在帮这位顾客选购，稍等一下就过来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: I'm actually helping someone right now, but I'll be with you in just a few.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我帮这些客户找到他们的梦想之船后马上就来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: Once I'm done helping this customer find their dream ship, I'll be right over.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我这边忙完了，就马上过来帮您。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: Tell you what. As soon as I wrap up over here, I'll swing on by and get you taken care of.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 敬请参观，我们有许多不错的船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Definitely take a look around. Got some great stuff in stock right now.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 瞧一瞧看一看呐。我们今天有许多好宝贝。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Take a wander and see what we have. There are some real gems today.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 我们进了许多您会感兴趣的新货，都是些好东西。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: We have a whole bunch of new inventory you're gonna wanna check out. Real nice stuff.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 你今天来真是太幸运了。这是我们一年来见过的最好的选择。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: It's real lucky that you came in today. Some of the best selection we've had all year.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 请您四处看看我们所提供的服务。我想当您看到我们有的东西时，您会很高兴的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Help yourself to a look around and see what we have on offer. I think you're gonna be real happy when you see what we got.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.chinese: 这是个重要的决定，您可以多考虑一下。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.english: This is a big decision so you be sure to take your time.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.chinese: 您尽管花时间考虑，不着急。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.english: Take all the time you need. Don't want to rush into anything.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.chinese: 请不必担心，您有更多时间来考虑这些问题。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.english: No worries if you need a few more moments to mull things over.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 您随时可以爬上去，四处走走。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: Feel free to climb right up and take a poke around.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 别拘束，喜欢这艘飞船就上去试试，启动引擎感受一下她的力量。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: Now don't be shy, you like something, go ahead and power her up. Get a sense of how she'll feel.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 请随意参观。如果有感兴趣的飞船就坐上去试试吧，不过千万别试着把她偷偷开走。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: Be sure to make yourself at home. See something interesting go ahead and get on in. Just don't try to sneak off with her.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 如果您想带着船队出去兜风，请前往我们的模拟驾驶室。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: If you wanna take any of the fleet out for a spin, help yourself to our simcab.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 供您参考，那边的模拟驾驶室非常适合带这些美人出去试飞。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: FYI, the simcab over there is perfect for taking these beauties out for a test run.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 我和您之间谈话看起来很好，但如果您想确定的话，我建议您在我们的模拟驾驶室里转一圈。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: Between me and you, looking is fine, but if you want to know for sure, may I suggest taking a spin in our simcab?

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 我们除了地面上所展示的东西还有更多选项。我们的终端上有所有细节。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: We have a few more options available than what's on the floor. Our terminal's got all the details.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 如果您找不到您想找的东西，那么终端上有我们的全部库存供您细读。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: If you don't see what you're looking for, the terminal's got our entire inventory for perusing.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 除了您所能看到的，我们还有几艘船可以在终端上查看。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: Beyond what you can see, we have a few more ships available on the terminal.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 不得不说，我觉得这艘飞船和您很配。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: Gotta say, I think this might be the ship for you.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 你问我真实看法的话，我认为您选的船不错。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: If you want my honest opinion. You could do a lot worse than this.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 如果您决定暂时不买，我会尽量阻止其他人买下它，直到您改变主意。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: Well, if you decide not to buy right now, I'll try to hold off the others until you change your mind.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 这很艰难，对吧？您现在应该买吗？还是您应该冒险等待？我的意思是我知道我会做什么，但我希望您做能让您开心的事。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: It's tough, right? Should you buy right now? Should you take the risk and wait? I mean I know what I would do, but I want you to do what'll make you happy.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 所以您选这艘是吗？我就猜您会选这艘呢。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: So is this the one? I think it might be the one.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 购买二手货确实是明智的做法。对环境更好，对您的银行账户更好，对您的压力也更小。更重要的是，这对您来说，它依然是新的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: Buying used really is the smart way to go. Better on the environment, better on bank account, and way less stress. And more importantly, it's new to you.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 您想知道新船和旧船之间的区别吗？只要离开经销商。砰。每艘船都会变成二手船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: You wanna know the difference between a new and used ship? Leaving the dealership. Bam. Every ship instrantly becomes a used ship.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 好吧，您看着也像是懂飞船的行家，不用我再多叨扰了吧。您随意挑选，待会儿我再过来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: Anyway, you look like someone who knows their ships. You don't need me talking your ear off. Do your thing, and I'll check on you in a bit.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 您知道的，您可以花一两分钟时间考虑一下。我先去帮助其他人，过会再回来看看。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: You know, you look like you could use a moment or two to mull things over. Let me go help some other folks and I'll check back in a few.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 瞧瞧我这说得您耳朵都起老茧了。您先自己看，我稍后过来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: Look at me, talking your ear off. Tell you what, you keep looking, and I'll be back.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.chinese: 感谢您的光临。请随时回来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.english: Thanks for stopping by. Come back any time.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.chinese: 很高兴能为您服务。欢迎下次光临，我们还可以再谈谈。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.english: It was great having you. Be sure to come back soon and we can talk more.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.chinese: 好吧，好好睡一觉，我们很快可以再谈谈的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.english: All right, sleep on it, and we'll talk soon.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_purch.chinese: 好的，再次感谢。购物愉快。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_purch.english: All right, thanks again. Hell of a purchase.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_purch.chinese: 大家注意啦！给这位新船主让个道儿！
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_farewell_purch.english: Look out, everyone! New ship owner coming through!
It was great doing business with you!

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 您觉得怎么样？真不错，对吧？
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: What do you think? Real nice, right?

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 细节如何？这是另一回事。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: How about that detailing? It's something else.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 我正打算说呢，这飞船跟您真配。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: I'm just gonna say it. You two look good together.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 很难说什么更好，对吧？宏伟的外表，还是真正锐利的内在。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: Hard to say what's better, right? That great exterior, or that real sharp interior.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 进去后，您就能看到什么才是真正的质量。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: You can really see the quality once you get inside.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.chinese: 我知道您在想什么。一艘看起来如此华丽的船怎么能花这么少的钱呢？老实说，我自己都不敢相信。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.english: I know what you're thinking. How can a ship that looks that gorgeous cost so little? To be honest, I can't believe it myself.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.chinese: 看看这些线条和样式。即使立着不动，她也像在飞翔。真正的美人。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.english: Those lines, the styling. Even sitting still she looks like she's flying. A real beauty.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_fa.chinese: 如果您想更快，这艘速度达人可以保持住自己的速度。油门还可以自行加速。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_fa.english: If you wanna talk fast, this speedster can hold her own. The throttle pretty much accelerates by itself.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_fa.chinese: 如果您在寻找速度，那么您就来对了。您应该听听这个宝贝运行的时候发出的轰鸣。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_fa.english: If you're looking for speed, then you're looking in the right place. You should hear this baby purr when she gets going.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.chinese: 这条飞船很棒，很难相信它还这么便宜吧。不过，它确实就卖这个价，一分不多。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.english: As good as this ship is, it's hard to believe it's this cheap. But hey, if that's what the price says, that's what the price says.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.chinese: 根据您的要求，这艘船可能是场内最好的东西之一。条件很好。价格也不错。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.english: Depending on which way you want to go, this ship is probably one of the best deals on the floor. Great condition. Great price.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.chinese: 这一款的优点在于，它与您一样坚强，甚至更坚强。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.english: What's great about this one here is that it works just as hard as you do if not harder.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.chinese: 如果您想让一艘船每天都在原地接受您丢给它的东西，那么这可能就是您想要的船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.english: If you want a ship that is going to be there day in, day out, taking what ever you throw at it, then this right here might be the ship you want.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.chinese: 您眼光真不错。这艘飞船做工极好，而且我跟您说，这样的工艺已经绝版了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.english: You got a good eye. That's some quality craftsmanship right there. They don't make 'em like this any more, I can tell you that.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.chinese: 我们店里每天都有各种载具，但时不时就会有这艘飞船一样，让我眼前一亮的好货出现。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.english: We get a lot of different vehicles coming and going, but every once in a while we get something in like this one here that really catches my eye.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.chinese: 数据规格的对比讨论永无止境，但有时候您第一眼见到某艘飞船，就知道那是您命中注定的。我建议相信自己的直觉。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.english: You can talk specs and figures all day, but sometimes when you look at a ship, you just know its right for you. I say trust that gut.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_sa.chinese: 就我个人而言，我对船的要求是能够让我安全到达目的地，并且还完好无损。这就是那艘船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_sa.english: Personally, what I look for in a ship, is something that can get me where I'm going safe and sound in one piece. That's gonna be this ship right here.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_st.chinese: 我不知道您是什么情况，但我一直都得使用更多的存储空间。这就是这艘船完美的原因。它拥有大量SCU空间以及别的东西。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_st.english: I don't know about you, but I can always use some more storage room. That's why this ship is perfect. Plenty of SCU and then some.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_st.chinese: 如果存储对您来说很重要，那么您应该给自己点好处，并花些时间与这艘船相处。我想您会很高兴看到它的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_st.english: If storage is important to you, then you should do yourself a favor and spend some time with this ship. I think you'll be happy with what you see.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 300系列的飞船的乐趣不仅仅在于驾驶，当你不驾驶她时，她也令人赏心悦目。我知道我不会把她踢出我的机库的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Not only is the 300 a pleasure to fly, when you're not flying her, she's a real pleasure to look at. I know I wouldn't kick her out of my hangar.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 看啊。我就直说了。这上面有个游泳池。如果这都不能说服您购买890，我不确定还有什么能说服您了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Look. I'll be blunt. There's a swimming pool. If that doesn't convince you on the 890, I'm not sure what else will.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 南船座的MPUV是一个很棒的小帮手。专门用来处理故障。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Argo MPUV is a great little workhorse. Functional to a fault.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 督导局这么长时间都依赖着复仇者是有原因的。很少有船只能与它的作战灵活性相媲美。这是一个象征。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: There's a reason the Advocacy's been counting on Avengers for so long. Few ships can match its operational flexibility. The thing's an icon.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 她是个杀手，不是吗？就像剜度拿着一把死镰，把猎物切割直到只剩下一块。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: She's a killer, isn't she? It's like the Vanduul took a Scythe and shaved it down till all that was left was the bite.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 我可以整天去夸克拉克，但我不会这么做的。我会让这艘船自己说话。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: I could pretty much talk all day about the Carrack, but I'm not gonna do that. I'm gonna let the ship speak for itself.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 蜻蜓不是船，而是生活方式。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Dragonfly is less of a ship and more of a lifestyle.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 哦，这里有艘日蚀？太隐秘了，我几乎都没注意到。只是和您开个玩笑。但说真的，捕食者的到来都是悄无声息的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Oh, is there an Eclipse here? Thing's so stealthy I almost didn't notice it. Just kidding with ya. But seriously, thing's as silent of a predator as they come.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 角斗士是一台迷人的机器。它如此精简，却又携带了威力巨大的弹药。身轻如燕却又力敌千钧。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Gladi is a fascinting bit of hardware. For being so streamlined, it carries some serious ordnance. Almost like a light heavy.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 短剑速度快，机动性强，正如所有的老前辈所说，它能打出超过它重量级的力量。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Gladius is fast, it's maneuverable, and as all the old timers say, it definitely punches above its weight class.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 我会向任何进来的赏金猎人推荐猎鹰的。它有您需要的速度来追上某个人，只要您追上了他们，您就可以把枪掏出来。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Hawk is what I recommend to any bounty hunter who comes in. It's got the speed you need to run someone down, and guns to spare once you catch up with them.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 信使绝对是我们在这里拥有的最有趣的船只之一。并不是每个数据运行程序都有自己的广播阵列的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Herald is definitely one of the more interesting ships we have on the lot. It's not every data runner that comes with its own broadcast array.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 大力神的效果就如广告所示。它拥有随时随地运输车辆所需的动力。这绝非易事。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Hercules performs as advertised. Its got the power needed to haul vehicles wherever, whenever. No easy feat.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 您知道吗，42中队的卡尔·梅森驾驶的就是一架大黄蜂。如果说有人知道什么才是战斗机的话，那就是那个家伙。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: You know, Cal Mason of Squadron 42 flies a Hornet. If anyone knows about fighters, it's that guy.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 如果您正在寻找运输载具，那么货轮绝不会出错。他们是为运输货物而制造的，如果连他们都做不好，那就完蛋了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: If you're looking for a hauler, you can't go wrong with a Hull. They were built to handle cargo, and damn if they don't do a good job of it.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 卡图因许多原因而引人注目，但单是那些疯狂的希安制造的楼梯就让它成为了必买之物。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Khartu stands out for a lot of reasons, but those crazy Xi'an stairs alone make it a must buy.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 如果按我的方式，我会亲自驾驶这位坏小伙。我的意思是，看看那些推进器。M50正在乞求一场飞行。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: If I had it my way, I would be out there flying this bad boy myself. I mean look at those thrusters. The M50 is just begging to be flown.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 您能相信猎户座是一艘真正的飞船，而不仅仅是某种采矿站吗？我是说看看这东西的大小。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Can you believe that the Orion is a ship that actually flies, and not just some kind of mining station? I mean look at the size of the thing.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 勘探者有一个很棒的地方：您飞到那里去，找到合适的地点来采矿，基本上就可以回本了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Here's the great thing about the Prospector: you go out there and find the right spot to mine, the ship will basically pay for itself.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 这辆小推车非常适合在机库等拥挤区域或城市中短途旅行。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: This little buggy is great for getting around crowded areas like hangars or for short trips around the city.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 谁能相信武藏能让赛车变得如此性感？
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Who would have believed that MISC could make a racer this sexy?

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 一位回收者的船长曾告诉我，她唯一没有打捞到的船是另一艘回收者。要搞定这玩意太麻烦了，它们可以一直飞下去。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: A Reclaimer captain once told me that the only ship she hadn't ever salvaged was another Reclaimer. The things are so tough, they just keep flying.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 救赎者的设计才是真正的赢家，如果您能有幸买下这艘船，它可能是您的下一艘强力的炮舰。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Redeemer's design is a real winner, and if you're lucky enough to snatch this one up, it could be your next great gunship.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 说到燃料，星际远航者可是许多人的行业标准。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: When it comes to fuel, the Starfarer is the industry standard for a lot of people.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 您知道大多数被发现的新行星的首次探索都是在大熊座的帮助下进行的吗？他们是坚韧耐用的漫游车，选择它在自然不过了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Did you know that most new planets found are first explored with the help of an Ursa? They're such a tough and durable rover that it's a natural pick.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 先锋深空战斗机。如果您要在深空作战，那么这就是您要驾驶的飞船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: The Vanguard Deep Space Fighter. If you got a fight in deep space, this is the ship you're gonna want to be flying.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 如果您想进入打捞这场游戏，那么这就是您想要的船。另外，您得承认，秃鹫对于一艘船来说是个好名字。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: This is the ship you want if you're looking to get into the salvaging game. Plus, you got to admit, the Vulture is just a great name for a ship.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.chinese: 您听说过几周前在极乐星系发现这些古代遗迹的探险家吗？我很确定他们驾驶的是一艘像这样的船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.english: You hear about that explorer who discovered those ancient ruins a few weeks back in Elysium? I'm pretty sure they were flying a ship just like this one.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.chinese: 从我的角度来看，您在船上所花费的时间无论多久，它都确保您在舒适的环境中旅行，这很值得。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.english: The way I see it, with as much time as you're gonna spend on board your ship, it really is worth it make sure that you travel in comfort.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.chinese: 虽然我们出售的所有船只都是经久耐用的，但也有很多船只并没有那么幸运。像这样的打捞船总是有需求的。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_shiptypecommen.english: Now, while all the ships we sell are made to last, there's plenty of them out there that aren't so lucky. Salvage ship like this is always in demand.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_ig_001.english: Hey, welcome. Great to have you.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_newdea.chinese: 欢迎来到全新交易飞船店，罗威尔首屈一指的二手船经销商。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_newdea.english: Welcome to New Deal Shipyard. The finest purveyor of pre-owned vessels in all of Lorville.
Hey, welcome to the New Deal.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_teachs.chinese: 嗨，欢迎光临蒂奇的飞船店，全列夫斯基最棒的飞船店。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_teachs.english: Hey, welcome to Teach's Ship Shop. Your stop for Levski's best ship deals.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_teachs.chinese: 嘿，很高兴见到你。欢迎来到蒂奇的飞船店。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_pitch_welcome_teachs.english: Hey, great to see ya. Welcome to Teach's.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.chinese: 您准备好起飞的话，任何一台ASOP终端都可以取出您的新飞船。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.english: As soon as you're ready to fly, you're new ship will be waiting for you at any of the ASOP terminals.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.chinese: 所有手续办好之后，新飞船就会在ASOP终端那里等着您了。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.english: Once all the paperwork goes through, the ship will be ready and waiting at the ASOP.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.chinese: 好吧，我让其他员工把它带过来，您的新船应该准备好了，您随时可以在载具终端上带她出去。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_encourageas.english: All right, I'm having the crew bring it around and your new ship should be all ready for you at the ASOPs whenever you want to take her out.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.chinese: 噢，这有些困难。资金不够吗？也许这里的其他东西更符合您的预算范围。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.english: Oh, that's tough. Not enough credits, huh? Maybe something else around here is more in your price range.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.chinese: 资金有点紧张，是吗？我那是怎么回事。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.english: Funds a little tight, huh? Know how that goes.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.chinese: 我觉得您的决定特别明智。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.english: I think you just made one hell of a good decision.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.chinese: 感觉不错吧？什么都比不了买新船的感觉
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.english: How good did that just feel? No rush like buying a new ship.

pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.chinese: 让我第一个为您的新船祝贺。我希望你们两个在未来的几年里能幸福。
pu_shipdealer1_m_cp_purchase_paymentresp.english: Let me be the first to congratulate you on your new ship. I hope the two of you will be very happy for years to come.

pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.chinese: 噢...好的...看来您需要点时间考虑下。没问题。
pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.english: Oh... yeah... you need a second. Sure.
Where the hell are you going?

pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.chinese: 好的，当然。太多太快了。需要一些独处的时间。懂了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_chat_convointerupt_i.english: Okay, sure. Too much too soon. Need some alone time. Got it.

pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_general_passing_ig_0.english: Sorry, could I just slip past?
Just gonna slide on by you real quick.

pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_general_strangebehav.chinese: 嗨，不好意思，您在做什么？
pu_shipdealer2_m_bs_general_strangebehav.english: Hi, sorry, what are you doing?
I'm trying to run a business here.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_chat_smalltalk_ig_00.chinese: 您过得怎么样？还不错吧？那就好。我也过得不错。就是昨天睡得稍微晚了点。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_chat_smalltalk_ig_00.english: How you doin'? You good? Good. That's good. I'm good too. Had a bit of a late one last night.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 这一款飞船甚至配备了一些居住设施，如果您打算在太空漂流一段时间，那就再合适不过了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: This one even comes with some habitation facilities, perfect if you're gonna be on the drift for a while.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 那是为副驾驶员提供的额外的座位，可以辅助运行飞船功能，或者只是拿来充当备用驾驶员，以便您可以休息。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: Got an extra seat in there for a co-pilot, can help run secondary ship functions or maybe just act as a backup pilot so you can get some rest.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 这一款产品导弹充足。没有什么比锁定制导导弹更能改变战斗的基调了，对吧？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: This one comes fully stocked with missiles. Nothing changes the tone of a battle faster than guidance-locked ordnance, am I right?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 正在寻找一些多人飞船？这个就很漂亮。几年前，在我得到这份工作之前，我自己也租过一个。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: Looking for a multicrew ship? This one's a beaut. Crewed one myself a couple years ago before I got this gig.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 由于我们已经在自己和外界环境之间设置了那些障碍，所以在内部没有任何障碍的情况下驾驶会带来极大的自由。您不同意吗？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: With all the barriers we put between ourselves and our environments, there's something tremendously freeing about piloting without any. Don't you agree?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 您还可以在这个宝贝身上找到一个方便进出的坡道。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: You'll also find a convenient ramp on this baby for easy access inside.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 而且，谁不想保持自己的形象完美呢？嗯，这不是个问题，这款产品有淋浴设施。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: Also, who doesn't like to keep themselves presentable? Well that is not a concern here, this model comes with a shower.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.chinese: 这是一艘单人飞船。工作有点多，毕竟你要注意很多事情，但我发现单飞还是有一些令人满意的地方的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_amenitiescomme.english: This one's for a solo pilot. It's a little bit more work as you have a lot more to pay attention to, but I find there's something satisfying about flying solo.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.chinese: 希安人制造了那些飞船很有趣，我也同意。在人类的产品中，您是看不到这样的线条的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_a.english: The Xi'an make interesting ships, I'll give them that. You don't really see lines like this in Human construction.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_g.chinese: 我喜欢灰猫。我就这么说。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_g.english: I love GreyCat. I'll just say it.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_k.chinese: 我实际上曾经用过克鲁格的船跑过比赛。那是很久以前的事情了。是业余赛事的，但是，我做的很棒。人们告诉我我可以成为职业选手。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_k.english: I actually used to race in a Kruger ship. Long time ago. It was purely amateur, but yeah, I was pretty good. People told me I could'a gone pro.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_o.chinese: 我不需要说什么，对吧？我的意思是，起源船就是起源船。等一等，看看这个。您会明白我的意思的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_o.english: I don't need to say anything, right? I mean, an Origin ship is an Origin ship. Just take a moment, look at that. You know what I mean.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_t.chinese: 正在寻找一些用于地面上的技术？盾博尔是个好品牌。尽管他们刚刚重回市场，但这项技术已经存在了很久了。为什么要修理那些没有坏的东西呢。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_brandcomment_t.english: Looking for some terrestrial technology? Tumbril's a good brand. Though they just relaunched, the tech's been around forever. I guess why fix what isn't broken.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我先和这位朋友谈完，稍后便过来找您。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: Let me just wrap up with my friend here and I'll come on by and check on you.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我们有一些生意要谈，一会儿我再过来见您。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: We got some business to discuss. I'll come check on you in a bit.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.chinese: 我手这边正有一位顾客，不过请放心，我马上就过来。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_busy_withcusto.english: I've got a customer at the moment, but don't worry, I'll be with you in a bit.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 您可以在店里四处转转，看看有什么喜欢的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Why don't you have a look around and see if there's anything you like.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 仔细瞧瞧，看看有没有什么感兴趣的东西。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Take a gander and see if something strikes your fancy.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 多看看，慢慢考虑，这可是个重大的决定。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Take a walk around, and just breathe it in, you know. It's a big decision.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 您自己看看吧。我一直认为坐下来，感受一下宇宙，感受属于您的飞船的召唤，是最好的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: I'll leave you to it. Always find it's best to sit back, take in the space and let your ship call to you.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.chinese: 您要做的就这些。走一走就行。如果是我正在做一个和您一样大的决定，我喜欢在做任何事情之前就把一切都考虑进去。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragebrows.english: Here's what you do. Just walk the place. If I'm making a decision as big as you're making, I like to take everything in before I do anything.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.chinese: 这个决定很重要，仔细考虑吧。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.english: It's a big decision, so think it over.
Take your time. Think on it.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.chinese: 我给您一些时间。也许您可以去散散步，好好想想。如果我自己想理清思路，重新审视问题的话，那我自己就是这么做的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragedecis.english: I'll give you a moment. Maybe go for a walk to think it over. That's always been my trick if I want to clear my head and look at the problem fresh.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 您随时都可以进去感受一下。不过不要起飞<笑>我在开玩笑，您是没法起飞的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: Feel free to hop in and take a feel. Don't take off though. <laugh> I'm kidding, you can't.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 如果看到有喜欢的就上去试驾一下吧，飞船上都装了限制器，不用担心撞机或是把店给毁了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: If you see one you like, then go ahead and try it out. We've got the inhibitors on so don't you worry about crashing or blowing up the shop.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.chinese: 所有飞船应该都是开放的，可以进去试一下手感。您一定会在这里待上很长一段时间的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encourageinspe.english: All the ships should be open, so climb in and see how it feels. Odds are, you'll be spending a lotta time in there.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 如果您想开着其中一艘出去兜风，那我们这也有一个模拟驾驶舱。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: We also have a simcab if you wanna take any out for a spin.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 如果您真的想要完整的驾驶体验，也可以使用模拟驾驶舱。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: There's a simcab too, if you really want that complete experience of flying the ship.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.chinese: 如果您想了解飞船飞行的真实情况，请随意使用我们的模拟驾驶舱。那就像真的一样。我保证。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragesimca.english: Feel free to check out our simcab if you wanna see what flying the ship's really like. It's just like the real thing. I promise.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 如果您想了解更多信息，为什么不到我们的终端看看呢。它和我一样可以满足您的需求。我保证。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: Why don't you step on over to our terminal if you're looking for additional info. That can take care of you almost as good as I can. Promise.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 请继续，如果需要的话，请使用终端。我们通常都会有一些额外的库存，但它们不会在地面上展示。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: Go ahead and hit up the terminal if you need. We usually have some extra inventory on there that's not on the floor.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.chinese: 如果您需要其他任何东西，请查看终端。上面又所有您关心的数字和数据。我？我关心的是它是什么感觉的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetermi.english: You need anything else, check out the terminal. That'll have all those numbers and data if that's what you're into. Me, I'm all about how it feels.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 您得好好考虑下，没问题，但可别想太久哦，这种好买卖可是眨眼就没了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: You got a lot to think about, no question, but not for too long, a deal this good won't last.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 您只要决定好了，我立马就能开始准备各种文件，不过在我看来，您跟这艘飞船天生就是一对。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: Just say the word and I'll start the paperwork, but it seems pretty obvious to me that the two of you are destined to be together.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 您怎么看？我们达成协议了吗？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: So what do you think? We got a deal or what?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 我的意思是，这肯定得花很多钱，但您真的需要考虑这些吗？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: I mean it's a lot of credits, sure, but what do you really have to think about?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 您的钱您做主。但换做我的话，该怎么选已经很明显了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: It's your money, but if it were me? The choice feels pretty obvious.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 我不知道您为什么不买二手货。当然，您没法把它吹成是全新的，但要是您问我的话，我觉得二手船更有特色。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: I don't know why you wouldn't buy used. Sure you don't get the bragging rights of saying it's brand new, but you ask me, used ships got more character.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.chinese: 说实话，如果由我来决定，我会对二手船收取更多费用。毕竟他们已经经过了测试，您知道他们可以胜任您的工作。新船？他们的漆面倒是不错。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_encouragetobuy.english: Honestly if it were up to me, I'd charge more for used ships. They've been out there. Tested. You know they can deliver. New ships? They got nice paint jobs.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 我还是不打扰您了，有任何需要尽管找我。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: You know what? I'll get outta your hair. Hunt me down if you need anything.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 可否原谅我失陪一下？谢谢。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: You excuse me for a moment? Thanks.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.chinese: 您花点时间考虑一下，这可是个重要决定，如果需要什么欢迎找我。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_excuse_fromcus.english: Take a moment. Think about it. It's a big decision. Come flag me down if you need anything.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.chinese: 如果您改变主意了就回来看看吧。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.english: Come back if you change your mind.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.chinese: 当您准备好下一步行动的时候，请告诉我。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_farewell_nopur.english: You let me know when you're ready to take that next step.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_farewell_purch.chinese: 尽情享受您的新飞船吧。

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 如果您问我的话，我认为除非您花一点时间坐在驾驶座上，否则您是没法对一艘船或任何事情有任何了解的。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: You ask me, you won't know the first thing about a ship or anything unless you spend a little time in the pilot seat.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 感觉怎么样？很棒啊对不对？
您觉得怎么样？真正感受到它的可能性了，对吧？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: What'd you think? Really get a sense of what's possible, right?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.chinese: 已经开始有家的感觉了，对吧？
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_playerexitship.english: Already starting to feel like home, right?

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.chinese: 相当漂亮，不是吗？我知道有一些人就是想让人眼前一亮。如果您也是那样的人，我想您已经找到了您需要的船。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.english: Quite a looker, isn't she? I know there are people out there that just wanna turn heads. If that's you, I think you found your ship.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.chinese: 每个人都会停下来注视这个的。这也不能怪他们。流畅的线条。无可挑剔的设计。这真的是一件艺术品。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_be.english: Everybody always stops to gawk at this one. Can't blame them really. Sleek lines. Impeccable design. It's a work of art really.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.chinese: 您不会找到一个更好的交易了。在全宇宙任何地方都找不到。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_gr.english: You aren't gonna find a better deal. Not anywhere in the 'verse.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.chinese: 坚韧，这就是我喜欢这个型号的地方。您可以把它拿出来，连续打磨上几个小时，这个宝贝会把它们通通接受，而且还要更多。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ha.english: Here's what I like about this model here: fortitude. You can take it out, grind away for hours at a time and this baby'll eat that up and ask for more.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.chinese: 我感到了您和飞船之间有种特殊的连系。您感觉到了吗？您当然感觉到了。这就是我的超能力，能感应人和船之间的连系。您要是像我一样卖出去这么多船的话，就能理解了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.english: I'm sensing a connection here. Do you feel that? Yeah, you do. That's my superpower, sensing connections. Makes sense when you sell as much product as I do.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.chinese: 你知道，有位比我睿智得多的智者曾经说过，“不是你在挑船，而是船在挑你”。我认为这艘飞船就是看上您了。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipcomment_ig.english: You know, someone considerably wiser than me once said, "you don't pick your ship, your ship picks you." I think this one, this one right here is sweet on you.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 您会进入起源世界，但不要被这句话的表面欺骗了。100系列拥有其更大的兄弟型号的所有卓越设计。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Your entry into the world of Origin ships, but don't let that fool you. The 100s got all the excellence and design of its bigger brothers.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 有什么东西比300系列更性感吗？有，那就是属于您的300系列。
pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.english: Is there anything sexier than a 300 series? The answer to that is yes, the one thing sexier is your 300 series.

pu_shipdealer2_m_cp_pitch_shipnamecommen.chinese: 85x是那种让您能在周末飞到那个手工熟食店去取野餐食材的豪华飞船。简单，优雅，令人惊叹。
