pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectiveco.chinese: 干得漂亮，成功护住了目标。

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectiveco.english: Looks like we're in the clear.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectiveco.chinese: 刚才真悬，不过总算搞定了。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectiveco.english: Kinda touch-and-go there, but I think we're good.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.chinese: 喂，你的任务是保住那艘船好吗？
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.english: You know, you were supposed to keep that ship alive.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.chinese: 友情提示：下次记得保护该保护的船。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.english: Piece of advice: next time protect the ship that you're supposed to protect.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.chinese: 你这保镖当得可真够称职的啊？
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.english: Really dropped the ball on that whole protection thing, huh.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.chinese: 这事儿本可以处理得更好的。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.english: That could've gone a whole helluva lot better.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.chinese: 专业建议：接护卫任务时别让客户暴毙。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivefa.english: Pro tip, don't let the client die on a protection racket.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.chinese: 来得正好，已经标出需要保护的目标（别打错了）。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.english: You made it. Marked the person you're not supposed to kill.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.chinese: 欢迎来到狗屎战场，进去把那群混蛋挡在客户飞船外面。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.english: Welcome to the shitshow. Get in there and keep those assholes off our client.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.chinese: 看清楚了啊，那堆杂碎和需要护送的船，开始干活。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipobjectivest.english: All right, you see the assholes and the ship that needs to get through this? Handle it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.chinese: 记着你的任务是保他们活口。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.english: Remember you're here to keep them alive.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.chinese: 能先专心保住目标飞船吗？
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.english: How about you focus on keeping that ship alive?

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.chinese: 还记得拿钱是来干嘛的吗？就那个需要保护的倒霉蛋？
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_defendshipreminder_gp.english: Remember what you're here to do. You know, the person we're paying you to protect?

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.chinese: 发现艘残骸船，想搜刮可以去看看。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.english: Looking at a shipwreck. Can check it out if you want.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.chinese: 捡到艘破得妈都不认的船，搜不搜随你。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.english: Picking up a ship. Looks all kinds of busted. Feel free to check it out.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.chinese: 扫描显示这是艘废弃船，不知道有没有油水，想摸奖就上吧。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyfindsabandonedsh.english: Scan's flagging this as a derelict ship. Not sure if there's anything of value in there, but go ahead and check it if you want.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegativ.chinese: 应该安全了...等等！那特么是啥？
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegativ.english: I think we're clear here… hold up a sec. What the hell is that?
Scan looks clear, so I think….. Actually check that. There's something weird here.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegativ.chinese: 看起来没东...等等，不对劲！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegativ.english: I'm not seeing anything… wait, scratch that. Something's not right.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptyscanfindsnothing.english: Scan's clear. I think we're good.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocation.english: Hold up a sec. Gonna do a scan.
Sit tight. Sending out a scan.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocation.chinese: 熄火等我扫完这破地儿。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocation.english: Park up while I do a scan.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocation.chinese: 你先歇会儿，我四处看看。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocation.english: Take a break while I look around.
Gonna do a scan real quick. Hold on.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_friendlyreinforcement.chinese: 叫了几个狠角色去支援你。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_friendlyreinforcement.english: Sending some hitters to your location to lend a hand.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_friendlyreinforcement.chinese: 找了群亡命徒帮你撑场子。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_friendlyreinforcement.english: Got some mean sonsofbitches coming to help you out.
Pulled some strings and got you some backup.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.chinese: 卧槽这架打得带劲，爷看爽了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.english: This is turning into a helluva scrap. Dig it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.chinese: 牛逼啊兄弟，杀疯了这是！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.english: Damn, you're kicking a lot of ass.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.chinese: 妈的该录下来发暗网的！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenco.english: I should've been recording this fight.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectiveclea.chinese: 我只能看到死人了，漂亮。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectiveclea.english: All I see are dead people. Nice.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectiveclea.chinese: 见鬼，居然真给你全杀完了。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectiveclea.english: I'll be damned. You got 'em all.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.chinese: 注意！几个杂碎朝你过来了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.english: Look out. Got some shitheads heading your way.
Got a fight coming at ya.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.chinese: 看来你要交几个“新朋友”了。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.english: Looks like you're about to make some new friends.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.chinese: 检测到愤怒崽种正在接近！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.english: Picking up some angry people inbound.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.chinese: 移动靶子正在热情送货上门~
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesobjectivestar.english: Some target practice are flying in hot.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.chinese: 弹药还够吗？他们叫增援了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.english: Hope you got some more ammo. They're calling in backup.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.chinese: 又有一群混蛋跳跃过来了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.english: Got some more assholes jumping in.
Shit, they called in some buddies.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.chinese: 准备迎战！有艘主力舰冲你来了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.english: Get ready. You got a cap ship heading your way.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.chinese: 好家伙，连大家伙都开出来了！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesreinforcement.english: They're pulling out the big guns.
Oh shit. Got a big one heading your way.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.chinese: 发现几个混蛋，不过还没看到目标。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.english: Picking up some assholes. No sign of the target.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.chinese: 来了来了...操，还没瞧见我们要找的那个。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.english: Here we go... Shit, I don't see the one we're looking for yet.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.chinese: 侦测到几个目标，但没看到咱们要找的人。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallout.english: Picking up some contacts. Not seeing our target though.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.chinese: 是我们自己的卫星，别手贱！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.english: Looks like one of our satellites. Leave it alone.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.chinese: 这卫星是自家产的，别碰！
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.english: Yeah, that satellite's one of ours. Don't mess with it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.chinese: 自己人的卫星，当没看见就行。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitefo.english: That's our satellite. You can ignore it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdmovetonextscan_gp_0.english: We're all good here. Move on.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdnothingfound_gp_002.english: I don't see a damn thing.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_g.chinese: 漂亮，最后一个也扫完了。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_g.english: All right, cool. Last one's done.
That was it. We're all good.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_002.chinese: 靠过去看看，做个聚焦扫描。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_002.english: Get a closer look. Do a focused scan.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_003.chinese: 来个聚焦扫描，我想确认点东西。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_003.english: Run a focused scan. I wanna check something.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_g.english: Yeah, that's the asshole we want.
There. I'm picking up the target.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_g.chinese: 哟，这不是大驾光临了嘛。
pu_stows_hea_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_g.english: Well look who decided to show up.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_targetthreatdestroyed.english: Got that son of a bitch.

pu_stows_hea_m_deh_targetthreatdestroyed.chinese: 太棒了，直接送他见阎王。

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.chinese: 这卫星不是咱们的，轰了它。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.english: That satellite isn't one of ours. Nuke it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.chinese: 不认识这破卫星，直接炸了吧。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.english: I don't recognize that satellite. Go ahead and blast it.

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.chinese: 鬼知道哪来的卫星，干就完了。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefou.english: Yeah, no idea was that satellite is. Take it out.

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.chinese: 给你几个坐标点，挨个查看有没有异常。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.english: Gonna pass along some points to check out. Hit each one and see if there's anything there.

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.chinese: 开工吧，按标记点走，扫描每个位置看看是什么。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.english: All right, let's get going. Head to the markers, run a scan, and see what's what.

pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.chinese: 流程很简单：按我标的点走，扫描并检查所有异常信号。
pu_stows_hea_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_0.english: Here's the routine. I'm sending you markers. Go to each one, do a ping and take a look at anything that comes up.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_ambushmissionaccept_g.chinese: 听说你想接脏活？情报已发，去埋伏点往死里干就完事。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_ambushmissionaccept_g.english: Heard you're down to punch out some people. You got the details, so head out, get set, and crack down on 'em hard.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.chinese: 我是斯托斯。欢迎入伙。尽快出发，必须速战速决干掉袭击者。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.english: Stows here. Good to have you on board. Head out as soon as you can. We need whoever's attacking us put down pronto.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.chinese: 咋样？我是斯托斯。坐标给你了，去把惹我们的杂种往死里揍，越疼越好。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.english: Waddup. It's Stows. You got the location, so get on out there and kick the hell outta whoever's screwing with us. Make it hurt.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.chinese: 来了老弟？整装备出发吧，有人需要保镖。斯托斯完毕。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_g.english: Hey there, killer. Arm up and head out. Got people that need some defending. Stows out.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.chinese: 我是斯托斯。总算来人了。有艘受保护的船急需支援，赶紧过去。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.english: Stows here. Glad someone finally stepped up. Got a ship under our protection that needs some help. Get on out there.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.chinese: 嘿哥们，那艘船快撑不住了。通讯里全是惨叫声，不知道他们还能挺多久。斯托斯完毕。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.english: Hey, I'm gonna need you to hustle out to help that ship. Couldn't pick out much aside from the screams, so not sure how much longer they'll last. Stows out.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.chinese: 斯托斯呼叫。你他妈赶紧去救那艘船！都快被打成筛子了！
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacce.english: It's Stows. Gonna need you to turn on some hustle out to that ship. They're getting all sorts of torn up.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 玩我呢？（压低声音）现在的小崽子连个简单任务都做不完。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: You kidding me? (under breath) Goddamn kids today can't finish a simple job.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 你他妈脑子进水了？多少人等着这活呢！操——<挂断>
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: What the hell's the matter with you? I had people who needed that shit done. Goddammit- <clicks off>

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.chinese: 接了活就别当逃兵，老子入行第一天就懂这道理。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionabandon.english: Don't ever walk away from a job you said you were gonna do. Hell, I learned that day one.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 我是斯托斯。听说你接了这单，谢了。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Stows here. Heard you're running this down for us. Appreciate it.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 嘿，我是斯托斯。多谢帮忙，最近活儿多得要命。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Hey, it's Stows. Thanks for picking up the slack. Got more work than I know what to do with.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.chinese: 漫步者你好啊，我是斯托斯。感谢入伙。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept_.english: Hey there, rambler. Stows here. Appreciate you rolling with us on this.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 多谢搞定，正在转帐，下次见。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: Thanks for sorting that out for us. Transfering your creds now and see you next time.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 干得漂亮，这就给你打钱。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: You're all done. Nice one. I'll get you paid.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.chinese: 你好啊，我是斯托斯。报酬马上到账。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissioncomplet.english: What's up, it's Stows. Gonna send your pay.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 真他妈灾难现场。下回练练再来接活吧。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: Well that was a shitshow. Maybe up your game before you take another job for us.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: 搞砸了是吧？老子还得给你擦屁股，再见了您。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: Really screwed that one up, huh. Looks like I gotta clean up your mess now on top of all the other shit I gotta do. Later.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.chinese: <对着麦克风长叹> 太菜了，下次拿出真本事行不行？
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_gp.english: <big sigh into microphone> That sucked. Maybe dust off your A-game for next time, huh?

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.chinese: 你来巡逻？太好了。原定的怂包溜了，急需顶班。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.english: You're gonna do that sweep for us? Great. Had some skag bail on me so I need it done pronto.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.chinese: 我是斯托斯。正给你规划巡逻路线，虽然大概率是摸鱼，但弹药还是带足。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.english: It's Stows. I'll be pushing you along this sweep. Just putting together the route. Will probably be pretty quiet, but stock up for anything.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.chinese: 我是斯托斯。感谢接下这无聊差事，但咱们猎头帮地盘必须有人盯着，说不定有惊喜呢？
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_g.english: Stows here. Thanks for picking up this patrol. I know it's dull shit, but Headhunters gotta have eyes on our turf. You never know, maybe things'll pop off.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_gp.chinese: 我瞅瞅...没问题，继续下一个。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_gp.english: Lemme see… yeah, we're good here. Keep on rolling.

pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_gp.chinese: 行吧，这儿干净了，下一个。
pu_stows_hea_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_gp.english: Yeah, all right. Nothing else here. Head on off.
Think we can move onto the next one.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckali.chinese: 飞船未正确对齐，货舱分配权限已取消。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckali.english: Ship incorrectly aligned. Cargo deck assignment revoked.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckali.chinese: 警告：飞船未正确对齐，请立即调整。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckali.english: Warning. Ship incorrectly aligned. Adjust immediately.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.chinese: 请稍候，正在为您分配货运甲板停泊位。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.english: Stand by for cargo deck assignment.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.chinese: 货运甲板已分配，请前往指定区域。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.english: Cargo deck assigned. Proceed to designated area.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.chinese: 抵达已确认，请调整飞船对齐，准备开始物资转运。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.english: Arrival confirmed. Align ship to begin transfer.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.chinese: 货运甲板分配权限已取消。
时间限制已超时，货运甲板分配权限已取消。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckpar.english: Time limit exceeded. Cargo deck assignment revoked.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckrem.chinese: 错误：请伸出货舱主轴以继续操作。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodeckrem.english: Error. Extend cargo spindles to proceed.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodecktak.chinese: 时间限制已超时，正在转移飞船位置。

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodecktra.chinese: 物资转运中断，请调整飞船对齐以继续。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodecktra.english: Cargo transfer interrupted. Align ship to continue.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodecktra.chinese: 物资转运已开始，请保持当前状态。
物资转运已完成，请立即撤离该区域。
pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atccargodecktra.english: Cargo transfer complete. Vacate area immediately.

pu_systematc01_civ_m_atc_atcfarewell_gp_.chinese: 交通管制即将断开连接。

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.chinese: 瞧瞧，这最后一票货总算收齐了。现在就剩你把它们全送到位，咱今天就能收工了。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.english: Looks like that was the last piece of cargo. Now, you just got to tackle delivering it all off and we can call it a day.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.chinese: 嘿，刚瞅见你货都装满了，路上顺顺利利啊，等你送到我再跟你联系。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.english: Hey, just saw you're all loaded up. Good luck on the run and I'll be in touch when you make the drop.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.chinese: 科瓦莱什呼叫，听说你把最后一批货都收了，不错！现在撸起袖子赶紧送出去吧，希望一路顺风别出岔子。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_collectallcargohaulin.english: Covalex calling. Looks like you picked up the last of the goods. Great. Now to roll up your sleeves and get it all delivered. Hopefully it goes smoothly.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.chinese: 不干了是吧？行啊，谁没点事儿呢，哪有空为这种靠不住的承包商掉眼泪？等你哪天想干了，咱们再碰头。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.english: Quitting the job, huh? Oh well. Too much going on to waste time crying over flaky contractors. I'll see you again when you're ready to work.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.chinese: 太好了太好了太好了！退回来的货我这边都录进系统了，谢了啊，下次再合作！
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.english: Cool, cool, cool. Got that drop-off logged in. Thanks for taking care of that and I'll talk to you next time.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.chinese: 行，看你把东西都还回来了，这下不用上报飞行员了，省心。下次接单再聊。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.english: Okay, see that you handed everything back in. Always nice when I don't have to report a pilot to the authorities. I'll talk to you on the next contract.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.chinese: 好嘞，谢了啊，东西还回来了，总算少了一桩事。哦对了，抱歉，另一条线还有个承包商在叫，我得赶紧接。
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionabandonhauling.english: All right. Thanks for returning that. Nice to check something off the to-do list. Oh, sorry. Got an actual contractor comming on the other line. Gotta go.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missioncompletehaulin.chinese: 我是艾拉，这趟干得漂亮，货都对得上，钱马上给你打过去。呃...嗯，应该没漏啥了，搞定！
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missioncompletehaulin.english: El here. Thanks for doing that run. Everything looks good, so I'll get you those credits. Uhh…. Yeah, I think we're done. Good stuff.

pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionfailhaulingcar.chinese: 嘿，我是艾拉。这单得取消了，货都没了，你咋送？别灰心，下回肯定能成，加油！
pu_tieno_cov_f_pmh_missionfailhaulingcar.english: Hey, it's El. I gotta pull the contract from you. Can't really do a delivery when the cargo's destroyed. Anyway, better luck next time, yeah?

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstasteroidba.chinese: 行了，门开了。进去小心点，别因为大意让人从背后偷袭，那可就亏大了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstasteroidba.english: All right, it's open. Be careful going in. Don't want someone getting the drop on you because you let your guard slip.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstvanduuldes.chinese: 干得漂亮，搞定一个剜度。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstvanduuldes.english: Nice work taking out that Vanduul.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstvanduuldes.chinese: 漂亮一击！剜度可没那么容易倒下。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxfirstvanduuldes.english: Good kill. Duul don't like to go down easy.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedal.chinese: 好，最后这块数据到手了。赶紧去终端解密，传到互安防务的服务器上。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedal.english: Good. That's the final piece of data we needed. Time to decrypt them at the terminal and get them uploaded to InterSec servers.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.chinese: 行，又一个加密数据包。接着找，剩下的还多着呢。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.english: All right. That's another encrypted data packet. Keep going and find the rest.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.chinese: 又一个数据包，估计就剩几个了，你再努把力。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.english: That's one more data packet. Shoudn't be too many more left for you to find.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.chinese: 再来一个数据包，进度不错，但别分心，先把剩下的全找出来再说。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.english: Another data packet. We're making progress, but for now, focus on finding the rest of the data.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.chinese: 又搞到一个数据包，不错，离全找齐不远了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollectedco.english: Okay, got another data packet. Good. Shouldn't be much longer to track them all down.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollecteden.chinese: 这就是解密数据包需要的密钥。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollecteden.english: That's the decryption key we need to unlock the data packets.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollecteden.chinese: 密钥到手，现在你就能上传那些数据包了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxitemcollecteden.english: Decryption key secured. Now you'll be able to upload the data packets.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionaccept_g.chinese: 我们的飞船需要你的帮助。不知道它还能撑多久。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionaccept_g.english: Our ship needs your help. Not sure how long it'll last.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionaccept_g.chinese: 走吧。你得保护好那艘飞船。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionaccept_g.english: Let's go. You gotta protect that ship.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.chinese: 我猜我们的飞船很高兴见到你。尽你所能保护好它。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.english: Bet our ship is happy to see you. Do everything you can to keep it safe.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.chinese: 太好了，你来了。接下来就是硬骨头了。祝你好运，保护好我们的飞船。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.english: Great, you made it. Now comes the hard part. Good luck protecting our ship.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.chinese: 没时间浪费了。最好赶紧帮忙，否则就晚了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.english: No time to waste. Better start helping before it's too late.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.chinese: 需要你顶上来。我们的飞船出大事了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissionacceptre.english: Need you to step up. Our ship's in serious trouble.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.chinese: 真是千钧一发。谢谢你为我们挺身而出。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.english: That was close. Thanks for stepping up for us.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.chinese: 很高兴你能帮忙。不知道没有你我们该怎么办。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.english: Glad you were available to help. Don't know what we would've done without you.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.chinese: 我把这事儿划掉了。外面干得不错。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxmissioncomplete.english: I'll check that off the list. Good work out there.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxreminddecryptio.chinese: 嘿，咱们还得再找一个解密密钥，才能打开剩下的数据。这走私团伙的头目身上肯定有。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxreminddecryptio.english: Hey, we're going to need to find another decryption key in order to access the remaining data. One of the leaders of this smuggling ring should have them.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.chinese: 好，你到了。干掉那些剜度和碎刃帮，然后把数据包和密钥全给我捞回来。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.english: Good. You made it. Go ahead and neutralize the Vanduul and Shattered Blade, then acquire the data packets and decryption key.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.chinese: 行，先收拾了这些剜度和碎刃帮，再把数据包和密钥找全了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.english: All right. Deal with these Vanduul and Shattered Blade, then find the data packets and decryption key.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.chinese: 这些剜度真是冲着碎刃帮来的，杀出条路，把数据给我捞出来解密。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatarriveatl.english: Those Vanduul really got it out for these Shattered Blade. Fight your way through and then collect the data for decryption.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatlockedast.chinese: 进不去？行，你再四处转转，找块能用的备用电源。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatlockedast.english: No access, huh. You'll have to scout around and find a replacement power bank again.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatlockedast.chinese: 得先给它通上电才能开门，附近看看有没有能用的电源。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatlockedast.english: You'll need to power it up to gain access. See if you can find a usable power bank nearby.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.chinese: 我得找别人来接手这活儿了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.english: I'll need to find someone else to take care of this contract.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.chinese: 听着，互安防务用不了那种不守信用、半途而废的人。要是想给我们干活，就得说到做到
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.english: Look, InterSec can't use people who don't follow through on contracts. If you're gonna work for us, make sure you can commit.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.chinese: 你正从一场还没解决的麻烦事中抽身。以后可别再这么干了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionabandon_gp_.english: You're walking away from a volatile situation that still needs to be resolved. Please don't do this in the future.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionaccept_gp_0.chinese: 互安防务的托宾呼叫。人民联盟和碎刃帮那边又出状况了。赶紧过去，到了现场他们会给你具体建议。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionaccept_gp_0.english: Tobin at Intersec calling. Got another situation between the People's Alliance and Shattered Blade. Head out there and they'll advise.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_001.chinese: 真不想这么做，但我得叫停这次行动。现在成功几率为零了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_001.english: Hate to do it, but I'm calling this operation. There is a zero chance of success now.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_002.chinese: 我要你撤出来。咱们已经没机会完成这任务了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_002.english: I'm pulling you out. We've lost any chance of completing this mission.

pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_003.chinese: 这活儿干不成了，局势已经彻底失控了。
pu_tobin_int_m_pmh_tsgmissionfail_gp_003.english: This op isn't going to work. We've lost control of the situation.

pu_uee_navy_repui_leadership.chinese: 拉维尼娅·沃林福德，海军总长

pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.chinese: 请注意，有不法势力使此区域内的量子航行失效。请寻找庇护，直至当局清除威胁。
pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.english: Attention. Hostile elements have disabled Quantum Travel in this sector. Please shelter in place until authorities have resolved the threat.

pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.chinese: 请注意。请寻找庇护，直至当局清除威胁。
pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.english: Attention. Please shelter in place until authorities have resolved the threat.

pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.chinese: 请注意，该地区威胁已清除，你们可以正常航行了。
pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.english: Attention. The threat in this sector has been resolved. You are free to resume normal travel.

pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.chinese: 请注意，此区域内的威胁已被清除。您可以重新进行正常航行。感谢您的耐心等待。
pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_announce_event_threa.english: Attention. The threat in this sector has been cleared. You are free to resume normal travel. Your patience has been appreciated.

pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_enter_sectorarea_thr.chinese: 警告。您已进入高风险地区。建议所有驾驶员寻找其他可用路线。请保持高度警惕。
pu_ueealert02_f_dpa_enter_sectorarea_thr.english: Warning. You have entered a high threat area. All pilots are encourage to seek alternate routes. Extreme caution advised.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.chinese: 您好，活动大厅已开放。感谢您的耐心等待，祝您游览愉快。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.english: Hello, the event halls are now open. Thank you for your patience and enjoy your day.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.chinese: 请注意，所有活动大厅现已开放。祝您过得愉快！
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.english: Attention, all the event halls are now open. Please enjoy your day.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.chinese: 各位访客请注意。远见中心感谢您的耐心等待。活动大厅现已开放。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_nowopen_.english: Attention, attendees. We at the Vision Center thank you for your patience. The event halls are now open.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 请注意，我们感谢您的光临。远见中心即将开放。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Attention, thank you for visiting. The Vision Center will be opening shortly.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 各位访客请注意。我们感谢您的耐心等待。远见中心即将对公众开放。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Attention all attendees, we thank you for your patience. The Vision Center will be opening to the public very soon.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.chinese: 各位访客大家好。远见中心将很快向公众开放。我们感谢并欢迎您的到来。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_announce_halls_opening_.english: Hello, attendees. The Vision Center will be open to the public very soon. Thank you and welcome.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_001_y.chinese: 你违反了十字军的法律。安全部队现已出动。
pu_vcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_001_y.english: You are in violation of Crusader law. Security forces have been dispatched.

pu_vcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_002_y.chinese: 你正在非法侵入十字军的财产。请原地等待，安全部队正向你赶来。

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.chinese: 不是吧？你水平不该这样啊。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.english: Oh, come on. Was expecting better from you.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.chinese: 说实话，福克斯韦尔对承包商的期待更高。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.english: Gonna be honest, Foxwell expects more from our contractors.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.chinese: 妈的！这下要接投诉通讯了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.english: Damn it! I'm gonna get some angry comms about this.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.chinese: 太差劲了，简直一塌糊涂。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef.english: That was not good. Not good at all.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.chinese: 好了，这是你要护送的船，务必保它周全。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.english: Okay, that's who you're here to protect. Make sure they stay safe.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.chinese: 目标确认。不惜一切代价保证他们安全。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.english: That's the client. Do whatever you have to do to keep 'em safe.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.chinese: 找到了？好，“安全毯行动”正式开始。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives.english: Ok, good, you found them. Operation Security Blanket is a go.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipreminder_g.chinese: 集中注意力，那艘船命悬一线。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipreminder_g.english: Focus. That ship is in serious trouble.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipreminder_g.chinese: 再不动手那船就要完蛋。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipreminder_g.english: If you don't do something, that ship is toast.
Quick! Save that ship before it's too late.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.chinese: 差点漏掉，你附近有艘报废飞船。福克斯韦尔不管这个，要不要探索随你。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.english: Almost missed it, but there's an derelict vessel near your position. It's not Foxwell's concern, so it's up to you if you want to investigate any further.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.chinese: 注意，扫描到不远处有艘死船。去不去看你的选择。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.english: Heads up, my scans spotted a dead ship not too far for you. Your call on whether you want to check it out or not.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.chinese: 你那边有动静...对，是艘废弃船。想搜刮就自便。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds.english: Picked up something in your sector. Okay, yeah, looks like a derelict ship. Feel free to investigate it if you want.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.chinese: 扫描显示安全...等等，有情况！
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.english: Scans all came back clear so I think - Wait… Just got something.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.chinese: 呃...稍等。不对劲，确实有东西。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.english: Huh... Hold tight for second. Yeah, that's not right. Something's definitely there.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.chinese: 准备说安全的时候...妈的，扫到东西了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati.english: Before I give you the all clear, let me just check... Damn it, found something.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocatio.chinese: 目前没发现，正在深度扫描，保持待命。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocatio.english: Hey, not seeing anything yet. I'm gonna do a deeper scan. Stand by.
Hold tight while I scan the sector.
Running a scan. Maintain your position.
Stand by. Going to do a quick scan.
Hold up a sec. Need to check something.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocatio.chinese: 我得做个扫描，等我一下。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocatio.english: I need to run a scan. Give me a second.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_friendlyreinforcemen.english: Good news. Looks like we got some backup to help you out.
Called in some support. They should be there soon.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenc.english: Hey, you're doing good. Keep it up.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenc.chinese: 干得太他妈漂亮了，别松懈。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenc.english: You're doing a hell of a job. Don't back down now.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenc.chinese: 压着他们打，别给喘息机会。

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.chinese: 好了，没检测到其他敌对目标，应该安全了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.english: Alright, not seeing any more hostiles. Think you're in the clear.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.chinese: 清场完毕，扫描范围内没有目标了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.english: Looks like you're clear. Scans are clear of targets.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.chinese: 未发现敌对活动，确认区域安全。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle.english: Not picking up any hostile activity. Giving you the all clear.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.chinese: 注意，你当前位置出现敌对目标。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.english: Heads up, got hostiles at your location.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.chinese: 喔不，准备好，有一伙人朝你那去。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.english: Oh no, get ready. There's company coming your way.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.chinese: 扫描显示不法分子正在接近。

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta.english: Watch out. Enemies heading your way.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.chinese: 清醒点！敌方增援来势汹汹。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.english: Look alive. There's hostile reinforcements coming in hot.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.chinese: 动真格的了，援军马上到。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.english: They're not messing around. Here comes the backup.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.chinese: 坏消息：有艘大船正朝你逼近，明显不怀好意。准备好。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.english: Got some bad news: a big ship's bearing down on your location and it's not friendly. Get ready.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.chinese: 大家伙来了，你肯定把他们惹毛了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.english: Big ship coming in. You must've really pissed them off.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.chinese: 警告，重型火力的家伙冲你来了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen.english: Heads up. You've got some serious firepower heading your way.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.chinese: 看来活儿来了。不过还没发现目标。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.english: Looks like we're in business. No sign of the target yet though.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.chinese: 发现坏家伙了，但没看到目标...
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.english: Got eyes on some baddies. Don't see the target…

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.chinese: 有接触，稳住别慌。目标还没看见。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou.english: Got contacts. Stay chilly. I don't see the target yet.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.chinese: 是监控卫星，运转正常，不用管它。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.english: Looks like a monitoring satellite. Seems functional so we can let it be.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.chinese: 确认过了，那颗是友方卫星，继续前进吧。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.english: Let me confirm. Yup, that satellite is friendly and functional. Let's move on.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.chinese: 卫星状态正常，你可以继续任务了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef.english: Okay, that satellite is good. You're clear to proceed.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.chinese: 好了，最后一个扫描点完成。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.english: Alright, that was the last scan point.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.chinese: 这是我们需要扫描的最后一处，多谢协助。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.english: That was the last scan we needed. Thanks for the help.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.chinese: 至此，咱们的任务完成了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_.english: And with that, our work here is done.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_00.chinese: 你最好做个聚焦扫描，看看情况咋样。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_00.english: You should do a focused scan and see what's what.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_00.chinese: 行了，做个聚焦扫描，搞点情报回来。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_00.english: All right, run a focused scan to get some more intel.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_.chinese: 就是他们，准备好了就上。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_.english: That's them. Go when you're ready.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_.chinese: 目标确认，武器启动，好好干一票。
pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_.english: That's the target. Weapons on and good hunting.

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatdestroye.chinese: 目标已击落，重复，目标已击落。

pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatdestroye.english: That's a kill on the target.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.chinese: 不妙，那颗卫星发出异常信号。安全起见，去把它端了。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.english: Uh oh. Getting some strange readings from that satellite. Just to be safe, go ahead and neutralize it.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.chinese: 等等...确认了，是未注册卫星。授权你摧毁它。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.english: Hold tight... Yeah, that satellite isn't registered. You're cleared to take it out.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.chinese: 见鬼，布置这卫星的是个高手，差点骗过我。赶紧解决掉。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo.english: Damn, whoever set up that satellite knew what they were doing. It almost fooled me. Get rid of it.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.chinese: 既然你到了，需要你检查这片区域。前往标记点并启动扫描。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.english: Okay, now that you're here, we need you to check the area. Fly to the designated points and ping your scanner.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.chinese: 确保该星系安全，去标记位置进行扫描。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.english: Let's make sure the sector's secure. Head to the marked locations and run a scan.

pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.chinese: 看来你准备好执行安检了。按导航点依次扫描每个位置。
pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_.english: Looks like you're ready for a security sweep. You should be seeing waypoints. Make your way to each one and ping your scanner.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_.chinese: 我是福克斯韦尔的沃尔顿。需要你立即前往防守目标点，他们可能撑不了多久了。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_.english: Hey, it's Walton with Foxwell. Need you to deploy and defend that site on the double. Not sure how much longer they'll be able to hold out.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_.chinese: 这里是福克斯韦尔的沃尔顿。合约目标点情况紧急，立即装备前往。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_.english: Walton from Foxwell here. Looks like things are about to get real bad on that contract. Grab your gear and get to that site immediately.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacc.chinese: 我是沃尔顿。长话短说，福克斯韦尔需要你立即为这艘船提供安保。祝任务顺利。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacc.english: Walton here. Sorry for keeping this short, but Foxwell needs you to provide security for this ship on the double. Good luck out there.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacc.chinese: 感谢接手。刚和飞行员通过话，他们正焦急等待你的抵达。别让我们失望。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacc.english: Thanks for grabbing this. Just spoke with the pilot and they're anxiously awaiting your arrival. Don't let us down.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 呃，不清楚你为何放弃合约。虽然暂时找不到替补，但...好吧我想办法。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Hey, yeah, not sure why you aren't completing the contract. I don't really have anyone else to handle it, but okay, I'll see what I can do.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 难以置信你就这样放弃任务。福克斯韦尔需要可靠的人手。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: I can't believe you're just walking away from a job like that. Foxwell needs people we can count on.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.chinese: 接到投诉说合约未完成。既然为福克斯韦尔工作，就该有始有终。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando.english: Getting some angry comms about this contract not being completed. If you work for Foxwell, we expect you to finish it.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 福克斯韦尔沃尔顿。很高兴你加入协助，所需物资已备齐。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Walton from Foxwell here. Glad that you're coming on board to lend us a hand. You should have everything you need to get going.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 我是福克斯韦尔的沃尔顿。现在开工吧，积压合约太多了。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Hey, I'm Walton with Foxwell. Let's get you to work. We're swamped with contracts so it'd be good to get this one cleared out.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.chinese: 欢迎加入。我是你的对接人沃尔顿，我方准备就绪，你可以开始履行合约。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept.english: Welcome onboard. I'm Walton, your Foxwell point of contact. Everything looks good on my side, so you may proceed with your contract.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 干得好，福克斯韦尔表示感谢。正在安排酬金。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Hey, nice work. Foxwell appreciates it. I'll get your money sent.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 合约完成，正在转账支付。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Contract complete. Initiating your payment now.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.chinese: 信用点已转出。感谢你清理完这个合约。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple.english: Sending creds your way. Thanks for clearing out that contract.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 抱歉需要撤销你的合约，你可能还没准备好做安保工作。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: Sorry, gonna have to pull this contract from you. You might not be ready for security work yet.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 我得重新分配合约，你似乎不太适合这个任务。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: I'm gonna reassign the contract. I just don't think you're a right fit for this.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.chinese: 不得不解除合约。福克斯韦尔要求外勤人员维持企业标准。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g.english: I'm sorry but I need to revoke this contract. Foxwell needs its field operatives to uphold our corporate standard.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_.chinese: 福克斯韦尔沃尔顿提醒：别裸装出勤巡逻，最近局势不太平。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_.english: Hey, it's Walton with Foxwell. Courtesy reminder to not head out on patrol without getting geared up. Things have been wild out there lately.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_.chinese: 感谢承担巡逻任务，但弹药补给要带足，随时可能用上。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_.english: Foxwell appreicates you covering that patrol, but don't go out low on ammo and other essentials. You might need 'em.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.chinese: 好，看来我们准备好奥斯卡·米奇了。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.english: Okay, looks like we're ready to Oscar Mickey. Head to the next patrol point.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.chinese: 很好，区域安全。继续下一个点位。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.english: Good, good. Area secured. Let's get you deployed to the next one.

pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.chinese: 此地净空，可前往下一区域。
pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g.english: We're clear here. You can head to the next sector.

recoverstolen_danger_0001.chinese: 我们预计此行应当比较顺利，但还是请做好准备以防意外发生。
recoverstolen_danger_0001.english: We expect things should go relatively smoothly, but be ready just in case they don't.

recoverstolen_danger_0003.chinese: 我们对此地点的初步调查表明，这里没有直接的安全风险，但老手都知道不能把身家性命寄托在调查报告上。
recoverstolen_danger_0003.english: We did some preliminary scouting of the site and it should be clear, but experienced operators know better than to rely on that to keep them safe.

recoverstolen_danger_0004.chinese: 犯事的盗贼可能仍然潜伏在附近，所以务必小心。
recoverstolen_danger_0004.english: The thieves responsible might still be lurking around, so use caution.

recoverstolen_obj_long_01.chinese: 前往 ~mission(Location) 收回被盗窃的货物
recoverstolen_obj_long_01.english: Go to ~mission(Location) to retrieve the stolen goods.

recoverstolen_space_danger_0001.chinese: 完成这份合约时务必保持谨慎，窃贼很可能全副武装并怀有强烈的敌意。
recoverstolen_space_danger_0001.english: It would be prudent to go into this contract expecting the thief to be armed and extremely hostile.

recoverstolen_space_danger_0002.chinese: 如果事情不幸出了什么差错，~mission(contractor)不会提供任何形式的战斗援助。接受这份合约风险自负。
recoverstolen_space_danger_0002.english: Unfortunately, if things go south out there, ~mission(contractor) cannot commit combat support at this time. Take this contract at your own risk.

recoverstolen_space_danger_0003.chinese: 在接触这些罪犯时要保持谨慎，你要是把他们逼得走投无路，他们会做什么可说不准。
recoverstolen_space_danger_0003.english: Use caution approaching this perp. No telling how they might react when you get them cornered.

recoverstolen_space_danger_0004.chinese: 这个小贼还是有点关系的，要是有些 ~mission(client) 的朋友出现可别太惊讶。
recoverstolen_space_danger_0004.english: And since this dragger is well-connected, don't be surprised if some of their ~mission(client) friends show up.

recoverstolen_space_obj_long_01.chinese: 找到 ~mission(TargetName) 的飞船和失窃的 ~mission(Item)。

recoverstolen_space_obj_long_02.chinese: 在 ~mission(TargetName) 带着 ~mission(Item) 逃走之前消灭他们。
recoverstolen_space_obj_long_02.english: Neutralize ~mission(TargetName) before they can escape with the stolen ~mission(Item).

recoverstolen_space_obj_long_03.english: Recover the stolen ~mission(Item) from the wreckage.

recoverstolen_space_timed_0001.chinese: 这件事儿所剩时间不多，我们要赶在这些财物被销赃或是转移出星系之前追回它们。
recoverstolen_space_timed_0001.english: Timing's going to be tight on this. We need to recover the property before it can be sold off or moved out of system.

recoverstolen_space_timed_0002.chinese: 我们的情报指出很快会有一场拍卖会进行，所以你得赶紧解决这事。
recoverstolen_space_timed_0002.english: Our intel indicates that a sale might be happening sooner than later, which means we're going to need you to move swiftly on this.

recoverstolen_space_timed_0003.chinese: 没多少时间可浪费了，~mission(TargetName)随时可能会逃走。
recoverstolen_space_timed_0003.english: Not a lot of time to waste on this since ~mission(TargetName) is a definite flight risk.

recoverstolen_space_timed_0004.chinese: 为防止出现任何变数，我们需要你立刻完成此合约。
recoverstolen_space_timed_0004.english: To help limit any additional complications from springing up, we need this contract completed ASAP.

recoverstolen_space_timed_0005.chinese: 时间正在飞逝，没时间磨磨唧唧的了。每过去一秒钟成功几率就降低一点。
recoverstolen_space_timed_0005.english: As far as timing goes on this, afraid there's not a lot of wiggle room. Every second that passes, the chances of success only get worse.

recoverstolen_timed_0001.chinese: 请务必注意时间，我们必须在失窃财物被转移至其他地方前收回它们。
recoverstolen_timed_0001.english: Time is unfortunately of the essence here. We need to recover the property before it can be moved to a different location.

recoverstolen_timed_0002.chinese: 我们的侦查表明，如果想成功收回失窃的财物，必须迅速展开行动。
recoverstolen_timed_0002.english: Our reconnaissance showed that if we want this operation to succeed, the retrieval must be handled swiftly.

recoverstolen_timed_0005.chinese: 这个任务很紧急，请尽快完成。
recoverstolen_timed_0005.english: This is a priority task, so it will need to be resolved quickly.

recoverstolen_timed_0006.chinese: 这个包裹需要尽快取回，以防情况有变。
recoverstolen_timed_0006.english: This package needs to be retrieved as soon as possible in order to limit any additional complications.

recoverstolen_timed_0007.chinese: 这次任务的机会转瞬而逝，确保你别错过它。
recoverstolen_timed_0007.english: This job's got a narrow window of opportunity. See that you don't miss it.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.chinese: 欢迎来到弧光酒吧！我能为您做什么？
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.english: Welcome to ArcCorp Bar! What can I serve you?

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.chinese: 从纯净水到最高品质的太空冷却剂，我们应有尽有。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.english: We have everything from pure water to the highest-quality space alcool.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.chinese: 有什么我可能错过的大新闻吗？
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.english: Any big news I might have missed?

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.chinese: 我不这么认为。最近一切都很平静。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.english: I don't think so. Things have been pretty quiet lately.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.chinese: 如果你改变主意，我随时奉陪。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte.english: I'm always there if you change your mind.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_lev_c.chinese: 嘿，旅行者！ 想聊聊吗？
关于狗斗，我肯定能教你一两招。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_lev_c.english: I'm sure I could teach you a thing or two about dogfighting.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_lev_c.chinese: 好吧，晚点再来，我们喝一杯。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_lev_c.english: All right, come back later and we'll have a drink.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.chinese: 欢迎来到弧光酒吧！我能为您做什么？
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.english: Welcome to ArcCorp Bar! What can I serve you?

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.chinese: 从纯净水到最高品质的太空酒精，我们应有尽有。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.english: We have everything from pure water to the highest-quality space alcohol.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.chinese: 有什么需要尽管示意我。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite.english: Just give me a sign if you need anything.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpdistrojobwell_arccorp.chinese: 还有什么需要帮忙的吗？
sc_lz_shops_arccorpdistrojobwell_arccorp.english: Anything else I can help you with?

sc_lz_shops_arccorpdistrojobwell_arccorp.chinese: 我们有几份合约。请查看面板。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpdistrojobwell_arccorp.english: We have a few contracts available. Please have a look at the board.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.chinese: 欢迎光临弧光商店。我们以最低的价格提供弧光集团的所有最新技术。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.english: Welcome to ArcCorp Store. We have all the latest technologies from ArcCorp available at the lowest price.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.chinese: 我想看看你有什么要卖的。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.chinese: 当然让我给你看看我们最新的核融合引擎，这是真正的工业奇迹。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.english: Sure thing. Let me show you our newest fusion engine. It's a true marvel of engineering.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.chinese: 我们将以最优惠的价格为您提供弧光集团原装配件。
sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.english: We'll give you the best price for your original ArcCorp parts.

sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s.chinese: 祝您在弧光星过得愉快

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_insu.chinese: 您好！有什么能为您效劳的？
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_insu.english: Hi! What can I do for you?

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_insu.chinese: 我想了解一下你们的保险套餐。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_insu.english: I'd like to know about your insurance packages.

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 欢迎访问天文舰队！今天我能为您做些什么？
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: Welcome to Astro-Armada! How can I help you today?

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 让我跟我们的保险代表确认一下他马上就来。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: Let me check with our insurance representative. He should be with you in just a minute.

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 我们的保险代表已经准备好了您可以到他的办公室找他。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: Our insurance representative is ready. You can meet him in his office.
I'd like to sell my ship.
I'd like to buy a ship.

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 我们的展台上有最受欢迎的机型，机库里还有更多机型。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: We have our most popular model right here on the show floor, and many more in our hangar.

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 如果您有任何问题，请告诉我。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: Let me know if you have any questions.

sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.chinese: 我想为我的飞船买份保险。
sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale.english: I'd like to get insurance for my ship.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 今天我能为您做些什么？
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: How may I help you today?
I want to write my will.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 当然可以，我们有一份简单的表格，您可以填写。
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: Sure. We have this easy form you can fill out.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 还有什么需要帮忙的吗？
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: Anything else I can help you with?
I'm here to collect my inheritance.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 对于您的损失，我们深表遗憾，但我们会尽最大努力为您提供方便。
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: We are sorry for your loss, but we'll do our best to make this process easy for you.
I'm sorry, I changed my mind.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 我的大门永远为您敞开。
欢迎来到巴克利庄园。我们可以提供哪些帮助？
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: Welcome to Barclay's Estate. How may we help?
I'd like to talk with a lawyer please.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: O我们的资深律师马上就到，请坐。
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: One of our qualified lawyers will be available in just a minute, please have a seat.

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 我们的律师已经准备好与您会面。请从这扇门进去，他的办公室在右边第一间。
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: Our lawyer is ready to meet with you. Please go through this door, his office is the first on the right.
I'm sorry, I have to go

sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.chinese: 别忘了，巴克利庄园随时为您服务。
sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta.english: Don't forget, Barclay's Estate is always there for you.

sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.chinese: 欢迎光临卡莎巴服装店。您需要什么帮助？
sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.english: Welcome to Casaba Outlet. How may I help you?

sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.chinese: 我们有适合各种场合的服装供您选择。
sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.english: We have a great selection of clothes for every occasion.
I'd like to try out these clothes.

sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.chinese: 当然可以，只要进入无人的更衣室就可以了。
sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.english: Sure. Just go into any of the unoccupied changing room.

sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.chinese: 如果你想尝试什么，就来找我吧。
sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s.english: Come see me if you need to try anything.

sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.chinese: 欢迎来到中心质量。我能为您提供什么服务？
sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.english: Welcome to Centermass. How may I be of service?
What do you have for sale?

sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.chinese: 我们拥有来自ASD、克劳斯&韦纳等公司的最新武器和防御对策。
sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.english: We have the latest weapons and defensive countermeasures from ASD, Klaus & Werner, MaxOx, and many others.
Can I help you in some other way?
I have some parts I'd like to sell.

sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.chinese: 我们一直在寻找优质零件。
sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.english: We're always looking for quality parts.

sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.chinese: 请记住，如果您要开火，中心质量绝对是您的不二之选。
sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp.english: Remember, when you fire, you can't go wrong with Centermass.

sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.chinese: 我总是需要一些额外的信用点。
sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.english: I can always use some extra credits.

sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.chinese: 我不想引起不必要的注意。你愿意吗？
sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.english: I don't want any unwanted attention. Are you up for it?
I might have misjudged you then.

sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.chinese: 我就是这项任务的最佳人选。
sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.english: I'm just the man for the task.

sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.chinese: 好的，一切准备就绪后，我会联系你的。
sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_.english: All right. I'll contact you when everything is ready.
This isn't the kind of work I'm looking for.

sc_lz_shops_cubbyblast_cubby_blast_clor_.chinese: 欢迎来到立方爆炸。我是克洛·维，为您提供银河系中最好的个人武器。
sc_lz_shops_cubbyblast_cubby_blast_clor_.english: Welcome to Cubby Blast. I'm Clor Vee, offering you the best in personal weapons in this part of the galaxy.
I have some weapons to sell

sc_lz_shops_cubbyblast_cubby_blast_clor_.chinese: 让我看看你有什么，我会给你一个价格。
sc_lz_shops_cubbyblast_cubby_blast_clor_.english: Let me see what you have and I'll give you a price.

sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.chinese: 我想为我的飞船购买部件。
sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.english: I'd like to buy parts for my ship.

sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.chinese: 我有一些多余的零件想卖掉。
sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.english: I have some extra parts I'd like to sell.

sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.chinese: 好吧，我可以看看你的东西，然后给你一个价格。
sc_lz_shops_dumpersdepot_dumpers_depot_m.english: All right, I can always take a look at what you have and give you a price.

searchbody_danger_0001.chinese: 如果我没有提醒您就是我的失职：进入残骸地点会有潜在的危险，请务必谨慎行事。
searchbody_danger_0001.english: We would be remiss if we did not remind you that venturing into the wreck site will potentially be hazardous, and all caution should be used.

searchbody_danger_0002.chinese: 虽然都懂，但一定要小心。我们不希望发生在 ~mission(Ship) 的任何事再发生在你身上。
searchbody_danger_0002.english: It goes without saying, but be careful out there. We would hate for whatever or whoever happened to the ~mission(Ship) to happen to you.

searchbody_danger_0003.chinese: ~mission(Ship)可能是非法行为的受害者，所以请不要草率行事。谨慎是重中之重。
searchbody_danger_0003.english: It's possible that the ~mission(Ship) was the victim of foul play, so make sure to take your time and don't get sloppy. Caution is the keyword.

searchbody_timed_0001.chinese: 我们都希望将这个问题尽快解决，所以还是紧迫一些吧。
searchbody_timed_0001.english: We would all like to see this matter closed as quickly as possible, and as such, a certain amount urgency is warranted.

searchbody_timed_0002.chinese: 我们已经被要求尽快解决此事，尽快搞定吧。
searchbody_timed_0002.english: We've been asked to expedite matters, and are looking to settle this ASAP.

searchbody_timed_0003.chinese: ~mission(TargetName|First)已经失踪有一段时间了，所以无论你用什么手段，请尽快想办法吧。
searchbody_timed_0003.english: ~mission(TargetName|First) has been missing for some time, so anything you could do to settle this as quickly as possible would be great.

searchcrew_danger_0001.chinese: 如果我们不提醒您冒险进入残骸地区会有潜在危险，那我们就失职了，所以请务必小心谨慎。
searchcrew_danger_0001.english: We would be remiss if we did not remind you that venturing into the wreck site will potentially be hazardous, and all caution should be used.

searchcrew_danger_0002.chinese: 虽然都懂，但一定要小心。我们不希望发生在 ~mission(Ship) 的任何事再发生在你身上。
searchcrew_danger_0002.english: It goes without saying, but be careful out there. We would hate for whatever or whoever happened to the ~mission(Ship) to happen to you.

searchcrew_danger_0003.chinese: ~mission(Ship)可能是非法行为的受害者，所以请不要草率行事。谨慎是重中之重。
searchcrew_danger_0003.english: It's possible that the ~mission(Ship) was the victim of foul play, so make sure to take your time and don't get sloppy. Caution is the keyword.

searchcrew_obj_long_01.english: Go to ~mission(Location) to search for missing crew.

searchcrew_timed_0001.chinese: 我们都希望将这个问题尽快解决，所以还是紧迫一些吧。
searchcrew_timed_0001.english: We would all like to see this matter closed as quickly as possible, and as such, a certain amount urgency is warranted.

searchcrew_timed_0002.chinese: 我们已经被要求尽快解决此事，尽快搞定吧。

searchcrew_timed_0003.chinese: 那艘船的船员已经失踪有一段时间了，所以无论你用什么办法，尽快解决吧。
searchcrew_timed_0003.english: The crew has been missing for a while now and anything you could do to settle this as quickly as possible would be great.

sectorsweep_danger_001.chinese: 不要低估 ~mission(Client) 的飞行技能，他们已经证明了自己的实力。
sectorsweep_danger_001.english: Do not underestimate the ~mission(Client)' flying skills. They have proven themselves more than capable so far.

sectorsweep_danger_002.chinese: 接近时请务必小心，那里真的一团糟。
sectorsweep_danger_002.english: Make sure to use extreme caution with your approach. It's been a real mess out there.

sectorsweep_danger_003.chinese: 我们非常清楚这是一个有潜在危险的合约，但是一切风险都需要你自己承担。
sectorsweep_danger_003.english: And so we're perfectly clear, this is a potentially dangerous contract, so you are undertaking this at your own risk.

sectorsweep_danger_004.chinese: 这并不是一个简单的任务，在 ~mission(Client) 的队伍里，有一些真正的战士。
sectorsweep_danger_004.english: It's not going to be an easy task. The ~mission(Client) have some serious fighters in their ranks.

sectorsweep_jingo_0001.chinese: 是时候让我们来教训教训这些混蛋玩意儿了，出来混总是要还的。
sectorsweep_jingo_0001.english: It's time that we show these bastards that they can't do whatever they want without paying the consequences.

sectorsweep_jingo_0002.chinese: 不能再允许他们胡作非为了，我们是时候该站出来了。
sectorsweep_jingo_0002.english: This can't be allowed to go on any longer. It's time we took a stand.

sectorsweep_jingo_0003.chinese: 这些不法之徒对十字军人民实行粗暴行径已经太久了，是时候改变这个局面了。
sectorsweep_jingo_0003.english: These outlaws have been running roughshod over the people of Crusader for too long. It's time for a change.

sectorsweep_jingo_0004.chinese: 看到这些凶手将得到他们应有的下场，真是令人欣慰。
sectorsweep_jingo_0004.english: It will be a relief to see these cutthroats put down once and for all.

sectorsweep_obj_long_00.chinese: 在预定的集合点会合，同时注意巡逻路线。
sectorsweep_obj_long_00.english: Meet at the set rendezvous point while the patrol route is coordinated.

sectorsweep_obj_long_02.chinese: 在巡逻区域内消灭所有敌人。

spacecargo_illegal_analogy_0001.english: a bunch of fries and no ketchup

spacecargo_illegal_analogy_0003.english: a comb does for a bald man

spacecargo_illegal_danger_0001.chinese: 尽量保持低调，这儿已经足够热闹了。
spacecargo_illegal_danger_0001.english: Try to keep a low profile. Things have been heating up around here enough as is.

spacecargo_illegal_danger_0002.chinese: 我相信你有在遇到麻烦时照顾好自己的能力。
spacecargo_illegal_danger_0002.english: If you run into any trouble, I'm trusting you can handle yourself.

spacecargo_illegal_danger_0003.chinese: 警告你一下，近期这片区域内的安保活动频繁，请采取适当的预防措施。
spacecargo_illegal_danger_0003.english: Word of warning. Security's been increasing their presence in the area. Take the appropriate precautions.

spacecargo_illegal_danger_0004.chinese: 我不想找任何麻烦，不过要是安保来了你得料理了他们。
spacecargo_illegal_danger_0004.english: I'm not expecting any trouble, but if security does show up, take care of it.

spacecargo_illegal_danger_0005.chinese: 我建议你小心行事，不要大动干戈。我不想因为这个招惹什么目光。
spacecargo_illegal_danger_0005.english: I'm expecting you to keep the drop on the low. Don't want any heat on this.

spacecargo_illegal_obj_long_02.chinese: 将 ~mission(Item) 从残骸中找回来。
spacecargo_illegal_obj_long_02.english: Acquire the shipment of ~mission(Item) from the wreckage.

spacecargo_illegal_threat_0001.chinese: 把你的头捏爆在你的头盔里
spacecargo_illegal_threat_0001.english: paint the inside of your helmet red

spacecargo_illegal_threat_0002.chinese: 让你后悔从娘胎里出来
spacecargo_illegal_threat_0002.english: make you wish you had been on Vega when the 'duul attacked

spacecargo_illegal_threat_0003.chinese: 把最近的恒星塞到你的屁眼里
spacecargo_illegal_threat_0003.english: arrange a vacation for you inside the nearest star

spacecargo_illegal_threat_0004.chinese: 把你放到德雷克的逃生舱里。

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0001.chinese: 你小子不在交货日期前把事儿办成你就死定了。
spacecargo_illegal_timed_0001.english: There's a deadline on this, as in if we don't get this valuable item fast, somebody's going to wind up dead.

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0002.english: Need this done quick, so don't mess around.

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0003.chinese: 你最好在别的拾荒者把 ~mission(Ship) 的残骸吃干扒净前去把货拿到手。
spacecargo_illegal_timed_0003.english: Expect you to get there ASAP before some hopper stumbles across the ~mission(Ship) and salvages it first.

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0004.chinese: 我们的客户 ~mission(Client) 催得比较紧，不要迟到。
spacecargo_illegal_timed_0004.english: The ~mission(Client) need this fast, so make sure you're not late.

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0005.chinese: 这个货品不会永远在太空里飘着，你得在它消失前把它拿到手。
spacecargo_illegal_timed_0005.english: This stuff isn't gonna float out there forever, so handle it before it's too late.

spacecargo_illegal_timed_0006.chinese: 这次的活儿机会转瞬而逝，确保你别错过它。
spacecargo_illegal_timed_0006.english: This job's got a narrow window of opportunity. See that you don't miss it.

spacecargo_legal_danger_0001.chinese: 接近任务区域的时候请保持警惕，该区域内有不法分子活动。
spacecargo_legal_danger_0001.english: When approaching the site, stay alert. Outlaws have been known to operate in that area.

spacecargo_legal_danger_0002.chinese: 我相信你能处理好意料之外的麻烦。
spacecargo_legal_danger_0002.english: If you run into any trouble, I'm trusting you can handle yourself.

spacecargo_legal_danger_0003.chinese: 安全部门近期针对该区域内的海盗活动发布了安全警告，请知悉。请采取适当的预防措施。
spacecargo_legal_danger_0003.english: You should know that security's warned of increased outlaw activity in the area. Take the appropriate precautions.

spacecargo_legal_danger_0004.chinese: 注意保持警惕，这里是臭名昭著的法外之徒寻猎场。
spacecargo_legal_danger_0004.english: Stay sharp though. That area's a known outlaw hunting ground.

spacecargo_legal_danger_0005.chinese: 有许多飞行员说该地区变得越来越危险，所以请务必小心。
spacecargo_legal_danger_0005.english: Other pilots have said that that area has gotten dangerous, so be careful.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0001.english: Time is unfortunately of the essence here.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0002.chinese: 考虑到外界因素，这次回收任务必须尽快完成。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0002.english: Due to outside elements, this retrieval must be handled quickly.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0003.chinese: 这次运输任务已经超时，因此你得赶快行动。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0003.english: This delivery is already overdue, so you will have to move fast.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0004.chinese: 客户强调了这次任务是紧急任务。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0004.english: The client has designated this as a rush job.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0005.chinese: 这是一个重要的任务，赶紧把它处理了。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0005.english: This is a priority task, so it will need to be resolved quickly.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0006.chinese: 这些货品需要尽快收回，快点开始行动吧。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0006.english: This shipment needs to be retrieved quickly, so you'll need to collect it ASAP.

spacecargo_legal_timed_0007.chinese: 这次任务的机会转瞬而逝，确保你别错过它。
spacecargo_legal_timed_0007.english: This job's got a narrow window of opportunity. See that you don't miss it.

spacecollect_cargo_obj_long_01.chinese: 前往 ~mission(Location) 进行回收任务。

spacecollect_cargo_obj_long_02.english: Retrieve the shipment of ~mission(Item) from the wreck.

spacesteal_danger_0001.chinese: 如果他们打算暴力反抗的话，做好把他们干掉的准备。
spacesteal_danger_0001.english: If they end up putting up any kind of fight, be ready to put them down.

spacesteal_danger_0002.chinese: 要是有人找你麻烦，直接干掉他们。懂?
spacesteal_danger_0002.english: Anyone gives you any trouble out there, you drop them. Understand?

spacesteal_danger_0003.chinese: 这是艘民用船，但你一样要做好战斗准备。
spacesteal_danger_0003.english: This is a civvy ship, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't be ready to fight.

spacesteal_danger_0004.chinese: 不清楚目标船是否有护航，做好万全准备。
spacesteal_danger_0004.english: Not sure if the ship's gonna have escorts or not, so be ready for anything.

spacesteal_danger_0005.chinese: 我不认为 ~mission(TargetName|Last) 会给你带来太多麻烦。他们一般都是单独行动，就算是他们带着朋友，也不会太多。
spacesteal_danger_0005.english: I don't expect ~mission(TargetName|Last) to give you much trouble. They usually fly solo and if they do drag along friends, it's not much.

spacesteal_obj_long_02.chinese: 在他们带着货跑路之前拿下 ~mission(TargetName|Last)。
spacesteal_obj_long_02.english: Take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) before they can escape with the goods.

spacesteal_timed_0001.chinese: 如此天赐良机，吾等已静候多时。因汝延误，必悔之。
spacesteal_timed_0001.english: We've been waiting for a chance this good. Hate for it to slip away because you dragged ass.

spacesteal_timed_0002.chinese: 赶紧把这事儿给整了。~mission(client)要是知道因为你拖拖拉拉而没拿到~mission(Contractor|StealItem)的话，他们可不会太高兴。
